en.concept: Initial fragments of titles and proper names
en.description: Activations cluster around unusual segmentation and repetition at the beginnings of proper names or titles (Hungary Hall, Virove), Shakespeare company names, and fragments such as An and Acc at the beginning of PubMed abstracts; no single semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: Tokenization and repeated title for Hungary
patterns.context: “Hungary Hall” is split across tokens and repeated after a newline, followed by the body text “was”.

patterns.name: Tokenization and repeated title for Virove
patterns.context: The proper name “Virove” is split into multiple tokens and repeated after consecutive newlines, followed by “is a”.

patterns.name: Shakespeare company names
patterns.context: Appears in plays, acting histories, or company names; the trigger is the proper name Shakespeare, not general medical context.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragments in medical abstract titles
patterns.context: At the beginning of PubMed abstracts or near titles: examples include the case title “A unusual case of ANA negative systemic lupus erythemat…” and several different words beginning with “Acc” (Accelerated, Accuracy, Accurate, Acculturation).

11_215.concept: 标题与专名的起始片段
11_215.description: 激活集中于专名或标题开头的异常切分与重复（Hungary Hall、Virove）、Shakespeare剧团名，以及PubMed摘要起始处的An、Acc等片段；未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: Hungary 的分词与重复标题
patterns.context: “Hungary Hall”被跨 token 切分，并在换行后重复，随后接续正文“was”。

patterns.name: Virove 的分词与重复标题
patterns.context: 专名“Virove”被拆成多个 token，在连续换行后重复，随后接续“is a”。

patterns.name: Shakespeare 公司名称
patterns.context: 出现在戏剧、演员经历或剧团名称中；触发点是专名 Shakespeare，而非一般医学语境。

patterns.name: 医学摘要标题中的词首片段
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要开头或标题附近：既有“A unusual case of ANA negative systemic lupus erythemat…”的病例标题，也有多个以“Acc”开头的不同词（Accelerated、Accuracy、Accurate、Acculturation）。

en.description: Activation is distributed across word-initial subword fragments: proper nouns in Wikipedia, Shakespeare in dramatic passages, and medical terms in PubMed titles (case、Accelerated、Accuracy/Accurate、Acculturation). It may favor title-style word beginnings or specific word forms and cannot be attributed to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns such as people’s or place names appear at the beginning of a passage or in a title; activation falls within words split into multiple tokens. The name is sometimes repeated later.

patterns.name: Case-related word in clinical case titles
patterns.context: A medical abstract title introduces a rare clinical case as a case report, followed by a diagnosis or description of the condition.

patterns.name: Accelerated in medical titles
patterns.context: An abstract title begins with Accelerated, followed by a medical term such as recovery.

patterns.name: Accuracy/Accurate in medical titles
patterns.context: An abstract title begins with Accuracy or Accurate and introduces a research topic such as measurement, use, or estimation.

patterns.name: Acculturation in medical titles
patterns.context: An abstract title begins with Acculturation, followed by a research topic such as psychopathology or groups.

patterns.name: Shakespeare company name
patterns.context: Appears as part of a company name in biographies or introductions to theatrical works; surrounding text concerns theaters, performing careers, or the context of the work.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia articles on literary figures and theater

11_215.description: 激活分散于词首切分片段：Wikipedia 中的专名，戏剧段落中的 Shakespeare，以及 PubMed 标题中的医学词汇（case、Accelerated、Accuracy/Accurate、Acculturation）。可能偏好标题式词首或特定词形，不能归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 词内切分的专名片段
patterns.context: 片段开头或标题处出现人名、地名等专名，激活落在被分成多个 token 的词内部；有时后面重复该名称。

patterns.name: 临床病例标题中的病例词
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题以病例报告形式介绍罕见临床病例，随后出现诊断或病情描述。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 Accelerated
patterns.context: 摘要标题以 Accelerated 开头，后接 recovery 等医学术语。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 Accuracy/Accurate
patterns.context: 摘要标题以 Accuracy 或 Accurate 开头，介绍测量、使用、估算等研究主题。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 Acculturation
patterns.context: 摘要标题以 Acculturation 开头，后接心理病理、群体等研究主题。

patterns.name: 莎士比亚剧团名称
patterns.context: 人物生平或戏剧作品介绍中，作为剧团名称的一部分出现；周围涉及剧院、演艺经历或作品背景。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 文艺人物与戏剧条目

en.concept: Specific word forms and title fragments
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on word-initial Acc, several subword fragments in proper nouns, and unusual case in case-report titles. Overall, it appears to respond to specific word forms or title fragments rather than a unified topic.

patterns.name: Word-initial “Acc”
patterns.context: The word-initial fragment Acc is most strongly marked, with weaker activation on following morphemes; it appears in titles or at the start of abstract text.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical paper titles and abstracts

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on consecutive subword fragments in proper nouns or personal names, sometimes repeated after a line break; they share no obvious semantic category.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of personal names
patterns.context: Names are split into multiple tokens, and activation covers part of the given name and surname; interview-title wording follows.

patterns.name: Vocabulary in case-report titles
patterns.context: A medical title describes a rare case, with the strongest activation on case; compared with nearby words such as A、NA、lupus, activation is concentrated on title wording.

11_215.description: 激活主要集中于词首 Acc、专名中若干分词片段，以及病例标题里的 unusual case；总体更像对特定词形或标题片段的响应，而非统一主题。

patterns.name: 词首「Acc」
patterns.context: 词首片段 Acc 被标记最强，后续词素也有较弱激活；出现在标题或摘要正文开头。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学论文标题及摘要

patterns.name: 专名内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或人名中的连续子词片段，部分在换行后重复；没有共同的明显语义类别。

patterns.name: 人物姓名的分词片段
patterns.context: 姓名以多个 token 分割，激活覆盖名字和姓氏的一部分；后接访谈标题字样。

patterns.name: 病例标题中的词汇
patterns.context: 医学标题中描述罕见病例，case 的激活最强；与相邻的 A、NA、lupus 等词相比，激活集中在标题用语。

en.concept: Specific English subword fragments and figure labels
en.description: Activations mainly occur on several English subword fragments at the beginning or within words (Acc, Hung, Set, iro), and also respond to patent figure labels FIG; the fragments span styles, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition evident.

patterns.name: Word-initial Acc-
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of English words that continue into different words; no shared meaning or fixed syntactic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical/biomedical paper titles or abstracts

patterns.name: Subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within proper names or words, and different fragments within the same name may trigger separately; context is insufficient to infer a unified morphological condition.

patterns.name: Figure labels
patterns.context: References to figure numbers in patent text, followed by a number and a description of the figure content.

11_215.concept: 特定英文子词片段及图号标记
11_215.description: 激活主要落在词首或词内的若干英文子词片段（Acc、Hung、Set、iro），另对专利图号 FIG 也有反应；片段跨文体，未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词首 Acc-
patterns.context: 出现在英文词首，后续组成不同词；未见同一词义或固定句法条件。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学/生物医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或词中的片段，且同一名称内部不同片段可分别触发；缺少足以归纳统一词法条件的上下文。

patterns.name: 图号标记
patterns.context: 专利文本中的图示编号引用，后接编号及对图示内容的说明。

en.concept: Local formatting and word-initial fragments in text
en.description: Responds primarily to English word-initial “Acc” across a range of academic terms; weaker activation also occurs on proper-noun fragments in Wikipedia titles and on the period in the EuroParl number “4.4.”

patterns.name: Word-initial Ac-
patterns.context: Neuron activation falls on English word-initial “Acc”; terms include Accelerated、Accuracy、Accurate、Acculturation

patterns.name: Set/on in proper nouns
patterns.context: Personal names are repeated in Wikipedia article titles and body text; activation is distributed over some of the proper noun’s tokens

patterns.name: Hung in proper nouns
patterns.context: Place names are repeated in Wikipedia article titles and body text; activation is at the beginning of the name’s first word

patterns.name: Period in a number
patterns.context: In numbers at the beginning of a sentence or entry, activation is marked on the decimal point

11_215.concept: 文本中的局部格式与词首片段
11_215.description: 主要响应英文词首“Acc”，涵盖多种学术词项；另对维基百科标题中的专名片段及EuroParl编号“4.4”的点号有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 词首 Ac-
patterns.context: 神经元激活落在英文词首的“Acc”上；词项包括 Accelerated、Accuracy、Accurate、Acculturation

patterns.name: 专名中的 Set/on
patterns.context: 维基百科条目标题与正文重复人名，激活分布在专名的部分 token 上

patterns.name: 专名中的 Hung
patterns.context: 维基百科条目标题与正文重复地名，激活在名称首词的词首

patterns.name: 编号中的点号
patterns.context: 句首或条目开头的编号中，激活标在小数点上

en.description: All fragments are symbolic algebra from DM Mathematics, centered on polynomials or products composed of variable powers and coefficients; some also include expansion or factorization instructions, expansion results, or questions about third derivatives.

patterns.name: Variables multiplied by powers
patterns.context: Different powers of variables recur in polynomial expansions or expressions to be expanded; sometimes followed by a result or an “Expand” prompt
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, symbolic algebra and polynomial expansion

patterns.name: Expansion instructions or answer markers
patterns.context: An expansion instruction or apparent expansion result follows a complex algebraic expression; answer formats vary.
patterns.domain: Mathematical solutions and symbolic computation text

patterns.name: Factorization instruction
patterns.context: The English command Factor follows a polynomial expression and requests factorization

patterns.name: Derivative question
patterns.context: A natural-language question about the third derivative follows a polynomial expression; the preceding expression contains powers of f

patterns.name: Multiplication or division coefficients in power expressions
patterns.context: Powers of letter variables are preceded by fractional or integer coefficients in polynomials to be simplified or differentiated
patterns.domain: Symbolic algebra; polynomials with fractional coefficients

11_215.description: 所有片段均为 DM Mathematics 中的符号代数，集中出现变量幂次与系数构成的多项式或乘积；部分还带展开、因式分解指令、展开结果或三阶导数提问。

patterns.name: 变量与幂相乘
patterns.trigger: 变量字母后接 «**»，并出现如 «i**4»、«k**2»、«o**3»、«f**7»、«d**5»，常伴随系数与加减项
patterns.context: 多项式展开式或待展开表达式中，变量的不同幂次重复出现；有时接着出现结果或“Expand”提示
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，符号代数与多项式展开

patterns.name: 展开题指令或答案标记
patterns.trigger: «Expand»；以及换行后的 «-» 接数字、系数与幂项，如 «-1434*k**4»、«-7946*d**5»
patterns.context: 复杂代数表达式后出现展开指令或疑似展开结果；答案格式并不完全一致
patterns.domain: 数学题解与符号计算文本

patterns.name: 因式分解指令
patterns.context: 多项式表达式后出现英文命令 Factor，要求因式分解

patterns.name: 导数提问
patterns.context: 多项式表达式后以自然语言询问三阶导数，前面的式子含 f 的幂次项

patterns.name: 幂次结构中的乘除系数
patterns.context: 字母变量的幂项前带分数或整数系数，处于待化简或求导的多项式中
patterns.domain: 符号代数；分式系数多项式

en.description: Activations cluster around symbolic algebra in DM Mathematics problems: especially polynomial differentiation, but also factorization, combining like terms, product expansion or coefficient matching, and a few questions about a specific digit of an integer.

patterns.name: Exponential powers in algebraic differentiation problems
patterns.context: A differentiation instruction follows a polynomial expression, or a differentiation question appears next to its answer; common elements include variable powers, coefficients, and additive or subtractive terms.

patterns.name: Polynomial simplification or factorization
patterns.context: An algebraic expression involving variable powers is to be simplified by combining like terms or factorized; the fragment may also include adjacent problems.

patterns.name: Polynomial product expansion and coefficient matching
patterns.context: Connects a product of factors or an expression with a target polynomial form; the specific operation is not fully clear in the fragment.

patterns.name: Digit-place questions
patterns.context: Asks for a particular digit in a number defined by a variable expression; context includes integers and arithmetic expressions.

11_215.concept: 数学代数表达式与运算
11_215.description: 激活集中于DM数学题中的符号代数：尤其是多项式求导，也包括因式分解、合并同类项、乘积展开或系数匹配，以及少量询问整数特定位数的题目。

patterns.name: 代数式求导题中的指数幂
patterns.trigger: “second derivative”“third derivative”“Differentiate”“wrt”“with respect to”，以及代数式中的“*变量**指数”
patterns.context: 多项式表达式后接求导指令，或求导问题与其答案相邻；常见变量幂、系数和加减项。

patterns.name: 多项式整理或因式分解
patterns.trigger: “Collect the terms”“Factor”，以及带重复同类项或乘积因子的多项式
patterns.context: 围绕变量幂的代数式要求合并同类项或因式分解，片段也可能包含相邻题目。

patterns.name: 多项式乘积展开与系数匹配
patterns.context: 将因式乘积或表达式与目标多项式形式联系起来；具体操作在片段中不完全明确。

patterns.name: 数字位数问题
patterns.context: 询问由变量表达式定义的数中某一位数字；上下文含整数与运算式。

en.description: Activations span mathematical digit problems and expressions, document labels/statuses/Chinese comments in code, and image-reference labels and section divider lines in papers; they primarily reflect structured text markers and field boundaries, with specific triggers varying by context.

patterns.name: Specific digit-number puzzles
patterns.context: A math problem or expression asks about a digit place or contains a number expression with variable k; there is no evidence that the neuron responds only to a particular number or operation

patterns.name: Documentation labels in code comments
patterns.context: Labels beginning with @ in code documentation comments, often accompanied by class, package, or return-type descriptions

patterns.name: OK markers in code
patterns.context: Repeated OK status markers in code or test-related text, followed by numbers and expressions

patterns.name: Chinese noun comments in code
patterns.context: Chinese natural-language explanations embedded in code comments or documentation; activations fall on multiple Chinese words

patterns.name: Image references and numbered labels
patterns.context: Repeated Markdown image references in PubMed Central text, with filenames, figure/subfigure identifiers, and numbers; activations often cover filename fragments and labels
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper figure references or converted Markdown

patterns.name: Section heading divider lines
patterns.context: Section headings in paper body text followed by divider lines made of equals signs; strongest activations fall on the divider lines

11_215.description: 激活跨数学位数题与算式、代码中的文档标签/状态/中文注释，以及论文中的图像引用标签和章节分隔线；主要呈现结构化文本标记与字段边界，具体触发形式因语境而异。

patterns.name: 特定位数数字谜题
patterns.trigger: «hundred»、« digit»、« units»、« of»，以及算式中的 «*»、«k»、«+»
patterns.context: 数学题或算式中出现数字位数提问，或含变量 k 的数字表达式；没有证据表明神经元只对某个特定数字或运算反应

patterns.name: 代码注释中的文档标签
patterns.context: 代码文档注释中以 @ 开头的标签，常伴随类、包或返回类型说明

patterns.name: 代码中的 OK 标记
patterns.context: 代码或测试相关文本中重复出现的 OK 状态标记，后接编号及表达式

patterns.name: 代码中的中文名词注释
patterns.context: 代码注释或文档中嵌入中文自然语言说明；激活落在多个中文词上

patterns.name: 图像引用与编号标签
patterns.context: PubMed Central 文本中重复的 Markdown 图像引用，带有文件名、图表/子图标识和编号；激活常覆盖文件名碎片与标签
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的图表引用或转换后的 Markdown

patterns.name: 章节标题分隔线
patterns.context: 论文正文中的章节标题及其下方由等号组成的分隔线；最强激活落在分隔线上

en.concept: PMC paper image and methods formatting markers
en.description: Primarily responds to image markers, image filenames and their medical journal abbreviations, numeric/hyphenated identifiers, and sp numeric attributes in PMC text; the eighth segment responds to scans, absorption corrections, instrument names, and symbolic parameters in crystallographic methods, possibly a different pattern.

patterns.name: Image markers and their attributes
patterns.context: Triggers occur in Markdown image markers and subsequent number, caption/page-style attributes; often appear as consecutive image markers separated by newlines.
patterns.domain: Extracted or typeset text from PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Medical journal name fragments
patterns.context: These fragments are embedded in image filenames or strings resembling journal abbreviations, usually adjacent to numbers, hyphens, and image markers; they should not be treated as medical terms in ordinary body text.

patterns.name: Numbers and hyphens in image filenames
patterns.context: Number sequences and hyphens form part of image file identifiers, appearing with journal name fragments and `![](` in filenames; activations are distributed across multiple numeric fragments.

patterns.name: Figure numbers and page-style numbers
patterns.context: Appear in attributes following image filenames, formatted as identifiers and decimal numbers; activations occur around the decimal point, numbers, and `sp`.
patterns.domain: Paper image metadata/page or plate labels

patterns.name: Scanning and absorption correction terminology
patterns.context: Appears in technical body text describing scan parameters and absorption correction; differs from the image-file marker pattern.

patterns.name: Angle and parameter symbols
patterns.context: Experimental parameter lines composed of symbols, numbers, and units, adjacent to scan and correction information.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods or instrument parameter tables

11_215.concept: PMC论文图像与方法排版标记
11_215.description: 主要响应PMC文本中的图像标记、图像文件名及其医学期刊缩写、数字/连字符编号和sp数字属性；第8段则响应晶体学方法中的扫描、吸收校正、仪器名及符号参数，可能是不同模式。

patterns.name: 图像标记及其属性
patterns.context: 触发点出现在图像 Markdown 标记及其后的编号、图注/页码样式属性中；多为连续图像标记，换行分隔。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文的抽取或排版文本

patterns.name: 医学期刊名片段
patterns.context: 这些片段嵌在图像文件名或类似期刊缩写的字符串中，通常与数字、连字符及图像标记相邻；不应视为普通正文中的医学术语。
patterns.domain: 医学论文图像文件名/期刊缩写

patterns.name: 图像文件名中的数字与连字符
patterns.context: 数字序列和连字符构成图像文件标识的一部分，与期刊名片段及 `![](` 同处文件名；激活分布在多个数字片段上。

patterns.name: 图号与页码式数字
patterns.context: 出现在图像文件名后的属性中，呈现为编号和带小数点的数字；小数点、数字及 `sp` 周边均有激活。
patterns.domain: 论文图像元数据/页码或图版标注

patterns.name: 扫描与吸收校正术语
patterns.context: 出现在技术性正文中，描述扫描参数和吸收校正；与图像文件标记模式不同。

patterns.name: 角度与参数符号
patterns.context: 以符号、数值和单位组成实验参数行，与扫描及校正信息相邻。
patterns.domain: 实验方法或仪器参数表

en.description: Activations occur at word-segment boundaries across various formats: proper names, code identifiers, medical variants and compound terms, as well as table numbers, punctuation, template attributes, and patent terminology; the shared feature appears to be segmentation boundaries in structured text.

patterns.name: Internal capitalization boundaries in proper names
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple tokens, with activations on segments of names or terms; sometimes adjacent to punctuation, code symbols, or numbers
patterns.domain: Paper author addresses, medical text, code

patterns.name: Markers and table numbers in structured documents
patterns.context: Medical paper fragments with tables or citation markers, dense with numbers, spaces, periods, and parentheses

patterns.name: Code identifiers and their tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Identifiers in code are split into segments, often accompanied by underscores, scope symbols, templates, or method names

patterns.name: HTML/template and attribute syntax
patterns.context: In HTML attributes or template syntax, markers, quotation marks, colons, and arrows appear next to attribute values

patterns.name: Medical variant and transcript notation
patterns.context: Exons, transcript numbers, and nucleotide substitution notation mix numbers and punctuation with letters

patterns.name: Patent-style multimedia claims
patterns.context: Claim language lists network devices, content servers, access counts, and decryption keys

patterns.name: Biomedical abbreviations and research terminology
patterns.context: Abbreviations, compound words, and hyphenated terms appear in medical research paragraphs or tables
patterns.domain: Clinical research and NIH project abstracts

patterns.name: Author name and address fields
patterns.context: Institutional city, state, or country addresses follow author names and are separated by commas and line breaks

11_215.concept: 结构化文本的词段边界
11_215.description: 激活分布于多种格式的词段边界：专名、代码标识符、医学变异和复合术语，以及表格数字、标点、模板属性和专利术语；共同点偏向结构化文本中的切分边界。

patterns.name: 专名内部的大小写边界
patterns.context: 词被拆成多个 token，激活落在名称或术语的部分词段上；有时邻接标点、代码符号或数字
patterns.domain: 论文作者地址、医学文本、代码

patterns.name: 结构化文档中的标记与表格数字
patterns.context: 表格或带引用标记的医学论文片段，数字、空格、句点和括号密集出现

patterns.name: 代码标识符及其分词边界
patterns.context: 代码中的标识符被拆分为词段，常伴随下划线、作用域符号、模板或方法名
patterns.domain: Github 代码及 API 文档

patterns.name: HTML/模板与属性语法
patterns.context: HTML 属性或模板语法中，标记、引号、冒号和箭头与属性值相邻

patterns.name: 医学变异与转录本记法
patterns.context: 外显子、转录本编号及核苷酸替换写法中，数字和标点夹杂字母

patterns.name: 专利式多媒体权利要求
patterns.context: 权利要求句式列举网络设备、内容服务器、访问次数及解密密钥

patterns.name: 生物医学缩写与研究术语
patterns.context: 医学研究段落或表格中出现缩写、复合词及连字符术语
patterns.domain: 临床研究与 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 作者姓名和地址字段
patterns.context: 作者署名后的机构城市、州或国家地址，以逗号和换行分隔

en.description: Activations cluster around stress/distress and their hyphenated compounds, also covering PTSD and disease- or health-outcome-related expressions; they also occur in injury narratives, casual conversation, and various medical contexts, making it difficult to attribute them to a single strict semantic feature.

patterns.name: Emotional distress and stress
patterns.context: Descriptions of psychological stress, emotional distress, or related symptoms; also includes mentions of stress in general conversation.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, online posts, medical and health research

patterns.name: Compound expressions of stress and inducing factors
patterns.context: Stress combines with words such as induced or associated in hyphenated modifiers describing stress-induced or stress-associated diseases, reactions, and biological processes.

patterns.name: Post-traumatic stress disorder terminology
patterns.context: Diagnostic or literature review language mentioning posttraumatic stress disorder and similar symptoms.

patterns.name: Related compounds for diseases and treatment
patterns.context: Related forms hyphenated compounds with diseases, symptoms, or health outcomes; some examples also involve distress or symptoms.
patterns.domain: Medical and health research, clinical outcome descriptions

patterns.name: Broad unexplained activations
patterns.context: Activations occur in legal injury narratives, office conversations, and various medical terms, with no single, more specific semantic condition explaining them.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, online posts, medical papers

11_215.description: 激活集中于 stress/distress 及其连字符复合词，也覆盖 PTSD、疾病或健康结局相关表达；此外在伤害叙述、闲聊和多种医学语境中都有激活，难以归结为单一严格语义特征。

patterns.name: 情绪困扰与压力
patterns.context: 心理压力、情绪困扰或相关症状的描述；也包括一般口语中提到 stress。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、网络帖子、医学与健康研究

patterns.name: stress 与诱发因素的复合表达
patterns.context: stress 与 induced 或 associated 等词以连字符构成复合修饰语，描述压力诱发或相关的疾病、反应和生物过程。

patterns.name: 创伤后应激障碍术语
patterns.context: 出现 posttraumatic stress disorder 及其类似症状的诊断或文献综述表述。

patterns.name: 疾病与治疗的 related 复合表达
patterns.trigger: “cancer-related emotional distress”“alcohol-related liver disease”“oral-related symptoms”“health-related quality of life”
patterns.context: related 与疾病、症状或健康结局构成连字符复合修饰语；部分例子同时涉及 distress 或症状。
patterns.domain: 医学与健康研究、临床结局描述

patterns.name: 未解释的广泛激活
patterns.trigger: 除上述压力、应激或 related 复合表达外，没有明确共同触发子串
patterns.context: 激活分布于法律伤害叙述、办公室闲聊及多种医学术语中，无法由单一更具体语义条件解释。
patterns.domain: 法律、网络帖子、医学论文

en.description: Responds mainly to medical or hazard descriptions of serious risks, diseases, and complications, especially “serious” and neurological consequences; it also covers text on disease treatment, epidemiology, and experimental mechanisms. Strong activation also occurs on an immune-related table passage, which is difficult to fit into a shared semantic category.

patterns.name: serious risk / disease / complications
patterns.context: Evaluative wording describing a severe hazard, outcome, or health condition; strongest recurring pattern is “serious” in “serious neurological problems,” “serious risk hazard,” “serious injury,” “serious complications,” “most serious disease,” and “serious radiological accident.”
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical abstracts and project descriptions, encyclopedia narrative

patterns.name: neurological disease or problems
patterns.context: Neurological effects appear as disease consequences or model phenotypes; accompanied by severity terms (“severe” or “serious”).

patterns.name: disease conditions and treatment
patterns.context: Disease is discussed in terms of causes, treatment eligibility, incidence, burden, complications, or experimental models; not always paired with “serious.”
patterns.domain: Patent background, public health and medical research

patterns.name: angiogenesis-dependent disease wording
patterns.context: Patent prose specifying a subset of diseases or conditions treatable by an invention.

patterns.name: tabular immunophenotype and statistics
patterns.context: A compact biomedical table listing cell-marker groups, case counts, and an average proliferation statistic; no clear shared trigger with the prose patterns.

patterns.name: RSV-induced disease mechanism
patterns.context: Research aims describe immune-cell roles and mechanisms in disease progression and resolution.

patterns.name: unexplained strong activation on table formatting
patterns.context: Activation occurs in structured tabular text, but the displayed snippet does not establish a reliable semantic or lexical link to the other patterns.

11_215.description: 主要响应严重风险、疾病及其并发症等医学/危害描述，尤其“serious”及神经系统后果；也覆盖疾病治疗、流行病学和实验机制文本。另对一段免疫表格强烈激活，难以归入共同语义。

patterns.name: serious risk / disease / complications
patterns.context: Evaluative wording describing a severe hazard, outcome, or health condition; strongest recurring pattern is “serious” in “serious neurological problems,” “serious risk hazard,” “serious injury,” “serious complications,” “most serious disease,” and “serious radiological accident.”
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学摘要与项目描述、百科叙述

patterns.name: neurological disease or problems
patterns.context: Neurological effects appear as disease consequences or model phenotypes; accompanied by severity terms (“severe” or “serious”).

patterns.name: disease conditions and treatment
patterns.context: Disease is discussed in terms of causes, treatment eligibility, incidence, burden, complications, or experimental models; not always paired with “serious.”
patterns.domain: 专利背景、公共卫生与医学研究

patterns.name: angiogenesis-dependent disease wording
patterns.context: Patent prose specifying a subset of diseases or conditions treatable by an invention.

patterns.name: tabular immunophenotype and statistics
patterns.context: A compact biomedical table listing cell-marker groups, case counts, and an average proliferation statistic; no clear shared trigger with the prose patterns.

patterns.name: RSV-induced disease mechanism
patterns.trigger: “RSV-induced disease” and “exacerbation of allergic airway disease”
patterns.context: Research aims describe immune-cell roles and mechanisms in disease progression and resolution.

patterns.name: unexplained strong activation on table formatting
patterns.trigger: “Total average”, dashed separators, and table entries
patterns.context: Activation occurs in structured tabular text, but the displayed snippet does not establish a reliable semantic or lexical link to the other patterns.

en.description: Activations occur in medical text about severe disease outcomes, clinical causes and treatments, eye injuries, and labor pain, as well as medical paper titles/headers; they also appear in legal harm and compensation and in immune mechanism research. Medical table formatting may be an independent trigger.

patterns.name: High-risk or severe outcomes in disease descriptions
patterns.context: Medical text emphasizes the severity and consequences of disease, pain, or harm; legal text describes emotional harm.

patterns.name: Medical table or section heading format
patterns.context: Section headings, table titles, or case-characteristic headers in medical papers, often accompanied by Markdown markers, line breaks, and alignment spaces.

patterns.name: Ophthalmic diagnoses and injury prevention
patterns.context: Discusses common diagnoses at presentation and ways to reduce eye injuries and improve post-injury care.

patterns.name: Causes, testing, and treatment response in medicine
patterns.context: Describes tests to diagnose disease causes, or patient responses to treatment and remission, followed by case data.
patterns.domain: Clinical medical abstracts and case studies

patterns.name: Damages and compensation in legal texts
patterns.context: Describes compensation items, damages, or grounds for claims in legal rulings or litigation statements.

patterns.name: Low back pain and labor
patterns.context: Clinical trials describe pain during the first stage of labor and pain-relief interventions.

patterns.name: Disease mechanisms and immune responses
patterns.context: Research objective statements on immune cells, inflammation, or disease remission mechanisms.
patterns.domain: Immunology research abstracts or project descriptions

11_215.description: 激活出现于医学文本中的严重疾病结局、临床病因与治疗、眼伤及产痛，也见医学论文标题/表头；另见法律损害与赔偿、免疫机制研究。医学表格格式可能是独立触发因素。

patterns.name: 疾病表述中的高风险或严重结局
patterns.context: 医学文本中强调疾病、疼痛或损害的严重性及其后果；法律文本中描述情绪损害。

patterns.name: 医学表格或小节标题格式
patterns.context: 医学论文中小节标题、表格标题或病例特征表头，常伴随 Markdown 标记、换行和对齐空格。

patterns.name: 眼科诊断及伤害预防
patterns.context: 讨论就诊时的常见诊断，以及减少眼部伤害和改善伤后就医。

patterns.name: 医学中的病因、检测与治疗反应
patterns.trigger: « detection»« of»« specific»« IgE»；« cause»« of»« ur»«tic»«aria»；« response»；« remission»
patterns.context: 描述诊断病因的检测，或患者对治疗的反应与缓解，并接续病例数据。
patterns.domain: 临床医学摘要及病例研究

patterns.name: 法律文本中的损害赔偿
patterns.trigger: « compensation»« for»« all»« damages»；« intentional»« infliction»« of»« emotional»« distress»
patterns.context: 法律裁决或诉讼陈述中描述赔偿项目、损害或索赔理由。

patterns.name: 低背痛与分娩
patterns.context: 临床试验描述分娩第一阶段的疼痛及止痛干预。

patterns.name: 疾病机制与免疫反应
patterns.trigger: « RSV»«-»«induced»« disease»；« allergic»« airway»« disease»；« immune»« response»
patterns.context: 研究免疫细胞、炎症或疾病缓解机制的研究目标陈述。
patterns.domain: 免疫学研究摘要或项目描述

en.concept: Disease or injury and its consequences
en.description: Activation includes claims for emotional distress in legal texts, disease or injury and their consequences in medical research, and formatting in medical document titles and tables; the triggering forms are not consistent across groups.

patterns.name: Legal claims for emotional distress
patterns.context: Legal rulings discuss causes of action, whether claims are sufficiently pleaded, or case transfer; activation is concentrated around “of emotional distress.”

patterns.name: Inflammation, pain, or disease mechanisms
patterns.context: Medical research describes mechanisms and effects of disease, inflammation, pain, or cytotoxicity; activation often falls near “induced” or related pathological phrases.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, medical paper abstracts

patterns.name: Complications and consequences of injury
patterns.context: Describes the occurrence of clinical complications, injuries, and their consequences; trigger words vary but all occur in descriptions of risk or outcomes.

patterns.name: Titles or table formatting in structured medical documents
patterns.context: Activation occurs in paper section headings, table titles, or layout separators, rather than in the semantics of continuous prose.

11_215.description: 激活包括法律文本中的情绪困扰诉因、医学研究中的疾病或损伤及其后果，以及医学文档标题和表格排版；各组触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: 情绪困扰的法律诉因
patterns.trigger: “infliction of emotional distress”（[1] 为 “intentional infliction of emotional distress”；[4] 为 “outrageous infliction of emotional distress”）
patterns.context: 法律判决中讨论诉因、主张是否充分或案件是否移送；激活集中于 “of emotional distress” 附近。

patterns.name: 炎症、疼痛或疾病机制
patterns.context: 医学研究中描述疾病、炎症、疼痛或细胞毒性的机制与效应；激活常落在 “induced” 前后或相关病理短语附近。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、医学论文摘要

patterns.name: 并发症及伤害后果
patterns.context: 描述临床并发症出现、伤害发生及其后果；触发词不完全一致，但都处在风险或后果叙述中。

patterns.name: 结构化医学文档中的标题或表格排版
patterns.trigger: “Conflicts of Interest”“Etiologies”“Diagnosis”“Clinicopathological features”及其周围换行、Markdown 标记和空格（[5]、[10]）
patterns.context: 激活出现在论文的章节标题、表格标题或版面分隔处，而非连续正文语义中。

en.description: Mainly occurs in medical/biomedical text involving pain, inflammation, immunodeficiency, infection, cellular mechanisms, and eye symptoms; also activates on medical disclaimers and ADA and emotional-harm language in legal text.

patterns.name: Sickle cell disease and pain
patterns.context: Acute sickle cell episodes, chronic pain, and worsening pain with age in patients with SCD.

patterns.name: Immunodeficiency and adenosine metabolism
patterns.context: Discusses severe combined immunodeficiency caused by ADA deficiency and thymocyte differentiation.

patterns.name: Inflammation, infection, and related disease mechanisms
patterns.context: Research on infection-related lung injury/ARDS, inflammation-induced pain, DSS colitis, and inflammatory genes.

patterns.name: TLR and trophoblast cells
patterns.context: Research on trophoblast cell responses to bacterial or viral components, TLR regulation, and apoptosis.

patterns.name: ADA legal abbreviation and discrimination claims
patterns.context: Gender discrimination, state-law claims, and emotional-harm claims in an ADA context; here ADA is a legal abbreviation, not an enzyme.

patterns.name: Medical disclaimers and care advice
patterns.context: States that information is for educational purposes only and cannot replace diagnosis, treatment, or a doctor's advice.

patterns.name: Cell senescence and molecular pathways
patterns.context: Discusses RD-triggered cell senescence and related proteins and genetic knockdown evidence.

patterns.name: Eye allergy symptoms
patterns.context: Describes symptoms of eye disease or allergies, such as redness, itching, tearing, discharge, and burning pain.

11_215.description: 主要出现在医学/生物医学文本中，涉及疼痛、炎症、免疫缺陷、感染、细胞机制及眼症状；也激活于医学免责声明和法律文本中的ADA及情绪伤害措辞。

patterns.name: Sickle cell disease与疼痛
patterns.context: SCD患者的急性镰状细胞发作、慢性疼痛及其随年龄加重。

patterns.name: 免疫缺陷与腺苷代谢
patterns.context: 讨论ADA缺乏导致严重联合免疫缺陷，以及胸腺细胞分化。

patterns.name: 炎症、感染及相关疾病机制
patterns.context: 研究感染相关肺损伤/ARDS、炎症诱发疼痛、DSS结肠炎及炎症基因。
patterns.domain: 医学与实验生物学研究

patterns.name: TLR与滋养层细胞
patterns.context: 研究滋养层细胞对细菌或病毒成分的反应、TLR调控及凋亡。

patterns.name: ADA法律缩写及歧视诉讼
patterns.trigger: “under the ADA”、«sex»2« discrimination»、«intentional»3« infliction» of «emotional»9« distress»
patterns.context: ADA语境中的性别歧视、州法诉求及情绪伤害主张；此处ADA是法律缩写而非酶。

patterns.name: 医学免责声明与诊疗建议
patterns.context: 声明信息仅供教育用途，不能替代诊断、治疗或医生建议。

patterns.name: 细胞衰老与分子通路
patterns.context: 讨论RD触发的细胞衰老以及相关蛋白、遗传敲低证据。

patterns.name: 眼部过敏症状
patterns.context: 描述眼部疾病或过敏的红、痒、流泪、分泌物及烧灼痛等症状。

en.description: Activation occurs in legal contexts involving injury and emotional distress, as well as biomedical text on induction/triggering mechanisms, inflammation and immunity, cellular responses, and stress regulation. It also covers vitamin D deficiency and sweetener research, without forming a single stable lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Legal wording related to emotional/psychological harm
patterns.context: Legal text describes conduct that harms children or names a tort/state-law cause of action; activation is concentrated near words such as injury, emotional, and distress.

patterns.name: Inductive mechanisms and pathological outcomes
patterns.context: Biomedical text uses relationships such as induction, mediation, or triggering to explain mechanisms and their disease, pain, or cellular outcomes.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and NIH research text

patterns.name: Neural/physiological regulation and stress
patterns.context: Research plans treat working memory, arousal, and stress regulation as research constructs to be measured.

patterns.name: Immune inflammation and cellular responses
patterns.context: Describes cytokines, immune-related cells or receptors, and cellular function, survival, and inflammatory responses.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Vitamin D deficiency
patterns.context: Clinical characteristics or nutritional deficiency descriptions in cohorts of leprosy patients.

patterns.name: Artificial sweeteners and oxidative status
patterns.context: Animal studies describe research aims concerning sweeteners’ effects on blood glucose, blood lipids, and red blood cell oxidative status.

11_215.concept: 健康损害与生物医学效应
11_215.description: 激活见于法律语境中的伤害、情绪困扰，也见于生物医学文本中的诱导/触发机制、炎症免疫、细胞反应及应激调节；另覆盖维生素D缺乏和甜味剂研究，未形成单一稳定的词面模式。

patterns.name: 情绪/精神损害相关法律措辞
patterns.trigger: “inflict”与“physical injury or mental or emotional injury”（[1]）；“intentional infliction of emotional distress”（[2]）
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述对儿童造成伤害的行为，或作为侵权/州法诉因名称；激活集中在 injury、emotional、distress 等词附近。

patterns.name: 诱导性机制与病理结果
patterns.context: 生物医学文本以诱导、介导或触发等关系说明机制及其疾病、疼痛或细胞结果。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及 NIH 研究文本

patterns.name: 神经/生理调节与应激
patterns.context: 研究计划中将工作记忆、唤醒及应激调节作为待测量的研究构念。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter，精神病风险研究计划

patterns.name: 免疫炎症与细胞反应
patterns.context: 描述细胞因子、免疫相关细胞或受体，以及细胞功能、存活与炎症反应。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 维生素 D 缺乏
patterns.context: 麻风病患者群体的临床特征或营养缺乏描述。

patterns.name: 人工甜味剂与氧化状态
patterns.context: 动物研究描述甜味剂对血糖、血脂及红细胞氧化状态的研究目的。

en.concept: Relations and effects in narrative text
en.description: Activation concentrates on expressions describing pathological processes, effects, and their relationships in medical texts, especially structures such as “of”, “induced”, and “in”; it also responds to narratives about patients or parties in legal claims, allergy testing cases, and identification of clinical beneficiaries.

patterns.name: “of” and related disease or process structures
patterns.context: Appears near expressions of relationships involving pathological processes, effects, or mechanisms in scientific abstracts or medical grant projects; common structures include “X-induced Y”, “role in …”, or “of …”.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts and project descriptions

patterns.name: Legal claims and findings
patterns.context: Describes parties’ failure to present sufficient claims or evidence in legal decisions, especially discrimination and tort claims.

patterns.name: Allergen testing and patient outcomes
patterns.context: Case narratives report allergy history, skin prick tests, and allergen sensitization results.

patterns.name: Identifying beneficiaries in clinical trials
patterns.context: Discusses how testing or trials before and after treatment identify patients who may respond or benefit from treatment.

11_215.description: 激活集中于医学文本中描述病理过程、效应及其关系的表达，尤其是“of”“induced”“in”等结构；另对法律诉请、过敏检测病例和临床获益者识别中的患者/当事人叙述有反应。

patterns.name: “of”及其疾病或过程关联结构
patterns.context: 科学摘要或医学资助项目中，出现在病理过程、效应或机制的关系表达附近；常见“X-induced Y”“role in …”或“of …”结构。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要与项目描述

patterns.name: 法律诉请与认定
patterns.context: 法律判决中描述当事人未能提出充分主张或证据，尤其是歧视及侵权诉请。

patterns.name: 过敏原检测与患者结果
patterns.context: 病例叙述中报告过敏病史、皮肤点刺测试及过敏原致敏结果。

patterns.name: 临床试验中的受益者识别
patterns.context: 讨论治疗前后检测或试验如何识别可能响应、从治疗中获益的患者。

en.description: Activation is distributed across medical, legal, and experimental text: prominent themes include experiencing symptoms or injury, pain and its hyphenated compounds, as well as TNF/cellular mechanisms, stress-related disease names, neuropsychological constructs, qPCR tables, and prevention and treatment recommendations.

patterns.name: Victimization, symptoms, and injury in medical or legal contexts
patterns.context: Describes individuals experiencing disease, symptoms, or physical or psychological harm; legal passages emphasize serious medical needs, alongside child-injury provisions and descriptions of allergic symptoms.

patterns.name: Pain-related terms and behaviors
patterns.context: Pain and its hyphenated compound modifiers in research on pain or pain sensitivity; often adjacent to behavior, stimuli, inflammation, or treatment effects.

patterns.name: Hyphenated names of stress or disease conditions
patterns.context: Hyphenated compound condition, etiology, or disease-abbreviation names in biomedical text, especially phrases formed with stress, related, induced, and similar terms.
patterns.domain: Medical and life sciences papers, grant applications

patterns.name: TNF and cellular biology mechanisms
patterns.context: Inflammation, cell death/survival, or stress pathways described alongside TNF, cellular processes, and molecular regulation.

patterns.name: Neuropsychological and physiological regulation constructs
patterns.context: In studies of individuals at risk for psychosis, cognitive function, arousal, and stress regulation are treated as measurement constructs.

patterns.name: IFN-qPCR markers in gene-testing tables
patterns.context: qPCR entries for IFNα/IFNβ co-occur with primer sequences and blank columns in tables or experimental records.

patterns.name: Conduct causing harm in legal provisions
patterns.context: Legal provisions specify that a guardian or other person intentionally causes or permits physical, psychological, or emotional harm to a child.

patterns.name: Management and prevention recommendations
patterns.context: Explains that a disease has no cure but can be managed through appropriate prevention and treatment.

11_215.description: 激活分散于医学、法律和实验文本：突出遭受症状或伤害、疼痛及其连字符复合词，也涉及TNF/细胞机制、应激疾病名称、神经心理构念、qPCR表格和预防治疗建议。

patterns.name: 医学或法律语境中的受害、症状与损伤
patterns.trigger: « suffered»5« from»3« a»6« "»5«serious»7« medical»9« need»（[2]）；« suffer»5« from»4« allergic»3« symptoms»（[8]）；« injury»« or»« mental»« or»« emotional» injury（[5]）
patterns.context: 描述个体遭受疾病、症状或身体、心理伤害；法律段落强调严重医疗需求，另有儿童受伤条款与过敏症状介绍。

patterns.name: pain相关术语及行为
patterns.context: 疼痛或痛觉敏感性研究中，pain及其连字符复合修饰语；常与行为、刺激、炎症或治疗效果相邻。

patterns.name: 连字符连接的应激或疾病状态名称

patterns.domain: 医学与生命科学论文、资助申请

patterns.name: TNF与细胞生物学机制

patterns.name: 神经心理与生理调节构念

patterns.name: 基因检测表格中的IFN-qPCR标记

patterns.name: 法律条文中的施加伤害行为

patterns.name: Cytokines and immune signaling pathways

patterns.name: Molecular experimental markers and assays
patterns.context: Experimental assay methods, nucleic acid sequences, or molecular expression markers appear

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in medical terms

patterns.name: Intentional-injury wording in legal provisions

patterns.name: Claims of medical need in judicial decisions

patterns.name: 损伤与炎症相关医学术语

patterns.name: 细胞因子及免疫信号通路

patterns.name: 医学术语词内片段

patterns.name: 法律条文中的故意伤害表述

en.description: Patterns include biomedical experimental labels, immune/cytokine regulation, and inflammatory oxidative damage, as well as medical needs and pain diagnoses; Swedish legislative word forms also occur, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Molecular biology experiment table formatting
patterns.context: Table rows consisting of primer names, direction, sequences, or experimental assay items; activation is concentrated on primer/experiment labels and some sequence characters.

patterns.name: Factors, cellular function, and signal regulation

patterns.name: Inflammation, oxidative stress, and tissue damage
patterns.context: Describes inflammatory responses, ROS generation, tissue damage, or related pathological processes, often linked to cytokines, stress, or disease induction.

patterns.name: Disease and medical problem descriptions

patterns.domain: Legal rulings and medical epidemiology abstracts

patterns.name: Swedish political/legislative word forms
patterns.context: Compound words or morphological segmentation appear in Swedish parliamentary speeches, especially concerning legislative processes and economic governance.

11_215.description: 模式涵盖生物医学实验标签、免疫/细胞因子调控及炎症氧化损伤，也包括医疗需求与疼痛诊断；另有瑞典语立法词形，缺乏统一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 分子生物学实验表格格式

patterns.name: 因子与细胞功能、信号调控

patterns.name: 炎症、氧化应激与组织损伤
patterns.context: 描述炎症反应、ROS生成、组织损伤或相关病理过程，常与细胞因子、应激或疾病诱导相连。

patterns.name: 疾病与医学问题表述
patterns.context: 提及医疗需求、患者病症、疼痛相关诊断或临床病例；并非统一的分子机制语境。
patterns.domain: 法律判决与医学流行病学摘要

patterns.name: 瑞典语政治/立法词形
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中出现复合词或形态切分，尤其涉及立法进程与经济治理。

en.description: Primarily responds to the Swedish within-word suffix “nings” (in compounds relating to regulation, legislation, settlement, etc.); it also responds to vocabulary related to inflammation, immunity, and treatment in biomedical texts. The specific triggers in some medical passages are uncertain.

patterns.name: “nings” in Swedish compounds
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of Swedish words, especially long compound nouns or derived words, such as «lagstiftningsförfarande» and «bosättningsprogram»; the token boundary falls within the word.

patterns.name: Vocabulary related to inflammation and immune responses
patterns.context: Medical abstracts describe inflammation, infection, immune regulation, or related physiological responses; hyphenated compounds such as «inflammation-induced» and «infection-related» are common.

patterns.name: Treatment and drug response
patterns.context: Describes drug administration, efficacy, changes before and after treatment, or treatment hypotheses.
patterns.domain: Clinical and translational medicine research abstracts

patterns.name: “nings” forms in regulatory and oversight systems
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary texts discuss joint EU and China oversight systems; the word-final «nings» is also matched.

patterns.name: “nings” forms related to legislative procedures
patterns.context: An internal word segment in the Swedish term for “legislative procedure,” in a parliamentary discussion of legislative work.

patterns.name: “nings” forms related to settlement programs
patterns.context: An internal word segment in the Swedish compound for “settlement program,” appearing in an EU project title.

patterns.name: Biomedical fragments not fully explained by the patterns above
patterns.context: Includes topics such as immune markers, blood cells, or traumatic brain injury, but not all key activation positions correspond to the inflammation or treatment vocabulary described above; they may also relate to common words such as «that» and «the», which is difficult to confirm from the fragments.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and NIH project texts

11_215.description: 主要响应瑞典语词内后缀“nings”（监管、立法、定居等复合词）；另在生物医学文本中对炎症、免疫及治疗相关词汇有反应。部分医学段的具体触发词不确定。

patterns.name: 瑞典语复合词中的“nings”
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语词尾，尤其是较长复合名词或派生词中，如 «lagstiftningsförfarande»、«bosättningsprogram»；token 边界落在词内部。

patterns.name: 炎症与免疫反应词汇
patterns.context: 医学摘要描述炎症、感染、免疫调节或相关生理反应；常见连字符复合词，如 «inflammation-induced»、«infection-related»。

patterns.name: 治疗及药物反应
patterns.context: 描述药物给药、疗效、治疗前后变化或治疗假设。
patterns.domain: 临床与转化医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 监管与监督系统的“nings”词形
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中谈及 EU 与中国的共同监督系统；同样命中词尾 «nings»。

patterns.name: 立法程序相关的“nings”词形
patterns.context: 瑞典语中“立法程序”一词的内部词段，处于议会讨论立法工作的语境。

patterns.name: 定居项目相关的“nings”词形
patterns.context: 瑞典语“定居项目”复合词中的内部词段，出现在欧盟项目标题中。

patterns.name: 未被上述词汇模式充分解释的生物医学片段
patterns.context: 包含免疫指标、血液细胞或创伤性脑损伤等主题，但关键激活位置并不都对应前述炎症或治疗词汇；也可能与常见词 «that»、«the» 等有关，难以从片段确认。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要及 NIH 项目文本

en.description: Activation spans long Swedish compounds, English legal boilerplate, medical disease terms, primer-table symbols, animal-death descriptions, mathematical numbers, and URL fragments; apart from their local formatting or context, no stable shared triggering condition is evident.

patterns.name: Word-final/medial elements in Swedish compounds
patterns.context: Long compounds or words composed of multiple subword fragments are activated in Swedish parliamentary text; activation falls on internal or final fragments, with no single fixed root.

patterns.name: Specific English function words and legal boilerplate
patterns.context: A long conditional sentence in English legal text describes a court finding a dispute arbitrable and staying litigation; activation is distributed across multiple common words and legal terms.

patterns.name: Disease terms in English medical text
patterns.context: An abstract discusses endotoxin-induced mastitis and stress responses in dairy cows; activation is concentrated on disease-related words and their compound modifiers.

patterns.name: Primer-table formatting and symbols
patterns.context: A primer table in a paper’s methods section includes Markdown bolding, column headings, primer sequences, and qPCR markers; symbols and short sequence fragments are also activated.

patterns.name: Disease statistics in English narrative
patterns.context: A narrative reports disease in farm animals and the proportion of cases ending in death/euthanasia; activation falls on words related to animals and mortality outcomes.

patterns.name: Decimal precision and numerical calculations
patterns.context: A math problem asks for a number to be rounded to a specified number of decimal places; activation occurs in digit strings and decimal notation.

patterns.name: URL and within-word English fragments
patterns.context: A HackerNews post cites an article link; activation is concentrated on URL punctuation, the domain, and split English word fragments, with a title about implicit beneficiaries and sexism.

11_215.description: 激活横跨瑞典语长复合词、法律英文套语、医学疾病词、引物表格符号、动物死亡叙述、数学数字和网址片段；除各自局部格式或语境外，未见稳定共享触发条件。

patterns.name: 瑞典语复合词中的词尾/词内成分
patterns.trigger: 「övervakningssystem」「vidarebosättningsprogram」「hållbarhetskrav」等复合词，以及「gemensamma」「public service-bolaget」中的分词片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，较长复合词或由多个子词片段组成的词获得激活；激活落在词内或词尾片段，未见单一固定词根。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 瑞典语辩论/议案文本

patterns.name: 特定英文功能词与法律套语
patterns.context: 英文法律条文句式中，描述法院确认争议可仲裁并中止诉讼的长条件句；激活分布在多个普通词和法律术语上。

patterns.name: 英文医学文本中的疾病词
patterns.context: 奶牛内毒素诱发乳腺炎及应激反应的摘要语境，激活集中在疾病相关词及其复合修饰语。

patterns.name: 引物表格格式与符号
patterns.context: 论文方法部分的引物表格，含 Markdown 粗体、列标题、引物序列和 qPCR 标记；符号及短序列片段也获激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 英文疾病统计叙述
patterns.context: 报告农场动物疾病及病例死亡/安乐死比例的叙述，激活落在动物与死亡结局相关词上。

patterns.name: 小数精度与数值计算
patterns.context: 要求将数值舍入到指定小数位的数学题，激活出现在数字串及小数表示中。

patterns.name: 网址与英文词内片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子引用文章链接；激活集中在 URL 标点、域名及被拆分的英文词片段，标题涉及隐性受益与性别歧视。

en.description: Primarily responds to the Swedish noun suffix “-nings”, especially in parliamentary texts; it also activates on local formatting in primer tables, hexadecimal code, hyphens in medical compounds, pathway slashes, and reference years.

patterns.name: Swedish noun suffix -nings
patterns.context: In Swedish words, especially deverbal nouns or compounds; activation concentrates near the suffix fragment

patterns.name: PCR primer table formatting
patterns.context: Primer tables in biomedical papers, with column headings, aligned whitespace, and separators

patterns.name: Hexadecimal code entries
patterns.context: Hexadecimal values arranged by line with braces and commas, as in code or data tables

patterns.name: Hyphens in biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Hyphens connect compound modifiers or term components; activation also falls on adjacent medical vocabulary

patterns.name: Slash notation in the TLR/MyD88 pathway
patterns.context: A slash connects a receptor and signaling molecule in an immunological pathway name

patterns.name: Year fragments in literature citations
patterns.context: Citation format with author names and years in square brackets

11_215.description: 主要响应瑞典语名词后缀“-nings”，尤其出现在议会文本中；另对引物表格排版、十六进制代码、医学复合词连字符、通路斜线及文献年份等局部格式也有激活。

patterns.name: 瑞典语 -nings 名词后缀
patterns.context: 瑞典语词中，尤其是由动词派生的名词或复合词；激活集中在后缀片段附近

patterns.name: PCR 引物表格格式

patterns.name: 十六进制代码项
patterns.context: 按行排列的十六进制数值与花括号、逗号构成的代码或数据表

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合修饰语或术语成分；激活也落在相邻医学词汇上

patterns.name: TLR/MyD88 通路斜线写法
patterns.context: 免疫学通路名称中以斜线连接的受体与信号分子

patterns.name: 文献引用中的年份片段
patterns.context: 方括号内含作者名和年份的文献引用格式

en.description: Activation is distributed across domains and lacks a unified semantic theme: internal fragments of long Swedish words, mathematical digit strings, legal and medical terms, and formatting markers in emails and experimental tables. The clearest local pattern is sensitivity to specific word or structured-text fragments.

patterns.name: Swedish word-final/compound elements
patterns.context: Inflected words or long compounds in Swedish sentences; activation falls on internal word fragments, often in longer nouns or nominalized verbs

patterns.name: Number and precision formatting
patterns.context: Numbers occur in calculations, precision, or rounding questions; activation is concentrated on digit strings rather than the question wording

patterns.name: Legal procedure vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses whether a case is submitted, jurisdiction, and case transfer; activation favors litigation-procedure terms

patterns.name: Pain and clinical-care vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes changes in patient populations, primary care, and pain-related diagnoses

patterns.name: Injury grading and patient statistics
patterns.context: Reports patient counts and injury severity classified by ASIA A/B/C grades

patterns.name: Email footers and forwarded-message metadata
patterns.context: Forwarding markers, sender, time, and other formatted metadata appear after the end of the email body

patterns.name: Primer tables and experimental markers
patterns.context: Experimental tables list forward/reverse primers and PCR-related markers
patterns.domain: Molecular biology paper or experimental table

11_215.concept: 词片段与结构化文本标记
11_215.description: 激活分布于多种领域且缺乏统一语义：瑞典语长词内部片段、数学数字串、法律与医学术语，以及邮件和实验表格的格式标记。较明显的局部规律是对特定词片段或结构化文本片段敏感。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾/复合词成分
patterns.trigger: 瑞典语中词内或词尾的 «nings»、«nings»«för»、«mp»«nings»、«syn»«-» 等子串，以及拆分的复合词，如 «lag»«stift»«nings»«pak»«et»
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子中的屈折词或长复合词，激活落在词的内部片段，常见于较长的名词或动词名词化形式

patterns.name: 数字与精度格式
patterns.context: 数字出现在计算题的数值、精度或舍入问题中，激活集中于数字字符串而非提问文字

patterns.name: 法律程序词汇
patterns.trigger: « claims»、« brought»、« court»、« cases»、« petitions»、« though»、« never»、« filed»
patterns.context: 讨论案件是否提交、管辖权及案件移送；激活偏向诉讼程序相关词语

patterns.name: 疼痛与诊疗词汇

patterns.name: 损伤分级与患者统计
patterns.context: 报告患者人数及按 ASIA A/B/C 等级划分的损伤严重程度

patterns.name: 邮件页脚与转发元数据
patterns.context: 邮件正文收尾后出现转发标记、发件人及时间等格式化元数据

patterns.name: 引物表格及实验标记
patterns.context: 实验表格列出正向/反向引物及 PCR 相关标记
patterns.domain: 分子生物学论文或实验表格

en.description: Activation is distributed across multilingual policy, medical, and physics texts, landing on Swedish compound morphemes, terminology, legal numbers, and reference years; no unified semantic or syntactic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: “Scope of application” in Swedish compounds
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary texts, the scope or domain component of compounds or nouns; strong activation concentrates on morphemes related to “scope/domain”.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Swedish administrative and legislative texts

patterns.name: Swedish oversight and regulation vocabulary
patterns.context: Parliamentary contexts involving regulation, oversight agencies, or joint oversight systems; high activation lands on morphemes in the word for “oversight”.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Swedish regulation and policy discussions

patterns.name: Swedish environmental and sustainability requirements
patterns.context: When social conditions, the environment, sustainability, and health protection requirements are listed together, activation lands on the morphemes for “environment” and “sustainability”.

patterns.name: Swedish public service media
patterns.context: When discussing the provision of high-quality information and the public service media model, activation concentrates on “service-” and compound-word hyphens.

patterns.name: Health scales and quality-of-life items
patterns.context: Health research introduces HRQoL scales, dimensions, and pain/discomfort items.

patterns.name: Spanish legal citation numbers
patterns.context: Document numbers, years, and gazette-style citations in Spanish legal or agreement texts.

patterns.name: Citation years in string theory
patterns.context: Reference markers consisting of author names and years in theoretical physics papers; activation concentrates on year digits.

patterns.name: Swedish safety levels
patterns.context: Parliamentary statements about reducing trade barriers while ensuring a high level of safety; activation lands on the morpheme for “safety”.

patterns.name: Pain-related medical diagnoses
patterns.context: Reports the number and prevalence changes of pain-related diagnoses, listing categories such as myalgia and headache.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC, epidemiology or medical research abstracts

11_215.description: 激活分布于多语种政策、医学、物理文本，落点包括瑞典语复合词词素、术语、法律编号及文献年份；未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 瑞典语复合词中的“应用范围”
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，复合词或名词的表示范围、领域部分；强激活集中在“范围/领域”相关词素。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，瑞典语行政与立法文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语监督与管制词汇
patterns.context: 涉及监管、监督机构或共同监督系统的议会语境；高激活落在“监督”一词的词素上。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，瑞典语监管与政策讨论

patterns.name: 瑞典语环境与可持续发展要求
patterns.context: 并列列举社会条件、环境、可持续性与健康保护要求时，激活落在“环境”和“可持续性”词素。

patterns.name: 瑞典语公共服务媒体
patterns.context: 讨论高质量信息供给及公共服务媒体模式时，激活集中在“service-”与复合词连字符。

patterns.name: 健康量表与生活质量项目
patterns.context: 健康研究中介绍 HRQoL 量表、维度及疼痛/不适项目。

patterns.name: 西班牙语法律引文编号
patterns.context: 西班牙语法律或协议文本中的文件编号、年份和公报式引文。

patterns.name: 弦理论中的引用年份
patterns.context: 理论物理论文中以作者名和年份组成的参考文献标记；激活集中在年份数字。

patterns.name: 瑞典语安全水平
patterns.context: 讨论降低贸易障碍同时保证较高安全水平的议会语句；激活落在“安全”词素。

patterns.name: 疼痛相关医疗诊断
patterns.context: 报告疼痛相关诊断人数及患病率变化，并列出肌痛、头痛等类别。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC，流行病学或医疗研究摘要

en.concept: Local word forms and structural markers
en.description: Strong responses are distributed across several forms: Swedish -nings derivatives, has/shall perfect or obligation structures in legal text, and local punctuation forms such as parentheses and hyphens in medical text and code; paragraphs 6 and 7 lack clear corresponding triggers.

patterns.name: Perfect auxiliary has
patterns.context: Has is followed by been and introduces a past participle or perfect/passive construction; paragraphs 7 and 10 also contain has been, but the marker focuses on has.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, medical abstracts, and other written text

patterns.name: Swedish -nings derivatives
patterns.context: Occurs in Swedish nouns, embedded in word endings or compound boundaries; examples include övervakningssystem, tillämpningsområde, and övervaknings-.

patterns.name: Shall in legal proceedings
patterns.context: In legal provisions or agreements, shall introduces procedural arrangements, obligations, or legal effects.

patterns.name: Hyphens in pain-related diagnoses
patterns.context: In medical contexts, connects compound adjectives or appears in the spelling of diagnosis names.

patterns.name: Parentheses in imperative code macros
patterns.context: In C-style code, a function-like macro takes arguments with a left parenthesis.

patterns.name: Parenthesized numbers after surgery names
patterns.context: A number or category is indicated in parentheses after a surgery name.

11_215.description: 强响应分散于多类形式：瑞典语 -nings 派生词、法律中的 has/shall 完成或义务结构，以及医学和代码中括号、连字符等局部标点形态；第6、7段缺乏明显对应触发点。

patterns.name: 完成式助动词 has
patterns.context: has 后接 been，并引出过去分词或完成/被动结构；第7、10段也出现 has been，但标记焦点是 has。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、医学摘要及其他书面语

patterns.name: 瑞典语 -nings 派生词
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语名词中，嵌于词尾或复合词边界，例为 övervakningssystem、tillämpningsområde、övervaknings-。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会瑞典语辩论文本

patterns.name: 诉讼程序中的 shall
patterns.context: 法律条款或协议中，shall 引出程序安排、义务或法律效果。

patterns.name: 疼痛相关诊断中的连字符
patterns.context: 医学语境中连接复合形容词，或出现在诊断名称的拼写形式中。

patterns.name: 命令式代码宏中的括号
patterns.context: C 风格代码中，函数式宏以左括号接收参数。

patterns.name: 手术名称后的括号编号
patterns.context: 手术名称之后用括号标示编号或类别。

en.description: Activation examples belong to medical terminology, legal procedural language, and paper citation years; local trigger positions vary, with no stable lexical or semantic feature explaining all examples.

patterns.name: Medical terms and compounds
patterns.context: Appears in health-related papers, often involving diseases, symptoms, clinical measurements, or effects induced by a factor; activation falls on term fragments, hyphens, or negative prefixes.

patterns.name: Legal procedural language
patterns.context: Describes litigation, jurisdiction, arbitration, or court rulings in legal texts; triggers are distributed across procedural terms and common auxiliary verbs.

patterns.name: Year fragments in paper citations
patterns.context: Years appear in author–year citations in ArXiv papers, near citation markers and name fragments.

11_215.description: 激活样例分属医学术语、法律程序表述和论文引文年份；局部触发位置多样，缺少能解释所有样例的稳定词法或语义特征。

patterns.name: 医学术语与复合词
patterns.context: 出现在健康相关论文中，常涉及疾病、症状、临床测量或由某因素诱发的效应；激活位置落在术语片段、连字符或否定前缀上。

patterns.name: 法律程序用语
patterns.trigger: “arbitration has« been»”“the« action»”“« federal claims» have”“« could» be presented”
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述诉讼、管辖权、仲裁或法院裁决；触发点分散在程序词和常见助动词上。

patterns.name: 论文引文中的年份片段
patterns.context: 年份出现在 ArXiv 论文的作者—年份式引文中，邻近引用标记与姓名片段。

en.concept: Heterogeneous text formats and terminology fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to separator lines, headers, and signatures in email forwarding templates; also covers expressions of thanks, legal procedural terms, pain-related medical terms, and Swedish compound-word fragments. Trigger forms vary across corpora.

patterns.name: Email forwarding-header separator
patterns.context: A fixed-format area between the forwarded email header and the body/sender information, often accompanied by slash-separated names, departments, or addresses

patterns.name: Procedural language in legal provisions
patterns.context: Terms related to jurisdiction, stays of proceedings, and arbitration procedures occur in continuous formal legal text

patterns.name: Pain-related medical terminology
patterns.context: Medical research abstracts describe pain diagnoses, visit counts, and disease categories

patterns.name: Swedish compounds and intra-word segmentation
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary text, compound words are split into multiple subword tokens; activation falls on several stems or morpheme fragments

patterns.name: Polite email sign-offs
patterns.context: Expressions of thanks near the end of a short email body, followed by a signature, contact information, or forwarding header

patterns.name: Names/signatures in forwarded emails
patterns.context: Names after a forwarding separator or in the email signature; not all names co-occur with expressions of thanks

11_215.concept: 异质文本格式与术语片段
11_215.description: 主要响应邮件转发模板的分隔线、头部及署名；也覆盖感谢语、法律程序词、疼痛医学术语和瑞典语复合词片段。不同语料中的触发形态并不统一。

patterns.name: 邮件转发头分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件转发头与正文/发件人信息之间的固定格式区域，常伴随斜杠分隔的姓名、部门或地址

patterns.name: 法律条文中的程序性用语
patterns.trigger: "action"、"is commenced"（段2）；"suit or proceeding"、"stay the trial"、"arbitration"（段8）
patterns.context: 正式法律句子中，诉讼管辖、审理中止及仲裁程序等词语处于连续条文语境

patterns.name: 疼痛相关医学术语
patterns.context: 医学研究摘要描述疼痛诊断、就诊人数及疾病类别

patterns.name: 瑞典语复合词及词内切分
patterns.trigger: "miljö"（被切为 «mil»、«j»、«ö»）、"handelsförhandlingar"、"fiskeri- och vattenbruksprodukter" 中的词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，复合词被分成多个子词 token；激活落在若干词干或词素片段上

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的客套结束语
patterns.context: 短邮件正文的感谢语附近，后接署名、联系方式或转发头

patterns.name: 转发邮件中的姓名/署名
patterns.trigger: "Heckler, James"、"Bennett Kaufman"、"Rob G Gay"、"Larry W. Bass"、"Awais Omar"、"Judy Dyer"
patterns.context: 转发分隔线之后的姓名，或邮件署名位置；并非所有姓名都与感谢语同现

en.concept: Document structure and specialized text fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to separators, headers, line breaks, closings, and signatures in Enron forwarded emails; also shows sporadic responses to email bodies, Higgs paper citations, legal jurisdiction provisions, and Swedish social and environmental terms.

patterns.name: Email forwarding separators and headers
patterns.context: Forwarding headers in Enron emails, often including the forwarder, department, date, and time, with horizontal lines and line breaks before and after.

patterns.name: Email closings and signatures
patterns.context: After the email body ends, expressions of thanks, blank lines, signatures, or the sender's name in the forwarded email appear; some names are adjacent to a line break and forwarding header.

patterns.name: Email subject and body prompts
patterns.context: Email metadata or brief body prompts, especially subject lines and concise action markers in forwarded emails.

patterns.name: Short phrases in email bodies
patterns.context: Everyday short sentences or explanatory text in email bodies; activation also appears in blank lines and forwarding formats after the body.

patterns.name: Higgs and citations in high-energy physics
patterns.context: Paper text discussing Higgs production, the Standard Model, or experimental constraints, interspersed with literature citations and years.

patterns.name: Jurisdictional language in legal provisions
patterns.context: Formal legal text listing where litigation occurs or conditions for personal jurisdiction, with continuous, formulaic phrasing.

patterns.name: Social and environmental terms in Swedish policy text
patterns.context: Swedish sentences discuss third countries, equal conditions, and social conditions, the environment, and sustainability; activation is concentrated in subword fragments.

11_215.concept: 文档结构与专业文本片段
11_215.description: 主要响应 Enron 转发邮件的分隔线、头部、换行、收尾和署名；另对邮件正文、Higgs论文引用、法律管辖条文及瑞典语社会环境词有零散响应。

patterns.name: 邮件转发分隔与邮件头
patterns.context: Enron 邮件中的转发头部，常包含转发者、部门、日期和时间，前后有横线及换行。

patterns.name: 邮件收尾与签名
patterns.trigger: «Thanks»、«↵»、«Greg»、«Kristann Shireman»、«Awais»、«Awais Omar»、«Larry W. Bass»、«Janet R Dietrich»
patterns.context: 邮件正文结束后出现感谢语、空行、署名或被转发邮件的发件人姓名；部分名字紧邻换行和转发头。

patterns.name: 邮件主题与正文提示
patterns.trigger: «Subject»、«Org Chart that Ray just brought down»、«From»、«FYI»、«action»、«re:»
patterns.context: 邮件元数据或简短正文提示，尤其是主题行以及转发邮件中的简洁事项标记。

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的简短语句
patterns.trigger: «E-»、«mail»、«from her to our trader»、«are you going to go to this with me?»、«your»、«information»
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的日常短句或说明性文字，激活也出现在正文之后的空行与转发格式中。

patterns.name: 高能物理中的 Higgs 与引文
patterns.context: 讨论 Higgs 产生、标准模型或实验约束的论文语句，夹有文献引用和年份。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的诉讼管辖措辞
patterns.context: 正式法律文本列举诉讼发生地点或个人管辖权条件，句式连续、程序化。

patterns.name: 瑞典语政策文本中的社会与环境词汇
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子谈第三国、平等条件以及社会条件、环境和可持续性；激活集中在词内子词。

en.description: Activation is distributed across medical pain and efficacy vocabulary, legal litigation boilerplate, Swedish compounds, and scientific symbols/subword fragments; it also includes several isolated word fragments and common words, with no unified semantic feature.

patterns.name: Hyphen or slash boundaries within pain-related terms
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on hyphens or slashes within words and the fragments immediately following them; examples include pain-related, fibromyalgia, HRQoL, pain/discomfort, and post-treatment.

patterns.name: Function words and litigation terms in legal boilerplate
patterns.context: In long legal English sentences, articles, prepositions, conjunctions, and other function words occur near terms related to litigation, liability, and injury; triggers are not limited to any fixed legal term.
patterns.domain: Decisions, litigation procedures, and legal argumentation

patterns.name: Within-word morphological boundaries and proper-name hyphens in Swedish
patterns.context: Internal fragments and connectors stand out when long, continuous Swedish words are split into multiple tokens, or when the proper name IMO is followed by a hyphenated compound.

patterns.name: Symbolic strings and token boundaries in scientific texts
patterns.context: Square brackets, colons, numbers, and fragmented author names occur in citations, or random codes consist of alphanumeric fragments; activation falls on symbols and fragmented substrings.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper citation formats; GitHub code or data strings

patterns.name: Irregular within-word fragments in English
patterns.context: In general scientific English, word-final or within-word fragments, compound hyphens, and a few common function words are marked; these examples lack a clear shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Legal argumentation and biomedical research texts

patterns.name: Isolated abbreviation or word-fragment activations
patterns.context: In a few passages, only sporadic initials, word fragments, or common words are marked, making it difficult to identify stable trigger conditions from the given context.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, particle physics papers, and legal texts

11_215.description: 激活分散在医学疼痛及疗效词汇、法律诉讼套语、瑞典语复合词和科研符号/分词碎片；也包含若干孤立词段与普通词，无法归为统一语义特征。

patterns.name: 疼痛相关术语内部的连字符或斜线边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内的连字符或斜线，以及紧邻其后的词段；出现于 pain-related、fibromyalgia、HRQoL、pain/discomfort、post-treatment 等写法中。

patterns.name: 法律套语中的功能词及诉讼词
patterns.context: 法律英语长句中，冠词、介词、连词等功能词与诉讼、责任、伤害相关词语相邻；触发并非只限于某个固定法律术语。
patterns.domain: 判决、诉讼程序及法律论述

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内构词边界与专名连字符
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续书写的长词被分成多个词段时，或专名 IMO 与后续连字符复合时，内部词段及连接符显著。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语欧洲议会政策文本

patterns.name: 科学文本中的符号化字符串与分词边界
patterns.context: 出现文献引用中的方括号、冒号、数字和被切碎的作者名，或由字母数字碎片组成的随机代码；激活落在符号及碎片化子串上。
patterns.domain: 科研论文引用格式；GitHub 代码或数据串

patterns.name: 不规则英文词内碎片
patterns.context: 一般科研英语中，词尾或词内切分片段、复合词连字符，以及少数普通功能词被标记；这些例子之间缺少清晰共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 法律论述与生物医学科研文本

patterns.name: 孤立的缩写或词段激活
patterns.context: 少数段落中只有零散首字母缩写、词段或普通词被标记，难以从给出的上下文确定稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、粒子物理论文及法律文本

en.description: Activation is distributed across medical symptoms and outcomes, legal relative clauses and procedures, research objectives, Swedish fisheries administration terms, and endoscopy scores; there is insufficient evidence to group them into a single semantic or grammatical pattern.

patterns.name: Pain and symptoms in medical text
patterns.context: Lists pain, symptoms, diseases, or quality-of-life dimensions in clinical studies or health questionnaires; also includes compound expressions such as “pain-related diagnoses”.

patterns.name: Relative clauses and foreseeability in legal text
patterns.context: Legal text describes jurisdiction, property, or liability, especially restrictive relative clauses introduced by which/that.

patterns.name: Progress of legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes a court order, post-trial motion, or appeal process as completed or entering the next stage.

patterns.name: Research objectives and treatment outcomes
patterns.context: Research plans or medical grant texts state long-term goals, therapy development, and improvement of clinical outcomes after transplantation.

patterns.name: Swedish administrative and fisheries terms
patterns.context: Continuous Swedish word fragments related to committee members, maritime affairs, fisheries, and aquaculture products.

patterns.name: Description of endoscopic inflammation scores
patterns.context: Explains grading endoscopic reports by the degree of mucosal activity and lists score levels.

11_215.description: 激活分布在医学症状与结局、法律关系从句及程序、研究目标、瑞典语渔业行政词汇和内镜评分中；没有足够证据将它们归为同一词义或语法模式。

patterns.name: 医疗文本中的疼痛及症状
patterns.context: 在临床研究或健康量表中列举疼痛、症状、疾病或生活质量维度；也包括“pain-related diagnoses”等复合表达。

patterns.name: 法律语句中的关系从句与可预见性
patterns.trigger: «which»« could»« reasonably»« have»« been»« fore»«seen»；«that»« is»« the»« subject»« of»« the»« action»
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述诉讼管辖、财产或责任，尤其是由 which/that 引导的限定性关系从句。

patterns.name: 法律程序进展
patterns.context: 描述法院命令、审判后动议或上诉程序已经完成或进入下一阶段。

patterns.name: 研究目标与治疗结果
patterns.trigger: «long»«-»«term»« goal»、«develop»« new»« therapies»、«increase»« the»« number»、«patients»« who»« are»« non»«-»«di»abetic
patterns.context: 研究计划或医学资助文本中陈述长期目标、开发疗法及改善移植后的临床结果。

patterns.name: 瑞典语行政与渔业词汇
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续词片段，涉及委员会成员、海洋事务、渔业和水产产品。

patterns.name: 内镜炎症评分说明
patterns.context: 说明内镜报告按黏膜活动程度进行分级，并列举评分档位。
patterns.domain: 医学研究方法、内镜评估

en.description: Primarily responds to pain and related symptom terms, also appearing in clinical outcome assessments; there are sporadic responses to endoscopic inflammation grading, legal damages or medical needs, radiation experiments, and line-break markers in biographies.

patterns.name: Pain and symptom terms
patterns.context: Appears in disease descriptions, chief complaints, symptom lists, or pain-related diagnoses; also includes contexts where symptoms and functional impacts are listed together.
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine, epidemiology, and medical legal texts

patterns.name: Assessment and outcome measures
patterns.context: Scales and evaluation measures related to health-related quality of life, patient outcomes, or symptom severity.

patterns.name: Endoscopic mucosal inflammation grading
patterns.context: Describes the activity of the mucosa in affected regions and its grading in endoscopy reports.

patterns.name: Legal damages and remedies
patterns.context: Discusses harm caused by torts or other wrongful acts and whether a court can award damages.

patterns.name: Legal standard for serious medical needs
patterns.context: In prison medical litigation, explains that the plaintiff must establish a serious medical need and urgency.

patterns.name: Biography and music career
patterns.context: An entry introduces biographical details and musical identity; activation falls on a line-break marker.

patterns.name: Radiation and redox reactions
patterns.context: Describes disrupted redox balance in mice following whole-body radiation.

11_215.description: 主要响应疼痛及相关症状词，也见于临床结局评估；另对内镜炎症分级、法律损害或医疗需求、辐射实验及传记中的换行标记有零星响应。

patterns.name: 疼痛及症状词
patterns.context: 在疾病、就诊主诉、症状清单或疼痛相关诊断中出现；也包括症状与功能影响并列的语境。
patterns.domain: 临床医学、流行病学及医疗法律文本

patterns.name: 评估与结局指标
patterns.context: 围绕健康相关生活质量、患者结局或症状严重程度的量表和评价指标。

patterns.name: 内镜黏膜炎症分级
patterns.context: 描述内镜报告中受累区域的黏膜活动度及分级。

patterns.name: 法律损害与救济
patterns.context: 讨论侵权或其他不法行为造成损害，以及法院能否判给赔偿。

patterns.name: 医疗需求法律标准
patterns.context: 监狱医疗诉讼中，说明原告须证明严重医疗需求及紧迫性。

patterns.name: 人物传记与音乐职业
patterns.context: 人物条目介绍出生信息及音乐身份；激活落在换行标记上。

patterns.name: 辐射与氧化还原反应
patterns.context: 描述小鼠接受全身辐射后氧化还原反应平衡受到扰动。

en.description: Responses are distributed across multilingual parliamentary text and medical, legal, and social science corpora. Medical passages often concern pain, symptoms, scores, or disease severity, but independent triggers include Swedish word fragments, line breaks, behavioral discussion, and radiation terminology; no single theme explains them.

patterns.name: Abdominal pain or discomfort phrases
patterns.context: Abdominal symptoms or pain appear as study measures, diagnoses, or findings; some activations span word boundaries

patterns.name: Swedish intra-word segmentation and suffixes

patterns.name: Swedish word-final and within-word fragments

en.description: Activation spans several local structures: Swedish within-word and word-final fragments and line breaks in parliamentary texts, table tabs, hyphen boundaries, and slashes and symptom-word fragments in medical symptom lists; no single meaning runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Suffixes and within-word fragments in long Swedish words

patterns.name: Tabs and column separators in tables
patterns.context: Located between fields in table rows, alongside locations, organization names, and numeric codes; activation concentrates primarily on tabs and column boundaries.

patterns.name: Hyphen-separated term boundaries
patterns.context: Hyphens occur between components of Swedish compounds or EU-related terms, or serve as range separators; however, the same symbol also appears in unmarked positions.

patterns.name: Slashes in medical symptom lists
patterns.context: Slashes connect paired symptom or diagnosis names, such as “pain/discomfort”, “tiredness/fatigue”, and “weakness/fatigue”; the slash itself is marked in these contexts.

patterns.name: Within-word segmentation in European Parliament texts
patterns.context: In addition to Swedish morpheme fragments, EU abbreviations and compound/within-word fragments can activate; the fragments occur in policy, political, or expansion-related discussions.

patterns.name: Symptom-word fragments in English medical texts
patterns.context: In English medical content, some fragments of segmented symptom words such as abdominal pain, fatigue, and depression are marked as active; this overlaps with the slash-list pattern but does not explain all medical activations.

11_215.description: 激活覆盖多类局部结构：瑞典语词内/词尾片段与议会文本换行、表格制表符、连字符边界，以及医学症状列表中的斜杠和症状词片段；没有单一词义贯穿所有段。

patterns.name: 瑞典语长词中的后缀/词内片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在被拆分的瑞典语词内部，尤其是词尾或词素边界附近；片段本身并非只对应一个固定词义。

patterns.name: EuroParl 文本中的换行标记
patterns.context: 段落或发言人标记附近的换行 token 激活很强；常出现在议会发言、签名或段落转换处。

patterns.name: 表格中的制表符/列分隔
patterns.context: 位于表格行的字段之间，伴随地点、机构名称和数字代码；激活主要集中在制表符及列边界。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的表格/数据清单

patterns.name: 连字符分隔的术语边界
patterns.context: 连字符出现在瑞典语复合词或 EU 相关词的组成部分之间，或充当数字范围分隔符；但相同符号也出现在未标记位置。

patterns.name: 医学症状列表中的斜杠
patterns.context: 斜杠连接症状或诊断的并列名称，如“pain/discomfort”“tiredness/fatigue”“weakness/fatigue”；斜杠本身在这些上下文中被标记。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会文本中的词内切分
patterns.context: 除瑞典语词素片段外，EU 缩写及复合词/词内片段也可激活；片段处于政策、政治或扩展相关论述中。

patterns.name: 英文医学文本中的症状词片段
patterns.context: 英文医学内容中，腹痛、疲劳、抑郁等症状词被切分时，部分词片段标记为激活；这与斜杠列表模式有重叠，但不能解释全部医学激活。

en.description: The primary pattern is strong responsiveness to the token “slave” and phrases containing it, covering slavery, the slave trade, slave labor, and figurative uses; it also responds strongly to “LA” in lists of travel destinations.

patterns.name: slave and its compounds
patterns.context: The token slave appears in noun phrases or compounds, referring to enslaved people, matters related to slavery, or figurative references; its syntactic position is not consistent across passages
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narrative, history, film descriptions, religious texts, reviews

patterns.name: LA place-name abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears in a list of travel destinations as an abbreviation for Los Angeles

11_225.concept: slave 词元检测，另有 LA
11_225.description: 主要模式是对词元“slave”及含它的短语高度响应，涵盖奴隶、奴隶贸易、奴隶劳动与比喻性用法；另对旅行目的地列表中的“LA”强烈响应。

patterns.name: slave 词及其复合词
patterns.context: 词元 slave 出现在名词短语或复合词中，可指被奴役者、奴隶制度相关事物，也可出现在比喻性指称中；各段没有一致的句法位置
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、历史、电影介绍、宗教文本、评论

patterns.name: LA 地名缩写
patterns.context: 出现在一串旅行目的地中，作为 Los Angeles 的缩写

en.concept: Occasional responses to the word slave and LA
en.description: Strongly responds to slave (including plural forms and phrases containing it), covering literal enslavement, historical slaves, the slave trade and labor, as well as figurative usage; also responds strongly to LA in lists of travel destinations.

patterns.name: The word slave and related phrases
patterns.context: The singular or plural form slave appears directly, often in connection with owners, enslavement, the slave trade, prison labor, or historical contexts; some uses are figurative.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, historical and film descriptions, religious texts, reviews

patterns.name: Place name LA
patterns.context: A list of locations in a travel email, with LA among place names such as Portland, Calgary, and St. Louis.
patterns.domain: Enron emails, routine business travel records

11_225.concept: slave 词汇与 LA 的偶发响应
11_225.description: 强烈响应 slave（含复数及构成短语），涵盖字面奴役、历史奴隶、奴隶贸易与劳动，也有比喻用法；另在旅行地点列表中强烈响应 LA。

patterns.name: slave 一词及相关短语
patterns.trigger: «slave»10；包括 “molecular slave”、“treating him like a slave”、“slave hold”、“slave-labor programs”、“slaves in their possession”、“former slave”、“a slave he had purchased”、“a slave”
patterns.context: 直接出现单数或复数 slave，常与所有者、奴役、奴隶贸易、监狱劳动或历史背景相连；个别用法是比喻性指称。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、历史与电影介绍、宗教文本、评论

patterns.name: 地点名 LA
patterns.context: 行程邮件中的地点列表，LA 位于 Portland、Calgary 与 St. Louis 等地名之间。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、日常出差记录

en.description: All passages contain and mark the same trigger word, “slave,” covering uses referring to literal slave status, slavery, the slave trade, and slaveholders; topics and styles vary, with no other distinct pattern apparent.

patterns.name: The word slave
patterns.context: Whether slave refers to an enslaved person, the institution of slavery, or a slaveholder, the token itself triggers activation; in most examples it occurs in narrative sentences.
