11_225.description: 全部段落都包含并标记了同一触发词“slave”，涵盖字面奴隶身份、奴隶制、奴隶贸易与奴隶主等用法；主题和文体各异，未见其他独立模式。

patterns.name: slave 词项
patterns.trigger: «slave»10；也包括“slave trade”“slave societies”“slave owners”等组合
patterns.context: 无论 slave 指被奴役者、奴隶制度或奴隶主，token 本身都能触发；多数例子中出现在叙述性句子中

en.description: Activation spans several distinct titles, terms, and web fragments; the most consistent repeated trigger is slave (including compounds and figurative uses), but memo, causes, characters, and Tagged also trigger separately.

patterns.name: Heavy metals and soil distribution title
patterns.context: A paper-title-style phrase describing the distribution of heavy metals in soil profiles.

patterns.name: Engineering and protease-resistance title
patterns.context: A title or title opening; technical terms such as engineering and protease-resistant occur adjacent to each other.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts; bioengineering or protein research

patterns.name: Memo
patterns.context: An email mentions receiving a memo from Rick and notes that it concerns a trip report.

patterns.name: Postoperative peritoneal adhesion title
patterns.context: A medical title discusses postoperative bowel obstruction, peritoneal bands, and adhesions, with “causes” prominently activated.

patterns.name: The word slave and related uses
patterns.context: The word slave appears in different contexts, including enslaved status, forced-labor projects, and figurative complaints; it also appears in the fragment 'slave or'.
patterns.domain: Film descriptions, historical entries, film reviews, sports reports, and miscellaneous web text

patterns.name: Game tags
patterns.context: Game names and platform-style metadata beginning with “Tagged:”.

11_225.concept: 多义词与标题/元数据片段
11_225.description: 激活覆盖数种彼此不同的标题、术语和网页片段；最一致的重复触发是 slave（含复合词或比喻用法），但 memo、causes、characters、Tagged 等也分别触发。

patterns.name: 重金属与土壤分布标题
patterns.context: 论文标题式短语，描述重金属在土壤剖面中的分布特征。

patterns.name: 工程与蛋白酶抗性标题
patterns.context: 标题或标题开头；engineering、protease-resistant 等技术术语相邻出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要；生物工程或蛋白质研究

patterns.name: 备忘录
patterns.context: 邮件中提及从 Rick 收到一份备忘录，并说明其与行程报告有关。

patterns.name: 术后腹膜粘连标题
patterns.context: 医学标题讨论术后肠梗阻、腹膜带和粘连，且“causes”受到突出激活。

patterns.name: slave 一词及相关用法
patterns.context: 词语 slave 出现在奴隶身份、强制劳动项目或比喻性抱怨等不同语境；也出现在分词 'slave or' 中。
patterns.domain: 电影介绍、历史条目、电影评论、体育报道及杂乱网页文本

patterns.name: 游戏标签
patterns.context: 以“Tagged:”开头的游戏名称及平台标签式元数据。

en.description: The most stable, cross-style strong trigger is slave and its plural or compound forms, relating to slavery, slaveholders, slave labor, and related people; newline markers also often activate. The O.O. and period in passage 10 cannot be explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Slave vocabulary
patterns.context: Strongly activates when slave appears, including plural forms and hyphenated compounds; contexts concern slaves, slavery, the slave trade, slaveholders, slave labor, or slave characters.
patterns.domain: Slavery history, political commentary, literature, film and television descriptions, and related classifications

patterns.name: Paragraph and newline markers
patterns.context: Multiple line-break boundaries are marked, but the passage topics differ; this may be a secondary response related to text formatting, difficult to distinguish from the core vocabulary pattern.
patterns.domain: Web text, encyclopedia entries, and other text containing line breaks

patterns.name: Initials and periods
patterns.context: The final passage contains letter initials and periods, with no slave-related words; the independent trigger is unclear.

11_225.description: 最稳定、跨文体的强触发是 slave 及其复数或复合形式，涉及奴隶制、奴隶主、奴隶劳动与相关人物；换行标记也常激活。第10段的 O.O. 与句点无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: slave词汇
patterns.context: 出现 slave（含复数、连字符复合词）时强烈激活；上下文涉及奴隶、奴隶制、奴隶贸易、奴隶主、奴隶劳动或奴隶角色。
patterns.domain: 奴隶制历史、政治评论、文学、影视介绍及相关分类

patterns.name: 段落与换行标记
patterns.context: 多处换行边界被标记，但各段正文主题不同；可能是与文本格式有关的次级响应，难以和核心词汇模式区分。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、百科条目及其他带换行的文本

patterns.name: 姓名缩写及句点
patterns.context: 末段出现字母缩写与句点，未见 slave 相关词，独立触发原因不明。
patterns.domain: 疑似地址或组织名称片段

en.concept: Fragments and markers in specialized text
en.description: Activation is sporadic across internal fragments of technical vocabulary, compounds, and symbol boundaries; it also occurs in metal/nuclide terminology, paper markers, and clinical imaging descriptions. Email thanks and signatures are isolated examples. Passage 8 contains only an image marker and numbers, making the specific trigger mechanism difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in medical/technical terminology
patterns.context: Activation often falls on subword fragments inside words or adjacent word fragments; contexts are mostly technical terminology, especially long words, compounds, and medical or technical vocabulary, with no fixed fragment position.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, livestock nutrition, materials/electronics, and technical documents

patterns.name: Heavy metals and element/substance symbols
patterns.context: Element-, metal-, or nuclide-related words/symbols occur; passage 2 discusses soil heavy metals, passage 4 discusses iron deposits in the brain, and passage 6 mentions the half-life of krypton-77.
patterns.domain: Environmental science, medical imaging, nuclear physics

patterns.name: Structured markers and citation formatting
patterns.context: Activation occurs around structured text such as square brackets, figure/table citations, or Markdown image markers; these markers are embedded in paper text or image references.

patterns.name: Hyphens in compounds
patterns.context: Hyphens connect compounds, age expressions, or technical abbreviations; triggers are not limited to any one field.
patterns.domain: Medicine, research, product descriptions, and patent text

patterns.name: Email courtesies and signature formatting
patterns.context: An email ends with a thank-you, followed by a line break, signature, and separator; activation involves both internal word fragments and email layout.

patterns.name: Clinical imaging and disease narrative
patterns.context: A clinical case describes admission for severe illness, prior medical history, and chest X-ray/MRI images or imaging sequences.

patterns.name: Paper-title-style topic phrases
patterns.context: A research title or abstract opening uses a noun phrase to summarize the research subject, distribution, measurement, or experimental treatment.

11_225.concept: 专业文本中的片段与标记
11_225.description: 激活分散在专业词汇的内部片段、复合词及符号边界，也见于金属/核素术语、论文标记和临床影像描述；邮件致谢与签名较孤立。第8段仅见图片标记与数字，难以确定具体触发机制。

patterns.name: 医学/科技术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内部的子词片段或相邻词片段上；上下文多为专业术语，尤其长词、复合词及医学或科技词汇，片段的位置并不固定。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、畜牧营养、材料/电子及技术文档

patterns.name: 重金属与元素/物质符号
patterns.context: 出现元素、金属或核素相关词语/符号；段2讨论土壤重金属，段4讨论脑内铁沉积，段6提及氪-77半衰期。
patterns.domain: 环境科学、医学影像、核物理

patterns.name: 结构化标记与引用格式
patterns.context: 方括号、图表引用或 Markdown 图片标记等结构化文本周围出现激活；这些标记嵌在论文正文或图像引用中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及网页/Markdown 文档

patterns.name: 复合词中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合词、年龄表达或技术缩写；触发并不局限于某一领域。
patterns.domain: 医学、科研、产品说明及专利文本

patterns.name: 邮件礼貌语与签名排版
patterns.context: 邮件以致谢语结尾，随后换行、签名及分隔线；激活同时涉及词内片段和邮件版式。

patterns.name: 临床影像与疾病叙述
patterns.context: 临床病例中描述重症入院、既往病史及胸片/MRI影像或影像序列。

patterns.name: 论文标题式主题短语
patterns.context: 科研题名或摘要开头以名词短语概括研究对象、分布、测定或实验处理。

en.description: Primarily responds to the appro string prefix across different word forms such as approvals, approximately, and approbatory; it also responds strongly to informing in two academic contexts. The fields and meanings do not form a unified theme.

patterns.name: approval word forms and suffixes
patterns.context: Activation centers on the string appro; subsequent spelling can form different words such as approvals, approximately, and approbatory, with no specific semantic requirement.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including policy, academic, business, legal, technical, and narrative

patterns.name: Stem in informing
patterns.context: The intraword trigger falls at the stem/suffix boundary in informing; it appears in “informing obesity policy” and “informing theory”.

11_225.description: 主要响应 appro 字符串前缀，横跨 approvals、approximately、approbatory 等不同词形；另在两个学术语境中强烈响应 informing。各领域和语义不构成统一主题。

patterns.name: approval 词形及其后缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在字符串 appro 后；后续拼写可构成 approvals、approximately、approbatory 等不同词，且不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括政策、学术、商业、法律、技术和叙事

patterns.name: informing 中的词干
patterns.context: 词内触发点位于 informing 的词干/后缀边界；出现在“informing obesity policy”和“informing theory”中。

en.description: Activation is sporadic across the internal fragments “ange” and “De,” proper names and place names, email fields, titles, and boundary punctuation; isolated examples also include a tumor and a religious book title. The corpora and contexts vary widely, making it difficult to group them under a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragment containing “ange”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the spelling fragment “ange,” embedded in a materials term, an institution name, and a personal name; there is no apparent shared semantic condition
patterns.domain: Materials patents, scientific institution names, academic citations

patterns.name: De in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on the fragment De, a particle in a proper name or at the beginning of a word; examples cover personal names, business language, email recipient names, and place-name aliases
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic tables, business email, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Lists of people and organizations
patterns.context: Names of people/organizations in lists, recipient fields, or news headlines, often accompanied by commas, semicolons, email fields, or title formatting

patterns.name: Place-name or entity-name fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation occurs within proper names, especially place names, facilities, equipment, or aliases in historical entries; there is no consistent syntactic environment

patterns.name: Colons after names or titles; email fields
patterns.context: Names and field labels cluster around email headers and recipient/CC fields

patterns.name: Title-style or tag-style phrases
patterns.context: News headlines, case titles, or encyclopedia entry titles, with line breaks, square brackets, or repeated title formatting

patterns.name: Strong punctuation before quotations and em dashes
patterns.context: Double em dashes and quotation marks before narrative quotations, or line breaks at paragraph/field boundaries; boundary formatting may be the trigger

patterns.name: Medical tumor terminology
patterns.context: A case title describes pediatric kidney injury accompanied by a tumor; there is insufficient evidence that the response is to a medical concept beyond this term

patterns.name: Religious book title and recitation context
patterns.context: In a narrative, a mother assigns the child material from the Book of Common Prayer and asks the child to recite it; high activation also falls on punctuation before a quotation

11_225.description: 激活分散在词内片段“ange”“De”、人名地名及邮件字段、标题和边界标点上；另有肿瘤、宗教书名等孤例。不同语料与语境差异大，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 包含“ange”的专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拼写片段“ange”上，分别嵌在材料术语、机构名称和人名中；没有明显共同语义条件
patterns.domain: 专利材料、科学机构名称、学术引文

patterns.name: 专名中的 De
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或词首的分词片段 De；覆盖人名、商业用语、邮件收件人姓名及地名别称
patterns.domain: 百科表格、商务邮件、百科条目

patterns.name: 人名与组织名列表
patterns.context: 名单、收件人栏或新闻标题中的姓名/机构名称，常伴随逗号、分号、邮件字段或标题格式

patterns.name: 专名中的地名或实体名片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名内部，尤其是地名、设施、设备或历史条目别名；并无统一句法环境

patterns.name: 姓名或称谓后的冒号、邮件字段
patterns.context: 邮件头及收件人/抄送字段附近，姓名与字段标签密集出现

patterns.name: 标题式或标签式短语
patterns.context: 新闻标题、病例题名或百科条目标题，带换行、方括号或重复标题格式

patterns.name: 引语及破折号前的强标点
patterns.context: 叙事引语前的双破折号和引号，或段落/字段分隔处的换行；可能是边界格式触发

patterns.name: 医学肿瘤术语
patterns.context: 病例标题中描述儿科肾脏损伤伴肿瘤；除该词外没有足够证据表明是医学概念响应

patterns.name: 宗教书名与背诵语境
patterns.context: 叙事中母亲给孩子布置《公祷书》内容并要求背诵；高激活也落在引语前标点

en.description: Strong activation centers on several proper nouns and word-final fragments: opoly appears in oligopoly, duopoly, and perfluoropolyether; there is also high responsiveness to Panama, Somerville, Heyburn, Boyle, Barnaby, and legal citation punctuation. The examples span fields and show no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Market-structure terms
patterns.context: The word-final fragment appears in terms for market or business competition structures: «ol»2«ig»3«opoly»9, and «du»1«opoly»9.

patterns.name: The place name Panama
patterns.context: Appears as a place or proper noun; one instance is followed by « Disease», another by the place name “Barro Colorado Island”.
patterns.domain: Discussion of banana diseases, forest ecology

patterns.name: PFPE fragment in patent chemistry term
patterns.context: Appears in «perfluor«opoly»9«ether»», forming “perfluoropolyether”; nearby text discusses lubricants and their molecules.

patterns.name: Citation punctuation in legal cases
patterns.context: A case citation, “People v. Hawes”, immediately follows a statutory provision and an explanation of its application.

patterns.name: Somerville name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the researcher name “Chris Somerville”, within a historical account of screening Arabidopsis lipid-metabolism mutants.

patterns.name: Heyburn name fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the author surname “Heyburn” in a quotation from a historical US court decision.

patterns.name: Boyle name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in “Robert Boyle”, in a list of figures in alchemy, chemistry, and mineralogy.

patterns.name: Barnaby name fragment
patterns.context: Appears within the surname “Barnaby” in a historical narrative, near a discussion of artillery and its requirements.

11_225.description: 强激活集中于若干专名和词尾片段：opoly 出现在 oligopoly、duopoly、perfluoropolyether 中；另对 Panama、Somerville、Heyburn、Boyle、Barnaby 及法律引证标点有高响应。跨领域，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 垄断结构术语
patterns.context: 词尾片段出现在表示市场或企业竞争结构的词中：«ol»2«ig»3«opoly»9，以及«du»1«opoly»9。

patterns.name: Panama 地名
patterns.context: 作为地点或专名出现；一处接« Disease»，另一处接地名“Barro Colorado Island”。
patterns.domain: 香蕉病害讨论、森林生态学

patterns.name: 专利化学词中的 PFPE 片段
patterns.context: 出现在«perfluor«opoly»9«ether»»中，构成“perfluoropolyether”；附近讨论润滑剂及其分子。

patterns.name: 法律判例中的引证标点
patterns.context: 法规条文及法条适用说明之后，紧接判例引证“People v. Hawes”。

patterns.name: Somerville 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在研究者姓名“Chris Somerville”中，接在关于拟南芥脂质代谢突变体筛选的历史叙述里。

patterns.name: Heyburn 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在引述美国历史判决的作者姓氏“Heyburn”开头。

patterns.name: Boyle 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Robert Boyle”中，位于炼金术、化学和矿物学人物名单。

patterns.name: Barnaby 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在历史叙述中人物姓氏“Barnaby”内，附近谈及火炮及其要求。

en.concept: Proper nouns and fragments in specialized text
en.description: Activation is distributed across proper nouns, place names, and split fragments of proper nouns; it also appears in sports classifications, legal citations and litigation language, bibliographies, negative medical findings, and biomedical tissue descriptions. No single semantic pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: Character fragments within place names
patterns.context: Activation falls within place names or anatomical terms split across multiple tokens; passage 1 contains a city name within a person’s name, and passage 10 contains a histological term.

patterns.name: People's names and titles
patterns.context: First names, surnames, or full names in proper nouns; also includes parties in legal cases and names near representative roles.

patterns.name: Legal citations and procedural language
patterns.context: Case citations, litigation procedures, and judicial reasoning; names of cited people are also activated.

patterns.name: Sports figures and team narratives
patterns.context: Cricketer categories, or narratives about football careers, leagues, and people; place names are also activated.

patterns.name: Bibliographic information on publications and historical institutions
patterns.context: Authors, institutions, dates, and publication locations in references.

patterns.name: Negative findings in medical examinations
patterns.context: Examination records itemize negative findings such as no tenderness and no limitation of movement.
patterns.domain: Medical examination records in legal materials

patterns.name: Quantitative immunohistochemistry description
patterns.context: Describes skin samples, cell counts, and tissue layers, including experimental conditions and image analysis.

patterns.name: Descriptions of people associated with adult entertainment venues
patterns.context: Describes celebrity visitors, spokespeople, and their relationships at Nevada brothels.
patterns.domain: Biographical and adult-entertainment venue encyclopedia entries

11_225.description: 激活分布于专名、地名及被拆分的专名片段，也见于体育分类、法律引证与诉讼措辞、书目、医学阴性体征和生物医学组织描述；没有单一语义模式能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 地名内部的字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分为多个 token 的地名或解剖术语内部；第1段为人名中的城市名，第10段为组织学术语。

patterns.name: 人物姓名与称谓
patterns.context: 专名中的名、姓或完整姓名；也包括法律案件当事人和代表身份附近的人名。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律判例、人物叙述

patterns.name: 法律引证与程序措辞
patterns.trigger: «See»、«Re»、«v.»、«217»、«Md.»、«A.2d»、«(1958)»、«new»、«trial»、«against»、«disqualification»、«inevitably cause[s] delay»、«sufficient cause»、«bill of review»、«finality of judgments»
patterns.context: 判例引注、诉讼程序及司法理由陈述；被引人名亦有激活。

patterns.name: 体育人物与球队叙述
patterns.context: 板球运动员分类，或足球经历、联赛与人物叙述；地名也有激活。

patterns.name: 出版物与历史机构书目信息
patterns.context: 参考文献条目中的作者、机构、年代及出版地。
patterns.domain: 百科参考文献、艺术史书目

patterns.name: 医学检查中的否定体征
patterns.context: 检查记录逐项描述无压痛、无活动受限等阴性发现。
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的医学检查记录

patterns.name: 定量免疫组化描述
patterns.context: 描述皮肤样本、细胞计数及组织层次，含实验条件和图像分析。

patterns.name: 成人娱乐场所相关人物描述
patterns.context: 描述内华达州妓院的名人来访、代言人及其关系。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与成人娱乐场所条目

en.description: Activation spans multiple genres, with triggers including disease and pathology terms, legal evidentiary language, definitions in photography theory, song choruses, media criticism, and science-fiction plots; there is no common lexical or contextual feature across passages.

patterns.name: Disease- or injury-related terms
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of disease, pathological processes, clinical features, or treatment; some contexts involve immune mechanisms or animal models.

patterns.name: Court ruling language
patterns.context: Legal reasoning explains the burden of proof and standards for factual findings.

patterns.name: Epistemological statements about photography
patterns.context: An author defines the relationship between photography and belief and narrows the meaning of a term.

patterns.name: Chorus language in lyrics
patterns.context: Rhyming lyrics appear after a song number, character, or chorus label.

patterns.name: Political media commentary
patterns.context: Criticizes mainstream media for failing to report the truth, then cites institutional or organizational sources.

patterns.name: Science-fiction plot and mothership
patterns.context: Describes a scene in which space heroes and aliens leave a mothership.
patterns.domain: Science-fiction film reviews or plot descriptions

11_225.description: 激活涵盖多种文体，触发内容包括疾病与病理术语、法律举证措辞、摄影理论定义、歌词副歌、媒体批评及科幻情节；未见贯穿各段的共同词面或语境。

patterns.name: 疾病或损伤相关术语
patterns.context: 出现在疾病、病理过程、临床特征或治疗描述中；部分语境涉及免疫机制或动物模型。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、临床与病理学

patterns.name: 法庭判决措辞
patterns.trigger: «The moving party»、«burden»、«conclusively»、«no genuine issue of material fact exists»
patterns.context: 法律论证中阐述举证责任及事实认定标准。

patterns.name: 摄影认识论表述
patterns.trigger: «When I say»、«belief independent»、«I mean»、«in this precise and restricted sense»
patterns.context: 作者界定摄影与信念之间关系，并限定术语含义。

patterns.name: 歌词中的副歌用语
patterns.context: 歌曲编号、角色或副歌标注之后出现押韵歌词。

patterns.name: 政治媒体评论
patterns.context: 批评主流媒体未报道真相，随后引用机构或组织来源。

patterns.name: 科幻剧情与母舰
patterns.context: 描述太空英雄、外星人及飞船离开母舰的剧情场面。
patterns.domain: 科幻影视评论或剧情描述

en.description: Activations occur in medical assessments, disease descriptions, database screening, patent chemistry, statistical figures, as well as fantasy and science-fiction narratives, media commentary, and technical discussions; no common trigger is clear.

patterns.name: Classification, measurement, and risk assessment in medical research
patterns.context: Describes extracting measures, classifying patients, or assessing risk of bias in research methods or results.

patterns.name: Disease, pathology, and clinical descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses the nature, cause, pathology, or symptoms of disease; also includes legal language referring to disease as an insurance risk factor.
patterns.domain: Medical texts and legal texts concerning health risks

patterns.name: Databases, information sources, and inclusion/exclusion criteria
patterns.context: Introduces data sources and describes rules for screening or excluding materials in a study.

patterns.name: Patent claims and materials chemistry
patterns.context: Patent text lists chemical compositions and moves on to claim review or obviousness analysis.

patterns.name: Specific types of numbers and statistics
patterns.context: Lists percentages, thresholds, and years following classification measures or measurement results; activation may be influenced by combinations of numbers and symbols.

patterns.name: Stories, genre fiction, and plot descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces settings in genre fiction or characters, ships, and plot in science-fiction stories; the two passages have different trigger words and may share only a broad narrative context.
patterns.domain: Web articles, fantasy or science-fiction narratives

patterns.name: Media commentary and institutional quotations
patterns.context: Criticizes the media in a strongly opinionated tone and cites an institution or its website content.
patterns.domain: Online commentary, texts concerning gun-related issues

patterns.name: Software projects, articles, and technical licensing discussions
patterns.context: A forum-style discussion expresses uncertainty about an article's content and mentions a project or technical license; the opening also contains fragments of code or formatting text.

11_225.description: 激活分布于医学评估、疾病描述、数据库筛选、专利化学、统计数字，以及奇幻科幻叙述、媒体评论和技术讨论；共同触发因素不明确。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的分类、测量与风险评估
patterns.trigger: “outcome measure”, “follow-up”, “measurements”, “Bias risk assessment”, “seven-category”, “Cochrane Collaboration’s Risk of Bias tool”
patterns.context: 研究方法或结果报告中，描述提取指标、患者分类或偏倚风险评估。

patterns.name: 疾病、病理及临床描述
patterns.context: 谈论疾病的性质、病因、病变或症状；也包括疾病作为保险风险因素的法律表述。
patterns.domain: 医学文本及涉及健康风险的法律文本

patterns.name: 数据库、资料来源与纳入排除标准
patterns.context: 介绍资料库的来源，并说明研究筛选或排除资料的规则。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求与材料化学
patterns.trigger: “bisphenol A polyester”, “succinic acid”, “glutaric acid”, “adipic acid”, “Claim 1”, “rejected as obvious”
patterns.context: 专利文本列举化学组成，并转入权利要求审查或显而易见性判断。

patterns.name: 特定类型的数字与统计量
patterns.context: 在分类指标或测量结果之后列出百分比、阈值及年份；激活可能受数字和符号组合影响。

patterns.name: 故事、类型文学与剧情描写
patterns.trigger: “plot device”, “urban fantasy”, “paranormal investigator”, “The Dresden Files”；“a hero”, “space helmet”, “alien scientist”, “mothership”
patterns.context: 介绍类型小说中的设定或科幻故事里的角色、飞船与情节；两段触发词不同，可能只是宽泛的叙事语境。
patterns.domain: 网络文章、奇幻或科幻叙述

patterns.name: 媒体评论与机构引述
patterns.trigger: “mainstream” media, “report the truth”, “National Shooting Sports Foundation”, “blog post”
patterns.context: 以带有立场的语气批评媒体，并援引机构或其网站内容。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、枪支议题相关文本

patterns.name: 软件项目、文章与技术许可讨论
patterns.trigger: “The article mentions this”, “how they differ”, “Parsemus”, “licensing the technology”
patterns.context: 论坛式讨论中对文章内容表示不确定，并提及项目或技术许可；开头还出现零碎代码或格式文本。

en.description: Activation appears in formal text covering classification, measurement, research outcomes, and clinical risk terminology, as well as legal definitions, news reports, and directory formatting. The commonality is broad, primarily structured explanations or informational statements.

patterns.name: Semiquantitative/category scoring terminology
patterns.context: A method or assessment tool is described as semiquantitative or explicitly categorized; often adjacent to terms such as scoring, measurement, and risk assessment.

patterns.name: Research outcomes and measurement
patterns.context: Describes research questions, outcome measures, follow-up, or outcome assessment; common in research methods or clinical question frameworks.

patterns.name: Cancer and clinical risk/prognosis
patterns.context: Describes cancer risk, disease progression, or survival outcomes, including patients, genotypes, or disease characteristics.

patterns.name: Definitions and instructions in legal text
patterns.context: Addresses the meaning of legal terms, evidentiary requirements, or supplemental jury instructions.

patterns.name: Media and public issues in news
patterns.context: Criticizes media coverage or relays claims related to public organizations and social issues.

patterns.name: Crime and police action in news
patterns.context: Reports on suspects, robberies, and encounters with police.

patterns.name: Flyers and controversy involving social groups in news
patterns.context: Reports on flyers circulated on social media and controversial statements involving sexual-orientation groups.

patterns.name: Directory, title, and reference formatting
patterns.context: Content is organized using line breaks, indentation, section numbering, or directory entries rather than continuous prose.

11_225.concept: 结构化信息与分类说明
11_225.description: 激活见于正式文本中的分类、测量、研究结局与临床风险术语，也见法律定义、新闻报道和目录排版；共同点较宽泛，主要是结构化说明或信息陈述。

patterns.name: 半定量/类别评分术语
patterns.context: 方法或评估工具被描述为半定量，或明确按类别划分；常与评分、测量、风险评估等词相邻。

patterns.name: 研究结局与测量
patterns.context: 说明研究问题、结局指标、随访或结局测量；常见于研究方法或临床问题框架。

patterns.name: 癌症与临床风险/预后
patterns.context: 描述癌症风险、疾病进展或生存结果，包含患者、基因型或疾病特征。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的定义与指令
patterns.context: 围绕法律术语的含义、证据要件或陪审团补充指示展开。

patterns.name: 新闻中的媒体与公共议题
patterns.context: 批评媒体报道或转述公共组织、社会议题相关说法。

patterns.name: 新闻中的犯罪与警察行动
patterns.context: 报道嫌疑人、抢劫及其与警方接触的事件。

patterns.name: 新闻中的传单与社会群体争议
patterns.context: 报道社交媒体传播的传单及其涉及性取向群体的争议言论。

patterns.name: 目录、标题与参考资料排版
patterns.trigger: «References»、«External links»、罗马数字章节标题及页码
patterns.context: 以换行、缩进、章节编号或目录条目组织内容，而非连续正文。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple contexts: infinitival “to” and its complements, fixed legal phrases, definitions and classifications, functional limitations in patents, clinical applicability statements, title endings, and emphatic rhetoric; they are difficult to reduce to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Purpose or result complement to
patterns.context: Introduces an infinitive, purpose, or result after a verb or adjective; activation strength varies.

patterns.name: Known/unknown-person formula in legal documents
patterns.context: A fixed legal phrase in criminal charges describing co-conspirators and whether their identities are known.

patterns.name: Definitions and classification statements
patterns.context: Defines a medical term, then introduces a classification or subtype.

patterns.name: Functional limitations in patent claims
patterns.context: A patent describes protein or nucleic-acid components and specifies their function in producing antibodies and specific reactions.

patterns.name: Ending of Monsterists in a title
patterns.context: Appears in the music interview link title “The Monsterists”; may respond to a word ending or proper-name fragment rather than syntax.

patterns.name: Clinical research protocol and applicability
patterns.context: Compares microarray platforms and predictive accuracy, and identifies tumor characteristics, emphasizing clinical applicability.

patterns.name: Emphatic phrase in narrative
patterns.context: An opening to a personal story uses colloquial rhetoric to emphasize the facts that follow.

11_225.concept: 多语境中的功能性短语
11_225.description: 激活分散于多种语境：不定式“to”及其后续成分、法律固定套语、定义分类、专利功能限定、临床应用表述、标题词尾和强调性修辞；难以归结为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 目的或结果补语 to
patterns.context: 在动词或形容词后引出不定式、目的或结果；触发力度不一。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律判决、叙述性评论

patterns.name: 法律文书中的已知/未知人名公式
patterns.trigger: «to»9« the»5« Grand»4 Jury known« and»2« unknown»4
patterns.context: 刑事指控中描述共谋对象及其身份是否已知的固定法律套语。

patterns.name: 定义与分类表述
patterns.context: 先给出医学术语定义，再引出分类或亚型。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的功能性限定
patterns.trigger: «capable»« of»3« generating»4« antibodies»3« that»8« specifically»5« react»5
patterns.context: 专利描述蛋白或核酸构件，并限定其产生抗体及特异反应的功能。

patterns.name: 标题中 Monsterists 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在音乐采访链接标题“The Monsterists”中；可能响应词尾或专名片段，而非句法。

patterns.name: 临床研究方案与适用性
patterns.context: 比较微阵列平台、预测准确度并寻找肿瘤特征，突出临床可应用性。

patterns.name: 叙述中的强调性短语
patterns.context: 个人故事开场，以口语化修辞强调接下来的事实。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in legal documents discussing the sufficiency of evidence, support for convictions, and the use of evidence; it also appears in medical research texts and in judgments or rhetorical questions in news commentary, controversy reporting, stories, and literary criticism.

patterns.name: Whether legal evidence is sufficient
patterns.context: In court opinions or appeal summaries, discusses whether the government or state presented enough evidence to support a conviction, or whether evidence was sufficient to submit to a jury; often accompanied by a conclusive judgment.
patterns.domain: US criminal decisions and appellate legal documents

patterns.name: Use of evidence in legal issues
patterns.context: Numbered questions ask whether a court erred in allowing evidence, involving searches, government evidence collection, or admissibility; not necessarily a discussion of evidentiary sufficiency.
patterns.domain: Lists of issues in criminal procedure decisions

patterns.name: Research platforms, testing, and predictive accuracy
patterns.context: Describes comparisons between experimental platforms, tumor samples, and clinical tests or predictive measures.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research plans or NIH project texts

patterns.name: Public materials and their controversial statements
patterns.context: Introduces flyers circulated in Dublin and their statements about gay and bisexual people.

patterns.name: Rumors and locations in a thriller story
patterns.context: A childlike, game-like quotation introduces a haunted mansion, followed by a rumor that the deceased person lives there.

patterns.name: Media headlines, accusations of bias, and rhetorical questions
patterns.context: Comments on whether newspaper headlines prove widespread Islamophobia in British society, using rhetorical questions to discuss the basis for the accusation.

patterns.name: Rhetorical questions and assertions in literary evaluation
patterns.context: Raises a rhetorical question about Shakespeare’s works, then emphatically rejects a particular evaluation.

11_225.description: 激活主要集中于法律文书中对证据充分性、定罪支持及证据使用的论述；另见医学研究文本，以及新闻评论、争议报道、故事和文学评论中的判断或反问表达。

patterns.name: 法律证据是否充分
patterns.trigger: “sufficient evidence”“produce enough evidence”“failed to produce”“to convict”“to support his conviction”
patterns.context: 法院意见或上诉摘要中，讨论政府或州是否提出足够证据支持定罪，或证据是否足以提交陪审团；常伴随结论性判断。
patterns.domain: 美国刑事判决与上诉法律文书

patterns.name: 法律争点中的证据使用
patterns.context: 以编号问题提出法院是否错误准许使用证据，涉及搜查、政府取证或证据可采性；不一定讨论证据是否充分。
patterns.domain: 刑事诉讼判决中的争点列表

patterns.name: 科研平台、检测与预测准确度
patterns.trigger: “microarrays”“similar or better accuracy”“predicting PFS”“Clinically applicable TaqMan”
patterns.context: 描述比较实验平台、肿瘤样本及临床检测或预测指标。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划或 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 公开材料及其争议性陈述
patterns.context: 介绍在都柏林传播的传单及其对同性恋者、双性恋者的言论。

patterns.name: 惊悚故事中的传闻与地点
patterns.trigger: “Look for candy in a mansion haunted by Death”“Rumors began to circulate”
patterns.context: 以儿童游戏式引语引入闹鬼宅邸，并叙述死亡本人住在其中的传闻。

patterns.name: 媒体标题、偏见指控与反问
patterns.trigger: “headlines about Muslims blowing up the Pope”“hardly evidence”“would anyone be surprised”
patterns.context: 评论报纸标题能否证明英国社会普遍存在伊斯兰恐惧症，并以反问讨论指控依据。

patterns.name: 文学评价中的反问与断言
patterns.trigger: “would put forward as the crown of his life and work”“Again I say”“it can hardly be”
patterns.context: 围绕莎士比亚作品提出修辞性问题，随后用强调语气否定某种评价。

en.description: Activations often occur in structures involving inference, purpose, ability, or result introduced by “to,” especially legal evidential sufficiency and medical testing/automated analysis texts; there are also responses to video identification, evidentiary admissibility, and expressions of degree in news.

patterns.name: Evidential sufficiency and inference
patterns.context: Legal reasoning assesses whether evidence can support an inference or conviction, or exclude reasonable doubt; activation often falls near words such as to, enough, produce, and infer.

patterns.name: Corroboration and admissibility of evidence or statements
patterns.context: Discusses how evidence corroborates a party's statement, whether it is admissible, or whether the government can use it at trial.

patterns.name: Clarity and identification capability of video evidence
patterns.context: Assesses whether surveillance video can identify a suspect; the sentence contains the ability/sufficiency structure clear enough to identify.

patterns.name: Detection and diagnostic capability
patterns.context: Discusses whether a test method can quickly confirm or rule out a diagnosis and compares it with the current gold standard.

patterns.name: Automated detection/analysis methods
patterns.context: Describes laboratory measurements, staining, or detection performed using automated instruments or techniques.

patterns.name: Purpose, result, or degree structures introduced by “to”
patterns.context: Not limited to one meaning: in legal, news, and scientific texts, to introduces purpose, ability, result, or degree; some activations concentrate on to.

patterns.name: Controversial claims and expressions of degree
patterns.context: A news report presents a leaflet's strong evaluation and the analogy it goes on to propose; activation falls near a structure that intensifies the claim.

11_225.concept: 能力、推断与证据充分性
11_225.description: 激活常见于“to”引出的推断、用途、能力或结果结构，尤其法律证据充分性与医学检测/自动分析文本；另有视频识别、证据采纳及新闻中的程度表达。

patterns.name: 证据充分性与推断
patterns.trigger: “enough to create an inference”“enough evidence”“failed to produce enough evidence”“to permit a jury to infer”
patterns.context: 法律论证中评估证据能否支持某种推断、定罪或排除合理怀疑；激活常落在 to、enough、produce、infer 等词附近。

patterns.name: 证据或陈述的佐证、采纳
patterns.trigger: “corroborate appellant's statements”“admissible as an adoptive admission”“use evidence obtained”
patterns.context: 讨论证据如何佐证当事人陈述、是否可采，或政府能否在庭审中使用证据。

patterns.name: 视频证据的清晰度与识别能力
patterns.trigger: “footage was not clear enough to identify”
patterns.context: 评估监控视频能否辨认嫌疑人，句中出现 clear enough to identify 的能力/充分性结构。

patterns.name: 检测与确诊能力
patterns.trigger: “could be used”“quickly confirm or exclude the diagnosis”
patterns.context: 讨论检测方法能否快速确认或排除诊断，并与现行金标准比较。

patterns.name: 自动化检测/分析方法
patterns.trigger: “using an automatic analyzer”“automatic p53 immunohistochemical staining technique”
patterns.context: 描述实验室以自动化仪器或技术进行测量、染色或检测。

patterns.name: “to”引出的目的、结果或程度结构
patterns.trigger: “so far as to”“to permit”“to produce”“to withstand”“to identify”“to quickly confirm”
patterns.context: 不局限于单一语义：法律、新闻和科学文本中，to 引出目的、能力、结果或程度；部分激活集中在 to。

patterns.name: 争议性主张与程度表达
patterns.trigger: “outrageous and bizarre statements”“so far as to liken”
patterns.context: 新闻报道介绍传单的强烈评价及其进一步提出的类比；激活点落在程度推进结构附近。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on actions or results introduced by the infinitive to, and are also common in expressions with go on meaning to continue or begin doing something. A Digital Microscopy heading in a list of research facilities is also present and cannot be directly explained by the first two patterns.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: to introduces a subsequent action or result; in legal texts, it commonly appears in evidentiary arguments such as “to infer,” “to create,” and “to withstand,” and in news or narrative texts, it introduces a subsequent action.
patterns.domain: Legal argument, news, and general expository prose

patterns.name: go on and related continuation expressions
patterns.context: Describes someone or a text continuing to do something; «went» «on» «the» «air» in paragraph 8 is another use of the same phrase.

patterns.name: “Digital Microscopy” project heading
patterns.context: Appears in a list that introduces project categories with plus signs and describes the uses of research equipment.

11_225.description: 激活主要集中在不定式 to 引出的动作或结果，也常见于 go on 表示继续或开始进行某事的表达。另有科研设施列表中的 Digital Microscopy 标题，不能由前两种模式直接解释。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: to 引出后续动作或结果；在法律文本中常见于 “to infer”“to create”“to withstand”等证据论证，在新闻或叙述中引出后续动作。
patterns.domain: 法律论证、新闻与一般说明文

patterns.name: go on 及相关延续表达
patterns.context: 叙述某人或文本继续做某事；第 8 段的 «went» «on» «the» «air» 是同一短语的另一种用法。

patterns.name: “Digital Microscopy”项目标题
patterns.context: 出现在以加号引出项目类别、并说明科研设备用途的列表中。

en.description: Most concentrated in legal opinions assessing whether evidence, facts, or descriptions suffice to support an inference and meet the burden of proof; also covers negation or qualification of the evidentiary record. Other examples include enumerations in reports, medical terminology, and poetic dialogue, which cannot all be attributed to the same trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Evidential sufficiency and inference
patterns.context: Legal reasoning determines whether evidence, facts, or the government's proof suffice to support an inference, suspicion, or conviction; often appears in statements of the standard of proof in court opinions.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and criminal legal documents

patterns.name: Negation or qualification of the evidentiary record
patterns.context: Legal opinions review whether the record, reports, or descriptions support a judgment, involving negation, contrast, or limits on sufficiency.

patterns.name: Enumerating facts or events in reports
patterns.context: Introduces a list of subsequent events in a report; this passage does not clearly involve a legal standard of proof.

patterns.name: Medical terminology and research methods
patterns.context: Discusses disease, diagnosis, or research methods in medical papers; the two passages have different topics and specific trigger words, but both are in professional medical contexts.

patterns.name: Response to Death in literary dialogue
patterns.context: A character responds “Death” to a question in a poem or literary dialogue; it is not clearly related to the legal reasoning and professional discussion in other passages.

11_225.description: 最集中于法律判决中评估证据、事实或描述是否足以支持推断及证明标准，也覆盖证据记录的否定或限定；另见报告列举、医学论文术语和诗歌对白，不能都归为同一触发模式。

patterns.name: 证据充分性推断
patterns.trigger: “evidence” “enough” “to … create an inference” [2]；“sufficient evidence … to permit a jury to infer” [7]；“sufficient … facts” “allowing him to reasonably suspect” [4]；“must prove beyond a reasonable doubt” [10]
patterns.context: 法律论证中判断证据、事实或政府证明是否足以支持推断、怀疑或定罪；常出现在法院意见的证明标准表述中。
patterns.domain: 美国判例与刑事法律文书

patterns.name: 否定或限定证据记录
patterns.trigger: “does not indicate” “does, however, indicate” [3]；“serious doubts whether … would be sufficient” [8]
patterns.context: 法律意见审查记录、报告或描述能否支持某项判断，涉及否定、转折或充分性限制。
patterns.domain: 判例事实认定与证据分析

patterns.name: 报告列举事实或事件
patterns.trigger: “The report went on to list some of the higher-profile shootings” [5]
patterns.context: 报告叙述中引出后续所列举的事件；本段未出现明显的法律证明标准。

patterns.name: 医学术语及研究方法
patterns.trigger: “biliary and pancreatic manifestations” [1]；“invasive margin … colorectal cancer” “automated high-throughput image quantification” [9]
patterns.context: 医学论文中讨论疾病、诊断或研究方法；两段主题和具体触发词不同，但均为专业医学语境。
patterns.domain: 临床医学与生物医学研究

patterns.name: 文学对白中的死亡回应
patterns.context: 诗歌或文学对白，人物以“Death”回应提问；与其他段落的法律论证及专业论述不明显相同。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across several local collocations: media appearances or broadcasts (1, 2, 4, 5, 6), medical diagnostic capability (3), legal denials of testimony and inferences (7, 9, 10), and research relevance (8); no single shared semantics is apparent.

patterns.name: “on” followed by a broadcast medium or public appearance
patterns.context: Expressions such as “went on the air,” “appearances on …,” and “interviewed on …” refer to someone speaking or appearing publicly via radio, television, or a program; a program name sometimes follows closely.

patterns.name: Broadcast times and station call signs
patterns.context: “on” introduces a station frequency or call sign, followed by a broadcast time.

patterns.name: Diagnostic capability or accuracy after “can”
patterns.context: In medical sentences, describes whether a test can accurately diagnose a disease or condition.

patterns.name: Negative judgments or testimony after “did not”
patterns.context: In legal discussion, reviews whether a witness made a statement or whether a report recorded it; also introduces contrary evidence after a contrast.

patterns.name: Legal evidence supporting an inference
patterns.context: A court assesses whether evidence is sufficient to support legal inferences, such as criminal intent.

patterns.name: High correlation of experimental results
patterns.context: Research abstracts report a high correlation between data and immunohistochemical findings.

11_225.description: 强激活分散于多种局部搭配：媒介亮相或播出（1、2、4、5、6）、医学诊断能力（3）、法律否定证词与推断（7、9、10）、科研相关性（8）；未见单一共同语义。

patterns.name: “on”后接传播媒介或公开亮相
patterns.context: 出现“went on the air”“appearances on …”“interviewed on …”等表达，指某人通过广播、电视或节目公开发声、亮相；有时紧邻节目名。
patterns.domain: 新闻、人物传记、娱乐报道

patterns.name: 播出时间与电台呼号
patterns.context: “on”引出电台频率或呼号，后接播出时间。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、广播节目介绍

patterns.name: “can”后接诊断能力或准确性
patterns.context: 医学句子中描述检测手段能否准确诊断疾病或表现。

patterns.name: “did not”后接否定判断或证词
patterns.context: 法律论述中回顾证人是否作出某项陈述，或报告是否记载该陈述；也用于转折引出相反证据。

patterns.name: 法律证据支持推断
patterns.context: 法院评估证据是否足以支持犯罪意图等法律推断。

patterns.name: 实验结果的高度相关
patterns.context: 科研摘要中报告数据与免疫组织化学发现之间的高度相关。

en.description: Activations concentrate on evaluating or qualifying statements: medical texts discuss accurate identification and the relevance of test results; legal texts discuss evidence, opinions, and negative judgments. There are also responses to electrical-current specifications and a poetic passage answering “Death.”

patterns.name: accurately describing diagnostic or identification capability
patterns.context: Evaluates whether a test, analysis, or expression profile can accurately diagnose or identify risk, or is highly correlated with other findings.

patterns.name: Evidence, statements, and opinions in legal contexts
patterns.context: Legal texts negate, qualify, or evaluate reports, testimony, affidavits, or court conclusions.

patterns.name: Current specifications and equipment configuration
patterns.context: Describes the relationships among circuit-board trace width, current capacity, and the number of relays/devices.

patterns.name: First-person answer: Death
patterns.context: In a poetic dialogue, the narrator answers the other person's question about who seized them.

11_225.description: 激活集中于评估或限定陈述：医学文本谈准确识别、检测结果相关性；法律文本谈证据、意见及否定性判断。另对电流规格和诗歌中回答“Death”的片段有反应。

patterns.name: accurately 描述诊断或识别能力
patterns.context: 评价检测、分析或表达谱能否准确诊断、识别风险，或与其他发现高度相关。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、项目简介

patterns.name: 司法语境中的证据、陈述与意见
patterns.context: 法律文本中对报告、证词、宣誓书或法院结论作否定、限定或评估。

patterns.name: 电流规格与设备配置
patterns.context: 说明电路板走线宽度、电流容量及继电器／设备数量之间的关系。
patterns.domain: 电子技术论坛或说明文字

patterns.name: 第一人称回答 Death
patterns.context: 诗歌对话中，叙述者回答对方关于谁抓住自己的提问。

en.description: Covers passages on medical diagnosis, data analysis, legal inference and evidentiary sufficiency, as well as radio broadcasts and media appearances. Activations often fall on connectives or degree words such as can, to, on, and highly; no stable specialized content-word trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Syntactic connectives introducing continuation
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across common words connecting subsequent predicates, degrees, or relations, especially can, to, on, and highly; they do not consistently correspond to a specialized semantic word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; medical papers, legal opinions, sports, and biographies

patterns.name: Medical diagnosis and testing expressions
patterns.context: Appears in papers reporting diagnostic capability, data correlations, or analytical results; activations fall on general function or degree words rather than consistent medical terminology.

patterns.name: Legal inference and evidentiary sufficiency
patterns.context: Involves inferring from facts, whether allegations are sufficient, whether evidence or affidavits omit facts, and whether identification descriptions are adequate.

patterns.name: Broadcast channels and scheduling
patterns.context: Mentions programs, radio or television broadcast platforms, frequencies, schedules, or media appearances; strong activations mainly fall on on.

11_225.description: 覆盖医学诊断、数据分析、法律推断与证据充分性，以及广播播出和媒体露面等段落。激活常落在 can、to、on、highly 等连接或程度词上，未见稳定的专门内容词触发模式。

patterns.name: 引出续文的句法连接词
patterns.context: 激活散布在连接后续谓语、程度或关系的常见词中，尤其是 can、to、on、highly 等；并未稳定对应某个专门语义词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；医学论文、法律判决、体育与人物简介

patterns.name: 医学诊断与检测表述
patterns.context: 出现在报告诊断能力、数据相关性或分析结果的论文叙述中；激活落在一般功能词或程度词，而非一致的医学术语上。

patterns.name: 法律推断与证据充分性
patterns.context: 涉及从事实推断、指控是否充分、证据或宣誓书是否遗漏事实，以及识别描述是否足够。

patterns.name: 广播渠道与播出安排
patterns.context: 提及节目、广播或电视播出平台、频率、时间安排或媒体露面；强激活主要落在 on。
patterns.domain: 体育与人物类百科条目

en.description: Activations mainly cluster around whether evidence supports a conclusion and judgments of accuracy (3, 5, 6, 7, 2, 10); two other clear patterns concern broadcast and television dissemination (1, 4, 8) and sources and differing interpretations (9).

patterns.name: Unable to prove or establish a conclusion
patterns.context: Concerns whether facts, evidence, or the record support a conclusion; commonly involves negation, qualification, or inference, with activations on conclusive verbs and their surrounding context
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, factual reasoning, and biographical narrative

patterns.name: Assessing accuracy and diagnosis
patterns.context: Evaluates the accuracy and reliability of tests, diagnoses, or statements
patterns.domain: Medical papers and legal evidence review

patterns.name: Broadcast and television dissemination
patterns.context: Describes people or sporting events being broadcast on radio or television or appearing publicly, emphasizing media prepositions and dissemination verbs
patterns.domain: Biographies, sports broadcasts, and radio program information

patterns.name: Sources and differing interpretations
patterns.context: Mentions sources, fact-checking, and differing interpretations in reporting or controversial discussion
patterns.domain: News commentary or public policy discussion

11_225.description: 激活主要聚集于证据能否支持结论及准确性判断（3、5、6、7、2、10），另有广播电视传播（1、4、8）与来源、不同解释（9）两组明显模式。

patterns.name: 无法证明或建立结论
patterns.context: 关于事实、证据或记录能否支持某结论；常见否定、限定或推断表达，激活落在结论性动词及其邻近语境
patterns.domain: 法律判决、事实论证及传记叙述

patterns.name: 评估准确性与诊断
patterns.context: 评价检验、诊断或陈述的准确性、可靠性
patterns.domain: 医学论文与法律证据审查

patterns.name: 广播电视传播
patterns.context: 描述人物或体育赛事通过广播、电视播出或公开露面，突出媒介介词和传播动词
patterns.domain: 人物介绍、体育转播及广播节目资料

patterns.name: 来源与不同解释
patterns.context: 在报道或争议论述中提及来源、事实核查及不同解读
patterns.domain: 新闻评论或公共政策讨论

en.description: Activations appear mainly in contexts where reports, records, or sources are used to explain, list, or label information; other cases include the fixed parenthetical “it may be said,” source and reporting assessments, media interviews, quoted legends, medical diagnosis, statements of uncertainty, and political figures’ television appearances. No single stable trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Statements in reports, records, and information
patterns.context: Uses report, record, or sources as information sources, with verbs such as indicate, establish, list, and label describing their contents, evidence, or uncertainty; common nearby structures include does/not, it, and that.
patterns.domain: Legal records, news reports, and location information

patterns.name: Parenthetical expression “it may be said”
patterns.context: “it may be said” functions as a parenthetical that qualifies or modifies the preceding statement; a report or evidence context is not required.

patterns.name: Source and reporting assessments
patterns.context: Discusses how different sources, interpretations, or reports handle unverified allegations; emphasizes information sources and their credibility or differences.

patterns.name: Media appearances and interviews
patterns.context: Biographical entries list media appearances, interviews, or regular contributions, with nearby terms such as radio, television, and on.

patterns.name: Legends and what they claim
patterns.context: Uses a fixed expression to introduce what a legend or traditional narrative claims.

patterns.name: Medical diagnosis and disease classification
patterns.context: Medical texts list diseases and abbreviations and state the capabilities or limitations of diagnostic tests.

patterns.name: Uncertainty and its source
patterns.context: Explicitly states that a location or fact is uncertain and mentions a source’s location designation.

patterns.name: Political figures’ statements on media programs
patterns.context: News reports describe political figures appearing on television programs and advancing an issue or exerting pressure on the program.

11_225.description: 激活主要出现在报告、记录或来源被用来说明、列举或标注信息的语境；另覆盖固定插入语“it may be said”、来源与报道评价、媒体采访、传说引述、医学诊断、不确定性说明及政治人物电视露面，缺乏单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 报告、记录及信息的陈述
patterns.trigger: “The officer's accident report does not indicate… it does, however, indicate…”（1）；“The record does not establish…”（3）；“The report went on to list…”（5）；“Some sources label…”（9）
patterns.context: 以 report、record 或 sources 为信息来源，用 indicate、establish、list、label 等动词说明其内容、证据或不确定性；邻近常见 does/not、it、that 等陈述结构。
patterns.domain: 法律记录、新闻报道、地点资料

patterns.name: it may be said 的插入表达
patterns.trigger: “to which she had been almost, it may be said, brought up”
patterns.context: “it may be said”作为插入语，限定或修饰前面的说法；不要求报告或证据语境。

patterns.name: 来源与报道评价
patterns.trigger: “Other sources, of course, have different interpretations”；“sources”
patterns.context: 讨论不同来源、解释或报道如何处理未经核实的指控；强调信息来源及其可信度或差异。

patterns.name: 媒体露面与采访
patterns.trigger: “public radio and television appearances”；“interviewed frequently on National Public Radio”
patterns.context: 人物简介中列举媒体露面、采访或定期贡献，附近出现 radio、television、on 等词。

patterns.name: 传说及其所称内容
patterns.context: 以固定表达引出传说或传统叙述所称的内容。

patterns.name: 医学诊断与疾病分类
patterns.trigger: “No single diagnostic test can accurately diagnose…”
patterns.context: 医学文本列举疾病及缩写，并陈述诊断测试的能力或局限。

patterns.name: 不确定性及其来源
patterns.trigger: “Location Uncertainty”；“where the station was located is uncertain”
patterns.context: 明确指出地点或事实不确定，并提及来源对位置的标注。

patterns.name: 政治人物在媒体节目中的表态
patterns.trigger: “Mr. Obama, in an appearance on NBC's ‘Meet the Press,’”
patterns.context: 新闻报道描述政治人物参加电视节目，并在节目中推动议题或施压。

en.description: Activations cover syntactic function words and discourse connectors across different text types, with a tendency toward legal reporting, the contents of reports or petitions, and evidentiary framing; philosophical discussion is also present, with no unified topic.

patterns.name: Function words and syntactic continuation
patterns.context: Activations fall on common function words, auxiliaries, and syntactic connectors, in continuations of narration, reported speech, or argument; no fixed topic words are apparent.
patterns.domain: Fictional narrative, news, and legal reasoning

patterns.name: Report/statement language in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal texts report the contents of documents, reports, or parties' statements, often accompanied by discourse markers such as “further” and “recited.”

patterns.name: Quotation, sources, and evidentiary framing
patterns.context: Connectors introduce an inference, source, report content, or evidence; activations are distributed around sentence openings and quotation frames.

patterns.name: Theoretical literature/conceptual discussion
patterns.context: Discusses thinkers, aesthetic judgment, and academic concepts; activations occur in abstract argument and conceptual connections.

11_225.description: 激活覆盖多种文本中的句法虚词与论述连接，也偏向法律文书转述、报告或请愿书内容及证据框架；另见哲学概念讨论，主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 虚词与句法续接
patterns.trigger: “«it»3 «may»10 «be»8 said”以及“does not indicate”“according to”“may be relevant”
patterns.context: 激活落在常见虚词、助动词和句法连接词上，句子处于叙述、转述或论证的延续部分，未见固定主题词。
patterns.domain: 小说叙述、新闻与法律论证

patterns.name: 法律文书中的报告／陈述用语
patterns.context: 法律文本中转述文件、报告或当事人所述内容，常伴随“further”“recited”等叙述标记。

patterns.name: 引述、出处与证据框架
patterns.trigger: “«Accordingly»”“«according to»”““«The» «report» went on to list”“«evidence that»”
patterns.context: 以连接语引入推论、来源、报告内容或证据；激活分布于句首及引述框架附近。

patterns.name: 理论性文献／概念讨论
patterns.context: 讨论思想家、审美判断及学术概念，激活出现在抽象论述和概念联系中。

en.description: Activations are scattered across copulas, legal procedure and allegation language, statements of reports and data, news paraphrases, medical definitions and classifications, as well as contrastive connectives; no single stable lexical or semantic trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: be in clauses
patterns.context: Activations often fall on be verbs or nearby, especially copulas, passive structures, or auxiliary constructions in formal narratives, definitions, and judgments; not every instance can be unified this way.
patterns.domain: Written narrative, news, legal, and academic texts

patterns.name: Legal allegations and litigation language
patterns.context: Litigation procedures, allegations, evidence, or sworn statements; activations are scattered across legal formulae and related words.

patterns.name: Statements of reports, evidence, and results
patterns.context: Related nouns and surrounding statement words activate when citing reports, describing data, or summarizing research results.
patterns.domain: News, academic abstracts, or science reporting

patterns.name: Paraphrases and sources in reporting
patterns.context: News texts paraphrase someone’s claims, identify sources, or cite reports.

patterns.name: Academic classification and definition statements
patterns.context: Defines and classifies medical terms and lists subtypes.

patterns.name: Contrast and transition markers
patterns.context: Introduces contrast, qualification, or transition after stating facts or evidence.

patterns.name: Isolated neutral connectives or function words
patterns.context: These high-frequency words activate sporadically across contexts, with no consistent collocation or semantic condition.

11_225.description: 激活分散于正式书面语中的系词、法律程序与指控措辞、报告及数据陈述、新闻转述和医学定义分类，也涉及转折连接；没有单一稳定的词汇或语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 从句中的 be
patterns.trigger: « it»« may»« be»« said»；« is»，« is»；« was»
patterns.context: 激活常落在 be 动词或其附近，尤其是正式叙述、定义、判断中的系词、被动结构或助动结构；并非每个实例都能据此归一。
patterns.domain: 书面叙述、新闻、法律、学术文本

patterns.name: 法律指控与诉讼措辞
patterns.trigger: « indictment»、« charge»、« failed»、« to»« sufficiently»；« affidavits»、« aver»
patterns.context: 诉讼程序、指控、证据或宣誓陈述语境；激活散布在法律固定表达及相关词上。

patterns.name: 报告、证据与结果的陈述
patterns.context: 引用报告、说明数据或概述研究结果时，相关名词及其周边陈述词激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻、学术摘要或科普报道

patterns.name: 报道中的转述与来源
patterns.context: 新闻文本中转述某人说法、交代消息来源或引用报道。

patterns.name: 分类与定义式学术表述
patterns.context: 对医学术语进行定义、分类并列出亚型。

patterns.name: 对比与转折标记
patterns.context: 在陈述事实或证据后引出对比、修正或转折。

patterns.name: 单独出现的中性连接或功能词
patterns.context: 这些高频词在不同语境中零散激活，未显示一致的特定搭配或语义条件。

en.concept: English function words and stylistic cues
en.description: Activations are scattered across diverse contexts: English function-word sequences, legal accusations, reported testimony, program broadcasts, poetic dialogue, uncertain locations, and lists of automated industries. No single lexical theme explains all the fragments.

patterns.name: Local sequences of auxiliaries and copulas
patterns.context: Responds to specific words or adjacent structures in English function-word phrases, though positions and collocations vary.
patterns.domain: Narrative, news, encyclopedic, legal, and expository prose

patterns.name: Litigation language in legal documents
patterns.context: Criminal charges, motions to dismiss, and legal argument; triggers fall on litigation actions or nearby function words.

patterns.name: Reporting, testimony, and statement vocabulary
patterns.context: Reporting nouns and verbs used to introduce evidence, reports, or sources.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, news, and industry reporting

patterns.name: Television production and broadcast information
patterns.context: Describes program production, broadcast programs, or radio frequencies.

patterns.name: Dramatic quotations in poetry
patterns.context: Direct quotations, archaic pronouns, and dramatic dialogue in first-person poetic narration.

patterns.name: Place names and location uncertainty
patterns.context: Encyclopedic entries list geographic locations and discuss uncertainty in location records.

patterns.name: Automation and industry lists
patterns.context: Industry reports list sectors investing in automation.
patterns.domain: Industry reports and technology business reporting

patterns.name: Passive and modal expressions in general narration
patterns.context: Modal words and passive expressions appear as asides describing characters’ circumstances, growth, or suitability.

11_225.concept: 英语功能词与文体线索
11_225.description: 激活分散在多种语境中：包含英语功能词序列，也覆盖法律指控、报告证词、节目广播、诗歌对白、地点不确定及自动化行业列举；没有一个词汇主题能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 助动词与系词局部序列
patterns.trigger: « it» « may» « be» « said»；« is»；« to»；« that»
patterns.context: 对英语功能词短语中的特定词或相邻结构有反应，但各处位置与搭配不完全一致
patterns.domain: 叙事、新闻、百科、法律及说明文

patterns.name: 法律文书的诉讼措辞
patterns.trigger: « indictment» « challenged» « in» a habeas proceeding；« failed» « to» « sufficiently» charge
patterns.context: 刑事指控、申请撤销及法律论证语境，且触发落在诉讼动作或其邻近功能词上

patterns.name: 报告、证词与陈述词汇
patterns.trigger: « affidavits» « further» « aver»red；accident « report»；« report» states
patterns.context: 介绍证据、报告或消息来源时出现的报告性名词及动词
patterns.domain: 法律文书、新闻与行业报道

patterns.name: 电视节目制作及播出信息
patterns.trigger: « producers» « of» « the» « Fox» « TV» « show»；« weekly» « synd»icated « radio» « program»；« 102»« .»« 5»
patterns.context: 描述节目制作、广播节目或电台频率

patterns.name: 诗歌中的戏剧性引语
patterns.context: 第一人称诗歌叙述中，出现直接引语与古雅代词、戏剧化对白

patterns.name: 地名与地点不确定性
patterns.trigger: « New» York City；« United» States；Location Uncertainty；« sources» label its placement
patterns.context: 百科条目列出地理位置，并讨论地点记载不确定

patterns.name: 自动化与行业列举
patterns.trigger: Healthcare, automotive, « defense», oil and gas, « mining»；automation
patterns.context: 商业或技术报道列举投资自动化的行业
patterns.domain: 行业报告与科技商业报道

patterns.name: 一般叙事中的被动/情态表达
patterns.context: 叙述人物处境、成长或适合性时，以情态词和被动表达作插入说明

en.description: Activations are scattered across genres and often fall on English syntactic transitions, quotations, or source and media expressions in reporting; legal and medical passages also show strong activations, but no clear lexical pattern unifies all examples.

patterns.name: Quotation expressions and complement structures
patterns.context: Auxiliary verbs, copulas, or prepositions in English sentences connect to following participial or quotation expressions; in some examples, the relation may simply be syntactic adjacency.

patterns.name: News sources and reporting
patterns.context: News or informational texts mention news sources, differences among sources, or uncertainty about location information.

patterns.name: Media organizations, radio, and television
patterns.context: Involves television programs, interview broadcasts, or radio program production and distribution.

patterns.name: Statements and evidence in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal texts describe affidavits, testimony, or parties’ actions; activations fall at common narrative transitions in legal documents.

patterns.name: Medical classification definitions
patterns.context: Medical descriptions open with terms, definitions, and classification entries.

11_225.description: 激活分散于多种文体，常落在英语句法衔接、引述或报道中的来源与媒体表达；法律、医学段落也有较强激活，但未见能统一解释所有例子的明确词汇模式。

patterns.name: 引述表达与补语结构
patterns.trigger: « may»10« be»8« said»3；« was»4« fond»3« of»10« describing；« said»4« in»4« mastery
patterns.context: 英语句子中的助动词、系动词或介词与后续分词/引述表达相连；个别例子里也可能只是句法邻接。
patterns.domain: 文学叙述、哲学论述、诗歌

patterns.name: 消息来源与报道
patterns.context: 新闻或资料性文本提及消息来源、来源差异或地点信息的不确定性。

patterns.name: 媒体机构及广播电视
patterns.trigger: « producers»6« of»7« the»5« Fox»7« TV»8« show»9；« on»5« the»7« air»4；« radio»4« program»2
patterns.context: 涉及电视节目、采访播出或广播节目制作与传播。

patterns.name: 法律文件中的陈述与证据
patterns.trigger: « affidavits»5« further»8 averred；« partnership meetings».»2 The
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述宣誓书、证词或当事人行为；激活落在法律文书常见的叙述衔接处。

patterns.name: 医学分类定义
patterns.context: 医学说明以术语、定义和分类条目开篇。

en.concept: Assertive predicates in formal written English
en.description: Activations are scattered across several kinds of fixed written expressions: modal phrases, news reporting and media sources, legal reports, and biomedical language about incidence, classification, and diagnosis; broadcast frequencies and phrases expressing location uncertainty also occur.

patterns.name: it in modal auxiliary phrases
patterns.context: it is followed by a modal expression such as may be said; in this example, activation concentrates on may.

patterns.name: Broadcast frequency numbers
patterns.context: A radio frequency and station call sign follow on in a broadcast introduction.

patterns.name: Media outlet as subject in a news sentence
patterns.context: A production company and program name precede the reporting verb announced in a news story.

patterns.name: Newspaper as reporting source
patterns.context: A news narrative cites a source using newspaper reported.

patterns.name: Predicate in a traffic-accident report
patterns.context: In a legal account of an accident, report is the subject of does not indicate.

patterns.name: Difficulty determining in medical literature
patterns.context: A biomedical paper describes disease incidence as difficult to determine.

patterns.name: NPR media name
patterns.context: The media name is highlighted when a person has appeared on an NPR program or interview.

patterns.name: Disease definition and classification terms
patterns.context: After a medical definition, the text states that the disease is further divided into subtypes.

patterns.name: Location uncertainty and sources
patterns.context: An entry on a location says the site is uncertain and uses sources to describe its location.

patterns.name: Diagnostic capability statements
patterns.context: Biomedical literature discusses whether a diagnostic test can accurately diagnose disease manifestations.

11_225.concept: 正式书面语中的陈述谓语
11_225.description: 激活分散在多类固定书面表达中：情态短语、新闻报道与媒体来源、法律报告，以及医学论文的发生率、分类和诊断表述；另含广播频率和地点不确定性句式。

patterns.name: 情态助动词短语中的 it
patterns.context: it 后接 may be said 一类情态表达；本例激活集中在 may

patterns.name: 广播频率数字
patterns.context: 广播节目介绍中，on 后跟调频频率及电台呼号

patterns.name: 新闻句中的媒体报道主语
patterns.trigger: « producers»6« of»6« the»4« Fox»7« TV»8« show»9« announced
patterns.context: 新闻报道中，报道动词 announced 前出现制作方及节目名称

patterns.name: 报道来源 newspaper
patterns.context: 新闻叙述以 newspaper reported 引述报道来源

patterns.name: 交通事故报告谓语
patterns.context: 事故报告的法律叙述中，report 作主语并接 does not indicate

patterns.name: 医学文献中的难以确定
patterns.context: 医学论文讨论疾病发生率时，描述其难以确定

patterns.name: NPR 媒体名称
patterns.context: 人物曾在 NPR 节目或采访中露面，媒体名称被突出

patterns.name: 疾病定义与分类术语
patterns.context: 医学定义之后说明疾病进一步分为若干亚型

patterns.name: 地点不确定与来源
patterns.context: 地点条目说明站址不确定，并借来源描述其位置

patterns.name: 诊断能力陈述
patterns.context: 医学文献论述诊断测试能否准确诊断疾病表现

en.concept: English function words and judgment structures
en.description: Activations are heterogeneous: one group recurs in modal, copular, and referential structures involving may, be/is/was, and pronouns; others appear sporadically in legal judgments and rules, negative reports, times and numbers, uncertainty about sources, medical definitions and classifications, and philosophical evaluative expressions.

patterns.name: Modal or epistemic may
patterns.context: may is followed by a verb or verb phrase to express possibility, inference, or permission. In [1], it is the “may be said” enclosed by split markers; [8] has “may consist”; [10] has “may believe”.

patterns.name: be adjacent to modal words
patterns.context: The copula or auxiliary be occurs with participles, adjectives, or modal structures. Some instances are also adjacent to may, but not all instances of be/is/was share the same context.
patterns.domain: General narrative, philosophical texts, biomedical papers

patterns.name: it and related pronouns
patterns.context: Pronouns occur within sentences or clauses, refer to something mentioned earlier, or introduce a judgment. In [1], it combines with may be; in [10], it would seem and may believe jointly form an inferential expression.

patterns.name: Modal, judgment, and rule words in legal prose
patterns.context: Legal rulings or arguments describe the limits of a court’s knowledge, the application of rules, or acceptance of a proposition. This partly overlaps with modal expressions but is not triggered solely by may.

patterns.name: Reporting and negative judgment structures
patterns.context: In accident reports or statements of evidence, does/do not describes whether records indicate something; activation centers on reports and the judgment structures that follow them.

patterns.name: Time digits and punctuation
patterns.context: A broadcast time follows a station call sign in a program introduction; activation falls on digits and a period rather than on a prominent may structure.

patterns.name: Uncertainty and sources
patterns.context: A location is described as uncertain and sources are mentioned; high activation centers on sources, while the text also contains is uncertain.

patterns.name: Medical disease classification and diagnosis
patterns.context: Medical texts describe diseases and risks through definitions, classifications, or test capabilities; activation occurs in definition/classification sentences and capability judgments in abstracts.

patterns.name: Evaluative words in linguistic and philosophical writing
patterns.context: Evaluative collocations appear in discussions of thinkers, taste, and philology; their connection to triggers in other passages is weak.

11_225.concept: 英语功能词与判断结构
11_225.description: 激活分布较杂：一组反复出现在 may、be/is/was 及代词构成的情态、系词和指代结构中；其余散见法律判断与规则、报告否定、时间数字、来源不确定性、医学定义分类及哲学评价表达。

patterns.name: 情态或认识性 may
patterns.context: may 后接动词或动词短语，表达可能性、推断或许可；在 [1] 是被切分标记包围的 “may be said”，[8] 为 “may consist”，[10] 为 “may believe”。
patterns.domain: 叙述、法律论证、学术史文本

patterns.name: be 与情态词邻接
patterns.context: 系动词或助动词 be 处在分词、形容词或情态结构中；部分实例也与 may 相邻，但并非所有 be/is/was 都有相同上下文。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、哲学文本、医学论文

patterns.name: it 及相关代词
patterns.context: 代词出现在句中或从句中，指代前文事物或引出判断；[1] 的 it 与 may be 连用，[10] 的 it would seem 与 may believe 共同构成推断表述。

patterns.name: 法律文体中的情态、判断与规则词
patterns.context: 法律判决或论证中，描述法院认知边界、规则适用或对某命题的接受程度；与情态表达部分重合，但并非仅由 may 触发。

patterns.name: 报告与否定判断结构
patterns.context: 事故报告或证据陈述中，以 does/do not 描述记录是否表明某事；高亮集中于报告及其后的判断结构。

patterns.name: 时刻数字与标点
patterns.context: 广播节目介绍中，电台呼号后出现播出时间；激活落在数字及句点，而不是显著的 may 结构。

patterns.name: 不确定性与来源
patterns.context: 介绍地点无法确定并提到资料来源；高激活集中在 sources，正文还出现 is uncertain。

patterns.name: 医学疾病分类与诊断
patterns.context: 医学文本以定义、分类或测试能力描述疾病和风险；激活在定义/分类句及摘要中的能力判断处。

patterns.name: 语言学与哲学论述中的评价词
patterns.context: 讨论思想家、品味和语文学时，出现带评价色彩的惯用搭配；与其他段落的明确触发关系较弱。

en.concept: Function words in English verb constructions
en.description: Primarily responds to infinitive to and constructions with may/would followed by a verb; other cases involve prediction/evidence vocabulary, statistical citations, report narratives, and an internal fragment of multifactorial. Several activations cannot be explained by one unified local pattern.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Occurs in an infinitive construction followed by a verb; appears across different fields and genres.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, academic and legal texts

patterns.name: Modal verb constructions
patterns.context: may/would followed by a bare verb; found in narrative and historical discussion contexts, respectively.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative and encyclopedic historical texts

patterns.name: Prediction- or estimation-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Involves statements about survival rates, predictors, or evidence, but trigger words and syntactic positions are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Citation of statistical data
patterns.context: Numbers and reports of statistical results occur nearby in citations of government statistics.
patterns.domain: Public health and social policy discussion

patterns.name: Report introducing subsequent content
patterns.context: report is the subject, with went on to introducing the report’s subsequent list of items.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a multisyllabic word
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the segmented word multifactorial; this passage shows no stable syntactic trigger condition.

patterns.name: it be at a sentence boundary
patterns.context: The sentence contains the parenthetical it may be said, followed by It is at the start of the next sentence; this may reflect a local high-frequency function-word collocation, but there are few instances.

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers without clear classification
patterns.context: Occurrences are in medical terminology, legal argument, and general copular constructions, with no clear shared local condition.

11_225.concept: 英语动词结构中的功能词
11_225.description: 主要响应不定式 to 及 may/would 等后接动词的结构；另见预测/证据词汇、统计引述、报告叙述和 multifactorial 词内片段。多处激活无法由统一局部模式解释。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.trigger: «to»，尤其是随后接动词原形的 to（如 «to»9 estimate、«to»9 list、«to»9 believe、«to»9 sufficiently）
patterns.context: 处于不定式结构中，后接动词；不同领域和文体均出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、学术及法律文本

patterns.name: 情态动词搭配
patterns.context: may/would 后接动词原形；分别出现于叙事和历史论述语境。
patterns.domain: 文学叙事、百科历史文本

patterns.name: 预测或估计相关词汇
patterns.context: 涉及生存率、预测因子或证据的陈述，但触发词与句法位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 统计数据引述
patterns.context: 政府统计数据引述中，数字与统计结果的报告相邻。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、社会政策论述

patterns.name: 报告引出后续内容
patterns.context: 以 report 作主语，使用 went on to 引出报告后续列举内容。

patterns.name: 多音节词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的 multifactorial 一词内部；该段未显示稳定的句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 句界处 it be
patterns.context: 句内有 it may be said 的插入语，后续句首又出现 It is；可能反映局部高频功能词搭配，但实例有限。

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的零散触发
patterns.context: 分别位于医学术语、法律论证及一般系词结构中，未见共同而明确的局部条件。

en.concept: English sentence patterns and function-word fragments
en.description: Activations occur across diverse English function words and formulaic expressions: literary “it may be said,” medical definitions and introductions of evidence, legal “suffice it to say,” reporting “went on to,” and sporadic copulas, modals, and an aside containing sources. The contexts lack a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Completing the fixed expression “it may be said”
patterns.context: The expression “it may be said” occurs in a sentence, especially when may be said is followed by an explanation or evaluation; preceded by almost.

patterns.name: Function words in medical terminology and disease definitions
patterns.context: Medical papers use is to introduce definitions, classifications, or disease descriptions, near technical terms, noun phrases, and passive constructions.

patterns.name: be in copular and modal expressions
patterns.context: be, is, or may occurs in common copular, modal, or inferential constructions; triggers are scattered in sentences, with no consistent local collocation.
patterns.domain: Social science, classics, and other academic prose

patterns.name: Legal expression “suffice it to say”
patterns.context: A fixed expression introduces a brief conclusion in legal argument, followed by judgments such as indictments are sufficient.

patterns.name: Quoting and continuation in reporting narratives
patterns.context: went on to introduces a subsequent list or passage in reporting narratives.

patterns.name: Formula for introducing research evidence
patterns.context: Academic papers use “lines of evidence” to introduce research support or evidence; related high activations fall on words such as indicate and point and nearby words.

patterns.name: High activation near sources
patterns.context: An aside of course follows sources, and the sentence discusses different sources or interpretations; activation centers on sources and nearby punctuation and words.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Although sporadic copulas and modal words occur, this passage does not show a specific trigger collocation that can be confidently identified.

11_225.concept: 英语句式与功能词片段
11_225.description: 激活分布于多种英语功能词与套语：文学中的“it may be said”、医学定义与证据引介、法律“suffice it to say”、报告“went on to”，以及若干零散的系词、情态词和 sources 插入语；不同语境缺乏统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 补全固定表达“it may be said”
patterns.context: 在句中出现“it may be said”这一表达，尤其是 may be said 后接说明或评价；前接 almost。

patterns.name: 医学术语及疾病定义中的功能词
patterns.context: 医学论文中以 is 引出定义、分类或疾病描述，邻近术语、名词短语和被动结构。

patterns.name: 系词与情态表达中的 be
patterns.context: be、is 或 may 出现在常见系词、情态或推测句式中；触发分散在句中，未见统一的局部搭配。
patterns.domain: 社会科学、古典学等论述 prose

patterns.name: 法律表达“suffice it to say”
patterns.context: 法律论述中以固定表达引出简要结论，后接 indictments are sufficient 等判断。

patterns.name: 报告叙述中的引述与延续
patterns.context: 报告叙述中使用 went on to 引出后续列举或内容。

patterns.name: 研究证据引介套语
patterns.trigger: «Several»2« lines»1 of« evidence»8« indicate»1；«Several»3« lines»1 of»1« evidence»9« point»4
patterns.context: 学术论文用“lines of evidence”引出研究支持或证据指向；相关高激活落在 indicate、point 等词及周边。

patterns.name: sources 附近的高激活
patterns.context: sources 后接 of course 的插入语，句中谈论不同来源或解释；激活集中于 sources 及邻近标点和词。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 尽管有零散系词或情态词，但该段未显示足以确认的具体触发搭配。

en.description: Activations occur in syntactic connections and complement structures across genres, as well as in definitions, classifications, statistical reporting, and conventional legal and patent expressions. Content patterns such as medical terminology and lists of automated industries match only partially, making it difficult to establish a single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: “be said” parenthetical
patterns.context: A sentence contains a be verb and its complement, or a parenthetical such as “it may be said”; triggers are scattered and do not form a stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Phrases introducing subsequent content
patterns.context: Often follows a verb or participle and takes to, an infinitive, as, or another complement to describe a subsequent action, basis, function, or evaluation.

patterns.name: Classification and definition statements
patterns.context: Defines or classifies an object, usually followed directly by a category, definition, or explanation of a legal term.

patterns.name: Function words in coordination structures
patterns.context: Occurs at coordination, prepositional phrases, or complement links; only a few local markers activate, possibly reflecting a broad syntactic function-word pattern.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, technical and news texts

patterns.name: Statistical figures and reporting contexts
patterns.context: Near statistics, risk estimates, or report conclusions; activation falls on different words, possibly relating to the textual structure used to present evidence.

patterns.name: Legal opinion wording
patterns.context: Fixed legal expressions in criminal charges or judicial texts.

patterns.name: Conventional patent language
patterns.context: Describes the purpose or effect of an invention and introduces figures or specification content.

patterns.name: Medical terminology and disease progression
patterns.context: Discusses tumors, disease classification, prognosis, or biomarkers, but activation does not consistently fall on these terms.

patterns.name: Lists of automated industries
patterns.context: Lists industries when discussing investment in automation; the connection to other passages is unclear.

11_225.description: 激活分布于多种文体中的句法连接与补语结构，也见于定义、分类、统计报告、法律和专利惯用表达。医学术语及自动化行业列举等内容模式仅部分吻合，难以证明单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: “be said”插入语
patterns.trigger: “almost it may be said, brought up”中的“may be said”；另有“being homeless can be … and is often …”中的“can be”“is often”
patterns.context: 句子中出现 be 动词及其后的补语，或“it may be said”这类插入语；触发较分散，未形成稳定句法条件

patterns.name: 引出后续内容的短语
patterns.trigger: “went on to list”“taken in accordance with”“serve as”“failed as an independent prognostic factor”“used to estimate”
patterns.context: 常见于动词或分词之后，接 to、不定式、as 或其他补语，说明后续动作、依据、作用或评价

patterns.name: 分类与定义表述
patterns.trigger: “is defined as”“is further classified into”“term … is herein defined”
patterns.context: 定义或分类对象，通常紧接类别、定义内容或法律术语解释

patterns.name: 并列结构中的功能词
patterns.trigger: “and”“with”“in”“for”等，如“associated with”“in order to”“for novel cancer therapies”
patterns.context: 出现在并列、介词短语或补语连接处；仅少数局部标记激活，可能是宽泛的句法功能词模式
patterns.domain: 医学论文、技术与新闻文本

patterns.name: 统计数值与报告语境
patterns.context: 统计数据、风险估计或报告结论附近；激活落在不同词项上，可能与呈现证据的文本结构有关

patterns.name: 法律判决措辞
patterns.trigger: “beyond a reasonable doubt”“that term is herein defined”
patterns.context: 刑事指控或裁判文本中的固定法律表达

patterns.name: 专利说明书惯用语
patterns.trigger: “Other objects, benefits, and features … will become apparent … when taken in accordance with the attached drawings”
patterns.context: 描述发明目的、效果并引出附图或说明书内容

patterns.name: 医学术语及疾病进程
patterns.context: 肿瘤、疾病分类、预后或生物标志物讨论；但激活位置并不稳定地落在这些术语上

patterns.name: 自动化行业列举
patterns.trigger: “Healthcare, automotive, defense, oil and gas, and mining”
patterns.context: 讨论自动化投资时并列行业名称；与其他段落难以建立明确联系

en.description: Activations are scattered across structures expressing likelihood judgments, copular explanations, uses and classifications, quotations, and discussions of sources; some passages have only sporadic triggers, with no unified vocabulary or domain.

patterns.name: Modal and judgment expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences presenting a judgment, possibility, or argumentative conclusion; activation falls on may/be or a subsequent subword fragment.

patterns.name: Predication of relations and outcomes
patterns.context: Common copulas, judgment words, or infinitive structures appear when explaining an entity’s properties, meaning, use, or classification.

patterns.name: Introducing quotations or discourse
patterns.context: Introduces a quotation, reported content, or subsequent narration; triggers center on reporting verbs and adjacent function words.

patterns.name: Selection or classification terms
patterns.context: Explains a name, measure, subtype, or classification purpose; activation may fall on a term or its explanatory context.

patterns.name: Differences in sources and viewpoints
patterns.context: Discusses sources of information or differing interpretations of the same accusation.

11_225.concept: 判断与说明性话语结构
11_225.description: 激活分散在判断可能性、系词式说明、用途与分类、引述和来源讨论等结构中；部分段落仅有零散触发，缺乏统一词汇或领域。

patterns.name: 情态与判断表达
patterns.context: 出现在提出判断、可能性或论证结论的句子中；激活落在 may/be 或 may 的后续词片上。

patterns.name: 关系与结果的述谓
patterns.context: 在说明某事物的性质、意义、用途或分类时，常见系词、判断词或不定式结构。

patterns.name: 引述或话语引入
patterns.context: 引出引文、报告内容或后续叙述，触发集中在引述动词及其相邻功能词。

patterns.name: 选择或分类术语
patterns.context: 解释名称、指标、分型或分类用途；激活可能落在术语或其解释性上下文。

patterns.name: 来源与观点差异
patterns.context: 讨论消息来源或对同一指控的不同解读。

en.description: The most prominent patterns are “as the name suggests/implies” and infinitive to; a few other examples activate in the legal quotation “it is stated” and the statistical-evidence lead-in “statistics show.” The corpus spans diverse fields.

patterns.name: “as the name…” expression
patterns.context: name activates most strongly in explanatory parentheticals such as “as the name suggests/implies.”
patterns.domain: Popular science explanations, educational texts, and product feature descriptions

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
