patterns.name: UTF-8 string-output comment
patterns.context: Code sets encoding to utf8, followed by a comment explaining the output string.

patterns.name: CSS cannot change checkbox state
patterns.context: An answer addresses changing a checkbox’s selected state with CSS and mentions JavaScript as an alternative.

patterns.name: extension in compiler warnings
patterns.context: A compiler pragma comment explains why a warning is disabled, involving non-standard extensions such as zero-length arrays.
patterns.domain: C/C++ source code and compiler diagnostics

patterns.name: Label width determines line wrapping
patterns.context: Discusses how text wrapping is determined when a Label’s width is undefined, and gives setting it to “100%” as a solution.

patterns.name: Contract enforceability and no reliance
patterns.context: A disclaimer states that an email does not constitute an enforceable contract and that recipients may not claim a contract based on it.

patterns.name: Reading the SVG stroke-width property
patterns.context: Code first reads an element’s stroke-width property, then reads it from the style utility if needed.

patterns.name: Chart plugin feature comments
patterns.context: An HTML comment lists the resize and pie plugins for Flot charts and explains their purpose.

patterns.name: Database features and author assessment
patterns.context: A discussion compares InnoDB and MySQL, says the former provides traditional relational database features, and evaluates the original author’s judgment.

11_267.concept: none
11_267.description: 激活分散于代码注释、技术问答、法律邮件与数据库讨论；局部突出的词包括 now/allows、width、extension、属性名及技术术语，未见跨语料稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: now 与 allows 的邻接搭配
patterns.context: now 紧接 allows，后接 for；段落讨论新功能带来的能力或改进。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件，能源交易/估值

patterns.name: UTF-8 字符串输出注释
patterns.context: 代码将 encoding 设为 utf8，随后注释说明输出字符串。

patterns.name: CSS 无法修改 checkbox 状态
patterns.context: 回答关于用 CSS 改变 checkbox 选中状态的问题，并提到 JavaScript 替代方案。

patterns.name: 编译器警告中的 extension
patterns.context: 编译器 pragma 注释解释禁用警告的原因，涉及零长度数组等非标准扩展。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 源码及编译器诊断

patterns.name: Label 宽度决定换行
patterns.context: 讨论 Label 宽度未定义时如何确定文本换行，并以设为“100%”作解法。

patterns.name: 合同可执行性与禁止依赖
patterns.trigger: «enforceable contract»；«may not be relied on»；«basis of a contract»
patterns.context: 免责声明说明邮件不构成可执行合同，收件人不得据此主张合同。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件法律免责声明

patterns.name: SVG stroke-width 属性读取
patterns.context: 代码先读取元素的 stroke-width 属性，必要时再从样式工具读取。

patterns.name: 图表插件功能注释
patterns.context: HTML 注释列出 Flot 图表的 resize 与 pie 插件，并说明其用途。

patterns.name: 数据库功能与作者评价
patterns.context: 对话比较 InnoDB 与 MySQL，称前者提供传统关系数据库功能，并评价原作者的判断。

en.description: Responds to varied encoding/UTF-8 code, CSS style comments, and recurring legal disclaimers in Enron emails; commonality is weak, and activation depends on local wording.

patterns.name: Legal disclaimers in Enron emails
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on disclaimer wording stating that an email does not constitute a contract or may not be relied on to assert a contract; the same disclaimer has several similar versions, including variants with line breaks or quotation marks.

patterns.name: Encoding and UTF-8 in code
patterns.context: Occurs in code and technical Q&A about setting string encodings, URL encoding/decoding, or describing encoded data; activations fall on related identifiers and near UTF-8 strings.

patterns.name: CSS table-style comments and colors
patterns.context: A CSS comment explains striped/hover table background colors, with color values and CSS variable definitions nearby.

11_267.concept: none
11_267.description: 响应多种具体的编码/UTF-8代码、CSS样式注释，以及反复出现的Enron邮件法律免责声明；共同点较弱，激活依赖各局部措辞。

patterns.name: Enron邮件法律免责声明
patterns.trigger: “intended recipient”“contract by estoppel”“Enron Corp.”以及“may not be relied on”
patterns.context: 激活集中在关于邮件不构成合同、不得据此主张合同的免责声明措辞；同一免责声明有多种近似版本，含换行或引用符号变体。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件法律免责声明

patterns.name: 代码中的编码与 UTF-8
patterns.context: 出现在设置字符串编码、URL 编解码或说明已编码数据的代码与技术问答中；激活落在相关标识符及 UTF-8 字符串附近。

patterns.name: CSS 表格样式注释与颜色
patterns.context: CSS 注释说明表格条纹/悬停背景色，附近有颜色值和 CSS 变量定义。

en.concept: Descriptions of attributes and behavior in technical contexts
en.description: Activations occur in both physics and programming text. Programming examples often involve setting, overriding, or implementing attributes/values, and also occur near conditional assumptions and specific identifiers. Physics examples discuss symmetry breaking and gauge theory.

patterns.name: Setting and overriding attributes, configuration, or parameter values
patterns.context: Discusses how to set, read, or override attributes/values in objects, elements, files, or configurations; sometimes explicitly compares existing and new values.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Compatibility and implementation differences
patterns.context: Asks about or explains behavioral differences among older versions, compilers, or implementations, and the need to upgrade or handle those differences.
patterns.domain: Technical forums, programming documentation, and code comments

patterns.name: Assumptions, conditions, and qualifiers of possibility
patterns.context: Proposes options or hypotheses, or qualifies technical behavior with conditions or possibilities; these terms do not all refer to the same specific mechanism.
patterns.domain: Technical explanations, Q&A, and code comments

patterns.name: Symmetry breaking and gauge theory in physics
patterns.context: Discusses Lagrangians, mass terms, symmetry breaking, and introducing additional gauge bosons or new physics to restore unitarity.

patterns.name: Questions about new standards or upgrade paths
patterns.context: While discussing compatibility with older versions, asks why a particular standard is used and whether upgrading is necessary.

patterns.name: Strings and encodings in specific technical terms or identifiers
patterns.context: Character encodings, style properties, or case-sensitive identifiers appear; the examples serve different purposes and show no single shared semantics.

11_267.concept: 技术语境中的属性与行为说明
11_267.description: 跨物理与编程文本均有激活；编程例常涉及属性/值的设置、覆盖或实现差异，也出现在条件假设和具体标识符附近。物理例讨论对称性破缺与规范理论。

patterns.name: 属性、配置或参数值的设定与覆盖
patterns.trigger: “attributes cannot be modified”“unconditionally overrides the charset”“assigns ... an alias”“options.encoding = ...”“classList.add('selected')”“set the fontSize”
patterns.context: 讨论如何设置、读取或覆盖对象、元素、文件及配置中的属性/值；有时明确比较已有值与新值。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码与技术讨论

patterns.name: 兼容性与实现差异
patterns.trigger: “compatibility issues”“Some compilers handle this”“Some versions of SplitString might return”
patterns.context: 询问或说明不同旧版本、编译器或实现的行为差异，以及升级或处理差异的必要性。
patterns.domain: 技术论坛、编程文档与代码注释

patterns.name: 假设、条件与可能性限定
patterns.context: 提出可选方案或假设，或用条件、可能性限定某项技术行为；这些词并非都指向同一具体机制。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、问答与代码注释

patterns.name: 物理学中的对称性破缺与规范理论
patterns.context: 讨论拉格朗日量、质量项、对称性破缺，以及为恢复幺正性引入额外规范玻色子或新物理。

patterns.name: 关于新标准或升级路径的提问
patterns.context: 在讨论旧版本兼容性时，追问采用特定标准的原因及升级是否必要。

patterns.name: 具体技术术语或标识符中的字符串与编码
patterns.context: 出现字符编码、样式属性或大小写形式特定的标识符；各例用途不同，未显示单一共同语义。

en.concept: Proper names and terms in technical and legal contexts
en.description: Activations are scattered across source-code identifiers, compiler and language-compatibility discussions, legal liability and remedies terminology, and UTF-8/charset encoding; no single stable meaning covers all passages.

patterns.name: Identifiers and type names in code
patterns.context: Activations are distributed around code identifiers, type declarations, and member/method names; these are mostly camelCase, snake_case, or capitalized programming terms.

patterns.name: Compiler and C++ compatibility
patterns.context: Discusses language standards, differences in compiler implementations, compatibility issues, or whether an upgrade is necessary.

patterns.name: Legal liability and remedies terminology
patterns.context: Civil litigation facts and claims involving defenses, damages, torts, or property/contract remedies.

patterns.name: Character encoding and charset
patterns.context: Sets output encoding or discusses a conflict between the character set specified by a server and file-reading options.
patterns.domain: Programming source code and technical Q&A

11_267.concept: 技术与法律语境中的专名、术语
11_267.description: 激活散见于源码标识符、编译器与语言兼容讨论、法律责任及救济术语，也涉及 UTF-8/charset 编码；没有单一稳定语义可覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与类型名
patterns.context: 激活分布在代码标识符、类型声明和成员/方法名称周围；多为驼峰、下划线或大写开头的编程词。

patterns.name: 编译器与 C++ 兼容性
patterns.context: 讨论语言标准、编译器实现差异、兼容问题或升级是否必要。

patterns.name: 法律责任与救济术语
patterns.context: 民事诉讼事实与主张，涉及抗辩、赔偿、侵权或财产/合同救济。

patterns.name: 字符编码与 charset
patterns.context: 设置输出编码，或讨论服务器指定的字符集与文件读取选项之间的冲突。

en.description: Activations span several types of technical text: C++ compilers and code identifiers, legal claims, webpage scroll offsets, particle physics terminology, and curve parameter descriptions. The commonality is weak; they often involve specialized terms, compound words, and code identifiers in technical or legal contexts.

patterns.name: C++ code and compiler compatibility
patterns.context: Discusses C++ code, variable-length arrays, and whether compilers accept the relevant syntax

patterns.name: Claims and legal concepts in legal documents
patterns.context: Statements of legal facts, litigation claims, or court discussions of rights and remedies

patterns.name: Properties, type definitions, and member operations in code
patterns.context: Identifiers in code snippets use camelCase or snake_case and involve object properties, enums, or struct definitions

patterns.name: Scroll offsets and page headers
patterns.context: Describes setting an offset when scrolling to a target position to avoid a fixed menu or header

patterns.name: Symmetry and Lagrangians in physics
patterns.context: Discusses chiral Lagrangians, symmetry, and derivative order

patterns.name: Particle physics decay diagrams and color suppression
patterns.context: Describes annihilation, penguin, and tree-level contributions in baryon decays

patterns.name: Curve-edge parameters and defaults
patterns.context: Explains that a parameter controls whether an edge is curved, and that removing the parameter restores the default value

11_267.concept: 专门术语与复合标识符
11_267.description: 激活覆盖多类技术文本：C++编译器与代码标识符、法律主张、网页滚动偏移、粒子物理术语，以及曲线参数说明。共同点偏弱，常落在技术或法律语境中的专门术语、复合词与代码标识符。

patterns.name: C++ 代码与编译器兼容性
patterns.context: 讨论 C++ 代码、可变长度数组及编译器是否接受相关写法

patterns.name: 法律文书中的主张与法律概念
patterns.context: 法律事实陈述、诉讼主张或法院讨论权利与救济

patterns.name: 代码中的属性、类型定义与成员操作
patterns.context: 代码片段中标识符采用驼峰或下划线命名，涉及对象属性、枚举或结构体定义

patterns.name: 滚动偏移与页面标题栏
patterns.context: 描述滚动到目标位置时需设置偏移以避开固定菜单或标题栏

patterns.name: 物理学中的对称性与拉格朗日量
patterns.context: 讨论手征拉格朗日量、对称性及导数阶数

patterns.name: 粒子物理衰变图与颜色抑制

patterns.name: 程序代码与标识符

patterns.context: 讨论类型、方法、库、编译器或 API 时，技术名词和代码符号密集出现；激活常落在标识符及其邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答、代码注释与技术文档

patterns.name: 泛型与类型系统

patterns.name: 编译器兼容性与语言差异

patterns.name: 序列化与数据表示

patterns.name: 函数式编程与解析器组合

patterns.name: 编码器的字符串处理选项
patterns.trigger: «decodeStrings»、«We accept only strings»、«don’t need to decode them»

patterns.name: 图形 API 与底层访问

patterns.name: 代码注释中的解释语气

patterns.context: 代码或问答中用解释性语句说明实现选择、限制或行为原因。

en.description: Technical text emphasizes support, implementation differences, and limitations of tools, compilers, libraries, devices, or types; it also covers functional programming terminology, UID specifications, and optional capabilities described in code comments.

patterns.name: Compiler implementation differences

patterns.name: Capabilities and limitations of specific tools or libraries

patterns.name: UID field specifications and library support

11_267.concept: 软件能力与实现限制

patterns.name: 编译器实现差异

patterns.name: 具体工具或库的能力与限制

patterns.context: 描述软件、库、设备或类型支持、不支持或忽略某项能力。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、代码问答、技术讨论

patterns.name: 函数式编程术语
patterns.context: 介绍函数式编程抽象或语言功能；第6段同时涉及编译器支持。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的可选扩展说明
patterns.context: 内核风格注释说明驱动可选择实现扩展能力。

patterns.name: 浏览器兼容性及否定表达
patterns.context: 指出浏览器缺少某项 API，并据此质疑跨浏览器兼容性。

patterns.name: 特定序列化行为

patterns.name: 配置项被忽略
patterns.context: 解释样式设计器中的字体设置不起作用，因为引擎忽略相关属性。

patterns.name: UID字段规范与库支持
patterns.context: 说明 UID 的位字段含义及某库支持的变体范围。

en.description: Primarily responds to programming-related technical text: language and compiler differences, type and library constraints, as well as functional abstractions, SIMD optimization, and specific code or API explanations in JS/SVG and PHP.

patterns.name: Compiler and language feature compatibility
patterns.context: Discusses differences in how compilers support and handle syntax, template deduction, or optimization approaches

patterns.name: Type, generic, and serialization constraints
patterns.context: Explains how type systems, generic forms, type classes, or serialization constrain available implementations
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, involving .NET and Standard ML

patterns.name: Functional programming abstractions and library instances
patterns.context: Discusses abstractions such as functors and monads and the instances provided by parser libraries

patterns.name: JavaScript encoder string options

patterns.name: Reading SVG stroke-width attributes

patterns.name: PHP superglobals and deprecation of old-style arrays

11_267.concept: 编程语言与实现细节
11_267.description: 主要响应编程技术文本：语言与编译器差异、类型及库约束，也覆盖函数式抽象、SIMD优化，以及JS/SVG和PHP的具体代码或API说明。

patterns.name: 编译器及语言特性兼容性
patterns.trigger: “Some compilers tolerate it”, “depends on the compiler”, “compilers handle this”
patterns.context: 讨论不同编译器对语法、模板推导或优化方案的支持与处理差异

patterns.name: 类型、泛型与序列化约束
patterns.trigger: “DateTimeOffset type is not supported”, “typeclass does not exist”, “non-generic form”, “IEnumerable”
patterns.context: 说明类型系统、泛型形式、类型类或序列化对可用实现的限制

patterns.name: 函数式编程抽象与库实例
patterns.context: 谈论函子、单子等抽象及解析器库提供的实例

patterns.name: SIMD/XOR 与条件分支替代方案
patterns.trigger: “XOR's on multiple items at once”, “SIMD instructions”, “if-then-else”
patterns.context: 比较批量位运算与条件分支实现，并提到编译器识别简单模式

patterns.name: JavaScript 编码器字符串选项
patterns.context: 代码中设置流编码器选项，并以只接收字符串解释无需解码

patterns.name: SVG 描边宽度属性读取
patterns.context: 从原生属性或样式对象读取 SVG 元素的 stroke-width

patterns.name: PHP 超全局变量与旧式数组弃用
patterns.context: 辨析 PHP 变量是否为超全局，并提及旧式长数组在 PHP 5.4.0 移除

en.description: Mainly responds to compilers, type systems, and differences in their support in programming discussions; also covers concrete code/APIs, browser compatibility, and numeric representation in development contexts, with no narrow theme shared by all passages.

patterns.name: Compiler and type-system differences
patterns.context: Discusses how compilers handle language features, inference, support, or code acceptance, and differences in behavior across compilers.
patterns.domain: Programming languages, compilers, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Generics, overloading, and polymorphism
patterns.context: Explains the purpose and compatibility of generics, overloading, type classes, or polymorphism in type systems.
patterns.domain: Programming language design and API compatibility discussions

patterns.name: Code implementation and specific syntax/API
patterns.context: Code snippets or technical explanations include specific libraries, functions, types, or implementations; they do not all concern the same language feature.
patterns.domain: Software engineering, code examples, and developer discussions

patterns.name: Cross-platform/browser support limitations
patterns.context: Notes that a web feature or API is unsupported by some browsers, raising questions about cross-browser compatibility.

patterns.name: Bit width and numeric representation approaches
patterns.context: Discusses data types for representing values beyond the 64-bit range and lists wider integers or emulation approaches.
patterns.domain: Low-level programming and numeric type implementations

11_267.concept: 编程技术讨论
11_267.description: 主要响应编程技术讨论中的编译器、类型系统及其支持差异；也覆盖具体代码/API、浏览器兼容和数值表示等开发语境，未见所有片段都共享的窄主题。

patterns.name: 编译器与类型系统的差异
patterns.trigger: «comp»«ilers»10« handle»、«comp»«ilers»10« are»、«comp»«ilers»10« tolerate»；另有 «implicit»« argument»« deduction»、«compiler»
patterns.context: 讨论编译器如何处理语言特性、推断、支持或容忍代码，以及编译器间行为差异。
patterns.domain: 编程语言、编译器与技术问答

patterns.name: 泛型、重载与多态
patterns.context: 解释类型系统中泛型、重载、类型类或多态机制的用途与兼容性。
patterns.domain: 编程语言设计与 API 兼容性讨论

patterns.name: 代码实现与具体语法/API
patterns.context: 代码片段或技术解释中出现具体库、函数、类型或实现方案；并非都涉及同一语言特性。
patterns.domain: 软件工程、代码示例与开发者讨论

patterns.name: 跨平台/浏览器支持限制
patterns.context: 指出某个网页功能或 API 不被部分浏览器支持，从而质疑跨浏览器兼容性。

patterns.name: 位宽与数值表示方案
patterns.context: 讨论表示超出 64 位范围的数据类型，并列举更宽整数或模拟方案。
patterns.domain: 底层编程与数值类型实现

en.description: Activations occur mainly in programming contexts, especially compiler support and differences, types, and language features; they also cover code assumptions, conditional implementations, functional abstractions, SIMD, and formatted output, without reducing to a single specialized topic.

patterns.name: Compiler capabilities and compatibility
patterns.context: Discusses differences in compiler support or capabilities for language features, template deduction, and coding styles.
patterns.domain: Programming languages, compilers, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Types and type support issues
patterns.context: Concerns support, representation, inference, or underlying types; some passages involve serialization and bit width.
patterns.domain: Programming, type systems, and software engineering

patterns.name: Code feature and implementation details
patterns.context: Explains implementation assumptions, limitations, workarounds, or required manual implementation in code or technical documentation.

patterns.name: Conditional branches and alternatives
patterns.context: Describes or shows conditional checks and alternative implementations; may also discuss compiler optimization or type checking.

patterns.name: Functional programming abstractions and instances
patterns.context: Discusses instances and uses of type classes or abstract interfaces in programming language libraries.

patterns.name: Language features and boundaries of language specifications
patterns.context: Explains whether syntax or deduction behavior is part of the language standard and how a compiler handles it.
patterns.domain: C++ and programming language technical Q&A

patterns.name: Comments or explanatory statements in code
patterns.context: Comments within code snippets state assumptions or design rationale.

patterns.name: XOR/SIMD batch processing
patterns.context: Discusses hardware instructions for processing multiple data items at once and the compiler's ability to generate or select an implementation.

patterns.name: Code formatting and pretty-printing
patterns.context: Mentions producing formatted representations of data types, requiring a separate implementation for each type.

11_267.concept: 编程技术解释与实现
11_267.description: 主要激活于编程技术语境，尤其是编译器支持/差异、类型与语言特性；也覆盖代码假设、条件实现、函数式抽象、SIMD及格式化输出，难以归约为单一专门主题。

patterns.name: 编译器能力与兼容性
patterns.context: 讨论编译器对语言特性、模板推导、代码写法的支持差异或能力。
patterns.domain: 编程语言、编译器与技术问答

patterns.name: 类型与类型支持问题
patterns.context: 围绕类型的支持、表示、推断或底层类型展开；有的涉及序列化和位宽。
patterns.domain: 编程、类型系统与软件工程

patterns.name: 代码特性与实现细节说明
patterns.trigger: “We assume that the 'stroke-width'”、“We accept only strings”、“non-overloaded variant of show”
patterns.context: 在代码或技术说明中解释实现假设、限制、变通方案或所需手工实现。

patterns.name: 条件分支及替代方案
patterns.context: 描述或展示条件判断、备选实现；可能同时谈编译器优化或类型判断。

patterns.name: 函数式编程抽象与实例
patterns.context: 谈编程语言库中的类型类/抽象接口实例及其用途。

patterns.name: 语言特性与语言规范边界
patterns.trigger: “variable-length array”、“aren't actually part of C++”、“implicit argument deduction”
patterns.context: 解释某种语法或推导行为是否属于语言标准、以及编译器如何处理。

patterns.name: 代码中的注释或说明性陈述
patterns.trigger: “// NOTE: We assume”与“// We accept only strings”
patterns.context: 代码片段内以注释陈述假设或设计理由。

patterns.name: XOR/SIMD批量处理
patterns.trigger: “support XOR's on multiple items at once”、“SIMD instructions”
patterns.context: 讨论一次处理多个数据项的硬件指令，以及编译器生成或选择实现的能力。
patterns.domain: 低层优化与计算机体系结构

patterns.name: 代码格式化与 pretty-print
patterns.context: 提到为数据类型输出格式化表示，且需要为每种类型提供实现。

en.description: Mainly responds to programming technical text: compiler support and compatibility, language and type mechanisms; also covers UI styling issues and frontend code for property access, option configuration, and explanatory comments.

patterns.name: Compiler compatibility and type support
patterns.context: Discusses whether compilers can support, infer, or accept a language feature, type, or coding style.
patterns.domain: Programming languages, C++, tools, and Q&A, [1][2][4][5]

patterns.name: Language features and type mechanisms
patterns.context: Explains or compares language abstractions, type systems, operator/function overloading, or library mechanisms.
patterns.domain: Functional programming, Scala, JavaScript, and other technical discussions, [3][6][8]

patterns.name: Ignored UI style properties
patterns.context: Explains that a style designer's font settings have no effect and that the UI engine ignores the relevant properties.

patterns.name: String decoding options and comment explanations
patterns.context: Code configures an option and uses a comment to explain that string decoding is unnecessary.

patterns.name: Reading SVG stroke width
patterns.context: Code reads an SVG stroke width from an element attribute or style, with a nearby comment stating an assumption.

11_267.concept: 编程技术解释与实现
11_267.description: 主要响应编程技术文本：编译器支持与兼容性、语言和类型机制；也覆盖 UI 样式故障及前端代码中属性读取、选项配置和解释性注释。

patterns.name: 编译器兼容性与类型支持
patterns.context: 讨论编译器能否支持、推断或容忍某种语言特性、类型或代码写法。

patterns.name: 语言特性与类型机制
patterns.context: 解释或比较语言抽象、类型系统、操作符/函数重载或库机制。
patterns.domain: 函数式编程、Scala、JavaScript 等技术讨论，[3][6][8]

patterns.name: 界面样式属性被忽略
patterns.context: 说明样式设计器对字体设置不起作用，并指出界面引擎忽略相关属性。
patterns.domain: 桌面 UI 与样式引擎问答，[7]

patterns.name: 字符串解码选项与注释说明
patterns.context: 代码配置选项后用注释解释无需解码字符串。

patterns.name: SVG 描边宽度读取
patterns.context: 代码从元素属性或样式中读取 SVG 描边宽度，附近注释陈述假设。

en.concept: Local features in numerical and scientific text
en.description: Activates on numbers, operators, and punctuation across math problems, as well as biomedical text containing diversity-related vocabulary or quantitative units; sporadic subword fragments are also highlighted, insufficient to establish a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in math problems
patterns.context: Several tokens near numbers, minus signs, comparison symbols, and punctuation activate in math questions or arithmetic expressions; paragraph 1 is also followed by a newline and “Let y =”.

patterns.name: Diversity-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in organizational contexts discussing diversity, fairness, and inclusion, or in descriptions of diversity among chemical or biological entities; the triggering terms belong to different domains.
patterns.domain: Corporate diversity and inclusion; biomedical/chemical abstracts

patterns.name: Quantitative scientific text with units
patterns.context: Numbers occur next to scientific units of measurement, exponents, or experimental doses; some activations fall on parts of units or on numbers rather than semantic words.

patterns.name: Other locally high-activation words
patterns.context: These highlights are scattered across problems, method descriptions, and results; the fragments themselves do not show a common, clear trigger.

11_390.concept: 数字与科学文本局部特征
11_390.description: 激活跨数学题中的数字、运算符和标点，以及含多样性词汇或定量单位的生物医学文本；另有零散词片段高亮，无法据此确认统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 数学问句或算术表达式中，数字、负号、比较符号及标点附近的若干 token 激活；第 1 段还接着出现换行和“Let y =”。

patterns.name: 多样性相关词汇
patterns.context: 讨论多样性、公平与包容的组织语境，或描述化学、生物学对象的多样性；触发词所在领域不同。
patterns.domain: 企业多元与包容；生物医学/化学摘要

patterns.name: 含单位的定量科学文本
patterns.context: 数值与科学计量单位、指数或实验剂量相邻；有些激活落在单位组成部分或数字上，而非语义词。

patterns.name: 其他局部高激活词
patterns.context: 这些高亮分散在题目、方法描述及结果文本中，片段本身没有显示出共同而明确的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 数学题与生物医学摘要

en.concept: Multiple text features, difficult to unify
en.description: The response pattern is not singular: activations occur on numerical expressions in mathematical comparison problems, “diversity” in organizational and research texts, and the repeatedly occurring kg unit in biomedical quantitative texts.

patterns.name: Numerical symbols in comparison or arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Numbers, minus signs, and comparison words form mathematical problems; in one case, a newline is followed by a subsequent algebra problem.

patterns.name: diversity in diversity and inclusion contexts
patterns.context: Describes how organizations build an inclusive culture, promote women's participation, and foster diversity; diversity is the direct trigger.

patterns.name: diversity in scientific contexts
patterns.context: Appears alongside multiplicity and different catalytic properties, or near natural products, chemical diversity, and lead structures.

patterns.name: Numerical expressions with the medical unit kg
patterns.context: Appears in quantitative results such as dosage, body mass index, in vivo balance, toxic doses, spiked concentrations, or milk production; formats often include kg/m², kg⁻¹, mg kg⁻¹, or kg day⁻¹.
patterns.domain: Medical and biomedical abstracts, experimental results

11_390.concept: 多种文本特征，难以统一
11_390.description: 响应模式并不单一：数学比较题中的数值表达、组织与科研文本中的“diversity”，以及生物医学定量文本里反复出现的 kg 单位均有激活。

patterns.name: 比较或算术题中的数值符号
patterns.context: 数字、负号和比较词构成数学题目；一处还紧接换行及后续代数题。

patterns.name: 多样性与包容性语境中的 diversity
patterns.context: 描述组织如何建设包容文化、促进女性参与及多元化；其中 diversity 是直接触发词。
patterns.domain: 职场多元化与包容性文章

patterns.name: 科学语境中的 diversity
patterns.context: 与 multiplicity、不同催化性质并列，或与 natural products、chemical diversity 和 lead structures 相邻。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/药物发现摘要

patterns.name: 医学单位中的 kg 数值表达
patterns.context: 出现在剂量、体重指数、体内平衡、毒性剂量、加标浓度或产奶量等定量结果中；格式多为 kg/m²、kg⁻¹、mg kg⁻¹ 或 kg day⁻¹。
patterns.domain: 医学与生物医学摘要、实验结果

en.concept: Local cues in diversity and measurement texts
en.description: The most prominent activation pattern is diversity, covering workplace inclusion and chemical diversity; other local activations occur on mathematical size comparisons, German compound-word fragments, and the kg measurement unit in several medical/biological texts.

patterns.name: diversity/inclusion
patterns.context: The word appears in diversity and inclusion contexts involving organizations, the workforce, and women's participation; the same passage also includes “inclusive culture” and “equality, respect and trust”.

patterns.name: Size-comparison problems
patterns.context: Compares variables or numerical values in mathematical problems; activation is concentrated on the compared items and the numbers that follow them.

patterns.name: Chemical diversity
patterns.context: Describes the diversity, properties, or research uses of drugs, chemicals, molecules, or natural products.

patterns.name: German compound-word fragments
patterns.context: In formal German texts, long compound words are split into multiple subword tokens; the passage discusses information access, public participation, and decision-making procedures.

patterns.name: Toxicology dosage units
patterns.context: Reports single-dose toxicity and dosage in animals, with units expressing mass per body weight.

patterns.name: Anthropometric units
patterns.context: The methods section of a medical study reports participants' BMI; strong activation falls on the kg token in the unit.

patterns.name: Metabolic flux units
patterns.context: Reports infusion and hepatic/visceral balance data, with measurement units normalized by body weight and time.

patterns.name: Anesthetic dosage units
patterns.context: Reports the body weight of pigs in an animal anesthesia study; activation is concentrated on the kg token.

11_390.concept: 多样性与计量文本中的局部线索
11_390.description: 激活最显著的词义模式是 diversity，涵盖职场包容及化学多样性；另有数学大小比较、德语复合词片段，以及多篇医学/生物学文本中计量单位 kg 的局部激活。

patterns.name: diversity/inclusion
patterns.context: 组织、劳动力及女性参与的多元化与包容性语境中出现该词；同段还有“inclusive culture”“equality, respect and trust”。

patterns.name: 比较大小题
patterns.trigger: Which is bigger: r or 4?；smaller: -15949 or -2?
patterns.context: 数学题目中比较变量或数值，激活集中在比较对象及其后的数字。

patterns.name: 化学多样性
patterns.trigger: “diversity”及“multiplicity, diversity”；“wide variety of drugs, chemicals and carcinogens”
patterns.context: 描述药物、化学物质、分子或天然产物的多样性、性质或研究用途。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与药物化学摘要

patterns.name: 德语复合词片段
patterns.context: 德语正式文本中，长复合词被切分成多个子词 token；段内讨论信息获取、公众参与和决策程序。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会/法律政策文本

patterns.name: 毒理学剂量单位
patterns.context: 报告动物单次给药毒性及剂量，单位中出现质量/体重表示。

patterns.name: 人体测量单位
patterns.context: 医学研究方法部分报告受试者 BMI；强激活落在单位中的 kg token。

patterns.name: 代谢通量单位
patterns.context: 报告输注及肝脏/内脏平衡数据，出现按体重和时间归一化的计量单位。

patterns.name: 麻醉剂量单位
patterns.context: 动物麻醉研究中报告猪的体重，激活集中在 kg token。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to minus signs and the following numbers, variables, fractions, or expressions in mathematical material, and also to expressions containing subtraction; one passage of cochlear science prose has no obvious common trigger.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions following a minus sign
patterns.context: A minus sign prefixes a number or algebraic expression; it is often followed by a number, variable, fraction, or parentheses, and appears in operations, answers, or lists.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; math problems, calculations, or numerical lists

patterns.name: Subtraction operators and math-problem contexts
patterns.context: A minus sign occurs in a continuous arithmetic expression and may indicate subtraction or a negative number; sometimes accompanied by a newline, problem instruction, or result.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; arithmetic exercises and calculation problems

patterns.name: Local mathematical sequences of numbers and operators
patterns.context: Formula fragments comprising numbers, variables, plus or minus signs, slashes, parentheses, and similar symbols; the specific operation may not be identifiable from the fragment alone.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; formula or expression fragments

patterns.name: General English explanatory prose
patterns.context: Continuous English prose discussing processes within the cochlea and their functions; no obvious mathematical symbols or minus signs.

11_390.concept: 数学负号及减法
11_390.description: 主要在数学材料中对负号及其后的数值、变量、分数或表达式强烈响应，也见于含减法的算式；另有一段耳蜗科学散文，无明显共同触发线索。

patterns.name: 负号后的数学表达式
patterns.context: 负号作为数值或代数表达式的前缀；常接数字、变量、分数或括号，出现在运算、答案、列表中。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；数学题、计算式或数值列表

patterns.name: 减法运算符及其数学题语境
patterns.context: 减号处于连续算术表达式中，可表示减法或负数；有时伴随换行、题目指令或结果。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；算术练习与计算题

patterns.name: 数字与运算符的局部数学序列
patterns.context: 数字、变量、正负号、斜线、括号等组成的公式片段；不一定能仅凭片段确定具体运算含义。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；公式或表达式残片

patterns.name: 一般英文说明性文字
patterns.context: 连续英文散文，谈及耳蜗内的过程及其功能；没有明显数学符号或减号。

en.concept: How headline prefix and several isolated triggers
en.description: The main pattern is two newlines followed by the “How” prefix in HackerNews headlines; other activations include newlines/True in mathematical fragments and specific words in two biomedical contexts, with no shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: HackerNews headline prefix
patterns.context: A headline begins with “How” after two newlines; activation falls on “How”, while the subsequent headline content varies

patterns.name: Newlines and True in mathematical problems
patterns.context: In a mathematical exercise or answer fragment, “True” appears after a newline, followed by an item number and a function expression

patterns.name: Wording about the consequences of alcohol abuse
patterns.context: After the sentence-initial “The”, discusses the effects of alcohol abuse on the public

patterns.name: Transcription factor terminology
patterns.context: “transcription factor” appears after “The”, followed by NF-kappaB

11_390.concept: How 标题前缀及若干孤立触发
11_390.description: 主要模式是 HackerNews 标题前两个换行及“How”前缀；另有数学片段中的换行/True，以及两种生物医学语境中的特定词语，缺乏共同的语义触发因素。

patterns.name: HackerNews 标题前缀
patterns.context: 两个换行后以“How”开头的标题；激活落在“How”，其后标题内容各异

patterns.name: 数学题中的换行与 True
patterns.context: 数学练习或答案片段中，换行后出现“True”，接着是编号及函数表达式

patterns.name: 酒精滥用后果措辞
patterns.context: 句首“The”之后，谈论酒精滥用对公众的影响
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 医学/公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 转录因子术语
patterns.context: “The”之后出现“transcription factor”，随后为 NF-kappaB
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物医学文本

en.description: Responds mainly to minus signs and neighboring numbers or variables; also activates noticeably on long-space alignment in documents, including court headings and code/license fields.

patterns.name: Minus signs and negative-number/subtraction expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign is used as a number sign or as a subtraction operator in a mathematical expression; often accompanied by numbers, decimal points, or variables.

patterns.name: Fixed-spacing and parenthetical formatting in court headings
patterns.context: Appears near title pages, case names, or court headings in court rulings; long spaces align the heading, case name, and parentheses.

patterns.name: Long-space alignment in code
patterns.context: Spaces align fields, values, or addresses in code or license text; this is distinct from legal-heading formatting.

11_390.concept: 负号与长空格排版
11_390.description: 主要响应负号及其邻近数字或变量；另对文档中的长空格排版对齐有明显激活，见于法院标题和代码/许可证字段。

patterns.name: 负号及负数/减法表达式
patterns.context: 负号作为数字的符号或数学表达式中的减法运算符；前后常伴随数字、小数点或变量。

patterns.name: 法院标题中的固定空格与括号排版
patterns.trigger: «                        »（长空格），后接“THE PEOPLE,”、“)”或法院名称等
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决书标题页、案名或法院抬头附近；长空格用于对齐标题、案名和括号。

patterns.name: 代码中的长空格对齐
patterns.trigger: «                        »，如“"push"”后的长空格及GNU许可证地址前的长空格
patterns.context: 代码或许可证文本中，空格用于对齐字段、数值或地址；并非法律标题排版。

en.concept: Specific word fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activations occur on substrings within several specific words (especially intrac and United), tokenized proper nouns and technical terms, as well as newlines, code punctuation, and formula symbols; contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Specific substring “intrac” within words
patterns.context: Activations fall within words beginning with intrac; [2], [3], and [8] all contain this substring, but the meanings and domains differ

patterns.name: Specific substring “United” within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on United in place-name phrases; no other similar place names are observed

patterns.name: Newlines and numeric formatting
patterns.context: Short sequences of numbers, commas, carriage returns, and newlines, with activations distributed across multiple characters

patterns.name: “6 Force” title fragment
patterns.context: Force follows the number 6 in title-style line-break formatting

patterns.name: Names and punctuation/code fragments
patterns.context: Code symbols, newlines, and punctuation occur around status parameters, variables, or strings; multiple positions activate simultaneously

patterns.name: Tokenization in proper names
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across subword fragments in a company name, which is repeated later and followed by a company description

patterns.name: Tokenization in technical terms
patterns.context: Multiple consecutive subword fragments activate to form the title of a research project

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula markers
patterns.context: Activations fall on several fragments of LaTeX formulas and astronomical numerical expressions

11_390.concept: 特定词片段与格式标记
11_390.description: 激活分布在若干特定词内子串（尤其 intrac、United）、分词化专名与专业术语，以及换行、代码标点和公式符号上；各类上下文差异较大。

patterns.name: 词内特定子串“intrac”
patterns.context: 激活落在以 intrac 开头的词内部；[2]、[3]、[8] 都出现这一子串，但词义和领域不同

patterns.name: 词内特定子串“United”
patterns.context: 激活落在地名短语中的 United；未见于其他类似地名

patterns.name: 换行及数字化排版
patterns.context: 数字、逗号、回车与换行组成的短序列，激活分布在多个字符上

patterns.name: “6 Force”标题片段
patterns.context: 数字 6 后接 Force，出现在标题式的换行排版中

patterns.name: 名称及标点/代码片段
patterns.context: 状态参数、变量或字符串周围夹有代码符号、换行和标点；多种位置同时激活

patterns.name: 专有名称中的分词
patterns.context: 激活分布在公司名称的词片段中，后文重复该名称并介绍公司

patterns.name: 专业术语中的分词
patterns.context: 多个词内子片段连续激活，构成研究项目标题

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式标记
patterns.context: 激活落在 LaTeX 公式和天文学数值表达式的若干片段上

en.concept: Boundaries and fragments in structured text
en.description: Sensitive mainly to newlines, indentation, and list formatting; also activates on names, place names, numeric fields, and split long words. Other activations are scattered across code credits, academic biographies, sports results, election directories, and patent text, without a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Table or list line breaks
patterns.context: Content is laid out as a multiline table, itemized list, or delimited record; activations often fall on newlines and surrounding spaces or punctuation
patterns.domain: Structured text, rosters, and data lists

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns are split into multiple subword tokens; these may be place names, personal names, or organization names, with no unified semantic category
patterns.domain: Emails, biographies, sports records, encyclopedia, and academic texts

patterns.name: Numeric, date, and identifier fields
patterns.context: Numbers occur in aligned numeric rows, years, rankings, volume numbers, or date fields
patterns.domain: Data tables in emails, sports results, journal information, and date lines

patterns.name: Code documentation and attribution blocks
patterns.context: Code comments or source-file headers containing routine descriptions, author information, and indentation

patterns.name: Terminology suffixes and web-comment fragments
patterns.context: Fragmentary English word endings appear near optimization-related sentences, links, and quoted comments; the full word or a shared meaning cannot be determined from context

patterns.name: Heading and author-biography formatting
patterns.context: An author-introduction heading followed by a professional and institutional biography

patterns.name: Repeated listing of a name
patterns.context: An encyclopedia biography opens with a repeated name, followed by birth information

patterns.name: Competition stages and ranking records
patterns.context: Event names, stages, riders, and overall results are listed in rows

patterns.name: Journal bibliographic information
patterns.context: Short bibliographic-style lines containing journal names and volume numbers

patterns.name: Date heading and prose opening
patterns.context: A date follows a heading, then the body text begins; there are many newlines

patterns.name: Election results directory
patterns.context: Section headings, directory-style links, and associated bibliography in an encyclopedia entry

patterns.name: Long-word fragments in patent technical terminology
patterns.context: Long technical words are split into subwords within patent descriptions of mechanical structures and component movement

11_390.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与片段
11_390.description: 主要对换行、缩进和条目化排版敏感；同时在姓名、地名、数字字段及被拆分的长词上激活。其余激活分散于代码署名、学术简介、体育成绩、选举目录和专利文本，未显出统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 表格或列表换行
patterns.trigger: 频繁出现的「↵」，尤其与缩进、短行、字段分隔符相邻
patterns.context: 内容被排成多行表格、条目清单或带分隔符的记录；激活常落在换行及周围空格、标点上
patterns.domain: 结构化文本、名单与数据列表

patterns.name: 姓名及专名的子词片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个子词 token；有时是地名、人名或机构名，未见统一语义类别
patterns.domain: 邮件、传记、体育记录、百科与学术文本

patterns.name: 数字与日期、编号字段
patterns.context: 数字出现在对齐的数值行、年份、排名、卷号或日期字段中
patterns.domain: 邮件中的数据表、体育结果、期刊信息及日期行

patterns.name: 代码文档与署名块
patterns.context: 代码注释或源文件头部，包含例程说明、作者信息和缩进格式

patterns.name: 术语后缀及网页评论残片
patterns.context: 断裂的英文词尾出现在优化相关句子、链接和评论引用附近；无法由上下文确定完整词或共同语义

patterns.name: 标题与作者简介格式
patterns.context: 作者介绍标题及其下方的职业、机构简介

patterns.name: 姓名重复列示
patterns.context: 百科传记开头重复姓名，随后接出生信息

patterns.name: 竞赛阶段与名次记录
patterns.trigger: 「Stage 3」「Stage 1」「Tour of Flanders」「Giro d'Italia」「3rd place overall classification」
patterns.context: 赛事名称、阶段、车手和总成绩按行列出

patterns.name: 期刊书目信息
patterns.context: 期刊名称与卷号构成的书目式短行

patterns.name: 日期标题与散文开头
patterns.context: 标题后跟日期，再转入正文；换行较多

patterns.name: 选举结果目录
patterns.trigger: 「Voting and results」「Results by Alliance」「List of Elected MPs」「Elections in Tamil Nadu」「Bibliography」
patterns.context: 百科条目的章节标题、目录式链接和附属书目
patterns.domain: 选举相关 Wikipedia 条目

patterns.name: 专利技术词中的长词片段
patterns.context: 长技术词被拆分成子词，处于机械结构与部件运动的专利描述中

en.concept: Proper nouns and fields in structured text
en.description: Activations cluster around proper nouns and their dense enumeration: academic institutions, astronomical addresses, and author bylines are most common, with coverage also including patent trademarks/inventors, project-title terminology, management-course topics, and email contacts.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and place names in institutional addresses
patterns.context: University, department, city, street, region, and country names in institutional, departmental, or author addresses; proper nouns are often split into multiple subwords
patterns.domain: Academic paper author addresses, institutional profiles

patterns.name: Astronomical institutions and academic units
patterns.context: Academic institution names and their affiliations, often listed alongside postal addresses, postal codes, and countries

patterns.name: Author names and byline fields
patterns.context: Author, editor, or contact names in bylines, correspondence information, or database editor fields; names often contain split character fragments
patterns.domain: Paper bylines, journal editor information, grant project records

patterns.name: Product and technology names in patent text
patterns.context: Trademarks, computing platforms, product names, or inventor names in patent background or explanatory text and patent citations

patterns.name: Embryology terminology in project names
patterns.context: Research-method and biological-material terminology appears consecutively in NIH project or literature title-style fields; “Embryos” and words in the title trigger activation

patterns.name: Management education programs and business terminology
patterns.context: A series of business-management topics appears in descriptions of full-time management program courses or areas of focus

patterns.name: Email recipients and business contacts
patterns.context: Email headers list recipients, copied recipients, and email addresses; names may be accompanied by company email addresses

11_390.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与字段
11_390.description: 激活集中于专名及其密集列举：学术机构、天文地址和作者署名最常见，也覆盖专利商标/发明人、项目标题术语、管理课程主题及邮件联系人。

patterns.name: 机构地址中的专名与地名
patterns.context: 机构、院系或作者地址中出现的大学、城市、街道、地区及国家名称；专名内部常被切成多个子词
patterns.domain: 学术论文作者地址、机构简介

patterns.name: 天文学机构与学术单位
patterns.context: 学术机构名称及其隶属关系，常与邮政地址、邮编、国家并列

patterns.name: 作者姓名与署名字段
patterns.context: 作者、编辑或联系人姓名出现在署名、通讯信息或数据库编辑字段中；姓名常包含被拆分的字符片段
patterns.domain: 论文署名、期刊编辑信息、基金项目文献记录

patterns.name: 专利文本中的产品与技术名称
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明文字中出现商标、计算机平台、产品名或专利引用中的发明人姓名

patterns.name: 项目名称中的胚胎学术语
patterns.trigger: “Optical Sectioning Deep Inside Live Embryos by Selective Plane Illumination”
patterns.context: NIH项目或文献标题式字段中，连续出现研究方法和生物材料术语；“Embryos”及标题中的词触发
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究项目/文献记录

patterns.name: 管理教育项目与商业术语
patterns.context: 介绍全日制管理项目课程或关注领域时出现的一串商业管理主题

patterns.name: 邮件收件人及商务联系人
patterns.context: 邮件头部列出收件人、抄送人和邮箱地址；姓名可能伴随公司邮箱

en.concept: Special word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across rare proper nouns and word-internal fragments, technical terms, code identifiers, forum word forms, mathematical notation, and newline markers; the commonality seems to be a response to rare or special subword fragments, not a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Rare fragments in entity names
patterns.context: Long or uncommon spelling fragments in personal names, place names, or building names; activations fall on subword fragments within the names.

patterns.name: Rare word forms in academic terminology and literature titles
patterns.context: Mycological terminology, German book titles, or technical word forms in academic literature, containing word-internal subword fragments.

patterns.name: Nested type terms in code identifiers
patterns.context: Hyphenated identifiers in GCC or compiler diagnostic directives; highlights segments such as nested, anonymous, and type.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in application names
patterns.context: Proper or common words in continuous text, with activations concentrated on subword fragments in the middle of their spelling; different instances do not clearly belong to the same semantic class.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and local formula fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on variables, integral-symbol commands, or formatting commands in mathematical formulas and LaTeX notation.

patterns.name: Paragraph and section boundary markers
patterns.context: A newline marker in a conclusion paragraph activates; surrounding text discusses the conclusion of a family-centered project.

11_390.concept: 特殊词形与子词片段
11_390.description: 激活分散于罕见专名和词内片段、专业术语、代码标识符、论坛中的词形、数学记号及换行标记；共同点更像对少见或特殊子词片段的响应，无法由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 实体名称的罕见片段
patterns.context: 人名、地名或建筑名称中，尤其是较长或不常见的拼写片段；激活落在名称内部的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 学术术语与文献标题中的罕见词形
patterns.context: 真菌学术语、德语书名或学术文献中的专业词形，包含词内部子词片段。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的嵌套类型词
patterns.context: GCC 或编译器诊断指令中的连字符标识符；突出显示嵌套、匿名、类型等词段。

patterns.name: 应用名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 连续文本中的专名或普通词，激活集中在拼写中间的子词片段；不同实例并不显然属于同一语义类。

patterns.name: 数学记号与公式局部
patterns.context: 数学公式及 LaTeX 记号中，激活落在变量、积分符号命令或排版命令上。

patterns.name: 段落与小节边界标记
patterns.context: 结论段落中的换行标记被激活，周围涉及家庭中心项目的结论文字。

en.description: Activations occur in diverse texts, often on subword fragments within proper nouns (especially place names, institutions, and venues), and also in category directories, headings, and legal citations; there is no stable single trigger word, and some examples are difficult to attribute.

patterns.name: Fujian place names/proper nouns ending in “ian”
patterns.context: The suffix -ian appears in a place or institution name; activation falls on the final fragment of the word rather than the whole sentence
patterns.domain: Geographic encyclopedia entries, medical institution text

patterns.name: Category directories and section headings
patterns.context: Category lists or section/category headings in the title area or at the end of Wikipedia entries; activations often fall on category words or entities within them

patterns.name: Regional or institutional entities in proper nouns
patterns.context: Place names, venues, institutions, or entity names appear in directory entries or narratives, especially multiword proper nouns
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia categories, travel descriptions, sports entries

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations are scattered within proper nouns split into multiple subwords; examples include fungal genus names, place names, team names, and studio names
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, travel copy, sports and film encyclopedias

patterns.name: Report-series abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Near legal case citations and case names, court reporter series, and volume/page information

patterns.name: Disease and hospital terminology in medical titles/institution names
patterns.context: Pathogens, tumors, and hospitals appear in medical research or institution names

patterns.name: Consecutive words in general proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper-noun phrases in headings or introductory sentences discussing a theatrical genre, language, or region; no local trigger shared with other examples

patterns.name: Court in institution/venue names
patterns.context: Appears as part of a proper noun in arena names or street addresses

patterns.name: Fragmentary or heterogeneous directory/citation snippets
patterns.context: Activations occur in book titles, case names, or mixed directory and citation text, without enough repeated evidence to establish a more specific pattern

11_390.concept: 专名与结构化条目片段
11_390.description: 激活出现在多种文本中，常落于被子词切分的专名片段（尤其地名、机构、场馆），也见于分类目录、标题及法律引证；缺乏稳定单一触发词，部分样本难以归因。

patterns.name: “ian”结尾的福建地名/专名
patterns.context: 地名或机构名中出现词尾 -ian；激活落在该词的末尾片段，而非整句
patterns.domain: 百科地理、医学机构文本

patterns.name: 分类目录与栏目标题
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾或标题区的分类列表、栏目/分类标题；激活常落在分类词或其中实体名上
patterns.domain: 百科条目与分类元数据

patterns.name: 专名中的地域或机构实体
patterns.context: 地名、场馆、机构或实体名称出现在目录条目或叙述中，尤其是多词专名
patterns.domain: 百科分类、旅游介绍、体育条目

patterns.name: 专名中的词素片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在被切分成多个子词的专名内部；现有例子涵盖真菌属名、地名、队名和制片厂名
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、旅游文案、体育与电影百科

patterns.name: 法律引证中的报告集简称
patterns.context: 法律判例引证及案名、法院报告集和卷页信息附近

patterns.name: 医学标题/机构名中的疾病与医院术语
patterns.context: 医学研究或机构名称中出现病原体、肿瘤和医院等术语

patterns.name: 一般专名中的连续词语
patterns.context: 标题或介绍性句子中，谈及戏曲类型、语言或地域的专名短语；缺少与其他样本一致的局部触发条件

patterns.name: 机构/场馆名中的 Court
patterns.context: 作为专名的一部分，出现在球馆名称或道路地址中

patterns.name: 残缺或异质的目录/引证片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在书名、案名或混杂的目录与引证文本中，未见足够重复证据形成更具体规律

en.description: Activations are distributed across many types of text, often landing on fragments split within words, proper-name spellings, and URLs (especially the Forbes domain); other sporadic triggers include headlines, anchors, punctuation, and common function words, with no single semantic or domain-specific condition.

patterns.name: forbes spelling fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a URL whose domain would ordinarily be spelled Forbes; activation falls on a split fragment of the domain name.

patterns.name: Fragments split within words
patterns.context: The fragment occurs within a complete word split across tokens; examples include proper names and common words, with no shared semantic condition observed.

patterns.name: Fragments in surnames and personal names
patterns.context: Appears in parties, lawyers, or name lists in legal texts; some surnames are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Entry title marker
patterns.context: Appears in a biographical entry as a section heading for works, followed by an introduction to biographical works.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial article and space
patterns.context: Activation falls on common English function words with a leading space; the examples differ in position and syntactic role.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial article and species description
patterns.context: A copula and taxonomic description follow a species name.

patterns.name: Title citation fragment
patterns.context: The word is split into fragments and appears near a paper title or proper name; it may also simply be a fragment split within an ordinary word, so an independent trigger condition cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Section anchor marker
patterns.context: Appears in a Markdown-style section heading anchor, followed by Sec1.

patterns.name: Numerical citation marker
patterns.context: Bracketed numerical markers preceding reference or link lists.

11_390.concept: 跨 token 拼写片段
11_390.description: 激活分布在多种文本中，常落于词内拆分片段、专名拼写和 URL（尤其 Forbes 域名）；另有标题、锚点、标点及常见功能词等零散触发，缺少单一语义或领域条件。

patterns.name: forbes 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在 URL 中，域名本应拼作 Forbes；激活落在被拆分的域名片段上。

patterns.name: 词内切分片段
patterns.context: 片段处在跨 token 的完整词内部；涉及专名或普通词，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 姓氏及姓名拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律文本的当事人、律师或姓名列表中，部分姓氏被拆分为多个 token。

patterns.name: 条目标题标记
patterns.context: 出现在人物条目中，作为作品小节标题，后接传记作品介绍。

patterns.name: 句首冠词及空格
patterns.context: 激活落在带前导空格的常见英文功能词上；例子中位置和句法作用不同。

patterns.name: 句首冠词与物种描述
patterns.context: 物种名称之后接系词和分类描述。

patterns.name: 标题引用片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分后出现在论文标题或专名附近；也可能只是普通词内切分，无法确认独立触发条件。

patterns.name: 小节锚点标记
patterns.context: 出现在 Markdown 风格的章节标题锚点中，后接 Sec1。

patterns.name: 数字标注
patterns.context: 参考文献或链接列表前的方括号数字标记。

en.description: Activations often fall on subword fragments within proper nouns, long words, and multisyllabic words, especially place, street, and institution names; there are also sporadic responses to category labels, medical terminology, sports and program entries, and newline delimiters. The range of genres is broad, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Local subword fragments within multiword expressions
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within proper nouns or technical terms; these are usually long, multisyllabic, or uncommon names, and fragments may span adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, legal, medical, and general explanatory texts

patterns.name: City streets and place names
patterns.context: Place names occur in street addresses or place descriptions; some activations concentrate on fragments within the names and may extend to Avenue.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, historical encyclopedias, public transit descriptions

patterns.name: Category or entry-style text after proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns such as species names or category labels occur in encyclopedia definitions, classification entries, or category lists.

patterns.name: Ingredients and institution names
patterns.context: Experimental materials, culture media, or supplier names are listed as proper nouns and abbreviations.

patterns.name: Consecutive newline characters
patterns.context: Appears at paragraph or item boundaries in encyclopedia entries or lists; also activates when occurring alone.

patterns.name: Section or program title words
patterns.context: Common English words are tokenized and activate in headings or program names following a newline.

patterns.name: Sports team and venue proper nouns
patterns.context: Team, venue, and campus-related proper nouns appear in university basketball team descriptions.

patterns.name: Long book titles and river names
patterns.context: Geographic proper nouns appear in river and watershed contexts in descriptions of book contents.

patterns.name: Cutaneous fungi and disease names
patterns.context: Study subjects and disease names appear in quantitative testing and patient descriptions.

patterns.name: City and neighborhood names in addresses
patterns.context: Multiple neighborhood and city names are listed in transit service area descriptions.

patterns.name: Incomplete or peripheral activations in geographic names
patterns.context: A large geographic proper-noun fragment activates weakly, possibly co-occurring with a stronger place-name fragment in the same passage.

patterns.name: Institution, competition, or artist-related proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns or event names appear in sports reports and biographical project abstracts; activations are weak and scattered.

11_390.concept: 专名与长词片段
11_390.description: 激活多落在专名、长词及多音节词的内部子词片段，尤见地名、街道和机构名称；也零星响应分类标签、医学术语、体育与节目条目，以及换行分隔符。覆盖文体广，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 多词内部的局部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或术语的词内片段上；通常是较长、多音节或不常见的名称，片段可跨相邻 token。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、医学及一般说明性文本

patterns.name: 城市街道及地点名称
patterns.context: 地名在街道地址或地点描述中出现；部分激活集中于名称内部片段，也可延伸到 Avenue。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、历史百科、公共交通说明

patterns.name: 专名后的分类或条目式文本
patterns.context: 物种名或类别标签等专名出现在百科定义句、分类条目或类别列表中。

patterns.name: 成分与机构名称
patterns.context: 实验材料、培养基或供应商名称以专名及缩写形式列举。

patterns.name: 连续换行符
patterns.context: 出现在百科条目或名单的段落、条目分隔处；单独出现时也激活。

patterns.name: 章节或节目标题词
patterns.context: 换行后的标题或栏目名称中，普通英文词被分词激活。

patterns.name: 运动队名称与场馆专名
patterns.context: 大学篮球队介绍中，队名、场地及校区相关专名出现。

patterns.name: 长篇书名与河流名称
patterns.context: 书籍内容介绍中，地理专名在河流及流域语境里出现。

patterns.name: 皮肤真菌与疾病名称
patterns.context: 研究对象和疾病名称出现在定量检测及患者描述中。

patterns.name: 地址中的城市及社区名称
patterns.context: 交通服务范围描述中，多个社区及城市名依次列举。

patterns.name: 地理名称中的不完整或边缘激活
patterns.context: 较大的地理专名片段仅有弱激活，可能与同段中更强的地名片段共现。
patterns.domain: 历史地理叙述、法律文本

patterns.name: 机构、竞赛或艺术家相关专名
patterns.context: 专名或活动名称出现在赛事报道、人物生平项目摘要中；激活较弱且分散。

en.description: Activations occur across several kinds of informational text: place names, venues and classifications, residential and sports facility descriptions, parking patents, experimental reagents, vehicle specifications, and event history. A common tendency is dense listing of specific entities, places, facilities, or configurations, though topics vary widely.

patterns.name: Place names and facility proper nouns
patterns.context: Geographic or facility entities in proper names, often made up of multiple tokens; activation may fall on different fragments within a proper name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic geography, sports venues, and local introductions

patterns.name: Park and community directories
patterns.context: A list of park names is followed by a city or community category heading.

patterns.name: End-of-entry television station categories
patterns.context: References, external links, and categories at the end of a television station entry.

patterns.name: Parking services and valet parking
patterns.context: Describes valet parking systems or related search technology used by restaurants and other venues.

patterns.name: Culture medium and reagent supplier information
patterns.context: Experimental methods list cell culture media, additives, suppliers, and locations.

patterns.name: Residential rooms and house layout
patterns.context: Describes residential spaces, room functions, and amenities floor by floor.

patterns.name: Spectator services at sports venues
patterns.context: Describes spectator seating, suites, and food, beverage, and passage facilities within a venue.

patterns.name: River activities and public access points
patterns.context: Introduces a river's navigability, recreational activities, and public access points along its banks.

patterns.name: Vehicle specifications and production information
patterns.context: Introduces car models, engine configurations, assembly locations, and factories.

patterns.name: Event ceremonies and venues
patterns.context: Recounts the time, place, and ceremony of an event's opening.

11_390.concept: 具体实体与设施信息
11_390.description: 激活分布于多类资料性文本：地名、场馆与分类，住宅和体育设施描述，停车专利，实验试剂，汽车规格及赛事史。共同倾向是密集列举具体实体、地点、设施或配置，但主题跨度大。

patterns.name: 地名及设施专名
patterns.trigger: 地名、机构名和设施名，如 “Mt. Tabor Park”“Assembly Hall”“Constitution Avenue”“Kansas River”“Agua(s)calientes, Mexico”
patterns.context: 专名中的地理或设施实体，常由多个分词组成；激活可落在专名内部不同片段上。
patterns.domain: 百科地理、体育场馆与地方介绍

patterns.name: 公园与社区目录
patterns.context: 公园名称列表之后接城市或社区分类标题。

patterns.name: 电视台条目分类尾部
patterns.trigger: “KOTA Territory”“Category: Television channels and stations established in 1958”
patterns.context: 电视台条目末尾的参考资料、外部链接和分类。

patterns.name: 停车服务与代客泊车
patterns.trigger: “valet parking system”“parking”“establishments offering their patrons valet parking”
patterns.context: 说明餐馆及其他场所使用的代客泊车系统或相关检索技术。

patterns.name: 培养基与试剂供应商信息
patterns.trigger: “Eagle’s medium”“DMEM”“Gibco”“Beijing Solarbio Science & Technology Co., China”
patterns.context: 实验方法中列出细胞培养基、添加剂及供应商和所在地。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 住宅房间与房屋配置
patterns.context: 逐层描述住宅空间、房间用途与配套设施。

patterns.name: 体育场馆观众服务
patterns.context: 描述观众席位、包厢以及场馆内餐饮和通道设施。

patterns.name: 河流活动与公共通达点
patterns.context: 介绍河流的通航、休闲活动及沿岸公共入口。

patterns.name: 车辆规格与生产信息
patterns.trigger: “2007 model”“DOHC 1.8-liter gasoline engine”“assembled at Nissan’s … assembly plant”
patterns.context: 介绍汽车车型、发动机配置、组装地点及工厂。

patterns.name: 赛事仪式与场地
patterns.trigger: “Junior Olympic Games”“open on August 21, 1967”“Departmental Auditorium”“Constitution Avenue”
patterns.context: 叙述赛事开幕的时间、地点与仪式。

en.description: Activations occur in noun phrases, proper nouns, technical terms, table percentages, Danish word forms, and code fields; common patterns are weak, some cover only a single passage, and they are difficult to reduce to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Function words and collocational elements in noun phrases
patterns.context: Activations fall within ordinary noun phrases, often involving noun modifiers, compound nouns, or plural nouns; the specific semantics vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, patent, travel, sports, and historical texts

patterns.name: Components of institutions and proper nouns
patterns.context: Place names, organization names, or venue names within proper nouns; activations concentrate on several words or morphemes in the name.

patterns.name: Ingredients, materials, and experimental reagent names
patterns.context: Culture media, reagents, or drug names appear in biomedical methods or drug tables; some abbreviations and word-internal fragments activate.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, experimental methods and medical tables

patterns.name: Numbers and statistics in parentheses
patterns.context: Values or percentages in table rows, especially percentages in parentheses; no clear consistent numerical semantics are evident.

patterns.name: Word-internal graphemes and multilingual morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activations sometimes fall inside longer words rather than on whole words; examples include brand names or inflected and derived Danish forms, with unclear triggers.

patterns.name: Fields and values in structured configuration
patterns.context: Activations occur near field names, type declarations, and default values in JSON/API documentation, including newline markers.

patterns.name: TV station and entry-category text
patterns.context: Channel information, references, and category labels at the end of encyclopedia entries; activations include conjunctions within category phrases.

11_390.concept: none
11_390.description: 激活分布在名词短语、专名、专业术语、表格百分比、丹麦语词形和代码字段等处；共同规律较弱，部分只覆盖单段，难以归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的功能词和搭配成分
patterns.trigger: 如 “assembly plant”“valet parking system”“campgrounds”“toilets”“Assembly Hall”“dining rooms”
patterns.context: 激活落在普通名词短语中，常涉及名词前修饰语、名词复合词或复数名词；不同例子具体语义不一。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、旅游、体育及历史文本

patterns.name: 机构与专名中的组成部分
patterns.trigger: “Nissan”“Aguascalientes, Mexico”“Beijing Solarbio Science & Technology Co.”“Indiana Hoosiers”“Assembly Hall”
patterns.context: 专名内部的地名、组织名或场馆名；激活集中于名称中的若干词或词素。

patterns.name: 成分、材料与实验试剂名称
patterns.context: 生物医学方法或药物表格中，出现培养基、试剂或药物名称；部分缩写和词内片段被激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，实验方法与医学表格

patterns.name: 数字及括号中的统计数据
patterns.context: 表格行中的数值或百分比，尤其括号内的百分比；未见明确一致的数值语义。

patterns.name: 词内字素与多语种形态片段
patterns.context: 激活有时落在较长词内部而非完整词上；可见于品牌词或丹麦语屈折、派生形式，触发条件不清。
patterns.domain: 论文材料、丹麦语议会文本

patterns.name: 结构化配置中的字段和值
patterns.context: JSON/API 文档中，字段名、类型声明和默认值附近出现激活，包含换行标记。

patterns.name: 电视台与条目分类文本
patterns.trigger: “KOTA”“subchannel”“Category: Television channels and stations established in 1958”
patterns.context: 百科条目尾部的频道信息、参考资料及分类标签；激活包括分类短语中的连接词。

en.description: Activations occur on structured fragments in various formatted texts: tabular statistics, medical terminology and experimental materials, addresses and place names, scientific measurement expressions, code identifiers, Italian word fragments, and HTML tags. The shared pattern is weak and tends toward local fragments among numbers, proper nouns, and formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Numbers, percentages, and group statistics in tables
patterns.context: Numbers, percentages, and categories or age groups occur together in medical research tables or statistical data rows; strong activations fall on numerical fragments and some labels
patterns.domain: Tables and clinical statistics in PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Drug names and their component word fragments
patterns.context: Antituberculosis drugs or drug combinations appear in table rows listing treatment or resistance categories and their statistical results; activation falls on fragments within drug names

patterns.name: Biomedical reagents, suppliers, and specifications
patterns.context: The methods section gives a continuous list of culture media, serum, antibiotics, brands/manufacturers, and locations

patterns.name: Place names and street/building fields in addresses
patterns.context: Geographic or address components in addresses, rooms, or street names; sometimes adjacent to descriptions of institutions or commercial facilities
patterns.domain: Business email signatures and encyclopedia descriptions of city buildings

patterns.name: Numbers and units in scientific measurement expressions
patterns.context: Exponential notation, temperature, and rate units in physics/materials science texts; activation falls on numbers, near mathematical symbols, and on unit fragments

patterns.name: Code identifiers and hexadecimal values
patterns.context: Field names, identifiers, and hexadecimal values arranged in columns in code or debugging constant definitions

patterns.name: Italian word-internal fragments and relational words
patterns.context: In continuous Italian parliamentary speeches, activations are distributed across word-internal fragments and conjunctions, relational words, and abstract nouns; no stable single-word-meaning trigger is observed

patterns.name: HTML tags and webpage control code
patterns.context: Tag boundaries, attributes, or control-related text in webpage templates/frontend code, interspersed with indentation and newlines

11_390.concept: 结构化文本中的局部片段
11_390.description: 激活分布于多种格式化文本的结构化片段：表格统计、医学术语与实验材料、地址地名、科学计量式、代码标识符、意大利语词片段及 HTML 标签。共同点较弱，偏向数字/专名/格式边界中的局部片段。

patterns.name: 表格中的数字、百分比及分组统计
patterns.context: 医学研究表格或统计数据行中，数字、百分比与分类/年龄组并列出现；强激活落在数值片段及部分标签上
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文中的表格与临床统计

patterns.name: 药物名称及其组成词片段
patterns.context: 抗结核药物或药物组合出现在列举治疗/耐药分类及其统计结果的表格行中；激活位于药名内部片段
patterns.domain: 医学论文，结核病药物统计

patterns.name: 生物医学试剂、供应商与规格
patterns.trigger: modified« Eagle»'s medium、«DM»EM、«Gib»co、«Solar»bio、« Science» & « Technology» Co., « China»
patterns.context: 方法部分以连续清单描述培养基、血清、抗生素及品牌/厂商和地点

patterns.name: 地址中的地名与街道/建筑字段
patterns.trigger: « Singapore»、«Room»；« California» « Avenue»、«Building»、«Palo» Alto；« Avenue» « South»、« May»nard « Alley» « South»
patterns.context: 地址、房间或街道名称中的地理/地址成分；有时邻接机构或商业设施描述
patterns.domain: 商务邮件签名及百科城市建筑叙述

patterns.name: 科学计量式中的数字与单位
patterns.context: 物理/材料科学文本中的指数记数、温度和速率单位，激活落在数字、数学符号附近及单位片段

patterns.name: 代码标识符与十六进制数值
patterns.context: 代码或调试常量定义行中，字段名、标识符及十六进制值按列排列

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段及关系词
patterns.context: 连续的意大利语议会发言中，激活分布在词内片段及连接词、关系或抽象名词上；未见稳定的单一词义触发
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语政治演讲

patterns.name: HTML 标签与网页控件代码
patterns.context: 网页模板/前端代码中的标签边界、属性或控件相关文本，夹有缩进与换行

en.description: Primarily responds to dense combinations of numbers, percentages, and punctuation in tables or aligned data; also responds to code identifiers, hexadecimal constants, and date strings. Activations in prose fall on subword fragments, possibly due to numeric or tokenization effects; a shared cause with the primary pattern cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Numeric and percentage table cells
patterns.context: Numbers, punctuation, and percent signs are split or adjacent in tables or aligned statistical data; often accompanied by line breaks and blank columns
patterns.domain: Clinical research tables in PubMed Central, including counts, proportions, age, sex, and regional statistics

patterns.name: Consecutive numbers and dates/decimals
patterns.context: Dates, identifiers, or decimals occur in aligned rows and columns, with numbers adjacent to slashes or decimal points

patterns.name: Architecture/instruction fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++-style identifiers, comments, or parameters, with numbers mixed with letters and split into fragments

patterns.name: Hexadecimal constants and symbols in code
patterns.context: Hexadecimal addresses are adjacent to equals signs, the letter x, and numbers in debug macros or constant assignments

patterns.name: Incidental combinations of numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Words are split by tokenization in continuous text, with nearby numbers or punctuation, but no clear statistical table structure

11_390.concept: 数字及结构化数据片段
11_390.description: 主要响应表格或对齐数据中密集的数字、百分比及标点组合；也响应代码标识符、十六进制常量和日期数字串。散文段的激活落在拆分词片段上，可能是数字/分词效应，无法确认与主模式同因。

patterns.name: 数字与百分比表格单元格
patterns.context: 表格或对齐的统计数据中，数字、标点和百分号被拆分或紧邻；常伴随换行及空白列
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的临床研究表格，包括人数、比例、年龄、性别及地区统计

patterns.name: 连续数字与日期/小数
patterns.context: 对齐的行列数据中出现日期、编号或小数，数字和斜线、小数点相邻
patterns.domain: StackExchange 表格或日志式数据

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的架构/指令片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 风格标识符、注释或参数中，数字与字母混合并被拆分
patterns.domain: Github 的 x86 指令相关代码

patterns.name: 代码中的十六进制常量与符号
patterns.context: 调试宏或常量赋值中，十六进制地址紧邻等号、字母 x 和数字
patterns.domain: Github 的预处理宏/底层代码

patterns.name: 数字与标点的偶然组合
patterns.trigger: « lim»«ous»«ines»及其周围的 «moving»；激活落在拆分后的词片段上
patterns.context: 连续文本中词语被分词切开，附近有数字或标点，但未见明确统计表格结构

en.concept: Tables and code markers in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to structured text in tables and code: counts, percentages, and abbreviated fields in medical tables, and newlines, JSON key-value pairs, enumeration identifiers, assignment symbols, and hexadecimal constants in code.

patterns.name: Values and percentages in medical tables
patterns.context: Activation occurs in aligned table columns containing numbers or statistical data, commonly counts, percentages, and group numbers; the specific numbers activated vary across fragments.
patterns.domain: Clinical or medical research tables in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Newlines after table cells
patterns.context: A newline immediately follows a table cell or structured field; it also appears in code lists and object contents, so it cannot independently explain all activations.
patterns.domain: Medical tables and structured code text

patterns.name: JSON enum values and field definitions
patterns.context: Near structured key-value pairs such as enum options, default values, and field types in JSON configuration or schemas.
patterns.domain: JSON configuration or API schemas on GitHub

patterns.name: C/C++ constant assignments and hexadecimal values
patterns.context: Constants or structure sizes are assigned values with equals signs in code, with values represented in hexadecimal; activations are distributed across assignment symbols, numbers, and their components.
patterns.domain: System code or hardware constant definitions on GitHub

patterns.name: Comma-separated enum items in code
patterns.context: Adjacent identifiers are listed as enum or table items, with commas following the identifiers.
patterns.domain: Instruction set definition code in C/C++ on GitHub

patterns.name: Null and numbers in structured data
patterns.context: null and numeric values occur in pairs in nested JSON/JSON-like lists, in configuration or data-mapping contexts.
patterns.domain: Structured configuration or test data on GitHub

patterns.name: Category and abbreviation fields in medical tables
patterns.context: Abbreviations such as sex, disease, or missing-value labels appear alongside numbers in table rows; these fields appear in only one fragment.
patterns.domain: Medical data tables in PubMed Central

11_390.concept: 结构化文本中的表格与代码标记
11_390.description: 主要响应表格与代码中的结构化文本：医学表格的计数、百分比和缩写字段，以及代码中的换行、JSON 键值、枚举标识符、赋值符号和十六进制常量。

patterns.name: 医学表格中的数值与百分比
patterns.context: 表格列对齐的数字或统计数据行中激活，常见计数、百分比、分组编号；不同片段里被激活的具体数字并不一致。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的临床或医学研究表格

patterns.name: 表格单元格后的换行
patterns.context: 换行紧接着表格单元格或结构化字段；也出现在代码列表和对象内容中，不能单独解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: 医学表格与结构化代码文本

patterns.name: JSON 枚举值及字段定义
patterns.context: JSON 配置或 schema 中，枚举选项、默认值和字段类型等结构化键值附近。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 JSON 配置或 API schema

patterns.name: C/C++ 常量赋值与十六进制值
patterns.context: 代码中以等号给常量或结构体大小赋值，数值采用十六进制表示；激活分布在赋值符号、数字及其组成部分。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的系统代码或硬件常量定义

patterns.name: 代码中的逗号分隔枚举项
patterns.context: 相邻的标识符作为枚举或表项列出，逗号跟在标识符之后。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 C/C++ 指令集定义代码

patterns.name: 结构化数据中的 null 与数字
patterns.context: 嵌套 JSON/类 JSON 列表中，null 与数值成对出现，并处于配置或数据映射上下文。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的结构化配置或测试数据

patterns.name: 医学表格中的分类与缩写字段
patterns.context: 表格数据行中，性别、疾病或缺失值等缩写与数值并列；这些字段只在单个片段出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的医学数据表格

en.concept: Numbers and identifiers in structured data
en.description: Primarily activates on numbers, percentages, and aligned cell data in research tables, covering counts, measurements, and labels across topics; also activates on enum constants and x86 instruction identifiers in code.

patterns.name: Numbers and percentages in tables
patterns.context: Trigger locations are mostly near values or statistical columns in scientific tables, often with row breaks, inter-column whitespace, counts, and percentages; specific numbers and table structures vary across excerpts

patterns.name: Identifiers or measurements in tables
patterns.context: Activations fall on row-initial identifiers, abbreviated fields, or numeric cells; aligned multicolumn data surrounds them, but no consistent field meaning is evident

patterns.name: Code constants and enum identifiers
patterns.context: Located in debug-block ID definitions resembling C/C++, followed by an assignment and a hexadecimal constant

patterns.name: x86 instruction mnemonic identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in instruction ID names, near comments indicating X86/X64 instruction categories

11_390.concept: 结构化数据中的数字与标识符
11_390.description: 主要对论文表格中数字、百分比及对齐的单元格数据激活，覆盖不同主题的计数、测量值和标签；另对代码中的枚举常量及 x86 指令标识符激活。

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与百分比
patterns.context: 触发位置多在科学表格的数值或统计列附近，常伴随行换行、列间空白、计数和百分比；不同片段中具体数字及表格结构各异

patterns.name: 表格中的编号或测量值
patterns.context: 激活落在表格行首的编号、缩写字段或数值单元格；周围有对齐的多列数据，但未见统一的字段含义
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的表格（具体主题不一）

patterns.name: 代码常量与枚举标识符
patterns.context: 位于类似 C/C++ 的调试块 ID 定义中，后接赋值与十六进制常量

patterns.name: x86 指令助记符标识符
patterns.context: 出现在指令 ID 名称中，邻近注释标明 X86/X64 指令类别
patterns.domain: GitHub 汇编器或指令集相关代码

en.concept: Numbers and boundaries in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, percentages, and cell separators in tabular text; also responds to fragments and punctuation in code identifiers, field names, and numeric constants. Covers medical tables and source code.

patterns.name: Statistical cells in medical paper tables
patterns.context: Appears in multi-column medical results tables, often near counts, percentages, decimals, age groups, clinical variables, or table statistics; triggers are mostly percentage and numerical fragments, not necessarily semantically complete words.
patterns.domain: Medical paper tables in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in code identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++-like enum names, instruction identifiers, or structure fields/constant definitions; activates on internal fragments of code identifiers, numbers, and punctuation.

11_390.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与边界
11_390.description: 主要响应表格化文本中的数字、百分比及单元格分隔，也响应代码标识符、字段名和数值常量中的片段与标点；覆盖医学表格和源代码。

patterns.name: 医学论文表格中的统计单元格
patterns.context: 出现在多列医学结果表中，常与人数、百分比、小数、年龄组、临床变量或表格统计值相邻；触发点多为百分比及数字片段，未必是语义完整的词。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文表格

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的数字与分隔符
patterns.trigger: 如 «                        »、«DBG_BLOCK_ID_CSC»中的下划线分隔结构，«mov»、«n»、«,»、«X86»，以及 «Size»、«of»、«IP»、«req»、«=»、«x»、«8»
patterns.context: 出现在类似 C/C++ 的枚举名、指令标识符或结构字段/常量定义中；对代码标识符内部片段、数字和标点激活。

en.concept: Symbolic fields in structured tables and code
en.description: Activations cluster on numbers, percentages, and measurements in structured tables, as well as identifiers, assignment symbols, and hexadecimal constants in code; also seen on column headers and separator lines in genomic tables.

patterns.name: Numbers and percentages in tables
patterns.context: Numbers, percent signs, and adjacent fragments occur in table rows and columns, statistical results, or measurements; numbers are often split into tokens and surrounded by variable names or text labels

patterns.name: Code identifiers and hexadecimal constants
patterns.context: Identifiers, operators, and hexadecimal values are interspersed in code or debug constant definitions; some identifiers are split into subwords

patterns.name: Column headers and separator lines in genomic tables
patterns.context: Table header rows and column separators made of consecutive hyphens
patterns.domain: Genomics research tables in PubMed Central

11_390.concept: 结构化表格与代码中的符号化字段
11_390.description: 激活集中于结构化表格中的数字、百分比和测量值，以及代码中的标识符、赋值符号与十六进制常量；另见基因组表格列标题和分隔线。

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与百分比
patterns.context: 数字、百分号及其相邻部分出现在表格行列、统计结果或测量值中；数字常被拆分标记，周围有变量名或文字标签

patterns.name: 代码标识符与十六进制常量
patterns.context: 代码或调试常量定义中，标识符、运算符和十六进制值混排；部分标识符被拆成子词

patterns.name: 基因组表格的列标题与分隔线
patterns.context: 表格标题行和由连续连字符构成的列分隔线
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的基因组学论文表格

en.concept: Table and identifier fragments in structured text
en.description: Primarily activates on numbers, statistics, field labels, and separators in structured tabular text, especially biomedical paper tables; there are also local patterns involving code identifier fragments and fragments within gene abbreviations and drug names.

patterns.name: Numbers and statistics in tables
patterns.context: Numbers appear in table cells or aligned statistical data rows, often adjacent to unlabelled field names, blank columns, or newlines; activation falls on numbers and some punctuation.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central paper tables covering demographics, clinical data, and group comparisons

patterns.name: Table titles, field names, and separators
patterns.context: At table titles, variable names, column names, or horizontal separators in medical or biomedical papers; activation falls not only on values but also on labels and formatting characters.
patterns.domain: Structured table text in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Structure names and identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: In code or code-like text, activation falls on internal identifier fragments, punctuation, or nearby numbers; the two examples are a structure size definition and an x86 instruction enum.
patterns.domain: Github source code, constant definitions, or comments

patterns.name: Gene and genetics table headers
patterns.context: In column headings of gene predictor tables, activation is concentrated on abbreviations and uppercase letter sequences; other table numbers and symbols also activate.

patterns.name: Fragments within medical terminology
patterns.context: Substrings within antituberculosis drug names are marked, surrounded by drug regimens and proportion data; it is unclear whether activation targets word-internal fragments or mixed table formatting.
patterns.domain: Clinical or drug research tables in PubMed Central

11_390.concept: 结构化文本中的表格与标识符片段
11_390.description: 主要对结构化表格文本中的数字、统计量、字段标签和分隔符产生激活，尤其是生物医学论文表格；另有代码标识符片段，以及基因缩写和药名内部片段等局部模式。

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与统计量
patterns.context: 数字出现在表格单元格或行列对齐的统计数据中，常与未标记的字段名、空白列或换行相邻；激活落在数字及部分标点上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的论文表格，涉及人口统计、临床数据和分组比较

patterns.name: 表格标题、字段名与分隔符
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学论文中，表格标题、变量名、列名或横向分隔线处；激活不只落在数值上，也落在标签和格式字符上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的结构化表格文本

patterns.name: 代码中的结构名与标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码或类似代码的文本中，激活落在标识符内部片段、标点或紧邻的数字上；两个例子分别是结构大小定义和 x86 指令枚举。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码、常量定义或注释

patterns.name: 基因与遗传学表头
patterns.context: 基因预测因子表格的列标题中，激活集中在缩写和大写字母序列；其余表格数字及符号也有激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的遗传学/基因组学论文

patterns.name: 医学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 抗结核药物名称内部的子串被标记，周围是药物治疗方案及比例数据；此处无法确定激活是针对词内片段还是混合表格格式。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的临床或药物研究表格

en.description: Primarily responds to extracted text from biomedical research tables: values, percentages, headers, and separator lines, as well as row and column content such as group labels, medical terms, drugs, regions, ages, and experimental abbreviations.

patterns.name: Values, percentages, and statistical symbols in tables
patterns.context: Occur as counts, proportions, statistical results, or missing values in table rows and columns; activations fall on numbers, percent signs, and symbols.

patterns.name: Table header rows and column separator lines
patterns.context: Near table column names, headers, or column separators represented by horizontal lines.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research tables and their extracted text

patterns.name: Case, sample, and group codes
patterns.context: Tables list category labels by cohort, subject characteristics, or cell/control group, often alongside numbers.
patterns.domain: Clinical cohort and experimental biomedical tables

patterns.name: Medical classification or diagnostic terms
