patterns.domain: Legal text, sports reporting, game instructions, and career advice

patterns.name: having followed by a person- or experience-related noun
patterns.context: having is followed by “an older person,” with further explanation of their experience; activation is concentrated on “having an older person”.

patterns.name: Specific symbols and expressions in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In mathematical typesetting, activation falls on numbers, variables, or terms in formulas, with no stable natural-language collocation apparent.
patterns.domain: StackExchange mathematical formulas, ArXiv mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Control preferences or settings
patterns.context: Describes users or players saving online game preferences and settings, which are then used to match players.

patterns.name: Business interests, compromise, and employers
patterns.context: Discusses whether to compromise to keep a project going when a startup’s equity upside is limited, and choosing an employer.

11_399.description: 激活分布在人物的团队角色、重要性与适配评价，职业建议中的经验及利益选择，游戏偏好设置，以及数学公式。没有明显统一的词形或句法触发，可能是多种局部模式叠加。

patterns.name: 球员或个人被评为合适、重要
patterns.trigger: “a defendant” “less likely” “exercise” / “an icon” “team player” / “good fit” / “an important piece to a team”
patterns.context: 涉及某人（或球员、玩家）在团队、群体或制度中的角色、适配性、重要性，或个人受到某种影响；不同语境中评价对象和措辞不完全相同
patterns.domain: 法律、体育报道、游戏说明及职业建议

patterns.name: having 后接人物或经验相关名词
patterns.context: having 后出现“an older person”，并继续说明其经验；激活集中在“having an older person”

patterns.name: 数学公式中的特定符号及表达式
patterns.context: 数学排版中，激活落在公式的数字、变量或运算项上，未见稳定的自然语言搭配
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数学公式、ArXiv 数学公式

patterns.name: 控制偏好或设置
patterns.trigger: “save their online gaming preferences and settings”
patterns.context: 说明用户或玩家保存线上游戏偏好和设置，并据此匹配玩家

patterns.name: 商业利益、妥协与雇主
patterns.trigger: “make compromises” “their high-upside baby alive” “your own interests first” “an employer”
patterns.context: 讨论创业公司股权上行空间有限时，是否为维持项目而妥协，以及选择雇主

en.concept: Professional argumentation and evaluative text fragments
en.description: Activation is concentrated in legal argumentation and rule provisions; it also appears in mathematical definitions, theorems, and formula fragments, as well as sports reporting that evaluates teams or athletes. Trigger words and genres vary widely.

patterns.name: Legal evidence rules and disputes
patterns.context: Discusses admissibility of evidence, expert qualifications, jury functions, or defendant rights; common in continuous judicial reasoning and rule provisions.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, judicial opinions and evidence rules

patterns.name: Findings of fact about employment relationships
patterns.context: Compares whether different entities are employers and explains what the evidence can or cannot establish.

patterns.name: Insurance fraud and coverage-condition clauses
patterns.context: Lists conditions under which an insurer may refuse coverage or pertaining to a policy, in itemized-clause format.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, insurance statutes or quoted opinions

patterns.name: Formal mathematical definitions and propositions
patterns.context: Introduces a statistical definition or states an inequality over the real numbers; often accompanied by LaTeX, headings, and theorem formatting.

patterns.name: Fractions and powers in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Formula fragments in mathematical Q&A, containing powers, numerators, denominators, and variables; no explicit natural-language trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Praise in sports reporting
patterns.context: Quotes a coach discussing a college football team’s performance, or praises and evaluates a baseball pitcher.

11_399.concept: 专业论证与评价文本片段
11_399.description: 激活集中于法律论证和规则条文，也见数学定义、定理及公式片段，以及体育报道中对球队或运动员的评价；触发词与文体跨度较大。

patterns.name: 法律证据规则及其争议
patterns.context: 讨论证据能否采纳、专家资格、陪审团职能或被告权利；常见于连续的判决论证和规则条文。

patterns.name: 法律中的雇佣关系事实认定
patterns.context: 比较不同主体是否为雇主，并说明证据所能或不能证明的事实。

patterns.name: 保险欺诈及承保条件条款
patterns.context: 列举保险人拒绝承保或保单相关的条件，呈现分项条款格式。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，保险法条文或判决引文

patterns.name: 形式化数学定义与命题
patterns.context: 引入统计定义，或陈述实数范围内成立的不等式；常伴随 LaTeX、标题和定理格式。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的分数与幂
patterns.context: 数学问答中的公式片段，含幂次、分子分母及变量；未见明确自然语言触发词。

patterns.name: 体育报道中的夸赞性描述
patterns.context: 引述教练谈大学橄榄球队的成绩，或以棒球投手为对象的赞誉与评价。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻或体育题材叙述

en.description: Activation samples come from legal rulings and insurance clauses, mathematical formulas and information theory, code, biomedical experiments, and lawyer advertising. Legal text predominates, but triggers differ across domains, with no reliable common vocabulary or single theme apparent.

patterns.name: Legal evidence, litigation, and insurance clauses
patterns.context: Legal texts discuss whether evidence is admissible, expert qualifications, findings of fact, or insurance contract conditions; formal statements and enumerated clauses are common.
patterns.domain: Court rulings, legal rules, and insurance law

patterns.name: Local symbols and terminology in mathematics and information theory formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical definitions, proofs, or formula formatting; activation falls on common words, symbols, and numbers near formulas, rather than a single mathematical topic.

patterns.name: Numerical computation and variable names in code
patterns.context: Function calls, variable names, and numeric literals in Python-style code.

patterns.name: In vivo and in vitro experimental descriptions in biomedical research
patterns.context: Papers mention in vivo and in vitro experiments together when describing results.

patterns.name: Lawyer and compensation language in legal-services advertising
patterns.context: Promotes legal services to prospective clients, emphasizing dealing with insurance companies and obtaining compensation.

11_399.description: 激活样本分属法律判决与保险条款、数学公式和信息论、代码、生物医学实验及律师广告；法律文本占多数，但各领域触发形式不同，未见可靠的共同词汇或单一主题。

patterns.name: 法律证据、诉讼及保险条款
patterns.trigger: “be admitted”, “statement into evidence”, “expert at the deposition”, “factfinder”, “fraudulent”, “insurer”, “policy”
patterns.context: 法律文本中讨论证据能否采纳、专家资格、事实认定或保险合同条件；常见正式陈述和分项条款格式。
patterns.domain: 法院判决、法律规则及保险法

patterns.name: 数学与信息论公式中的局部符号和术语
patterns.trigger: “vectors”, “linearly independent”, “uniform distribution”, “ε-close to uniform”, “L(f, P)”, 数学公式中的“1”“b”“p”
patterns.context: 数学定义、证明或公式排版；触发落在公式邻近的常用词、符号与数字上，并非单一数学主题。

patterns.name: 程序代码中的数值计算与变量名
patterns.context: Python风格代码中的函数调用、变量名及数字字面量。

patterns.name: 生物医学研究中体内外实验表述
patterns.context: 论文叙述实验结果时并列提及体内与体外实验。

patterns.name: 法律服务广告中的律师与赔偿措辞
patterns.context: 面向潜在客户宣传律师服务，强调应对保险公司及获得赔偿。

en.concept: Local word forms and domain terms as triggers
en.description: Trigger patterns are not uniform: they include a superlative suffix, an English negative contraction, randomly selected wording, and terms or evaluative expressions from sports, biomedicine, and law. The legal passages share themes of evidence and procedure; the rest have only local word-form or domain cues.

patterns.name: Superlative form -est
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the adjective superlative suffix -est; the word describes a team's historical record.

patterns.name: Randomly selected picked
patterns.context: A mathematical text describes how elements in a finite-field vector space are randomly selected; activation falls on picked.

patterns.name: can't after a negated auxiliary
patterns.context: In an informal sports forum, activation falls on the negative contraction part of can't; the similar form won't also appears.

patterns.name: Legal evidence and qualification
patterns.context: A legal ruling discusses hearsay evidence, the qualification of witnesses or experts, sufficiency of evidence, a defendant's adopted statements, and jury selection; broadly distributed across legal reasoning and procedural language.

patterns.name: Evaluations of sports figures and teams
patterns.context: Positive evaluations of pitchers, teams, season performance, or championship prospects; activation involves evaluative words and related expressions.

patterns.name: in vivo / in vitro contrast
patterns.context: A biomedical paper presents in vivo and in vitro experimental results in parallel; activation is distributed across multiple tokens in conjunctions and phrases.

11_399.concept: 局部词形与领域词语触发
11_399.description: 触发模式并不统一：包括最高级后缀、英语否定缩写、随机抽取用语，以及分属体育、生物医学和法律的术语或评价表达。法律段落共享证据与程序主题；其余仅有局部词形或领域线索。

patterns.name: 最高级形态 -est
patterns.context: 激活集中在形容词最高级后缀 -est；该词描述球队项目的历史成绩。

patterns.name: 随机抽取的 picked
patterns.context: 数学文本中描述有限域向量空间里的元素如何被随机选取，激活落在 picked。

patterns.name: 否定助动词后的 can't
patterns.context: 口语化体育论坛中，激活落在 can't 的否定缩写部分；另有 won't 同类形式。

patterns.name: 法律证据与资格认定
patterns.trigger: admission ... into evidence；expert ... qualified；jury ... credible ... sufficient；accused ... adoption；prosecutor ... peremptory challenges
patterns.context: 法律判决中讨论传闻证据、证人或专家资格、证据充分性、被告采纳陈述及陪审员遴选；较广泛地分布于法律推理与程序用语。

patterns.name: 体育人物与球队评价
patterns.trigger: greatest pitchers；world-beater；winningest football program；playoffs ... win it all
patterns.context: 围绕投手、球队、赛季表现或夺冠前景的正面评价；激活涉及评价性词语及相关表达。

patterns.name: in vivo / in vitro 对照
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中对体内与体外实验结果作并列说明；激活分布在连接词和短语内部多个 token。

en.concept: Statements of entitlement, rights, and properties
en.description: Primarily responds to statements about rights, entitlements, and capacity to act in legal contexts, especially “entitled to”; it also appears in defining properties of mathematical objects, describing statistical methods, and statements about ability and equal treatment in startup texts.

patterns.name: Legal rights or entitlements
patterns.context: A legal subject is said to have the right to take an action, obtain a hearing, or qualify; also includes a court determining whether it may issue a ruling.

patterns.name: Ability and equal treatment
patterns.context: Describes the abilities, treatment, or rights co-founders should receive.

patterns.name: Definitions or properties of mathematical objects
patterns.context: Definitional statements describe properties and notation for distributions, vectors, or mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Descriptions of statistical methods and objective functions
patterns.context: Describes properties of estimation methods and their optimization problems.

11_399.concept: 资格、权利与性质的陈述
11_399.description: 主要响应法律语境中对权利、资格及行动能力的陈述，尤其是“entitled to”；也见于定义数学对象性质、说明统计方法，以及创业文本中的能力与平等待遇表述。

patterns.name: 法律上的权利或资格
patterns.trigger: “entitled”后接“to”，如“entitled … to …”；另有“is … qualified”“could not … award”
patterns.context: 法律主体被说明有权采取某行动、获得听证或具备资格；也包括法院判定其能否作出裁决。

patterns.name: 能力与平等待遇
patterns.context: 描述共同创始人应获得的能力、待遇或权益。

patterns.name: 数学对象的定义或性质
patterns.trigger: “is … ε-close”“is … denoted”“is said to be picked”
patterns.context: 用定义性句式说明分布、向量或数学符号的性质与记法。

patterns.name: 统计方法及目标函数描述
patterns.context: 描述估计方法及其优化问题的性质。

en.concept: Terms and judgment fragments across domains
en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematics papers, case law, everyday narratives, and biomedical texts; local cues include formulas and terminology, legal judgment words, expert qualifications and “recklessly,” as well as vaccine vocabulary. No single stable semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Traces of character-level/subword segmentation
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented word fragments rather than consistently corresponding to any complete word; examples include ordinary text, legal text, and paper terminology.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and formula-adjacent positions
patterns.context: Punctuation and word fragments near mathematical symbols, formulas, or definitions; activation does not fall only on symbols.

patterns.name: Qualification, adjudication, and rule language in legal arguments
patterns.context: In legal argument, evidence review, or statutory application, qualification judgments, the rights of parties, and adjudicative standards commonly appear.

patterns.name: Wording about dangerous conduct in statutes
patterns.context: Describes elements of conduct that creates a danger to property or people; in this example, activation is prominent on “recklessly”.

patterns.name: Personal narrative by a restaurant owner
patterns.context: First-person, colloquial self-narration; the speaker discusses their own abilities and experience running a restaurant.

patterns.name: Random selection and vector-space definitions
patterns.context: A mathematical definition of a finite field and vector space explains how vectors are randomly selected.

patterns.name: Immunity and vaccine terminology
patterns.context: Mentions an immune response and a safe Salmonella vaccine strain.

patterns.name: Bayesian estimation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses posterior information and point-estimation methods in Bayesian inverse problems, especially MAP estimation.

patterns.name: Value of home improvements and compensation
patterns.context: A case discusses whether a jury may award damages based on the value of home improvements, along with related litigation disputes.

patterns.name: Legal claims and judgment standards
patterns.context: A case cites established facts and explains the requirements for obtaining summary judgment.

patterns.name: Statutory defenses and current statutory wording
patterns.context: When a defendant raises a statutory defense, the court discusses their right to rely on the text of current statutes.

11_399.concept: 跨领域的术语与判断片段
11_399.description: 激活分散于数学论文、判例、生活叙述和生物医学文本；局部线索包括公式及术语、法律判断词、专家资格与“recklessly”，以及疫苗词汇。未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 逐字母/子词切分痕迹
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词片段上，而非稳定对应某一完整词；包括普通文本、法律文本和论文术语。

patterns.name: 数学记号与公式邻接位置
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式或定义附近的标点和词片段；激活分布并不只落在符号上。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的资格、裁判与规则用语
patterns.context: 法律论证、证据审查或法规适用语境中，常见资格判断、当事人权利和裁判标准。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的危险行为措辞
patterns.context: 描述造成财产或人身危险的行为要件；该例中激活突出落在“recklessly”。

patterns.name: 餐馆经营者的个人叙述
patterns.context: 第一人称、口语化自述；说话者谈及自身能力与经营餐馆的经历。

patterns.name: 随机抽取与向量空间定义
patterns.context: 有限域及向量空间的数学定义中，说明向量如何被随机选取。

patterns.name: 免疫与疫苗名词串
patterns.context: 提及免疫反应以及安全的沙门氏菌疫苗菌株。

patterns.name: 贝叶斯估计术语
patterns.context: 讨论贝叶斯逆问题中的后验信息和点估计方法，尤指 MAP 估计。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 统计/计算方法论文

patterns.name: 住宅改良价值与赔偿
patterns.context: 判例讨论陪审团是否可按房屋改良价值判赔，以及相关诉讼争议。

patterns.name: 法律主张与判决标准
patterns.context: 判例援引既有事实并说明取得简易判决所需条件。

patterns.name: 法规抗辩与现行法律文字
patterns.context: 被告提出法规抗辩时，法院讨论其援引现行法规文本的权利。

en.description: Activations occur in legal entitlements and admissibility of evidence, probability distribution definitions, statistical estimation methods, hockey player evaluations, and financial disclaimers; no clear shared semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Legal statements of entitlement/right
patterns.context: In legal argumentation, a subject is said to have a right, be eligible, or be able to take an action; includes “entitled to rely”“entitled to anticipate”“entitled to exercise”“be entitled to summary judgment”.

patterns.name: Admissibility/exception judgments under rules of evidence
patterns.context: Concerns whether a statement may be admitted as evidence, whether an exception applies, and judicial interests; unlike entitlement statements, these are specific rules of evidence admissibility.

patterns.name: Distributions and approximate uniformity in mathematical definitions
patterns.context: Defines or describes the notation for a random variable’s uniform distribution and its closeness to a uniform distribution.

patterns.name: Estimation methods and optimization objectives
patterns.context: Describes estimators, optimization processes, or estimation methods in statistics or Bayesian inverse problems.

patterns.name: Hockey player and team-style evaluations
patterns.context: Evaluates a player’s style of play and suitability for a particular team.

patterns.name: Financial disclaimers and information-update statements
patterns.context: Describes the source of reliability for opinions or information, the judgments they reflect, and the possibility that they may change or not be updated.

11_399.description: 激活分布于法律资格与证据准入、概率分布定义、统计估计方法、冰球球员评价及金融免责声明；共同的具体语义模式不明显。

patterns.name: 法律中的资格／权利表述
patterns.context: 法律论述中以某主体为主语，说明其有权、符合资格或可以采取某行动；包括“entitled to rely”“entitled to anticipate”“entitled to exercise”“be entitled to summary judgment”。

patterns.name: 法律证据规则中的准入／例外判断
patterns.context: 围绕陈述能否作为证据采纳、例外是否适用及司法利益展开；与资格表述不同，是具体的证据准入规则。

patterns.name: 数学定义中的分布与接近均匀
patterns.context: 定义或记号说明随机变量的均匀分布及其与均匀分布的接近程度。
patterns.domain: 概率论／理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 估计方法与优化目标
patterns.context: 描述统计或贝叶斯逆问题中的估计量、优化过程或估计方法。
patterns.domain: 统计学与应用数学论文

patterns.name: 冰球球员与球队风格评价
patterns.context: 评价球员的比赛特点及其是否适合某支球队。

patterns.name: 金融免责声明与信息更新声明
patterns.trigger: “subject to change without notice”“may or may not be updated”
patterns.context: 说明意见或信息的可靠性来源、其反映的判断，以及未来可能变更或不更新。
patterns.domain: 金融机构邮件／免责声明

en.description: Most activation comes from legal texts, especially the admission of evidence, parties' authority, statutory requirements, and jury discretion; other examples include vaccine immunogenicity, viral antibody targets, Bayesian estimation, and uniform distributions in scientific texts. No single clear semantic trigger point is apparent.

patterns.name: Admission of legal evidence and statements
patterns.context: Discusses whether evidence, statements, or facts may be admitted, and the related rules, exceptions, and conditions
patterns.domain: Legal rulings or rules of evidence

patterns.name: Authorization, rights, or judgment in litigation
patterns.context: Describes the authority, rights, burden of proof, or litigation decisions of parties, juries, or prosecutors

patterns.name: Statements of legal conditions and standards
patterns.context: States conditions necessary for applying the law, proof requirements, or standards of discretion

patterns.name: Insufficient vaccine immunogenicity
patterns.context: Describes the difficulty of eliciting an immune response after administering a candidate vaccine

patterns.name: Bayesian posterior point estimation
patterns.context: Introduces posterior information and point-estimation methods in Bayesian inverse problems

patterns.name: Uniform distribution of a random variable
patterns.context: A formula states that a variable follows a uniform distribution over a set

patterns.name: Antibody targets on viral envelopes
patterns.context: Describes regions of viral envelope glycoproteins and their epitopes being targeted by neutralizing antibodies

patterns.name: Statutory citations and grounds for a defense
patterns.context: Cites a repealed statute and discusses the defendant's right to rely on the text of current statutes

patterns.name: Jury verdicts and the value of home improvements
patterns.context: Compares the value of home improvements with material and labor costs to discuss a damages award

patterns.name: Jury selection and discrimination standards
patterns.context: Discusses prosecutors' use of peremptory challenges and whether this meets the non-discrimination standard

patterns.name: Random occurrence of a generic authorization expression
patterns.context: The phrase itself occurs in a summary judgment context, surrounded by discussion of whether the facts support summary judgment

11_399.concept: 法律判断与科学技术陈述
11_399.description: 多数激活来自法律文本，尤其是证据采纳、当事人权限、法定条件与陪审团裁量；另有疫苗免疫原性、病毒抗体靶点、贝叶斯估计及均匀分布等科学文本，未见同一明确语义触发点。

patterns.name: 法律证据采纳与陈述
patterns.context: 讨论证据、陈述或事实是否可被采纳，以及相关规则、例外和条件

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的授权、权利或判断
patterns.context: 描述当事人、陪审团或检方的权限、权利、举证责任及诉讼判断

patterns.name: 法律条件与标准的表述
patterns.context: 陈述法律适用的必要条件、证明要求或裁量标准

patterns.name: 疫苗免疫原性不足
patterns.context: 描述候选疫苗经给药后引发免疫反应的困难

patterns.name: 贝叶斯后验点估计
patterns.context: 介绍贝叶斯反问题中的后验信息及点估计方法

patterns.name: 随机变量的均匀分布
patterns.context: 公式中说明变量服从某个集合上的均匀分布

patterns.name: 病毒包膜抗体靶点
patterns.context: 描述病毒包膜糖蛋白区域及其表位被中和抗体靶向

patterns.name: 法条引注与抗辩依据
patterns.context: 援引已废止法条，并讨论被告依赖现行法规文本的权利

patterns.name: 陪审团裁决与房屋改良价值
patterns.trigger: “jury”“award”“value of improvements to the house”“cost of materials and labor”
patterns.context: 比较房屋改良价值与材料、人工成本，以讨论损害赔偿裁决

patterns.name: 陪审团选择与歧视标准
patterns.context: 讨论检察官使用无因回避权及其是否符合非歧视标准

patterns.name: 随机出现的通用权限表达
patterns.context: 短语本身出现在总结判决语境中，附近围绕事实能否支持简易判决

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous contexts: legal negation, rights, and adjudication language; mathematical properties; financial disclaimers; biomedical terminology; and everyday praise. A single semantic theme does not readily explain them.

patterns.name: “can” adjacent to a negation word
patterns.context: In legal argumentation, indicates that an interest cannot be retained or a statement may not be admitted; in [2], not and can are separated.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, legal rulings or rules of evidence

patterns.name: Legal proof and adjudication language
patterns.context: Rights, proof, liability, or adjudication in formal legal statements; activation is distributed around common function words and legal expressions.

patterns.name: Contract legal terminology
patterns.context: contractually is split at a token boundary, highlighting “contract” and its continuation; discusses an employer waiving statutory limited liability.

patterns.name: Words describing mathematical properties
patterns.context: Conditions such as continuity and strict positivity following formulas.

patterns.name: Securities copy with a disclaimer
patterns.context: A disclaimer states that the information provided does not constitute an offer to sell; activation falls on the “should be considered” structure.
patterns.domain: Enron Emails, financial or securities disclaimers

patterns.name: Antibody-related terminology
patterns.context: mAbs (monoclonal antibodies) are marked as split tokens; nearby text discusses broadly neutralizing antibodies and their epitopes.

patterns.name: Praise and exception-based evaluation
patterns.context: An informal comment says that people who invest in professional training are commendable.

11_399.description: 激活分布在异质语境：法律否定、权利与裁判措辞，以及数学性质、金融免责声明、生物医学术语和日常赞赏；难以由单一语义主题统一解释。

patterns.name: “can”与否定词相邻
patterns.trigger: [1] «cannot»；[2] «can» … «not» «be»；都突出情态动词 can 与否定表达的组合
patterns.context: 法律论述中，表示不能保留利益或陈述不得采纳；[2] 中 not 与 can 分开出现

patterns.name: 法律证明与裁判用语
patterns.context: 正式法律语句中的权利、证明、责任或裁判表述；激活分布在常见功能词和法律表达周边

patterns.name: 合同法律术语
patterns.context: contractually 被分词边界拆开，突出「contract」及其续接；讨论雇主放弃法定有限责任

patterns.name: 数学性质描述词
patterns.context: 公式后的连续性、严格正性等数学条件

patterns.name: 带免责声明的证券文案
patterns.context: 免责声明中说明所述信息不构成出售要约；激活落在 should be considered 结构
patterns.domain: Enron Emails，金融或证券免责声明

patterns.name: 抗体相关术语
patterns.context: mAbs（单克隆抗体）被拆分标记，附近讨论广泛中和抗体及其表位

patterns.name: 赞赏与例外评价
patterns.context: 日常评论中评价投入专业训练者值得赞赏

en.description: Most passages are legal texts, especially those involving evidence, burden of proof, experts, or adjudication; other isolated patterns include website license grants, mathematical property statements, sports praise, and first-person, self-effacing narratives.

patterns.name: Legal argument and evidence review
patterns.context: Legal documents discuss admissibility of evidence, burden of proof, expert qualifications, adjudication, or fact-finding; activation often falls on argument terms and adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Case law, litigation opinions, and rules of evidence

patterns.name: Grant of rights in license terms
patterns.context: Website terms of use state what rights the website receives when a user uploads content.

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and regularity statements
patterns.context: Formulas describe the support of a function or measure and state properties such as continuity and positivity.

patterns.name: Praise for sports figures and team achievements
patterns.context: Comments on a player's performance, praising consistency, clutch play, and contribution to a championship.

patterns.name: Humbly denying expert status
patterns.context: First-person, colloquial self-narration; the speaker modestly or self-deprecatingly says they will not become an expert.

11_399.description: 多数段落是法律文本，尤其涉及证据、举证责任、专家或裁决；另有网站许可授予、数学性质陈述、体育赞誉和第一人称谦逊自述等孤立模式。

patterns.name: 法律论证与证据审查
patterns.context: 在法律文书中讨论证据可采性、举证责任、专家资格、裁决或事实认定；激活常落在论证词及其相邻 token 上。
patterns.domain: 判例、诉讼意见与证据规则

patterns.name: 许可条款中的权利授予
patterns.context: 网站使用条款说明用户上传内容后授予网站何种使用权。
patterns.domain: 网站服务条款／法律文本

patterns.name: 数学定义与正则性陈述
patterns.context: 以公式描述函数或测度的支撑集，并陈述其连续性、正性等性质。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，LaTeX 技术文本

patterns.name: 体育人物赞誉与团队成就
patterns.context: 评论球员表现，称赞其稳定、关键时刻发挥及对夺冠的贡献。

patterns.name: 谦逊地否认专家身份
patterns.context: 第一人称、口语化自述；说话者以自我贬抑或谦逊语气否认自己会成为专家。
patterns.domain: 个人博客或访谈式散文

en.description: Primarily appears in legal argumentation, responding to evidence, findings of fact, and modal judgments (will/could/would); it also appears in positive sports evaluations, technical superlative evaluations, and descriptions of mathematical properties, with weaker links to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Possibility and evidentiary thresholds in legal argumentation
patterns.context: In legal rulings or litigation arguments, discusses whether evidence can support a finding of fact, whether the burden of proof is met, and judgments a court or jury might make; modal verbs and infinitive structures are common.

patterns.name: Positive evaluations in sports contexts
patterns.context: Describes a player’s contribution to a team or suitability for a particular team system; evaluative adjectives modify nouns.

patterns.name: Emphatic superlative evaluations of technical products
patterns.context: When comparing software or development tools, gives the highest level of positive evaluation using emphatic language.

patterns.name: Strict properties in mathematical contexts
patterns.context: Mathematical statements specify that a function or quantity is strictly positive over a given interval.

11_399.description: 主要出现在法律论证中，响应证据、事实认定与情态判断（will/could/would）；另见体育正面评价、技术最高级评价及数学性质描述，后几类与主模式联系较弱。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的可能性与证据门槛
patterns.trigger: “will produce”“could rationally find”“could fail”“would cast doubt”“tends to support”“could not award”“would be sufficient”；反复出现的“fact-finder”“evidence”
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉讼论证中，讨论证据能否支持事实认定、是否达到证明标准，以及法院或陪审团可能作出的判断；常见情态动词和不定式结构

patterns.name: 体育语境中的正面评价
patterns.context: 描述球员对球队的贡献或其是否适合某种球队体系；评价性形容词修饰名词

patterns.name: 技术产品的强调式最高评价
patterns.context: 比较软件或开发工具时，以强调表达给出最高程度的正面评价

patterns.name: 数学语境中的严格性质
patterns.context: 数学表述中说明函数或量在指定区间内严格为正

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in legal texts concerning the sufficiency of evidence, reasonable fact-finding, admissibility of evidence, and conditions for adjudication; a few other patterns include the legal modal will, strict positivity in mathematics, sports praise, and software recommendations.

patterns.name: Evidentiary standards and reasonable inferences
patterns.context: Concerns whether evidence supports a ruling and whether a factfinder can reasonably reach a conclusion; often co-occurs with modals such as could, would, permitted and with inference or proof standards.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, evidence law, and appellate review

patterns.name: will in legal sentences
patterns.context: Appears in statements of legal rules or reasoning to indicate an evidentiary effect or purpose of a rule; activation is especially strong in paragraph 1.

patterns.name: Admissibility of evidence and consequences for adjudication
patterns.context: Discusses whether evidence is admissible, whether a jury may award damages, or whether a ruling is supported.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, rules of evidence, and civil disputes

patterns.name: Judgment summaries and sufficiency of facts
patterns.context: Summarizes litigation facts and determines whether they meet legal conditions for judgment or formation of an offer.

patterns.name: Numerical support and continuous positivity
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas describe a function's or distribution's support, continuity, and positivity; activation falls on the word strictly.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, especially probability or analysis

patterns.name: Praise for sports figures
patterns.context: Praises someone's consistent performance and reliability in clutch situations, emphasizing their contribution to the team's championship.

patterns.name: Software or tool recommendations
patterns.context: Users or reviewers share software or API prices, personal trial impressions, and recommendations from others.

11_399.concept: 语境依赖的评价与判定
11_399.description: 激活主要集中于法律文本中证据的充分性、合理事实认定、证据采纳及裁判条件；另见法律情态will、数学中的严格正性、体育赞誉和软件推荐等少数模式。

patterns.name: 证据证明标准与合理推断
patterns.trigger: «evidence»、«clear and convincing evidence»、«reasonable inferences»、«probative evidence»、«reasonable trier of fact»、«reasonable factfinder»
patterns.context: 围绕证据能否支持裁决、事实认定者能否作出合理判断，常与 could、would、permitted 等情态词及推断、证明标准搭配。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、证据法及上诉审查

patterns.name: 法律语句中的 will
patterns.context: 位于法律规则或推理表述中，说明某种证明效果或规则目的；第1段中激活尤其强。

patterns.name: 证据采纳与裁判后果
patterns.context: 讨论证据是否可采、陪审团能否裁定赔偿或某项裁判是否有依据。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、证据规则与民事争议

patterns.name: 判决摘要与事实是否充分
patterns.context: 概述诉讼事实，并判断事实能否满足判决或要约成立等法律条件。

patterns.name: 数值支持集及连续正性
patterns.context: 数学公式中描述函数或分布的支持集、连续性和正性；激活落在 strictly 一词上。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，偏概率或分析

patterns.name: 体育人物赞誉
patterns.context: 称赞某人表现稳定、关键时刻可靠，并强调其对球队夺冠的贡献。

patterns.name: 软件或工具推荐
patterns.context: 用户或评论者分享软件、API 的价格、个人试用评价及他人推荐。

en.description: Most passages are legal texts concerning whether evidence supports a ruling, factual inferences, and credibility; other passages cover mathematical support sets, sports performance, and honors. More than one shared signal is present, with clear cross-domain outliers.

patterns.name: Conditional/evidentiary inference with “would”
patterns.context: In legal reasoning, connects evidence to an expected legal conclusion or inference, such as “evidence … would produce” or “evidence … would support”; “would be sufficient” also appears.

patterns.name: Evidence supporting rulings or damages
patterns.context: Discusses whether evidence supports a court ruling, damages award, or factual finding; common phrases include “support the trial court’s decision” and “support it”.

patterns.name: Evidence credibility and evidentiary basis
patterns.context: Courts assess whether material has an evidentiary basis, is credible, or can be believed by the factfinder.

patterns.name: Whether a reasonable jury could infer
patterns.context: Uses a reasonable jury or factfinder standard to determine whether a particular factual inference could be drawn.

patterns.name: Evidentiary standards on appeal
patterns.context: States the burden of proof, reviews whether discretion was abused, or examines evidence favoring the prevailing party on appeal.

patterns.name: Support sets and strict positivity in mathematics
patterns.context: Formulas describe the support interval of a function or density and its continuity and strict positivity within the interval.

patterns.name: Sports figures’ performance and honors
patterns.context: Describes players’ performances in key moments, team championships, and individual season statistics or honors.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC sports texts, Wikipedia athlete biographies

11_399.description: 多数段落是法律文本，涉及证据能否支持裁决、事实推论及可信度；另有数学支撑集、体育表现与荣誉。共享信号不止一个，且有明显跨领域离群段。

patterns.name: “would”的条件/证据推论
patterns.context: 法律论证中连接证据与预期法律结论或推论，如“evidence … would produce”“evidence … would support”；也出现“would be sufficient”。

patterns.name: 证据支持裁判或损害赔偿
patterns.context: 讨论证据是否支持法院裁决、赔偿裁定或事实认定，常见“support the trial court’s decision”“support it”。

patterns.name: 证据可信度与证明基础
patterns.context: 法院评估材料是否有证据基础、是否可信，或事实认定者能否相信证据。

patterns.name: 合理陪审团能否推断
patterns.trigger: “reasonable jury”“could not infer”“reasonable factfinder could rationally find”
patterns.context: 以合理陪审团或事实认定者为标准，判断其能否作出某种事实推论。

patterns.name: 上诉审查中的证据标准
patterns.trigger: “Clear and convincing evidence”“abuse of discretion”“prevailing party”
patterns.context: 陈述证据证明标准、审查裁量是否滥用，或上诉法院审查有利于胜诉方的证据。

patterns.name: 数学中的支撑集与严格正性
patterns.context: 公式描述函数或密度的支撑区间及其在区间内连续、严格为正。

patterns.name: 体育人物表现与荣誉
patterns.context: 描述球员在关键时刻的表现、球队夺冠及个人赛季数据或荣誉。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 体育文本、Wikipedia 运动员传记

en.description: Activation spans multiple domains: evaluations of sports figures and players, positive assessments of ability or services, legal arguments about evidence, introductions to people and their awards, and mathematical norm inequalities. The commonality is weak; the main shared feature is complete descriptive statements.

patterns.name: Athlete performance and honors
patterns.context: Statistics, scouting evaluations, team drafts, or descriptions of player performance; may involve American football, hockey, and other sports
patterns.domain: Sports biographies, player evaluations, and game commentary

patterns.name: Professional ability and positive recommendations
patterns.context: Personal experiences evaluating products, services, or people, using positive judgments, descriptions of competence, or recommendations

patterns.name: Legal standards of proof and evidentiary reliability
patterns.context: Courts or legal texts discuss standards of proof, the evidentiary basis, and credibility

patterns.name: Career honors and awards
patterns.context: Introduces a person's business or industry honors, with the year and awarding organization
patterns.domain: Biographies, business news, or encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Norm conditions in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Conditions or estimates expressed using derivatives, norms, and inequalities

11_399.description: 激活覆盖多种领域：体育人物与球员评价、正面能力或服务评价、法律证据论述、人物奖项介绍，以及数学范数不等式；共同点较弱，主要是结构完整的描述性陈述。

patterns.name: 运动员表现与荣誉
patterns.trigger: “tackles”, “sacks”, “All-America”, “All-Big 12”；“championship”, “hands”, “clutch”；“Islanders”, “pick”, “goal-scoring winger”, “shot”, “speed”；“played both defensive end and tight end”, “Rivals.com 250”, “four-star rating”
patterns.context: 体育人物的统计数据、球探评价、球队选秀或球员表现介绍；可涉及美式足球、冰球及其他运动
patterns.domain: 体育传记、球员评价与赛事评论

patterns.name: 专业能力与正面推荐评价
patterns.context: 以个人经验评价产品、服务或人员，使用正面判断、能力描述或推荐语

patterns.name: 法律证明标准与证据可靠性
patterns.trigger: “Clear and convincing evidence”, “degree of proof”, “fact-finder”；“matter of law”, “evidentiary foundation”, “untrustworthy”
patterns.context: 法院或法律文本中论述举证标准、证据基础及可信性

patterns.name: 人物职业荣誉与奖项
patterns.context: 介绍人物获得的商业或行业荣誉，并附年份、授奖机构
patterns.domain: 人物传记、商业新闻或百科条目

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的范数条件
patterns.context: 以导数、范数和不等式写出的条件或估计

en.description: Activations cover statements about evidence, burdens of proof, and rulings in legal documents, as well as praise for people receiving awards or performing well; also found are website content license terms and a Christmas cactus gift description. No single stable lexical trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Legal evidence and ruling language
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions discussing evidentiary credibility, litigation burdens of proof, trial rulings, or standards of proof.

patterns.name: Achievements, awards, and praise
patterns.context: Describes a person receiving awards or honors, or a team contribution, with a commendatory or laudatory tone.

patterns.name: Contract license terms
patterns.context: Website terms of use specify the rights granted to the platform when users upload content.

patterns.name: Holiday plant gift description
patterns.context: Introduces Christmas cactus and its flower colors as a holiday gift idea.

11_399.description: 激活覆盖法律文书中的证据、举证和裁判表述，以及人物获奖或表现出色的赞誉文字；另见网站内容授权条款和圣诞仙人掌礼品介绍，未见单一稳定词法触发。

patterns.name: 法律证据与裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: “as a matter of law”“evidentiary foundation”“untrustworthy”“trial court”“non-moving party”“reasonable jury”“clear and convincing evidence”“fact-finder”
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见中，讨论证据可信度、诉讼举证责任、审判裁定或证明标准。

patterns.name: 成就、奖项与表扬
patterns.context: 称述个人获得奖项、荣誉或团队贡献，带有表彰、赞扬意味。
patterns.domain: 人物简介、音乐报道、体育评论

patterns.name: 合同授权条款
patterns.trigger: “you grant”“perpetual, nonexclusive and royalty-free right to use”
patterns.context: 网站使用条款规定用户上传内容后授予平台的使用权。
patterns.domain: 网站服务条款／法律文本

patterns.name: 节日植物礼物介绍
patterns.context: 以节日送礼为由介绍圣诞仙人掌及其开花颜色。
patterns.domain: 生活方式／礼品推荐文案

en.description: Includes fixed legal formulations assessing whether evidence could support a jury finding, as well as positive evaluations, achievements, and expressions of satisfaction in sports, personal, product, and family contexts; the contexts differ substantially.

patterns.name: Jury possibility in legal decisions
patterns.context: In legal argument or decisions, discusses whether evidence is sufficient for a reasonable juror to make a finding, whether a matter can go to a jury, or whether evidence supports a ruling.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, civil litigation, and evidentiary sufficiency analysis

patterns.name: Sports performance and positive evaluation
patterns.context: Introduces athletes’ season statistics, honors, or on-field ability, often ending with emphatic praise.
patterns.domain: Sports profiles, commentary, and draft analysis

patterns.name: Achievements, awards, and honors
patterns.context: Biographies describe awards, annual titles, or career achievements.

patterns.name: Product praise in a concluding statement
patterns.context: After describing a product experience, gives a recommendation using an intensifier and positive adjective.

patterns.name: Emphatic language in family expressions
patterns.context: Quotes personal feelings about spending time with one’s mother or son, using an intensifier to emphasize satisfaction.

11_399.concept: 评价性结论与可能性判断
11_399.description: 包括法律文本中判断证据能否支持陪审团认定的固定表述，以及体育、人物、产品和亲情语境里的正面评价、成就或满足感表达；各类语境差异明显。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的陪审团可能性
patterns.trigger: “could find”“could not award”“would be sufficient”“no reasonable juror could find”
patterns.context: 法律论证或判决语境，讨论证据是否足以让合理陪审员作出认定、是否可提交陪审团或支持裁决。
patterns.domain: 美国判例、民事诉讼与证据充分性分析

patterns.name: 体育表现与正面评价
patterns.trigger: “consensus first-team All-America”“an enormous part”“a perfect winger”；另有“great speed”“soft hands”
patterns.context: 介绍运动员的赛季数据、荣誉或球场能力，常以强烈正面评价收束。
patterns.domain: 体育人物简介、评论与选秀分析

patterns.name: 成就奖项与荣誉表彰
patterns.context: 人物简介中叙述获奖、年度称号或职业成就。
patterns.domain: 商业人物传记与荣誉介绍

patterns.name: 产品赞誉式结语
patterns.context: 产品体验描述后，以强调性副词和正面形容词作推荐式评价。

patterns.name: 亲情表达的强调语
patterns.trigger: “literally all I could have asked for”
patterns.context: 引述个人对与母亲、儿子共度时光的感情表达，以强调词突出满足感。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体相关新闻引语

en.concept: Evaluative statements in legal texts and sports reporting
en.description: Activation spans legal rulings, evidence and statutes, as well as football player profiles, platform licenses, and family quotations; legal passages repeatedly involve juries, rulings, and evidentiary judgments, while sports passages focus on player performance, statistics, and honors.

patterns.name: Reasonable-jury standard in legal rulings
patterns.context: Legal opinions or rulings discuss whether evidence is sufficient to support a jury finding, especially in the context of summary judgment

patterns.name: Jury authority and award amounts
patterns.context: Discusses whether a jury has authority to make a particular ruling, award damages, or determine value

patterns.name: Assessment of evidentiary reliability and admissibility
patterns.context: A court evaluates the evidentiary basis and credibility of a third-party letter

patterns.name: Privacy disclosure exceptions in statutory text
patterns.context: Lists categories of information that may be exempt from disclosure, including medical records
patterns.domain: Statutory text or legal citations, freedom of information and privacy

patterns.name: Legal authorization or evidentiary support for an award
patterns.context: Reviews whether evidence authorized a jury to award the value of home improvements, involving material and labor costs
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, property or civil damages

patterns.name: American football player statistics and honors
patterns.context: Biographical statements of player season statistics and college football honors

patterns.name: License wording in social platform terms
patterns.context: Explains the usage license granted to a platform after a user posts a photo
patterns.domain: Online news or discussion of terms of service

patterns.name: Family sentiments about parents, children, and birthdays
patterns.context: Social media photos or birthday-related quotations expressing time spent with a mother and son

patterns.name: Player performance and team results in sports commentary
patterns.context: Praises a player's reliable catching, clutch performance, and contribution to a championship

patterns.name: Football player and quarterback coordination
patterns.context: A coach or teammate evaluates a receiver's route running and catching, and their rapport with the passer

11_399.concept: 法律与体育报道中的评价性陈述
11_399.description: 激活跨越法律判决、证据与法规，以及橄榄球人物报道、平台许可和家庭引语；法律段落反复出现陪审团、裁定与证据判断，体育段落则集中于球员表现、数据和荣誉。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的合理陪审团标准
patterns.context: 法律意见或判决讨论证据是否足以支持陪审团认定，尤其是简易判决语境

patterns.name: 陪审团权限与裁决数额
patterns.context: 讨论陪审团是否有权作出某项裁决、损害赔偿或价值认定

patterns.name: 证据可靠性与可采性评价
patterns.trigger: “lacking in evidentiary foundation”及“authentically unreliable and untrustworthy”
patterns.context: 法院评估第三方信件的证据基础和可信度

en.description: Strong activations are concentrated in modality, evidence evaluation, and formal obligation language in legal decisions and contract terms; praise words, relational words, and sporadic proper-name fragments also occur, without a consistent cross-corpus pattern.

patterns.name: Negative “unreliable/untrustworthy” evaluations in court reasoning
patterns.context: Courts make negative judgments when discussing evidence, documents, or party arguments; activations cluster around negative evaluative words and their morphological fragments.

patterns.name: Modality, conditions, and ruling-related language in legal texts
patterns.context: Legal arguments describe whether a claim succeeds, whether evidence is sufficient, or what a court or jury can or cannot decide; activations fall on common function words or modal expressions.

patterns.name: Formal obligations and legal relationships in contract terms
patterns.context: Contracts, terms of service, or license texts state grants of rights, disclaimers, and indemnification obligations, often using legal boilerplate and formal clauses.

patterns.name: Litigation facts and legal document format
patterns.context: Narratives of case facts, litigation procedure, contract clauses, or evidentiary review contain procedural vocabulary used in legal documents.

patterns.name: Emphatic positive evaluations and achievement words
patterns.context: Personal testimonials, award profiles, social media quotes, or product reviews contain clear praise; some activations fall on intensifiers or evaluative words.
patterns.domain: Personal testimonials, biographies, social media, and product reviews

patterns.name: Abstract words related to connection/relationships
patterns.context: Discusses a sense of connection with all of life; appears only once, in a passage that also contains strong praise.

patterns.name: Ownership and affiliation statements
patterns.context: Discusses ownership or belonging in relation to photo rights, work, or family relationships; activations are weak or sporadic, so a distinct stable pattern cannot be confirmed.
patterns.domain: Terms of service, legal decisions, personal narratives

patterns.name: Fragments in names and entity names
patterns.context: Proper names or brand names are marked because of subword fragments, with no consistent semantic trigger condition apparent.

en.concept: Local Fragments in Achievement Recognition and License Terms
en.description: Activations appear mainly in descriptions of awards and honors, sports performance, and achievement narratives; there are also terms granting a website a nonexclusive, royalty-free right to use content, subwords in proper names, and one instance of “Nonvolatile” in a patent.

patterns.name: Awards and honors
patterns.context: A person or group receives an award, annual title, or honor; some fragments also occur with wording such as won/earned/awarded/received.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia and biographies or reporting related to people, sports, and entertainment

patterns.name: Sports figures’ performance and achievements

patterns.name: Granting nonexclusive, royalty-free rights to use content

patterns.name: Nonvolatility in a technical name
patterns.context: A patent or technical document citation describes a property of memory cells; this appears in only one passage, so its relation to other patterns cannot be established.

en.concept: Positive evaluations and statements of achievement

patterns.name: 应用推荐与产品使用体验
patterns.trigger: « mobile»« sales»« app»；« favorite»；« listing»« process»
patterns.context: 用户推荐应用，并描述使用感受或产品用途。

en.description: Activations are distributed across website promotion and commercial copy, including license terms, customer reviews, service descriptions, personal awards, sports evaluations, and affiliate marketing disclosures. The common thread is public-facing descriptive text that is positive or practical, but there is no obvious unified trigger.

patterns.name: Authorization and license terms
patterns.context: Describes rights granted to a website or platform after users upload content, often alongside legal terminology and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Website terms of service, copyright licenses

patterns.name: Customer reviews and recommendations
patterns.context: Presents customer satisfaction, gratitude, or first-person experience, often in commercial website promotional copy.
patterns.domain: Customer reviews or marketing copy on travel, law firm, event venue, and other websites

patterns.name: Commercial service descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a company’s service scope, target customers, or business advantages; not necessarily a customer review.

patterns.name: Lists of personal achievements and awards
patterns.context: Centered on a person or professional, listing awards, titles, and quantities.

patterns.name: Sports figures’ performance and team records
patterns.context: Evaluates athletes’ performances in key moments and connects them with team championships or contributions.

patterns.name: Affiliate programs and earnings disclosures
patterns.context: Explains that a website participates in an affiliate marketing program and earns fees from referrals.

11_399.description: 激活分布于网站宣传与商业文案：包括授权条款、客户评价、服务介绍、人物奖项、体育评价和联盟营销披露；共同点是偏正面或实用的公开介绍性文本，但没有明显统一触发词。

patterns.name: 授权与许可条款
patterns.context: 描述用户上传内容后授予网站或平台的权利，常与法律条款用语及标点连用
patterns.domain: 网站服务条款、版权许可

patterns.name: 客户评价与推荐语
patterns.context: 呈现客户满意度、感谢或第一人称体验评价，常见于商业网站宣传文案
patterns.domain: 旅游、律师、活动场地等网站的客户评价或营销文案

patterns.name: 商业服务介绍
patterns.context: 介绍企业服务范围、服务对象或业务优势；不一定是客户评价

patterns.name: 人物成就与奖项罗列
patterns.context: 以姓名或职业人物为中心，陈列奖项、头衔及数量
patterns.domain: 摄影师简介、个人履历宣传

patterns.name: 体育人物表现与团队战绩
patterns.context: 评价运动员在关键时刻的表现，并联系球队夺冠或贡献

patterns.name: 联盟项目与收益说明
patterns.context: 说明网站参与联盟营销计划，以及通过推荐产生费用
patterns.domain: 网站披露、联盟营销说明

en.description: Covers emphatic evaluations in quotations, legal platform-license terms, percentage guarantees, the name of a festive plant, football statistics and honors, and five-star review promotions. Trigger word types and writing styles vary widely, with no stable single semantic pattern apparent.

patterns.name: Emphatic evaluations in quotations
patterns.context: In quotations or first-person impressions, evaluators use intensifiers to express satisfaction, amazement, or engagement; activation often falls on common colloquial words such as “is”, “just”, “literally”, “I’m”.
patterns.domain: News quotes, sports interviews, experience reviews

patterns.name: Legal terms granting a license
patterns.context: Terms of service describe a user granting a license to a platform; nearby language includes grant, a, non-exclusive, and royalty-free legal wording. Activation is particularly concentrated on frequent conjunctions and punctuation in license conditions.
patterns.domain: Website terms of service, copyright licenses

patterns.name: Percentage guarantees and ticketing promotions
patterns.context: Commercial advertising describes a ticketing service and makes a promise using a percentage and a guarantee; activation stands out on the percent sign, surrounded by price or guarantee language.

patterns.name: Plant word forms in product names
patterns.context: A gardening gift article introduces a festive plant; when the plant name is segmented or spelled out, activation appears within the word and in explanatory text.

patterns.name: Sports statistics and honor names
patterns.context: Player season data and honors; activation involves numbers and components of team or honor names.

patterns.name: Five-star review promotion
patterns.context: A law firm advertisement uses customer reviews and star ratings as proof of service quality; star ratings appear alongside review language.

11_399.description: 涵盖引述中的强调评价、平台许可法律条款、百分比保证、节庆植物名、橄榄球统计荣誉及五星评价宣传。触发词类和文体差异很大，未见稳定的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 引述中的评价强调
patterns.trigger: “is literally all I could have asked for”；“It’s just incredible”；“I’m just trying”；“was nothing short of AMAZING”
patterns.context: 引述或第一人称感想中，评价者用强调词表达满足、惊叹或投入；激活常落在口语常见词上，如“is”“just”“literally”“I’m”。
patterns.domain: 新闻引语、体育采访、体验评价

patterns.name: 授予许可的法律条款
patterns.trigger: “you grant Animal-World.com a perpetual, nonexclusive, and royalty-free”；“you hereby grant to Instagram a non-exclusive, fully paid and royalty-free”
patterns.context: 服务条款描述用户向平台授予许可，附近出现 grant、a、非独占及免版税等法律措辞；激活尤其集中于许可条件中的高频连接词和标点。
patterns.domain: 网站服务条款、版权许可

patterns.name: 百分比保证与票务宣传
patterns.context: 商业宣传描述票务服务并以百分比加保证作承诺；激活突出百分号，周围有价格或保证措辞。
patterns.domain: 本地商业广告、票务网站

patterns.name: 产品名中的植物词形
patterns.context: 园艺礼物文章介绍节庆植物；植物名被拆分或拼写时，激活出现在词内部及说明性文字中。

patterns.name: 体育统计与荣誉名称
patterns.trigger: “24.5 sacks”“47 tackles for loss”“consensus first-team All-America”
patterns.context: 球员赛季数据及荣誉统计；激活涉及数值、队名/荣誉名称构词部分。

patterns.name: 五星评价宣传
patterns.context: 律师事务所广告以客户评价和星级证明服务质量；星级数字与评价措辞共同出现。

en.description: Activations cover the granting of rights and disclaimers in legal texts, commercial promotion and real estate descriptions, evaluations of sports performance, colloquial expressions of strong positive feelings, sweepstakes promotions, and guarantee language. They tend toward emphatic or evaluative expression, but appear in varied contexts.

patterns.name: Legal disclaimers and grants of rights
patterns.context: Website terms of use state rights granted to the website after users upload content, or include disclaimers and limitation-of-liability clauses.
patterns.domain: Website terms of service, legal texts

patterns.name: Positive evaluations in commercial promotion
patterns.context: Promotes services or products by highlighting selling points with language such as superior, discounted, or select.

patterns.name: Colloquial positive feelings and emphasis
patterns.context: Speakers express strong positive evaluations of experiences, achievements, or events, often with consecutive intensifiers.

patterns.name: Evaluations of sports performance and achievements
patterns.context: Describes athletes, teams, or event performance, emphasizing winning streaks, key plays, championships, or competitive level.

patterns.name: Percentage and guarantee language
patterns.context: A business introduces ticketing services and emphasizes a guarantee with a specific percentage.

patterns.name: Promotional sweepstakes and package duration
patterns.context: Advertising attracts participation or website visits with chances to win and travel packages.

patterns.name: Descriptions of real estate features
patterns.context: Property descriptions portray homes using evaluative words about their surroundings, architectural features, and charm.

11_399.concept: 强调性评价与宣传措辞
11_399.description: 激活覆盖法律授予权利与免责、商业宣传和房产描述、体育表现评价，以及口语化的强烈正面感受、抽奖促销和保证措辞；共同点偏向强调性、评价性表达，但触发情境多样。

patterns.name: 法律免责声明与权利授予
patterns.trigger: “you grant Animal-World.com a perpetual, nonexclusive and royalty-free”
patterns.context: 网站使用条款中说明用户上传内容后授予网站的权利，或免责、责任限制条款。
patterns.domain: 网站服务条款、法律文本

patterns.name: 商业宣传中的积极评价
patterns.context: 宣传服务或产品时，以优越、优惠、精选等措辞突出卖点。

patterns.name: 口语化的正面感受与强调
patterns.trigger: “It’s just an amazing blessing”“It’s just incredible”“was very cool”
patterns.context: 说话者对经历、成就或事件表达强烈正面评价，常有连续的强调词。
patterns.domain: 体育采访、个人体验叙述

patterns.name: 体育表现及成就评价
patterns.trigger: “17th straight win”“always clutch”“won the championship”“elite players”
patterns.context: 描述运动员、球队或赛事表现，强调连胜、关键发挥、冠军或竞技水平。

patterns.name: 百分比与保证措辞
patterns.context: 商家介绍票务服务时，用明确比例强化保证。

patterns.name: 促销抽奖与套餐时长
patterns.context: 广告以赢奖机会和旅行套餐吸引参与或访问网站。

patterns.name: 房产特色描写
patterns.context: 房屋介绍以环境、建筑特色和迷人等评价性词语描绘房产。

en.concept: Web promotion and formal terms/introductory text
en.description: Activation appears across several web genres: emphatic positive reviews and service selling points in marketing copy, authorization or disclaimers in legal terms, institutional award introductions, and biomedical mechanism statements. No single obvious word form runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Excessive praise in advertising copy
patterns.context: Customer reviews or product recommendations express satisfaction through strongly positive evaluations and exclamations.
patterns.domain: Travel experiences, app product promotions or user reviews

patterns.name: Prominent selling points in commercial promotions
patterns.context: Commercial webpages or advertisements describe service or product advantages, often using superlatives, star ratings, or guarantees.
patterns.domain: Legal services, real estate, ticketing, and other marketing copy

patterns.name: Authorization and licensing language in legal terms
patterns.context: Terms specify the scope of the license a platform receives after a user uploads content or photos; focus on license terms such as grant, perpetual, nonexclusive, royalty-free.
patterns.domain: Website terms of use, content licensing terms

patterns.name: Disclaimer and legal remedies clauses
patterns.context: Legal text limits liability or the remedies users may claim.

patterns.name: Institutional biographies and award reporting
patterns.context: Third-person accounts report staff appointments, institutional awards, and award-winning projects.

patterns.name: Gene and mechanism descriptions in academic research
patterns.context: States epigenetic regulation, gene expression, and molecular mechanisms.

11_399.concept: 网页宣传与正式条款/介绍文本
11_399.description: 激活出现于多种网页文体：营销文案的强烈好评、服务卖点，法律条款的授权许可或免责，以及机构奖项介绍和生物医学机制陈述。没有单一明显词形贯穿全部段落。

patterns.name: 广告文案中的极端好评
patterns.trigger: “nothing short of A MA ZING!”；“absolutely love it!”
patterns.context: 客户评价或产品推荐中，用强烈正面评价和感叹表达满意。
patterns.domain: 旅游体验、应用产品的宣传或用户评价

patterns.name: 商业宣传中的突出卖点
patterns.trigger: “the best car accident lawyers”；“our 5-star client reviews”；“unrivaled selection”；“a 100% guarantee”
patterns.context: 商业网页或广告介绍服务、产品优势，常用最高级、星级或保证等宣传用语。
patterns.domain: 法律服务、房地产、票务等营销文案

patterns.name: 法律条款中的授权及许可措辞
patterns.trigger: “grant … a perpetual, nonexclusive and royalty-free”；“grant … a non-exclusive, fully paid and royalty-free”
patterns.context: 用户上传内容或照片后，条款规定平台获得的许可范围；关注 grant、perpetual、nonexclusive、royalty-free 等许可术语。
patterns.domain: 网站使用条款、内容授权条款

patterns.name: 免责及法律救济条款
patterns.trigger: “disclaims all liability”；“YOU HAVE NO REMEDIES FOR NEGLIGENCE”
patterns.context: 法律文本限制责任或用户可主张的救济。
patterns.domain: 软件或内容服务的免责声明

patterns.name: 机构履历与奖项报道
patterns.context: 以第三人称报道机构人员任职、机构获奖及获奖项目。

patterns.name: 学术研究中的基因与机制描述
patterns.trigger: “Genome-wide profiling”；“upregulation of EZH2 target genes”；“SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complex”
patterns.context: 陈述表观遗传调控、基因表达及分子机制。

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns and their subword fragments, opening words in titles, legal clause vocabulary, matrix in medical/programming contexts, and adjustments in emails; no unified semantic or stable syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments of split proper nouns or variants of proper-noun forms, including personal names, place names, and event names; trigger positions vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies and event entries, code comments

patterns.name: Title words at the beginning of a sentence or entry
patterns.context: The context opens with a person’s name, an event title following a year, or “Incidence” in a paper title; activations concentrate on the opening word or its subword fragment.

patterns.name: Medical term matrix
patterns.context: In breast reconstruction and radiation therapy abstracts, refers to acellular dermal matrix; in a knitr question, refers to a matrix and its indexing.

patterns.name: Contract or disclaimer wording
patterns.context: In data-use terms, describes data as available for use while prohibiting its transfer to other people or entities; activations are scattered across restrictive clauses.

patterns.name: Adjustment items in email reports
patterns.context: A short email excerpt mentions GCP adjustments highlighted in red, with line breaks and list-style formatting nearby.

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 激活分散于专名及其词片段、标题开头、法律条款词汇、医学/编程中的 matrix，以及邮件中的 adjustments；未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的专名或专名形态变体片段上；包括人名、地名及赛事名称，触发位置并不统一。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目与赛事条目、代码注释

patterns.name: 句首或条目开头的标题词
patterns.context: 上下文开头以人物名称、年份赛事标题或论文题名中的“Incidence”开篇；激活集中在开头词或其词片段。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、医学论文摘要

patterns.name: 医学术语 matrix
patterns.context: 出现在乳房重建与放射治疗摘要中，指无细胞真皮基质；另一次出现在 knitr 问题中，指矩阵及其索引。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 合同或免责声明措辞
patterns.context: 数据使用条款中，描述数据可供使用、禁止向他人或实体传递；激活词分散在限制性条款中。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件中的法律/许可文本

patterns.name: 邮件报告中的调整项
patterns.context: 简短邮件片段提及以红色突出显示的 GCP 调整项，周围有换行和列表式排版。

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper names and subword fragments, entry line breaks, email legal-restriction language, medical terminology, and matrix-index questions; no single stable semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Local strings in proper names or word forms
patterns.context: Activations occur on specific fragments within proper names, place names, surnames, or words; usually with no clear semantic trigger, and often on subword fragments after tokenization.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, code comments, emails, and paper titles

patterns.name: Line breaks after entry titles
patterns.context: Consecutive line breaks follow proper names or entry titles, especially formats where a repeated title or body text follows the title.
patterns.domain: Formatting in encyclopedia entries, code comments, abstracts, or emails

patterns.name: Legal restrictions and permission language
patterns.context: Describes data provision, usage restrictions, and prohibitions on passing data to other people or entities without consent.
patterns.domain: Confidentiality, licensing, or usage terms in emails

patterns.name: Disease and clinical terminology in medical papers
patterns.context: Disease, treatment complications, and tissue reconstruction terminology appear in medical research titles or abstracts.

patterns.name: Matrix indices and row numbers
patterns.context: Asks how to prevent knitr from outputting matrix indices or row numbers; here, matrix is a computational object, not medical tissue.

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 激活分散于专名和词内片段、条目换行、邮件法律限制措辞、医学术语及矩阵索引问题；未见单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名或词形中的局部字串
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、地名、姓氏或词语内部的特定片段；通常没有明显的语义触发条件，且多为分词后的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 百科、代码注释、邮件及论文标题等多种文体

patterns.name: 条目标题后的换行
patterns.context: 专名或条目标题之后出现连续换行，尤其是标题后接重复标题或正文的格式。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、代码注释、摘要或邮件中的排版

patterns.name: 法律限制与许可措辞
patterns.context: 描述数据的提供、使用范围限制，以及未经同意不得向他人或实体传递数据。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的保密、许可或使用条款

patterns.name: 医学论文中的疾病与临床术语
patterns.context: 医学研究标题或摘要中出现疾病、治疗并发症及组织重建相关术语。

patterns.name: 矩阵索引与行号
patterns.context: 提问如何阻止 knitr 输出矩阵索引或行号；这里的 matrix 是计算对象而非医学组织。

en.description: Activations are distributed across internal or final fragments of various English words, involving names, terminology, titles, legal language, and medical terms; specific words in event titles and technical Q&A also appear, making it difficult to identify a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Nonstandard spelling fragments at word ends or within words
patterns.context: Activations occur on final or internal subword fragments; the words belong to different categories, including names, terminology, and common words, with no stable single-sense condition.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including code comments, encyclopedia entries, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Components in proper names and titles
patterns.context: Concentrated in event titles, including years, place-name adjectives, and event-category words.

patterns.name: Restrictive language in legal/usage terms
patterns.context: Appears in numbered clauses describing data usage permissions and restrictions on passing data to others.

patterns.name: Cancer and medical topic words
patterns.context: In medical abstracts, appears in statements about cancer incidence or postoperative complications; activations fall on medical word fragments.

patterns.name: Object-identifying words in technical Q&A
patterns.context: Appears in StackExchange questions in contexts involving domain names, program output, or data structures; the triggered meanings vary.

11_413.concept: 英文词片段／子词
11_413.description: 激活分布在多种英文词的内部或词尾片段，涉及人名、术语、标题、法律措辞和医学词；另见赛事标题及技术问答中的特定词，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 英文词尾或词内的非标准拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词的末尾或内部子词片段；词本身分属姓名、术语或普通词，未见稳定的单一词义条件。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、百科条目、医学摘要等多种文体

patterns.name: 专名与标题中的组成片段
patterns.context: 集中出现在赛事名称标题中，包含年份、地名形容词及赛事类别词。

patterns.name: 法律／使用条款中的限制性措辞
patterns.context: 处于编号条款中，说明数据使用权限及不得向他人传递的限制。
patterns.domain: 商业数据使用条款／邮件

patterns.name: 癌症与医学主题词
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，围绕癌症发生率或术后并发症陈述；激活落在医学词语片段。

patterns.name: 技术问答中的对象标识词
patterns.context: StackExchange问题中，出现在域名、程序输出或数据结构相关语境；触发词义各异。

en.concept: Fragments of proper nouns and title text
en.description: Activations are distributed across names and their split fragments, encyclopedia proper nouns following years, numbered legal clauses, code copyright notices, and words in medical titles; the commonality is weak, though many high activations fall on proper nouns or their subword fragments.

patterns.name: Personal names and name components
patterns.context: Appears in personal names, often with a space between given and family names; sometimes the name is repeated after a line break or accompanied by biographical, gender, or other notes.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of years and proper nouns
patterns.context: A year is followed by a country, region, event, or place name split across multiple tokens; unmarked content appears in election, Grand Prix, or date-title contexts.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry titles or title-like text

patterns.name: Numbered clauses and restrictive legal language
patterns.context: Clause numbers are embedded in formal use restrictions describing the scope of data availability and prohibiting transfer to other people or entities.
patterns.domain: Legal or compliance text in emails

patterns.name: Code copyright notices
patterns.context: Appears in code comments, preceded by a line break and comment marker, followed by the copyright holder and distribution notice.

patterns.name: Disease and population phrases in medical titles
patterns.context: Forms the opening of a research title, followed by disease incidence, exposure factors, and the study population.

11_413.concept: 专名及标题文本片段
11_413.description: 激活分布于姓名及其拆分片段、年份后接的百科专名、编号法律条款、代码版权声明和医学标题词语；共同点较弱，许多高激活落在专名或其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 人名及姓名组成部分
patterns.context: 出现在人物姓名中，常有名字与姓氏之间的空格；有时姓名在换行后重复，或附带生平、性别等说明。

patterns.name: 年份与专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 年份后接被拆分成多个 token 的国家、地区、赛事或地名；未标记内容分别出现选举、大奖赛或日期标题语境。
patterns.domain: 百科条目标题或标题式文本

patterns.name: 编号条款及限制性法律表述
patterns.context: 条款编号嵌在正式的使用限制条款中，说明数据可用范围及不得向他人或实体传递。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的法律或合规文本

patterns.name: 代码版权声明
patterns.context: 出现在代码注释中，前有换行和注释符号，随后为版权人及分发声明。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的疾病与人群词组
patterns.context: 组成研究标题的开头，后接疾病发生率、暴露因素及研究人群。

en.concept: Structured proper names and formatting in diverse texts
en.description: Activations occur in encyclopedia titles and proper names, personal titles and timelines, and technical product titles; they also appear in long runs of spaces in emails, code copyright comments, and medical terminology. Commonality is weak, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Initial or internal subwords in proper names
patterns.context: Personal names, place names, nationalities, and event names are split into multiple subword tokens; often accompanied by numbers, titles, or category words.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on people, elections, and sports

patterns.name: Year and entry-title formatting
patterns.context: A year or title is followed by a blank line or line break, reflecting encyclopedia entry-title and section formatting.

patterns.name: Long runs of spaces
patterns.context: Long sequences of whitespace appear in email bodies or formatted text, followed by a line break and link description.

patterns.name: Software product names and repeated titles
patterns.context: A product name appears as a title and is repeated at the start of the body text after the title.

patterns.name: Source-code copyright notice
patterns.context: A copyright holder and year range follow a comment marker at the start of a line, with more comment lines afterward.

patterns.name: Date–person–biography entries
patterns.context: Lists people by date and gives their occupation, tenure, or year of death, separated by dashes.

patterns.name: Medical disease and complication terminology
patterns.context: Disease names and their complications appear in statements about health burdens.

patterns.name: Titles and ordinal formatting
patterns.context: An ordinal, noble title, and regional title follow a name.

11_413.concept: 多样文本中的结构化专名与格式
11_413.description: 激活分布于百科标题与专名、人物头衔和年表、技术产品标题，也包括邮件长空格、代码版权注释及医学术语；共同点较弱，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的词首或内部子词
patterns.context: 人名、地名、国籍或赛事名称等专名被拆成多个子词 token；常伴随数字、头衔或类别词。
patterns.domain: 百科人物、选举、体育条目

patterns.name: 年份与条目标题格式
patterns.context: 年份或标题后接空行、换行，呈现百科条目标题及章节格式。

patterns.name: 大量连续空格
patterns.context: 长串空白在邮件正文或格式化文本中连续出现，后接换行和链接说明。

patterns.name: 软件产品名及重复标题
patterns.context: 产品名作为标题出现，并在标题后再次以正文开头复现。

patterns.name: 源代码版权声明
patterns.context: 行首注释符后写版权人和年份范围，随后仍是注释行。

patterns.name: 日期—人物—生平条目
patterns.context: 按日期列出人物及职业、任职或去世年份，使用破折号分隔。

patterns.name: 医学疾病及并发症术语
patterns.context: 疾病名称及其并发症出现在关于健康负担的陈述中。

patterns.name: 头衔与序数格式
patterns.context: 姓名后附序数、贵族头衔及地域称号。

en.description: Strongly responds to the sentence-initial token “In”: one pattern opens patent background sentences, while another combines with “hibition of” to form the biomedical title phrase “Inhibition of”.

patterns.name: Opening of a patent background paragraph
patterns.context: Sentence-initial “In” introduces background descriptions, followed by discussion of mechanical design, communication networks, digital maps, or computer networks

patterns.name: Titles beginning with “Inhibition of”
patterns.context: “Inhibition” is split into the two tokens “In” and “hibition”, followed by the process, target, or object being inhibited
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles or abstract openings

11_413.concept: 句首“In”
11_413.description: 对句首 token“In”反应强：一类开启专利背景句，另一类与“hibition of”相连，组成“Inhibition of”这一生物医学标题短语。

patterns.name: 专利背景段落开头
patterns.trigger: «In»，常接“the construction of”“conventional communication networks”或“recent years”
patterns.context: 句首以“In”引入背景描述，后续讲述机械设计、通信网络、数字地图或计算机网络

patterns.name: 以“Inhibition of”开头的标题
patterns.context: “Inhibition”被拆分成“In”与“hibition”两个 token，后接被抑制的过程、靶点或对象
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要开头

en.description: The most stable cue is sentence-initial «Either», which introduces alternatives in formal text; other highlights are scattered across patent titles, scientific-term subwords, and common function words, with no consistent semantics. Paragraphs 2, 4, and 8 lack «Either»; the source of their activations is unclear.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Either
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a new sentence or after a transition, followed by an alternative, experimental condition, or result; this marker appears in all ten excerpts, but the following content varies.
patterns.domain: Formal genres such as academic papers, patents, and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Sentence boundary before Either
patterns.context: Either follows a complete statement, often introducing another possibility after the preceding sentence ends with a period; some excerpts show a complete period before Either, while others have a comma or truncated text.

patterns.name: Patent section headings and formatting
patterns.context: Numbered section headings in patent background sections and their title-style capitalization; although Either also appears in the same excerpt, the headings themselves may be additional local triggers.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in scientific terms
patterns.context: Subword fragments in terms or proper nouns across multiple disciplines; they are scattered, with no shared semantics or stable morphological pattern, and may reflect independent weak patterns or contextual coincidence.
patterns.domain: Physics, patents, biomedicine, military, and other scientific texts

patterns.name: Function and structural words in academic prose
patterns.context: These words appear in complex formal statements, method descriptions, or noun phrases; they are also often unmarked, so they cannot explain high activations on their own and may be influenced by local collocations or syntactic position.

11_413.concept: 句首 Either 引出的备选项
11_413.description: 最稳定的线索是句首 «Either»，用于正式文本中提出备选情形；其余高亮分散于专利标题、科学术语子词及常见功能词，缺少一致语义。第2、4、8段没有 «Either»，其激活来源不明。

patterns.name: 句首 Either
patterns.context: 作为新句或转折后的句首，后接备选情形、实验条件或结果；该标记在十段中全部出现，紧邻的后续内容各不相同。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利及生物医学摘要等正式文体

patterns.name: Either 前的句界
patterns.trigger: 句号、问号或句子边界后接 «Either»
patterns.context: Either 位于完整陈述之后，常以句号结束前句后继续提出另一种情形；部分段落在 Either 前可见完整句号，部分截取处为逗号或截断文本。

patterns.name: 专利章节标题与格式
patterns.context: 专利背景部分的编号章节标题及其标题式大小写格式；虽同段也有 Either，但标题自身可能构成额外局部触发。

patterns.name: 科学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 多种学科术语或专名中的子词片段；它们分布零散，未见共同语义或稳定词形规律，可能是独立的弱模式或上下文偶然。
patterns.domain: 物理、专利、生物医学、军事及其他科学文本

patterns.name: 学术文体中的功能词与结构词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在复杂的正式陈述、方法描述或名词短语中；它们也大量未标记，不能单独解释高激活，可能受局部搭配或句法位置影响。

en.description: Activations occur across code punctuation, script variables, type definitions, comments, legal judgments and litigation titles, old-book dedications, and poetry collection contents; the common cue is unclear and may involve boundaries and formatting fragments in structured text.

patterns.name: Carriage returns/separators at the end of commands or methods
patterns.context: Activations often fall near the end of code statements, blocks, or functions, accompanied by line breaks, indentation, or punctuation; however, similar tokens also occur in non-code text.

patterns.name: Litigation relations and judicial wording in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in court docket titles or judgment text, involving parties, witnesses, motions, and rulings.

patterns.name: Echo commands and path variables in shell scripts
patterns.context: A shell script echoes a path concatenated from date and directory variables; paragraph 10 also contains «@echo off».

patterns.name: Names and institutions in book dedications
patterns.context: A copyright or dedication page lists the dedicatee and religious titles or institutions.

patterns.name: Titles, authors, and page numbers in poetry contents
patterns.context: Contents-style formatting, with poem titles, author names, and page numbers separated by spaces or underscores.

patterns.name: Type aliases and time-unit definitions
patterns.context: A C++ code block defines a type alias for a clock structure and a duration.

patterns.name: Login method comments and exception declarations
patterns.context: A PHP-style method comment describes login functionality, parameters, and exceptions.

patterns.name: State fields in Angular controllers
patterns.context: A JavaScript controller initializes scope properties and sets default values.

11_413.concept: 结构化文本边界
11_413.description: 激活分布于代码标点、脚本变量、类型定义、注释和法律判决、诉讼标题、旧书题献及诗集目录；共同线索不明确，可能偏向结构化文本中的边界与排版片段。

patterns.name: 命令或方法结束处的回车/分隔符
patterns.context: 激活常落在代码语句、块或函数结束附近，并伴随换行、缩进或标点；但同类 token 也出现在非代码文本中。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的诉讼关系与裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: «Appellee»、«against»、«The child in question»、«principal witness»、«petitions for rehearing»、«are denied»
patterns.context: 出现在法院案卷标题或判决正文中，涉及当事人、证人、申请及裁判结果。

patterns.name: 命令行脚本中的回显与路径变量
patterns.context: shell 脚本中回显由日期和目录变量拼接的路径；第10段也出现 «@echo off»。

patterns.name: 书籍题献中的身份与机构名称
patterns.context: 版权页或题献页列出受献者及宗教职衔、机构。

patterns.name: 诗歌目录中的标题、作者与页码
patterns.context: 目录式排版，诗题、作者姓名和页码以空格或下划线分隔。

patterns.name: 类型别名与时间单位定义
patterns.context: C++ 代码块中定义时钟结构体的类型别名及 duration。

patterns.name: 登录方法注释与异常声明
patterns.context: PHP 风格方法注释说明登录功能、参数及异常。

patterns.name: Angular 控制器中的状态字段
patterns.context: JavaScript 控制器初始化作用域属性并设置默认值。

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal document formatting, document references, code errors and assertions, commitments to work effort, contract disclaimers, energy-market text, and biomedical research; they span many fields, with no single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Date and case-number formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears at the top of a court document, where dates, filing/ruling information, and case numbers are formatted with aligned spaces and line breaks.

patterns.name: Document contents, page numbers, and cross-references
patterns.context: Describes where a section appears in the contents, mentioning page numbers, section order, or misplaced citations.

patterns.name: Error handling and assertions in code
patterns.context: Appears in code involving connection-failure messages, error objects, or test assertions.

patterns.name: Project effort, commitment, and work returns
patterns.context: Discusses how much work or time to invest, fulfilling commitments, and the resulting returns or arrangements.

patterns.name: Contract disclaimers and data warranties
patterns.context: Contract-style clauses disclaim express or implied representations or warranties about data.

patterns.name: Energy markets, prices, and trading periods
patterns.context: Involves energy price paths, models, forward curves, trading periods, or electricity costs and rates.

patterns.name: Research objectives and biological parameters
patterns.context: States a research objective and identifies parameters controlling a biological process.

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 激活分布于法律文书版式、文档引用、代码错误与断言、工作投入承诺、合同免责声明、能源市场文本及生物医学研究；跨多领域，无单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 法律文书日期与案号版式
patterns.context: 出现在法院文书页首，日期、提交/裁决信息和案号以对齐空格及换行排版。

patterns.name: 文档目录、页码与交叉引用
patterns.context: 说明某个章节在目录中的位置，提及页码、章节次序或引用放置不当。

patterns.name: 代码中的错误处理与断言
patterns.context: 出现在代码中，涉及连接失败提示、错误对象，或测试断言。

patterns.name: 项目投入、承诺与工作回报
patterns.context: 谈论投入多少工作或时间、履行承诺，以及由此带来的回报或安排。

patterns.name: 合同免责声明与数据保证
patterns.context: 合同式条款否认对数据作明示或默示的陈述、保证。

patterns.name: 能源市场、价格与交易期限
patterns.context: 涉及能源价格路径、模型、远期曲线、交易期限或电费及费率。

patterns.name: 科研目标与生物学参数
patterns.context: 陈述研究目标，识别控制某种生物过程的参数。

en.description: Activations show several local patterns: constituents following its, sentence-initial The, fragments of proper nouns or identifiers, and template numbers and layout words; several semantically unrelated sporadic words cannot be grouped under a unified rule.

patterns.name: Nouns or noun phrases following its
patterns.context: The word or phrase immediately after “its” is marked; noun phrases, negation structures, and possessive structures all occur, with no stable semantic requirement.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: everyday narrative, spiritual writing, sports, technology, astronomy, business, etc.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or word-initial fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on proper nouns, identifiers, or initial fragments of split words; subsequent text continues the word or name.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, spiritual prose, code, web templates

patterns.name: Sentence-initial The
patterns.context: The article The appears at the beginning of a paragraph or sentence; the subject or noun phrase follows the activation point.
patterns.domain: Popular science explanations, business arguments, statistical commentary

patterns.name: Template numbers and grid-layout terms
patterns.context: Appears in explanations of numbered steps and web-template file paths.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on general words and code variables
patterns.context: These activations occur in different semantic and syntactic environments; the samples do not reveal a shared, specific trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Everyday narrative, spiritual prose, code, business writing

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 激活呈多种局部模式：its 后续成分、句首 The、专名或标识符片段，以及模板编号和布局词；另有若干语义迥异的零散词，无法归为统一规则。

patterns.name: its 后接名词或名词短语
patterns.trigger: «its»（如“its dark”“its arrival”“its departure”“its higher frequency”“its wasn’t”“its supermassive”“its host galaxy’s”）
patterns.context: “its”后紧邻的词或词组被标记；名词性成分、否定结构及所有格结构均有，未见稳定的语义要求。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：日常叙述、灵性文字、体育、科技、天文学、商务等

patterns.name: 专名或词首片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、标识符或被切分的词的开头片段；后续文本继续补全该词或名称。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、灵性散文、代码、网页模板

patterns.name: 句首 The
patterns.context: 段落或句子开头出现冠词 The；激活点之后继续陈述主语或名词短语。
patterns.domain: 科普说明、商务论述、统计评论

patterns.name: 模板编号与网格布局语汇
patterns.context: 位于编号步骤及网页模板文件路径的说明中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答／模板配置

patterns.name: 通用词与代码变量等零散激活
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在不同语义和句法环境中，无法从样本确认共同的特定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、灵性散文、代码、商务文字

en.concept: Note markers and sporadic vocabulary triggers
en.description: The most stable local trigger for strong activations is the sentence-initial explanatory marker Note (with a colon or that); other activations are scattered across story behind, cognition/doubt words, medical injury terms, and isolated examples in spiritual writing and IRC, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or in-sentence explanatory marker Note
patterns.context: The trigger is Note and its following punctuation when introducing an inference, explanation, or code documentation note; [3] is followed by a that-clause, [4] by a that-clause, and [6][9] by a colon.
patterns.domain: General articles, code comments, and technical documentation

patterns.name: story in references to a story or background
patterns.context: When questioning or commenting on someone’s experience or circumstances, story is followed by behind this, meaning the underlying reason.

patterns.name: Descriptions of health and nerve injury
patterns.context: Several words in medical descriptions activate in discussions of physical injury, innervation, and muscle symptoms.

patterns.name: Cognition- or confirmation-related expressions
patterns.context: Appears in expressions of knowing, questioning, or realizing; collocations and syntax vary, with no shared fixed local phrase.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony reported in prose, macroeconomics articles, fiction

patterns.name: Spiritual expressions about frequency and energy
