patterns.context: These words activate near the end of a passage about harmonizing life energy with love and light and producing high-frequency effects.

patterns.name: Spanish-language disk-information context
patterns.context: A Spanish IRC conversation discusses disk information; higher activation falls on informacion, with no phrase around it that is notably shared with the other excerpts.

patterns.name: Expressions of awareness and contact in fiction
patterns.context: In a fictional narrative, personified it is unaware that it has previously had contact with someone; this is somewhat semantically related to the cognition words in [3][7], but the context differs.

11_413.concept: 说明标记及零散词汇触发
11_413.description: 强激活最稳定的局部触发是句首说明词 Note（含冒号或 that）；其余分散于 story behind、认知／质疑词、医学损伤术语，以及灵性文、IRC等孤例，未见统一语义或句法规律。

patterns.name: 句首或句中说明标记 Note
patterns.context: 在提出推论、解释或代码文档说明时，触发词 Note 及其后的标点；[3] 后接 that 从句，[4] 后接 that 从句，[6][9] 后接冒号。
patterns.domain: 一般文章、代码注释及技术说明

patterns.name: 故事或来历的 story
patterns.context: 在质疑或评论某人经历、处境时，story 后接 behind this，表示背后缘由。

patterns.name: 健康与神经损伤描述
patterns.context: 讨论身体损伤、神经支配和肌肉症状时，对医学描述中的若干词有激活。

patterns.name: 认知或确认相关表达
patterns.context: 出现在表示知道、质疑或意识到的表达中；搭配和句法各异，未见共同的固定局部短语。
patterns.domain: 法律庭审转述、宏观经济文章、小说叙述

patterns.name: 频率与能量的灵性表述
patterns.context: 谈论以爱与光调和生命能量、并产生高频率影响时，段尾附近激活这些词。

patterns.name: 西班牙语磁盘信息语境
patterns.context: 西班牙语 IRC 对话中谈及磁盘信息；较高激活落在 informacion，周围没有与其他段显著相同的词组。

patterns.name: 小说中的认识与接触表达
patterns.context: 小说叙述中，拟人化的 it 没有意识到自己曾与某人接触；与[3][7]的认知词有一定词义联系，但语境不同。

en.concept: Common words and local text structures
en.description: Activations are scattered across genres: they often occur on “the” and sentence-initial “Some of” constructions; they also appear in patent phrases like “overcome the …”, the literary sentence-final “denied”, periods in legal citations, and an internal fragment of inform. Other highlighted spans lack stable common semantics.

patterns.name: Highlighting after “the”
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the article “the” in sentences or fixed phrases, but its position and collocations are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Prose across fields, including technical and legal texts

patterns.name: Overcoming existing shortcomings
patterns.context: Patent backgrounds describe flaws in existing approaches or problems caused by surgery, then introduce problems a new approach must overcome; strong activation centers on “the”.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Some of the
patterns.context: A sentence or clause begins with “Some of …” to introduce a subset; the peak falls on “of”, followed by a possessive or “the”.
patterns.domain: Academic reviews, medical abstracts, news/web articles

patterns.name: Negation and emphatic let it be denied
patterns.context: In literary, aphoristic sentences, emphasizes that truth cannot be denied; activations fall on “denied”.

patterns.name: L.Ed. in legal citations
patterns.context: An abbreviation for a legal reporter in a court opinion citation; activation falls on the period in the abbreviation.

patterns.name: Highlighted fragments of inform
patterns.context: Activations fall on substrings or token boundaries in inform, appearing in “inform​er” and “informally”; the two examples have no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Local activations not covered by the patterns above
patterns.context: These spans alone do not support a more reliable common trigger condition than local collocations or genre.
patterns.domain: Literature, philosophical reviews, medicine, web articles, and patents

11_413.concept: 常见词与局部文本结构
11_413.description: 激活分散于多种文体：常见于“the”，以及句首“Some of”结构；也出现在专利“overcome the …”、文学句末“denied”、法律引注句点和 inform 的词内片段。其余高亮缺乏稳定共同语义。

patterns.name: “the”后的高亮
patterns.context: 激活常落在句中或固定搭配里的冠词“the”，但其位置和搭配并不统一。
patterns.domain: 多领域散文及技术、法律文本

patterns.name: 克服既有缺点
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述现有方案的缺陷或手术造成的问题，并引出新方案需要克服的问题；强激活集中于“the”。

patterns.name: 句首 Some of the
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头以“Some of …”引出部分对象，峰值落在“of”，后接所有格或“the”。
patterns.domain: 学术评论、医学摘要、新闻／网络文章

patterns.name: 否定与强调性 let it be denied
patterns.context: 文学性、格言式句子中，强调真理不可被否认；激活落在“denied”。

patterns.name: 法律引注中的 L.Ed.
patterns.context: 法院判决引文中的法律报告简称，激活落在缩写的句点。

patterns.name: 高亮 inform 的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 inform 的子串或分词边界，分别出现在“inform​er”和“informally”中；两例上下文没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 未能归入上述模式的局部激活
patterns.trigger: «right»、«truth»、«denied»等上下文中的散布激活（[2]）；«principle»、«unassailable»、«Some»等（[6]）；«efficacy»及相关句子成分（[7]）；«productive»、«collaborative»、«innovative»等（[8]）；专利与医学文本中未与“the”搭配的零散标记（[1]、[4]、[5]）
patterns.context: 仅凭这些片段无法建立比局部搭配或文体更可靠的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 文学、哲学评论、医学、网络文章、专利

en.description: Activations span texts from many domains and are scattered across words, phrases, and subwords that vary in semantics and form; the available samples are insufficient to infer a reliable shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Local activations on specific words or subwords
patterns.context: Trigger positions and neighboring phrases differ substantially across excerpts; no consistent morphological form, grammatical position, or stable contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including legal texts, medical papers, philosophy, literature, and parliamentary texts

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 激活跨多领域文本，分散在语义和词形各异的词语、短语及子词上；现有样本不足以归纳可靠的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 特定词语或子词的局部激活
patterns.trigger: 高亮分布于不同词类与子词，如 “Among the latter”“upper chambers”“The bliss of Being”“hidden profoundness”“inflammatory influences”“interrogatories”“dat[i] commerciali”“приоритетите”
patterns.context: 各段触发位置及相邻词组差异很大；看不出一致的词形、语法位置或稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学论文、哲学、文学、议会文本等多种文体

en.concept: Polysemous word fragments and formal texts
en.description: Activations span sacred impulses and descriptions of inner depths in literature, as well as indicia, interrogatories, and no error in law; they also appear in patent symbols and biomedical experiment titles, and cannot be explained by a single obvious word sense.

patterns.name: Sacred impulse or duty
patterns.context: Associated with first-person moral or spiritual motives involving felt experience, inner feeling, the need to protest, or testing others; “sacred” is followed by an abstract duty or impulse.

patterns.name: Indicia in law
patterns.context: Legal arguments discuss evidence, credibility, or possible grounds for a claim; in the examples, indicia is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Interrogatories in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Court orders, trials, or records refer to written questions submitted to or handled by parties; often near procedural terms such as jury, transcript, and affidavits.

patterns.name: Findings of error in legal decisions
patterns.context: Appellate review evaluates a lower court’s ruling or handling, followed by the specific matter decided.

patterns.name: Inmost soul and hidden inner life
patterns.context: Literary contexts depict characters exploring or examining their own souls, secrets, and inner depths.

patterns.name: Indicia in patent text
patterns.context: A game device displays symbols or markers based on a random outcome and uses them to determine a reward; the text also discusses other technical details.

patterns.name: Experimental-methods section title
patterns.context: Appears as a subsection title in a paper’s Methods section, immediately followed by descriptions of experimental materials and procedures; no clear lexical trigger is evident here.

11_413.concept: 多义词片段与正式文本
11_413.description: 激活覆盖文学中的神圣冲动与内在深处描写，以及法律中的 indicia、interrogatories 和 no error；另见专利符号标记与生物医学实验标题，无法由单一明显词义解释。

patterns.name: 神圣冲动或责任
patterns.context: 与 felt、心中感受、必须表达抗议或检验他人等第一人称道德/精神动机相连；“sacred”后接抽象义务或冲动。

patterns.name: 法律中的 indicia
patterns.context: 法律论证中谈证据、可信度或主张的可能依据；在例句里 indicia 被拆成多个 token。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的 interrogatories
patterns.context: 法院命令、审判或记录中提及向当事方提交/处理的书面询问；常邻近 jury、transcript、affidavits 等程序词。

patterns.name: 法律裁判中的错误认定
patterns.context: 上诉审查对下级法院裁决或处理方式作出评价，后接具体裁判事项。

patterns.name: 灵魂深处与隐秘内在
patterns.context: 描写人物探索或剖析自身灵魂、秘密和内在深处的文学语境。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的 indicia
patterns.context: 游戏装置依据随机结果显示符号或标记，并据此决定奖励；与其他技术细节相连。

patterns.name: 实验方法章节标题
patterns.context: 作为论文方法部分的小节标题，紧接实验材料和操作描述；该处没有明显的词汇触发证据。

en.concept: Prominent word fragments in legal documents and miscellaneous items
en.description: Responds primarily and strongly to interrogatories in U.S. legal texts, with sporadic responses to legal terminology, courtroom dialogue, and injury clauses; other examples include impulses in literature, descriptions of health damage, and HTML/Latin fragments.

patterns.name: interrogatories in court proceedings
patterns.context: Appears in litigation texts such as court orders, special jury questions, or party responses; often adjacent to transcript, affidavits, answer, and similar terms.

patterns.name: indicia in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in judicial discussion of whether to hold an evidentiary hearing and whether the defendant can show that the request has a possible basis.

patterns.name: colloquy in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Appears in quoted dialogue between a defendant and a court, discussing whether a guilty plea was knowing and voluntary.

patterns.name: Moral or spiritual impulses
patterns.context: In passages about Socrates testing others through divine impulse, or motivating the publication and verification of ideas.

patterns.name: Mental and health damage
patterns.context: Describes the negative effects of drinking or similar things on a person’s health, nervous state, and behavior.

patterns.name: Legal clauses on harming children
patterns.context: Lists parents, guardians, or caregivers who intentionally cause or allow children to suffer physical, mental, or emotional harm.

patterns.name: HTML tags and Latin fragments
patterns.context: HTML page source containing an incomplete or split Latin sentence.

11_413.concept: 法律文书中的显著词片段及杂项
11_413.description: 主要在美国法律文本中强烈响应 interrogatories，并零星响应法律术语、审理对话和伤害条款；另见文学中的冲动、健康损害描写及HTML/拉丁文片段。

patterns.name: 法院书面程序中的 interrogatories
patterns.context: 出现在法院命令、陪审团特别问题或当事人答复等诉讼程序文本中；常与 transcript、affidavits、answer 等相邻。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 indicia
patterns.context: 出现在讨论是否举行 evidentiary hearing、被告能否证明请求具有可能依据的司法论述中。

patterns.name: 法律审理中的 colloquy
patterns.context: 出现在对被告与法院之间对话的引述，讨论认罪是否知情、自愿。

patterns.name: 道德或精神冲动
patterns.context: 在谈苏格拉底以神圣冲动检验他人、或推动发表和验证观念的论述中。

patterns.name: 精神与健康损害
patterns.context: 描述饮酒或类似事物对人的健康、神经状态与行为的负面影响。

patterns.name: 伤害儿童的法律条款
patterns.context: 列举父母、监护人或照护者故意造成或允许儿童受到身体、精神或情绪伤害。

patterns.name: HTML 标签与拉丁文片段
patterns.context: HTML 页面源码中夹有未完成或被拆分的拉丁文句子。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页内容/标记语言

en.description: Activations occur in court-procedure terminology, legal authority and citations, literary sacred-impulse and slavery imagery, medical discussions of hearing and language, spiritual-healing statements, and fragments in Latin-like pseudo-text; no stable semantic trigger spans all examples.

patterns.name: “interrogatories” in court documents
patterns.context: Appears in procedural legal contexts involving questions submitted to a jury, court records, or a supplemental transcript.

patterns.name: Legal powers in a legal phrase
patterns.context: Describes statutes or constitutional arguments limiting the president’s legal powers.

patterns.name: Number ranges in legal citations
patterns.context: Page numbers or volume-page ranges in case citations.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Latin-like pseudo-text
patterns.context: Latin placeholder text; activations occur within spelling fragments, with no stable semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: The collocation Sacred impulse
patterns.context: Recounts Socrates being driven by a sacred impulse to test others.

patterns.name: The iron yoke image
patterns.context: Depicts the heavy, cruel oppression of enslavement.

patterns.name: Hearing and language risks in premature infants
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between NICU noise, limited language exposure, and hearing/language disorders.

patterns.name: Spiritual healing and suffering souls
patterns.context: Describes healing others’ hearts and souls through love, light, and spiritual energy.

11_413.concept: 无统一概念
11_413.description: 激活分布在法院程序术语、法律权力与引注、文学中的神圣冲动和奴役意象、医学听觉语言讨论、灵性疗愈语句及拉丁伪文词片中；未见一个贯穿全部片段的稳定语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 法院文件中的“interrogatories”
patterns.context: 出现在陪审团提交问题、法院记录或补充 transcript 的程序性法律语境中

patterns.name: 法律短语中的 legal powers
patterns.context: 描述国会限制总统法律权力的法条或宪法论述

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字范围
patterns.context: 判例引注中的页码或卷页范围

patterns.name: 拉丁文伪文中的词片
patterns.context: 拉丁文占位文本，激活分布在拼写片段内部，未见稳定语义触发词

patterns.name: Sacred impulse 搭配
patterns.context: 叙述苏格拉底受神圣冲动驱使去考验他人

patterns.name: iron yoke 意象
patterns.context: 描写奴役带来的沉重、残酷压迫

patterns.name: 早产儿听觉与语言风险
patterns.trigger: « auditory»4« system»...« NICU»...« speech»4« and»1« language»1
patterns.context: 讨论 NICU 噪声、有限语言暴露与听觉／语言障碍的关系

patterns.name: 灵性疗愈与受苦灵魂
patterns.context: 以爱、光和灵性能量疗愈他人的心灵与灵魂

en.description: Activations often occur on subword fragments created by splitting words into tokens, across literature, legal text, pseudo-Latin placeholder text, and code; legal passages also cluster around judicial terminology, while code passages highlight Fill identifiers. The semantic themes are not unified.

patterns.name: Within-word subword boundaries and continuations
patterns.context: Activations often fall on fragments of words split into multiple tokens, especially word-medial or subsequent subwords; however, not all within-word splits are equally strong, and this alone cannot explain all examples.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, including Latin placeholder text, legal text, prose, and code

patterns.name: Legal procedure and adjudication terminology
patterns.context: Appears in contexts related to court rulings or arbitration, discussing the right to counsel, evidence, arbitrator authority, or written jury questions; activations occur on terms and nearby within-word fragments.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, statutes, or judicial procedure texts

patterns.name: Word fragments in Latin placeholder text
patterns.context: In continuous pseudo-Latin placeholder passages, many words are split into subword tokens; prominent activations include «placer», «er», and are not limited to legal or specific semantic content.
patterns.domain: StackExchange example code or placeholder text

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Gutenberg prose
patterns.context: In narrative or rhetorical prose, activations fall on ordinary words, within-word splits, or adjacent fragments; the passages have varied topics and cannot be grouped under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Fill fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: In YAML-style configuration fields, identifiers repeatedly contain Fill, with activations concentrated on the identifier's subword fragments.

11_413.concept: 词内子词片段响应
11_413.description: 激活多出现在词内拆分的子词片段，跨文学、法律、伪拉丁占位文本和代码；法律段落还聚集司法术语，代码段突出 Fill 标识符。各语义主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 词内子词边界与续接
patterns.trigger: 多个片段在词内切分处激活，如 «pl»2«acer»10«at»5、«interrog»9«atories»3、«mis»3«behavior»3、«persever«ing»4
patterns.context: 激活常落在一个词被拆成多个 token 的片段上，尤其是词中部或后续子词；但并非所有词内切分都同样强，无法单独解释全部例子。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，含拉丁占位文本、法律文本、散文及代码

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁判术语
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或仲裁相关语境，讨论辩护权、证据、仲裁员权限或陪审团书面问题；激活分布在术语及其附近的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法条或司法程序文本

patterns.name: 拉丁占位文本中的词片段
patterns.context: 在连续的伪拉丁占位段落中，大量词被拆为子词 token；显著激活包括 «placer»、«er»，并不局限于法律或特定语义。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 示例代码或占位文本

patterns.name: Gutenberg散文中的词内片段
patterns.context: 在叙事或修辞性散文中，激活落在普通词、词内切分或相邻片段上；这些段落主题各异，不能归为同一语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 Fill 片段
patterns.context: YAML 风格配置字段中，标识符反复包含 Fill，激活集中在该标识符的子词片段。
patterns.domain: GitHub 配置或序列化代码

en.description: Activations cover courts, cases, jurisdiction, and rights-and-obligations language in legal opinions; they also occur in promises/relationship termination, sacred inner drive, sharp penetrating imagery, HTML and Latin, and German/Dutch ecological parliamentary texts. No single part of speech or topic explains them all.

patterns.name: Adjudicative and legal language in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions, case facts, or discussions of legal rights, often near formal wording about adjudication, jurisdiction, review, or legal relationships.

patterns.name: Continuity, performance, and obligations
patterns.context: Triggers occur in expressions about promises, permanently ending a relationship, or imposing obligations; examples involve land returns, termination of parental rights, and legal duties.

patterns.name: Sacred impulse and inner drive
patterns.context: Discusses a sacred mission or inner drive, with an example of a person being moved to test others.

patterns.name: Sharpness, penetration, and bodily interior imagery
patterns.context: Metaphorical sentences describe something as sharper, able to penetrate and divide soul from spirit or body parts.

patterns.name: HTML markup and Latin strings
patterns.context: Webpage HTML tags, indentation, and embedded Latin placeholder or body text appear together; activations occur on markup and internal word subwords.

patterns.name: German/Dutch ecological issues and names
patterns.context: Appears in cross-tokenized German/Dutch parliamentary text discussing environmental organizations, inquiry documents, and Lithuanian members of parliament.

11_413.concept: 正式文本中的高显著措辞
11_413.description: 激活覆盖法律判决中的法院、案件、管辖权与权利义务措辞，也见于承诺／终止关系、神圣内在驱动、锋利穿透意象、HTML与拉丁文，以及德荷语生态议会文本；并无单一词类或主题能解释全部。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的裁判与法律措辞
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见、案件事实或法律权利讨论中，常与裁判、管辖权、审查或法律关系等正式措辞相邻。

patterns.name: 持续、履行与义务
patterns.context: 触发点落在承诺、永久终止关系或施加义务等表达中；分别涉及土地回报、亲权终止和法律义务。

patterns.name: 神圣冲动与内在驱动
patterns.context: 讨论神圣使命或内心驱动力，并以人物受其推动、去检验他人为例。
patterns.domain: 文学、哲学或宗教性散文

patterns.name: 锋利、穿透及身体内部意象
patterns.context: 在比喻性句子中描写某物更锋利、能穿透并分开灵魂与精神或身体部位。

patterns.name: HTML 标记与拉丁文字符串
patterns.context: 网页 HTML 标签、缩进和嵌入的拉丁文占位或正文同时出现；激活分布在标记和词内子词上。

patterns.name: 德语／荷兰语生态议题与姓名
patterns.context: 出现在跨词片段化的德语／荷兰语议会文本中，谈及生态组织、调查文件和立陶宛议员。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal wording, markup code, conjunctions in scripture, and pseudo-Latin text; more prominent local features include full, legal terminology, and statutory fragments, without a unified semantic or stable morphological pattern.

patterns.name: Emphatic adjective full
patterns.context: Used as an adjective in a noun phrase, modifying a following noun; the following noun varies across passages.

patterns.name: Expressions of full extent or completeness in legal text
patterns.context: Appears in “full panoply of constitutional rights,” meaning a complete range of rights.

patterns.name: Parallel categories of children's physical and mental health in legal text
patterns.context: A statutory provision lists categories of children's health; the strongest activations in this passage fall on physical and emotional.

patterns.name: Emphasis on case in a legal ruling
patterns.context: Appears in “Every case before this Court thus far,” referring to cases heard by the court.

patterns.name: Emphasis on legal precedent in a legal ruling
patterns.context: Appears in “any legal precedent,” describing precedent; other nearby words are also activated.

patterns.name: Fragments of statutory citation numbers in legal quotations
patterns.context: Appears in a statutory citation establishing jurisdiction, with activations on fragments of the number.

patterns.name: HTML class names and inheritance anchors
patterns.context: Appears in HTML list tags and anchor attributes pointing to inherited classes, forming code/markup fragments.

patterns.name: And in religious scripture
patterns.context: Connects preceding and following phrases in the parallel structure of a long scripture-like sentence.

patterns.name: Aliqu in Latin placeholder text
patterns.context: Appears in a pseudo-Latin placeholder passage, where words are split into subword tokens.

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 激活分散在法律措辞、标记代码、经文连接词及伪拉丁文本中；较突出的局部包括 full、法律术语与法条片段，缺乏统一语义或稳定词形模式。

patterns.name: full 前置强调词
patterns.context: 作为名词短语中的形容词，修饰后续名词；后续名词在不同段落中不同。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的全量/完整范围表述
patterns.context: 出现在“full panoply of constitutional rights”中，表示完整的一系列权利。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的儿童身心健康并列
patterns.context: 法规条文列举儿童健康类别；此段最强激活落在 physical 与 emotional。

patterns.name: 法律判决中 case 的强调
patterns.context: 出现在“Every case before this Court thus far”中，指法院审理的案件。

patterns.name: 法律判决中 legal precedent 的强调
patterns.context: 出现在“any legal precedent”中，描述先例；其余近邻词也有激活。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的法条编号碎片
patterns.context: 出现在管辖权依据的法条引用中，激活落在编号片段。

patterns.name: HTML 类名与继承锚点
patterns.context: HTML 列表标签和指向继承类的锚点属性中出现，呈现代码/标记语言碎片。

patterns.name: 宗教经文中的 and
patterns.context: 在经文式长句的并列结构中，连接前后短语。

patterns.name: 拉丁语占位文本中的 aliqu
patterns.context: 出现在伪拉丁占位段落中，词语被子词切分。

en.concept: Heterogeneous features, including legal authority and multilingual word fragments
en.description: Activations span religious prose, U.S. legal arguments, EU multilingual texts, and literary narrative; several peaks fall on legal-authority words, scriptural language, or fragments within split European-language words, with no single stable semantics explaining all passages.

patterns.name: Emphatic adjectives in theology
patterns.context: Modifies concepts such as impulse, hope, or God in religious narrative or scripture.

patterns.name: Case-law authority in legal arguments
patterns.context: Arguments concern courts, precedent, legal questions, or statutory authority, often alongside words such as “this Court”, “before”, and “statutory”.
patterns.domain: U.S. judicial opinions and legal texts

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in European Parliament multilingual text
patterns.context: Dutch, German, and other EU parliamentary texts; high activations fall on internal fragments of split words, with no consistent meaning or grammatical function.

patterns.name: Words for moral corruption in biblical style
patterns.context: Christian scripture describes sins and includes nearby expressions about redemption and cleansing.

patterns.name: Words describing legal terms or case strength
patterns.context: Legal texts discuss funds authorized by Congress or legal arguments; specific triggers are scattered, with no stable shared semantics.

patterns.name: Positive appraisals of diligence and perseverance
patterns.context: Describes honest, hard-working, persistent pioneers and rhetoric about land keeping its promises.

patterns.name: Narrative about impulses and ideas
patterns.context: Recounts Socrates being driven by a sacred impulse to test others; strong activations mainly concentrate on “sacred”.

11_413.concept: 法律权威与多语词片段等异质特征
11_413.description: 激活跨越宗教散文、美国法律论证、欧盟多语文本及文学叙述；若干峰值落在法律权威词、经文用语或被拆分的欧洲语言词片段上，未见单一稳定语义能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 神学中的强调性形容词
patterns.context: 宗教叙述或经文中，修饰冲动、希望、上帝等概念

patterns.name: 法律论证中的判例权威
patterns.context: 围绕法院、判例、法律问题或法定权限展开论证，常伴随“this Court”“before”“statutory”等词
patterns.domain: 美国司法意见与法律文本

patterns.name: 欧洲议会多语文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语、德语等欧盟议会文本；高激活落在被拆分词的内部片段，未见一致的词义或语法功能

patterns.name: 圣经语体中的道德败坏词
patterns.context: 基督教经文中描述罪行，并与救赎、洁净等表达相邻

patterns.name: 描述法律术语或案件强弱的词
patterns.context: 法律文本中讨论国会授权的资金或法律论据；具体触发分散，未见稳定的共同语义

patterns.name: 勤勉与坚守的正面评价
patterns.context: 描写诚实、辛勤、坚持的拓荒者，以及土地兑现承诺的修辞

patterns.name: 冲动与观念的叙述
patterns.context: 叙述苏格拉底受神圣冲动驱使去试探他人；强激活主要集中在“sacred”

en.concept: Legal terminology and authority across multiple domains
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in legal text, especially authority, jurisdiction, obligations, case-record facts, precedent authority, and judicial documents; other examples include courtroom questions and answers, Latin placeholder web pages, the divine impulse in literary philosophy, and Christian scripture about salvation.

patterns.name: Legal authority and jurisdiction
patterns.context: Discusses whether a court, judge, or party has jurisdiction, statutory authority, or an obligation, often alongside legal terms such as custody, sentence, and authority.

patterns.name: Legal facts and evidentiary record
patterns.context: Presents the record, pleadings, disputed facts, or evidentiary record in judicial reasoning.

patterns.name: Precedent and legal authority
patterns.context: Cites or evaluates precedent and the legal authority it represents; lists of legal terms also appear.

patterns.name: Case-header information in judicial documents
patterns.context: Header information such as the court name, jurisdiction, judge, and case number.

patterns.name: Legal rulings or procedural actions
patterns.context: Describes a court taking up a motion and deleting specific wording from a judgment or text.

patterns.name: Fragments in Latin filler text
patterns.context: Lorem ipsum-style Latin placeholder passages with split markup in HTML pages.

patterns.name: Divine impulse and religious thought
patterns.context: Discusses an inner divine drive, belief, or mental activity.
patterns.domain: Literary prose, religious or philosophical texts

patterns.name: Christian salvation and eschatological hope
patterns.context: In a Christian doctrinal context, describes the Second Coming of Christ, salvation, and cleansing from sins.

patterns.name: Courtroom questions and answers about roles and responsibilities
patterns.context: A lawyer or witness is questioned about their knowledge of a business, trustee responsibilities, and actual operations.

11_413.concept: 多领域文本中的法律术语与权威
11_413.description: 激活主要集中于法律文本，尤其权限、管辖、义务、案卷事实、判例权威及司法文书；另有庭审问答、拉丁占位网页、文学哲学中的神圣冲动和基督教救赎经文。

patterns.name: 法律权限与管辖
patterns.context: 讨论法院、法官或当事人是否有管辖权、法定权限或义务，常伴随 custody、sentence、authority 等法律术语

patterns.name: 法律事实与证据记录
patterns.context: 司法论证中陈述案卷、诉状、事实争议或证据记录

patterns.name: 判例与法律权威
patterns.trigger: «cases»9« which»4« represents»4« the»2« weight»3« of»3« authority»5
patterns.context: 援引或评价判例及其代表的法律权威；也出现法律术语的列举

patterns.name: 司法文书案头信息
patterns.context: 法院名称、司法辖区、法官及案号等文书抬头信息

patterns.name: 法律裁定或程序动作
patterns.context: 描述法院受理动议并删去判决或文本中的特定措辞

patterns.name: 拉丁文填充文本中的碎片
patterns.context: HTML 页面中被拆分标记的拉丁文 Lorem ipsum 式占位段落

patterns.name: 神圣冲动与宗教思想
patterns.context: 谈论内在的神圣驱力、信念或思想活动
patterns.domain: 文学散文、宗教或哲学文本

patterns.name: 基督教救赎与末世盼望
patterns.context: 基督教教义语境，描述基督再临、救赎及洁净罪行

patterns.name: 法律庭审问答与角色职责
patterns.context: 律师或证人被询问对企业、受托人职责及实际运作的认识

en.concept: Issues and authority-based arguments in legal opinions
en.description: Primarily responds to wording that frames issues in U.S. legal opinions (especially issue and only issue) and nearby references to courts, cases, precedents, and authorities; it also covers case captions, procedural rules, statutory citations, and specific legal topics such as habeas, immigration consequences, criminal convictions, legislative records, and appellate review.

patterns.name: Issue-related legal arguments
patterns.context: Judicial opinions define an issue, state whether it is meritorious, or determine whether a case applies; often appears near words such as court, case, and judgment.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, appellate opinions, and legal analysis

patterns.name: Precedent and authoritative support
patterns.context: Cites, distinguishes, or evaluates precedents and legal authorities to support or limit a legal argument.
patterns.domain: Case citations and judicial legal writing

patterns.name: Terms for courts and litigants
patterns.context: Formal litigation documents refer to courts, parties, or judicial offices; may co-occur with discussion of issues.

patterns.name: Legal document formatting and procedural language
patterns.context: Formatting or set expressions in statutes, case captions, procedural rules, and conclusions of judgments.
patterns.domain: Court opinions, case captions, and statutory citations

patterns.name: Failure to exhaust judicial remedies
patterns.context: Discusses a habeas petition filed before the petitioner exhausted judicial remedies.

patterns.name: Immigration consequences and plea-advice duties
patterns.context: Discusses whether counsel must advise about immigration-removal consequences or seek a plea that would not result in removal.

patterns.name: Parties and agencies in case captions
patterns.context: Case captions formatted with capitalized names and government-agency names; activations fall on caption text fragments.

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and offense grades
patterns.context: Describes a theft-related conviction and raises the question of the offense grade.

patterns.name: Criminal instructions and references to law enforcement
patterns.context: Compares different terms for government agents/law-enforcement officers in jury instructions and discusses the supporting precedent.

patterns.name: Litigation deadlines and trustee sales
patterns.context: Determines whether the plaintiff sued within the statutory period after a trustee sale, then identifies the only issue before the court.

patterns.name: Legislative records and the journal entry rule
patterns.context: The parties cite the legislative records of both chambers in their pleadings, leaving no factual dispute.

patterns.name: Congressional appropriation-category terms
patterns.context: Lists different names for categories or amounts of funds authorized by Congress and discusses representative cases and the weight of authorities.

patterns.name: Plain-error review on appeal
patterns.context: After citing the Texas appellate rules, narrows the question to whether the error is apparent on the face of the record.

11_413.concept: 法律意见中的争点与权威论证
11_413.description: 主要对美国法律意见中界定争点的用语（尤其 issue、only issue）及其邻近的法院、案件、判例和权威引证起反应；另覆盖诉讼标题、程序规则、法规引证，以及若干具体法律主题，如 habeas、移民后果、刑事定罪、立法记录和上诉审查。

patterns.name: issue 相关法律论证
patterns.trigger: “issue”“only issue”“no issue”“question at hand”，尤其是 «issue»9、“the»2« only»5« issue»9”；也见“issue … that case”
patterns.context: 司法意见中界定争点、说明争点是否成立或案件是否适用；常出现在法院、案件、判决等词附近。
patterns.domain: 美国判例、上诉意见及法律分析

patterns.name: 判例与权威依据
patterns.context: 援引、区分或评价先例及法律权威，用于支持或限定法律论证。
patterns.domain: 判例引证与司法法律文体

patterns.name: 法院及诉讼参与者称谓
patterns.trigger: “Court”“Plaintiff”“Petitioner”“Chief Special Master”“District Court”，以及 «the» 后接 Court 的结构
patterns.context: 正式诉讼文件中提及法院、当事人或司法职务；可与争点论述同现。

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与程序语言
patterns.context: 法规、案卷标题、程序规则、判决结论等法律文书格式或固定表达。
patterns.domain: 法院意见、案卷标题及法规引证

patterns.name: 未耗尽司法救济
patterns.context: 讨论申请人未先用尽司法救济而提出的 habeas 申请。

patterns.name: 移民后果与认罪答辩义务
patterns.context: 讨论律师是否须就移民遣返后果提供建议，或努力促成不导致遣返的答辩。

patterns.name: 案件标题中的当事方与机关
patterns.context: 以大写姓名和政府机关名称排版的诉讼标题；激活落在标题文本片段。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与量刑等级
patterns.trigger: “convicted of receiving stolen property”“theft of some rifles”“grading”
patterns.context: 叙述盗窃相关定罪并引出罪行等级问题。

patterns.name: 刑事指示与执法人员表述
patterns.trigger: “instruction”“government agents”“law enforcement officer”“Cruz cites no case”
patterns.context: 比较陪审团指示中对政府代理人／执法人员的不同称呼，并评述先例依据。

patterns.name: 诉讼时限与受托人出售
patterns.context: 确认原告是否在受托人出售后法定期限内起诉，再界定法院面前的唯一争点。

patterns.name: 立法记录与 journal entry rule
patterns.trigger: “journal entry rule”“journal entries of both houses”“no issue of fact”
patterns.context: 双方在诉状中援引两院立法记录，因而不存在事实争议。

patterns.name: 国会拨款类别术语
patterns.trigger: “spillover, grubstake, wild card, and unfilled bin”
patterns.context: 列举国会允许的资金类别或额度的不同称呼，并讨论代表性判例及权威分量。
patterns.domain: 公共财政／拨款法律意见

patterns.name: 上诉中的明显错误审查
patterns.trigger: “only issue is whether error is apparent on the face”
patterns.context: 引用德州上诉规则后，将问题限定为错误是否表面可见。

en.concept: Discussion of issues and grounds in legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to wording in rulings that defines the issue under review and evaluates the applicability or grounds of cited precedent, authority, and claims; also includes legal remedy terminology, title-page formatting, and a passage of Slovenian legal text.

patterns.name: Defining the issue under review
patterns.context: A judicial opinion states the sole issue the court must currently hear or review, often followed by a whether clause or the scope of review.
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings and legal opinions

patterns.name: Citing precedent or authority and evaluating applicability
patterns.context: States that a point lacks grounds, is inapplicable, or is unjustified when discussing precedent, legal authority, or litigation claims.

patterns.name: Combinations of legal terms
patterns.context: Uses parallel terms for equitable and legal remedies; the passage also discusses contracts and disputed issues.

patterns.name: Typography and institutional names in judgment headings
patterns.context: Line breaks, indentation, and capitalized institutional names are split across the title page or case-name field of a court document.

patterns.name: Slovenian legal wording
patterns.context: A Slovenian quotation concerning public safety and surveillance by judicial authorities; it differs from the repeated patterns in English legal opinions.

11_413.concept: 法律文书中的问题与依据评述
11_413.description: 主要响应判决中界定待审问题，以及援引判例、权威和主张后评估其适用性或依据的法律论证措辞；另见法律救济术语、标题排版和一段斯洛文尼亚语法律文本。

patterns.name: 界定待审问题
patterns.context: 司法意见中说明法院当前需要审理或复核的唯一问题，常接 whether 子句或 review 范围。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律意见

patterns.name: 援引判例或权威并评估适用性
patterns.context: 在讨论判例、法律权威或诉讼主张时，陈述缺乏依据、不可适用或没有理由。

patterns.name: 法律术语组合
patterns.context: 出现衡平法与法律救济的并列术语，段落亦在讨论合同及争议问题。

patterns.name: 判决书标题的排版与机构名称
patterns.context: 法院文书的标题页或案名栏中，换行、缩进及大写机构名称被拆分排印。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语法律表述
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语引文中关于公共安全及司法机关监控的表述；与英语法律意见的重复模式不同。
patterns.domain: 斯洛文尼亚语法律文本

en.description: Primarily responds to statements in legal texts about issues, evidentiary review, and adjudicative status; it also covers detailed descriptions of church architectural elements and party identifiers in legal document captions.

patterns.name: Issues and rulings in legal decisions
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions, trial records, or judicial reasoning, often concerning an issue, evidence, a standard of review, or readiness for judgment; legal register.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions, appellate opinions, and judicial orders

patterns.name: Church architectural elements and descriptions
patterns.context: Describes a church or tower through a sequence of architectural elements, locations, and forms.

patterns.name: Party identifiers in legal document captions
patterns.context: The caption section of a court document or administrative decision lists the petitioner, respondent, and titles.
patterns.domain: Legal document layout and case captions

11_413.concept: 结构化专业描述与判断
11_413.description: 主要响应法律文本中对争点、证据审查及裁判状态的表述，也覆盖教堂建筑构件的细节描写和法律文书标题中的当事方标识。

patterns.name: 法律裁判中的争点与审理结论
patterns.trigger: “issue”“only issue”“matter is now fully submitted”“fully advised”“decisive issue”，以及 “substantial question”“error”
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见、审理记录或判决论证中，常围绕争点、证据、审查标准或裁判准备状态；法律语体
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、上诉意见及司法命令

patterns.name: 教堂建筑构件与建筑描述
patterns.trigger: “pointed high arch”“stone bowl”“marble shafts”；“nave”“south aisle”“chancel”“stepped angled buttresses”
patterns.context: 以连续的建筑构件、方位与形制描述教堂或塔楼

patterns.name: 法律文书标题中的当事方标识
patterns.context: 法院文书或行政裁决书的标题区，列出申请人、被申请方及职衔
patterns.domain: 法律文书版式与案卷标题

en.concept: Lists of specific matters and components
en.description: Legal passages often introduce issues for adjudication, procedural developments, rights, or evidentiary questions; there are also strong activations on dense lists of building components and ornament in architectural descriptions. The shared feature is broad: describing and enumerating specific matters.

patterns.name: Introducing pending matters or issues
patterns.context: A judicial opinion turns to the current issues, defects, or matters to be decided in a case; often appears after the factual or procedural background.
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings and legal reasoning

patterns.name: Procedural status and readiness for adjudication
patterns.context: Describes the progress of a case through filing, hearings, trial, or litigation procedures.

patterns.name: Lists of architectural façade components and details
patterns.context: Uses parallel nouns and adjectives to describe a building's form, façade, openings, ornament, or components in detail.

patterns.name: Statements of legal rights and issues
patterns.context: Discusses whether a legal error affects a substantive issue, or the rights, immunities, and legal classification of litigants.

patterns.name: Testimony and credibility
patterns.context: Witness testimony, disputed facts, and witness credibility are central to the case determination.

11_413.concept: 具体事项与构件的列举
11_413.description: 法律段落多在引出待裁争点、程序进展、权利或证据问题；另对建筑描述中构件与装饰的密集列举有强激活。共同点较宽泛，均偏向具体事项的说明与列举。

patterns.name: 待决事项/争点的引入
patterns.trigger: “a decisive issue”“The matter is now fully submitted”“the only apparent defect”“a vital matter”“the only issue before the Court”“One of the issues”
patterns.context: 司法意见中转入案件当前争点、缺陷或待裁定事项；常出现在事实或程序背景之后。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律论证

patterns.name: 法律程序状态与裁判准备
patterns.trigger: “fully submitted”“ready for ruling”“at the hearing”“trial judge”“to proceed”“civil actions”
patterns.context: 叙述案件提交、听证、审判或诉讼程序的进展。

patterns.name: 建筑立面构件及细部的罗列
patterns.context: 以并列名词和形容词具体描述建筑的形制、立面、开口、装饰或构件。

patterns.name: 法律权利与法律问题的表述
patterns.context: 讨论法律错误是否影响实体问题，或诉讼当事人的权利、豁免及法律分类。

patterns.name: 叙述证词及可信度
patterns.trigger: “testified”“credibility was a decisive issue”“alleged heroin sales did not occur”
patterns.context: 以证人证词、争议事实及证人可信度作为案件判断的核心。

en.description: Primarily responds to legal documents marking issues for decision, emphasizing the importance of arguments or matters, and the thorough completion of case statements and submissions; also responds to language of salvation, atonement, and cleansing in religious scripture.

patterns.name: Legal issue marker
patterns.context: In a legal opinion, explicitly identifies the matter to be decided as the sole or dispositive issue.

patterns.name: Importance and strength of argument
patterns.context: Legal text highlights the strength of an argument, the importance of a matter, or a defect in a ruling.

patterns.name: Thorough completion or presentation
patterns.context: Describes allegations as to be more fully developed, or case materials as fully submitted and ready for decision.

patterns.name: Religious salvation and atonement
patterns.context: Christian scripture describes salvation, deliverance from sin, and cleansing.

11_413.concept: 显著性与完成状态
11_413.description: 主要响应法律文书中标示争点、强调论证或事项的重要性，以及案件陈述和提交的充分完成；另在宗教经文中响应救赎、除罪与洁净表述。

patterns.name: 法律争点标记
patterns.trigger: “only other issue”“decisive issue”“The only issue before us”“the only issue before the Court”
patterns.context: 法律意见书中将待裁决的问题明确标为唯一或决定性争点。

patterns.name: 重要性与论证力度
patterns.context: 法律文本突出论点的强弱、事项的重要性，或裁定中的缺陷。

patterns.name: 充分完成或陈述
patterns.context: 描述指控将被更充分阐述，或案件材料已充分提交、准备裁决。

patterns.name: 宗教救赎与除罪
patterns.trigger: “redeem us from every lawless deed”“purify for Himself”
patterns.context: 基督教经文中描述救赎、脱离罪行与洁净。

en.concept: Issues and adjudicative language in appellate rulings
en.description: Primarily responds to the identification of core issues in appellate rulings, as well as stock phrases about reviewing the record and law and affirming the lower court; also involves criminal convictions and sentencing, evidentiary standards, citations to procedural rules, and less common discussion of jury-trial rights.

patterns.name: Stating issues in appellate opinions
patterns.context: Identifies a case's core issue in a court opinion, often followed by whether, on trial, or an assessment of witness credibility; sometimes issue is adjacent to an adjective.

patterns.name: Reviewing judgments and affirming the lower court
patterns.context: After reviewing the record or law, an appellate court states that it affirms the trial court's ruling; common in concluding paragraphs, also appearing in expressions about review of the lower court's ruling.

patterns.name: Citation of statutory procedural rules
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a ruling paragraph as a citation to rules governing appeals or judgment procedure; the trigger prominently features the letter R followed by a formatted rule number.

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and sentencing
patterns.context: Discusses criminal convictions, whether a sentence has expired, or jury trials in criminal cases; some words are split into subword tokens.

patterns.name: Legal evidence and standards of proof
patterns.context: Discusses clear and convincing evidence required to prove abandonment, whether an evidentiary hearing was held, or whether the record supports the ruling.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, evidence, and standards of proof

patterns.name: Liberal construction of pleadings and failure-to-state-a-claim defenses
patterns.context: When considering a failure-to-state-a-claim defense, requires a liberal construction of the plaintiff's petition in the plaintiff's favor.

patterns.name: Legal status of jury trials
patterns.context: Historical or constitutional discussion distinguishing jury trial as part of governmental structure from a defendant's right or privilege.
patterns.domain: Legal history and criminal procedure discussion

patterns.name: Random numbers and fragments
patterns.context: Numbers appear near page numbers, citations, or truncated text, with no evident stable semantic or grammatical trigger.
patterns.domain: Citations or layout fragments in legal documents

11_413.concept: 上诉判决中的争点与裁判表述
11_413.description: 主要响应上诉判决中对核心争点的标示，以及审查案卷、法律并维持原判的套语；也涉及刑事定罪量刑、证据标准、诉讼程序引证和少见的陪审团权利论述。

patterns.name: 上诉意见中的争点表述
patterns.trigger: « issue»9、« only»4« issue»9、« crucial»6« issue»9、« decisive»9« issue»6
patterns.context: 在法院意见中标示案件核心争点，常接 whether、on trial 或对证人可信度的判断；有时 issue 与形容词相邻。

patterns.name: 判决审查与维持原判
patterns.trigger: « affirm»3、« judgment»1、« trial»3« court»2、« review»1、« record»5、« applicable»7« law»4
patterns.context: 上诉法院回顾记录或法律后，说明维持审判法院裁决；常见于结论段，也有对原判的审查表述。

patterns.name: 法定程序规则引证
patterns.context: 出现在判决段落末尾，作为上诉权或判决程序规则的引证；触发点突出字母 R 及其后的格式化规则编号。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与量刑
patterns.context: 讨论刑事定罪、刑期是否届满或刑事案件中的陪审团审判；部分词被分词拆开。

patterns.name: 法律证据与证明标准
patterns.context: 谈到证明遗弃所需的清楚且令人信服的证据，或是否举行证据听证、案卷是否支持裁决。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、证据与证明标准

patterns.name: 诉状宽松解释及诉因抗辩
patterns.trigger: « petition»、« liber»«ally»、« plaintiff»、« no»« cause»« of»« action»
patterns.context: 在审理无诉因抗辩时，要求对原告诉状作有利于原告的宽松解释。
patterns.domain: 路易斯安那州民事诉讼判决

patterns.name: 陪审团审判的法律地位
patterns.context: 历史或宪法性论述中，区分陪审团审判作为政府结构的一部分还是被告的一项权利或特权。

patterns.name: 随机数字及残片
patterns.context: 数字出现在页码、引证或截断文本附近，未见稳定的语义或语法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的引证或版面残片

en.concept: Salient terms and formulaic fragments in text
en.description: Activations are scattered across domains: legal documents show a particular preference for issue(s) marking points for decision and also respond to formulaic phrases such as fully advised and heavy presumption; strong activations also occur for Java byte-stream variables, words describing literary settings, and fragments of lawless in scripture.

patterns.name: Byte array in Java serialization code
patterns.context: A method accepts a byte[] parameter and passes it to a ByteArrayInputStream constructor; activation peaks on the variable bytes.

patterns.name: Spatial and architectural description in narrative
patterns.context: Describes looking down from a height, a house entrance, and a porch railing; activation falls on descriptive adjectives or their subword fragments.

patterns.name: Disputed-issue terminology in legal opinions
patterns.context: In legal documents, often appears on issue(s) when stating the scope of review, appellate questions, or the issues in a case; nearby phrases include before us, here, we must consider, and on appeal.

patterns.name: Formulaic phrase indicating full familiarity in a legal opinion
patterns.context: After reviewing the record, applicable law, and the parties’ memoranda, a court uses fully advised in the premises to indicate that it is fully informed about the case and ready to decide.

patterns.name: Degree modifier in legal argument
patterns.context: Appears before a presumption established by the FAA, forming “a heavy presumption”; it is not an issue label.

patterns.name: Negative moral conduct in religious text
patterns.context: A Pauline-style religious passage says Christ saves believers from all kinds of lawless conduct; the peak is on the subword fragment of lawless.

11_413.concept: 文本中的显著词语与套语片段
11_413.description: 激活分散在不同领域：法律文书中尤其偏向 issue(s) 标示争点，也响应 fully advised、heavy presumption 等套语；另对 Java 字节流变量、小说空间描写词及经文 lawless 的片段有强激活。

patterns.name: Java 序列化代码中的字节数组
patterns.context: 方法接收 byte[] 参数，并将其传入 ByteArrayInputStream 构造函数；激活峰值落在变量 bytes 上。

patterns.name: 自然叙事中的空间与建筑描述
patterns.trigger: « high»9、« wide»10、« ra»8«iling»；周围出现 bank、stairway、door、dwelling、porch
patterns.context: 描写从高处向下看、房屋入口及门廊栏杆等场景；激活落在描述性形容词或其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 法律意见中的争议焦点用语
patterns.context: 法律文书在陈述审理范围、上诉问题或某案争点时，常出现在 issue(s) 一词上；附近可见 before us、here、we must consider、on appeal 等。

patterns.name: 法律意见中表示充分知悉的套语
patterns.context: 法院回顾案卷、适用法律和双方备忘录后，以 fully advised in the premises 表示已充分了解案件、准备裁决。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的程度修饰语
patterns.context: 出现在 FAA 设定的推定之前，构成“a heavy presumption”；并非争点标签。

patterns.name: 宗教文本中的否定性道德行为
patterns.context: 保罗书信式宗教段落谈到基督救赎信徒脱离各样不法行为；峰值在 lawless 的子词片段。

en.description: Responds to legal issues and case discussion, church architectural components and forms, and expressions of solidity or strength; it also appears with legal statements about adverse effects, religious salvation, and descriptions of trees in spring. The triggers are scattered.

patterns.name: Issue in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal case discussion revolves around issues, case facts, or court decisions, often in constructions such as “The only issue…” and “issues in that case”.

patterns.name: Church architectural components and forms
patterns.context: Strongly responds to the names of specific forms and components when describing a church’s plan, tower, arch, window, roof, or architectural ornament.

patterns.name: Solid or tangible properties of entities
patterns.context: Words describing height, solidity, or strength modify an entity or argument; the specific meaning varies by domain.
patterns.domain: Nature writing, architectural descriptions, legal argument

patterns.name: Negative legal impact
patterns.context: In the context of applying a legal rule or statute, describes rights as not adversely or harmfully affected.

patterns.name: Salvation and unlawful conduct
patterns.context: Religious text describes Christ redeeming people and delivering them from unlawful conduct.

patterns.name: Spring trees and scenery
patterns.context: A spring woodland scene depicts branches, chorus-like sounds, and tree trunks.

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 响应法律文本的争点与案件论述、教堂建筑构件和形制，也对坚实或强烈等性质表达有反应；另见法律上的不利影响、宗教救赎及春日树木描写，触发内容分散。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 issue
patterns.context: 法律案件论述中，围绕争点、案件事实或法院裁决展开，常出现在“The only issue…”“issues in that case”等句式

patterns.name: 教堂建筑构件与形制
patterns.context: 描述教堂平面、塔楼、拱、窗、屋顶或建筑装饰时，对具体形制与构件名称有强响应

patterns.name: 坚实或有形的实体属性
patterns.context: 出现高度、坚固、强度等性质词并修饰实体或论证对象；具体语义与领域不同
patterns.domain: 自然描写、建筑说明、法律论证

patterns.name: 否定性法律影响表述
patterns.context: 法律规则或法条适用语境中，描述权利未受到不利或有害影响

patterns.name: 救赎与违法行为
patterns.context: 宗教文本中，描述基督救赎并使人脱离违法行为

patterns.name: 春日树木景物
patterns.context: 春天的树林场景，以枝条、合唱般的声音和树干描写自然景物

en.concept: Within-word fragments and statements of significance
en.description: Activations are distributed across legal issues, significance, and several within-word fragments in legal text; they also appear on lawless in scripture, spatial adjectives in fiction, constateren in Dutch, and octagonal in architectural terminology. There is no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Stating legal issues
patterns.context: Introduces an issue to be decided in a legal opinion or ruling, often in structures such as “the issue … is whether” or “only issue before us”.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal reasoning

patterns.name: Decisive issue in litigation
patterns.context: Emphasizes the importance of evidence, credibility, or a jury trial in a criminal proceeding.

patterns.name: Subword activation in lawless
patterns.context: Religious text includes “every lawless deed”; activations concentrate on subwords in lawless, semantically referring to unlawful or wrongful acts.

patterns.name: Spatial adjectives and landscape description
patterns.context: Describes a high place, a wide railing, and the surrounding environment in a landscape or architectural passage; nearby text also includes “from a high bank” and “on a wide railing”.

patterns.name: Local legal vocabulary in general legal text
patterns.context: Legal text includes statements about being adversely affected, race-neutral reasons, or not needing to restate something; activations fall on within-word substrings, with no unified syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Dutch
patterns.context: In a Dutch European Parliament speech, activation occurs within the word “constateren” (to state, observe); the surrounding text discusses the impact of the crisis on women.

patterns.name: Morphological fragment in architectural terminology
patterns.context: In a description of church architecture, activation occurs within “octagonal”, describing an octagonal skylight.

11_413.concept: 词内片段及重要性表述
11_413.description: 激活分布于法律文本的争点、重要性及若干词内片段，也见经文lawless、小说空间形容词、荷兰语constateren和建筑术语octagonal；没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律争点表述
patterns.context: 法律意见或判决中引出待裁定问题，常见于“the issue … is whether”或“only issue before us”等结构

patterns.name: 诉讼中决定性争点
patterns.context: 刑事诉讼叙述中强调证据、可信度或陪审团审判对案件的重要性

patterns.name: lawless 的分词激活
patterns.context: 宗教文本中出现“every lawless deed”；激活集中在 lawless 的子词，语义上指违法、不法行为

patterns.name: 空间形容词及景物描写
patterns.context: 景物或建筑叙述中，形容高处、宽阔栏杆及周边环境；同时附近有“from a high bank”“on a wide railing”

patterns.name: 一般法律文本中的局部法律词汇
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现受不利影响、种族中立理由或无需复述等表述；激活落在词内子串，未见统一句法触发

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语欧洲议会发言中，激活出现在“constateren”（指出、观察到）一词内部；周围讨论危机对女性的影响

patterns.name: 建筑术语中的形态片段
patterns.context: 教堂建筑描写中，激活落在“octagonal”内部，描述八角形天窗

en.concept: Legal issue statements and several topical phrases
en.description: The most consistent pattern is the presentation or definition of issues in legal text, especially collocations of issue with central, presented, appeal, and similar terms; other activations occur in fire-insurance disputes, rules on injury to rights, valley scenery, news footnotes, religious salvation, and furniture components.

patterns.name: Discussion of issue in legal decisions
patterns.context: Raises, defines, or discusses an issue in a legal decision or opinion; activation may fall near “issue” or on another word in the issue statement, such as “central” in paragraph 2.

patterns.name: Valley terrain and stream scenery
patterns.context: Narrative description of a character descending a slope, with features such as a valley, riverbank, or mountain stream.

patterns.name: Fire loss and property insurance dispute
patterns.context: Describes property loss caused by fire and turns to a dispute involving a trustee or insurance; activation is concentrated on “central issue”.

patterns.name: Statutory application and conditions for injury to rights
patterns.context: Quotes a general rule about whether a public official’s rights were adversely affected by the implementation of a law.

patterns.name: Termination of an Indian project and news copyright footnote
patterns.context: A newswire or news excerpt includes project withdrawal, termination conditions, and copyright or column footnotes; activation mainly falls on the copyright footnote.
patterns.domain: News text / email or newswire excerpt

patterns.name: Christian salvation and lawless conduct
patterns.context: Christian doctrine or scriptural language describes Christ saving believers from sin.

patterns.name: Historical furniture components and decorative details
patterns.context: An object description details furniture style, backrests, carvings, and component layout.

11_413.concept: 法律争点表述及若干题材词组
11_413.description: 最稳定的模式是法律文本中提出或界定争点，尤其是 issue 与 central、presented、appeal 等搭配；另见火灾保险争议、权利受损规则，以及山谷景物、新闻尾注、宗教救赎和家具构件等少量题材。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的 issue 论述
patterns.trigger: “issue”常与“central issue”“issue presented”“issue upon which”“only issue”连用；同时触发周围的“central”“presented”“appeal”“arguments”“before”等词
patterns.context: 法律判决或法律意见中提出、界定或讨论争点；激活可落在“issue”附近，也可落在争点表述中的其他词，如第2段的“central”

patterns.name: 山谷地形与溪流景物
patterns.context: 叙事性描写中人物沿坡道下行，出现山谷、河岸或山间溪流等地形景物

patterns.name: 火灾损失与财产保险争议
patterns.context: 描述火灾造成的财物损失，并转入受托人或保险相关争议；激活集中于“central issue”

patterns.name: 法条适用与权利受损条件
patterns.trigger: “rights”“are not adversely and injuriously affected”“operation of an Act”
patterns.context: 引述关于公职人员权利是否因法律实施受到不利影响的一般规则

patterns.name: 印度项目终止与新闻版权尾注
patterns.trigger: “pulling out of the Indian project”“Final termination”“Copyright”“All Rights Reserved”“International World”
patterns.context: 新闻电讯或新闻摘录，含项目退出、终止条件以及版权和栏目尾注；激活主要落在版权尾注
patterns.domain: 新闻文本／邮件或电讯摘录

patterns.name: 基督教救赎与无律法之罪行
patterns.context: 基督教教义或经文式语句，叙述基督救赎信徒脱离罪行

patterns.name: 历史家具构件与装饰细节
patterns.context: 描述家具式样、靠背、雕刻和构件布局的器物说明

en.description: Most activations come from legal texts, especially phrases that introduce issues, emphasize grounds for a decision, state orders, and present procedural conclusions; signature formatting also appears. The remaining activations involve literary scenery and verse, and geometric descriptions of architecture. Each has clear local trigger words, but they do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Introducing an issue in a legal decision
patterns.context: A decision first gives the case facts or procedural history, then uses issue/question to introduce the legal question to be decided; “issue” or “question” and nearby words show the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Emphatic commentary in legal decisions
patterns.context: The court comments on the importance of a right or finds that litigation materials are sufficient; emphasis words appear alongside legal argument.

patterns.name: Statements of rulings or orders in legal text
patterns.context: A statute or decision addresses fees, relief, visitation arrangements, or a decision that oral argument is unnecessary; includes normative shall or a procedural determination.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, statutes, and procedural texts

patterns.name: Facts about personal injury and property damage in legal text
patterns.context: Case facts or statutory remedies involve property loss, child health, and safety.
patterns.domain: Property insurance litigation and family law

patterns.name: Court signatures and panel lists
patterns.context: Court opinion signatures or lists of judges at the end or beginning of a decision; proper names are split into subwords.

patterns.name: Elevated scenery and architecture in literary narrative
patterns.context: A character looks down on a stream from a high bank and describes steps and a railing leading to a house porch.

patterns.name: White and green imagery in literary verse
patterns.context: Quotes an early modern poem describing a character’s appearance through bedding, green, and whiteness.

patterns.name: Descriptions of architectural space and geometry
patterns.context: Explains the geometric forms of church openings, a choir, and a lantern at the top of a tower.

11_413.concept: 多体裁文本中的显著短语
11_413.description: 多数激活来自法律文本，尤以引出争点、强调裁判理由、陈述命令及程序结论为主；另有署名版式。其余为文学景物与诗句、建筑几何描述，均有明确局部触发词，但难归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的“issue”议题引出
patterns.trigger: “central issue here”“The issue presented on appeal”“The primary question presented”
patterns.context: 判决书先交代案件事实或程序，再用 issue/question 引出待裁决的法律问题；“issue”或“question”及其周边词激活最突出
patterns.domain: 美国判决与法律意见书

patterns.name: 法律判决中的强调性评述
patterns.context: 法院评述权利的重要性或认定诉讼材料充分；强调词及法律论证语境共同出现
patterns.domain: 美国判决与法律意见书

patterns.name: 法律文本中的裁判结论或命令表述
patterns.trigger: “shall pay all costs”“shall modify the order”“deemed unnecessary”
patterns.context: 法规或判决说明费用、救济、探视安排，或决定无需口头辩论；包含规范性 shall 或程序性判断
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法规及程序文本

patterns.name: 法律文本中的人身与财产损害事实
patterns.trigger: “fire and substantial smoke and water damage”“physical, mental or emotional health”
patterns.context: 案件事实或法定救济涉及财产损失、儿童健康与安全
patterns.domain: 财产保险诉讼与家庭法

patterns.name: 法院署名与合议庭名单
patterns.context: 判决末尾或开头的法院意见署名、法官名单；专名被拆分成子词

patterns.name: 文学叙述中的高处景物与建筑
patterns.context: 人物从高岸俯瞰溪流，并描述通往住宅门廊的阶梯与栏杆

patterns.name: 文学诗句中的白色与绿色意象
patterns.context: 引述早期现代诗句，以床褥、绿色和洁白描写人物外貌
patterns.domain: 莎士比亚诗歌引文及文学考据

patterns.name: 建筑空间与几何形状描述
patterns.context: 说明教堂开口、唱诗席及塔顶天窗的几何形态

en.description: Activations are scattered across expressions of importance, completeness, issues, and legal effect in legal texts; child emotional health and a broad railing in a novel also appear. Beyond the prevalence of legal contexts, there is no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Impaired emotional health
patterns.context: Concerns whether a judge should restrict visitation if it may harm a child’s mental or emotional health; the strongest activation falls on emotional.

patterns.name: Emphasis on fundamentality / importance
patterns.context: Legal argument emphasizes the fundamental nature, importance, or completeness of a right, matter, or legal effect; highlighted words vary.

patterns.name: Disputed issue
patterns.context: A decision or appellate opinion explicitly raises the core / principal issue in a case; activation falls on issue or a nearby qualifier of the issue.

patterns.name: Descriptive scene phrase
patterns.context: Narrative text describes a broad railing on a house porch; activation is concentrated on the adjective of width and the noun it modifies.

patterns.name: Finality of judgment
patterns.context: Discusses whether a criminal conviction has binding effect in a subsequent civil action.

11_413.concept: 法律论证中的显著表述
11_413.description: 激活散见于法律文本中的重要性、完整性、争点及裁判效力表述，也出现儿童情绪健康和小说中的宽栏杆描写；除法律语境偏多外，未见单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 情绪健康受损
patterns.context: 涉及法官是否应因探视可能危害儿童身心健康而限制探视；最强激活落在 emotional。

patterns.name: 基础性／重要性强调
patterns.context: 法律论证中强调某权利、事项或法律效力的根本性、重要性或完整程度；高亮词并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 争议焦点
patterns.context: 判决或上诉意见明确提出案件的核心／主要争点；激活落在 issue 或相邻的焦点限定语。

patterns.name: 描写性场景词组
patterns.context: 叙事性文字中描写住宅门廊上的宽栏杆；激活集中在宽度形容词及其所修饰的名词。

patterns.name: 终局裁判效力
patterns.context: 讨论刑事定罪在后续民事诉讼中是否具有约束力。
patterns.domain: 司法意见／证据与既判效力

en.concept: Features of varied narrative and legal phrases
en.description: Activations cover juries and constitutional rights in legal text, fixed issue expressions, trustee and property-damage accounts, as well as reclining postures, descriptions of spatial arrangements, and chapter formatting in fiction; no single triggering theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: Jury-trial rights and constitutional protections
patterns.context: Discusses the right to a jury trial in criminal proceedings, whether a defendant knew and understood their rights, and the legal status of the jury system; activations concentrate on related legal language.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, criminal procedure, and constitutional legal writing

patterns.name: “central issue” discourse frame
patterns.context: A legal document turns to an issue or focus of argument, especially in the fixed phrase “central issue”; this pattern is independent of the specific dispute.

patterns.name: A character leaning or reclining
patterns.context: Describes a character leaning or reclining; both passages include leaned, but one depicts standing while leaning on a hand, and the other reclining against a chair.

patterns.name: Descriptions of spatial layout and interior furnishings
patterns.context: Provides successive details about a house, terrain, furniture, or light, including location, dimensions, spatial relationships, and other visual information.

patterns.name: Fire-related property loss
patterns.context: Lists damage caused by a fire and personal property that was damaged or insured.
patterns.domain: Insurance- or bankruptcy-related legal fact statements

patterns.name: Trustee role and business control
patterns.context: Courtroom questions and answers discuss whether a party acknowledges the trustee's full role in operating a business.

patterns.name: Printed chapter headings and character entrance action
patterns.context: Illustration markers and all-caps chapter headings in scanned or typeset text are followed by a description of the protagonist reclining in a chair; this may overlap with the “character reclining” pattern, but the heading format itself does not appear in other passages.

11_413.concept: 多类叙事与法律短语特征
11_413.description: 激活覆盖法律文本中的陪审团与宪法权利、固定争点表达、受托人及财产损害叙述，也覆盖小说里的倚靠姿势、空间陈设描写和章节版式；没有单一触发主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 法庭陪审团权利与宪法保障
patterns.context: 讨论刑事审判中的陪审团审判权、被告是否知悉并理解权利，以及陪审团制度的法律地位；激活集中在相关法律论述词句。
patterns.domain: 美国判例、刑事诉讼与宪法法律文体

patterns.name: “central issue”论述框架
patterns.context: 法律文书转入争点或论证焦点时，尤其是固定搭配“central issue”；此模式与具体争议内容无关。

patterns.name: 人物倚靠或后仰
patterns.trigger: « leaned»«eas»ily» upon … hand；« leaned» back … in his chair
patterns.context: 叙述人物以身体倚靠、后仰的姿势；两处均出现 leaned，但一处为倚手站立，一处为靠椅后仰。

patterns.name: 空间布置与室内陈设描写
patterns.context: 以连续细节描写房屋、地形、家具或光线，包含位置、尺寸、空间关系等视觉信息。

patterns.name: 火灾财产损失
patterns.context: 列举火灾造成的损害及受损、投保的个人财产。
patterns.domain: 保险或破产相关法律事实陈述

patterns.name: 受托人角色与企业控制
patterns.context: 庭审问答中讨论当事人是否承认受托人在企业经营中的完整角色。

patterns.name: 印刷章节标题及人物出场动作
patterns.context: 扫描或排版文本中的插图标记、全大写章节标题之后，叙述主人公坐在椅中后仰；可能与“人物后仰”模式重叠，但标题格式本身不见于其他段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across descriptions of heights, architecture, and furniture; key determinations in legal text; emotional collapse; trampling in poetry; and a character’s leaning posture. These fragments have no consistent part of speech or single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Descriptions of heights, railings, and architecture
patterns.context: Narrative or explanatory text describes architecture, furniture, and their structures, often involving height, support, or surfaces; activation falls on multiple words in the relevant phrases.
patterns.domain: Novel setting descriptions, furniture product descriptions

patterns.name: Key determinations in legal argument
patterns.context: Legal decisions or litigation discussion emphasize rights, disputed issues, the scope of rights, or substantive questions.

patterns.name: Emotional hurt and collapse
patterns.context: Discusses an intense emotional reaction caused by being hurt by someone loved in an intimate relationship.

patterns.name: The action of trampling in poetry
patterns.context: A line of poetry commands something to serve as an object to be trampled; the tone is poetic or contemptuous.

patterns.name: A character’s leaning posture
patterns.context: Narrates a character standing beside a table and supporting their body with a hand.

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 激活分散于高处及建筑家具描写、法律文本的关键判断、情绪崩溃、诗歌中的践踏和人物倚靠姿态；这些片段没有一致的词类或单一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 高处、栏杆与建筑描写
patterns.context: 叙述或说明建筑、家具及其结构，常涉及高度、支撑或表面；具体激活落在相关短语中的多个词上
patterns.domain: 小说环境描写、家具产品说明

patterns.name: 法律论证中的关键判断
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉讼论述，强调权利、争议焦点、权利范围或实质性问题

patterns.name: 情绪受伤与崩溃
patterns.context: 谈及亲密关系中被爱的人伤害所导致的强烈情绪反应

patterns.name: 诗歌中践踏的动作
patterns.context: 诗行中命令某物充当被践踏之物，语气带有诗性或蔑视

patterns.name: 人物倚靠姿态
patterns.context: 叙述人物站在桌旁、以手支撑身体的姿态

en.description: The response patterns vary: a high riverbank and railings in novels; split fragments of “trample” and “shatter” in poetry and prose; issues, rights, judicial discretion, and judicial review in legal texts; and activation on a Swedish long-word fragment. The legal-issue pattern spans the most segments.

patterns.name: Elevated edge or railing
patterns.context: In a description of a setting, depicts a high edge, riverbank, or railing, especially with descriptions of position or viewpoint around “wide railing”.

patterns.name: Unusual verb segmentation
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple subwords, activation is concentrated on the beginning or middle fragment of the verb; the verbs are “trample” and “shatter”, respectively.

patterns.name: Legal issues and litigation arguments
patterns.context: Legal text presents an argumentative context involving issues, appeals, constitutional rights, judicial discretion, or judicial review.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal writing

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a long Swedish word
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary text, activation falls on a subword fragment within a word; no local semantic cue resembling the English legal pattern is apparent.

11_413.concept: 争点与显著词片段
11_413.description: 响应模式多样：小说中高处河岸与栏杆；诗歌、散文中被切分的“trample”“shatter”；法律文本中争点、权利、法院裁量和司法审查；另在瑞典语长词片段上激活。法律争点模式覆盖最多段。

patterns.name: 高处边缘或栏杆
patterns.context: 景物叙述中，描述高处边缘、河岸或栏杆，尤其「wide railing」前后有位置或视线描写。

patterns.name: 不寻常的动词切分
patterns.context: 词被分成多个子词时，激活集中在动词开头或中间片段；前者为“trample”，后者为“shatter”。

patterns.name: 法律争点与诉讼论证
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现争点、上诉、宪法权利、法院裁量或司法审查等论证语境。

patterns.name: 瑞典语长词内部片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，激活落在一个词的子词片段上；未见与英语法律模式相同的局部语义线索。

en.description: Activations span scenery, law, emotional prose, and poetry: they include legal issues, juries, and constitutional rights arguments, as well as salient adjectives, breaking, and trampling imagery. No single stable theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Descriptions of heights and architectural details
patterns.context: Narrates a character looking down at a stream from a height and describes specific scenes such as steps, a porch, and a railing; activation is concentrated on adjectives describing space or objects and some nouns.

patterns.name: Introducing a legal issue
patterns.context: A legal opinion or decision introduces the central question for consideration in a case, often next to words such as “presented”, “case”, and “here”.

patterns.name: The fundamental nature of a trial and jury
patterns.context: Discusses the constitutional status of jury trials in criminal cases, emphasizing that they are an important or fundamental feature of the American justice system.

patterns.name: Constitutional rights and adequate understanding
patterns.context: Discusses whether a defendant knew and understood their procedural or constitutional rights, particularly the court’s duty to advise and the extent of understanding shown by the record.

patterns.name: Legal effect and full weight
patterns.context: Discusses the enforcement and interpretation of a law or regulation and the full legal effect or weight it should be given.

patterns.name: Emotional hurt and breaking
patterns.context: When someone close hurts the speaker, uses imagery of breaking to describe a powerful emotional blow.

patterns.name: Trampling imagery in poetry
patterns.context: A poetic line commands that something be taken to be trampled, using a verb that conveys bodily action and destruction.

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 激活跨越景物、法律、情感散文与诗歌：包括法律争点、陪审团及宪法权利论述，也涉及显著形容词、破碎和践踏意象；未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 高处与建筑细节描写
patterns.context: 叙述人物从高处俯视溪流，并描写台阶、门廊和栏杆等具体场景；激活集中于空间或物体的形容词及部分名词。

patterns.name: 法律争点引入
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决书中引出案件待审议的核心问题，常与“presented”“case”“here”等词相邻。

patterns.name: 审判及陪审团的根本性
patterns.context: 讨论刑事审判中陪审团审判的宪法地位，强调其为美国司法制度的重要或根本特征。

patterns.name: 宪法权利与充分理解
patterns.context: 论述被告是否知晓并理解其程序性或宪法权利，尤其涉及法院告知义务及记录所显示的理解程度。

patterns.name: 法律效力与充分权重
patterns.context: 讨论法律或法规的执行、解释及应赋予其完整法律效力或权重。

patterns.name: 情感受伤与破碎
patterns.context: 亲近的人伤害说话者时，以破碎意象描述强烈的情感打击。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的践踏意象
patterns.context: 诗句命令某物被拿去践踏，使用带有身体动作和破坏意味的动词。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several unrelated phrases: expressions of spatial paths, issues and emphatic wording in legal reasoning, a verb for trampling in poetry, within-word fragments in Polish, maxillofacial medical terminology, and a metaphor of emotional brokenness; no stable semantic feature spans all passages.

patterns.name: Spatial prepositional phrases and direction
patterns.context: Describes a view, path, or positional relationship extending outward or upward from somewhere, often using successive prepositions and article phrases.

patterns.name: Issues and emphatic words in legal discussion
patterns.context: When legal text states an issue, legal right, rule's effect, or case question, activated words fall on argumentative nouns and emphatic modifiers.

patterns.name: Trampling imagery in poetry
patterns.context: In an imperative poetic line, a verb means to trample; the preceding text compares something to a pillow, and the following text turns it into something to be stepped on.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Polish word forms
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across Polish subword fragments involving expressions about other institutions, the top priority, and being involved in something.

patterns.name: Maxillofacial and joint anatomy terminology
patterns.context: Describes clinical findings and imaging results related to bone, occlusion, and the temporomandibular joint.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, orthodontics and temporomandibular joint

patterns.name: Metaphor of emotional harm as brokenness
patterns.context: Describes an intense emotional reaction to being hurt by a loved one, using “broken” as a metaphor.

11_413.concept: none
11_413.description: 激活分布于多种互不相同的词句：空间路径表达、法律论证中的争点与强调语、诗歌践踏动词、波兰语词内片段、颌面医学术语及情感破碎隐喻；未见贯穿各段的稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: 空间介词短语与方向
patterns.context: 描写从某处向外或向上延伸的视线、路径或位置关系，常见连续介词和冠词短语
patterns.domain: 文学叙事、自然景物描写

patterns.name: 法律论述中的争点与强调词
patterns.context: 法律文本在陈述争点、法律权利、规则效力或案件问题时，激活词落在论证性名词和强调性修饰语上

patterns.name: 诗歌中的践踏意象
patterns.context: 命令式诗句中，动词表示践踏；前文将某物比作枕头，后文转为踩踏用途

patterns.name: 波兰语词形中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在波兰语词内部的子词片段，涉及与其他机构、第一优先事项及涉及某事等表达

patterns.name: 颌面与关节解剖术语
patterns.context: 描述骨骼、咬合及颞下颌关节的临床表现和影像所见
patterns.domain: 医学摘要，正畸/颌面关节

patterns.name: 情感伤害的破碎隐喻
patterns.context: 描述被所爱之人伤害时的强烈情绪反应，以“破碎”作比喻

en.description: Activations center on expressions of breadth and completeness, and on emphasis of important issues, interests, and substantive effects in legal texts; there are also isolated triggers for “shatter” in emotional injury and “trample” in poetry.

patterns.name: wide / full expressions of breadth
patterns.context: An adjective of degree or scope appears before a noun; it describes a broad railing, the full set of constitutional rights, or the full weight of legal effect.

patterns.name: Legal language emphasizing importance and substance
patterns.context: Legal text emphasizes the importance of an issue, interest, or matter and its substantive impact; highlights often fall on evaluative adjectives or issue nouns.

patterns.name: Emotional impact and breaking metaphor
patterns.context: In a context of hurt in an intimate relationship, the word is split into subword fragments to describe a strong emotional blow.

patterns.name: Trampling action in poetry
patterns.context: In the imperative phrase “let it serve to … on”, the split verb means to trample; the preceding text uses poetic imagery.

11_413.concept: 强调性词语
11_413.description: 激活集中于宽泛、完整等程度/范围表达，以及法律文本中重要争点、利益和实质影响的强调；另有情感受创的“shatter”和诗歌中的“trample”两个孤立触发。

patterns.name: wide / full 宽泛程度词
patterns.context: 程度或范围形容词出现在名词前；分别描述栏杆宽阔、宪法权利全套、法律效力的完整权重。

patterns.name: 重要性与实质性法律措辞
patterns.context: 法律文本中强调争点、利益或事项的重要程度与实质影响；高亮常落在评价性形容词或争点名词上。

patterns.name: 情绪冲击与破碎隐喻
patterns.context: 在亲密关系受伤的语境中，词语被拆成子词片段；描述情感受到强烈打击。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的践踏动作
patterns.context: 祈使句“let it serve to … on”中，拆分的动词表示践踏；前文是诗歌意象。

en.description: Mainly appears in case law, highlighting the importance and effect of issues, legal rights, or matters; there are also two isolated patterns: “wide railing” in literature and “trample on” in poetry.

patterns.name: Discussion of legal issues and grounds for judgment
patterns.context: Legal text raises an issue, explains the effect of a law or a right, and uses abstract evaluative terms to emphasize its importance or completeness; not every adjacent word is marked.
patterns.domain: Case law and criminal and civil legal reasoning

patterns.name: Wide railing in a residential setting
patterns.context: Describes a wide railing on the porch of a residence; activations concentrate on the adjective wide and nearby material.

patterns.name: Trampling action in poetry
patterns.context: A poetic line commands that something be used for trampling; activation falls on the verb trample and the following preposition.

11_413.concept: 重要性与强调
11_413.description: 主要出现在判例中，突出争点、法律权利或事项的重要性与效力；另有文学中的“wide railing”和诗句中的“trample on”两种孤立模式。

patterns.name: 法律问题的论述与裁判理由
patterns.context: 法律文本中提出争点、说明法律效力或权利，并以抽象评价词强调其重要性或完整性；不是每处相邻词都被标记
patterns.domain: 判例、刑事与民事法律论证

patterns.name: 住宅景物中的宽阔栏杆
patterns.context: 叙述住宅门廊时，描述栏杆宽阔；激活集中在形容词 wide 及其邻近部分

patterns.name: 诗句中践踏的动作
patterns.context: 诗歌句中命令某物被用作践踏之物，激活落在动词 trample 及后接介词

en.description: Mixed activation patterns: the most concentrated activations occur in email archive headers, whitespace, and proper-name fragments; others are scattered across subword fragments, math problems, medical phrases, and patent terminology, with no consistent cross-segment semantics.

patterns.name: Morpheme boundaries within compound words
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented subword fragments, including word-final or word-initial fragments. These fragments occur in different contexts, with no consistent semantic function.
patterns.domain: Medical titles, math problems, patent text, and other genres

patterns.name: Email forwarding headers and whitespace fields
patterns.context: Near email header fields such as addresses, dates, and recipients, especially in formatted regions containing tabs and newlines; strong activation often occurs in whitespace between fields.

patterns.name: Entity-name or identifier fragments
patterns.context: Proper names such as people’s names, email addresses, and organization names are split into multiple tokens; activation occurs across name fragments and nearby email-header formatting, making it unclear whether it responds to the names themselves or the email format.

patterns.name: Need in a piano-related question
patterns.context: In the title-style question “First, How Long Does a Piano Need to Be”, Need has the strongest activation; there is insufficient context to establish a more general semantic trigger.

patterns.name: prime factors in math problems
patterns.context: Repeatedly appears in problems asking for the prime factors of integers; nearby are numbers and comma-separated answers.

patterns.name: in vitro model phrase
patterns.context: In a medical abstract title, “in vitro” is followed by whole bladder model; activation may relate to this fixed phrase or associated medical vocabulary.

patterns.name: Effect of polar surface-area ratio
patterns.context: In a regression-analysis passage discussing peptide retention and the nonpolar/polar surface-area ratio, the verb occurs where the variable’s effect is described.

patterns.name: Occluding component in a patent
patterns.context: In a patent description of image display and selection methods, «masked» modifies parts of array; a single passage is insufficient to infer broader trigger conditions.

11_647.concept: none
11_647.description: 激活模式混杂：邮件归档的头部、空白和专名片段最集中；其余分散在词内片段、数学题、医学短语及专利术语中，未显出跨段统一语义。

patterns.name: 合成词内部的词素边界
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词内片段上，包含词尾或词首片段；这些片段各自出现在不同语境中，未见一致的语义功能。
patterns.domain: 医学标题、数学题、专利文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 邮件转发头部与空白字段
patterns.context: 邮件地址、日期、收件人等邮件头字段附近，尤其是含制表符和换行的格式化区域；多处在字段间空白处强激活。

patterns.name: 实体名称或标识符片段
patterns.context: 姓名、邮箱地址、组织名等专名被拆成多个 token；激活分布在名称片段及其邻近邮件头格式中，无法确定是对专名本身还是邮件格式的反应。

patterns.name: 钢琴相关问句中的 Need
patterns.context: 标题式问句“First, How Long Does a Piano Need to Be”中，Need 获得最强激活；没有足够上下文证明更一般的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的 prime factors
patterns.context: 反复出现在要求列出整数质因数的题目中；附近还有数字与逗号分隔的答案。

patterns.name: 体外模型短语
patterns.context: 医学摘要的标题中，“in vitro”后接 whole bladder model；这段激活可能与该固定短语或相关医学词汇有关。

patterns.name: 极性表面积比的影响
patterns.context: 讨论肽保留率及非极性/极性表面积比的回归分析段落中，动词出现在说明变量影响的位置。

patterns.name: 专利中的遮挡部件
patterns.context: 图像显示与选择方法的专利描述中，«masked» 修饰 array 的 parts；单段证据不足以归纳更广触发条件。

en.description: Activation is heterogeneous: the most consistent pattern is headers, tabs, and delimiters in Enron emails. Other instances involve medical terminology, prime-factor questions, patent vocabulary, “Need” in a title, and “exerts” in an abstract; no unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Document delimiters and tabs
patterns.context: In email headers, forwarded messages, or structured records, delimiters and tabs separate the body, headers, and fields; especially at forwarding markers and empty fields after dates.

patterns.name: Email headers and recipient fields
patterns.context: Email metadata includes senders, recipients, email addresses, or forwarding information. Activation often falls on tabs and header-field boundaries rather than coherent body text.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within terminology
patterns.context: Specialist terms in medical titles or abstracts are split by tokenization; stronger activation falls on internal term fragments, such as “ural”.

patterns.name: Repeated prime-factor queries
patterns.context: Math problems repeatedly ask for the prime factors of a given integer; activation concentrates on “prime” and nearby text.

patterns.name: Patent terminology for image display
patterns.context: Descriptions of image-display methods using pinhole or slit arrays contrast masked portions with aperture portions.

patterns.name: “Need” in a piano question
patterns.context: A title-style question asks how long a piano needs; activation concentrates on the modal/need verb, surrounded by the title and introductory text.

patterns.name: Area ratio in regression analysis
patterns.context: An abstract discusses peptide retention and how the nonpolar/polar surface-area ratio affects retention. Activation highlights “exerts,” which expresses the relationship.

11_647.concept: 异质的结构与关键词触发
11_647.description: 激活分布异质：最一致的是 Enron 邮件中的头部、制表符与分隔结构；其余分别落在医学术语、质因数题、专利词、标题中的 Need 和摘要中的 exerts，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 文档分隔符与制表符
patterns.context: 邮件头、转发邮件或结构化记录中，分隔符和制表符用于分开正文、邮件头及字段；尤其在转发标记、日期之后的空字段位置。

patterns.name: 邮件头与收件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件元数据中出现收发件人、邮箱地址或转发信息；激活常落在 tab 及头部字段边界，而非连贯正文。

patterns.name: 术语内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 医学标题或摘要中出现被分词切开的专业术语；较强激活落在术语内部片段，如「ural」。

patterns.name: 重复的质因数查询
patterns.context: 数学题目反复要求列出给定整数的质因数，激活集中在 prime 及其附近。

patterns.name: 图像显示专利术语
patterns.context: 描述针孔阵列或狭缝阵列的图像显示方法时，出现被遮蔽部分与孔径部分的对照。

patterns.name: 钢琴问题中的 Need
patterns.context: 标题式问题询问钢琴需要多久；激活集中于情态/需求动词，周围是标题与后续引导语。

patterns.name: 回归分析中的面积比
patterns.context: 论文摘要讨论肽保留率及非极性/极性表面积比对保留的影响，激活突出于表述影响关系的「exerts」。

en.description: Activation is scattered across different corpora: isolated high responses occur in titles, medical terminology, locomotive compounds, whitespace in email headers, patent terms, scientific phrasing, and legal testimony. Email samples also show repeated responses to whitespace in structured headers.

patterns.name: Subword of “Need” in a title
patterns.context: “[thing] Need to Be …” title construction, with high activation on “Need”; the same sentence also contains the tokenized proper name “P»1iano”, but this does not establish that it is a necessary condition.

patterns.name: Subword within a neurological term
patterns.context: Occurs within tokenized “Sensorineural”, near the medical phrase “hearing loss (SNHL)”.

patterns.name: Second part of “electric” in a compound
patterns.context: Occurs in the compound “diesel-electric locomotive,” describing a locomotive type.

patterns.name: Empty fields in email records
