en.concept: Symbols and numbers in structured text
en.description: Activations occur in paper statistics and numerical results, medical tables/filtering results, and also legal case records and definitions, code diffs, and math answers. Common surface features are mostly structured symbols, numbers, and formatting markers; there is no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Statistical symbols and numerical results
patterns.context: Statistical measures, Greek letters, equal signs, and their values appear in paper text or results tables; triggers often fall on symbol or numerical fragments.

patterns.name: Court-record headings and case numbers
patterns.context: Formal heading information such as court level, jurisdiction, and case number in the layout of court opinions or case records.

patterns.name: Definitions and line breaks in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal argument introduces a term definition or quoted material, with a line break before the quotation.

patterns.name: Code-diff file headers
patterns.context: File paths, old/new version markers, and code-block location markers occur together in patches or diffs.

patterns.name: Survey exclusions and sample counts
patterns.context: Methods or sample-selection results list invalid/missing consent and corresponding counts item by item.
patterns.domain: Medical research surveys and participant screening

patterns.name: Numerical answers and rounding instructions in math exercises
patterns.context: Math problems specify decimal places or rounding, followed by a calculated value or answer.

patterns.name: Table rules and tabular numerical layout
patterns.context: Plain-text tables in papers mix aligned columns, dividers, and category/numerical cells.

patterns.name: Truncated or anomalous number/symbol fragments
patterns.context: Tables are truncated, columns misaligned, or OCR/extraction formatting is corrupted; triggers cluster around comparison symbols and numerical fragments.
patterns.domain: Extracted text from medical data tables

patterns.name: Medical terms and diagnostic test results
patterns.context: Medical abstracts report disease subtypes, suspected diagnoses, and comparisons of detection rates; this may overlap with the statistical-results pattern.

11_647.concept: 结构化文本中的符号与数值
11_647.description: 激活分布于论文统计符号和数值、医学表格/筛选结果，也见法律案卷与定义、代码 diff、数学题答案；共同的表面特征多为结构化符号、数字及格式标记，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 统计符号与数值结果
patterns.context: 论文叙述或结果表中出现统计量、希腊字母、等号及其数值；触发常落在符号或数字片段上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与统计报告

patterns.name: 法庭案卷标题与案号
patterns.trigger: “IN THE COURT OF APPEALS OF OHIO”“Nos. L-17-1290”
patterns.context: 法院判决或案卷排版中，法院层级、辖区、案件编号等正式标题信息。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的定义与换行
patterns.context: 法律论证引出术语定义或引用材料，换行后开始引文。

patterns.name: 代码差异文件头
patterns.context: 补丁或 diff 中，文件路径、旧新版本标记和代码块位置标识相邻出现。

patterns.name: 问卷排除项与样本计数
patterns.context: 研究方法或样本筛选结果中，逐项列出无效/缺失同意及对应人数。
patterns.domain: 医学研究问卷与受试者筛选

patterns.name: 数学练习的数值答案与舍入指令
patterns.trigger: “to three dps.”、“Round i to the nearest integer.”及其后的数值
patterns.context: 数学题目要求小数位数或取整，随后给出计算值/答案。

patterns.name: 表格线与表格化数值排版
patterns.context: 论文中的纯文本表格，列对齐、分隔线和类别/数值单元格混杂。

patterns.name: 残缺或异常数字/符号片段
patterns.context: 表格被截断、列错位或 OCR/抽取格式混乱，触发集中于比较符号和数字片段。
patterns.domain: 医学数据表格抽取文本

patterns.name: 医学术语与诊断检验结果
patterns.context: 医学摘要中报告疾病分型、疑似诊断及检测率比较；可能与统计结果模式重叠。

en.concept: Numbers and link fragments in formatted text
en.description: Activations concentrate on local fragments in format-dense text, especially the domain and path of Atlantic links; also seen on numeric symbols, parentheses, and partial subword splits in statistics, mathematics, and demographic data.

patterns.name: Domain in The Atlantic links
patterns.context: The domain atlantic.com is split into marked subwords in link URLs, usually near HackerNews post titles or links.

patterns.name: Numeric and statistical symbol strings
patterns.context: Numbers, punctuation, variables, and units are interleaved in tables, statistical results in papers, or math problems; activations fall on some numeric or symbol fragments.
patterns.domain: Academic statistical text and math exercises

patterns.name: Parentheses and adjacent text
patterns.context: Parentheses and the results, values, or explanations inside them; some numbers may be split by tokenization.
patterns.domain: Medical paper text and scale reporting

patterns.name: Demographic number fragments
patterns.context: Words, punctuation, and numbers occur adjacent to one another in demographic data such as total population, urban and rural population, and sex ratios.

patterns.name: Newlines before titles or links
patterns.context: In HackerNews posts, an article title or URL immediately follows a newline; the newline is marked, but this does not occur in all such passages.

patterns.name: Split intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Common English words are split by the tokenizer, with activations on subword fragments inside words; the available examples are insufficient to identify a shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Article link path fragments
patterns.context: The path or archive portion of Atlantic article URLs; activations are distributed across path markers and nearby subword fragments.

11_647.concept: 格式化文本中的数字与链接片段
11_647.description: 激活集中于格式密集文本中的局部片段：尤其是 Atlantic 链接的域名与路径；另见统计、数学和人口数据中的数字符号、括号及部分拆词。

patterns.name: The Atlantic 链接中的域名
patterns.context: 链接 URL 中将域名 atlantic.com 拆分为带标记的子词；通常是 HackerNews 帖子标题或链接附近。

patterns.name: 数字与统计符号串
patterns.context: 表格、论文统计结果或数学题中，数字、标点、变量和单位交错出现；激活落在若干数字或符号片段上。
patterns.domain: 学术统计文本与数学练习

patterns.name: 括号及其邻接文本
patterns.context: 括号及括号内的结果、数值或说明；部分数字可能因分词而被拆开。
patterns.domain: 医学论文正文与量表报告

patterns.name: 人口统计数字片段
patterns.context: 人口总数、城乡人数及性别比例等人口统计数据中，词语、标点与数字相邻。

patterns.name: 标题或链接前的换行
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子中换行后紧接文章标题或 URL；换行本身被标记，但并非所有此类段落都出现。

patterns.name: 拆分的词内片段
patterns.context: 常见英文单词被分词器拆开，激活落在词中间的子词；现有例子不足以确定共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 文章链接路径片段
patterns.context: Atlantic 文章 URL 的路径或归档部分；激活分散在路径标记及邻近词片段。

en.concept: Boundaries and markers in structured text
en.description: Activations span multiple text types and often fall on newlines, delimiters, and structural boundaries; they also occur in chemical figure captions, statistical tables, code type declarations, and paper titles, making them difficult to attribute to a single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Symbols and line breaks in math problems
patterns.context: An arithmetic expression or problem is followed by a newline and an answer/next problem; activations cluster near line breaks and some punctuation and numbers.

patterns.name: Numerical markers in chemical structure captions
patterns.context: Chemical paper captions discuss atoms, bond lengths, displacement ellipsoids, and structure diagrams; markers also occur near image filenames.

patterns.name: Delimiters in URLs and URL paths
patterns.context: In news links and their slugs, activations occur around URLs, path separators, and hyphens.

patterns.name: Table layout and statistical values
patterns.context: Activations occur near horizontal rules, inter-column spaces, line breaks, and statistical data in paper results tables.

patterns.name: Integer width in type declarations
patterns.context: An integer type and bit width follow a field name in code; activations also cover some identifiers.

patterns.name: Section and table-structure markers in papers
patterns.context: Occurs when paper text transitions from a results paragraph to a section heading or table reference.

11_647.concept: 结构化文本边界与标记
11_647.description: 激活跨多种文本类型，常落在换行、分隔符及结构化边界；另在化学图注、统计表、代码类型声明和论文标题处出现，难以归结为单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 数学题中的符号与换行
patterns.context: 算术表达式或题目后接换行和答案/下一题；激活集中在换行及部分标点、数字附近。

patterns.name: 化学结构图说明中的数字标记
patterns.context: 化学论文图注，涉及原子、键长、位移椭球和结构图；标记也落在图像文件名附近。

patterns.name: URL 与网址路径中的分隔符
patterns.context: 新闻链接及其 slug 中，激活分布在网址、路径分隔符和连字符附近。

patterns.name: 表格排版及统计数值
patterns.context: 论文结果表格中，横线、列间空白、换行及统计数据附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 类型声明中的整数宽度
patterns.context: 代码中字段名后接整数类型及位宽；激活也覆盖部分标识符。

patterns.name: 论文章节与表格结构标记
patterns.context: 论文正文从结果段落转入章节标题或表格引用时出现。

en.description: Activations span several heterogeneous formats: numbers and column separators in statistical tables, hyphens and newlines in Hacker News link slugs, subword fragments within German words, and wording in remainder problems. The trigger conditions differ, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric columns in statistical tables
patterns.context: Numbers, percentages, or statistical values arranged in table columns, often with headers, spaces, separator lines, and parentheses; activations fall on numbers, punctuation, and whitespace between columns.
patterns.domain: Demographic data, medical research tables, and numeric tables

patterns.name: Slug line breaks in Hacker News links
patterns.context: In Hacker News link previews, URLs/titles are hyphenated; fragments continue across a line break or truncation, with activations often near title words, hyphens, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Fragments within German compound words
patterns.context: In continuous German prose, words are segmented into subword fragments; activations concentrate on fragments within words, especially compounds or inflected words.

patterns.name: Remainder wording in math problems
patterns.context: English questions or instructions ask for the remainder of a division, followed by an integer operation or answer.

11_647.concept: none
11_647.description: 激活覆盖多类异质格式：统计表格中的数字与分列符号、Hacker News 链接 slug 的连字符及换行、德语词内子词片段，以及余数题措辞。各类触发条件不同，缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 统计表格中的数字列
patterns.context: 数字、百分比或统计值排列在表格列中，常伴随表头、空格、分隔线及括号；激活落在数字、标点和列间空白上。
patterns.domain: 人口统计、医学研究表格及数值表

patterns.name: Hacker News 链接中的 slug 换行
patterns.trigger: URL 或链接文字里的连字符及跨行词组，如 «get-productive-with-automation»、«china-wants-to-dig-the-nicaragua-canal»
patterns.context: Hacker News 链接预览中，URL/标题由连字符连接；片段在换行或截断处继续，激活常落在标题词、连字符及换行附近。

patterns.name: 德语复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 德语连续正文中，词被子词片段切分；激活集中在词内部片段，尤其复合词或屈折词。

patterns.name: 数学题中的余数措辞
patterns.context: 以英文提问或指令询问除法余数，问题后跟整数运算式或答案。

en.concept: Numbers and markers in structured text
en.description: Most prominent in math problems involving numeric comparisons, negative numbers, and variable expressions; sporadic responses also occur to expanded polynomials, table numbers and inequality signs, demographic figures, legal subparagraphs, and forum links, markers, and edit sections.

patterns.name: Comparatives and ordering in math problems
patterns.context: Math exercises ask for the largest, smallest, second-largest, or second-smallest among several values or variables; often followed by an answer letter and the next problem.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics textbook or question bank

patterns.name: Minus signs and values in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in variable definitions, value lists, or expressions, especially comparison problems; numbers and operators have irregular spacing in symbolic text.

patterns.name: Algebraic expansion problems
patterns.context: An Expand instruction asks to expand a polynomial containing multiplication, minus signs, exponents, and variable-like characters.

patterns.name: Numbers and inequality signs in tables
patterns.context: Numbers are arranged in rows and columns, possibly in a grouped statistical table; activations fall near inequality signs, values, and table formatting.

patterns.name: Demographic figures
patterns.context: Describes regional total population, urban and rural populations, and sex and age composition; numbers have thousands separators or percentages in parentheses.

patterns.name: Legal section numbers and subparagraphs
patterns.context: Legal sentences connect clauses with subparagraph numbering, listing conditions such as in-state services or related goods.

patterns.name: Hacker News links and markers
patterns.context: Titles, URLs, edit notes, and Markdown separators in forum posts or duplicate-detection output.

patterns.name: Deictic words and paragraph transitions in forum posts
patterns.context: A post first makes a comment, then uses Edit to introduce a link to an earlier discussion, with a line break.

11_647.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与标记
11_647.description: 最突出的是数学题中比较数值大小、负数及变量算式；另对展开多项式、表格数字和不等号、人口统计数字、法律分项，以及论坛的链接、标记和编辑段落有零散响应。

patterns.name: 数学题中的比较级与排序
patterns.trigger: “What is the second biggest value”, “the smallest value”, “Which is the biggest value”, “the second biggest value”；选项含“(a)”“(b)”“(c)”
patterns.context: 在数学练习题中，要求从若干数值或变量中找最大、最小、第二大或第二小；常紧接答案字母及下一题。

patterns.name: 数学式中的负号与数值
patterns.context: 出现在变量定义、数值列表或算式中，尤其是比较大小题；符号化文本中数字与运算符间隔不规则。

patterns.name: 代数展开题
patterns.context: 以 Expand 指令要求展开多项式，包含乘法、负号、幂次和类似变量的字符。

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与不等号
patterns.trigger: “≤260”、“>260”及数值、括号内数值和表格列
patterns.context: 数字按行列排列，可能是分组统计表；激活落在不等号、数值及表格排版附近。

patterns.name: 人口统计数字
patterns.context: 描述地区总人口、城乡人口、性别及年龄构成，数字带千位分隔符或括号百分比。

patterns.name: 法律条文编号与分项
patterns.trigger: “(1d)”、“Relates to goods,”及条文中的分项标记
patterns.context: 法律句子以分项编号衔接，列举州内服务或相关商品等条件。

patterns.name: Hacker News 链接与标记
patterns.context: 论坛帖子或重复检测输出中的标题、URL、编辑说明及 Markdown 分隔符。

patterns.name: 论坛句中的指示词与段落转折
patterns.trigger: “fall into this trap.”、“Edit: see previous discussion on this here:”
patterns.context: 帖子正文先作评论，随后以 Edit 引出先前讨论链接，并伴随换行。

en.description: The strongest and most recurrent pattern occurs in math problems: negative numbers, operators, sequences, comparison prompts, and nearby problem delimiters. There are also sporadic responses to demographic number formats, punctuation in legal quotations, table fields, and news URL fragments, which cannot be reduced to a single stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Minus signs in math problems
patterns.context: A minus sign precedes a value, often near comparisons, sequences, or negative numbers in algebraic expressions; the activation marker does not always cover the entire number.

patterns.name: Operators and expressions in math problems
patterns.context: Operators occur in algebraic expressions, sequence problems, or integer-division/remainder problems, including expressions composed of variables and numbers.

patterns.name: Ordinal/ranking language in math problems
patterns.context: Questions ask for a term in a sequence or the maximum, minimum, or rank of a set of numbers; activations favor short function words and related symbols in the prompt.

patterns.name: Answers or delimiters in math problems
patterns.context: Activations occur near newlines and punctuation separating problems, choices, answers, or adjacent problems.

patterns.name: Numbers and parentheses in demographic statistics
patterns.context: Activations occur near formatting in demographic sentences, such as prepositions, parentheses, and percentages around values.

patterns.name: Quotation punctuation in judicial opinions
patterns.context: When a legal opinion introduces court instructions or a quotation, activations occur on the colon, newline, and quotation onset.

patterns.name: Table fields and country names
patterns.context: In a suspected email table with aligned columns, activations occur near country names, indentation, and numerical columns; the trigger relationship is unclear.

patterns.name: URL and news-headline word fragments
patterns.context: In webpage links and news headlines, activations occur near URL segmentation, hyphens, and segmented English words.

11_647.concept: 数学题标记及局部符号
11_647.description: 最强且反复的模式出现在数学题：负数、运算符、数列和大小比较题干，以及题目分隔符附近。另对人口统计数字格式、法律引述标点、表格字段和新闻网址词片段有零星响应，不能化为单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的负号
patterns.context: 负号出现在数值前，常与比较大小、数列或代数表达式中的负数相邻；激活标记并不总覆盖整个数字。

patterns.name: 数学题中的运算符与表达式
patterns.context: 运算符出现在代数式、数列题或整除求余题中；包括变量与数字构成的表达式。

patterns.name: 数学题中的序数/排名表述
patterns.trigger: «the»1 smallest value、«the»1 second biggest value、«i'th term»
patterns.context: 询问数列的某项或一组数中的最大、最小及其次序；激活偏向题干中的短功能词及相关符号。

patterns.name: 数学题的答案或分隔符
patterns.context: 题目、选项、答案或相邻题目之间的换行与标点附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 人口统计中的数字与括号
patterns.context: 人口统计句中，数值前后的介词、括号和百分比等格式化文本附近激活。

patterns.name: 判决书引述标点
patterns.context: 法律判决在引出法院指示或引文时，冒号、换行及引文起始处激活。

patterns.name: 表格字段及国家名称
patterns.context: 疑似邮件中的对齐表格，国家名称、缩进及数值列附近有激活；触发关系不明确。

patterns.name: 网址与新闻标题词片段
patterns.context: 网页链接及新闻标题中，网址分段、连字符和被切分的英文词附近激活。

en.concept: Boundaries and symbols in structured text
en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous text: most concentrated in numeric comparisons and variable definitions in math problems; also seen on table rows, lists of country names and numbers, paper formulas, legal citations and clauses, and literary bibliographies. A possible common thread is structured boundaries or punctuation, but there is no stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Numeric comparison prompts in math problems after a newline
patterns.context: A math exercise instruction or variable definition appears at a line break, often comparing several candidate values; in some examples, activations fall on the answer or minus sign.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; [4][5][10] are word problems, [6] is a sequence problem followed by a word problem

patterns.name: Structural markers in numeric tables
patterns.context: Quantitative table rows separated by newlines, containing comparison symbols, values in parentheses, and aligned numeric columns.

patterns.name: Aligned lists of numbers and country names
patterns.context: Country names appear as line-by-line entries embedded between whitespace-padded numeric columns.
patterns.domain: List or table fragments in Enron Emails

patterns.name: Physics prose with mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In physics paper prose, LaTeX mathematical formulas follow text on confidence levels and bounds.

patterns.name: Citations and punctuation in legal documents
patterns.context: Testimony quotations or resolution clauses appear in the body of legal decisions or legislation; activations are scattered across quotation marks, hyphens, and clause openings.

patterns.name: Bibliographic mentions of titles and names
patterns.context: Narrative text lists people and travel- or memoir-related books, with quotation marks and bibliographic-style names.

11_647.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与符号
11_647.description: 激活分布于异质文本：数学题的数值比较与变量定义最集中；另见表格行、国家名数字列表、论文公式、法律引文条款及文学书目。共同线索可能是结构化边界或标点，但并非稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 换行后数学题目中的数值比较提示
patterns.trigger: “Let w =”“Let s =”“Let y =”“Let g =”“What is the second biggest value”“What is the smallest value”“Which is the biggest value”及其后的“w”“y”“-”
patterns.context: 换行处出现数学练习题指令或变量定义，常比较若干候选数的大小；若干例子中激活落在答案或负号上。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；[4][5][10]为文字题，[6]为数列题后接续文字题

patterns.name: 数字表格中的结构标记
patterns.context: 换行分隔的定量表格行，含比较符号、括号内数值及对齐的数字列。

patterns.name: 数字与国家名的对齐列表
patterns.trigger: “Venezuela”“Lithuania”“Trinidad and Tobago”及其前后的数字、空格和换行
patterns.context: 国家名作为逐行条目，嵌在空白填充的数字列之间。
patterns.domain: Enron Emails 中的列表或表格片段

patterns.name: 带数学公式的物理学文字
patterns.context: 物理学论文正文中，置信水平与上下限文字后接 LaTeX 数学公式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的引文与标点
patterns.trigger: “‘less than forthcoming’”“‘acknowledged telling’”及引号、冒号、编号“71.”
patterns.context: 法律判决或立法文件正文中，出现证词引述或决议条款；激活散落在引号、连字符及条款起始处。

patterns.name: 书名与人名的书目式提及
patterns.trigger: “David Glasgow Farragut;”“S. A. Drake”及书名引号
patterns.context: 叙述文字中列举人物及旅行、回忆类书籍，伴随引号和书目式名称。

en.concept: Negative numbers and values in formatted text
en.description: Activations occur most often on minus signs, negative numbers, and comparison or sequence problems in math exercises; they also cover formatted content such as demographic percentages, deposition Q&A markers, and place names and numbers in tables, making it difficult to assign a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Minus signs and negative-number expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign is adjacent to a negative number, often in problems defining variables, listing values, or constructing expressions; a few other contexts involve ordinary prose or table numbers.
patterns.domain: Primarily math problems, also demographic data and country tables

patterns.name: Question words in comparison problems
patterns.context: Asks for a comparison among candidate values, often adjacent to variable definitions and an answer or new problem on the following line.

patterns.name: Negative-number sequences and term questions in math problems
patterns.context: A problem gives a sequence or algebraic expression and asks for a term; activations also fall on minus signs and numbers in the sequence.

patterns.name: Numeric transitions in demographic data
patterns.context: Statistical prose reporting total population, urban/rural breakdowns, and quantities and percentages by sex.

patterns.name: Q&A markers in deposition text
patterns.context: A newline is followed by numbering and quotation markers in Q&A-style court testimony; activations are not concentrated on clearly mathematical content.

patterns.name: Place names and numeric fields in tables
patterns.context: Country or region names are listed line by line beside abbreviations and numeric fields; activations fall on place names and field values.

11_647.concept: 格式化文本中的负数与数值
11_647.description: 激活最常见于数学题中的负号、负数及比较大小或数列题；另覆盖人口统计百分比、证词问答标记和表格地名与数字等格式化内容，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 负号与负数表达式
patterns.context: 负号紧邻负数，常出现在定义变量、列举数值或构造算式的题目中；另有少数上下文是普通文本或表格数字。
patterns.domain: 主要为数学题，亦见人口统计和国家表格

patterns.name: 比较大小题中的问句词
patterns.context: 要求比较候选数的大小，常与变量定义及后续换行的答案或新题相邻。

patterns.name: 数学题中的负数序列与项式提问
patterns.trigger: 负数列表，以及 “What is the h'th term” / “What is the o'th term”
patterns.context: 题目给出数列或代数式，询问某一项；激活也落在序列里的负号与数字上。

patterns.name: 人口统计中的数值衔接
patterns.trigger: “population of” 后的 “« of»”及数字、“« (»”后的百分比
patterns.context: 人口总量、城乡拆分及按性别给出的数量和百分比，格式为统计叙述。

patterns.name: 证词文本中的问答标记
patterns.context: 换行后出现编号与引号标记，处于问答式法庭证词中；激活不集中于明显的数学内容。

patterns.name: 表格中的地名与数字字段
patterns.context: 国家或地区名称逐行排列，旁有缩写和数字字段；激活落在地名与字段数字上。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的表格/清单

en.concept: Markers near numbers and structured data
en.description: Activations concentrate on minus signs, arithmetic expressions, and numbers in math problems, and also occur near quantities and percentages in statistical text, values in medical tables, and names, quotations, and Q&A markers in legal text; they do not reduce to a single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Minus signs and negative numbers in math problems
patterns.context: In math problems, sequences, or arithmetic expressions, a minus sign may indicate subtraction or a negative number; tokens near multiple minus signs are marked in the fragments.

patterns.name: Arithmetic prompts and answers
patterns.context: Near arithmetic problems and their expressions or answers; activations fall on prompt wording, operators, or numbers, not just one type of operation.

patterns.name: Number-sequence problems
patterns.context: A question asking for the next number follows a continuous sequence containing multiple integers or negative numbers.

patterns.name: Base conversion or base arithmetic
patterns.context: Addition or algebra problems explicitly specify a base and include values and alphanumeric characters.

patterns.name: Rounding instructions
patterns.context: A variable value or expression is given, followed by an instruction to round to a specified precision.

patterns.name: Demographic numbers and percentages in parentheses
patterns.context: Demographic prose reports data as population figures, breakdowns by sex, and percentages in parentheses.

patterns.name: Apartment occupancy statistics
patterns.context: Reports total apartments, permanently or seasonally occupied units, and vacant units, with percentages.

patterns.name: Table values and group labels
patterns.context: Multi-column group data in a medical paper table, including thresholds, counts, or percentages; context is truncated, so the specific measure is unclear.

patterns.name: People and quotations in legal text
patterns.context: A legal opinion discusses a party's testimony and cross-examination, with activations distributed around names and quotations.

patterns.name: Q&A-style testimony
patterns.context: Legal investigation or testimony records use a question-and-answer format to ask about the investigation and case findings.

11_647.concept: 数字与结构化数据附近的标记
11_647.description: 激活集中于数学题中的负号、运算表达式与数字，也出现在统计文本的数量及百分比、医学表格数值，以及法律文本的人名、引语和问答标记附近；难以归结为单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学题中的减号与负数
patterns.trigger: « -»，以及“-”出现在运算式或数值中
patterns.context: 数学题、数列或计算表达式中，减号可能表示减法，也可能是负数的符号；片段中多个负号附近的 token 被标记

patterns.name: 算术运算提示与答案
patterns.context: 算术题及其计算表达式或答案附近；激活落在提示语、运算符或数字上，并非只对应某一种运算

patterns.name: 数字序列题
patterns.context: 连续数列后提出求下一个数的问题，题目包含多项整数或负数

patterns.name: 进制转换或进制算术
patterns.context: 明确指定进制的加法或代数问题，式中包含数值及字母数字

patterns.name: 四舍五入指令
patterns.trigger: “Round h to the nearest 100000”“Round a to one dp”
patterns.context: 先给出变量数值或表达式，再要求按指定精度取整

patterns.name: 人口统计数字及括号百分比
patterns.context: 人口统计叙述以人口数、性别分项及括号内比例报告数据

patterns.name: 公寓占比统计
patterns.context: 报告公寓总量、永久或季节性占用量及空置量，并附比例

patterns.name: 表格数值及分组标签
patterns.context: 医学论文表格的多列分组数据，包含阈值、计数或百分比；上下文截断，具体指标不明

patterns.name: 法律文本中的人物与引述
patterns.context: 法律意见书讨论当事人的证词与交叉询问，激活分布在姓名、引语附近

patterns.name: 问答式证词
patterns.context: 法律调查或证词记录以问答格式呈现，问及调查和案件判断

en.description: Responses are diverse: numbers, minus signs, and operations in math problems; structured keys and values, punctuation, and line breaks in code configuration; and also legal narrative, demographic figures, and HTTP cache headers. No single stable trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Legal citations and testimony narratives
patterns.context: In legal opinions discussing evidence, witness statements, or cross-examination, activations fall on line breaks after quotations, delimiters, and adjacent text.

patterns.name: JSON/Jupyter structure and indentation
patterns.context: In serialized notebooks or application configuration, keys and values, quotes, commas, brackets, and line breaks form structured data.

patterns.name: Configuration entries and numerical parameters
patterns.context: Configuration files list options, Boolean values, and numbers consecutively; activations cluster near indentation, key names, or punctuation.

patterns.name: Demographic numbers and percentages
patterns.context: Demographic or regional-statistics narratives contain consecutive quantities with thousands separators and percentages.

patterns.name: Negative numbers and numerical sequences in math problems
patterns.context: Arithmetic, sequence, ordering, or comparison problems contain minus signs, numbers, and operation instructions; sometimes problems and answers appear consecutively.

patterns.name: HTTP cache-control directives
patterns.context: HTTP response headers list cache policies as key-value pairs, including hyphenated directives.

patterns.name: Ordinary negative numbers and numerical comparisons
patterns.context: Math word problems mix variables, equations, ordering, and signed values; they share number and minus-sign features with other math problems but are not necessarily pure arithmetic.

11_647.concept: 结构化数字与标点模式
11_647.description: 响应范围较杂：数学题中的数字、负号与运算，代码配置中的结构化键值、标点和换行，另见法律叙述、人口统计数字及HTTP缓存头；未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 法律引文与证词叙述
patterns.context: 法律意见中讨论证据、证人陈述或交叉询问时；激活落在引文后的换行、分隔符及相邻文本上。

patterns.name: JSON/Jupyter结构与缩进
patterns.context: 序列化的笔记本或应用配置中，键值、引号、逗号、括号和换行构成结构化数据。

patterns.name: 配置项与数值参数
patterns.context: 配置文件中连续列出选项、布尔值和数字，激活集中于缩进、键名或标点附近。

patterns.name: 人口统计数字及百分比
patterns.context: 人口或地域统计叙述中，连续出现带千位分隔符的数量和百分比。

patterns.name: 数学题中的负数与数字序列
patterns.context: 算术、数列、排序或比较题中出现负号、数字及运算指令；有时题目与答案连续排列。

patterns.name: HTTP缓存控制指令
patterns.context: HTTP响应头以键值形式列出缓存策略，包含连字符连接的指令。

patterns.name: 普通负数与数值比较
patterns.context: 数学文字题中混合变量、方程、排序与带符号数值；与其他数学题共享数字和负号特征，但未必是纯算术题。

en.description: Primarily responds to colons, quotations opened after line breaks, quotation marks, section numbers, and testimony formatting in legal documents; also activates on quotation-mark punctuation structures in JSON/Python code and questions about negative-integer sequences, whose relationship to the main pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Colon-introduced quotations in legal text
patterns.context: A legal opinion or decision introduces a statute, testimony, clause, or similar material, then opens a quotation with a colon, line break, and quotation mark; activations concentrate on the quotation-opening markers and nearby formatting.

patterns.name: Numbering or clause formatting in legal quotations
patterns.context: Quoted content is presented with numbering, asterisks, ellipses, or uppercase headings, possibly in legal provisions, tables, or exhibit formatting; no single fixed punctuation pattern is required.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal documents and quoted material

patterns.name: Quotation and testimony markers in legal documents
patterns.context: Near quotations from testimony, cross-examination, or written statements, including quotation marks, Q&A labels, or quoted claims; not all legal quotation openings have these markers.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw litigation records, testimony, or opinions

patterns.name: Quotation marks and key-value structure in JSON/code
patterns.context: Code or configuration data contains double-quoted keys, colons, and string values; this example does not show the same clear context as legal quotations.

patterns.name: Python regular expressions and code punctuation
patterns.context: Python code contains regular-expression calls, quotation marks, parentheses, and other symbols; may be related to sensitivity to quotation marks or punctuation, but is not legal text.

patterns.name: Negative-number lists and continuation questions in math sequences
patterns.context: A comma-separated series of negative integers is followed by a newline and the question “What is next”; it is not obviously related to the legal or code patterns.

11_647.concept: 引文及结构化标点
11_647.description: 主要对法律文书中冒号、换行后开启的引文及其引号、条款编号和证词格式响应；另在 JSON/Python 代码的引号标点结构、负整数数列提问中激活，后两类与主模式关系不明。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的冒号引述起始
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决先介绍法规、证词、条款等，随后用冒号、换行和引号开启引用内容；激活集中于引用起始标记及其邻近格式。

patterns.name: 法律文书引文中的编号或条款格式
patterns.context: 引述内容以编号、星号、省略点或大写标题呈现，可能是法律条款、表格或证物格式；并不要求同一固定标点。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律文书及引述材料

patterns.name: 法律文书中的引语与证词标记
patterns.context: 证词、交叉询问或书面陈述的引语附近，包含引号、问答标签或被引用的说法；不是所有法律引文起始都具备此类标记。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 诉讼记录、证词或意见书

patterns.name: JSON/代码中的引号及键值结构
patterns.context: 代码或配置数据中出现双引号包围的键、冒号和字符串值；此例未显示与法律引文相同的明确上下文。

patterns.name: Python 正则表达式与代码标点
patterns.context: Python 代码中出现正则表达式调用、引号及括号等符号；可能与引号或标点敏感有关，但不属于法律文本。

patterns.name: 数学序列中的负数列表与续项提问
patterns.context: 一串逗号分隔的负整数后出现换行，并以“What is next”询问后续项；与法律和代码模式均不明显相同。

en.description: Activation examples span code fields and HTTP headers, escaped documentation, math sequences, legal prose and quotations, and demographic data and medical tables. At most, they share punctuation, numbers, or fields in structured text, but their specific meanings and genres differ substantially, so they cannot be grouped under a single theme.

patterns.name: JSON/code key-value pairs and structured fields
patterns.context: A key is followed by a colon or arrow, quotation marks, parentheses, arrays/objects, indentation, or other structural symbols; activations are distributed around field names and formatting punctuation.
patterns.domain: Github configuration/serialized data; StackExchange code examples

patterns.name: HTTP response headers and protocol fields
patterns.context: HTTP headers consist of string keys and values in a list, with line breaks, indentation, and commas.

patterns.name: Escaped newlines and docstrings
patterns.context: Escaped newlines in code or configuration surround explanatory text, followed by a URL; it is unclear whether activation targets the escape sequence or explanatory text.

patterns.name: Number sequences and next-term questions
patterns.context: Numbers, commas, and question marks form a sequence problem; activations fall on numeric fragments and punctuation.

patterns.name: Procedure, capacity, and assessment in legal text
patterns.context: Describes procedures and assessments of the capacity of a court, institution, or party; notable activations include body words as well as line breaks and quotation marks.

patterns.name: Demographic figures and percentages
patterns.context: Population counts and percentages grouped by sex and age; parentheses and prose appear around the numbers.

patterns.name: Table headers and measurement data
patterns.context: Spaced-aligned column headers and separator lines appear alongside subject measurements in a table.

patterns.name: Travel destinations and private letters in quotations
patterns.context: A legal document paraphrases or quotes private letters mentioning travel destinations and friends or family; activations concentrate on quotation marks, place names, and quoted text.

11_647.concept: none
11_647.description: 激活例子跨越代码字段与HTTP头、转义文档、数学数列、法律叙述和引文，以及人口统计和医学表格。共同点至多是结构化文本中的标点、数字或字段，但具体词义与文体差异明显，不能据此归为单一主题。

patterns.name: JSON/代码键值与结构化字段
patterns.context: 键名后接冒号或箭头、引号、括号、数组/对象及缩进等结构符号；激活分布在字段名与格式化标点周围。
patterns.domain: Github 配置/序列化数据；StackExchange 代码示例

patterns.name: HTTP 响应头与协议字段
patterns.context: HTTP 头部以字符串键和值组成列表，伴随换行、缩进和逗号。
patterns.domain: Github 中的网络/服务器数据

patterns.name: 转义换行及文档字符串
patterns.trigger: "\\n"、"If you are not using a US-based region..."、"https://"
patterns.context: 代码或配置中的转义换行包围说明性文字，随后出现 URL；不能确定激活是针对转义符还是说明文本。

patterns.name: 数字序列与下一项问题
patterns.trigger: “What is the next term in”、“What comes next”，以及“270, 66, 10104, 13677”等数字串
patterns.context: 数字、逗号和问号构成数列题；激活落在数值片段和标点上。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的程序、能力与评估
patterns.trigger: “VA approval or certification”、“explained”、“slipped from competency to incompetency”、“appointed Dr. Guy Renfro to perform a psychological evaluation”
patterns.context: 叙述法院、机构或当事人的程序与能力评估；显著激活包含正文词语，也有换行和引号。

patterns.name: 人口统计数字与百分比
patterns.context: 人口数量及按性别、年龄分组的百分比；数字前后有括号和正文。

patterns.name: 表格列标题与测量数据
patterns.context: 表格中以空格对齐的列标题、分隔线与受试者测量值并列。

patterns.name: 引文中的旅行地点与私人书信
patterns.context: 法律文书转述或引用私人信件，提及旅行目的地及亲友；激活集中于引号、地点名和引述文字。
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的书信引文

en.description: Activations occur across code, data, and legal/encyclopedic prose, often on punctuation, quotation marks, line breaks, numbers, and field boundaries; specific semantics vary, with no single theme. They appear primarily sensitive to structured-text boundaries and mixed numeric formats.

patterns.name: Structured punctuation and field boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs at the boundaries of fields, list items, or text fragments; no particular domain is required.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric formats
patterns.context: Numbers are often adjacent to separators, quotation marks, or line breaks; sometimes they are JSON values, and sometimes quantities in prose.
patterns.domain: Code, legal, demographic, and data text

patterns.name: Code and key-value/type declarations
patterns.context: Keys, values, types, and punctuation are interleaved in structured configuration or mappings.

patterns.name: Legal quotations and trial Q&A markers
patterns.context: A decision or trial record introduces quotations, testimony, or Q&A content.

patterns.name: Long numeric strings and list data
patterns.context: Indented arrays or table-like data separated by line breaks, with comma-separated numbers.

patterns.name: HTTP request fields
patterns.context: An HTTP request is represented by key-value fields and a JSON body.

patterns.name: Parentheses, percentages, and population figures in prose
patterns.context: In demographic prose, parentheses enclose percentages or numbers, and figures are embedded in ordinary sentences.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and word breaks in English quotations
patterns.context: Ordinary legal prose contains direct quotations, line breaks, and words split across fragments.

patterns.name: URL/region configuration strings
patterns.context: Documentation describes regional adaptation, with a link and indented configuration text nearby.

11_647.concept: 文本结构边界与数字格式
11_647.description: 激活分布在代码、数据与法律/百科正文中，常落在标点、引号、换行、数字及字段边界；具体语义多样，未见单一主题，主要像对结构化文本边界和混合数字格式敏感。

patterns.name: 结构化标点与字段边界
patterns.context: 标点出现在字段、列表项或文本片段的边界；不要求特定领域
patterns.domain: 代码、法律文本、统计文本

patterns.name: 数字与数字格式
patterns.context: 数字常与分隔符、引号或换行相邻；有时是 JSON 数值，有时是正文中的数量
patterns.domain: 代码、法律、人口统计及数据文本

patterns.name: 代码与键值/类型声明
patterns.context: 结构化配置或映射中，键、值、类型和标点交错出现
patterns.domain: Github 配置、StackExchange 技术内容

patterns.name: 法律引文与庭审问答标记
patterns.context: 判决或庭审记录中引出引文、证词或问答内容

patterns.name: 长数字串与列表数据
patterns.context: 换行缩进的数组或表格状数据，数字以逗号分隔

patterns.name: HTTP 请求字段
patterns.context: 请求描述中以键值字段和 JSON 正文表示 HTTP 请求

patterns.name: 正文中的括号、百分比和人口数字
patterns.context: 人口统计叙述中，括号包围比例或数字，数字嵌在普通句子里

patterns.name: 英文引文中的引号与断词
patterns.context: 普通法律叙述中含直接引语、换行及跨片段词语

patterns.name: URL/区域配置字符串
patterns.context: 文档说明区域适配，并在附近出现链接及缩进配置文本

en.description: Patterns span numerical tables and arithmetic, formatting anomalies in patent text, HTML/JSON code, and legal narratives; trigger points vary, with some clustering around numbers and punctuation, but overall there is no unified semantic or stylistic feature.

patterns.name: Number strings with decimals and symbols
patterns.context: Activations fall on numbers, punctuation, and surrounding spaces; numbers often appear as decimals, negatives, percentages, or consecutive values in tables.
patterns.domain: Medical statistical tables, math problems, and numerical calculations; paragraphs 2, 4, 9, 10

patterns.name: Sparse or misaligned whitespace
patterns.context: The text consists mostly of extensive whitespace, isolated letters, and mathematical symbols, without readable continuous sentences; occurs in patent background material.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent text (this fragment appears to have formatting or extraction anomalies)

patterns.name: HTML tags and template concatenation
patterns.context: Code generates a page template containing HTML tags through string concatenation; activations occur near tags, quotation marks, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Quotations and procedural language in court records
patterns.context: Legal narrative or trial transcript contains court statements, procedural language, and quotations.

patterns.name: Testimony and cross-examination in legal opinions
patterns.context: Opinions recount the credibility, testimony, and questioning of witnesses or parties.

patterns.name: Keys, values, and nested fields in JSON configuration
patterns.context: Machine-readable configuration organizes data as JSON-style key-value pairs, arrays, and nested objects.

patterns.name: Jupyter Notebook code-cell structure
patterns.context: JSON metadata in a Notebook export is followed by code source content.

patterns.name: Kinematics terms in tables
patterns.context: Anatomical or movement-item names are presented alongside adjacent measurement values.
patterns.domain: Medical tables (possibly range-of-motion or physical-examination data)

11_647.concept: none
11_647.description: 模式横跨数值表格与算术、格式异常的专利文本、HTML/JSON 代码及法律叙述；可见触发点各异，部分集中在数字和标点，整体缺少统一语义或文体特征。

patterns.name: 带小数与符号的数字串
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、标点及其周围空格上；数字常以小数、负数、百分比或连续数值表格形式出现。
patterns.domain: 医学统计表格、数学题及数值计算；段2、4、9、10

patterns.name: 稀疏或错位的空白字符
patterns.trigger: 段3中反复出现的长空格串，以及“⁢”“⁡”等符号
patterns.context: 文本主要由大量空白、少量孤立字母和数学符号组成，缺少可读的连续语句；在专利背景材料中。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利文本（此片段疑似格式或抽取异常）

patterns.name: HTML 标签与模板拼接
patterns.context: 代码通过字符串拼接生成含 HTML 标签的页面模板，激活分布在标签、引号和换行附近。

patterns.name: 法庭记录中的引语及程序用语
patterns.trigger: “THE COURT: Mr. Pend”“the court addressed the possibility of consecutive sentencing”
patterns.context: 法律叙述或庭审逐字记录中出现法院发言、程序性表述及引语。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的证词与交叉询问
patterns.context: 判决叙述证人或当事人的可信度、证词及调查过程。

patterns.name: JSON 配置中的键值与嵌套字段
patterns.context: 机器可读配置以 JSON 风格的键值对、数组和嵌套对象组织数据。

patterns.name: Jupyter Notebook 代码单元结构
patterns.context: Notebook 导出数据的 JSON 元信息后接代码源内容。

patterns.name: 表格中的运动学术语
patterns.context: 解剖或动作项目名称与相邻测量数值并列呈现。
patterns.domain: 医学表格（可能为活动度或体格检查数据）

en.description: Strong activations occur across structural boundaries in code and configuration, quotations and parenthetical markers in legal text, address symbols in email headers, control characters in extracted patent text, and percentages in parentheses in scientific abstracts. The commonality is weak, mainly punctuation, separators, and formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Delimiters and indentation in structured code/configuration
patterns.context: Triggers occur at line starts, field boundaries, or statement boundaries in multiline structured text; they do not depend on a particular identifier.
patterns.domain: Github code, JSON configuration, and dependency manifests

patterns.name: Quotation introducers in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal decisions first introduce a statute, trial instruction, or quotation, then continue it after a colon and line break; local activations concentrate near quotation boundaries.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal decisions and legal discussion

patterns.name: Sender markers in email headers
patterns.context: Email headers list sender or recipient names and email addresses enclosed in angle brackets.

patterns.name: Special symbols and sparse characters in patent layouts
patterns.context: Text consists of extensive whitespace interspersed with a few characters and mathematical/formatting control symbols, with no recognizable ordinary sentences.
patterns.domain: USPTO Backgrounds patent text or extracted layout content

patterns.name: Percentages and parentheses in scientific papers
patterns.context: Research results report the proportion of samples contaminated, with the value in parentheses.

patterns.name: Parenthetical asides in legal prose
patterns.context: Legal discussion inserts source information in parentheses when citing the title of a legal book.

patterns.name: Quotations and cross-examination wording in legal decisions
patterns.context: A decision recounts witness testimony or cross-examination and marks quotations with quotation marks; this differs from the colon-introduced quotation-boundary pattern.

11_647.concept: 结构与标点边界
11_647.description: 强激活散见于代码与配置的结构边界、法律文本的引述和括号标记、邮件头地址符号、专利抽取文本的控制符，以及科学摘要的括号百分比。共同点较弱，主要是标点、分隔符和格式边界。

patterns.name: 结构化代码与配置中的分隔符和缩进
patterns.trigger: 换行符 «↵»、缩进空格、JSON 键值分隔符 «":"、逗号，或 Python 的 «try:»、«import»、«url» 等代码结构
patterns.context: 触发点位于多行结构化文本的行首、字段边界或语句边界；不依赖某个固定标识符。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、JSON 配置及依赖清单

patterns.name: 法律引文引导符
patterns.trigger: «:» 后接 «↵»，随后出现引号或引述内容
patterns.context: 法律判决正文先引出法条、庭审指示或引述，再以冒号和换行展开；局部激活集中在引述边界附近。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决与法律论述

patterns.name: 邮件头中的发件人标记
patterns.trigger: «↵» 后的 «<»，以及邮件地址中的 «@»、«.»
patterns.context: 邮件头列出发件人或收件人姓名及尖括号包围的邮箱地址。

patterns.name: 专利版面中的特殊符号与稀疏字符
patterns.trigger: «⁢»、«⁡» 及周围零散的字母或标点
patterns.context: 文本呈现为大量空白夹杂少量字符与数学／格式控制符，缺少可辨认的普通句子。
patterns.domain: USPTO Backgrounds 专利文本或抽取后的版面内容

patterns.name: 科学论文中的百分比与括号
patterns.context: 研究结果报告样本中受污染的比例，数值放在括号内。

patterns.name: 法律正文中的括号式旁注
patterns.trigger: «(» 后的法官或权威名称 «Earl of Halsbury»，以及后续 «,»
patterns.context: 法律论述在引用法律书籍名称时用括号插入来源信息。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的引语与交叉审问措辞
patterns.context: 判决叙述证人证言或交叉审问，并以引号标示引述；与冒号引文边界模式不同。

en.description: Activations are scattered across corpora: newlines, indentation, and punctuation in code and structured data; email-address delimiters; whitespace in patent-formula layout; legal quotation markers; and number boundaries and minus signs in math problems. No clear shared semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in code or structured files
patterns.context: Triggers cluster at line starts, indentation boundaries, or punctuation in structured fields; the content of the code and data itself is not consistent
patterns.domain: Github code, JSON, Jupyter notebooks, and dependency configuration

patterns.name: Email addresses and recipient delimiters
patterns.context: Occurs in recipient lists in email headers, where addresses and names are separated by punctuation

patterns.name: Sparse formula layout and whitespace
patterns.context: Characters are embedded in mathematical or technical layout fragments with large amounts of whitespace, without forming recognizable natural-language expressions
patterns.domain: Formula/layout content in USPTO patent background text

patterns.name: Quotations and transcription in legal text
patterns.context: Newlines and punctuation introduce statements by parties or the court in legal arguments or trial records

patterns.name: Math answers and number boundaries
patterns.context: Math problems and calculated results appear adjacent; activations fall on minus signs, numbers, or near answers, and problem types are not fully consistent
patterns.domain: Math word problems and numerical calculations

11_647.concept: 格式边界与分隔符
11_647.description: 激活分散在不同语料：代码与结构化数据中的换行、缩进和标点；邮件地址分隔符；专利公式排版空白；法律引述标记；以及数学题里的负号和数字边界。没有明显的共同语义触发点。

patterns.name: 代码或结构化文件中的格式标记
patterns.trigger: 换行符 «↵»、空格缩进，以及 JSON/配置中的引号、冒号、逗号和括号
patterns.context: 触发点集中在行首、缩进边界或结构化字段的标点处；代码和数据的内容本身并不一致
patterns.domain: Github 代码、JSON、Jupyter notebook 与依赖配置

patterns.name: 邮件地址与收件人分隔符
patterns.trigger: «@»、电子邮件地址中的点号，以及逗号和换行
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头部的收件人列表中，地址和姓名由标点分隔

patterns.name: 稀疏公式排版与空白
patterns.trigger: 长串空格，以及 «⁢»、«⁡»、希腊字母 «π» 等公式排版字符
patterns.context: 字符嵌在大幅空白构成的数学或技术排版片段中，未形成可辨认的自然语言表达
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景文本中的公式/排版内容

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引述与转写
patterns.trigger: «↵»、引号 «“»、冒号 «:» 及 «THE COURT:» 等引述标记
patterns.context: 法律论述或庭审记录中，换行和标点用于引出当事人陈述或法庭发言

patterns.name: 数学题答案及数字边界
patterns.trigger: 负号 «-»、数字串、等号式问答中的换行与结果
patterns.context: 数学题目和计算结果相邻；激活落在负号、数字或答案附近，题目类型并不完全相同
patterns.domain: 数学文字题与数值计算

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to two types of text: “Rat” at the beginning of a sentence to denote a laboratory animal in biomedical contexts, and “import” statements in source code from multiple languages on GitHub. The two trigger forms differ.

patterns.name: Biomedical text beginning with Rat
patterns.context: “Rat” appears at the beginning of a sentence to denote a laboratory animal, followed by its exposure conditions or physiological function; activation is concentrated on Rat, with weaker activation on adjacent words.

patterns.name: import statements in code
patterns.context: A code line begins with import, followed by a module name, imported symbol, or from clause; repeated instances of import also activate.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code in JavaScript/TypeScript, Swift, Python, and other languages

11_706.concept: 特定语料中的句首标记
11_706.description: 神经元主要响应两类文本：生物医学语境中句首表示实验动物的“Rat”，以及 GitHub 多种语言源代码中的“import”导入语句；两类触发形式不同。

patterns.name: Rat 开头的生物医学文本
patterns.context: 句首以 Rat 指实验动物，后接其暴露条件或生理功能；激活集中在 Rat，后续相邻词也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目文本、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 代码中的 import 语句
patterns.context: 代码行以 import 开始，后接模块名、导入符号或 from 子句；重复出现的 import 也会激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码，涉及 JavaScript/TypeScript、Swift、Python 等

en.concept: Specific opening markers in text: Rat or import
en.description: Activation is concentrated in two distinct text types: “Rat” at the beginning of sentences in biomedical corpora, and “import” in GitHub source-code import statements; the latter occurs across languages, import forms, and module names.

patterns.name: Biomedical text beginning with Rat
patterns.context: Rat appears at the beginning of a sentence or phrase, followed by a description of an animal exposure experiment or absorptive function after intestinal transplantation; activation also covers some following words.

patterns.name: Code import statements
patterns.context: An import statement at the beginning of source code; the trigger is independent of the imported object and occurs across multiple languages and import forms.

11_706.concept: 文本中的特定起始标记：Rat 或 import
11_706.description: 激活集中于两类不同文本：生物医学语料中句首的“Rat”，以及 GitHub 源代码中导入语句的“import”；后者跨语言、导入形式和模块名出现。

patterns.name: 以 Rat 开头的生物医学文本
patterns.context: 句首或短语开头出现 Rat，后文描述动物暴露实验或肠道移植后的吸收功能；激活也覆盖紧随其后的部分词语。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter、PubMed 生物医学文本

patterns.name: 代码导入语句
patterns.trigger: «import»，常后接模块、包名或导入内容
patterns.context: 源代码中的 import 语句开头；触发与导入对象无关，出现在多种语言及导入形式中。

en.description: Strongly responds to import at the beginning of code import statements; also responds to sentence-initial Rat in biomedical text and to the op fragment inside ophthalm... medical terms. The first two biomedical triggers are not entirely identical.

patterns.name: Biomedical text beginning with Rat
patterns.context: “Rat” appears at the beginning of a title or sentence, followed by an animal-study topic; one instance is followed by “fetuses exposed to bis-di...”, another by “jejunal absorptive function”.
patterns.domain: NIH research records, PubMed biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Fragment inside a medical term
patterns.context: Activation falls on a spelling fragment of ophthalm... medical terms and appears in titles related to metastatic endophthalmitis, as well as in repeated titles after line breaks.

patterns.name: Code import statements
patterns.context: At the beginning of a code line, followed by a module, package, symbol, or name; several passages also contain from, line breaks, or paths.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, covering multiple languages and import styles

11_706.concept: 片段/词边界触发
11_706.description: 强烈响应代码导入语句开头的 import；也响应生物医学文本中的 Rat 句首，以及 ophthalm... 医学术语内部的 op 片段。前两类生物医学触发彼此并不完全相同。

patterns.name: Rat 开头的生物医学文本
patterns.context: “Rat”位于标题或句子开头，后接动物研究主题；一处接“fetuses exposed to bis-di...”，另一处接“jejunal absorptive function”。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究记录、PubMed 生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 医学术语内部的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 ophthalm... 医学术语的拼写片段上，并出现在转移性眼内炎相关标题及换行后的重复标题中。

patterns.name: 代码导入语句
patterns.context: 位于代码行开头，后接模块、包、符号或名称；多段还出现 from、换行或路径。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码，涵盖多种语言与导入写法

en.description: Activation is concentrated on «Rat» and «import» at the beginning of a sentence or line: the former appears in rat research contexts, while the latter appears in import statements across multiple programming languages.

patterns.name: Biomedical phrases beginning with Rat
patterns.context: “Rat” is a noun referring to a laboratory animal or research subject, followed by an organ, function, or experimental description

patterns.name: import statements in code
patterns.context: A code line begins with import, followed by a module, symbol, or package path; import sometimes appears again in the same snippet

11_706.concept: 常见记录/语句开头
11_706.description: 激活集中在句首或行首的 «Rat» 和 «import»：前者出现在大鼠研究语境，后者出现在多种语言的代码导入语句中。

patterns.name: 以 Rat 开头的生物医学短语
patterns.context: “Rat”作为实验动物或研究对象的名词，后接器官、功能或实验描述
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目资料

patterns.name: 代码中的 import 语句
patterns.context: 代码行以 import 开始，后续是模块、符号或包路径；有时同一片段中再次出现 import

en.concept: Import statements at fragment beginnings (some samples do not fit)
en.description: Activation occurs in two rat-related medical research titles, a passage containing payment and contact fields, and import statements in code across multiple languages; the main shared trigger is “import” at the beginning of a fragment, but the medical titles and interface fields do not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Medical paper titles
patterns.context: Medical research titles focused on rats or their organs, involving exposure, function, or transplantation

patterns.name: Payment page fields
patterns.context: Short webpage or form text listing fields such as payment methods and contact information

patterns.name: Code import statements
patterns.context: Import statements at the beginning of a program file or fragment; imported objects, languages, and frameworks vary

11_706.concept: 片段开头的导入语句（部分样本不符）
11_706.description: 激活出现在两条大鼠医学研究标题、一段付款与联系字段，以及多种语言代码中的导入语句；主要共同触发线索是片段开头的“import”，但医学标题和界面字段并不符合这一模式。

patterns.name: 医学论文标题
patterns.trigger: “Rat fetuses exposed to bis-diamine”“Rat jejunal absorptive function after intestinal transplantation”
patterns.context: 以大鼠或其器官为研究对象的医学研究标题，涉及暴露、功能或移植

patterns.name: 付款页面字段
patterns.context: 短的网页或表单文字，列出付款方式、联系方式等字段

patterns.name: 代码导入语句
patterns.context: 程序文件开头或片段开头的导入语句；导入对象与语言、框架各异

en.description: Primarily responds to algebraic formulas and their symbols, variables, and operation instructions, especially operators and variables within formulas; also activates on long strings of spaces, email finance terminology, and descriptions of medical staining appearances.

patterns.name: Punctuation and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: These symbols occur in formulas, algebraic expressions, or equations; most are mathematical notation split by formatting or tokenization.

patterns.name: Algebraic operation instructions such as expand
patterns.context: Instructions before or after a formula requesting factoring, expansion, or solving.

patterns.name: Variables and function notation
patterns.context: Letters serve as algebraic variables, unknowns, or function arguments, embedded in formulas or problem text.

patterns.name: Consecutive spaces
patterns.context: Large spans of whitespace are marked on their own; nearby text is sporadic, possibly reflecting formatting, padding, or anomalous whitespace.

patterns.name: Transaction terminology in email
patterns.context: The phrase «volume represents sell-side only», concerning the basis of trading volume or sell-side data.
patterns.domain: Enron emails, financial or business writing

patterns.name: Pathology staining description
patterns.context: A numbered description after a line break explains the appearance of the background color and regular lines.
patterns.domain: Medical or histological descriptions in PubMed

11_706.concept: 数学符号与格式边界
11_706.description: 主要响应代数公式及其符号、变量和操作指令，尤其是公式中的运算符与变量；另对长串空格、邮件金融术语和医学染色外观描述有激活。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的标点与运算符
patterns.context: 这些符号位于公式、代数式或方程中；多为排版或分词后拆开的数学记号。
patterns.domain: 数学题目、符号化代数文本

patterns.name: 展开等代数操作指令
patterns.context: 作为公式前后的操作指令，要求因式分解、展开或求解。

patterns.name: 变量及函数记号
patterns.context: 字母充当代数变量、未知数或函数自变量，嵌入公式或题目文字中。

patterns.name: 连续空格
patterns.context: 大段空白字符本身被标记；附近只有零散文本，可能反映格式、填充或异常空白。

patterns.name: 邮件中的交易术语
patterns.context: 短语 «volume represents sell-side only»，涉及成交量口径或卖方侧数据。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、金融或商业文字

patterns.name: 病理染色描述
patterns.context: 在换行后的编号式描述中，说明背景颜色及规则线条的外观。
patterns.domain: PubMed 中的医学或组织学描述

en.concept: English articles and local word-form fragments
en.description: Activation most consistently occurs on the definite article “the” and indefinite articles “a/an” in academic text; sporadic activation also falls on fragments within technical terms, hyphens, units, and citation formats. Some fragments are difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: English article the
patterns.context: The definite article before a noun phrase; occurs across different subject areas

patterns.name: English article a/an
patterns.context: The indefinite article before a noun phrase

patterns.name: Nouns or modifiers following articles
patterns.context: Marked words occur at sentence beginnings or in structures involving prepositions, conjunctions, and similar elements; they do not appear to share a stable semantic trigger and may relate to local collocations or tokenization boundaries

patterns.name: Numerical values and units
patterns.context: Markers are concentrated in concentration ranges and unit expressions for plasma glycoproteins

patterns.name: Medical term fragment
patterns.context: Occurs inside the word “hyperstimulation”, concerning ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome

patterns.name: Comparison symbol or hyphen
patterns.context: Occurs in the compound term “spin--charge”

patterns.name: Bibliographic citation marker
patterns.context: Activation covers part of a citation marker, with no stable correspondence to the cited content observed

patterns.name: Local word fragments or noise
patterns.context: Markers fall within words or near boundaries between coordinated written forms, such as “and/or”, “monocytes/macrophages”, and “extinction/repopulation”; no unified semantic trigger can be inferred

11_706.concept: 英语冠词及局部词形片段
11_706.description: 激活最稳定地出现在学术文本中的定冠词“the”和不定冠词“a/an”；另有零散激活落在术语内部片段、连接符、单位及引文格式处，部分片段难以解释。

patterns.name: 英文冠词 the
patterns.context: 名词短语前的定冠词；在不同专业主题中均出现

patterns.name: 英文冠词 a/an
patterns.context: 名词短语前的不定冠词

patterns.name: 冠词后接名词或修饰语
patterns.context: 所标记词出现在句首或介词、连词等结构中，不像同一稳定语义触发；可能与局部搭配或分词边界有关

patterns.name: 数值与单位表达
patterns.context: 标记集中在血浆糖蛋白的浓度范围及单位表达中

patterns.name: 医学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在“hyperstimulation”一词内部，涉及卵巢过度刺激综合征

patterns.name: 比较符号或连接符
patterns.context: 出现在复合术语“spin--charge”中

patterns.name: 文献引用标记
patterns.context: 激活覆盖引文标记的一部分，未见与引用内容稳定对应

patterns.name: 局部词语片段或噪声
patterns.context: 标记落在单词或并列书写的词语边界附近，如“and/or”“monocytes/macrophages”“extinction/repopulation”，无法归纳为统一语义触发

en.description: All snippets activate on the capitalized article “An” at sentence beginnings or paragraph boundaries, followed by different noun phrases; domains and semantic content vary, with no evident shared theme.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial article An
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the capitalized article “An” at the beginning of a sentence, followed by a noun phrase; it often appears after a line break or paragraph boundary, opening a new sentence or paragraph.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including patents, encyclopedias, academic papers, emails, and web text

11_706.concept: 句首大写冠词 An
11_706.description: 所有片段都在句首或段落边界处激活于大写冠词“An”，后接不同名词短语；领域和语义内容各异，没有明显共同主题。

patterns.name: 句首冠词 An
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在句首的大写冠词“An”，后接名词短语；常位于换行或段落边界后，开启新句或新段。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括专利、百科、学术论文、邮件及网页文本

en.description: Activations occur across diverse technical content: Android XML, hardware lists, Japanese and Chinese technical text, LaTeX equations, and warranty emails. Their visible common features are not specific enough to reduce to a single trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Android XML tags and attributes
patterns.context: Activation appears around tags, attribute names, and values in Android layout or manifest XML code.

patterns.name: Hardware configuration lists
patterns.context: Computer components and configurations are listed on separate aligned lines; activation also occurs near numbers, units, and product names.
patterns.domain: Computer quotes or configuration lists in Enron emails

patterns.name: Japanese support or explanatory text
patterns.context: Continuous Japanese text; examples describe an account/IPN issue and UI text, respectively.
patterns.domain: Japanese technical support content and Japanese UI documentation

patterns.name: Chinese code comments and callback explanation
patterns.context: Chinese code comments explain a callback function and its arguments.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical expression
patterns.context: A recursive definition contains a radical expression, followed by a question about n.

patterns.name: Warranty coverage explanation
patterns.context: Explains whether a computer is still covered by its original or extended warranty; activation is distributed across phrases in the email body.

11_706.concept: none
11_706.description: 激活出现在多种技术内容中：Android XML、硬件清单、日中技术说明、LaTeX 数学式及保修邮件。它们共有的可见特征不够具体，无法归结为单一触发模式。

patterns.name: Android XML 标记与属性
patterns.context: Android 布局或 manifest 的 XML 代码中，标签、属性名及其值附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 硬件配置清单
patterns.context: 以分行、对齐的字段列出电脑部件和配置；数字、单位及产品名附近也有激活。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的电脑报价或配置清单

patterns.name: 日语支持或说明文字
patterns.context: 日语连续文本；分别是账户/IPN 问题说明和界面文本说明。
patterns.domain: 日语技术支持内容及日语 UI 文档

patterns.name: 中文代码注释与回调说明
patterns.context: 代码注释用中文解释回调函数及传入参数。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式
patterns.context: 递归定义含根式的数学式，后接关于 n 的提问。

patterns.name: 保修范围说明
patterns.context: 解释电脑是否仍在原厂或延长保修期内；激活分布于邮件正文短语中。

en.concept: Technical and document markers across domains
en.description: Activation spans legal citations, configuration or web contexts containing universal, software code and UI markers, and various patent terminology and formulaic phrases; no single stable trigger word is evident, and the activations appear to be domain-specific fragments.

patterns.name: Legal citations and procedural provisions
patterns.context: Occurs in U.S. court opinions or pleadings, concerning statutes, case citations, and code section numbers; activation is distributed across citation punctuation and legal terminology.

patterns.name: KCL abbreviation and cultural center description
patterns.context: In descriptive text about water features, pedestrian bridges, and a cultural/music center, the abbreviation KKL appears near articles and place descriptions.

patterns.name: universal configuration field
patterns.context: In a JSON-style object, universal is the value of an idiom field and is adjacent to scale, filename, and an image filename.

patterns.name: Web server resources and compression
patterns.context: A technical Q&A discusses website traffic, server resources, and page loading, then mentions compressing JS files and Angular Universal.

patterns.name: Motor vehicle transmission and motor/generator
patterns.context: A patent description discusses continuously variable transmission ratios, a locking device, and speed control of a first motor/generator.

patterns.name: Patent purpose and embodiment boilerplate
patterns.context: Patent background or specification text states the invention's purpose using fixed expressions such as “another object of the invention”, “present invention”, and “preferred embodiments”.

patterns.name: Java methods and TODO comments
patterns.context: Method declarations, layout operations, and unfinished TODO comments in Java code.

patterns.name: UI XML and component tags
patterns.context: XML layout or UI configuration snippets contain video wrappers, components, and application tags, followed by Q&A text about a receiver page.

patterns.name: Permanent magnet materials and embodiments
patterns.context: Patent text describes coercivity grades or rare-earth materials for permanent magnets across different embodiments.

11_706.concept: 多领域技术与文档标记
11_706.description: 激活涵盖法律引文、含 universal 的配置或 Web 语境、软件代码与 UI 标记，以及多类专利术语和套语；未见单一稳定触发词，呈现多种领域特定片段。

patterns.name: 法律引文与程序条款
patterns.context: 出现在美国法判决或诉状文本中，围绕法案、判例引文和法典章节编号；激活分布于引文标点及法律术语。

patterns.name: KCL 缩写与文化中心描述
patterns.context: 在介绍水景、步行桥及文化／音乐中心的说明文字中，缩写 KKL 前后有冠词和地点描述。

patterns.name: universal 配置字段
patterns.context: JSON 风格的对象中，universal 作为 idiom 字段值，并与 scale、filename 及图像文件名相邻。

patterns.name: Web 服务器资源与压缩
patterns.context: 技术问答讨论网站流量、服务器资源和页面加载，随后提及压缩 JS 文件及 Angular Universal。

patterns.name: 机动车传动与电机／发电机
patterns.context: 专利技术说明中讨论连续可变传动比、锁定装置及第一电机／发电机的转速控制。

patterns.name: 专利发明目的与实施例套语
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书以“another object of the invention”“present invention”“preferred embodiments”等固定表达陈述发明目的。

patterns.name: Java 方法与 TODO 注释
patterns.context: Java 代码中的方法声明、布局操作与未实现的 TODO 注释。

patterns.name: 界面 XML 与组件标签
patterns.context: XML 布局或 UI 配置片段，包含视频包装器、组件和应用标签，后接关于 receiver page 的问答文字。
patterns.domain: 软件界面开发／技术问答

patterns.name: 永磁体材料与实施例
patterns.context: 专利文本按不同实施例描述永磁体的矫顽力等级或稀土材料。

en.description: Activation spans software Q&A, code comments, and chemical, materials, and legal texts. Technical passages often contain negation words such as not/don't, to followed by an action verb, and prescriptive explanations; other passages contain domain-specific terminology and do not form a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: “not” in negation and necessity statements
patterns.context: Technical explanations or recommendations negate an operation, modification, or requirement; the strongest trigger is not, often in a “do not …” structure
patterns.domain: Software engineering documentation, technical Q&A, and code comments

patterns.name: Infinitive to and implementation/action verbs
patterns.context: to is followed by action verbs in software development, especially implement, define, extend, or write code; activation is stronger in paragraphs 1 and 3
patterns.domain: Software engineering Q&A and development documentation

patterns.name: Prescriptive/explanatory wording in technical documentation templates
patterns.context: Describes the purpose of a framework or generated code, default handling, and content that must not be modified

patterns.name: Web performance and resource constraint discussion
patterns.context: Discusses server RAM/CPU, page loading, traffic, or performance-related issues such as compression

patterns.name: React component updates and comparison logic
patterns.context: Repeated component rendering, connecting higher-order components, and adding a check at a setInfo call

patterns.name: Dependency injection and custom type converters
patterns.context: Asks how to define a Dozer custom converter with dependencies injected by Spring

patterns.name: Chemical reactions and photoredox catalysis
patterns.context: An abstract introduces radical cascade reactions, bond formation/cleavage, and photoredox catalysis

patterns.name: Polyurethane materials and nonionic compatibilizers
patterns.context: Cites a technical paper on rigid polyurethane foam and existing nonionic compatibilizers

patterns.name: Special or local legislation in legal provisions
patterns.context: A pleading cites constitutional limits on special acts or local laws passed by state legislatures

patterns.name: Redux connection and action binding explanation
patterns.context: Explains rules for using connect, dispatch, props, and bindActionCreators

11_706.concept: 否定与操作说明词
11_706.description: 激活覆盖软件问答、代码注释及化学、材料、法律文本。技术段常出现否定词 not/don't、to 加动作动词和规范说明；其余段各有领域术语，未形成共同语义触发。

patterns.name: 否定与必要性说明中的“not”
patterns.trigger: « not»10（第2、4段）；«no»2 need« to»5（第1段）；另有«don't»9（第10段）
patterns.context: 技术说明或建议中，否定某项操作、修改或需求；最强触发集中在 not，且常处于“do not …”结构
patterns.domain: 软件工程文档、技术问答及代码注释

patterns.name: 不定式 to 与实现/操作动词
patterns.trigger: « to»10 hard«code»（第1段）；« to»7« implement»（第5段）；« to»7« subclass»、« to»10« re»implement»（第3段）；« to»7« define»（第6段）
patterns.context: to 后接软件开发中的动作动词，尤其实现、定义、扩展或编写代码；第1、3段触发较强
patterns.domain: 软件工程问答与开发文档

patterns.name: 技术文档模板中的规范性/说明性措辞
patterns.trigger: « Required»5 method« for»4 Designer support« -»1 do« not»10« modify»5；« In»5« most»2« cases»1 you… can… leave… as-is（第2、3段）
patterns.context: 描述框架或生成代码的用途、默认处理方式及不可修改的内容

patterns.name: Web 性能与资源限制讨论
patterns.trigger: « your»5 webserver is limited« in»2 RAM«/»4CPU；« compression»；« not»10« need»5（第4段）
patterns.context: 讨论服务器 RAM/CPU、页面加载、流量或压缩等性能与资源问题

en.concept: Negation and operational instructions in technical contexts
en.description: The most prominent shared cue is the negation words not/don't, especially in technical contexts describing restrictions or discouraged actions; there is also activation for the infinitive to, patent-style qualifiers, and word strings in code configuration and template instructions.

patterns.name: Infinitive and recommendation phrasing

11_706.concept: 技术语境中的否定与操作说明

patterns.name: 否定与禁止

patterns.name: 不定式与建议语气

patterns.name: 专利式描述中的限定词
patterns.context: 出现在正式、长句式的技术或化学专利叙述中，涉及化合物、公式及其性质。

patterns.name: 框架配置标记
patterns.context: Android 主题 XML 配置中的属性和值。

patterns.name: 代码说明与模板文本
patterns.context: 围绕前端模板、指令和数据绑定展开的说明文字。

en.concept: Local features of software technical text
en.description: Activation often occurs in software engineering text: code identifiers, annotations, and calls; Android XML attributes; and design terminology and recommendations in technical Q&A. Legal rhetoric also appears. The triggers do not share a unified narrow feature.

patterns.name: Android XML attributes and layout values
patterns.context: Attribute names and assignments are marked as fragments in Android layout XML, often in groups of widget configurations

patterns.name: Code identifiers and surrounding method calls
patterns.context: Syntactic elements in source code or code snippets, often co-occurring with indentation, parentheses, line breaks, and method/class structures; the triggered elements are not fully consistent

patterns.name: Software design terminology
patterns.context: Natural-language passages in technical Q&A explaining design patterns, frameworks, or implementation choices

patterns.name: Reader-facing recommendations or instructions
patterns.context: Appears in technical Q&A when giving operational advice, next steps, or reference links; often adjacent to code examples

patterns.name: Method names as Android click attributes
patterns.context: Discusses specifying a click-handler method in an Android XML attribute and contrasting it with `OnClickListener` in code

patterns.name: Emphatic rhetoric in legal documents
patterns.context: Emphatic or evaluative wording advances criticism of an appeal in legal argument

patterns.name: Ordinary connectives and references in mixed technical text
patterns.context: Natural-language explanations between or after code examples; difficult to classify as a specific technical-syntax trigger

11_706.concept: 软件技术文本局部特征
11_706.description: 激活多见于软件工程文本：代码标识符、注解与调用，Android XML 属性，以及技术问答中的设计术语和建议语句；另有法律文书修辞。不同触发并无统一窄特征。

patterns.name: Android XML 属性与布局值
patterns.trigger: `android:` 后接 `layout_width`、`layout_height`、`orientation`、`context` 等属性，以及 `match_parent`、`fill_parent`、`vertical` 等值

patterns.name: 代码标识符与方法调用周边

patterns.context: 源码或代码片段中的语法元素，常与缩进、括号、换行及方法/类结构共现；触发对象不完全一致

patterns.name: 程序设计概念术语

patterns.name: 面向读者的建议或指引语句

patterns.context: 技术问答在给出操作建议、后续步骤或参考链接时出现；多与代码示例邻接

patterns.name: 方法名作为 Android 点击属性
patterns.context: 讨论在 Android XML 属性中指定点击处理方法，并与代码里的 `OnClickListener` 对照

patterns.name: 法律文书中的强调性修辞

patterns.context: 法律论述中以强调或评价性措辞推进对上诉的批评

patterns.name: 混合技术文本中的普通关联词与指代
patterns.trigger: `and`、`in another module`、`Then` 等普通衔接语
patterns.context: 代码示例之间或代码之后的自然语言说明；难以归为特定技术语法触发

en.description: Primarily activates on second-person recommendations and negation in technical Q&A, especially around don't, can't, you, and to/use; it also occurs in various code identifiers and configuration fragments. There are isolated activations for legal negation and acknowledgment/response markers.

patterns.name: Negative recommendation phrasing
patterns.context: When providing programming solutions or advice, second-person address and expressions of negation, restriction, or permission occur; most prominent around words such as don't, can't, and to.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and code formatting
patterns.context: Code fragments or API/configuration names in technical text; activation spans code and adjacent natural-language explanations and is not limited to a particular programming language.
patterns.domain: Code, software development documentation, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Second-person advice in Q&A
patterns.context: Direct advice or a rhetorical question addressed to the asker, with you and don't you together; does not need to occur in a code block.

patterns.name: Negation in legal decisions
patterns.context: The negation word no co-occurs with an assessment that an appeal lacks merit, in a statement about whether oral argument is needed.

patterns.name: User-feedback thanks and response markers
patterns.context: Thanks and response openings appear after code or web questions, but activation is scattered and its connection to the main negative phrasing is unclear.

patterns.name: Conditions and explanations in other programming contexts
patterns.context: Conditional, explanatory, or recommendation statements occur alongside technical context; some examples contain strong negation, but phrasing and trigger locations are not entirely consistent.

11_706.concept: 技术语境中的否定建议
11_706.description: 主要激活于技术问答的第二人称建议与否定表达，尤其 don't、can't、you 与 to/use 邻近；也出现在多种代码标识符和配置片段中。另对法律否定措辞及答谢、答复标记有孤立激活。

patterns.context: 在给出编程解决方案或建议时，出现对用户的第二人称称呼和否定、限制或许可类表达；最显著的是 don't、can't、to 等词附近。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与代码格式
patterns.context: 技术文本中的代码片段或 API／配置名称；激活词跨越代码和邻接的自然语言说明，不局限于某一种编程语言。
patterns.domain: 代码、软件开发文档及技术问答

patterns.name: 法律判决中的否定措辞

patterns.context: 代码或网页问题之后出现感谢及答复开头，但激活词分散，和主要否定句式关联不明。

patterns.name: 其他编程语境中的条件与解释
patterns.trigger: «default»、« We»5 decided« to»8« not»10« create»3« a»5 mixin（1）；«If»3« you»5're« using»7« Spring»3（3）；«In»5« Java»1« you»4« can»6't»8（7）；«Then»3« you»5« can»8« just»7 use（9）

en.description: Activation examples cover several types of software development text (Android, CSS, Spring, web registration and validation), as well as legal argument, casual conversation, and product copy. patterns.name: Paragraph transition “In this case” in legal decisions

11_706.concept: 文段转入与技术标记

patterns.name: “low-density”及相关材料描述
patterns.context: 医学文本中描述正常基质的密度；专利文本中描述低分子光导化合物。

patterns.name: 类型名称“JSF”及版本格式

patterns.name: Android 导入语句与组件标识符

en.description: Activation samples include separators in English negative contractions, technical identifiers, and legal compounds, as well as legal section headings, Portuguese technical responses, and patent material classifications; these domains and wording patterns are not uniform.

patterns.name: Negative contractions
patterns.context: A negative contraction appears in English dialogue or narration; in [3], “'t” is at the end of the truncated word “don't”.

patterns.name: Separators in technical identifiers
patterns.context: A colon or hyphen appears in an Android attribute name, XML tag name, or legal compound; subwords near these symbols also activate.

patterns.name: Legal appellate headings

patterns.name: Portuguese technical explanations
patterns.context: A Portuguese answer explains a validation error using HTTP status code 422 and compares two cases.

patterns.name: 法律上诉标题

patterns.name: 葡语技术说明

en.description: Activation is distributed across function words and evaluative words in Portuguese programming Q&A, the and to in English technical text, and near frontend code, warning comments, and database code; the passages lack a consistent semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Specific English article the
patterns.context: The article appears before a noun or noun phrase in English legal or technical prose; [4] also appears in the structure “under one of the sections”.

patterns.name: Portuguese function words and code explanations

patterns.name: To expressing “need/should”

11_706.concept: none

patterns.name: 特定英文冠词 the

patterns.name: 样式表及前端组件相关语境
patterns.context: 讨论网页样式、组件、模板或前端标记；激活分别落在句中词、HTML 注释内容和模板指令附近，未见统一触发词。

en.concept: Mixed local word forms and token patterns
en.description: The most stable shared phenomenon is strong activation on the t in English don’t, across various negative sentences and everyday contexts. Other high activations involve Portuguese principal, inert in a patent, data indentation, and sporadic subword fragments, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: don’t in negative evaluation phrases
patterns.context: In the English contraction don’t, activation falls on the token “t” after the apostrophe; the preceding text often contains I, followed by verbs such as have, like, eat, or remember. It is not limited to any particular emotion or collocation.

patterns.name: A “principal”-related fragment within a Portuguese word
patterns.context: In Portuguese technical Q&A about HTTP 422 and validation errors, strong activation is concentrated on the complete word principal, in the surrounding “a principal diferença” construction; other labels are scattered across Portuguese word fragments.

patterns.name: inert in chemical patent text
patterns.context: In patent-style lists of chemical reaction conditions, inert modifies solvent near descriptions of solvents, bases, and reactants.

patterns.name: Tabs/indentation in code or data
patterns.context: In code/data table snippets with hexadecimal values and equals signs, the label falls on an indentation tab; several numbers and letter tokens in the same passage also activate weakly.

patterns.name: Sporadic within-word or punctuation-adjacent activations

patterns.domain: Mixed forum, Q&A, and web text

11_706.concept: 混合局部词形与 token 模式
11_706.description: 最稳定的共同现象是英语 don’t 中 t 的强激活，出现在多种否定句和日常语境。其余高激活分别涉及葡语 principal、专利中的 inert、数据缩进及零散词片段，缺少统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 否定评价短语中的 don’t
patterns.trigger: «don»? 标注实际集中在 “don’t” 的 “10”：[1] don«'t»10 have；[2] don«'t»10 like；[4] don’«t»10 eat；[5] don«'t»10 like；[7] don«'t»10 really like；[9] don«'t»9 even remember
patterns.context: 英语缩写 don’t 中，激活落在撇号后的 token “t”；前文通常含 I，后续接 have、like、eat、remember 等动词。并非只限于某一种情绪或搭配。

patterns.name: 葡语词内部的“principal”相关片段
patterns.trigger: [3] «a»7 «principal»10；同段另有分词切分的葡语词片段，如 «S»3«endo»6
patterns.context: 葡语技术问答中谈 HTTP 422 与验证错误，强激活集中在完整词 principal，周围是“a principal diferença”结构；其他标注分散在葡语词片段中。
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 化学专利文本中的 inert
patterns.context: 化学反应条件的专利式列举中，inert 修饰 solvent，处于溶剂、碱及反应物说明附近。

patterns.name: 代码或数据中的制表符/缩进

patterns.domain: GitHub 代码或结构化数据

patterns.name: 零散的词内或标点邻接激活
patterns.context: 除上述较明显局部外，激活还分布在换行、代词、葡语词片段及常见词上；缺乏跨段一致的具体触发条件，不能据此归为稳定语义模式。
patterns.domain: 混合论坛、问答与网页文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across in-word fragments and phrases in different languages, code, and genres: Portuguese word forms and function words recur, alongside technical proper names, legal terminology, microbial classification, baking directions, Polish phrases, and chemical text; there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Cross-word activation around the fragment “al”
patterns.context: Activation falls on short fragments across word boundaries or inside words; examples occur near Romanian names/places, the legal term “de novo”, and a plant name in a catalyst paper. The contexts vary widely and cannot be reduced to a stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Portuguese function words and verb forms
patterns.context: In Portuguese sentences, function words such as “a”, “você”, and “pode” and fragments within verbs often activate; topics include code conversion/operational advice and programming Q&A.

patterns.name: Fragments in technical terms and proper names
patterns.context: In technical Q&A or technology news, activation concentrates on local fragments of names such as Ionic and IGTV, with weaker activation near technical terms such as Android, Fire, and Google; the fragments are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: In-word subword fragments in Portuguese text
patterns.context: In Portuguese code comments/Q&A text, activation falls on subword fragments split by tokenization, including accented and ordinary words; this overlaps with the Portuguese function-word pattern in the same passage.

patterns.name: Temperature and location phrases in recipes
patterns.context: Baking instructions describe preheating temperature and rack position; activation primarily falls on location-word fragments, with weaker activation on ordinary words in the same passage.

patterns.name: Classification-word fragments in microbiology descriptions
patterns.context: A species abstract lists standard classification features, including Gram staining, negative, motility, and lack of spore formation; the strongest activation is on the “non-spore” fragment.

patterns.name: Polish demonstrative phrase
patterns.context: The Polish formal text contains “W tym celu” (for this purpose), a phrase indicating purpose; the surrounding text discusses forest resistance to biotic and abiotic threats.

patterns.name: C# property code identifier
patterns.context: The property name CartaoCredito in a code declaration; activation falls on fragments within the identifier and overlaps with a Portuguese answer in the same passage.

patterns.name: Legal standard-of-review phrase
patterns.context: Courts use “de novo standard of review” when reviewing summary judgment; strong activation falls on the final word of the Latin legal term.

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and catalyst terminology
patterns.context: A catalyst synthesis abstract contains a spinel formula and nanocatalyst terminology; notable activation also occurs on the ordinary adjective “simple”, making it difficult to classify as a single specialized vocabulary pattern.

patterns.name: 波兰语指示短语
