patterns.context: 描述政党提名、选举联盟得票及席位结果。

patterns.name: 人名与专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名被切分成多个 token；仅在具体语境中与相关体育报道共现，不能单独确定触发作用。

en.description: Mainly occurs in sports coverage, especially cases where a player or team did not score, match results, and elimination; also appears in election wins and seat counts, football club updates, and one medical summary about a clotting protein.

patterns.name: Election results and seats
patterns.context: Describes elections, party candidates, and votes or seats won; the result verb win is common.

patterns.name: Sports non-scoring
patterns.context: Scoring by athletes or teams in matches or careers; often refers to not yet scoring or failing to score.
patterns.domain: Football, rugby, and other sports coverage and biographies

patterns.name: Cricket runs conceded and dismissals
patterns.context: Describes a cricket team being eliminated, players being dismissed, and score figures.

patterns.name: Football club and coach updates
patterns.context: Discusses clubs, the departure or retention of coaches, or team news; also includes descriptions of a team failing to score recently.

patterns.name: Clotting protein in medicine
patterns.context: Discusses vitamin K-dependent γ-carboxylation and related proteins in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma.

11_849.description: 主要出现在体育报道中，尤其是球员或球队未得分、比赛结果与出局；也见于选举胜负和席位统计、足球俱乐部动态，以及一处凝血蛋白医学摘要。

patterns.name: 选举结果与席位
patterns.context: 叙述选举、政党候选人及获得的票数或席位，常见结果动词 win。

patterns.name: 体育比赛未得分
patterns.trigger: «without scoring»、«failed to score»、«yet to score»、«not to score»
patterns.context: 运动员或球队在比赛或职业生涯中的得分情况；多为尚未或未能得分。
patterns.domain: 足球、橄榄球等体育报道与人物条目

patterns.name: 板球比赛失分与出局
patterns.context: 描述板球队被淘汰、球员出局及得分数字。

patterns.name: 足球俱乐部及教练动态
patterns.context: 谈论俱乐部、教练去留或球队近况；并出现球队近期未进球的描述。

patterns.name: 医学中的凝血蛋白
patterns.context: 讨论肝细胞癌患者的维生素K依赖性γ-羧化及相关蛋白。

en.concept: Obtaining or not obtaining a result
en.description: Primarily responds to “score” in sports contexts and statements about not yet scoring the first point. It also responds to “win/seat/vote” in election results, sports victories, and a few distinct patterns related to player recruitment and protein domain similarity.

patterns.name: Not yet scoring the first goal/point
patterns.context: A player or athlete has not scored their first goal or point by a given time; “score” and its contextual tokens show strong activation.

patterns.name: Winning seats or votes in elections
patterns.context: Describes a party or candidate winning or not winning seats or vote share in an election; activation is concentrated near win and outcome words such as seat and vote.

patterns.name: Winning a match or award
patterns.context: Recounts a team winning a championship or an athlete receiving an award; uses win in the sense of achieving victory or a result, as in elections, but in a sports context.

patterns.name: Similarity between biomolecular domains
patterns.context: Discusses similarities between protein subfamilies in cytoplasmic or extracellular domains.

patterns.name: Player recruitment and transfers
patterns.context: A club or team considers recruiting or loaning players, listing player names and joining status; the preceding scoring/victory patterns are not observed.

11_849.description: 主要响应体育语境中“score”及尚未取得首分的表述，也响应选举结果中的“win/seat/vote”、体育获胜，以及球员招募和蛋白质结构域相关性等少数不同模式。

patterns.name: 尚未取得首个进球/得分
patterns.trigger: “to score”及其附近的“yet”“still”“first”，如 “yet to score his first career goal”“yet to score his debut goal”“still has to score his first points”
patterns.context: 球员或运动员截至某时仍未取得首个进球或得分；“score”及其上下文 token 激活明显。
patterns.domain: 体育人物传记与比赛报道

patterns.name: 选举中赢得席位或投票
patterns.trigger: “win”与选举结果搭配，如 “win the highest share of the vote”“failed to win a seat”“did not win a single seat”
patterns.context: 描述政党或候选人在选举中取得或未取得席位、选票份额；激活集中在 win 及 seat、vote 等结果词附近。

patterns.name: 比赛或奖项获胜
patterns.trigger: “won”，如 “had won the FAW Women’s Cup”“won both the Golden Boot”
patterns.context: 回顾球队夺冠或运动员获得奖项；与选举中的 win 同属取得胜利/结果的用法，但体育语境不同。

patterns.name: 生物分子结构域的相关性
patterns.trigger: “related”及结构域术语，如 “related … in their cytoplasmic domains”“extracellular domains”
patterns.context: 讨论蛋白质亚家族在细胞质或细胞外结构域上的相似关系。

patterns.name: 球员招募与转会
patterns.context: 俱乐部或球队考虑招募、租借球员，列举球员姓名与加盟情况；未见前述得分/获胜触发。

en.description: Activations are distributed across contrastive conjunctions, cricket and football coverage, team histories, algebra problems, and lists of metabolic pathways; no single content theme explains all passages. Listing and structured text are the more apparent local cues.

patterns.name: Paired contrast and coordination structures
patterns.context: Highlights that both related aspects or objects hold when listing them in parallel; [8] also contains an ordinary “but” contrast.
patterns.domain: Patent background, biomedical abstracts, academic submission guidelines

patterns.name: Cricket statistics and match narrative
patterns.context: Describes player histories, seasons, match progress, and scores or dismissal statistics.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sports biographies and match reports

patterns.name: Football match coverage
patterns.context: Reports teams' difficulty scoring, match results, and season performance.

patterns.name: Skopje football clubs and loan history
patterns.context: Describes a player's loan destinations and the periods spent with each club.

patterns.name: Linear equation problem
patterns.context: Asks the reader to solve an equation or find a variable's value.

patterns.name: List of metabolic pathway names
patterns.context: Lists biochemical metabolic pathways or biological classification items in succession.

11_849.concept: 结构化列举与领域术语
11_849.description: 激活分散于并列转折表达、板球与足球报道、球队履历、代数题和代谢通路清单；没有单一内容主题能解释全部段落，较明显的局部线索是列举与结构化文本。

patterns.name: 成对转折与并列结构
patterns.trigger: “not only … but also”（[1] 的 “not only in their cytoplasmic domains, but also in their extracellular domains”；[2] 的 “not only prothrombin, but also protein C”）
patterns.context: 在并列列举两个相关方面或对象时，突出两者都成立；[8]另有普通的“but”转折连接。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、生物医学摘要、学术投稿说明

patterns.name: 板球统计与比赛叙述
patterns.trigger: 板球词汇和数据，如 “wicket-keeper”“all three major forms of the game”“first class matches”“Tests”“wickets”“run out”“6/81”
patterns.context: 描述球员履历、赛季、比赛进程及得分或出局数据。
patterns.domain: 维基百科体育传记与比赛报道

patterns.name: 足球比赛报道
patterns.context: 报道球队进球困难、比赛结果及赛季表现。

patterns.name: 斯科普里足球俱乐部与租借经历
patterns.context: 描述球员租借去向及效力球队的时间。
patterns.domain: 维基百科足球人物传记

patterns.name: 线性方程求解题
patterns.trigger: “Solve”以及含未知数、算术运算和等式的题目，如 “m - 3*n + 10 = 0”
patterns.context: 要求解方程或求变量值。

patterns.name: 代谢通路名称清单
patterns.trigger: “Taurine and hypotaurine metabolism”“Glutathione metabolism”“Aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis”等以分号和编号分隔的名称
patterns.context: 连续列举生化代谢通路或生物学分类项目。
patterns.domain: 生物医学数据库或论文补充材料

en.concept: The contrastive conjunction but and what follows
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the contrastive conjunction but and subsequent content, including concessions, negation, supplementary restrictions, and conditions. It also occurs in cricket, football statistics, and not only…but also contexts; triggering may depend on word order and local syntax.

patterns.name: Contrastive construction with “but”
patterns.context: In contrastive or concessive sentences, but introduces a restriction, addition, or contrast to preceding content; it is sometimes followed directly by a comma or occurs in a not only…but also construction.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, forums, and code-test text

patterns.name: Cricket scores and match statistics
patterns.context: Numbers embedded in match narratives indicate scores, batting figures, or scores; this co-occurs with the stronger “but” pattern.

patterns.name: Matches and goals in football statistics
patterns.context: Statistics on football players’ or teams’ goals, appearances, and recent records; includes numbers and league names.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia player articles and sports news

patterns.name: Parallelism with but also in medicine
patterns.context: Academic sentences use not only…but also to coordinate pathological processes or affected entities.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts; related constructions also occur in patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Negation or exception after “but”
patterns.context: But introduces a sole choice, a negative result, or a mismatch between expectation and reality; these are not from the same domain.

patterns.name: Contrastive responses in English questions
patterns.context: First expresses uncertainty or asks for feedback, then offers a tentative response.

patterns.name: Contrast and test evaluation in code assertions
patterns.context: Test code or comments first acknowledge that a test is unsatisfactory, then use but to shift to an evaluation or explanation.

patterns.name: Contrast in manuscript acceptance conditions
patterns.context: First states that submissions are welcome, then uses but to introduce required conditions.

11_849.concept: 转折词 but 及其后续
11_849.description: 主要对转折词 but 及其后续内容敏感，涵盖让步、否定、补充限制与条件；另有板球、足球统计及 not only…but also 等语境，触发可能受词序和局部句法影响。

patterns.name: 转折结构“but”
patterns.context: 转折或让步句中，but 引出对前述内容的限制、补充或对照；有时紧接逗号或 not only…but also 结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域 prose、论坛及代码测试文本

patterns.name: 板球比分与赛况数字
patterns.context: 数字嵌在比赛叙述中，表示得分、击球数或比分；与较强的 “but” 模式并存。

patterns.name: 足球统计中的比赛与进球
patterns.context: 足球运动员或球队的进球、出场及近期战绩统计；包含数字与联赛名称。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 球员条目及体育新闻

patterns.name: 医学中的 but also 并列
patterns.context: 学术句中以 not only…but also 并列病理过程或受影响对象。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要；专利背景亦出现相关结构

patterns.name: “but”后的否定或例外
patterns.context: but 后引出唯一选择、否定结果或预期与实际不符；并非同一领域。
patterns.domain: 商业评论、代码错误信息

patterns.name: 英语问句中的转折答复
patterns.context: 先表达不确定或请求反馈，再提出推测性回应。

patterns.name: 代码断言中的转折与测试评价
patterns.context: 测试代码或注释先承认测试不理想，再以 but 转向评价或说明。

patterns.name: 稿件接收条件中的转折
patterns.context: 先说明稿件欢迎投稿，随后以 but 提出必须满足的条件。

en.description: Activations occur across diverse phenomena, including split word fragments, common conjunctions, question-and-answer phrasing, punctuation and line breaks, numbers, and technical terminology. Each corpus has local triggers, but no single stable semantic pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Specific consonant letters in split words
patterns.context: Activations occur within words split by corpus tokenization, especially when a fragment combines with an adjacent fragment to form a complete word. Examples include prothrombin, Polish, wickets, and Fife, as well as «in» in Haddin.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patents, sports coverage, political coverage

patterns.name: Grammatical conjunctions and question-and-answer phrasing
patterns.context: Activates when connecting coordinated or contrastive elements, forming a not only…but also construction, or responding to a question in StackExchange answers; «question» activates more strongly than nearby words.
patterns.domain: Medical and patent papers, Q&A text

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near punctuation or structural boundaries such as commas, periods, and line breaks; commas mark coordination, numbers, or lists in several passages.

patterns.name: Numbers and scores
patterns.context: Numbers occur in cited volumes and pages, event years, cricket scores, or statistics; number-triggered activations are not limited to one format.

patterns.name: Biochemical terminology and amino acid names
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of vitamin K-dependent carboxylation, proteins, or amino acids; some activations fall on terminology fragments split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Headings and list structures
patterns.context: Near headings, section titles, or lists of honors in encyclopedia text; includes line-break headings and split proper nouns.

patterns.name: Negation or qualified judgment phrasing
patterns.context: Activates on negation, limitation, and contrastive wording in expressions such as “no choice but to”.

patterns.name: Generic Q&A advice phrasing
patterns.context: Expressions that soften a response and offer initial help in StackExchange answers, such as “may not answer your question completely” and “give you a head start”.

patterns.name: Research and personal-experience phrasing
patterns.context: In first-person quotes about inadequate prior research and personal experience, activation is concentrated near words about research and degree.

patterns.name: Gene and chemical names
patterns.context: When describing biosynthetic pathways and their genes and substrates, numerals, amino-acid name fragments, and function words activate.

11_849.description: 激活分散在断词片段、常见连接词、问答措辞、标点与换行、数字及专业术语等多种现象中；不同语料各有局部触发，未见能统一解释所有段落的单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 断词中的特定辅音字母
patterns.context: 激活出现在被语料切分拆开的词内部，尤其是词的片段与相邻片段组成完整词时；覆盖 prothrombin、Polish、wickets、Fife 等不同词，另有 Haddin 中的 «in»。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利、体育报道、政治报道

patterns.name: 语法连接词和问答措辞
patterns.context: 在连接并列或转折成分、构成 not only…but also 结构，或 StackExchange 问答中回应提问时激活；其中 «question» 强于附近词。
patterns.domain: 医学与专利论文、问答文本

patterns.name: 标点与格式边界
patterns.context: 逗号、句号、换行等标点或结构边界附近出现激活；逗号在若干段中标记并列、数值或列表。

patterns.name: 数字与比分数值
patterns.context: 数字出现在引文卷页、赛事年份、板球比分或统计数据中；数字触发并不局限于某一种格式。

patterns.name: 生化术语与氨基酸名称
patterns.context: 出现在维生素 K 依赖性羧化、蛋白质或氨基酸相关表述中；部分激活落在被分词拆开的术语片段上。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、生物化学论文

patterns.name: 标题与列表结构
patterns.context: 百科文本的标题、章节标题或荣誉列表附近；包括换行标题及被拆开的专名。

patterns.name: 否定或受限判断表达
patterns.context: 在“no choice but to”这类表达中，对否定、限制及转折措辞有激活。

patterns.name: 泛化问答建议语
patterns.context: StackExchange 回答中缓和回应并提供初步帮助的表达，如“may not answer your question completely”及“give you a head start”。

patterns.name: 研究与个人经历措辞
patterns.context: 叙述事前研究不足及个人经历的第一人称引语中，激活集中在研究和程度表达附近。

patterns.name: 基因与化学名称
patterns.context: 描述生物合成途径及其基因、底物时，数词、氨基酸名称片段及功能词出现激活。

en.concept: English contrastive and additive markers, and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: Activation mainly falls on contrastive and additive structures such as but/not only…but also, and also appears in responses or hedging expressions beginning with not. Other instances include Polish, Skopje, and fragments within various biomedical terms and proper names, with no consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Response or uncertainty after negation
patterns.context: A response, degree of certainty, or judgment follows the negator not; typically conveys concession or reservation.

patterns.name: not only…but also parallel construction
patterns.context: In negative or emphatic parallel constructions, extends the entities or aspects of a claim.

patterns.name: English but contrast or comparison
patterns.context: But introduces a clause or phrase that contrasts with, compares with, or adds to preceding content; not only need not be present.

patterns.name: Poland-related terms
patterns.context: The token Polish is split into marked pieces and occurs in country- or sports-related noun phrases.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in the place name Skopje
patterns.context: The place name Skopje occurs in narratives about a player’s team and season; activation falls on a split subword fragment.

patterns.name: Local fragments in biomedical terms
patterns.context: Occur respectively within a coagulation protein name and an immune cell phenotype marker, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Other within-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Occur within proper names, protein or virus names, or other word fragments; contexts differ and cannot be grouped under a consistent trigger condition.

patterns.name: No clear shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: Fragments span biographies, sports honors, track-and-field classifications, and spatial tree algorithms; activation is scattered and cannot be sufficiently explained by the patterns above.

11_849.concept: 英文转折与并列标记及零散词片段
11_849.description: 激活主要落在 but/not only…but also 等转折、并列结构，也出现在 not 开头的回应或保留表达；另有 Polish、Skopje 及多种生物医学和专名词内片段，缺少一致语义规律。

patterns.name: 转折后的回答/不确定表达
patterns.trigger: not« answer»…« your»…« question»…« completely»；not« sure»
patterns.context: 否定词 not 后接回应、确信程度或判断；通常是让步或保留语气。

patterns.name: not only…but also 并列结构
patterns.trigger: not only« … but also …»；“not« only» … «but also»”
patterns.context: 在否定式或强调式并列中，扩展同一论断的对象或方面。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 英文 but 转折/对照
patterns.context: but 引入与前文形成转折、对照或补充的从句/短语；未必出现 not only。

patterns.name: 波兰相关词项
patterns.context: 词项 Polish 被拆分标记，出现在国家/体育相关名词短语中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科体育与人物条目

patterns.name: 地名 Skopje 的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在球员效力球队及赛季叙述中的地名 Skopje；激活落在拆分后的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 维基百科足球人物条目

patterns.name: 生物医学词项局部片段
patterns.context: 分别位于凝血蛋白名称和免疫细胞表型标记中，未显示稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 其他词内子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名、蛋白/病毒名称或词内片段中，语境不同，无法归为一致触发条件。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、NIH 研究摘要

patterns.name: 未见明确共享触发模式
patterns.trigger: «op»、«je» 等词内片段以及零散功能词标记
patterns.context: 片段涵盖人物传记、体育荣誉、田径分类及空间树算法；激活位置分散，不能由上述模式充分解释。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、专利技术文本

en.description: Activations are concentrated on not only…but also / rather contrasts, commas, and coordination boundaries; other examples include commas after parentheses, negative forum replies, code identifiers, and proper-noun fragments.

patterns.name: not only…but also contrast structure
patterns.context: In a negative, limiting, or contrastive structure, one element is introduced and then another is added; sometimes this becomes “not…but rather…”.
patterns.domain: Academic discussion, medical papers, technical documentation

patterns.name: Coordinated elements and commas
patterns.context: A comma follows coordinated or listed elements, often at a local boundary in a longer sentence.

patterns.name: Comma after a sentence-final or parenthetical phrase
patterns.context: A comma follows a parenthetical or expression of uncertainty, and the main clause continues.

patterns.name: Quote/object boundary after a sentence comma
patterns.context: In an answer or explanatory sentence, a contrast, addition, or following clause appears near the comma; activation in the passage also includes words such as answer/question.

patterns.name: Indented suffix in a code identifier
patterns.context: The base point indentation identifier in an error message is split into subwords; activation falls on fragments related to point and indentation and on quotation-mark punctuation.

patterns.name: Negative subjective response
patterns.context: A first-person forum reply begins with an expression of uncertainty or lack of prior attempts, followed by a reason, elaboration, or suggestion.

patterns.name: Local fragments in proper nouns or technical terms
patterns.context: Names or abbreviations in technical discussions or biomedical text are tokenized, with activation on name fragments; their relationship to other patterns is unclear.

11_849.description: 激活集中于 not only…but also／rather 对比、逗号及并列边界；另见括号后逗号、否定式论坛回应、代码标识符和专名词片。

patterns.name: not only…but also 对举结构
patterns.trigger: «not» / «only»，以及相邻的 «but also»；另见 «rather» 连接替代解释
patterns.context: 在否定、限定或对比结构中，先提出一个成分，再补充另一个成分；有时转为“不是……而是……”。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、医学论文、技术说明

patterns.name: 并列成分与逗号
patterns.context: 逗号紧随并列项或列举成分，常出现在较长句子的局部边界处。
patterns.domain: 哲学论述、生物医学文本

patterns.name: 句末或插入语后的逗号
patterns.context: 括号内插入语或不确定性表达结束后接逗号，继续主句。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、口语化网络文本

patterns.name: 句末逗号后的引语／对象边界
patterns.context: 回答或说明句中，逗号附近接转折、补充或后续从句；该段激活分布还包含 answer/question 等词。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的缩进后缀
patterns.context: 错误消息中的 base point indentation 标识符被拆成子词，激活落在 point、indentation 相关片段及引号标点上。

patterns.name: 否定式主观回应
patterns.context: 第一人称论坛回复以不确定或尚未尝试的表述开头，后接理由、补充或建议。

patterns.name: 专有名词或技术术语的局部词片
patterns.context: 技术讨论或生物医学文本中的名称／缩写被分词，激活落在名称片段；这些实例与其他模式的关系不清楚。
patterns.domain: 网络技术讨论、病毒学论文

en.concept: Contrast and progression structures introduced by negation
en.description: Primarily responds to progressive parallelism introduced by negative forms such as not only…but also. It also occurs in reformulations after negation, exclusions defining the scope of a review, and incomplete responses in Q&A. Activation often spans the negator, parallel markers, and related predicates.

patterns.name: not only…but also parallel construction
patterns.context: In contrastive or progressive parallelism, activation spans not, only, and subsequent elements, often strongest near a comma; the construction may extend over a long distance.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including academic papers, patents, and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Contrast or reformulation after negation
patterns.context: First rejects one interpretation, then introduces an alternative explanation with rather; activation is concentrated near the negation and causal explanation.

patterns.name: Negative scope limitation
patterns.context: A review states that a category of entities is outside the scope of discussion; activation falls on words such as is, the, not, and discussed.

patterns.name: Hedging in Q&A responses
patterns.context: A respondent acknowledges that the reply may not fully resolve the question while offering help; activation is concentrated on answer, question, and completely.

11_849.concept: 否定引出的对比与递进结构
11_849.description: 主要响应 not only…but also 这类否定形式引出的递进并列，也见于否定后改述、综述范围排除及问答中的不完全回应。激活常分布在否定词、并列标记和相关谓语上。

patterns.name: not only…but also 并列结构
patterns.trigger: “not only” / “not only that” 与后续 “but also”
patterns.context: 在对比或递进并列中，激活分布于 not、only 及其后续成分，常在逗号附近较强；结构可跨较长距离延续。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、议会文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 否定后的对照或改述
patterns.context: 先否定某种解释，再以 rather 引出替代解释；激活集中于否定及因果说明附近。

patterns.name: 否定性的范围限定
patterns.context: 在综述中说明某类对象不在讨论范围内，激活落在 is、the、not、discussed 等词上。

patterns.name: 问答回应中的缓和表达
patterns.context: 回答者承认回复可能不完全解决提问，同时提供帮助；激活集中于 answer、question、completely。

en.description: Several passages center on words and commas in concessive or additive contrast structures such as not only… but also and not…rather; other passages activate on contrasts after questions, disclaimers, and formula operators, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Contrastive addition: not only…but also
patterns.context: First negates or limits “only this,” then adds another element with but also; activation may fall on not, only, related words, and commas.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research abstracts, patent background

patterns.name: Comma within a sentence
patterns.context: A comma occurs at a contrastive, additive, or parenthetical structure in a longer sentence; sometimes it immediately follows a local emphasis word or phrase.
patterns.domain: Mathematical text, research and medical text, forums, and web text

patterns.name: Correction after a concession
patterns.context: First rejects one interpretation, then introduces an alternative with rather; the comma marks the contrast.

patterns.name: Qualified stance after a concession
patterns.context: Acknowledges that the preceding point may be valid, then uses but to introduce a personal qualification or rebuttal.

patterns.name: Comma in an answer following a question
patterns.context: A comma appears mid-sentence in an answer or explanation, followed by but introducing an addition; no clear not only construction is present.

patterns.name: Contrast after a basic question
patterns.context: Qualifies a question as basic, then uses but to introduce a subsequent difficulty or addition.

patterns.name: Comma in a disclaimer-like coordination
patterns.context: But after a comma introduces a qualification on the purpose of the previously mentioned collection or action.

patterns.name: Comma in a formula
patterns.context: Activations occur near punctuation or operators within algebraic expressions; this is unrelated to contrastive structures in natural language.

11_849.description: 多段集中于 not only… but also、not…rather 等让步补充或转折结构中的词语及逗号；其他段落在问句后转折、免责声明和公式运算符处激活，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 转折补充：not only…but also
patterns.trigger: «not»…«only»…«,»…«but also»；如 «not»1« only»1 … «pro»2th«rom»1«bin»3«,»9 but also（2）、«not»2« only»2 … «but also»（4、5）、«related»3 not «only»2 …«,»9 but also（9）
patterns.context: 先否定或限制“仅仅如此”，随后用 but also 补充另一项；激活可落在 not、only、相关词及逗号上。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 句中逗号
patterns.context: 逗号位于较长句子的转折、补充或插入结构处；有时紧接局部强调词或短语。
patterns.domain: 数学文本、科研与医学文本、论坛及网页文本

patterns.name: 让步后转折纠正
patterns.context: 先否定一种解释，再用 rather 引出替代解释；逗号标记转折。

patterns.name: 让步后限定立场
patterns.context: 承认前述观点可能成立，再接 but 引出个人限定或反驳。

patterns.name: 问句后续回答的逗号
patterns.context: 逗号出现在回答或说明句的中段，随后 but 引出补充；没有明显 not only 结构。

patterns.name: 基础问题后的转折
patterns.context: 自我限定问题很基础，接 but 引出后续困难或补充。

patterns.name: 并列免责声明式逗号
patterns.context: 逗号后 but 引出对前述收集或行为的用途限定。

patterns.name: 公式中的逗号
patterns.context: 代数表达式内的标点或运算符附近出现激活；与自然语言转折结构无关。

en.description: Activation primarily occurs on intra-sentence commas, especially commas in progressive, contrastive, and adversative structures with not only…but also, but, or rather. A few exceptions include negated search statements and mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: Comma in concessive or progressive structures
patterns.context: A comma occurs in contrastive, progressive, or corrective structures such as not only…but also, rather than, and not … but, or before an interrupting contrast within a sentence.
patterns.domain: General written language, medical and academic writing, online comments

patterns.name: Progressive expression with “not only”
patterns.context: The negator not and only form “not only,” often followed by but also to introduce additional information; activation also falls on the associated comma.
patterns.domain: Academic, medical, and general explanatory writing

patterns.name: Comma introducing contrast or correction
patterns.context: After a comma, rather it or but introduces a contrast or correction to a preceding explanation or judgment.

patterns.name: Intra-sentence comma and contrastive addition
patterns.context: A comma separates elements in a list or comparison, followed by but not to restrict the contrasting item.

patterns.name: Comma introducing supplementary information
patterns.context: But also after a comma adds parallel information; not only need not occur earlier.

patterns.name: Passive expression of negative search results
patterns.context: Describes literature or records not being retrieved by a database, ending with searches; activation falls on searches.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A polynomial expression in a derivatives problem; activation falls near numbers and the minus sign, unlike the syntactic punctuation pattern in other examples.

patterns.name: Other weakly associated punctuation positions
patterns.context: A comma occurs near an in-sentence list or clause, but the excerpts are insufficient to determine a more specific structure.

11_849.concept: 句中逗号及对照递进结构
11_849.description: 主要激活于句中逗号，尤其是 not only…but also、but 或 rather 等递进、对照和转折结构中的逗号；另有检索否定句、数学表达式等少数异例。

patterns.name: 让步或递进结构中的逗号
patterns.context: 逗号出现在 not only…but also、rather than、not … but 等对照、递进或纠正结构中，或位于句中插入性转折前。
patterns.domain: 一般书面语、医学与学术写作、网络评论

patterns.name: “not only”递进表达
patterns.context: 否定词 not 与 only 构成“not only”，常接 but also 引出补充信息；激活点也落在相关逗号上。
patterns.domain: 学术、医学及一般说明文

patterns.name: 逗号连接转折或纠正
patterns.context: 逗号后用 rather it、but 等引出对前述解释或判断的转折、修正。

patterns.name: 句中逗号与对比补充
patterns.context: 在列举或比较中用逗号分隔成分，随后以 but not 限定对照项。

patterns.name: 逗号引出补充说明
patterns.context: 逗号后以 but also 补充并列信息；前面不一定出现 not only。

patterns.name: 否定检索结果的被动表达
patterns.context: 描述文献或记录未被数据库检索到，句末以 searches 收束；激活落在 searches。
patterns.domain: 系统综述、学术方法描述

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 导数题中的多项式表达式，激活落在数字和减号附近，与其他样例的句法标点模式不同。

patterns.name: 其他弱关联的标点位置
patterns.context: 逗号出现在句中列举或从句附近，但样例片段不足以确定更具体的结构。

en.concept: not only… but construction and but conjunction
en.description: Most passages feature the additive construction not only… but (also), with activation on the conjunction, nearby content words, or punctuation; there are also contrastive uses of but and an isolated non-homogeneously, whose relation to the main pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: not only construction and continuation
patterns.context: In the “not only X but (also) Y” construction, activation may fall on only, but, also, emphasized X/Y elements, or punctuation; sometimes the excerpt shows only one side of the construction.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, taxonomy, technical discussions, academic papers, and forum text

patterns.name: Contrastive but conjunction
patterns.context: but connects opposing or supplementary judgments, not necessarily with not only; examples show activation on but, a comma, or a nearby word.

patterns.name: Descriptions related to non-homogeneous transformations
patterns.context: Describes a quantity that does not vary homogeneously under transformation; this passage contains no not only/but construction.

11_849.concept: not only… but 构式及 but 连接
11_849.description: 多数段落出现 not only… but (also) 的并列递进构式，激活位置可在连接词、邻近内容词或标点；另有 but 转折用法及单独的 non-homogeneously，后者与主模式关系不明。

patterns.name: not only 构式及延续
patterns.context: 在 “not only X but (also) Y” 构式中，激活可落在 only、but、also，或被强调的 X/Y 成分及标点上；有时片段只显示构式的一侧。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分类学、技术讨论、学术论文及论坛文本

patterns.name: but 转折连接
patterns.context: but 用于连接相反或补充判断，未必有 not only；例中激活落在 but、逗号或邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、论坛评论

patterns.name: 非同质变换相关表述
patterns.context: 描述量在变换下并非按齐次方式变化；本段未出现 not only/but 构式。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的数学／物理讨论

en.concept: Progressive parallel expressions and discourse connectors
en.description: Primarily responds to progressive parallelism with “not only…but also,” with activation near its connectors or parallel content. It also responds to Q&A words, self-deprecating identity statements, and a few evaluative or colloquial words.

patterns.name: “not only … but also” parallel construction
patterns.context: Adds a progressive element to two parallel constituents in expressions such as “not only X but also Y”; activation may fall on only, but, also, or adjacent words.

patterns.name: Complete answers or questions
patterns.context: Answers a question or asks one in a Q&A context; may also involve self-deprecating claims that a question is stupid.

patterns.name: Negative self-positioning
patterns.context: A speaker denies being a fan or expert in a field, often to lower expectations about their stance or credentials.

patterns.name: Controversial or astonishing evaluation
patterns.context: Describes reactions of strong surprise or anger caused by a revelation, news, or similar event.

patterns.name: Colloquial contrast and closing expressions
patterns.context: In colloquial discussion, refers back to prior content, signals contrast, strengthens negation, or summarizes similar matters with “and such”; trigger words are scattered, with no unified construction apparent.

11_849.concept: 递进并列表达及话语连接
11_849.description: 主要响应“not only…but also”递进并列结构，且激活可落在其连接词或并列内容附近；另对问答词、自我否定式身份表述及少数评价、口语词有反应。

patterns.name: “not only … but also”并列结构
patterns.trigger: «not» / «only» 与后续 «but»，或同一结构中的并列结果词
patterns.context: 在“not only X but also Y”一类表达中，对两个并列成分作递进补充；激活可落在 only、but、also 或相邻词上。

patterns.name: 完整回答或问题
patterns.context: 回答提问，或在问答语境中提出问题；也可能涉及对问题是否愚蠢的自谦说法。

patterns.name: 否定式自我立场
patterns.context: 说话者否认自己是某领域的爱好者或专家，常用于降低立场或资历预期。

patterns.name: 争议或惊人评价
patterns.context: 描述揭露、消息等造成强烈惊讶或愤怒的反应。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、流行文化讨论

patterns.name: 口语转折与收束表达
patterns.context: 在口语讨论中指代前文、转折、加强否定或以“and such”概括同类事项；此处触发词分散，未见统一句式。

en.description: Primarily responds to contrastive or supplementary structures introduced by but, especially not only…but also; some activations also fall at the ends of phrases from different domains and in colloquial supplementary expressions, with no consistent lexical trigger.

patterns.name: but in contrastive/supplementary structures
patterns.context: but introduces a supplementary, contrastive, or concessive clause; it often appears before or after but, especially near also, a comma, or a phrase boundary.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, forum discussions, narrative, and technical text across domains

patterns.name: Closure of noun phrases or terms
patterns.context: Positive activation falls at the end of a multiword noun phrase or clause, often alongside a comma, period, or parentheses; no consistent lexical category is evident.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, technical text, online text

patterns.name: Discourse supplementation in colloquial language
patterns.context: In speech or informal writing, occurs near supplementary, concessive, or sentence-final expressions; specific trigger words vary.

11_849.description: 主要响应 but 引出的对照或补充结构，尤其 not only…but also；另有若干激活落在不同领域的短语末尾及口语补充表达，缺乏一致的词义触发。

patterns.name: 转折/补充结构中的 but
patterns.trigger: “but”及其前后相邻词，如 “not only … but also”、“Sure … but …”、“not … but …”
patterns.context: but 引出补充、对照或让步后的分句；常在 but 前后，尤其与 also、逗号或短语边界相邻。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的学术论文、论坛讨论、叙述及技术文本

patterns.name: 名词短语或术语的收束
patterns.context: 正激活落在多词名词短语或从句的末端，常伴随逗号、句号或括号；未见统一的词义类别。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、技术文本、网络文本

patterns.name: 口语中的话语补充
patterns.context: 口语或非正式文字中，出现在补充、让步或句尾表达附近；具体触发词不一致。

en.description: Activation is distributed across several structures: contrastive or supplementary but, additive not only constructions, same comparisons, as well as local patterns involving questions and answers, evaluations, strain markers, punctuation, and scientific terminology; no single semantic pattern explains all excerpts.

patterns.name: Contrast or supplementation around “but”
patterns.context: Introduces a contrast, limitation, supplement, or alternative after a prior statement; the semantic function varies across examples.
patterns.domain: Research papers, Q&A, legal texts, classical discourse, online articles

patterns.name: “not only … but also” coordination
patterns.context: In a negative additive coordination, presents more than one effect, classification, or function; in [2], the construction is incomplete in the excerpt.
patterns.domain: Online comments, research papers, and project descriptions

patterns.name: “same” in comparative constructions
patterns.context: Compares whether the types or frequencies of the objects are the same.

patterns.name: Answer- and question-related vocabulary
patterns.context: A respondent partially answers a question and notes that the answer may be incomplete.

patterns.name: Evaluation of something astonishing or infuriating
patterns.context: Describes revealed content as astonishing and coordinates it with the subsequent “infuriating”.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in mouse strain names
patterns.context: Numbers and letters form part of an experimental mouse strain marker, rather than an ordinary syntactic usage.

patterns.name: Commas, semicolons, and other punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs at boundaries of contrast, parentheticals, or coordination within a sentence; its specific syntactic role varies.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, classical discourse, research papers

patterns.name: Changes in concepts or processes
patterns.context: Scientific description of changes in RNA conformation and regulatory function.

patterns.name: Lists of choices and energy sources
patterns.context: Discusses choosing among options such as nuclear power, natural gas, and coal, then introduces another set of choices.

11_849.description: 激活分散在多种结构：but转折或补充、not only递进并列、same比较，以及问答、评价、品系标记、标点和科研术语等局部模式；没有单一语义模式能解释所有片段。

patterns.name: “but”前后的转折或补充
patterns.context: 在先前陈述后引入对照、限制、补充或另一项选择；各例语义功能不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 科研论文、问答、法律文本、古典论述、网络文章

patterns.name: “not only … but also”并列结构
patterns.context: 在否定式递进并列中，提出不止一种影响、分类或作用；[2]的句式不完整于摘录中。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、科研论文及项目描述

patterns.name: 比较结构中的“same”
patterns.context: 比较对象的类型或频率是否相同。

patterns.name: 答案与问题相关词汇
patterns.context: 回答者对问题作出部分回应，并说明答案可能不完整。

patterns.name: 惊人或激怒的评价
patterns.context: 形容揭示内容令人震惊，并与后续的“infuriating”并列。

patterns.name: 小鼠品系名称中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 数字和字母构成实验小鼠品系标记的一部分，并非普通句法用法。

patterns.name: 逗号及分号等标点
patterns.context: 标点出现在句中转折、插入语或并列结构边界；具体句法作用各异。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、古典论述、科研论文

patterns.name: 概念或过程变化
patterns.context: RNA构象变化与调控作用的科研描述。

patterns.name: 选择及能源来源列举
patterns.context: 在核能与天然气、煤炭等选项之间讨论选择，后续再引出另一组选择。

en.description: The most concentrated pattern is parallelism, progression, or scope expansion introduced by not only, often co-occurring with but, also, more importantly, and commas. There are also ordinary but contrasts, domain-specific terms, Q&A additions, and isolated collocations; it is unclear whether all are triggered by the same mechanism.

patterns.name: “not only…but (also)” construction
patterns.context: After the negative qualifier not only, lists parallel, progressive, or expanded properties, entities, or scope; activation often falls on subsequent content, punctuation, and adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Common argumentative constructions in academic papers, research abstracts, and online comments

patterns.name: Supplementary or contrastive connectors
patterns.context: After a concession, negation, or contrast, but introduces additional information, an opposing result, or further explanation; some examples do not contain not only.
patterns.domain: Q&A, research abstracts, and academic text

patterns.name: Emphatic progressive expression
patterns.context: After a similarity or argument has been established, the phrase marks a more important addition; observed in only one passage.

patterns.name: Comma before parallel content
patterns.context: A comma marks a syntactic boundary in a contrast, parenthetical, or list; this token is marked in several passages, but an isolated comma does not establish a unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Q&A addition after but
patterns.context: A respondent acknowledges that the answer is incomplete, then offers a helpful starting point; distinct from the contrastive use in scientific text.

patterns.name: Biomedical abbreviations and alphanumeric combinations
patterns.context: A mouse strain name occurs next to a species name; activation may target a split abbreviation token or collocation, but the specific mechanism is unclear.

patterns.name: Adverbial phrase indicating degree
patterns.context: Describes how a model responds to drug intervention; lacks a clear not only/but construction and is an isolated example.

patterns.name: Words expressing surprise and emotion
patterns.context: A but contrast links emotional evaluations of the same thing; activation spans adjectives and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Online book reviews or entertainment discussions

patterns.name: Scientific term and scope qualification
patterns.context: Explains that the degree of tumor vascular leakage varies across tumors of the same type and within a single tumor; aside from the but construction, whether the noun itself triggers activation is uncertain.

patterns.name: Paired listing of medical terms
patterns.context: Lists similarities between disease models and multiple sclerosis, then continues with a progression using but more importantly; evidence that the terms themselves independently trigger activation is limited.

patterns.name: Parallel treatment conditions
patterns.context: Compares two arginine treatments and uses but not to explicitly deny the effect of one of them.

patterns.name: Evaluation of an article and its insights
patterns.context: A commenter says that a passage from an article was very insightful to them and anticipates that readers may disagree; no not only construction is present, and the trigger is uncertain.

patterns.name: Parallel dietary restrictions
patterns.context: Clinical text describes whether guidance to restrict fluids or sodium is accepted; this recurs without an obvious but/not only construction.

11_849.description: 最集中模式是 not only 引出的并列、递进或范围扩展，常与 but、also、more importantly 和逗号共现。另有普通 but 对照，以及若干领域术语、问答补充和孤立搭配，无法确认均由同一机制触发。

patterns.name: “not only…but (also)”结构
patterns.trigger: “not only”以及其后的对照或递进成分，如 “not only … but also”“not only … but more importantly”“not only among … but even …”
patterns.context: 在否定限定 not only 后列举并列、递进或扩展的性质、对象或范围；激活常落在后续内容、标点及相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、科研摘要及网络评论中的常见论述句式

patterns.name: 补充或转折连接词
patterns.trigger: “but”及其后续成分，如 “but might give”“but not D-arginine”；另有 “but also”
patterns.context: 前文提出让步、否定或对照，but 引出补充、相反结果或进一步说明；部分例子并不含 not only。
patterns.domain: 问答、科研摘要与学术文本

patterns.name: 强调性递进表达
patterns.context: 在已有相似性或论据之后，以该短语标出更重要的补充；只见于一段。

patterns.name: 并列内容前的逗号
patterns.trigger: “,”，包括 “but … ,”以及复杂并列结构中的逗号
patterns.context: 逗号处于对照、插入或列举的句法边界；多段中该 token 被标记，但孤立逗号不足以确定统一触发条件。

patterns.name: but 后的问答补充
patterns.trigger: “but might give you a head start”
patterns.context: 回答者承认回答不完全，再提供有帮助的起点；区别于科学文本中的对照用法。

patterns.name: 生物医学缩写及字母数字组合
patterns.context: 小鼠品系名称与物种名相邻；激活可能针对拆分后的缩写 token 或搭配，具体机制不明。

patterns.name: 限定程度的副词短语
patterns.context: 描述模型对药物干预的反应方式；没有明确的 not only/but 结构，属于孤例。

patterns.name: 惊讶与情绪评价词
patterns.context: 以 but 转折连接对同一事物的情绪评价；激活跨越形容词和标点。

patterns.name: 科学名词及限定范围
patterns.context: 说明肿瘤血管渗漏程度在同类肿瘤之间及同一肿瘤内部存在差异；除 but 结构外，该名词本身是否触发不确定。

patterns.name: 成对列举的医学术语
patterns.context: 列举疾病模型与多发性硬化症的相似之处，并由 but more importantly 继续递进；术语本身的独立触发证据有限。

patterns.name: 并列治疗条件
patterns.context: 比较两种精氨酸处理，并用 but not 明确否定其中一种的效果。

patterns.name: 文章与洞见的评价
patterns.context: 评论者说明某段文章内容对自己很有启发，并预想读者可能不以为然；未见 not only 结构，触发原因不确定。

patterns.name: 饮食限制项目并列
patterns.context: 临床文本描述是否接受限制液体或钠的指导；重复出现，但没有明显的 but/not only 句式。

en.description: Primarily responds to contrast, supplementation, or qualification introduced by but, commonly in not only… but…; also covers the French equivalent structure. Activation often occurs near commas, with a few instances on subword fragments within words for unclear reasons.

patterns.name: but introducing contrast or supplementation
patterns.context: but introduces a clause contrasting with, supplementing, or qualifying the preceding text; it sometimes occurs in a fixed expression. Activation often falls on punctuation, a word, or a following word near but.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal texts, news, forum dialogue, and literary narrative

patterns.name: not only … but also additive structure
patterns.context: In a coordination, first negates “only this,” then introduces another item with but/mais; the trigger may occur on commas, words, or phrases before or after but.
patterns.domain: Academic, legal, literary, and forum texts, as well as French political text

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs near contrastive or additive conjunctions across various syntax and topics; it is difficult to determine whether punctuation itself is an independent trigger.

patterns.name: but in a phrase
patterns.context: but introduces a suggestion or softens a preceding judgment; this example has no clear not only construction.

patterns.name: Intra-sentence token-boundary fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside a tokenized word rather than on a complete word or an obvious but construction; its relation to the main pattern is uncertain.

patterns.name: French subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across French subword fragments such as articles, stems, and endings; the same passage also contains “non seulement … mais aussi”, so the whole-sentence structure may be a factor.

11_849.description: 主要对 but 引出的对比、补充或限定结构有反应，常见于 not only… but…；也覆盖法语对应结构。激活常邻近逗号，少数落在词内子词，成因不明。

patterns.name: but 连接对比或补充
patterns.trigger: “but”及其前后相邻内容，例如 “not only … but …”、“nothing but”、“not … but …”、“not … either but …”
patterns.context: but 引出与前文对比、补充或限定的分句；有时处在固定搭配中。激活常落在 but 附近的标点、词或后续词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律文本、新闻、论坛对话及文学叙述

patterns.name: not only … but also 递进结构
patterns.trigger: “not only … but …”，以及法语 “non seulement … mais aussi”
patterns.context: 并列结构中先否定“仅仅如此”，再由 but/mais 引出另一项；触发词可能位于 but 前后的逗号、词或短语。
patterns.domain: 学术、法律、文学、论坛及法语政治文本

patterns.name: 逗号标点
patterns.context: 在转折或并列连接词附近出现，跨多种句法和话题；难以判断标点本身是否独立触发。

patterns.name: 短语中的 but
patterns.trigger: “but might give you a head start”
patterns.context: but 引出建议或缓和前述判断；此例没有明显的 not only 结构。

patterns.name: 句中 token 边界碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的单词内部，而非完整词或显然的 but 结构上；与主模式的关系不确定。

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在法语冠词、词干及词尾等子词片段；同段也包含 “non seulement … mais aussi”，因此可能受整句结构影响。

en.description: Primarily responds to additive coordination such as not only… but also, where but supplements another item after the first; also includes concessive evaluations introduced by but and one public-health context involving risk and virus.

patterns.name: not only...but also
patterns.context: After introducing one item, adds, extends, or contrasts another through but also / but / but with; trigger points occur at multiple positions in this construction.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, political discourse, and historical narrative

patterns.name: Supplementary qualification of an answer or property
patterns.context: but adds a softening, concessive, or supplementary evaluation; no not only construction is present.

patterns.name: Risk- and virus-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses perceived threats based on outdated data versus actual danger, and distinguishes high- and low-risk populations.

11_849.description: 主要响应 not only… but also 等递进并列结构，在列出一项后由 but 补充另一项；另有 but 引出的让步评价，以及一例围绕 risk、virus 的公共卫生语境。

patterns.name: not only...but also
patterns.trigger: “not only”及后续“but also”（[3]、[4]、[5]、[7]、[8]）；“not only”后接并列成分并以“but”引出另一项（[9]、[10]）
patterns.context: 前一项被提出后，再通过 but also / but / but with 补充、扩展或对照另一项；触发点分布在这一结构中的多个位置
patterns.domain: 学术论文、政治论述及历史叙述

patterns.name: 回答或性质的限定补充
patterns.trigger: “but might give you a head start”；“but it gives a good enough”（[1]、[6]）
patterns.context: but 后追加缓和、让步或补充性评价；未出现 not only 结构

patterns.name: 风险与病毒词汇
patterns.context: 讨论基于过期数据的感知威胁与实际危险，并区分高、低风险人群
patterns.domain: 网络新闻讨论／公共卫生

en.concept: Markers of coordination and contrast structures
en.description: Many high activations fall on not only/incomplete not only coordination structures and their commas, and also on contrastive commas with not just/either; other activations occur on numbers and letters in the mouse strain B10.A.

patterns.name: not only ... but also coordination
patterns.context: Introduces an element, object, or scope, then adds a coordinated element with but also; activation often falls on the comma after not only, around but also, or at the boundary of a coordinated element.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, medical abstracts, and general expository text

patterns.name: Incomplete not only contrast structure
patterns.context: not only introduces an additive or contrastive construction, but the excerpt contains no corresponding but also, or the subsequent structure is incomplete.
patterns.domain: News commentary, forum Q&A, and academic text

patterns.name: Comma in negative contrast
patterns.context: but introduces a contrast or supplement, with not just or either in the preceding part; activation falls on the comma rather than a topic-specific word.

patterns.name: Punctuation in number-and-letter markers
patterns.context: A specific mouse strain name is split into a number, period, and letter; activation is concentrated within the marker rather than in a clear grammatical structure.

11_849.description: 多处高激活落在 not only/不完整 not only 并列结构及其逗号，也出现在 not just/either 的对照逗号；另有小鼠品系 B10.A 内的数字和字母激活。

patterns.name: not only ... but also 并列结构
patterns.trigger: “not only ... but also”，以及紧邻该结构的逗号，如 “not only ... regulation»,»”
patterns.context: 先引入一个成分、对象或范围，随后用 but also 增补并列成分；激活常落在 not only 后的逗号、but also 前后，或并列成分边界
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学摘要及一般说明文

patterns.name: 不完整的 not only 对照结构
patterns.context: 出现 not only 引出的递进或对照，但所给片段中没有对应的 but also，或后续结构未完整呈现
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、论坛问答及学术文本

patterns.name: 否定对照中的逗号
patterns.trigger: “not just a product, but a category”中的逗号；“not yet a billionaire, either, but ...”中的逗号
patterns.context: but 引入转折或补充对照，前项含 not just 或 either；激活落在逗号而非特定主题词上

patterns.name: 数字与字母标记中的标点
patterns.context: 特定小鼠品系名称被拆成数字、句点和字母；激活集中于标识内部，而非明确的语法结构

en.description: Most passages contain a “not only…but also” parallel construction, with activation on parallel constituents or the comma between them. Other instances include commas at citation boundaries and local word activations in comments and Q&A, which are difficult to explain fully with one structure.

patterns.name: not only…but also parallel construction
patterns.context: Explicit “not only X but also Y” parallel or expansion structure; activation may fall on words on the not only side, words on the Y side, or the comma before but, and is not necessarily fixed on the connector itself.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain argumentative, academic, and commentary writing

patterns.name: Comma and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: A comma occurs at the boundary of parallel constituents or structures such as quotations and parentheses; some instances are near not only…but also, while others are not.

patterns.name: Local complete expressions or words
patterns.context: Activation covers adjacent words or phrases; the given excerpts have no clear not only…but also construction, and comma position does not always explain it.

11_849.description: 多数段落含“not only…but also”并列结构，激活位置可落在并列成分或其间逗号；另有引文边界逗号及评论、问答中的局部词语激活，难以由单一结构完全解释。

patterns.name: not only…but also 并列结构
patterns.trigger: “not only”及其后续“but also”，常在 but 前的逗号附近出现标记，如 [1] “at« risk»7 … «virus»10”及 [2] “conformational« changes»3 … global« regulation»3«,»10”
patterns.context: 明确的“not only X but also Y”并列或扩展结构；激活可落在 not only 一侧的词、Y 侧的词或 but 前逗号，未必固定在连接词本身。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的论述、学术写作及评论性文字

patterns.name: 逗号及标点边界
patterns.context: 逗号位于并列成分或引文、括号等结构的边界；部分出现处邻近 not only…but also，另一些则不是。
patterns.domain: 学术论文引文格式、评论文字

patterns.name: 局部完整表达或词语
patterns.context: 激活覆盖相邻的词语或短语；给定片段中没有明显的 not only…but also 结构，也不总是由逗号解释。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on contrastive but and nearby punctuation and words: commonly in constructions that concede or acknowledge a limitation before adding a qualification, as well as in general contrastive turns; spans multiple online genres.

patterns.name: Hedging/reservation before a contrast
patterns.context: First acknowledges a possible objection, limitation, or negative judgment, then uses but to add, correct, or emphasize; activation often falls on but, adjacent punctuation, or a following word.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, Q&A, product discussions, and patent text

patterns.name: Intra-sentence contrastive but
patterns.context: but juxtaposes different judgments; there need not be an explicit concessive phrase, and activation may also fall on a following word or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, Q&A, and general web text

patterns.name: Parenthetical comma
patterns.context: A comma marks a parenthetical, concessive element, or sentence boundary before a contrast; by itself, it is insufficient to identify a semantic pattern.

11_849.description: 激活集中在 but 转折及其邻近标点、词语：常见于先让步或承认局限、再补充修正的句式，也包括一般对比转折；涉及多种网络文体。

patterns.name: 转折前置的弱化/保留
patterns.trigger: “but”及其前面的让步或否定表达，如“may not sound like”“may not answer”“may seem”“not only … but also”
patterns.context: 先承认某种可能的反对、局限或负面判断，再由 but 转向补充、纠正或强调；激活常落在 but、紧邻标点或其后词语上
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、问答、产品讨论及专利文本

patterns.name: 句中对比转折 but
patterns.context: but 将前后不同的判断并置；不一定有显式的让步短语，激活也可能落在 but 后的词或标点上
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、问答及一般网页文本

patterns.name: 插入性逗号
patterns.trigger: “,”，尤其是 but 前后的逗号，如“here, but”“times before, but”“such, but”
patterns.context: 逗号标出转折前的插入语、让步成分或句子边界；单独出现不足以确定语义模式

en.description: Primarily sensitive to supplementary or contrastive structures involving not only/not just and but also/but, as well as contrasts introduced by but after negation or concession. Several activations fall on nearby commas or words, making their independent role difficult to distinguish.

patterns.name: not only… but also correlative structure
patterns.context: In a coordinated or contrastive statement, first presents one aspect, then adds another; triggers may fall on nearby punctuation or words.
patterns.domain: News, politics, technology, patents, and general expository text

patterns.name: but contrast after negation
patterns.context: The first clause negates, limits, or concedes something; but introduces contrasting, supplementary, or corrective content.

patterns.name: Comma before but and punctuation
patterns.context: Across several examples, the marker falls on the comma before but, a word after the comma, or a nearby position; it may be jointly triggered by the contrastive structure and clause boundary.

patterns.name: Intra-word suffix in a highlighted coordinated predicate
patterns.context: Activation falls on a word suffix; this example also occurs in a “not only … but …” coordination, so an independent trigger is uncertain.

11_849.description: 主要对 not only/not just 与 but also/but 的补充或对照结构敏感，也覆盖否定、让步后由 but 引出的转折。若干激活落在邻近逗号或词语上，难以区分其独立作用。

patterns.name: not only… but also 对举结构
patterns.trigger: “not only”及后续“but also”（含“not just… but…”）
patterns.context: 在并列或对照陈述中，先提出一个方面，再补充另一个方面；触发可落在补充项附近的标点或词上。
patterns.domain: 新闻、政治、科技、专利及一般说明文

patterns.name: 否定后接 but 转折
patterns.trigger: “not … but …”或“may … but …”，包括“not answer … completely but…”
patterns.context: 前半句否定、限制或让步，but 引出对照、补充或修正内容。

patterns.name: but 前逗号及标点
patterns.trigger: “,»”等逗号，以及 but 附近的标点
patterns.context: 多个样例中标记落在 but 前的逗号、逗号后的词或相关邻近位置；可能与转折结构及分句边界共同触发。

patterns.name: 高亮并列谓词的词内后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在单词后缀部分；此例同时处于“not only … but …”并列结构中，是否独立触发不确定。

en.description: The most consistent signal is the comma, especially in additive coordination structures such as not only…but also; other activations are scattered across nouns and intra-word fragments, without a consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: The comma itself is marked; it often occurs after a parenthetical, coordinated structure, or supplementary statement within a sentence.
patterns.domain: Prose and technical text across domains

patterns.name: not only…but also coordination
patterns.context: Uses additive coordination for two objects, aspects, or categories; activation may fall on a nearby comma or following word.
patterns.domain: Popular science, academic writing, commentary, and general prose

patterns.name: Word-final or intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on part of a word rather than a standalone word; the specific word meanings vary.

patterns.name: Nouns and evaluative vocabulary
patterns.context: Activation occurs on nouns or evaluative words within a sentence, with no consistent semantic condition evident.
patterns.domain: News, forums, academic and general text

11_849.description: 最稳定的信号是逗号，尤其出现在 not only…but also 等并列补充结构中；另有若干分散的名词和词内片段激活，缺少一致语义主题。

patterns.name: 逗号标点
patterns.context: 逗号本身被标记；多出现在插入语、并列结构或句中补充说明之后
patterns.domain: 多领域散文与技术文本

patterns.name: not only…but also 并列结构
patterns.context: 对两个对象、方面或类别作递进并列；激活可落在邻近逗号或后续词上
patterns.domain: 科普、学术、评论及一般散文

patterns.name: 词尾或词中片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词的一部分，而非独立词；具体词义各异

patterns.name: 名词及评价性词汇
patterns.context: 在句中名词或评价词处激活，未见统一语义条件
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛、学术与一般文本

en.description: Activation is mainly concentrated on commas before the contrastive conjunction but and words in contrastive parallel structures such as not only … but also. A few activations fall on local words such as success, strange, and it, possibly influenced by nearby contrastive structures.

patterns.name: But in concession or contrast
patterns.context: But follows a comma and connects a contrast, concession, or addition; sometimes but is adjacent to a marked full word such as «it» or «either», which may also belong to this local structure.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, news, forums, scientific text

patterns.name: not only … but also parallel construction
patterns.context: Occurs in a not only … but also construction; the marker falls on content words after not only or on adjacent parallel constituents, including word forms spanning multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, parliamentary texts, online comments

patterns.name: Positive outcome and success
patterns.context: When discussing a colony’s appeal to settlers and its results, success occurs in the contrastive construction not alone … but likewise.

patterns.name: Strong evaluative word
patterns.context: In a personal account of the sound and feel of a golf club hitting the ball, but introduces an observation contrary to expectations or the norm.
patterns.domain: Sports equipment or personal experience reviews

patterns.name: It in a preference or choice
patterns.context: A luxury or expensive item is introduced, then but is used to explain that the speaker would not choose it.

patterns.name: But after a dash
patterns.context: After an inserted clarification following a dash, but introduces another option or contrast.

11_849.description: 激活主要集中于转折连词 but 前的逗号，以及 not only … but also 等对照并列结构中的词；少数激活落在 success、strange、it 等局部词上，可能受邻近转折结构影响。

patterns.name: 让步或对照中的 but
patterns.context: 逗号后接 but，连接前后对照、让步或补充转折；有时 but 紧邻标记的完整词，如 «it»、«either»，也可能属于这一局部结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、新闻、论坛、科学文本

patterns.name: not only … but also 并列结构
patterns.context: 处于 not only … but also 结构中，标记落在 not only 后的内容词，或相邻并列成分；包含跨词、跨 token 的词形。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、议会文本、网络评论

patterns.name: 正面结果与成功
patterns.context: 谈论殖民地吸引定居者及其结果时，success 出现在 not alone … but likewise 的对照结构中。

patterns.name: 强烈评价词
patterns.context: 球杆击球的声音和手感的个人体验中，but 引出与预期或常态相反的观察。
patterns.domain: 体育器材或个人体验评论

patterns.name: 偏好或选择中的 it
patterns.context: 先提出奢侈品或高价商品，再以 but 转折说明个人不会选择它。

patterns.name: 破折号后的 but
patterns.context: 破折号插入补充说明后，由 but 引出另一种选择或对照。

en.description: Activation is most concentrated on contrast, concession, or supplementation introduced by but, especially not only … but also and its ellipses and variants; it also covers but usages without a fixed not only structure, with some markers falling on local word fragments.

patterns.name: “not only … but also” additive coordination
patterns.context: Supplements or extends the first item, listing additional effects, properties, objects, or reasons; the two parts need not be adjacent.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including academic, patent, philosophical, and news text, as well as online discussions

patterns.name: “not just … but …” contrastive supplementation
patterns.context: First rejects a description as limited to the initial item, then presents a broader or different characterization.

patterns.name: Elliptical “not only A but B”
patterns.context: Two adjectival descriptions form a contrast, with no also after but.

patterns.name: Concession or supplementation after but
patterns.context: but introduces a concession, limitation, or contrast; some examples have no not only construction and do not form a fixed expression.
patterns.domain: Sports commentary, Q&A, philosophy, forum discussions

patterns.name: Local word forms around but
patterns.context: Activation falls on the marker word or a word fragment, possibly co-occurring with additive/contrastive patterns; these fragments alone cannot establish an independent trigger condition.

11_849.description: 激活最集中于 but 引出的转折、让步或补充，尤其是 not only … but also 及其省略、变体；同时覆盖若干无固定 not only 结构的 but 用例，部分标记落在局部词片段上。

patterns.name: “not only … but also”并列递进
patterns.trigger: “not only … but also”，含标记位置附近的“System»”“but also”“b but also”等
patterns.context: 用来补充或扩展前项，列出额外影响、性质、对象或理由；不要求两个部分紧邻。
patterns.domain: 学术、专利、哲学、新闻及网络讨论等多种文体

patterns.name: “not just … but …”对照补充
patterns.trigger: “not just a« product» … but a category”
patterns.context: 先否定描述只限于前项，再提出更广或不同的定位。

patterns.name: “not only A but B”省略 also
patterns.context: 两个形容词性描述构成对照，but 后不出现 also。

patterns.name: but 后的让步或补充
patterns.trigger: “« strange» but”“« question» « completely» but”“« it» but”“« b» … but also”等
patterns.context: but 引出让步、限制或转折；有些例子没有 not only 结构，也不构成固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 体育评论、问答、哲学、论坛讨论

patterns.name: but 前后局部词形
patterns.context: 激活落在标记词或词片段本身，可能与并列/转折模式共现，但单凭这些片段无法确认独立触发条件。
patterns.domain: 历史文本、哲学、论坛讨论

en.concept: Contrast and supplementary connection with but
en.description: Activation most often occurs in contrastive, concessive, or supplementary structures with but and nearby punctuation; not only…but also is a prominent subtype. A few markers fall on local words or subwords, and it is unclear whether they have the same cause.

patterns.name: Contrast or addition after but
patterns.context: A concession, negation, or incomplete judgment precedes but, which introduces a contrast, restriction, or addition; sometimes activation falls on a word near but.
patterns.domain: Forums, Q&A, news, and general argumentation

patterns.name: but also parallel construction
patterns.context: After stating a result, reason, or property, uses but also to add another item; activation is distributed over but and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, commentary, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Inter-sentence connection with comma followed by but
patterns.context: But follows a comma to introduce a contrast, supplementary restriction, or new clause; activation often falls on the punctuation and near but.

patterns.name: Local lexical or segmentation trigger
patterns.context: Some activations fall on words or subwords not directly adjacent to a but construction, possibly influenced by tokenization, syntactic position, or other local features; these examples do not establish a stable condition.

11_849.description: 激活最常出现在 but 转折、让步或补充结构及其邻近标点；not only…but also 是突出子型。少数标记落在局部词汇或子词上，不能确定是否同因。

patterns.name: but 后的转折或补充
patterns.trigger: « but»（如 [2] 的 «it» 后接 «but»、[6] 的 «strange» 后接 but、[10] 的 «completely» 后接 but）
patterns.context: 在 but 前出现让步、否定或不完整判断，but 引出对照、限制或补充；有时激活落在 but 邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、新闻与一般论述

patterns.name: but also 并列结构
patterns.trigger: « but» 后接 «also»，与前文 not only 或 only 构成并列
patterns.context: 先陈述一项结果、理由或性质，再用 but also 添加另一项；激活分布在 but 及邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、评论及一般说明文

patterns.name: 逗号后 but 的句间衔接
patterns.context: 逗号后由 but 引出反差、补充限制或新的分句；激活常落在标点及 but 附近。

patterns.name: 局部词汇或切分触发
patterns.context: 个别激活落在与 but 结构不直接相邻的词或子词上，可能受分词、句法位置或其他局部特征影响；无法从这些例子确定稳定条件。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、新闻、学术文献

en.description: Strongly responds to StackExchange questions beginning with Q: followed by a newline, and favors contexts about beginners, new versions, or new projects containing new; it also covers various programming question phrasings and code topics. One passage is an encyclopedia biography, unlike the main format.

patterns.name: StackExchange question opening
patterns.context: Begins with Q: and a blank line, followed by a question title, as commonly seen in StackExchange posts; this format appears in most samples.

patterns.name: Beginner or new-thing phrasing
patterns.context: Technical questions about being a beginner, a new version, a new project, or a newly created object; «new» has strong activation in several passages.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia biographical narrative
patterns.context: A coherent third-person biographical account mentioning a sales career, professional achievements, and career subsections; not in Q&A format.

patterns.name: Programming titles and code content
patterns.context: The question title or body contains a specific language, framework, API, test, or code; sample topics differ but all concern technical help.

patterns.name: Help-seeking tone and question phrasing
patterns.context: Asks about procedures or causes using questions, or states beginner status or apologizes in the body; not all questions use this phrasing.

11_971.concept: 技术问答中的新手提问
11_971.description: 强烈响应 StackExchange 的 Q: 换行式问题开头，并偏好含 new 的新手、新版本或新项目语境；也覆盖多种编程问题措辞与代码主题。另有一段百科人物传记，和主要格式不同。

patterns.name: StackExchange 问题开头
patterns.context: 以 Q: 和空行开头，后接问题标题，常见于 StackExchange 帖子；该格式出现在大多数样本中。

patterns.name: 新手或新事物表述
patterns.trigger: «new»，以及 «I am new to»、«new Python version»、«new project»
patterns.context: 围绕新手身份、新版本、新项目或新建对象的技术提问；«new» 在多段中激活较强。

patterns.name: 百科人物传记叙述
patterns.context: 连贯的第三人称生平介绍，提及销售职业、事业成就和生涯小节；不属于问答格式。

patterns.name: 编程标题与代码内容
patterns.context: 问题标题或正文包含具体语言、框架、API、测试或代码；样本主题彼此不同，但都属于技术求助。

patterns.name: 求助语气与提问措辞
patterns.context: 以疑问句提出操作或原因问题，或在正文中声明新手身份、表达歉意；并非所有问题都有这些措辞。

en.description: Primarily responds to the Q: blank-line format at the start of StackExchange questions and to new in questioners’ statements that they are beginners or starting a new project (1, 3–9); also activates on create new in titles (5), the instantiation keyword new in code (3, 10), and a sales occupation term in a biography (2).

patterns.name: Beginner-help opening in Q&A sites
patterns.context: At the beginning of a StackExchange question body, the questioner says they are new to a technology, version, project, or framework; «new» often appears in expressions such as “new to / new [technology] / new project”.

patterns.name: Q&A title format
patterns.context: Begins with Q: followed by a blank line, then a question title or body; may co-occur with beginner wording, but the title need not contain new.

patterns.name: create new in a title
patterns.context: The title describes creating or updating an entity with POST/PUT; new is part of the operation phrase, not an explicit statement of being a beginner.

patterns.name: Code syntax for a new object
patterns.context: In code, new is a language keyword for instantiating an object; it does not mean the questioner is a beginner.
patterns.domain: C#, Android/Java technical Q&A and code

patterns.name: Occupation in a biography
patterns.context: An encyclopedia biography introduces a female salesperson and her career; unrelated to the beginner pattern in technical Q&A.

11_971.concept: 新手求助及 new 相关上下文
11_971.description: 主要响应 StackExchange 问题开头的 Q: 空行格式，以及提问者自述新手或新项目的 new（1、3–9）；另对标题 create new（5）、代码实例化关键字 new（3、10）及传记中的销售职业词（2）有激活。

patterns.name: 问答站新手求助开头
patterns.trigger: «Q»:↵↵；«new»；«I am new to»；«I just started a new project»
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题正文开头，提问者说明自己刚接触某技术、版本、项目或框架；«new»常出现在“new to / new [technology] / new project”等表达中。

patterns.name: 问答标题格式
patterns.context: 以 Q: 开始并留空行，随后给出问题标题或正文；与新手措辞并存，但标题中不一定出现 new。

patterns.name: 标题中的 create new
patterns.context: 标题描述 POST/PUT 创建或更新实体，new 是操作短语的一部分，而非明确自述新手。

patterns.name: 新对象的代码语法
patterns.context: 代码中 new 是实例化对象的语言关键字；不表示提问者刚入门。

patterns.name: 传记中的职业身份
patterns.context: 百科传记介绍女性销售人员及其职业经历；与技术问答的新手模式无关。

en.concept: of phrases and technical text patterns
en.description: Activation is distributed across noun phrases introduced by “of,” process/practice expressions, and newly created content. It also appears in local patterns involving Q&A formatting, title separators, biographical marketing narratives, biomedical research, project implementation, and file output; no single semantic theme covers all excerpts.

patterns.name: “of” and following noun phrase
patterns.context: “of” follows a noun, adjective, or fixed expression and introduces possession, a topic, a process, or content; activation often extends through the following phrase.
patterns.domain: Written text across domains, including biomedicine, patents, encyclopedias, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Process- or practice-related expressions
patterns.context: Process or practice appears, followed by of/for and a specific activity or object; semantically concerns a procedure, method, or practice.
patterns.domain: Patent background and StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Expressions related to creating or developing
patterns.context: new modifies software, an application, or a file, or describes unfamiliarity with a technical framework; often occurs in a technical question or instruction.

patterns.name: StackExchange question format
patterns.context: The common Q&A-site format Q: followed by a blank line appears before the question body.

patterns.name: Title and section separator format
patterns.context: An equals-sign separator follows a title, or a standalone section heading appears with a line break.

patterns.name: Historical and development statements
patterns.context: History of introduces the historical development of a topic.

patterns.name: Sales and marketing narrative
patterns.context: A biography describes a sales occupation, sales identity, or marketing approach.

patterns.name: Medical research topic
patterns.context: Describes research on a disease category; activation here falls on “of” and the research-topic phrase that follows.

patterns.name: Project implementation statements
patterns.context: Describes project components and their implementation by project year.

patterns.name: Technical files and output information
patterns.context: An imperative instruction asks for a file to be created and includes output-size information.

11_971.description: 激活分布于“of”引出的名词短语、过程/实践表达和新建内容，也见于问答格式、标题分隔、人物营销叙述、生物医学研究、项目实施及文件输出等局部模式；未见单一语义主题覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: “of”及其后接名词短语
patterns.trigger: «of»，尤其是 “of RNA interference”“of studying inflammatory muscle diseases”“of the development of screening tests”“of video scan conversion”“of the program”“of this”
patterns.context: “of”出现在名词、形容词或固定表达之后，引出所属、主题、过程或内容；激活常延续到后续短语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域书面语，包括生物医学、专利、百科和技术问答

patterns.name: 过程或实践相关表达
patterns.trigger: “the process of video scan conversion”“the practice of using comments”“best process for a new ASP.NET web app”
patterns.context: 出现 process 或 practice，后接 of/for 及具体活动或对象；语义上涉及流程、方法或实践。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 新建或开发相关表达
patterns.trigger: “new to Broadleaf commerce framework”“a new ASP.NET web app”“Make new txt file”
patterns.context: new 修饰软件、应用或文件，或描述对某技术框架不熟悉；常处于技术问题的提问或指令中。

patterns.name: StackExchange 问题格式
patterns.context: 问题正文前出现问答站常见的 Q: 与空行格式。

patterns.name: 标题与小节分隔格式
patterns.context: 标题后出现等号分隔线或独立小节标题及换行。

patterns.name: 历史与发展表述
patterns.trigger: “History of the development of screening tests”
patterns.context: 以 History of 引出某主题的历史发展。

patterns.name: 销售与营销叙述
patterns.context: 人物传记中描述销售职业、销售身份或营销方式。

patterns.name: 医学研究主题
patterns.context: 描述研究某类疾病；此处激活落在 “of”及其后的研究主题短语。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究项目文本

patterns.name: 项目实施表述
patterns.trigger: “In the first year of the program”及“elements … have been implemented”
patterns.context: 按项目年度描述组成要素及其实施情况。

patterns.name: 技术文件与输出信息
patterns.context: 命令式地要求创建文件并包含输出大小信息。

en.description: All passages contain highly activated «of»; in addition, words such as documentation, Similar, may, and asking also activate strongly in a few passages, with no shared condition yet explaining this.

patterns.name: 8 after of
patterns.context: The preposition of connects neighboring constituents in a noun phrase or sentence; the content on either side varies.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including PubMed, NIH, patents, and email

patterns.name: Other highly activated function words
patterns.context: Words other than of also activate strongly in a few passages; no consistent syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Other localized word activations
patterns.context: These words or characters activate in their respective contexts, but no shared semantic or structural feature is apparent.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, email, patent backgrounds, PubMed

11_971.description: 所有段均含高激活的 «of»；此外，少数段中的 documentation、Similar、may、asking 等词也强激活，尚无共同条件可解释。

patterns.name: of 后的 8
patterns.context: 介词 of 在名词短语或句子中连接前后成分；前后内容不固定。

patterns.name: 其他高激活功能词
patterns.context: 在少数段中，非 of 的词也出现强激活；没有明显一致的句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、邮件

patterns.name: 其他局部词语激活
patterns.context: 这些词或字符在各自上下文中激活，但未见共同语义或结构特征。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、邮件、专利背景、PubMed

en.description: Most excerpts are strongly marked by the preposition of, spanning titles, noun phrases, quantity expressions, email questions, and mathematical phrases; a few additional nearby tokens also activate and cannot be fully explained by the same condition.

patterns.name: Phrase following of
patterns.context: The main highlight falls on the preposition of; the syntactic structures before it and the following content vary widely.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including paper titles, abstracts, emails, and mathematical instructions

patterns.name: Fixed collocation of the
patterns.context: the immediately follows of, forming a consecutive function-word combination within a noun phrase.

patterns.name: of followed by quantity or group descriptions
patterns.context: of introduces a time- or quantity-related expression, or combines with most to indicate the majority of a whole.

patterns.name: Phrase boundaries and title format
patterns.context: Activation occurs in phrase organization in titles or section headings, but the peak intensity remains on of or nearby.

patterns.name: of and conversational parenthetical in a question
patterns.context: of follows risk and introduces the gerund asking; it occurs in a polite parenthetical question in an email.

patterns.name: Mathematical fraction expression
patterns.context: A fraction follows power of, with further instructions to round to the nearest integer; activation covers of in the mathematical expression.

patterns.name: Nearby activations that are difficult to classify independently
patterns.context: These markers differ from the main highlight on of and occur respectively on a title subword fragment, a single letter after a line break, the word transport in an abstract, and the preposition in after hyperactivity; local evidence is insufficient to confirm a shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, titles, child behavior research

11_971.description: 多数段落强烈标记介词 of，覆盖标题、名词短语、数量表达、邮件问句和数学短语；另有少数邻近词片段激活，不能由同一条件充分解释。

patterns.name: of 后接短语
patterns.trigger: «of»10/9/8/7，后接 marine mammal、RNA interference、2018、the effectiveness、docosahexaenoate、the development、1/8 等
patterns.context: 高亮主要落在介词 of 上；其前后的句法结构与后续内容差异很大。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、摘要、邮件、数学指令等多种文体

patterns.name: of the 固定搭配
patterns.trigger: «of»8 «the»，后接 effectiveness、Mental Health Environment、Care Checklist 或 development
patterns.context: of 后直接接 the，构成名词短语内部的连续功能词组合。

patterns.name: of 后接数量或群体描述
patterns.context: of 引出时间／数量相关表达，或与 most 连用表示整体中的多数。

patterns.name: 短语边界与标题格式
patterns.context: 激活出现在标题或章节标题的短语组织中，但强度峰值仍落在 of 或其邻近位置。

patterns.name: 问句中的 of 与口语插入语
patterns.context: of 跟在 risk 后，引出动名词 asking；处于邮件中的礼貌性插入问句。

patterns.name: 数学分数表达
patterns.context: power of 后接分数，并继续说明取最近整数；激活覆盖数学表达中的 of。

patterns.name: 难以独立归类的邻近激活
patterns.context: 这些标记与主要高亮的 of 不同，分别位于标题词片段、换行后的单字母、摘要中的 transport 和 hyperactivity 后的介词 in；局部证据不足以确认统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、标题、儿童行为研究

en.description: Activation falls mainly on the English word new, replication in life-science contexts, and of in mathematical problem phrases; the first two categories recur across passages, while the mathematical category appears in only two passages, making it difficult to determine whether they share a mechanism.

patterns.name: New/innovation topic word new
patterns.context: Activation centers on new, with surrounding mentions of materials and treatment directions, streetcars, and genetic technology; no specific domain is required.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, entertainment text, technical introductions

patterns.name: Replication-related word replication
patterns.context: Appears in biomedical contexts, referring to DNA, viruses, or cell replication; the word itself is strongly activated in each case.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and research project descriptions

patterns.name: of in mathematical text
patterns.context: Appears in phrases in mathematical expressions or problem text, near numbers, powers, or decimals; the trigger mechanism relative to other patterns is unclear.

11_971.description: 激活主要落在英文 new、生命科学语境中的 replication，以及数学题短语中的 of；前两类跨段重复明显，数学类仅见两段，难以确定是否同一机制。

patterns.name: 新／创新主题词 new
patterns.trigger: «new»（第1段另有«directions»，第2段有«a new»，第7段有«A new»）
patterns.context: 激活集中在 new，周围提到材料与治疗方向、街车、遗传技术；不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、娱乐文本、技术介绍

patterns.name: 复制相关词 replication
patterns.trigger: «replication»，常见搭配为«DNA replication»、«HIV replication»、«cell replication»、«viral replication»
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学语境中，指 DNA、病毒或细胞的复制；该词本身均有较强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与研究项目描述

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 of
patterns.trigger: «of»（第9段为«ple»8« of»5« d»；第10段为«power»3« of»5）
patterns.context: 出现在数学表达或题目文字的短语中，邻近数字、幂或小数；触发机制与其他模式不明。

en.description: Responds to LaTeX formulas, symbols, and formulaic statements in mathematical and mathematical physics corpora, covering measure theory, number theory, particle physics, electromagnetism, vectors, Galois theory, and harmonic analysis; many passages also exhibit paper-abstract or mathematical Q&A genres.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and LaTeX formulas
patterns.context: Primarily in mathematical or physics texts, activation centers on symbols, commands, and some formula punctuation; specific topics vary considerably across passages.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and physics paper abstracts and Q&A

patterns.name: Measure and measurability
patterns.context: Occurs when measure spaces, measurable functions, or measure-related objects appear; passage 1 discusses measurability relative to a generated sigma algebra, and passage 2 concerns metric measure spaces.

patterns.name: Introductory phrasing in mathematical abstracts
patterns.context: Statements in abstracts introducing new objects, theories, or research; not all abstract passages clearly exhibit the same phrasing.

patterns.name: Crystal fields and rotational invariants
patterns.context: A physics research context discussing crystal field strength and alternative measures of it.

patterns.name: Number-theoretic function and Carmichael function
patterns.context: Defines a function and describes it through its multiplicativity and values on prime powers.

patterns.name: Neutrino oscillation
patterns.context: Introduces neutrino generation mixing and the probability of one type changing into another.

patterns.name: Relative motion and charge density
patterns.context: Describes moving objects, directions, and a charged rod in different reference frames.

patterns.name: Variable ranges and inequalities
patterns.context: Introduces real variables and constrains their values with formulaic inequalities; the specific physical meaning is incomplete in the fragment.

patterns.name: Vector angle construction problem
patterns.context: A Q&A problem asks for constructing vectors with a given angle.

patterns.name: Algebraic numbers and Galois problem
patterns.context: A StackExchange question and follow-up definition construct an algebraic number using recursive square roots and ask about its Galois properties.

patterns.name: Harmonic functions and half-space
patterns.context: A paper abstract proposes studying a class of harmonic functions on the positive half-space.
patterns.domain: Partial differential equations or harmonic analysis

11_971.description: 对数学与数学物理语料中的 LaTeX 公式、符号和公式化陈述有反应，涉及测度、数论、粒子物理、电磁学、向量、伽罗瓦理论及调和分析；多段还呈现论文摘要或数学问答体裁。

patterns.name: 数学符号与 LaTeX 公式
patterns.context: 主要在数学或物理文本中，激活集中于公式中的符号、命令及部分公式标点；各段具体主题差异很大。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理学论文摘要与问答

patterns.name: 测度与可测性
patterns.context: 出现测度空间、可测函数或测度相关对象时；段1讨论相对于生成的 sigma 代数的可测性，段2涉及度量测度空间。

patterns.name: 数学论文摘要的介绍句式
patterns.trigger: 「A new measure」「is defined」「We apply this theory」「In this paper, we consider」
patterns.context: 论文摘要中介绍新对象、理论或研究内容的陈述句；不是所有摘要段都明显呈现同一句式。

patterns.name: 晶体场与旋转不变量
patterns.context: 讨论晶体场强度及其替代度量的物理研究语境。

patterns.name: 数论函数与 Carmichael 函数
patterns.context: 定义一种函数，并用其乘性与在素数幂上的取值描述。

patterns.name: 中微子振荡
patterns.context: 介绍中微子代际混合及一种类型转变为另一类型的概率。

patterns.name: 相对运动与电荷密度
patterns.context: 在不同参考系中描述运动物体、方向及带电杆。
patterns.domain: 电磁学或狭义相对论问答

patterns.name: 变量范围与不等式
patterns.context: 给出实变量并以公式不等式限定其取值；具体物理含义在片段中不完整。

patterns.name: 向量夹角构造问题
patterns.context: 问答题要求构造具有给定夹角的向量。

patterns.name: 代数数与伽罗瓦问题
patterns.context: StackExchange 提问及后续定义，用递归平方根构造代数数并询问伽罗瓦性质。

patterns.name: 调和函数与半空间
