patterns.context: 论文摘要中提出在正半空间上研究某类调和函数。
patterns.domain: 偏微分方程或调和分析

en.description: Primarily responds to period punctuation, especially sentence-final periods in medical abstracts; also covers periods in software names, website domains, journal abbreviations, and near citations. Triggers depend on surrounding punctuation formatting and occur across genres.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation after decimal points in medical abstracts
patterns.context: In medical abstract titles or body text, a period is followed immediately by a newline or a new sentence; it often appears next to technical terms or titles.

patterns.name: Modelica namespace separator
patterns.context: A period separates software library, module, or type names, such as “Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Frames.Quaternions”.

patterns.name: Volume and page-number punctuation in citations
patterns.context: A period appears in journal abbreviations and bibliographic information such as volume and page numbers, e.g., “J. Clin. Invest., Vol. 79, pp. 15...”.

patterns.name: Website domain separator
patterns.context: A period separates subdomains and domains in URLs, such as “phdcn.harvard.edu” and “nimh.nih.gov”.

patterns.name: Periods in decimals or numerical expressions
patterns.context: A period occurs in abbreviations or number-related expressions, such as “e.g.” and near numbers in journal citations; the exact trigger location may depend on tokenization.
patterns.domain: NIH project text and patent citations

patterns.name: Period inside reference markers
patterns.context: A period occurs near a bracketed citation marker, surrounded by reference number ranges.

11_971.description: 主要响应句点标点，尤其医学摘要的句末句点；也覆盖软件命名、网址域名、期刊缩写及引文附近的句点。触发受标点周边格式影响，跨文体出现。

patterns.name: 医学论文摘要中的小数点后句末标点
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题或正文中，句号后紧接换行或新句；常与专业词、标题相邻。

patterns.name: Modelica 命名空间分隔符
patterns.context: 句点用于分隔软件库、模块或类型名称，如“Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Frames.Quaternions”。

patterns.name: 文献引文中的卷页数字标点
patterns.context: 句点出现在期刊缩写及卷、页等书目信息中，如“J. Clin. Invest., Vol. 79, pp. 15...”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的参考文献

patterns.name: 网址域名分隔符
patterns.context: 句点分隔网址中的子域名和域名，如“phdcn.harvard.edu”“nimh.nih.gov”。

patterns.name: 小数或数值表达式中的句点
patterns.context: 句点出现在缩写或数值相关表达中，例如“e.g.”以及期刊引文数字附近；具体触发位置可能受分词影响。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目文本及专利引文

patterns.name: 参考文献标记内部的句点
patterns.context: 句点位于方括号引文标记附近，周围是参考文献编号范围。

en.description: All passages are mathematical technical text, with activation centered on LaTeX formulas and their structured symbols; topics span analysis, algebra, topology, set theory, and statistics, alongside mathematical discussion and Q&A in formula contexts.

patterns.name: Measure, metric, and function-space symbols
patterns.context: Mathematical papers discuss completeness, metric measure spaces, function spaces, or local $L^2$ solutions; activation often falls on multiple tokens in mathematical symbols
patterns.domain: Mathematical analysis, functional analysis, and related StackExchange/ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Structural objects in algebra and topology
patterns.context: Algebra, topology, or logic papers introduce abstract structures, functors, or algebraic objects, often with $\mathcal{}$, superscripts, and subscripts
patterns.domain: Algebraic geometry, set theory, homological algebra, topology

patterns.name: Formula fragments with parameters and subscripts
patterns.context: Formulas contain parameterized operators, subscripts, and equalities; the surrounding text is mathematical derivation, but the passage is insufficient to determine the specific topic

patterns.name: Likelihood function and probability question
patterns.context: A StackExchange question asks how to specify a probability function and gives a likelihood definition

patterns.name: Set cardinality and counterexample argument
patterns.context: Calculates cardinality for a singleton case and shows a proposition is false; a specific counterexample or boundary-case argument

patterns.name: Complex LaTeX notation in mathematical text
patterns.context: Activation covers letters, parentheses, superscripts, subscripts, and command-split tokens inside formulas; it occurs across different mathematical topics and may reflect formula-dense typesetting

11_971.description: 所有段落均为数学技术文本，激活集中在 LaTeX 公式及其结构化符号；主题横跨分析、代数、拓扑、集合论和统计，另有公式上下文中的数学论述与问答。

patterns.name: 测度、度量与函数空间符号
patterns.trigger: “metric space”、“metric measure spaces”及“$L^2$”，并伴随“$(X,d)$”“$(\mathcal M,d,\mu)$”等符号
patterns.context: 数学论文中讨论完备性、度量测度空间、函数空间或局部 $L^2$ 解；激活常落在数学符号的多个 token 上
patterns.domain: 数学分析、泛函分析及相关 StackExchange/ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 代数与拓扑中的结构对象
patterns.context: 代数、拓扑或逻辑论文中引入抽象结构、函子或代数对象，常有 $\mathcal{}$、上标及下标记号
patterns.domain: 代数几何、集合论、同调代数、拓扑

patterns.name: 含参数与下标的公式片段
patterns.context: 公式中出现参数化算子、下标和等式；周围是数学推导，但该段不足以判定具体主题
patterns.domain: 数学论文，具体子领域不明

patterns.name: 似然函数与概率提问
patterns.context: StackExchange 问答中询问如何设定概率函数，并给出似然定义

patterns.name: 集合基数与反例论证
patterns.trigger: “exactly one element”、“$|X^{\mathbb N}|$”及“not true”，并提到“proper subset”
patterns.context: 通过单元素情形计算基数，指出命题不成立；是具体的反例或边界情形论证

patterns.name: 数学文本中的复杂 LaTeX 记号
patterns.context: 激活覆盖公式内部的字母、括号、上下标及命令拆分 token；跨不同数学主题出现，可能反映公式密集的排版特征

en.description: Primarily responds to abbreviations, numbering, punctuation, and litigation terminology in U.S. court opinions and regulatory citations; it also responds to substituent definitions in patent chemistry, formulas and results in mathematical papers, and document fields such as judgment dates.

patterns.name: Legal abbreviations and numbering in regulatory citations
patterns.context: In U.S. statute or regulation citations, activation is distributed across numbers, letter abbreviations, punctuation, and section numbers; often appears in sentences arguing for regulatory standards or citing authority.

patterns.name: Fixed legal terminology in court documents
patterns.context: In judicial review, administrative adjudication, or disability-benefit disputes, litigation role terms and evidentiary review terms appear in legal arguments or procedural descriptions.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in court opinions and litigation documents
patterns.context: Near the opinion body, citations, volume/page identifiers, panel information, or attorney appearance records; activation involves punctuation, line breaks, and document fields.

patterns.name: Variables and substituents in patent chemical definitions
patterns.context: Defines compound substituents using numbered R variables and lists options such as hydrogen, lower alkyl, or aryl.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and chemical patent text

patterns.name: Results and estimates in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Mathematical research papers state main results, optimal bounds, or function estimates, and include mathematical fonts and formula symbols.

patterns.name: Court opinions and judgment dates
patterns.context: Case document metadata records the filing date of an opinion; surrounding text may also include court district and attorney information.

11_971.description: 主要响应美国法律判决及法规引文中的缩写、编号、标点和诉讼术语；也响应专利化学取代基定义、数学论文公式与结果表述，以及判决日期等文书字段。

patterns.name: 法规引用中的法律缩写与编号
patterns.context: 美国法规或规章引文中，激活分布在数字、字母缩写、标点及章节编号上；常出现在论证法规标准或引用依据的句子里。

patterns.name: 判决文书中的固定法律术语
patterns.context: 司法审查、行政裁决或残障福利争议中，诉讼角色称谓与证据审查术语出现在法律论证或程序描述里。

patterns.name: 判决及诉讼文书的格式标记
patterns.context: 判决正文、引证、卷页标识、分庭信息或律师出庭记录附近；激活涉及标点、换行及文书字段。

patterns.name: 专利化学定义中的变量与取代基
patterns.context: 以 R 编号变量定义化合物取代基，列举氢、低级烷基或芳基等可选项。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与化学专利文本

patterns.name: 数学论文的结果与估计表述
patterns.context: 数学研究论文陈述主要结果、最优界或函数估计，并出现数学字体及公式符号。

patterns.name: 法院意见与判决日期
patterns.context: 案件文书元数据中记录意见书的提交日期，周边还可能包含法院分区与律师信息。

en.description: Activation often falls on abbreviations segmented unusually in medical and sports text (especially MT and WC), as well as metrics and units, and also appears in numerical formats; there are also subword segmentations in tread-mill and Earth-quake.

patterns.name: Letter combination MT in abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation markers fall on professional abbreviation fragments beginning with M and T; subsequent letters vary by field.

patterns.name: Abbreviations ending in WC
patterns.context: In body-measurement or abdominal-obesity contexts, especially labeling waist circumference abbreviations.

patterns.name: Other alphanumeric professional abbreviations
patterns.context: Medical text contains abbreviations for metrics, outcomes, time points, or physiological variables; activation often falls inside or at the boundary of the abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine, physiology, and medical research papers

patterns.name: Numerical and unit expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, statistics, or concentration units appear densely, especially alongside medical measurement results.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation of exercise equipment terms
patterns.context: A word is split into subwords and refers to exercise equipment or an exercise intervention.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation in an earthquake nickname
patterns.context: An English compound in a name or nickname is split; this does not clearly match the professional abbreviation pattern.

patterns.name: Range and measurement formats
patterns.context: Gives a survival-time range and follow-up duration using square brackets or adjacent time units.

11_971.description: 激活多落在医学与运动文本中被特殊切分的缩写（尤其 MT、WC）、指标及单位，也见数值格式；另有 tread-mill 和 Earth-quake 的子词切分。

patterns.name: 缩写中的字母组合 MT
patterns.context: 激活标记落在由 M、T 开头的专业缩写片段；其后续字母因领域而异。
patterns.domain: 生物医学缩写及体育缩写

patterns.name: 以 WC 结尾的缩写
patterns.context: 身体测量或腹部肥胖语境中，尤其是 waist circumference 的缩写标注。
patterns.domain: 医学、营养学和流行病学论文

patterns.name: 其他字母数字型专业缩写
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现测量指标、结局、时间点或生理变量的缩写；激活位置常在缩写内部或边界。
patterns.domain: 临床医学、生理学和医学研究论文

patterns.name: 数值及单位表达
patterns.context: 数值、统计量或浓度单位密集出现，尤其与医学测量结果并列时。

patterns.name: 运动训练器材词的子词切分
patterns.context: 词语被切成子词，且指向训练器材或运动干预。

patterns.name: 地震绰号中的子词切分
patterns.context: 人名或绰号中的英文复合词被拆分；与专业缩写模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 范围和计量格式
patterns.context: 以方括号或邻近时间单位给出生存时间范围与随访时长。

en.concept: Local patterns in formatting and terminology boundaries
en.description: Activation is distributed across number/unit/percent formatting, medical clinical terminology, code line-break structure, and a few dates and legal citations; triggers are local and not entirely consistent across excerpts.

patterns.name: Number, percentage, and unit formatting
patterns.context: Numbers occur next to percent signs, magnitude suffixes, units, or time units; numbers often appear as segmented tokens.
patterns.domain: Everyday text, car reviews, medical papers, and legal citations

patterns.name: Medical terminology and clinical expressions
patterns.context: Medical or health text includes terms for diseases, treatments, drugs, dosages, efficacy, and physiological measures; activation is not consistent for all medical words.
patterns.domain: Public health, medical abstracts, clinical medication instructions

patterns.name: Line breaks and code structure
patterns.context: Indentation, code blocks, or structured punctuation occur near line breaks; local activation is especially strong in code.

patterns.name: Specific numeric date expression
patterns.context: The date expression New Year's Day with a possessive is followed by a year.

patterns.name: Percentage formatting in everyday discourse
patterns.context: In colloquial first-person life advice, a percentage emphasizes an acceptable level; overlaps with the number-format pattern.

patterns.name: Tire mileage and number ranges
patterns.context: In a vehicle-use review, mileage is expressed with k and written as a range, near a numeric description of commuting.

patterns.name: Legal case citation format
patterns.context: A case citation following legal argument includes abbreviations, volume and page numbers, and citation punctuation.

11_971.concept: 格式与术语边界的局部模式
11_971.description: 激活分散于数字与单位/百分号格式、医学临床术语、代码换行结构，以及少量日期和法律引文；各段触发点局部且不完全一致。

patterns.name: 数字、百分号与单位格式
patterns.context: 数字与百分号、量级后缀、单位或时间单位相邻；数字常以分段 token 出现。
patterns.domain: 生活文本、汽车评论、医学论文及法律引文

patterns.name: 医学术语与临床表达
patterns.trigger: « physical»3« activity»3« (»3«PA»8«)»1、« iv»4« glucose»3、« hemodynamic»1、« respiratory»2
patterns.context: 医学或健康文本中出现疾病、治疗、药物、剂量、疗效及生理指标等术语；激活并非对所有医学词一致。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、医学摘要、临床用药说明

patterns.name: 换行与代码结构
patterns.context: 换行附近伴随缩进、代码块或结构化标点；代码中局部激活尤强。

patterns.name: 特定数字日期表达
patterns.context: 日期表达中带所有格的 New Year's Day，后接年份。

patterns.name: 日常语篇中的百分比格式
patterns.context: 口语化第一人称生活建议中，以百分比强调可接受程度；与数字格式模式重叠。

patterns.name: 轮胎里程与数字范围
patterns.context: 车辆使用评价中，里程数以 k 表示并写成范围，附近有数字化通勤描述。

patterns.name: 法律判例引文格式
patterns.context: 法律论证后的判例引用，包含缩写、卷页及引文标点。

en.description: Activation often appears in expressions evaluating suitability, comfort, effectiveness, or enjoyment, and also in advertising calls to action, medical measurements, legal time formats, and health advice; these sporadic patterns cannot be sufficiently explained by a single stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Describing comfort, convenience, or suitability
patterns.context: Describes whether an object, plan, activity, or solution is suitable, easy to use, effective, or enjoyable; common structures use degree or evaluation words to modify a quality, and include evaluative sentences such as “make … more functional” and “is … acceptable”.
patterns.domain: Broad coverage across lifestyle advice, product and activity copy, military training plans, and medical or public health text

patterns.name: Specific quantity or unit expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls near numbers, units, or abbreviations, used respectively for conversational emphasis, medical measurement units, and time markers in legal narratives; no unified local syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Online conversational language, medical abstracts, legal text

patterns.name: Promotional titles and calls to action
patterns.context: A title or advertising-style text uses an imperative, title case, or direct appeal for readers to take action.

patterns.name: Experimental results and threshold descriptions
patterns.context: Medical abstracts report samples, measurements, and thresholds; activation in this passage is scattered near sentence-final punctuation, numbers, and units, making it difficult to group with other patterns.

patterns.name: Time abbreviations in legal narratives
patterns.context: Describes the time law enforcement officers observed and entered a room; activation centers near the time format.

patterns.name: Target dietary patterns in health advice
patterns.context: Summarizes public health advice about dietary goals for lowering cholesterol and coronary heart disease risk; activation falls near goal verbs and diet-related words.

11_971.description: 激活常见于评价适宜性、舒适度、效果或愉悦感的表达，也出现在广告号召、医学测量数值、法律时间格式和健康建议等不同语境；这些零散模式无法由单一稳定触发条件充分解释。

patterns.name: 形容舒适、便利或合适程度
patterns.context: 描述某物、计划、活动或方案是否适合、容易使用、效果好或令人愉快；常见结构是程度或评价词修饰性质，也包括“make … more functional”“is … acceptable”等评价句。
patterns.domain: 生活建议、产品与活动文案、军事训练计划、医学或公共卫生文本；覆盖较广

patterns.name: 特定数量或单位表达
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、单位或缩写附近，分别用于口语强调、医学测量单位和法律叙述中的时间标记；未见统一的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 网络口语、医学摘要、法律文本

patterns.name: 宣传式标题与行动号召
patterns.trigger: “Make your camping experience memorable and enjoyable”“Go Get Your Nails Done”
patterns.context: 标题或广告式文本，以祈使句、标题大小写或直接号召读者采取行动。
patterns.domain: 户外用品宣传、生活方式博客

patterns.name: 实验结果及数值阈值叙述
patterns.trigger: “Two-thirds had normal fasting insulin (less than 13 mU/L)”
patterns.context: 医学摘要中报告样本、测量结果和阈值；本段激活分散在句末标点、数字及单位附近，难以归入其他模式。

patterns.name: 法律叙事中的时间缩写
patterns.context: 描述执法人员观察与进入房间的时间，激活集中在时间格式附近。

patterns.name: 健康建议中的目标饮食模式
patterns.trigger: “to achieve a dietary pattern that is low in saturated fat and cholesterol”
patterns.context: 总结公共卫生建议，谈论降低胆固醇与冠心病风险的饮食目标；激活落在目标动词及饮食模式相关词附近。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或营养学摘要

en.concept: is followed by a property description
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on the copula “is” and the property descriptions that follow it; other sporadic patterns include comparatives, convenience/comfort evaluations, goal expressions, medical units, and acceptability. These span multiple genres and are difficult to reduce to a single semantic function.

patterns.name: “is” and copular constructions
patterns.context: When describing a property, state, or recommendation, the copula “is” is followed by an adjective or state phrase; nearby context often contains “that”, “should”, or “most”.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, everyday blogs, patents, interior design

patterns.name: “more” comparative
patterns.context: Paired with “Faster”, modifies “efficient” and expresses an increase in degree.

patterns.name: Convenience expression near “things”
patterns.context: The modifier “more convenient” in the fixed expression “make things more convenient”.

patterns.name: Goal expression “to achieve”
patterns.context: Recommends that a population adopt a dietary pattern to achieve a goal.

patterns.name: Letter in a quantity and unit
patterns.context: Within the medical test value “13 mU/L”, in the unit for insulin concentration.

patterns.name: “acceptable” evaluation
patterns.context: Emphasizes that a convenient dinner option is entirely acceptable.

patterns.name: Related to “comfortable”
patterns.context: Describes the comfort of wearable items or a birthing position.

patterns.name: Excerpt with no clear generalizable trigger
patterns.context: Marked tokens are distributed across different parts of speech and syntactic positions in this excerpt.

11_971.description: 激活主要集中在系词“is”及其后性质描述，另有比较级、便利/舒适评价、目标表达、医学单位和可接受性等零散模式；这些模式覆盖多种文体，难以归为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: “is”及系词结构
patterns.context: 在描述性质、状态或建议时，系词“is”后接形容词或状态短语；相邻语境常含“that”“should”“most”等
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、日常博客、专利、室内设计

patterns.name: “more”比较级
patterns.context: 与“Faster”并列，修饰“efficient”，表达程度增加

patterns.name: “things”附近的便利表达
patterns.context: “make things more convenient”这一固定搭配中，修饰语“more convenient”

patterns.name: “to achieve”目标表达
patterns.context: 建议人群采取饮食模式以实现目标

patterns.name: 数量与单位中的字母
patterns.context: 医学检验数值“13 mU/L”内部，出现在胰岛素浓度单位

patterns.name: “acceptable”评价
patterns.context: 强调某种简便晚餐选择完全可接受

patterns.name: “comfortable”相关
patterns.context: 对穿戴物或分娩姿势作舒适度描述

patterns.name: 无明确可归纳触发的片段
patterns.trigger: 激活分布未呈现清晰共同触发子串
patterns.context: 该段中标记词分散于不同词类和句法位置

en.description: Activation often appears in expressions of positive effects, comfort and enjoyment evaluations, and efficiency comparisons, especially near connectors or structural words such as and, is, and to; it also occurs in weight-loss diets, medical technology, product descriptions, and formatting anomalies, and cannot be reduced to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Descriptions of comfortable, enjoyable experiences
patterns.context: In promotional text about lodging, travel, or outdoor experiences, describes an experience as enjoyable, comfortable, or memorable; evaluative words connected by and often occur nearby.

patterns.name: Positive evaluative words in recommendations or effects
patterns.context: Evaluates a state, solution, or procedure in health advice, medical or product descriptions, and parenting experiences; activation often falls on the conjunction and or the degree/evaluative expression that follows it.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent descriptions, health and parenting text

patterns.name: Efficiency or degree comparisons
patterns.context: Describes a relatively faster, easier, more efficient, or larger-quantity result, usually in a comparison or improvement context.
patterns.domain: Product technical descriptions, parenting experiences, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Nutrition and metabolism-related expressions
patterns.context: Discusses dietary goals or weight-loss mechanisms; strong activation occurs on words such as is/to in infinitive structures.

patterns.name: Expressions of existence or necessity
patterns.context: Technical or academic descriptions state a condition, need, or recommendation; trigger locations are inconsistent in this pattern.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent backgrounds, weight-loss advertising

patterns.name: Participle and degree-adverb collocation
patterns.context: Describes facilities or environments as highly comfortable or enjoyable; activation falls on be and very.

patterns.name: Emphasis on experiences in product titles
patterns.context: An outdoor gear promotional title or slogan emphasizes that a camping experience is memorable.

patterns.name: Words in special formats or text structures
patterns.context: Activation occurs in locally formatted material such as split words, all-caps emphasis, or medical parameter units, with no unified semantic context.
patterns.domain: Web text, forum text, medical technical text

11_971.description: 激活常见于正向效果、舒适愉悦评价及效率比较，尤见 and、is、to 等连接或结构词附近；也出现在饮食减重、医疗技术、产品说明和格式异常片段中，不能归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 舒适、愉悦的体验描述
patterns.context: 在住宿、旅游或户外体验的宣传文字中，形容某项体验令人愉快、舒适或难忘；附近常有 and 连接的评价词。

patterns.name: 建议或效果中的正向评价词
patterns.context: 在健康建议、医疗或产品说明以及育儿经验中，评价某种状态、方案或操作；激活常落在连接词 and 或其后的程度／评价表达上。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利说明、健康与育儿文本

patterns.name: 效率或程度比较
patterns.context: 描述相对更快、更容易、更有效率或数量更多的结果，通常处于比较或改善语境。
patterns.domain: 产品技术说明、育儿经验、医学摘要

patterns.name: 营养与代谢相关表述
patterns.context: 讨论饮食目标或减重机制，较强激活出现在不定式结构中的 is/to 一类词。
patterns.domain: 营养学摘要与减重宣传

patterns.name: 存在或必要性表达
patterns.context: 技术或学术说明中陈述某条件、需求或建议；本模式的触发位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、减重宣传

patterns.name: 分词与程度副词搭配
patterns.context: 描述设施或环境达到较高的舒适、愉悦程度，激活落在 be 和 very。

patterns.name: 产品标题中的体验强调
patterns.trigger: «Camping» Gears for Your Next Outdoor Adventure；«Make» your «camping» «experience»10 «memorable»
patterns.context: 户外用品推广标题或广告语，强调露营体验值得回忆。

patterns.name: 特殊格式或文本结构中的词
patterns.context: 激活出现在被切分的词、全大写强调或医学参数单位等局部格式中，缺少统一语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、论坛文本、医学技术文本

en.description: Activation often occurs when a positive property follows a conjunction; it also appears with reaching goals or thresholds, judgments of necessity, and conditions on medical measures. Contexts include medical evaluations, tourism advertising, design, patents, and diabetes values; the interior-design excerpt cannot be confidently assigned to a shared pattern.

patterns.name: Conjoined combination of effects or properties after “and”
patterns.context: In a coordinate structure, and is followed by a positive description of a method, service, or item; the clearest trigger is and itself, while the following adjective varies by context.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, tourism advertising, interior design, patent background

patterns.name: Reaching a threshold or condition
patterns.context: A numerical value, boundary, or target condition is reached, met, or reported; excerpt 1 also includes the state description “that« is»10« low»”, but this is not explicitly a threshold.
patterns.domain: Medical research, public health dietary recommendations

patterns.name: Necessity or judgment
patterns.context: Describes whether an intervention is necessary or needed, or proposes a solution for a need; activation occurs in both necessity judgments and statements of need.

patterns.name: Positive efficacy evaluations such as safe/effective
patterns.context: Evaluates the efficacy, safety, or success rate of a medical procedure, therapy, or technology.

patterns.name: Positive descriptions of products or services
patterns.context: In advertising or patent contexts, presents properties such as ease of use, reliability, or satisfaction in a coordinated list; superficially resembles coordinated positive evaluations of medical efficacy, but the contexts differ.

patterns.name: Blood glucose values and ranges
patterns.context: Presents blood glucose-related measures, comparison ranges, or trial enrollment criteria in diabetes or glucose-metabolism research.

11_971.description: 激活常见于并列连接后给出正面性质，也见于达到目标/阈值、必要性判断及医学指标条件。覆盖医疗评价、旅游宣传、设计、专利和糖尿病数值语境；室内设计段无法稳妥归入共同模式。

patterns.name: “and”后效果或属性的并列组合
patterns.context: 在并列结构中，and 后接对方法、服务或物品的正面性质描述；最明显的触发点是 and 本身，所接形容词因语境而异。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、旅游宣传、室内设计、专利背景

patterns.name: 达到阈值或条件
patterns.context: 数值、界点或目标条件被达到、满足或报告；片段 1 也出现“that« is»10« low»”的状态描述，但并非明确阈值。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、公共卫生饮食建议

patterns.name: 必要性或判断
patterns.trigger: « necessary»9；« is»6« generally»6 necessary；« need»（如« need»« for»）
patterns.context: 描述干预是否必要、是否需要，或针对需求提出方案；激活分布在必要性判断和需求表述中。

patterns.name: safe/effective 等正向疗效评价
patterns.trigger: « safe»3« and»9« effective»2；« excellent»2« technical»5« success»；« simple»3« and»10« effective»4
patterns.context: 对医疗操作、疗法或技术的有效性、安全性、成功率作评价。

patterns.name: 产品或服务的正面描述
patterns.trigger: « a»8« relaxing»4« and»10« wonderful»5« visit»；« simple»2« and»9« reliable»
patterns.context: 宣传或专利语境中并列呈现易用、可靠或令人满意等属性；与医学疗效评价有表面相似的并列正面评价，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 血糖数值与范围
patterns.context: 在糖尿病或糖代谢研究中呈现血糖相关指标、比较范围或试验入组条件。

en.description: Activations occur in coordinated evaluative words describing attributes or effects, as well as in discussions of healthy diets, clinical treatment evaluations, and medical classification thresholds. Across travel, lifestyle, and medical texts, the overall tendency is toward evaluative or normative descriptions.

patterns.name: Positive attributes of evaluated objects
patterns.context: When describing facilities, products, treatments, or spaces, lists advantages using coordinated adjectives; a common structure is and + evaluative word.
patterns.domain: Travel accommodations, interior design, health products, medicine

patterns.name: Evaluation of healthy diets and effects
patterns.context: Descriptions of diet, nutrition, or health effects involving healthfulness, fat, or cholesterol.

patterns.name: Attributes and suitability of medical interventions
patterns.context: Describes treatment thresholds, drug regimens, or efficacy, safety, and cost in clinical studies.

patterns.name: Statistical classifications and thresholds
patterns.context: Defines populations or diagnostic cutoffs using numbers, units, and comparison symbols.

11_971.description: 激活见于描述对象属性或效果的并列评价词，也见于健康饮食、临床方案评价及医学分类阈值；跨旅游、生活方式和医学文本，整体偏向评价性或规范性描述。

patterns.name: 评价对象的正面属性
patterns.context: 在描述设施、产品、治疗或空间时，用并列形容词列举优点；常见结构为 and + 评价词。
patterns.domain: 旅游住宿、室内设计、健康产品、医学

patterns.name: 健康饮食及效果评价
patterns.context: 饮食、营养或健康效果的描述，涉及健康性、脂肪或胆固醇。

patterns.name: 医学方案的属性与适用性
patterns.context: 临床研究中描述治疗阈值、药物方案或疗效、安全性及成本。

patterns.name: 统计分类与阈值
patterns.context: 以数字、单位和比较符号给出人群定义或诊断界值。

en.description: Activation covers positive experience and property evaluations, as well as numerical thresholds, classifications, and insulin-test expressions in medical text; triggers vary by context, with no single stable lexical item.

patterns.name: Affective evaluations in lodging/service advertising
patterns.context: Describes accommodation, vacation, or leisure experiences using structures such as “be / is / promises” to provide a positive evaluation; often relates to service, comfort, or enjoyment.

patterns.name: Convenience, health, and similarity evaluations of products or choices
patterns.context: Compares one choice with another and lists positive properties in sequence; the excerpt also includes comparisons about price and diet.

patterns.name: Functional and comfort evaluations of design spaces
patterns.context: Discusses kitchen or interior design and describes the practicality, comfort, and flow of the layout.

patterns.name: Medical thresholds and statements of reaching/classification by value
patterns.context: Medical text contains diagnostic or intervention thresholds or grouping criteria expressed as values, units, comparison symbols, or ranges; the specific disease need not be the same.

patterns.name: Insulin test values and units
patterns.context: Reports plasma/fasting insulin tests and their values, units, or normal ranges.

11_971.description: 激活涵盖正面体验与属性评价，以及医学文本中的数值阈值、分类和胰岛素检测表达；触发方式随语境变化，未见单一稳定词项。

patterns.name: 住宿/服务宣传语中的情感性评价
patterns.context: 描述住宿、度假或休闲体验时，以“be / is / promises”等结构给出正面体验评价；常与服务、舒适度、愉悦感相关。

patterns.name: 产品或选择的便利性、健康性与相似性评价
patterns.context: 比较某种选择与另一选项，连续列出正面属性；段中也有价格、饮食等比较信息。

patterns.name: 设计空间的功能与舒适评价
patterns.context: 谈厨房或室内设计时，描述空间应具备的实用性、舒适性和流畅布局。

patterns.name: 医学阈值及数值达到/分类表述
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现由数值、单位、比较符号或范围构成的诊断、干预阈值或分组标准；不要求具体疾病相同。

patterns.name: 胰岛素检测数值及单位
patterns.context: 报告血浆/空腹胰岛素检测及其数值、单位或正常范围。

en.description: Activations most consistently occur in medical efficacy evaluations such as “safe and effective.” They also cover spatial comfort and flow, travel experience promotions, and specialized medical descriptions of diabetes trials, obesity thresholds, and prostate anesthesia.

patterns.name: “safe and effective” evaluative collocations
patterns.context: Evaluates treatments, drugs, surgical techniques, or monitoring methods in medical abstracts; related words may be spread across longer sentences

patterns.name: “comfortable” and spatial design
patterns.context: Describes kitchen design and functional spaces; activations cluster around “comfortable” and “has”

patterns.name: Promotion of travel facilities and vacation experiences
patterns.context: Introduces resort facilities, locations, and services for travelers

patterns.name: Diabetes trials and blood glucose measures
patterns.context: Clinical trial titles or abstracts describing target populations, treatment regimens, and HbA1c inclusion ranges

patterns.name: Obesity definitions and BMI thresholds
patterns.context: Defines overweight or obese populations using waist circumference and BMI thresholds

patterns.name: Anesthetic blocks in prostate surgery
patterns.context: Discusses outpatient surgery, minimally invasive treatment, and medical costs for benign prostatic hyperplasia

11_971.description: 激活最一致地出现在“safe and effective”一类医学疗效评价中；此外也覆盖空间舒适与流畅、旅游体验宣传，以及糖尿病试验、肥胖阈值和前列腺麻醉等医学专门表述。

patterns.name: “safe and effective”评价搭配
patterns.trigger: “safe”邻近“and”及“effective”，常见为“safe and effective”或“effective and safe”
patterns.context: 医学摘要中评价治疗、药物、手术技术或监测方法；相关词可能被分散在较长句子中
patterns.domain: 医学论文，主要是 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: “comfortable”与空间设计
patterns.context: 描述厨房设计及功能性空间；激活集中在“comfortable”和“has”

patterns.name: 旅游设施与度假体验宣传
patterns.trigger: “amenities to suit the individual needs”及“promises a relaxing and wonderful visit”
patterns.context: 介绍度假村设施、位置与面向旅客的服务体验

patterns.name: 糖尿病试验与血糖指标
patterns.context: 临床试验标题或摘要，说明目标人群、治疗方案和 HbA1c 纳入范围

patterns.name: 肥胖定义与 BMI 阈值
patterns.context: 按腰围、BMI 阈值界定超重或肥胖人群

patterns.name: 前列腺手术麻醉阻滞
patterns.context: 讨论良性前列腺增生的门诊手术、微创治疗及医疗成本

en.description: Activation appears in several kinds of evaluative and classification contexts: design, lodging, and dietary texts often list qualities or properties; medical texts often concern measures and thresholds such as obesity and blood glucose; category-theory terminology also appears. The excerpts have limited commonality.

patterns.name: Design and spatial qualities
patterns.context: Describes the function, comfort, and design outcome of a kitchen or interior space.

patterns.name: Healthy eating and nutrition
patterns.context: Discusses dietary choices, how healthy foods are, nutritional composition, or energy metabolism.
patterns.domain: Nutrition and health education / dietary reviews

patterns.name: Obesity and blood glucose measures
patterns.context: Defines weight status or blood glucose levels using values, units, or grouping criteria.
patterns.domain: Medical research abstracts / clinical research protocols

patterns.name: Positive evaluation of lodging experience
patterns.context: Introduces accommodation facilities or travel experiences and lists advantages such as comfort and enjoyment.

patterns.name: Morphisms in category theory
patterns.context: Discusses morphisms and functions in a category-theory or graph-theory context.

11_971.description: 激活出现在多类评价与分类语境：设计、住宿和饮食文本常列举品质或属性；医学文本常围绕肥胖、血糖等指标及阈值；另见类别论术语。各段共享性有限。

patterns.name: 设计与空间品质
patterns.context: 描述厨房或室内空间的功能、舒适度和设计效果

patterns.name: 健康饮食与营养
patterns.context: 讨论饮食选择、食物健康程度、营养成分或能量代谢
patterns.domain: 营养与健康科普／饮食评论

patterns.name: 肥胖与血糖指标
patterns.context: 以数值、单位或分组标准界定体重状态或血糖水平
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要／临床研究方案

patterns.name: 住宿体验的正面评价
patterns.context: 介绍住宿设施或旅游体验，列举舒适、愉快等优点

patterns.name: 范畴论中的态射
patterns.context: 在类别论或图论语境中讨论态射及函数

en.description: Activations occur across medical, public health, forum, and marketing texts, often around continuations of predicates such as is/was/were, comparative structures with more, and adjectives or participles. Other fragments cover BMI cutoffs, drug doses, radiation safety, housing, and travel; no single stable theme is evident.

patterns.name: Continuation of the linking verb is
patterns.context: The trigger is is in a relative clause or attributive structure, followed by an adjective or complement; occurs in dietary advice and descriptions of living conditions.

patterns.name: more in comparative or degree constructions
patterns.context: more is followed by an adjective to express comparison or degree; appears in product promotions and discussions of treatment effects.

patterns.name: be + adjective/participle in medical texts
patterns.context: Medical abstracts describe measurements, patient status, study limitations, efficacy, or dose adjustments; activations are scattered across predicate structures.

patterns.name: BMI and cutoff expressions
patterns.context: Near quantitative definitions of body weight, obesity classifications, and waist circumference cutoffs.

patterns.name: Dietary advice and cardiovascular risk
patterns.context: Discusses blood lipids, coronary heart disease mortality, and promotion of a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol.

patterns.name: Housing choices and living conditions
patterns.context: Discusses finding a place to move that balances schools, a safe neighborhood, commuting, and housing.

patterns.name: Holiday toy shopping promotions
patterns.context: Marketing copy about holiday gifts and choosing toys for children.

patterns.name: Radiation doses and safety standards
patterns.context: Explains dose limits and the ALARA safety principle.

patterns.name: Specific drugs and treatment regimens
patterns.context: Describes drugs, doses, treatment courses, or therapy management guided by plasma concentrations.

patterns.name: Travel accommodation promotions
patterns.context: Highlights the location, facilities, and guest experience of vacation rentals.

patterns.name: Case recurrence and efficacy comparisons
patterns.context: Reports recurrence, compares treatment methods, and notes that further research is needed.

patterns.name: Scattered activation locations, difficult to assign to a thematic pattern
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across a truncated abstract on insulin measurement in diabetes; the fragment does not reveal a more specific shared trigger than predicate/text continuation.

patterns.name: Expressions of general ability or feasibility
patterns.context: Describes a goal or arrangement as achievable under reasonable conditions; specific meanings and domains vary considerably.

11_971.description: 激活分布于医学、公共卫生、论坛和营销文本，常落在 is/was/were 等谓语延续、more 比较结构及形容词或分词附近；另有 BMI 界值、药物剂量、辐射安全、住房与旅游等主题片段，未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 关系词 is 的延续
patterns.context: 触发点是关系从句或定语结构中的 is，后接形容词或补语；出现于饮食建议和居住条件描述。

patterns.name: 比较或程度结构中的 more
patterns.context: more 后接形容词，表达比较或程度；分别出现在商品宣传和治疗效果讨论中。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 be + 形容词/分词
patterns.trigger: “was measured” / “had normal” / “is restricted” / “proved to be” / “were adjusted” / “are effective”
patterns.context: 医学摘要中描述测量、患者状态、研究限制、疗效或剂量调整；激活词分散在谓语结构中。

patterns.name: BMI 与界值表达
patterns.context: 体重、肥胖分类及腰围界值等定量定义附近。

patterns.name: 膳食建议与心血管风险
patterns.context: 讨论血脂、冠心病死亡率及倡导低饱和脂肪和胆固醇饮食。

patterns.name: 居住选择与生活条件
patterns.trigger: “a place to live” / “good schools” / “safe and nice neighborhood” / “commute”
patterns.context: 讨论搬迁时寻找兼顾学校、安全社区、通勤和住房的地点。

patterns.name: 节日玩具购物宣传
patterns.context: 以节日送礼和为孩子挑选玩具为主题的营销文案。

patterns.name: 辐射剂量与安全规范
patterns.trigger: “annual dose limit” / “100 mrem” / “as low as reasonably achievable”
patterns.context: 说明剂量限值及 ALARA 安全原则。
patterns.domain: 职业健康/辐射安全文本

patterns.name: 具体药物及治疗方案
patterns.context: 描述药物、剂量、疗程或血浆浓度指导下的治疗管理。

patterns.name: 旅游住宿宣传
patterns.trigger: “amenities” / “Ideally located” / “promises a relaxing and wonderful visit”
patterns.context: 突出度假屋的地段、设施和旅客体验。

patterns.name: 病例复发与疗效比较
patterns.context: 报告复发情况，比较治疗方法并指出仍需进一步研究。

patterns.name: 激活位置分散，难以归入主题模式
patterns.context: 激活散布在截断的糖尿病胰岛素测量摘要中，无法从片段确定比谓语/文本延续更具体的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 一般能力或可实现性表达
patterns.context: 形容目标或安排在合理条件下可实现；具体语义和领域差异明显。

en.description: Activation appears in discussions of health and metabolism, quantitative thresholds or group classifications, and user-facing service advertising; it also covers a few contexts such as legal rulings, holiday shopping, and spatial design. It often accompanies suitability, comparison, or positive evaluations, but cannot be reduced to a single theme.

patterns.name: Measurement, thresholds, and classification criteria
patterns.context: Numbers or inequalities define judgment thresholds, grouping conditions, or legal review standards, often immediately followed by variables, units, or applicable entities.
patterns.domain: Medical research, clinical guidelines, legal documents

patterns.name: Nutrition and metabolic health
patterns.context: Discusses diet, weight, disease risk, or energy metabolism; includes both scientific measurements and everyday dietary evaluations.
patterns.domain: Medicine, nutrition, and diet-related consumer content

patterns.name: Positive advertising of services and experiences
patterns.context: Promotes accommodation, design, shopping, or dining services by describing experiences as satisfying, comfortable, or convenient.
patterns.domain: Travel accommodation, interior design, retail, and dining marketing copy

patterns.name: Suitability and comparison for people or objects
patterns.context: Mentions the needs of different users, the target audience for a service, or compares one group of subjects with others in research.
patterns.domain: Marketing copy, design interviews, medical research

patterns.name: Evidence and rulings in legal proceedings
patterns.context: A judicial opinion lists materials under review and explains the procedural ruling made by the court on that basis.

patterns.name: Holiday toy-shopping advertising
patterns.context: Promotes choosing gifts or shopping lists for children ahead of a holiday.

patterns.name: Describing spatial function and quality
patterns.context: A design professional discusses a kitchen or interior renovation and evaluates its function and user experience.
patterns.domain: Interior design interview or marketing copy

11_971.description: 激活出现在健康与代谢讨论、定量阈值或分组判定，以及面向用户的服务宣传中；也覆盖法律裁定、节日购物、空间设计等少数语境。常伴随对象适配、比较或正面评价，但不能化约为单一主题。

patterns.name: 衡量、阈值与分类标准
patterns.trigger: “less than 13 mU/L”、“> 88 cm”、“≥30”和“≥27 kg/m²”；另有“most favorable”
patterns.context: 数字或不等式给出判断阈值、分组条件或法律审查标准，常紧接变量、单位或适用对象。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、临床指南、法律文书

patterns.name: 营养与代谢健康
patterns.context: 讨论饮食、体重、疾病风险或能量代谢；包括科研测量与日常饮食评价。
patterns.domain: 医学、营养学及饮食相关消费内容

patterns.name: 服务与体验的正面宣传
patterns.trigger: “relaxing and wonderful visit”、“efficient, comfortable”、“more convenient”、“feeling superbly”
patterns.context: 宣传住宿、设计、购物或餐饮服务时，描述令人满意、舒适或方便的体验。
patterns.domain: 旅游住宿、室内设计、零售与餐饮营销文案

patterns.name: 对人群或对象作适配与比较
patterns.trigger: “individual needs of all travelers”、“for every child”、“for my clients”、“compared with”
patterns.context: 提及面向不同使用者的需求、服务对象，或研究中将一组对象与其他组比较。
patterns.domain: 营销文案、设计访谈、医学研究

patterns.name: 法律程序中的证据与裁定
patterns.context: 在司法意见中列举审查材料，并说明法院据此作出的程序性裁定。

patterns.name: 玩具节日购物宣传
patterns.context: 节日前宣传为儿童挑选礼物或购物清单。

patterns.name: 描述空间功能与品质
patterns.context: 设计从业者谈及厨房或室内空间改造，并评价其功能和使用体验。
patterns.domain: 室内设计访谈或营销文案

en.description: Activations span insulin, diabetes, and ferritin measures in medicine; nutrition advice, accommodation promotions, standard legal-decision phrasing, and cost-effectiveness descriptions of anesthesia equipment. They cross domains, with no single stable semantics.

patterns.name: Diet, blood lipids, and coronary heart disease risk
patterns.context: Describes the relationship between dietary patterns, blood cholesterol, and coronary heart disease mortality, and recommends that the public adopt a diet low in saturated fat.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts; nutrition and public health

patterns.name: Diabetes and insulin measures
patterns.context: Reports insulin measurements, insulin/glucose ratios, or HbA1c in studies of diabetes or impaired glucose tolerance; triggers are scattered across the measures and their testing context.

patterns.name: Accommodation facility descriptions in property promotions
patterns.context: Hotel or property descriptions use promotional language for the location, facilities, and lodging experience.

patterns.name: Favorable-viewpoint language in legal review of judgments
patterns.context: In discussing summary judgment, states that courts must view facts, evidence, or inferences in the light most favorable to the nonmovant or opposing party.

patterns.name: Elevated ferritin and transfusion cases
patterns.context: Mentions multiple transfusions and high ferritin levels in the context of sickle cell disease cases.

patterns.name: Cost-effectiveness attributes of anesthesia machines
patterns.context: Emphasizes cost-effectiveness when listing design requirements for portable field anesthesia machines; the same sentence also lists attributes such as safety, light weight, and ease of maintenance.

11_971.description: 激活涵盖医学中的胰岛素、糖尿病及铁蛋白指标，营养建议、住宿宣传、法律判决固定措辞，以及麻醉设备的成本效益描述；跨领域，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 饮食、血脂与冠心病风险
patterns.context: 描述饮食模式与血胆固醇、冠心病死亡率的关系，并建议公众采取低饱和脂肪饮食。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要；营养与公共卫生

patterns.name: 糖尿病与胰岛素指标
patterns.context: 糖尿病或糖耐量异常研究中，报告胰岛素测量、胰岛素/葡萄糖比值或 HbA1c；触发分散在指标及其检测语境中。

patterns.name: 房产宣传中的住宿设施描述
patterns.context: 酒店或房产介绍中，以宣传语描述地点、设施和住宿体验。

patterns.name: 法律判决审查中的有利视角措辞
patterns.context: 讨论 summary judgment 时，说明法院须从有利于非动议方或反对动议方的角度审视事实、证据或推论。

patterns.name: 铁蛋白升高与输血病例
patterns.context: 镰状细胞病病例背景下，提及多次输血及高铁蛋白水平。

patterns.name: 麻醉机的成本效益属性
patterns.context: 列举便携式野外麻醉机的设计需求时，强调成本效益；同句还列出安全、轻便、易维护等属性。
patterns.domain: 医疗设备说明／研究摘要

en.description: Responses are distributed across legal “most favorable to a party” review language, hotel accommodation experiences, medical test-value units, and evaluative expressions about meeting dietary goals, environmental tolerability, and equipment cost-effectiveness; there is no single stable theme.

patterns.name: Review from the perspective most favorable to a party
patterns.context: When reviewing evidence or facts in legal analysis and deciding whether a conviction/judgment is supported, often co-occurs with “all”, “evidence”, “inferences”, and “viewed”; activation is concentrated on “most”.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, evidence review and summary judgment standards

patterns.name: stay/delight in hotel accommodation advertising
patterns.context: Introduces the facilities, setting, or service of a hotel or vacation property in promotional copy for prospective guests; “stay” and nearby evaluative expressions are prominent.
patterns.domain: Hotel and travel accommodation marketing copy

patterns.name: Measurement units in numerical thresholds
patterns.context: A medical abstract reports insulin or ferritin test results as values, comparison terms, and laboratory units; activation falls on unit characters.

patterns.name: Achieving a goal in dietary recommendations
patterns.context: Discusses public health recommendations for reducing cholesterol or coronary heart disease risk and encourages a population to achieve a specific dietary pattern; “achieve” and the dietary description are marked.

patterns.name: Environmental odor tolerability
patterns.context: Patent background discusses improving environmental odors with fragrance materials, insect repellents, and similar products, including making the environment easier to tolerate.

patterns.name: Cost-effectiveness evaluation
patterns.context: Describes the required properties of field anesthesia equipment, alongside requirements such as portability, safety, and ease of maintenance; activation is concentrated on “cost”.

11_971.description: 反应分散：法律中的“最有利于某方”审查措辞、酒店宣传的住宿体验、医学检测数值单位，以及饮食达标、环境可耐受性和设备成本效益等评价表达；没有单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 最有利方视角审查
patterns.trigger: “in the light most … favorable to the prosecution”“in the light most favorable to the non-moving party”“inferences … the light most favorable to the nonmoving party”
patterns.context: 法律审查证据或事实、判断定罪/判决是否成立时，常与“all”“evidence”“inferences”“viewed”同现；激活集中在“most”。
patterns.domain: 美国判例法，证据审查及简易判决标准

patterns.name: 酒店住宿宣传中的 stay/delight
patterns.trigger: “your stay a pleasant experience”“your stay … is a delight”
patterns.context: 介绍酒店、度假物业的设施、环境或服务，面向潜在住客的宣传文案；“stay”及附近评价性表述显著。
patterns.domain: 酒店与旅游住宿营销文案

patterns.name: 数值阈值中的度量单位
patterns.context: 医学摘要中描述胰岛素或铁蛋白等检测结果，以数值、比较词和实验室单位报告阈值；激活落在单位字符上。

patterns.name: 饮食建议中的达成目标
patterns.trigger: “to achieve a dietary pattern that is low in saturated fat”
patterns.context: 讨论降低胆固醇或冠心病风险的公共卫生建议，倡导人群达到特定饮食模式；“achieve”及饮食描述被标记。

patterns.name: 环境气味的可耐受性
patterns.context: 专利背景中讨论香味材料、驱虫剂等对环境气味的改善，涉及让环境更容易忍受。

patterns.name: 成本效益评价
patterns.context: 描述野外麻醉设备所需特性，与便携、安全、易维护等要求并列；激活集中于“cost”。

en.concept: Salient content words in specialized descriptions
en.description: Primarily responds to highlighted measures, vitamin D, diet, and metabolic terms in medical and nutrition texts. There are also isolated activations for patent language about odor environments and accommodation promotions, with no single trigger feature that explains all patterns.

patterns.name: Vitamin D dosage and intake
patterns.context: Discussions of vitamin D dietary sources, intake, related genes, supplement doses, or blood concentrations

patterns.name: Biochemical measures and units
patterns.context: Medical texts reporting laboratory measurements, thresholds, or clinical measures, especially near numbers and units

patterns.name: Diet, nutrition, and metabolic health
patterns.context: Discusses food, dietary interventions, or their effects on blood lipids, satiety, and metabolic responses

patterns.name: Odor and environmental acceptability
patterns.context: Patent background describing fragrance materials or uses for improving environmental odors

patterns.name: Accommodation promotional language
patterns.context: Promotional descriptions of facilities, locations, and lodging experiences in hotel or property listings

11_971.concept: 专业描述中的显著内容词
11_971.description: 主要响应医学与营养文本中被重点标记的指标、维生素D、饮食及代谢词；另对气味环境专利措辞和住宿宣传语有孤立激活，未见能统一解释所有模式的单一触发特征。

patterns.name: 维生素 D 的剂量与摄入
patterns.context: 维生素 D 营养来源、摄入、相关基因、补充剂量或血液浓度的讨论

patterns.name: 生化指标及单位
patterns.context: 医学文本中报告实验室测量值、阈值或临床指标，尤其是数字和单位相邻处

patterns.name: 饮食、营养与代谢健康
patterns.context: 讨论食物、膳食干预或其对血脂、饱腹感及代谢反应的影响

patterns.name: 气味与环境可接受性
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述香味材料或改善环境气味的用途

patterns.name: 住宿宣传语
patterns.context: 酒店或房产介绍中的设施、位置及住宿体验宣传

en.concept: Medical and health terms with heterogeneous text fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to terms for lipids, fat, cholesterol, and glycolipid metabolism in medical and health texts; also appears in thyroid tests, insulin, and thiamine treatment. Other independent patterns include Danish parliamentary word fragments and tourism promotional language.

patterns.name: Medical terms related to lipids and fat
patterns.context: Appears in medical descriptions of blood lipid measures, lipoproteins, dietary fat, or related health risks; sometimes it triggers subwords split from within medical terms.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, nutrition and health advice

patterns.name: Thyroid and laboratory values
patterns.context: Medical descriptions near thyroid-stimulating hormone, its concentration, units, or thresholds.

patterns.name: Diabetes, insulin, and metabolism
patterns.context: Discusses diabetes, insulin levels, or hyperinsulinemia; paragraphs 7 and 9 involve metabolic research or patient measurements.
patterns.domain: Medical research and grant project abstracts

patterns.name: Danish word-form fragments and government text
patterns.context: Danish words are tokenized or split into within-word fragments; the full passage is a political or parliamentary statement about restarting negotiations.

patterns.name: Tourism accommodation copy
patterns.context: Hotel or resort descriptions that attract travelers with amenities, location, and an enjoyable stay.

patterns.name: High-dose thiamine supplementation
patterns.context: Discusses treatment for alcohol-related vitamin or electrolyte deficiencies and proposes a high-dose thiamine supplementation regimen.

patterns.name: Mixed advertising endings and isolated word fragments
patterns.context: The same passage combines political advertising, nutrition supplement promotion, and an isolated sentence fragment; these activations show no clear, consistent semantic trigger.

11_971.concept: 医学健康词及异质文本片段
11_971.description: 主要响应医学与健康文本中的脂质、脂肪、胆固醇及糖脂代谢词，也见于甲状腺检验、胰岛素、硫胺素治疗；另有丹麦语议会词片段和旅游宣传语等独立模式。

patterns.name: 脂质与脂肪相关医学术语
patterns.trigger: « lipid»、« fatty»、« fat»、« cholesterol»、« high»-«density»« lipoprotein»、« triglyceride»（« hyper»«trig»lyceridemia）
patterns.context: 出现在血脂指标、脂蛋白、饮食脂肪或相关健康风险的医学描述中；有时触发的是医学术语内部被拆开的子词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、营养与健康建议

patterns.name: 甲状腺与实验室数值
patterns.context: 甲状腺刺激激素及其浓度、单位或阈值附近的医学结果描述。

patterns.name: 糖尿病、胰岛素与代谢
patterns.context: 讨论糖尿病、胰岛素水平或高胰岛素血症；在第7、9段中涉及代谢研究或患者测量。
patterns.domain: 医学研究与资助项目摘要

patterns.name: 丹麦语词形片段与政务文本
patterns.trigger: « b»å«de»、« n»«ogle»、« rede»、« teg»«net»、« for»«handlet»、« im»«id»«l»«ert»«id»
patterns.context: 丹麦语词被分词或切成词内片段；整段为关于重启谈判的政治或议会表述。

patterns.name: 旅游住宿宣传语
patterns.trigger: « amenities»、« travelers»、« Ide»«ally»、« prime»、« tour»«istic»、« Windsor»« Hills»« Resort»、« promises»
patterns.context: 酒店或度假村介绍，以设施、地理位置和令人愉快的住宿体验吸引旅客。
patterns.domain: 旅游住宿网页宣传文案

patterns.name: 高剂量硫胺素补充
patterns.context: 讨论酒精相关维生素或电解质缺乏的处理，并提出高剂量硫胺素补充方案。

patterns.name: 混杂的广告尾句与孤立词片段
patterns.trigger: « V»（接续OTE）、« a»（接续great）、« D»（接续HA）、« m»（接续. repeatedly）
patterns.context: 同一段拼接了政治广告、营养补充宣传和孤立的句尾片段；这些激活未呈现清楚一致的语义触发。

en.concept: English articles and medical word-form fragments
en.description: The strongest reproducible signal is the English indefinite article a. Other activations include the definite article the, the initial H and hyper- in medical terms, and best within a Danish word. Other activations are sporadic and do not form stable patterns.

patterns.name: Article a
patterns.context: The English indefinite article a precedes a noun or noun phrase; it occurs across varied syntactic and content contexts
patterns.domain: English web pages, legal texts, nutrition texts

patterns.name: Article the
patterns.context: The English definite article the precedes a noun or an adjective-plus-noun phrase
patterns.domain: English web pages, legal texts, nutrition texts

patterns.name: H in hormone/metabolism terms
patterns.context: H occurs within the hormone-related word hormonal or the metabolic measure HOMA-IR; activation falls on the initial H
patterns.domain: PubMed nutrition, clinical, and metabolic research abstracts

patterns.name: hyper in hypercholesterolemia terms
patterns.context: hyper- is a medical term prefix followed by cholesterolemic or insulinemia

patterns.name: The sequence best within a Danish word
patterns.context: Occurs inside the Danish word “bestemmelser,” which is split into multiple subword tokens; context concerns instructions and their provisions

patterns.name: Sporadic whole-word or word-initial activations
patterns.context: These activations occur across general English web, legal, and medical texts, with no shared local lexical or syntactic condition

11_971.concept: 英语冠词及医学词形片段
11_971.description: 最强而可复现的信号是英语不定冠词 a；其余还包括定冠词 the、医学术语词首 H 与 hyper-，以及丹麦语词内 best。另有多种零散激活，未能归入稳定模式。

patterns.name: 冠词 a
patterns.context: 英语中不定冠词 a 后接名词或名词短语；多种句法与内容环境中都出现
patterns.domain: 英语网页、法律文本、营养学文本

patterns.name: 冠词 the
patterns.context: 英语定冠词 the 后接名词或形容词加名词短语
patterns.domain: 英语网页、法律文本、营养学文本

patterns.name: 激素/代谢术语中的 H
patterns.context: H 出现在激素相关词 hormonal 或代谢指标 HOMA-IR 的词内；激活落在词首 H
patterns.domain: PubMed 营养、临床与代谢研究摘要

patterns.name: 高胆固醇术语中的 hyper
patterns.context: hyper- 作为医学术语前缀，后接 cholesterolemic 或 insulinemia
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究文本

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内序列 best
patterns.context: 位于丹麦语词“bestemmelser”内部，词被切分为多个子词；上下文讨论指令及其条款

patterns.name: 零散的整词或词首激活
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在一般英语网页、法律及医学文本中，未见共同的局部词法或句法条件
patterns.domain: 酒店营销、法律、生物医学文本

en.description: Activations span nutrition research, advertising, law, mathematics, political news, and media lists, landing on content words, common words, and word fragments. Beyond local semantics in individual passages, no stable trigger condition spans all passages.

patterns.name: Nutrition and dietary research
patterns.context: Food components, metabolic measures, or dietary advice appear in nutrition, diet, or health research abstracts; activations also land on titles and ordinary sentence words.

patterns.name: Accommodation promotional copy
patterns.context: Hotel or vacation property descriptions of location, amenities, and an enjoyable stay; multiple words throughout a passage are marked.

patterns.name: Legal argumentation wording
patterns.context: Cites a review standard and states the requirements for factual findings and legal conclusions.

patterns.name: Sales promotion
patterns.context: A video or advice piece introduces promotions, pricing, and sales techniques in an upbeat tone with exclamation marks.

patterns.name: Recipe adaptation and dietary preferences
patterns.context: Describes adjusting a recipe to better suit a family and mentions vegetables, carbohydrates, and portions.

patterns.name: Swedish legal word forms
patterns.context: A Swedish sentence discusses whether members have a directive basis for adopting or applying a law; markings often land on split word fragments.

patterns.name: Category theory and graph homomorphisms
patterns.context: Discusses morphisms between categories and functors, then gives a graph morphism as an answer.

patterns.name: Political news narrative
patterns.context: Discusses Iranian nuclear weapons and the Israeli response to remarks made in an interview by the U.S. president.

patterns.name: Lists of media outlet names
patterns.context: Lists newspapers, magazines, and news organizations separated by commas.

11_971.description: 激活跨营养研究、宣传、法律、数学、政治新闻及媒体列表，落在内容词、常用词和词片段上；除各段局部语义外，未见贯穿所有段的稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 营养与饮食研究
patterns.context: 营养、饮食或健康研究摘要中，出现食物成分、代谢指标或饮食建议；激活也落在标题和普通句子词上。

patterns.name: 住宿宣传语
patterns.context: 酒店或度假物业介绍，描述地点、设施和令人愉快的入住体验；一整段多个词均被标记。

patterns.name: 法律论证措辞
patterns.context: 援引审查标准并陈述事实认定和法律结论应满足的条件。

patterns.name: 销售推广
patterns.context: 视频或建议介绍促销、定价及销售技巧，语气积极且带感叹号。

patterns.name: 食谱改写与饮食偏好
patterns.context: 叙述将食谱调整得更适合家庭，并提到蔬菜、碳水和分量。

patterns.name: 瑞典语法律词形
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子讨论成员采用或适用法律是否有指令依据；标记常落在拆分的词片段上。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法律/政策文本

patterns.name: 范畴论与图同态
patterns.context: 讨论范畴间态射、函子，并给出图的态射作为回答。

patterns.name: 政治新闻叙述
patterns.context: 谈论伊朗核武器及以色列方面对美国总统采访言论的反应。

patterns.name: 媒体刊物名称罗列
patterns.context: 以逗号连续列举报刊、杂志和新闻机构名称。

en.description: Activations are scattered across common English function words and noun phrase structures, numbers and units and cholesterol terms in medical texts, within-word Danish fragments, and expressions of degree and enjoyment in holiday advertising; no single semantic pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: Articles and noun phrases after English copulas
patterns.context: In English, the indefinite article a follows a copula or verb phrase and introduces a noun phrase; activations also land on nearby words such as “a” and “the”.
patterns.domain: Tourism promotions, commercial copy, legal text

patterns.name: Numbers and units in health research
patterns.context: Numbers are adjacent to percent signs, measurement units, or experimental parameters in medical or nutrition research narratives.
patterns.domain: PubMed, NIH, and medical research abstracts

patterns.name: Cholesterol-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Activations appear near related medical vocabulary in discussions of blood lipids, cholesterol, or cardiovascular risk.

patterns.name: Within-word Danish subword fragments
patterns.context: Fragments cross internal word boundaries in Danish administrative text; this is only one example, making its semantic or contextual conditions difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Holiday and enjoyment expressions
patterns.context: In smart-home holiday promotional copy, “much more” occurs next to an adjective expressing enjoyment.

11_971.description: 激活分散于英语常见虚词及名词短语结构、医学文本中的数字单位和胆固醇词汇、丹麦语词内片段，以及节日宣传中的程度与愉悦表达；尚无单一语义模式能解释全部样例。

patterns.name: 英语系动词后冠词与名词短语
patterns.context: 在英语中，系动词或动词短语后出现不定冠词 a，并继续引出名词短语；激活还落在邻近的“a”“the”等词上
patterns.domain: 旅游宣传、商业文案、法律文本

patterns.name: 健康研究中的数字与单位
patterns.context: 医学或营养研究叙述中，数字与百分号、计量单位或实验参数相邻

patterns.name: 胆固醇相关词汇
patterns.context: 谈及血脂、胆固醇或心血管风险时，相关医学词汇附近出现激活

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 丹麦语行政文本中，片段跨词内部边界；仅此一例，难以确定其语义或上下文条件

patterns.name: 节日与愉悦程度表达
patterns.context: 智能家居节日宣传语中，“much more”与表示愉悦的形容词相邻

en.concept: Sensitive to a and several local word forms
en.description: The most stable trigger is the article a, especially in a + noun/adjective phrases, across domains. There are also strong activations for the hyper subword in hypercholesterolemic and hyperinsulinemia, and for expressions of low cost or low expenses. Expressions of ease/pleasure in marketing contexts co-occur locally with step lists; paragraph 5 has no clear match.

patterns.name: Indefinite article a
patterns.context: The article a precedes a noun or adjective phrase; examples include “a pleasant experience,” “a breeze,” “a dietary pattern,” “a little more fit,” “a bit,” and “a whole.”
patterns.domain: Multidomain prose, including travel copy, marketing, health, blogs, and legal texts

patterns.name: Hypercholesterolemia and insulin-related terms
patterns.context: Medical terms are split into multiple subword tokens; triggers cluster at the initial hyper portion, especially in hypercholesterolemic and hyperinsulinemia.

patterns.name: Low-cost/low-expense expressions
patterns.context: Describes keeping costs or living expenses low, in contexts semantically related to low prices or saving.

patterns.name: Promotional process and experience expressions
patterns.context: In positive promotional contexts, describes a process as easy or a lodging experience as pleasant; both cases include a, but have different following collocations.

patterns.name: a in ordinary function words and phrases
patterns.context: The indefinite article a appears in various ordinary noun phrases, fixed expressions, or degree phrases, without requiring a particular domain or meaning.

patterns.name: Step-count cues in a final series list
patterns.context: A HackerNews post gives advice and then lists actions as numbered steps.

11_971.concept: 对 a 及若干局部词形敏感
11_971.description: 最稳定触发是冠词 a，尤其出现在 a + 名词/形容词短语中，跨领域出现；另对 hypercholesterolemic、hyperinsulinemia 的 hyper 子词及低成本、低开支表述有强激活。营销语境中的轻松/愉快表达与步骤列表仅局部共现；第5段无明显对应。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a
patterns.context: 冠词 a 后接名词或形容词短语；如 “a pleasant experience”“a breeze”“a dietary pattern”“a little more fit”“a bit”“a whole”。
patterns.domain: 多领域 prose，包括旅游文案、营销、健康、博客和法律文本

patterns.name: 超/高胆固醇与胰岛素术语
patterns.context: 医学术语被拆成多个子词 token；触发集中在 hyper 起始部分，尤其是 hypercholesterolemic 和 hyperinsulinemia。

patterns.name: 低成本／低开支表述
patterns.context: 描述把成本或生活开支维持在较低水平，低价或节省的语义邻近语境。
patterns.domain: 生活建议、消费服务说明

patterns.name: 宣传性过程与体验表达
patterns.context: 正面宣传语境中，称某项过程轻松，或住宿体验愉快；两处共同出现 a，但其后搭配不同。
patterns.domain: 营销文案、旅游住宿介绍

patterns.name: 普通功能词及短语中的 a
patterns.context: 不定冠词 a 出现在多种普通名词短语、固定表达或程度短语中，不要求特定领域或语义。

patterns.name: 末尾系列列表中的步数提示
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子给出建议后，以编号步骤列出行动。

en.description: Activations span many domains, involving both short phrase function words such as the article a and accommodation, sales, costs, blood lipids, law, family recipes, holiday smart-home content, and narrative expressions; no single semantic theme covers them all.

patterns.name: Function words and the article a in phrases
patterns.context: The article a is strongly marked in various contexts; nearby phrase components are also marked in passages 1, 2, 5, and 7, suggesting a response beyond a alone.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English webpages, legal text, and lifestyle articles

patterns.name: stay in accommodation promotions
patterns.context: Appears in hotel descriptions in expressions such as “make your stay a pleasant experience”.

patterns.name: sales process
patterns.context: The phrase “the sales process” in a sales advice article.

patterns.name: kept in cost reduction
patterns.context: Explains that service costs can be maintained at a low level: “cost can be kept lower”.

patterns.name: Cholesterol-related terms
patterns.context: Dyslipidemia terms in medical texts; paragraph 4 also marks “Serum”, “cholesterol”, and “remains”, while multiple medical nouns are marked near paragraph 10.

patterns.name: Reasonable basis in legal decisions
patterns.context: “a reasonable basis in the law” in a judicial review context, accompanied by discussion of evidence and legal conclusions.

patterns.name: Danish legal wording
patterns.context: Danish text discusses member states adopting laws inconsistent with a directive; activations cluster around regulatory terms and surrounding word fragments.

patterns.name: Making recipes more family-friendly
patterns.context: Discusses making small recipe adjustments to make a dish healthier or more family-friendly; “a”, “little”, and “more” are all marked.

patterns.name: Holidays and smart homes
patterns.context: Promotional expressions about Christmas and smart-home devices making the holidays more enjoyable.
patterns.domain: Consumer technology and holiday lifestyle webpages

patterns.name: Ongoing action in a narrative
patterns.context: The fixed expression “things were in full swing” in a travel narrative.

11_971.description: 激活跨多种领域，既涉及冠词 a 等短语功能词，也涉及住宿、销售、成本、血脂、法律、家庭食谱、节日智能家居和叙事表达；未见单一语义主题能覆盖全部。

patterns.name: 功能词与短语中的冠词 a
patterns.trigger: «a»，尤其是「a pleasant experience」「a breeze」「a reasonable basis」「a little」「a little more」
patterns.context: 多种上下文中冠词 a 被强烈标记；第 1、2、5、7 段附近还标记了相邻短语成分，似乎不只响应单个 a。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语网页、法律文本及生活方式文章

patterns.name: 住宿宣传中的 stay
patterns.context: 酒店介绍中出现在「make your stay a pleasant experience」一类表达。

patterns.name: sales process
patterns.context: 销售建议文章中「the sales process」一词组。

patterns.name: 成本降低中的 kept
patterns.context: 说明服务成本可被维持在较低水平：「cost can be kept lower」。

patterns.name: 胆固醇相关词语
patterns.context: 医学文本中的血脂异常术语；第 4 段还标记「Serum」「cholesterol」「remains」，第 10 段附近标记多项医学名词。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的合理依据
patterns.context: 司法审查语境中「a reasonable basis in the law」，并伴随对证据和法律结论的论述。

patterns.name: 丹麦语法律措辞
patterns.context: 丹麦语讨论成员国采用与指令规定不符的法律；激活集中在法规相关词及周边词片段。

patterns.name: 使食谱更适合家庭
patterns.context: 谈论对菜谱做小调整，使其更健康或适合家庭；其中「a」「little」「more」均被标记。

patterns.name: 节日与智能家居
patterns.context: 圣诞节及智能家居设备让假期更愉快的宣传性表达。
patterns.domain: 消费科技与节日生活方式网页

patterns.name: 叙事中的进行状态
patterns.context: 旅行叙事中「things were in full swing」的固定表达。

en.description: Activations are mixed across the English article a and common words, medical hyper- terms and threshold numbers, and within-word Danish fragments; there is no stable semantic or syntactic pattern across modes.

patterns.name: Words following the indefinite article a
patterns.context: Activations often land on a or the immediately following word; the following item may be an adjective, noun, or number, with no stable semantic category.
patterns.domain: Hotel descriptions, marketing copy, healthy eating articles, medical measures

patterns.name: hyper- in medical terms
patterns.context: In medical contexts, hyper- occurs in terms related to blood lipids, cholesterol, or insulin; activation sometimes lands on a stem fragment and sometimes on hyper itself.
patterns.domain: Kidney disease guidelines, cardiovascular risk research, diabetes research

patterns.name: Range or threshold numbers
patterns.context: In medical texts, values are adjacent to test measures, units, or inequality signs, indicating clinical thresholds; activations cluster on number fragments.

patterns.name: Within-word Danish fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur inside Danish words that are marked as split tokens; the fragment alone does not reveal a stable meaning or grammatical function.
patterns.domain: Formal European Parliament text in Danish

patterns.name: General English function words and syntactic positions
patterns.context: Sporadic activations land on common words such as articles, pronouns, or auxiliary verbs in contexts involving costs, products, and recipes, without showing a consistent theme.

patterns.name: Declarative words within or at sentence ends
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across words describing outcomes or processes in accommodation descriptions, sales copy, and cost explanations, with no clear semantic relationship.

11_971.description: 激活混杂于英语中的 a 及常见词、医学 hyper- 术语与阈值数字，并见于丹麦语词内片段；跨模式缺少稳定语义或句法规律。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a 后的词语
patterns.context: 多处激活落在 a 或其后紧邻的词上；后续可为形容词、名词或数字，未见稳定的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 酒店介绍、营销文案、健康饮食文章、医学指标

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 hyper-
patterns.context: 医学语境下，hyper- 出现在血脂、胆固醇或胰岛素相关术语中；激活有时落在词干片段，有时落在 hyper 本身。
patterns.domain: 肾病指南、心血管风险研究、糖尿病研究

patterns.name: 范围或阈值数字
patterns.context: 医学文本中数值紧邻检验指标、单位或不等号，表示临床界值；激活集中于数字片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学指标描述

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在被拆分标记的丹麦语单词内部，无法从片段单独确定稳定的词义或语法作用。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会丹麦语正式文本

patterns.name: 一般英语功能词和句法位置
patterns.context: 零散落在冠词、代词或助动词等常见词上，所在语境涉及成本、产品、食谱等，未显示一致主题。

patterns.name: 句末或句中陈述性词汇
patterns.context: 激活分散于描述结果或过程的词，分别位于住宿介绍、销售文案和成本说明中，语义关系不明确。

en.description: Activations are scattered across articles, common words, numbers and units, within-word fragments, and fixed phrases; some such as a, much, expenses, and persistently have local contextual cues, but there is no stable, consistent trigger pattern across genres.

patterns.name: Indefinite article a
patterns.context: The article a precedes a noun phrase or adjective+noun, as in “a pleasant experience”; activation is concentrated on a itself.

patterns.name: a at a word boundary
patterns.context: a appears in “make a breeze” as the article in a noun phrase.

patterns.name: Percent sign
patterns.context: Follows a number to express the proportion of calories from fat in nutrition research.

patterns.name: Indefinite article a
patterns.context: a occurs in “a bit” as part of a quantity phrase.

patterns.name: Degree adverb much
patterns.context: much modifies the comparative more to express increased degree.

patterns.name: Energy unit kJ
patterns.context: k appears in the energy unit kJ, following a value of approximately 3000.

patterns.name: Living expenses phrase
patterns.context: Personal finance advice about keeping living expenses as low as possible.

patterns.name: Adverb of persistent state
patterns.context: persistently modifies elevated, describing persistently high blood calcium.

patterns.name: Letter H
patterns.context: The single letter H at the beginning of the name Hacker News.

patterns.name: Within-word best letter fragment
patterns.context: best occurs within the Danish word “bestemt” and is not an independent English word.

patterns.name: Number token
patterns.context: The nutrition intervention dose number before a percentage.

patterns.name: Nutrient token
patterns.context: A calorie measurement context for the proportion of fat intake.

patterns.name: Food word ending
patterns.context: The latter part of the compound word meatballs.

patterns.name: Blood measure token
patterns.context: Laboratory test results in a case description.

patterns.name: Cross-word morphological fragment
patterns.context: A Danish word is split during tokenization, and activation lands on a letter fragment.

patterns.name: Context-dependent common word
patterns.context: A degree expression appears in a sentence describing family-friendliness; its activation target differs from those in other passages.

patterns.name: Degree and enjoyment phrase
patterns.context: Describes a more enjoyable and effortless experience in smart-home holiday promotions.

patterns.name: Common word in an expenses phrase
patterns.context: The advice sentence “keep your living expenses as low as you can”.

11_971.description: 激活分散在冠词、常见词、数字与单位、词内片段及固定短语中；部分像 a、much、expenses、persistently 有局部语境线索，但跨文体没有稳定一致的触发模式。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a
patterns.context: 冠词 a 后接名词短语或形容词+名词，如“a pleasant experience”；激活集中于 a 本身

patterns.name: 单词边界 a
patterns.context: a 出现在“make a breeze”中，作为名词短语的冠词

patterns.name: 百分比符号
patterns.context: 数字后表示营养研究中的脂肪热量占比

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a
patterns.context: a 位于“a bit”中，构成数量短语

patterns.name: 程度副词 much
patterns.context: much 修饰比较级 more，表达程度增强
patterns.domain: 智能家居节日宣传文案

patterns.name: 能量单位 kJ
patterns.context: k 位于能量单位 kJ 中，前接约 3000 的数值

patterns.name: 生活开支短语
patterns.context: 描述尽可能压低生活开支的个人理财建议

patterns.name: 持续状态词缀
patterns.context: persistently 修饰 elevated，描述血钙持续升高

patterns.name: 字母 H
patterns.context: Hacker News 名称开头的单字母 H

patterns.name: 词内 best 字母片段
patterns.context: best 出现在丹麦语“bestemt”词内，并非英语独立单词

patterns.name: 数字词元
patterns.context: 百分比前的营养干预剂量数字

patterns.name: 营养成分词元
patterns.context: 脂肪摄入比例的热量测量语境

patterns.name: 食物词尾
patterns.context: 复合词 meatballs 的后半部分

patterns.name: 血液指标词元
patterns.context: 病例描述中的实验室检查结果

patterns.name: 跨词形态片段
patterns.context: 丹麦语单词内部被分词拆分，激活落在字母片段上

patterns.name: 语境依赖的高频词
patterns.context: 适配家庭友好型的描述句中出现程度表达；与其他段的激活目标不一致

patterns.name: 程度与享受词组
patterns.context: 节日智能家居宣传中，描述体验更愉快省力

patterns.name: 开支短语中的高频词
patterns.context: “keep your living expenses as low as you can”建议句

en.description: High-activation locations are scattered across English articles, degree expressions, content words, medical values, mathematical phrases, and Danish word fragments; there is no stable cross-paragraph trigger, and several paragraphs can only be recorded as sporadic patterns.

patterns.name: Following tokens of the indefinite article a
patterns.context: Activation falls on the English indefinite article a in hotel copy, sales introductions, and a healthy recipe article; the topics and syntactic contexts differ.
patterns.domain: English web copy, marketing, lifestyle articles

patterns.name: Degree adverbs and evaluative expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions of comparison, degree, or change; [3] describes a holiday experience, [7] a healthier recipe, and [8] an increase in the frequency of pancreatitis attacks.

patterns.name: Content words or phrases in general text
patterns.context: Activations occur on words that do not fit the preceding patterns; no reliable shared meaning or fixed syntactic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Travel, marketing, lifestyle, and medical web texts

patterns.name: Medical values and measure formats
patterns.context: In medical passages or nutrition research, activations occur near numbers, units, and laboratory measures; however, their locations are not fixed, and not all related tokens are highlighted.

patterns.name: English preposition in and mathematical discussion
patterns.context: Significant activation occurs only in this paragraph, within the phrase “in fact” in a StackExchange mathematics discussion; there is insufficient evidence to determine whether the trigger is the preposition, phrase, or mathematical context.

patterns.name: Danish word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on subword fragments within words in Danish parliamentary texts, with no stable correspondence to activations in English paragraphs.

patterns.name: Phrases in travel narratives
patterns.context: Activations cluster in a narrative describing things as “in full swing” after arriving at the accommodation; it is unclear whether the trigger is the fixed idiom or a general word sequence.

11_971.description: 高激活位置分散于英语冠词、程度表达、内容词、医学数值、数学短语及丹麦语词片段；没有稳定的跨段触发条件，多个段落只能作为零散模式记录。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a 的后续 token
patterns.context: 激活落在英语不定冠词 a 上，分别出现在酒店文案、销售介绍以及健康食谱文章中；上下文主题和句法环境并不一致。
patterns.domain: 英语网页文案、营销、生活方式文章

patterns.name: 程度副词与评价性表达
patterns.context: 出现在比较、程度或变化表达中；[3] 描述节日体验，[7] 描述食谱更健康，[8] 描述胰腺炎发作频率增加。
patterns.domain: 生活方式网页、医学病例

patterns.name: 一般文本中的内容词或短语
patterns.trigger: « stay»8（[1]）；« process»8（[2]）；« holidays»5（[3]）；« things»5、« were»5（[5]）；« them»5、« it»7（[7]）；« persist»ently»7（[8]）
patterns.context: 激活分布在与前述模式不一致的词上；未见可靠的共同词义或固定句法条件。
patterns.domain: 旅游、营销、生活方式及医学网页文本

patterns.name: 医学数值与指标格式
patterns.context: 医学段落或营养研究中，数值、单位、实验室指标附近有激活；但激活位置并不固定，也并非所有相关 token 都高亮。

patterns.name: 英语介词 in 与数学论述
patterns.context: 仅此段出现显著激活，处在 StackExchange 数学讨论的短语“in fact”中；缺乏足够证据判断是否由介词、短语或数学语境触发。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词语片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在丹麦语议会文本的词内子词片段，无法与英语段落中的激活建立稳定对应。

patterns.name: 旅行叙述中的短语
patterns.context: 激活集中在到达住处后描述事情“正热火朝天地进行”的叙述中；是否响应固定习语或一般词语序列不明确。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various texts: prominent English article a, degree comparative more, and a few common words and medical term fragments. Several strong activations land on different parts of speech and occur in different contexts, with no single semantic pattern covering all passages.

patterns.name: Token following the article a
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the indefinite article a, followed by a noun or noun phrase; it sometimes appears mid-sentence and can also occur in a fixed expression.
patterns.domain: Multidomain webpage text, conversational narrative, and marketing copy

patterns.name: English degree adverb more
patterns.context: Modifies an adjective in comparative or degree expressions, describing something as more enjoyable, easier, or slightly healthier.
patterns.domain: Consumer webpages, holiday marketing, lifestyle articles

patterns.name: English stay
patterns.context: Appears in hotel and accommodation descriptions in the structure make your stay a pleasant experience.

patterns.name: English process
patterns.context: Paired with sales in the marketing expression make the sales process a breeze.

patterns.name: English things
patterns.context: Refers to matters in general; in one case it is the subject of easier, and in another it refers to things generally within a sentence.

patterns.name: Pronoun it in healthy eating
patterns.context: Refers back to a dish or recipe in the construction makes it a little more fit-friendly.

patterns.name: English holidays
patterns.context: In a holiday context, associated with positive descriptions of experiences such as enjoyable.

patterns.name: English in
patterns.context: The preposition is used to narrate a state or situation in “things were in full swing”, and in a mathematical argument in “in fact”.

patterns.name: Medical term hypercholesterolemic
patterns.context: Describes a population with dyslipidemia in a medical paper, near discussion of cholesterol and evidence.

patterns.name: Medical term hypertriglyceridemia
patterns.context: Discusses whether lipid-lowering drugs may worsen hypertriglyceridemia.

11_971.description: 激活分散在多种文本中：突出英语冠词 a、程度比较词 more，以及少数常见词和医学术语片段。多个强激活落在不同词类、不同语境，未见能覆盖全部段落的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 冠词 a 后的 token
patterns.context: 激活集中在不定冠词 a 上，后面接名词或名词短语；有时在句中，也可处于固定表达中。
patterns.domain: 多领域网页文本、口语化叙述与营销文案

patterns.name: 英语程度副词 more
patterns.context: 比较或程度表达中修饰形容词，描述更愉快、更方便或稍微更健康。
patterns.domain: 消费类网页、节日营销、生活方式文章

patterns.name: 英语 stay
patterns.context: 旅游住宿介绍中，出现在 make your stay a pleasant experience 结构里。

patterns.name: 英语 process
patterns.context: 与 sales 搭配，处于 make the sales process a breeze 的营销表达中。

patterns.name: 英语 things
patterns.context: 泛指事务；一处是 easier 的主语，一处是句中泛指的事情。

patterns.name: 健康饮食代词 it
patterns.context: 回指菜肴或食谱，处于 makes it a little more fit-friendly 句式中。

patterns.name: 英语 holidays
patterns.context: 节日语境中，与 enjoyable 等正向体验描述相连。

patterns.name: 英语 in
patterns.context: 介词用于叙述某种状态或情境：things were in full swing；以及数学论证中的 in fact。

patterns.name: 医学术语 hypercholesterolemic
patterns.context: 医学论文中描述人群血脂异常，附近讨论胆固醇与证据。

patterns.name: 医学术语 hypertriglyceridemia
patterns.context: 讨论降脂药物是否会加重高甘油三酯血症。

en.concept: Descriptions of improvement and adaptation outcomes
en.description: Most English passages focus on positive outcomes or suitability, describing services, methods, or resources as making an experience more enjoyable, easier, or better suited; independent trigger patterns also involve compression techniques, set theory, nutrition data, and Danish public issues.

patterns.name: Making things easier, more enjoyable, or manageable
patterns.context: Describes a product, practice, service, or resource as improving an experience, reducing difficulty, or helping achieve a goal; often appears in outcome-oriented or promotional statements.
patterns.domain: Tourism accommodation, sales advice, smart-home holiday content, family management resources, email

patterns.name: Improving healthy eating or adapting to family life
patterns.context: Describes making small adjustments to a dish or recipe to make it healthier or more suitable for a family; emphasizes the resulting suitability.

patterns.name: Compression methods and their names
patterns.context: Discusses encoding or compression prefixes and lists compression techniques.

patterns.name: Construction and consistency in mathematical set theory
patterns.context: Constructs a case in a mathematical argument and states that it is consistent with ZF without the axiom of choice.

patterns.name: Nutrition data and food combinations
patterns.context: Lists dietary components and provides quantitative nutrition information such as energy and protein proportions.

patterns.name: Danish public issue statement
patterns.context: Danish text discusses EU member states and the challenge terrorism poses to society; the visible portion has no obvious word-meaning pattern in common with the other passages.

11_971.concept: 改善与适配的效果表述
11_971.description: 多数英文段落以正面效果或适配为主题，称服务、方法、资源能让体验更愉快、更容易或更合用；另有压缩技术、集合论、营养数据和丹麦语公共议题等独立触发模式。

patterns.name: 让事情更轻松、愉快或容易管理
patterns.trigger: “make your stay a pleasant experience”、“a breeze”、“much more enjoyable”、“make things easier”、“keep your home resolutions”
patterns.context: 把某个产品、做法、服务或资源描述成能改善体验、降低难度或帮助达成目标；多见于结果或宣传性表述。
patterns.domain: 旅游住宿、销售建议、智能家居节日内容、家庭管理资源、邮件

patterns.name: 改善健康饮食或适配家庭生活
patterns.context: 描述对菜肴或食谱做小幅调整，使其更健康或更适合家庭；强调调整后的适配效果。
patterns.domain: 饮食与生活方式类博客

patterns.name: 压缩方法及其名称
patterns.context: 讨论编码或压缩前缀，并列举压缩技术。

patterns.name: 数学集合论中的构造与一致性
patterns.trigger: “pick distinct $x_1,x_2,...$”、“set up the situation”、“consistent with ZF”
patterns.context: 在数学论证中构造情形并说明其与不含选择公理的 ZF 一致。

patterns.name: 营养数据与食物组合
patterns.context: 列举膳食组成，并给出能量和蛋白质比例等定量营养信息。

patterns.name: 丹麦语公共议题陈述
patterns.trigger: “Terrorismen udgør en af de største udfordringer”
patterns.context: 丹麦语谈论欧盟成员国及恐怖主义对社会构成的挑战；可见部分没有明显对应其他段的词义模式。

en.concept: Uncertain local word-form and contextual patterns
en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: several passages highlight the article a, while others involve the degree use of more, words about family and activities, and abbreviations, numbers, or terms in mathematical and medical nutrition texts. No single word meaning readily explains them.

patterns.name: Boundary after the article a
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the indefinite article a, followed by an adjective, noun, or quantity expression; in these examples, the following words are pleasant, breeze, and lot.
patterns.domain: Tourism promotions, sales advice, technology introductions

patterns.name: Degree expression after more
