patterns.context: more is used in a comparative or degree construction meaning “to a greater extent”, followed by an adjective; the same passage also activates holidays, and, and other words.

patterns.name: Home and daily life words
patterns.context: Involves home, daily life, or activities; trigger words are distributed across home-related terms and phrases describing activity status.

patterns.name: Tokens near values or units
patterns.context: Activations occur within or near abbreviations, symbols, or specialized terms in scientific and mathematical texts; the specific trigger forms are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Mathematics Q&A, medical and nutrition abstracts

patterns.name: Matters related to trips or activities
patterns.context: Strong activations appear in accounts of holidays, travel, or activities, but their trigger locations and contexts differ.

11_971.concept: 不确定的局部词形与上下文模式
11_971.description: 激活模式较分散：数段突出冠词 a，另有 more 的程度用法、家庭与活动叙述词，以及数学和医学营养文本中的缩写、数字或术语。难以用单一词义解释。

patterns.name: 冠词 a 后的边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在不定冠词 a，后接形容词、名词或数量表达；这些例子中 a 后的词分别为 pleasant、breeze、lot。
patterns.domain: 旅游宣传、销售建议、科技介绍

patterns.name: more 后的程度表达
patterns.context: more 用于比较或程度结构，表示“更加”，后接形容词；同段另有 holidays、and 等词激活。

patterns.name: 居家与生活日常词
patterns.context: 涉及家庭、日常生活或活动进展；触发词分布在家庭主题词与描述活动状态的短语中。

patterns.name: 数值或单位附近的 token
patterns.context: 激活出现在科学、数学文本中的缩写、符号或专门术语内部/邻近位置；具体触发形式彼此并不一致。
patterns.domain: 数学问答、医学及营养学摘要

patterns.name: 行程或活动相关的事情
patterns.context: 对节日、旅行或活动的叙述中出现较强激活，但触发位置和语境不相同。

en.description: Activations occur in lifestyle and home copy, household expense advice, quantified medical measures, and biomedical terms; there are also sporadic triggers in sales and travel narratives. Function words, topic words, and medical markers are difficult to unify under a single pattern.

patterns.name: “a / be …” structures
patterns.context: Weak function words are marked in syntactic structures, but also occur in other contexts and cannot alone explain the strongest activations.

patterns.name: Accommodation and home convenience
patterns.context: Describes accommodation experiences, holiday home life, or improvements to household tasks, emphasizing comfort, pleasure, or convenience.

patterns.name: Living expenses and cost control
patterns.context: Discusses reducing everyday expenses, budgeting, or household financial management.

patterns.name: Quantified lists and thresholds
patterns.context: Numbers and units are embedded in nutrition or medical measure lists; [3] also contains formal notation and stepwise argumentation, but does not show the same number-unit pattern.

patterns.name: Broad everyday topic words
patterns.context: Appear separately in a sales techniques introduction and a travel narrative, with no obvious shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Biomedical terms
patterns.context: Contexts involving insulin resistance, hyperinsulinemia, and cardiovascular disease research.

11_971.description: 激活分布在生活与居家文案、家庭开支建议、数字化医学指标及生物医学术语中；另有销售和旅行叙事中的零散触发。功能词、主题词及医学标记难以归为单一模式。

patterns.name: “a / be …”结构
patterns.context: 弱功能词在句法结构中被标记，但这些词也见于其他语境，难以单独解释最强激活。

patterns.name: 住宿与居家便利
patterns.context: 介绍住宿体验、节日居家生活或家庭事务改善，强调舒适、愉悦或便利。

patterns.name: 生活开销及费用控制
patterns.context: 讨论压低日常支出、预算或家庭财务管理。
patterns.domain: 论坛建议、家庭管理文案

patterns.name: 量化列表与阈值
patterns.context: 数字与单位嵌入营养或医学指标列表；[3]也有形式化记号及分步论述，但未呈现同样的数值单位模式。

patterns.name: 广义日常主题词
patterns.context: 分别出现在销售技巧介绍和旅行叙事中，缺乏共同的明显触发条件。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语
patterns.context: 胰岛素抵抗、高胰岛素血症与心血管疾病研究语境。

en.description: Activations are scattered across accommodation, sales, holiday, and family copy, as well as mathematics, nutrition, and clinical texts; there is no stable shared semantics. Some high values occur near home, numerical units, and medical hyper- terms, but the trigger conditions are inconsistent.

patterns.name: stay in lodging or hotel-style accommodation descriptions
patterns.context: In accommodation promotional copy, stay is followed by an article and a description of an enjoyable or comfortable experience.

patterns.name: a breeze in the sales process
patterns.context: Explains that advice can make something easy; a and breeze form an idiomatic expression.

patterns.name: ZF in mathematical contexts
patterns.context: ZF is split and marked in discussions of set theory and axiom systems; it may respond to the letter Z.

patterns.name: Holiday enjoyment level
patterns.context: Smart-home devices make holidays easier and more enjoyable; activations cluster near expressions of increasing degree.

patterns.name: Activities or preparations in progress
patterns.context: Narrates a scene bustling with activity before a camping trip.

patterns.name: Numerical thresholds and units
patterns.context: A medical report classifies people according to blood lipid thresholds; activations occur near values, comparison signs, and units.

patterns.name: Energy values and units
patterns.context: A dietary trial describes food combinations and nutritional composition, with an energy unit following an approximate value.

patterns.name: Home efficiency and home resolutions
patterns.context: Promotes family management resources; strong activation occurs near home in a home-planning context.

patterns.name: Medical variable hyperlipidemia
patterns.context: Hyperlipidemia is listed among propensity score variables; activation falls within the disease term.

patterns.name: Medical variable hyperinsulinemia
patterns.context: Discusses the association between diabetes-related alleles and hyperinsulinemia; activation falls within the disease term.

11_971.description: 激活分散于住宿、销售、节假日与家庭文案，也见数学、营养和临床文本；没有稳定的共同语义。个别高值邻近 home、数值单位及 hyper-医学术语，但触发条件不一致。

patterns.name: 旅店或酒店式住宿介绍中的 stay
patterns.context: 住宿宣传语中，stay 后接冠词并描述愉快或舒适的体验。

patterns.name: 销售流程的 a breeze
patterns.context: 说明建议能让某件事变得轻松，a 与 breeze 构成惯用表达。

patterns.name: 数学语境的 ZF
patterns.context: 讨论集合论、公理系统时，ZF 被拆分标注；可能响应字母 Z。

patterns.name: 节假日愉悦程度
patterns.context: 智能家居使假期更轻松愉快；激活集中在程度递进表达附近。

patterns.name: 进行中的活动或准备
patterns.context: 叙述露营旅程前的场面正在热闹进行。

patterns.name: 数值阈值与单位
patterns.context: 医学报告中按血脂指标阈值分类，数值、比较符号和单位邻近激活。

patterns.name: 能量数值与单位
patterns.context: 膳食试验描述食物组合及营养组成，近似数值后跟能量单位。

patterns.name: 居家效率与 home resolutions
patterns.context: 推广家庭管理资源，home 邻近较强激活，并出现在居家规划语境。
patterns.domain: 家庭生活、电子书营销文案

patterns.name: 医学变量 hyperlipidemia
patterns.context: 倾向评分变量清单中列出高脂血症；激活落在疾病词内部。

patterns.name: 医学变量 hyperinsulinemia
patterns.context: 讨论糖尿病相关等位基因与高胰岛素血症的关联；激活落在疾病词内部。

en.concept: Responses to multiple lexical items and phrases
en.description: Activations involve home life and expressions that make experiences more convenient or pleasant, as well as hyper- lipid terminology in medicine. There are also isolated patterns involving set-theoretic ZF and “in full swing.”

patterns.name: Home life and household chores
patterns.context: Discusses home, household management, home appliances, or making everyday life more convenient; common in promotional copy.

patterns.name: Expressions of comfort, convenience, and pleasure
patterns.context: In comparative or result expressions describing an experience, task, or life as easier or more pleasant because of something, strong activations often fall on degree words or the indefinite article.

patterns.name: hyperlipidemia-related word forms
patterns.context: Medical texts use lipid-disorder terms beginning with hyper-; activation falls on subword fragments within the terms.

patterns.name: Expressions meaning ongoing or in full swing
patterns.context: Describes activities or preparations as proceeding energetically or being fully underway.

patterns.name: ZF preceding a set theory term
patterns.context: ZF occurs in nearby context discussing the axiom of choice, set theory, and related consistency.

11_971.concept: 多模式词汇与短语响应
11_971.description: 激活涉及家居生活及使体验更便利愉快的表达，也包括医学中 hyper- 血脂术语；另有集合论 ZF 和“in full swing”两处孤立模式。

patterns.name: 家居生活与家务
patterns.context: 讨论家庭、家务管理、家居设备或让日常生活更便利时；常见于宣传性文案。
patterns.domain: 生活方式、家居与消费文案

patterns.name: 舒适、便利与愉悦表达
patterns.trigger: “stay a pleasant experience”“process a breeze”“much more enjoyable”“a lot easier”中的“a”“much”“more”“a lot”
patterns.context: 在描述体验、任务或生活因某事而更轻松愉快的比较或结果表达中，强激活常落在程度词或不定冠词上。

patterns.name: hyperlipidemia 相关词形
patterns.context: 医学文本中以 hyper- 开头的血脂异常术语；激活落在术语内部的子词片段。

patterns.name: 进行中或全面展开的表达
patterns.context: 叙述活动或准备工作正在热烈、全面进行时。

patterns.name: 集合论术语前的 ZF
patterns.context: 讨论选择公理、集合论及相关数学一致性时，邻近上下文出现 ZF。

en.description: Activation sources are dispersed: including words such as succeeded and safer, as well as disease terms, mechanisms, technologies, models, and absorption terms in medical and research abstracts; no unified trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: Surname followed by parliamentary office
patterns.context: A biography describes someone succeeding another person to a seat or position; strong activation falls on succeeded.

patterns.name: Past participle succeeded
patterns.context: English sentences about completing or achieving something; here it refers respectively to succession, replacement, or military advance.

patterns.name: safer in a virtualization security comparison
patterns.context: Compares the security of containers and virtual machines; safer modifies choice.

patterns.name: Safety comparison between youth culture and real-world activities
patterns.context: Discusses teenagers’ online exploration and creative work, comparing their safety with real-life activities.

patterns.name: Medical term dyschondroplasia
patterns.context: A disease name is split into tokens in a medical abstract; activation is concentrated on the initial dys.

patterns.name: Wording in a mechanism research project
patterns.context: A project abstract introduces research into the basic mechanisms of some biological information.

patterns.name: Surgical technique phrase
patterns.context: A project abstract describes treatment methods with the phrase techniques for the treatment of...

patterns.name: Computer simulation model phrase
patterns.context: A project abstract mentions an existing computer simulation model and HIV disease.

patterns.name: Intestinal absorption phrase
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes the distribution of thyroxine absorption.

patterns.name: Remaining activations not clearly classifiable
patterns.context: Although some local markers are relatively strong, the excerpts are insufficient to confirm stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

11_1207.description: 激活来源分散：包括 succeeded、safer 等词，以及医学、科研摘要中的疾病词、机制、技术、模型和吸收等术语；尚无统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 姓氏后接议员职务
patterns.context: 人物传记中描述某人继承某人的议席或职位；强激活落在 succeeded。

patterns.name: 过去分词 succeeded
patterns.context: 与完成或达成某事相关的英语句子；此处分别指继任、取代或军事推进。

patterns.name: 虚拟化安全比较中的 safer
patterns.context: 比较容器与虚拟机的安全性，safer 修饰 choice。

patterns.name: 青春文化与现实活动的安全比较
patterns.context: 讨论青少年线上探索和创作，并与现实生活活动比较安全性。

patterns.name: 医学术语 dyschondroplasia
patterns.context: 医学摘要中疾病名称被分词切开；激活集中在词首 dys。

patterns.name: 机制研究项目措辞
patterns.context: 项目摘要介绍研究将探究某种生物信息的基本机制。

patterns.name: 手术技术短语
patterns.context: 项目摘要以 techniques for the treatment of... 描述治疗方法。

patterns.name: 计算机模拟模型短语
patterns.context: 项目摘要提及既有计算机模拟模型及 HIV 疾病。

patterns.name: 肠道吸收短语
patterns.context: 医学摘要描述甲状腺素吸收的分布。

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的其余激活
patterns.trigger: 分散于普通功能词或词片段，例如 «of»、«will»、«and»；无清楚共同触发子串
patterns.context: 虽有局部较强标记，但片段不足以确认稳定的语义或句法条件。

en.concept: Technical terms and local word forms
en.description: Primarily responds to medical and biological terms, as well as terms for research mechanisms and models; also responds to “safer” and vulnerability terms in HackerNews security discussions, and sporadically to “succeeded” in biographical or literary contexts. The latter cases are difficult to explain through the main pattern.

patterns.name: In-word fragments of low-frequency medical/biological terms
patterns.context: Activation falls within medical or biological technical terms, especially terms composed of multiple subword fragments; nearby text often includes research titles, treatments, or mechanism descriptions.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and NIH project abstracts

patterns.name: Mechanism and research-subject terminology
patterns.context: In research plans or scientific abstracts, technical content such as mechanisms, models, diseases, and cellular processes appears nearby; high activation concentrates on key scientific nouns and adjacent fragments.

patterns.name: “safer” in safety comparisons
patterns.context: “Safer” comparisons discuss virtualization relative to container-escape risk, and youth cultural exploration relative to real-world activities.

patterns.name: Computer security vulnerabilities and container terminology
patterns.context: Discusses vulnerabilities, privilege escalation, container escapes, and virtualization security; activation is distributed across fragments within security terms and adjacent technical terms.

patterns.name: Surgical treatment terminology
patterns.context: Title or abstract fragments describing surgical techniques intended to treat a disease.

patterns.name: “succeeded” in biographies
patterns.context: A biography describes someone succeeding another person in a position; the same word form appears once in a literary narrative, but in a different context.

patterns.name: “succeeded” in a literary context
patterns.context: Describes an artistic group or movement succeeding an earlier generation; shares the word form with succession to a position, but differs in subject matter and context.

11_1207.description: 主要响应医学、生物学专业词及科研机制、模型等术语；也响应HackerNews安全讨论中的safer和漏洞词，并零星响应传记或文学语境的succeeded，后两者难以由主模式解释。

patterns.name: 低频医学／生物学术语的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学或生物学专业词内部，尤其是由多个子词片段构成的术语；周围常见研究标题、治疗或机制描述。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 机制与研究对象术语
patterns.trigger: «basic»8« mechanisms»9« of»3« bioelectric information»；«model»9« of»3« advanced HIV disease»；«mechanisms»9« by»2« which»3« differentiation»
patterns.context: 研究计划或科研摘要中，机制、模型、疾病、细胞过程等专业内容相邻出现；高响应集中在关键科研名词及其邻近片段。

patterns.name: 安全性比较中的 safer
patterns.trigger: «virtual»ization« is»« the»« safer»10« choice»；« culture»« is»« actually»« safer»9
patterns.context: 出现 safer 比较，分别讨论虚拟化相对容器逃逸风险、以及青年文化探索相对现实活动的安全性。

patterns.name: 计算机安全漏洞及容器术语
patterns.context: 讨论漏洞、权限提升、容器逃逸及虚拟化安全；响应分布在安全术语的词内片段和相邻技术词上。

patterns.name: 外科治疗术语
patterns.context: 以治疗某种疾病为目的的外科技术标题或摘要片段。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的 succeeded
patterns.context: 传记叙述某人继任另一人的职位；另有一处相同词形出现在文学叙述中，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 文学语境中的 succeeded
patterns.context: 叙述某种艺术团体或潮流接续较早的一代；与人物继任职位的用法共享词形，但题材和语境不同。

en.description: The most stable signal is strong activation on “commonly” (segments 6–10); other activations are scattered across technical-word segmentation, technical terms, academic connective expressions, and locally frequent words, with no unified semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Words following “commonly”
patterns.context: The word “commonly” itself is marked 9, while some common collocations in the following text are unmarked; this looks more like activation on “commonly” than a unified pattern involving the words that follow.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within scientific terms
patterns.context: Multisyllabic technical terms in scientific or academic contexts are split into subword tokens; there is no consistent clue based on word beginnings, endings, or meaning.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research projects, philosophy papers

patterns.name: Linux security terminology and tokenization
patterns.context: Several technical words in security discussions are split into subwords; “safer” is also marked in the same passage.

patterns.name: “techniques” in patent text
patterns.context: “techniques” and “for” activate strongly in a title-like description of medical surgical techniques.

patterns.name: Inferential connectives in philosophy texts
patterns.context: A discussion of whether perceptual experience arises from inference shows prominent activation on a dash and the following “or.”
patterns.domain: Academic papers in philosophy and psychology

patterns.name: Species names and length descriptions
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry describes fish similarities, body length, and typical length; marked words occur in proper names and descriptive statements.

patterns.name: Gene methylation and transcription
patterns.context: Describes the association between gene methylation and transcriptional activity; significant activation falls mainly on “heavily” and “commonly.”

patterns.name: Descriptions of ATM use
patterns.context: Describes the functions and common uses of automated teller machines; activation is scattered across action and frequency expressions.

patterns.name: Commonness in charset descriptions
patterns.context: Describes Latin characters and characters not often used at the beginning of words; prominent activation is concentrated on “commonly.”

patterns.name: Commonness in a horse-blanket patent
patterns.context: Introduces horse blankets as usually being used for warmth; activation is concentrated on “commonly.”

11_1207.description: 最稳定线索是 commonly 的强激活（段6–10）；其余激活分散于专业词拆分、技术术语、学术连接表达及局部高频词，未见统一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: commonly 后的词
patterns.trigger: “commonly” 后紧接被标记的词：commonly «50»-65?；原文中明确为 “commonly»9” 后接 unmarked token（段 6 的 50、段 7 的 associated、段 8 的 in use、段 9 的 used、段 10 的 used）
patterns.context: 词 commonly 本身被标记为 9，且其后续文本中某些常见搭配词未标记；这更像对 commonly 的激活，而不是后续词的统一模式。
patterns.domain: 百科、科学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 科学词语内部子词片段
patterns.context: 科学或学术语境中的多音节专业词被拆成子词 token；没有一致的词首、词尾或词义线索。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研项目、哲学论文

patterns.name: Linux 安全术语与分词
patterns.context: 安全讨论中，若干技术词被拆分成子词；同段也标记了“safer”。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的 techniques
patterns.context: 医疗手术技术的标题式描述中，techniques 和 for 激活较强。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目标题/医学文本

patterns.name: 哲学文本中的推论连接符
patterns.context: 讨论知觉经验是否来自推论的论述中，破折号及其后的 or 激活突出。
patterns.domain: 哲学与心理学学术论文

patterns.name: 物种名与长度描述
patterns.context: 百科条目介绍鱼类相似性、体长和常见体长；被标记的词分布在专名和描述性语句中。

patterns.name: 基因甲基化与转录
patterns.context: 描述基因甲基化与转录活性的关联；显著激活主要落在 heavily 和 commonly。

patterns.name: ATM 使用描述
patterns.context: 描述自动银行机器的功能和常见使用方式；激活词分散在操作与频率表达中。

patterns.name: 字符集说明中的常见性
patterns.context: 描述拉丁字符及不常用于词首的字符；明显激活集中在 commonly。

patterns.name: 马具专利中的常见性
patterns.context: 介绍马毯通常用于保暖；激活集中在 commonly。

en.description: Activation occurs on word-initial or internal subword fragments across domains, commonly in medical and biomedical terms, as well as philosophical terms, proper nouns, titles, and names of patented devices; no unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Specific word-initial or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation on initial or internal subword fragments of words with varying meanings and full forms; some fragments recur across repeated titles.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, philosophical titles, patents, wiki entries, and web text

patterns.name: Biomedical topics and terminology
patterns.context: In medical or biomedical texts, activation falls on partial word fragments in terms for diseases, research mechanisms, and technologies; the specific word forms vary across passages.

patterns.name: Repeated titles or proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation near the beginning of titles, entry names, or proper nouns; initial fragments recur in repeated names or titles.

patterns.name: Philosophical terms in academic titles
patterns.context: In titles of philosophical works, activation covers multiple tokenized fragments of terms and personal names, with no shared semantics with the medical fragments.

patterns.name: Device names in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: A patent background uses the construction “commonly known as” followed by a device name in quotation marks; the name itself is split into subwords.

patterns.name: Surgical and disease names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in medical texts mentioning surgical techniques, conditions, or pain categories; trigger locations and term types vary.

11_1207.description: 激活分布于不同领域的词首或词内子词片段，常见于医学、生物医学术语，也见哲学术语、专名、标题及专利器械名称；未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词首或词内特定片段
patterns.context: 对单词的开头或内部子词片段激活，词义和完整词形各异；有的片段跨重复标题再次出现。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、哲学标题、专利、维基条目及网页文本

patterns.name: 生物医学主题与术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学文本中，激活落在疾病、研究机制及技术术语的部分词片段上；不同段落中的具体词形并不相同。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 标题或专名的重复呈现
patterns.context: 标题、条目名或专名开头附近激活；重复出现的名称或标题中，词首片段再次激活。

patterns.name: 学术标题中的哲学术语
patterns.context: 哲学作品标题中，激活覆盖术语与人名的多个切分片段，未见与医学片段相同的语义。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的器械名称
patterns.context: 专利背景句式“commonly known as”后接引号中的器械名称，名称本身按子词切分。

patterns.name: 手术与疾病名称
patterns.context: 医疗文本中出现手术技术、病症或疼痛类别时有激活；触发位置和术语类型不一致。

en.description: Primarily responds to “Effect of” in medical titles and the variables that follow; also activates strongly on “of the bonding” in chemistry statements, numeric pagination formats, NIH grant-purpose boilerplate, and the proper name “Bank of British West Africa.”

patterns.name: Research-title openings with “Effect of”
patterns.context: Titles or abstract phrases beginning with “Effect of X on Y”; X may be a disease, intervention, diet, demographic characteristic, or treatment

patterns.name: The phrase “of the bonding”
patterns.context: In descriptions of chemical bonding, “bonding” is followed by a material or chemical formula

patterns.name: Counting/pagination fragments formed with numbers and “of”
patterns.context: Digitized lists, search results, or other text with pagination/counts; the specific format varies by context

patterns.name: Grant-application boilerplate: “Purpose of this grant”
patterns.context: States the purpose of a grant application, followed by a description of the proposed research

patterns.name: “Bank of” in an institution name
patterns.context: The proper name “Bank of British West Africa,” with part of the name repeated after a line break

11_1207.description: 主要响应医学标题中的“Effect of”及其后续变量；另对化学语句中的“of the bonding”、数字分页格式、NIH 资助目的套语和专名“Bank of British West Africa”有较强激活。

patterns.name: “Effect of”研究标题开头
patterns.context: 以“Effect of X on Y”开头的标题或摘要短语；X 可为疾病、干预、饮食、人口特征或治疗

patterns.name: “of the bonding”短语
patterns.context: 化学键合相关表述中，bonding 后接材料或化学式
patterns.domain: PubMed 化学/材料科学摘要

patterns.name: 数字与“of”组成的计数/分页片段
patterns.context: 数字化列表、搜索结果或其他带分页/计数的文本；具体格式依上下文而异

patterns.name: “Purpose of this grant”资助申请套语
patterns.context: 说明资助申请目的，后续描述拟开展的研究

patterns.name: 机构名称中的“Bank of”
patterns.context: 专名“Bank of British West Africa”，并在换行后重复部分名称

en.description: All excerpts show significant activation on “as,” followed by an example or specific elaboration; topics and subsequent content vary, with no independent domain pattern evident.

patterns.name: as introducing examples
patterns.context: as is followed by one or more examples, category members, or specific instances; the word itself is the activation marker, while the surrounding examples vary
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, research project abstracts, medical abstracts, and news narratives

11_1207.description: 所有片段均在“as”处有显著激活，且后接示例或具体补充；题材和后续内容多样，没有显示出独立的领域模式。

patterns.name: as 引出例示
patterns.context: as 后接一个或多个示例、类别成员或具体实例；该词本身是激活标记，周围示例内容各不相同
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科研项目摘要、医学摘要及新闻叙述

en.concept: patent technical fields and example introducers
en.description: Primarily responds to patent field/background headings, introductory sentences describing an invention as relating to or addressing a technology, and the example phrase “such as”; also responds to clicks, acceptance/rejection, and displayed results in an interface-operation Q&A passage.

patterns.name: Patent technical-field heading
patterns.context: Appears in section headings in patent style, often with numbering and line breaks, followed by a description of the invention’s field or background

patterns.name: Patent field-introduction construction
patterns.context: At the beginning of a patent paragraph, states the technology to which the invention relates or that it addresses; may be followed by a specific field or simply describe a device or method

patterns.name: “such as” introducing examples
patterns.context: The phrase introduces one or more examples, which may be systems, materials, devices, disease-related objects, etc.; not limited to patent text

patterns.name: Web interface actions and results
patterns.context: Describes corresponding messages displayed on different pages after a user selects accept or reject in an interface

patterns.name: Technical background section
patterns.context: A patent document opens an explanation of existing technology with a technical-background section heading

11_1207.concept: 专利技术领域与举例引导
11_1207.description: 主要响应专利文本的领域/背景标题、发明涉及或针对某技术的引入句，以及引例短语“such as”；另对一段界面操作问答中的点击、接受/拒绝及显示结果有响应。

patterns.name: 专利技术领域标题
patterns.trigger: «Field» of the Invention»；«Technical» Field»；«Description» of the Background» Art
patterns.context: 出现在专利文体的章节标题中，常带编号和换行，后接发明领域或背景说明

patterns.name: 专利领域引入句式
patterns.context: 专利段落开头用来说明发明涉及或针对的技术对象；可能接具体领域，也可能只描述装置或方法

patterns.name: “such as”举例引导
patterns.context: 该短语引出一个或多个示例，示例对象可为系统、材料、设备、疾病相关对象等；并非只限于专利文本
patterns.domain: 专利说明书及技术问答

patterns.name: 网页操作与结果表达
patterns.trigger: «As» the user clicks on «accept»；«reject» it should «display» «reject»
patterns.context: 描述用户在界面中选择接受或拒绝后，在不同页面显示对应消息

patterns.name: 技术背景章节
patterns.context: 专利文档中以背景技术章节标题开启对既有技术的说明

en.description: The strongest activation is concentrated on sentence-initial “As,” which typically connects to preceding text and introduces background, conditions, or explanations across genres; weaker related triggers include “As soon as” and “where” defining symbols after a mathematical formula.

patterns.name: As trigger after an in-sentence preposition
patterns.context: As appears at the beginning of a new sentence, followed by a past participle, adjective, or noun phrase; the preceding text typically completes a statement.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including patents, news headlines, travel copy, mathematics papers, and biographical introductions

patterns.name: Sentence-initial As introducing a condition or temporal background
patterns.context: As appears sentence-initially and introduces a following clause or background expression; paragraph 9 has “As soon as,” whose syntax differs somewhat from the other examples.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, web descriptions, and general narratives

patterns.name: where in formulas
patterns.context: After a mathematical formula, where introduces variable definitions or conditions; activation falls on where rather than the formula symbols.

11_1207.concept: 句首连接与说明引导词
11_1207.description: 最强激活集中在句首“As”，通常承接前文并引出背景、条件或说明，跨多种文体出现；另有“As soon as”及数学公式后定义符号的“where”两类相关性较弱的触发。

patterns.name: 句内介词后的 As 触发
patterns.context: As 位于新句句首，后接过去分词、形容词或名词短语；前文通常已结束一个陈述。
patterns.domain: 专利、新闻标题、旅游文案、数学论文、人物介绍等多种文体

patterns.name: 句首 As 引出的条件或时间背景
patterns.context: As 位于句首并引出后续从句或背景表达；第9段为“As soon as”，与其他例子的句法结构不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 百科、网页说明及一般叙述

patterns.name: 公式中的 where
patterns.context: 数学公式后用 where 引入变量定义或条件，激活落在 where 而非公式符号上。

en.concept: specific word forms and proper-name fragments
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to Steve at the beginning of names, including email salutations and biographical encyclopedia entries; also responds to the proper name Gukov in ArXiv, the term Asht(e)kar–Sen, and As at sentence or clause beginnings.

patterns.name: First word of a name: Steve
patterns.context: The first name or a name prefix, followed by a surname, colon, comma, or line break; common in email salutations/signatures or biographical encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Gukov-related proper name
patterns.context: A person’s name or term in mathematical physics literature, listed alongside objects related to SU(2)

patterns.name: Asht(e)kar–Sen term
patterns.context: In a theoretical context where the independent variables are the tetrad and spin connection, the term appears as a sentence-final phrase

patterns.name: High activation on As in mathematical sentences
patterns.context: An English connector at the beginning or within a sentence that marks a transition or introduces a subsequent statement; occurs with mathematical results, expansions, or predictions

11_1207.description: 主要对姓名开头的 Steve 强烈响应，覆盖邮件称呼及百科人物条目；另响应 ArXiv 中的 Gukov 专名、Asht(e)kar–Sen 术语，以及句首/句中的 As。

patterns.name: 人名首词 Steve
patterns.context: 作为姓名的名或姓前缀，后接姓氏、冒号、逗号或换行；常见于邮件称呼/署名或百科人物条目
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、Wikipedia 人物条目

patterns.name: Gukov 相关专名
patterns.context: 作为数学物理文献中的人名或术语名称，并与 SU(2) 相关对象并列

patterns.name: Asht(e)kar–Sen 术语
patterns.context: 独立变量为 tetrad 与 spin connection 的理论语境中，术语作为句末短语出现

patterns.name: 数学句中 As 的高激活
patterns.context: 句首或句中转折/引出后续陈述的英语连接词；与数学结果、展开或预测语境共现

en.description: Activation is dispersed across multiple texts, concentrated on tokenized proper-name fragments and internal fragments of Polish words; scattered triggers also include English function words, a voting term, the code value rtl, and patent-number digits, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition evident.

patterns.name: Polish word-final and internal fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within inflected Polish words or stems, especially words with diacritics; the fragment may span multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Fragments in English names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Names of people, bands, or organizations are split into multiple tokens; activation often falls on a specific fragment within a name, and also occurs in lists dense with proper nouns.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia entries, directories, and web introductions

patterns.name: English function words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Common English prepositions, conjunctions, articles, or phrases occur in English narratives; there is no stable syntactic position, and many similar tokens are unmarked.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedias, web, and patent text

patterns.name: French voting instruction
patterns.context: In European Parliament voting procedures, instructs members to vote on an amendment; “hierop” recurs within a short span.

patterns.name: rtl in language-direction configuration
patterns.context: A code comment describes language reading direction and lists rtl as a possible value.
patterns.domain: CKEditor language configuration code on Github

patterns.name: Patent-number digits in English patent literature
patterns.context: The numeric token within patent citation number “3,954,1534”; nearby are other patent numbers and inventor names.

11_1207.description: 激活分散在多种文本中，集中于被拆分的专名片段和波兰语词内片段；另有英语功能词、表决词、代码值 rtl 及专利号数字等零散触发，未见一致语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 波兰语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语屈折词或词干内部，尤其是带变音符号的词；词片段可能跨多个子词元。
patterns.domain: 波兰语语料；欧盟议会文本（第10段）

patterns.name: 英语姓名及专名中的片段
patterns.context: 姓名、乐队名或组织名被拆分成多个 token；激活往往落在名字中的特定片段，也出现在专名密集的列表中。
patterns.domain: 英语百科条目、名录及网页介绍

patterns.name: 英语功能词与短语片段
patterns.context: 英语叙述中出现常见介词、连词、冠词或短语；没有稳定的句法位置，且大量同类 token 未标记。
patterns.domain: 英语百科、网页和专利文本

patterns.name: 法语表决指令
patterns.context: 欧洲议会表决程序中，指示议员对修正案投票；「hierop」在短时间内重复出现。

patterns.name: 语言方向配置中的 rtl
patterns.context: 代码注释描述语言阅读方向，并把 rtl 列为可能取值之一。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 CKEditor 语言配置代码

patterns.name: 英语专利文献中的专利号数字
patterns.context: 专利引证编号「3,954,1534」内部的数字 token；附近另有专利号和发明人姓名。

en.concept: patent invention-description boilerplate and adjacent technical text
en.description: Primarily responds to patent specification boilerplate about purposes, advantages, and phrases such as “According to the invention”; also commonly occurs in descriptions of engineering devices, materials, and manufacturing structures. It additionally covers a video-encoding citation, an ink-absorbing medium patent, and a private email about a sailing companion.

patterns.name: Patent purpose and invention-introduction boilerplate
patterns.context: Fixed phrases in patent backgrounds or specifications that state the invention’s purpose or advantages, or introduce a solution; activation falls on these phrases and neighboring words.

patterns.name: Mechanical and engineering component descriptions
patterns.context: Describes physical devices, components, materials, or structures and their functions, usually in patent technical descriptions; some examples co-occur with purpose boilerplate.

patterns.name: Materials, electronics, and manufacturing technology
patterns.context: Introduces material processing, magnetic-field devices, or semiconductor manufacturing structures, surrounded by technical terminology and invention-solution introductions.

patterns.name: Names in patent citations or document titles
patterns.context: Author names appear in technical patent passages; the trigger falls within a name fragment and does not clearly reflect patent-purpose boilerplate.

patterns.name: Recording media and ink-absorbing layers
patterns.context: Discusses coatings or layering methods to improve ink absorption and includes patent document numbers.

patterns.name: Sailing arrangements in a personal email
patterns.context: A private email mentions whether someone will go sailing after being widowed and finding assistance; its style differs from patent text.

11_1207.concept: 专利发明说明套语及邻近技术文本
11_1207.description: 主要响应专利说明书中目的、优点及“According to the invention”等套语，也常见于工程装置、材料和制造结构描述；另覆盖视频编码引文、吸墨介质专利，以及一段谈航行帮手的私人邮件。

patterns.name: 专利目的与发明引入套语
patterns.trigger: “objects and advantages”, “The object of the invention”, “According to the invention”
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书中陈述发明目的、优点，或引出解决方案的固定句式；激活落在这些套语及其邻近词上。

patterns.name: 机械与工程部件描述
patterns.context: 描述实体装置、构件、材料或结构及其功能，通常位于专利技术说明中；部分与目的套语同时出现。
patterns.domain: 工程、机械及装置类专利

patterns.name: 材料、电子与制造技术
patterns.trigger: “molten jet of metal”, “magnetic field”, “wiring layer”, “semiconductor package”
patterns.context: 介绍材料加工、磁场装置或半导体制造结构，周围有技术术语和发明方案引入语。
patterns.domain: 材料、电子及半导体专利

patterns.name: 专利引用或文献标题中的姓名
patterns.context: 技术专利段落中出现参考文献作者姓名；触发位置在人名内部的词片段，不体现明显的专利目的套语。
patterns.domain: 视频编码专利及参考文献

patterns.name: 录制介质与吸墨层
patterns.context: 讨论改善吸墨性的涂层或成层方法，包含专利文献编号。

patterns.name: 个人邮件中的航行安排
patterns.trigger: “glad of some help to sail it”, “talking about sailing it”, “find some help”
patterns.context: 私人邮件提到某人丧偶后是否外出航行，以及寻找协助；与专利文本风格不同。

en.description: Activation is concentrated in patent background text: citations to prior art, statements of problems/disadvantages, descriptions of technical components and materials, and patent-style paragraph transitions. It also covers terminology across multiple fields, numbering, and local topic shifts.

patterns.name: Citations and paragraph continuations in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: The background section of a patent cites earlier patents or literature, often at the beginning of a new paragraph or within a paragraph; covers multiple invention fields
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds, patent and literature citations

patterns.name: Statements of disadvantages or problems in background technology
patterns.context: Evaluates shortcomings of existing technology, manufacturing difficulties, or cost/energy-consumption issues
patterns.domain: Technical comparisons and problem statements in patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Technical terms and component descriptions in patent text
patterns.context: Uses technical nouns, component numbers, or material properties to describe an invention’s structure, process, or function
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions involving chemistry, detection, optics, ventilation, acoustics, thermal science, and mechanics

patterns.name: Template-like transitions between patent paragraphs
patterns.context: Moves from claims or technical descriptions to embodiments, or introduces known technology; fragments often occur at sentence or paragraph boundaries

patterns.name: Patent numbers, literature numbers, and numbering formats
patterns.context: Cites published patent application numbers or U.S. patent numbers, or appends alphanumeric identifiers to technical components
patterns.domain: Patent citations and technical component labels

patterns.name: Local fragments with topic shifts
patterns.context: Appears after discussions of thermal contact/energy consumption in one case, and in an image-processing background in another; no shared pattern involving patent citations or disadvantage triggers is apparent
patterns.domain: Payment technology and image-processing patent text

11_1207.description: 激活集中于专利背景文本：既有技术引证、问题/缺点陈述、技术部件与材料描述及专利式段落衔接；也覆盖多领域术语、编号和局部主题突变。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的引文与段落续接
patterns.trigger: “In the process described in U.S. Pat. No.”、“As further discussed in U.S. Pat. No.”、“shown in Geiger et al”及“in WO 98/314505”
patterns.context: 专利背景部分引用先前专利或文献，常位于新段开头或段落中；涵盖多种发明领域
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景、专利与文献引证

patterns.name: 背景技术的缺点或问题陈述
patterns.trigger: “Major drawback”、“One disadvantage”、“make no attempt”及“has to be expended”
patterns.context: 评价既有技术的不足、制造难点或成本/能耗问题
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的技术比较与问题陈述

patterns.name: 专利文本中的技术术语及部件描述
patterns.trigger: “polysiloxane polymer”、“decomposer off gas”、“shear wave”、“non-absorbing layers”、“waveguide”、“metallic sliding bearing layer”
patterns.context: 以技术名词、部件编号或材料性质说明发明结构、过程或功能
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明，涉及化学、检测、光学、通风、声学、热学及机械

patterns.name: 专利段落模板式衔接
patterns.trigger: “In the preferred embodiment”及“there have been known image processing methods”
patterns.context: 从权利要求或技术说明转入实施例，或引入已知技术；片段常处于句子、段落边界

patterns.name: 专利号、文献号与编号格式
patterns.context: 引用专利公开号、美国专利号，或为技术部件附加数字字母标号
patterns.domain: 专利引证和技术部件标注

patterns.name: 主题突变的局部片段
patterns.trigger: “A credit payment means”与“skin colors of persons”
patterns.context: 分别出现在热接触/能耗讨论后的新主题，以及图像处理背景中；未显出共同的专利引证或缺点触发规律
patterns.domain: 支付技术、图像处理专利文本

en.description: Primarily covers various internal subword fragments in Estonian parliamentary text; scattered trigger words also occur in English technical Q&A and patents, with no consistent meaning or syntactic condition evident.

patterns.name: Estonian morphological fragments
patterns.context: Trigger points are dispersed within Estonian words, with no clear fixed meaning or syntactic position, reflecting subword-level tokenization

patterns.name: Local words in English technical phrases
patterns.context: Scattered throughout English technical Q&A or patent text, with no shared, clearly identifiable term or fixed collocation

11_1207.concept: 语言与子词片段混合触发
11_1207.description: 主要覆盖爱沙尼亚语议会文本中的多种词内子词片段；另有英语技术问答与专利中的零散触发词，未见一致词义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语形态切分片段
patterns.context: 触发点分散在爱沙尼亚语词内部；没有明显固定词义或句法位置，呈现子词级切分

patterns.name: 英语技术词组中的局部词语
patterns.context: 散布于英语技术问答或专利文本；没有共同的明确词项或固定搭配

en.description: The most stable signal is strong activation on Estonian «mille» in parliamentary text; other sporadic activations occur on parliamentary names, citations and requests for help in technical Q&A, patent citation cues, and expressions of accepting an explanation.

patterns.name: Estonian word ending «mille»
patterns.context: «mille» appears in Estonian sentences, followed by or linked to subordinate-clause content; it is the most prominent activation site across multiple passages.

patterns.name: Introductions of names in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: A member’s name appears at the start of a sentence or after a line break, followed by an introduction to their speech, report, or identity; activation concentrates around the title and name.

patterns.name: Quoted links in technical help requests
patterns.context: When explaining a solution in technical Q&A, “see here and there” points to examples or links; activation concentrates on the demonstrative phrase.

patterns.name: Polite requests in technical help requests
patterns.context: After describing an error, the writer asks for assistance with “if anyone could help”; activation concentrates on the conditional phrase and request for help.

patterns.name: Example cues in patent text
patterns.context: When explaining technical background or material properties, “see, for example” introduces a citation or example.

patterns.name: Citation markers in patent text
patterns.context: Introduces an article in a technical description, followed by its title, authors, or journal information.
patterns.domain: USPTO; patent backgrounds and technical citations

patterns.name: An explanation being accepted as reasonable
patterns.context: A speaker comments on an explanation, indicating that it is convincing or that they accept it.

11_1207.concept: 局部关系与话语衔接标记
11_1207.description: 最稳定的线索是爱沙尼亚语议会文本中「mille」处的强激活；其余零散激活分别落在议会人名、技术问答的引例与求助、专利引文提示及认可解释的表达上。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词尾「mille」
patterns.context: mille 出现在爱沙尼亚语句子中，后接或关联从句内容；在多段中是最突出的激活位置。

patterns.name: 议会发言中的人名介绍
patterns.context: 句首或换行后出现议员姓名，并接续对其发言、报告或身份的介绍；激活集中在称谓及人名附近。

patterns.name: 技术求助中的引用链接
patterns.context: 技术问答说明解决方案时，以 see here and there 指向示例或链接；激活集中在指示性短语。

patterns.name: 技术求助中的礼貌请求
patterns.context: 描述错误后，以 if anyone could help 请求他人协助；激活集中在条件词和求助表达。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的举例提示
patterns.context: 说明技术背景或材料特性时，用 see, for example 引出文献或实例。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的引文标记
patterns.context: 在技术说明中引入一篇文章，并接文献题名、作者或期刊信息。

patterns.name: 解释被认可为有道理
patterns.trigger: «good»2« explanation»4« and»5« makes»3« sense»3« to»6« me»3
patterns.context: 说话者评述某种解释，表示其令人信服或自己接受了该解释。

en.concept: spatial relation words and local terms
en.description: High activation often falls on spatial relation words in patent text (adjacent, proximate, opposite, distal, end); other triggers include reference indicators and scattered words or name fragments. The triggers are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Morphological adjacency
patterns.context: Describes spatial relations between two regions, ends, or components, especially in patent technical text; in [1], “end” occurs in what appears to be Finnish text, so the semantic relation is uncertain.

patterns.name: Deictic words in references
patterns.context: Refers to other documents, locations, or previously mentioned patent citations; the trigger may relate to reference or citation structure, but examples are limited.

patterns.name: Specific word fragment
patterns.context: Within a name in an ArXiv author list; no shared contextual condition can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a technical term
patterns.context: In a technical description of related filter bandwidth; this is a single instance and may simply be triggered by the term itself.

patterns.name: Other patent word fragments
patterns.context: In a patent description of varactor units and electrode structures; the highly activated words do not clearly share a trigger form with fragments in other examples.

11_1207.concept: 空间关系词及局部词项
11_1207.description: 高激活多落在专利文本中的空间关系词（adjacent、proximate、opposite、distal、end），另有引用指示词及零散词项、人名片段；触发并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 形态相邻处
patterns.context: 在描述两个区域、端部或部件之间的空间关系时，尤其是专利技术文本；[1]的 “end” 出现在疑似芬兰语文本中，不能确定语义关系。

patterns.name: 引用中的指示词
patterns.context: 提及其他文档、位置或前述专利引用时；触发点似乎可能与指代或引用结构有关，但实例有限。

patterns.name: 特定单词片段
patterns.context: ArXiv 作者名单中的人名内部；未见可确认的共同上下文条件。

patterns.name: 技术术语内部片段
patterns.context: 相关滤波器带宽的技术描述中；这是单个实例，可能只是词项本身触发。

patterns.name: 其他专利词项片段
patterns.context: varactor 单元与电极结构的专利描述中；与其他片段中的高激活词没有明确共享触发形式。

en.description: Activations occur in Nordic names and Finnish and Estonian text, as well as programming Q&A and patent technical descriptions; multiple word fragments are marked within each text type, but topics and triggers are not consistent.

patterns.name: Finnish and Baltic-language text
patterns.context: Continuous non-English sentences; marking covers many segmented word fragments.
patterns.domain: European Parliament corpus, Finnish and Estonian

patterns.name: Nordic names and name fragments
patterns.context: Names of Nordic scholars or historical figures, including diacritics or uncommon spellings.

patterns.name: Software development and database Q&A
patterns.context: Discusses programming, data storage, database configuration, or troubleshooting; common technical terms and segmented word fragments are both marked.

patterns.name: Specialized terms in patent technical descriptions
patterns.context: Objective descriptions of signal processing or coating processes, containing technical nouns and property descriptors.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds and technical text

11_1207.description: 激活出现在北欧姓名及芬兰语、爱沙尼亚语文本，也出现在编程问答和专利技术说明；各类文本内部有多个词片被标记，但主题和触发词并不统一。

patterns.name: 芬兰语及波罗的海语言文本
patterns.context: 连续的非英语句子；标记覆盖大量被拆分的词片。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会语料，芬兰语与爱沙尼亚语

patterns.name: 北欧人名与姓名片段
patterns.context: 北欧学者或历史人物姓名，包含变音符号或不常见拼写。
patterns.domain: 学术作者列表、百科人物简介

patterns.name: 软件开发与数据库问答
patterns.context: 讨论编程、数据存储、数据库配置或解决问题；常见技术词及拆分的词片均有标记。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 HackerNews 技术讨论

patterns.name: 专利技术说明中的专门术语
patterns.context: 以客观说明口吻描述信号处理或涂层工艺，包含技术名词和性质描述词。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与技术文本

en.concept: Mixed detection of citation markers and Estonian text
en.description: Activations mainly fall into two categories: references and citation statements in patent technical backgrounds, and Estonian parliamentary text. One StackExchange API Q&A passage also appears, showing a distinct Q&A and operational-guidance pattern.

patterns.name: Patent technical backgrounds and citations
patterns.context: References, patent numbers, or literature citations appear after technical explanations; often accompanied by periods, commas, and abbreviations.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds involving oxidation, interfaces, chemical reactions, thin films, Bayesian networks, and magnetic storage; covers passages 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.

patterns.name: Estonian parliamentary text
patterns.context: Coherent Estonian word forms and sentence fragments, with punctuation such as commas and periods; no visible English patent-citation pattern.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Estonian parliamentary speeches; covers passages 2, 8, 10.

patterns.name: English Q&A and API guidance
patterns.context: In a Q&A format, the answer advises how to create or use an API and points to a webpage link.

11_1207.concept: 引证标记与爱沙尼亚语文本的混合检测
11_1207.description: 激活样本主要分成两类：专利技术背景中的参考文献与引证语句，以及爱沙尼亚语议会文本；另有一段 StackExchange API 问答，呈现独立的问答和操作指引模式。

patterns.name: 专利技术背景与引证
patterns.context: 技术说明之后出现参考文献、专利号或文献引证；常伴随句号、逗号及缩写。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，涉及氧化、接口、化学反应、薄膜、贝叶斯网络和磁存储；覆盖段 1、3、4、5、6、7。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语议会文本
patterns.context: 连贯的爱沙尼亚语词形与句子片段，出现逗号、句号等标点；没有可见英文专利引证模式。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语议会发言；覆盖段 2、8、10。

patterns.name: 英语问答及 API 指引
patterns.context: 问答格式中，回答给出如何创建或使用 API 的建议，并引向网页链接。

en.description: The main phenomenon is broad responses to subword fragments in segmented multilingual words, especially in Estonian, Slovenian, and Finnish parliamentary text; there are also sporadic word activations in English forum sentences, author names, and two types of patent technical text. There is no specific word meaning or syntactic trigger that is stable across passages.

patterns.name: Estonian word forms and endings
patterns.context: Subword fragments within words in continuous Estonian text, especially endings and inflections; they occur in sentences rather than standalone titles.

patterns.name: Slovenian word forms and endings
patterns.context: Words in Slovenian are split into subwords, with activation scattered across stems, inflectional endings, and grammatical forms; there is no single fixed lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Finnish words
patterns.context: Longer words in continuous Finnish text are split into multiple subword fragments, including stems, derivational/inflectional forms, and internal components, with no consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word forms with diacritics in Central and Eastern European languages
patterns.context: Slavic words with diacritics are split into subwords; the examples are sporadic fragments and do not establish a specific ending or grammatical function.

patterns.name: Ordinary English words and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic full words or initial/in-word fragments in English sentences, with no stable syntactic position or shared meaning; activation is concentrated in a forum question seeking to implement a feature.

patterns.name: Name and author-affiliation fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in an author list, with activation on subword fragments of names and punctuation in initials.

patterns.name: Ordinary English and noun phrases in patent descriptions
patterns.context: Sentences in patent background/description text involving rotation, alignment, components, or the purpose of an invention; activation is distributed over ordinary words and cannot be identified as specific to technical terms.

patterns.name: Signal-processing terms and narrowband descriptions
patterns.context: A technical passage about digital systems analyzing signals, related filters, and bandwidth; activation covers both terminology and general descriptive words.

11_1207.description: 主要现象是多语种词被切分后对子词片段的广泛响应，尤其见于爱沙尼亚语、斯洛文尼亚语和芬兰语议会文本；另有英语论坛句、作者姓名，以及两类专利技术文本中的零散词语激活。没有跨段稳定的特定词义或句法触发点。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词形与词尾
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语连续文本中的词内子词片段，尤其是词尾和屈折变化；出现在句中而非单独标题。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，爱沙尼亚语政治/议会文本

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词形与词尾
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语中词语被拆分为子词，激活散布在词干、屈折词尾及语法词形中；没有固定的单一词汇触发点。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内子词片段
patterns.trigger: 如« kõ»«ige»« su»«ure»«m»、« m»«ure»« sell»«es»、« ed»«as»«im»«ine»«k»«uid»、« nä»«in»«ud»
patterns.context: 芬兰语连续文本中，较长词被拆成多个子词片段；包括词干、派生/屈折形式及词内成分，没有一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 带变音符号的中东欧语词形
patterns.context: 带变音符号的斯拉夫语词语被切分为子词；现有例子是零散片段，不能据此确认特定词尾或语法功能。

patterns.name: 英语句中普通词与词内片段
patterns.trigger: « in»、« that»、« allows»、« changing»、« hoping»、« accomplish»
patterns.context: 英语句子中零散的完整词或词首/词内片段，没有稳定的句法位置或共同语义；激活集中在一段寻求实现某项功能的论坛提问中。

patterns.name: 人名及作者署名片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者名单中，激活落在姓名的子词片段及姓名缩写标点上。

patterns.name: 专利说明中的普通英语及名词短语
patterns.context: 专利背景/说明文字中，涉及旋转、对齐、部件或发明目的的句子；激活分布在普通词上，不能认定为特定技术术语专属。

patterns.name: 信号处理术语与窄带描述
patterns.trigger: « frequencies»、« digital»、« series»、« correlation»、« narrow»、« bandwidth»
patterns.context: 讲述数字系统分析信号、相关滤波器及带宽的技术段落；激活覆盖术语和一般描述词。
patterns.domain: USPTO Backgrounds，信号处理专利文本

en.description: Activations are distributed mainly across Estonian and a few Slovenian subwords in multilingual European parliamentary text. They also appear in German parliamentary forms of address, two patent technical descriptions, and an English forum expression of wishes; apart from multilingual text fragments, there is no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Estonian word forms and text fragments
patterns.context: Across varied sentence structures and topics, activations are scattered across consecutive Estonian tokens; they do not respond only to a particular word or topic

patterns.name: Estonian report/meeting expressions
patterns.context: Slovenian subword fragments in report- or meeting-related expressions; activations in the passage also span multiple surrounding tokens

patterns.name: Address for a parliamentary president
patterns.context: An address for a female president in a formal parliamentary speech; activations concentrate on subwords in the title

patterns.name: Description of a compensation chamber in a patent
patterns.context: Patent background text describes an evaporator, compensation chamber, and working fluid in a technical explanatory style

patterns.name: Description of a radial servo burst in a patent
patterns.context: A patent claim describes servo wedge regions and burst signals extending radially along data tracks

patterns.name: Expression of wishes in an English forum post
patterns.context: An informal first-person post explains a goal the author hopes to achieve and requests advice

11_1207.description: 激活主要分布于多语种欧洲议会文本中的爱沙尼亚语及少量斯洛文尼亚语子词，也出现在德语议会称谓、两段专利技术描述和英语论坛愿望表达中；除多语种文本片段外无统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词形与文本片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «an»、« 000»、«tööturuasutuste»、«valgust»、«hääletada» 等大量爱沙尼亚语子词片段
patterns.context: 跨多种句式和主题，神经元激活分散在连续的爱沙尼亚语 token 中；并非只对某个特定词或主题响应
patterns.domain: EuroParl 中的爱沙尼亚语议会发言

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语报告/会议用语
patterns.context: 报告或会议相关表述中的斯洛文尼亚语子词片段；该段的激活也遍及周围多个 token
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会发言

patterns.name: 议会主席称呼
patterns.context: 正式议会发言中对女性主席的称呼，激活集中在称谓的子词

patterns.name: 专利中的补偿腔室描述
patterns.context: 专利背景技术以技术说明口吻描述蒸发器、补偿腔室和工作流体

patterns.name: 专利中的径向伺服突发描述
patterns.context: 专利权利要求中描述伺服楔形区及突发信号沿数据轨道的径向延伸

patterns.name: 英语论坛中的愿望表达
patterns.context: 非正式第一人称帖子中说明希望实现的目标，并请求建议

en.description: Activations are scattered across forum interaction, example and citation cues, question corrections, code terminology, patent numbers, causal terms, Slovenian word fragments, and fragments within proper names; there is no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Quotation or example cue words
patterns.context: Introduces a citation, example, or referring content in technical explanations or forum replies; often occurs in short phrases and neighboring words.

patterns.name: Reader interaction and expressions of cognition in forum replies
patterns.context: Informal replies addressed to questioners, containing suggestions, personal judgments, or acknowledgments of uncertainty; activation may fall on these words and surrounding expressions.

patterns.name: Contrast, problem, or correction expressions in technical text
patterns.context: A technical discussion first raises a limitation, problem, or error in preceding text, then adds a contrast, explanation, or correction.

patterns.name: Local activation on code and technical identifiers
patterns.context: Code, identifiers, or technical terms occur in programming Q&A contexts; the specific trigger positions vary across examples.

patterns.name: Patent literature citation formats
patterns.context: Lists patents or related literature in a standard format in patent descriptions; activation occurs near citations.

patterns.name: Causal terminology
patterns.context: Technical background passages discussing Bayesian networks or causal relations.

patterns.name: Slovenian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Slovenian parliamentary text; activation falls on word-form fragments split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Fragments within personal or place names
patterns.context: Internal subword fragments in proper names in football match narratives, with no identifiable shared semantic condition.

11_1207.description: 激活散见于论坛互动、举例与引用提示、问题修正、代码术语、专利号、因果术语、斯洛文尼亚语词片段及专名片段；没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 引述或举例提示词
patterns.context: 在技术说明或论坛答复中引出引用、例子或回指内容；多出现在短语及其邻近词。

patterns.name: 论坛答复中的读者互动与认知表达
patterns.context: 面向提问者的非正式答复，包含建议、个人判断或承认不清楚；激活可能落在这些词及周围表达上。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的对照、问题或修正表达
patterns.context: 技术论述先提出限制、问题或前文错误，再作转折、说明或修正。

patterns.name: 代码与技术标识符的局部激活
patterns.context: 代码、标识符或技术术语处于编程问答上下文中；各例的具体触发位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 专利文献引用格式
patterns.context: 专利说明中以标准格式列举专利或相关文献；激活出现在引用附近。

patterns.name: 因果关系术语
patterns.context: 讨论贝叶斯网络或因果关系的技术背景段落。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本；激活落在被分词拆开的词形片段上。

patterns.name: 人名或地名内部片段
patterns.context: 足球比赛叙述中的专名内部子词片段，缺少可确认的统一语义条件。

en.description: High activations often fall on intra-word fragments or subwords in Slovenian, Dutch, and German parliamentary text, as well as English comments and patent text. Four English comments jointly highlight think of; other cross-language triggers are not consistent.

patterns.name: Slovenian intra-word segmentation fragments
patterns.context: Activations are marked at short word-fragment boundaries, especially letters or subword fragments within words; all three passages are Slovenian parliamentary text.

patterns.name: English fixed expression think of
patterns.context: In English sentences, think of is followed by a use, idea, or object; sentences are often first-person negatives using I can't think of, but speakers and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Dutch intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within the Dutch verb brengen, in the context of a parliamentary report conclusion and a new initiative.

patterns.name: German intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur within Abstimmung, a German parliamentary procedure term, in a formal statement about voting results.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in patent text
patterns.context: Activations are marked in a technical description in an English patent claim involving nanocolor films, electrodes, and dye molecules; the same passage also has several weaker intra-word or subword-fragment activations.

11_1207.description: 高激活多落在词内片段或子词上：斯洛文尼亚语、荷兰语、德语议会文本，以及英语评论与专利文本。四段英语评论共同突出 think of；其余跨语言触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内切分片段
patterns.context: 激活标在词语的短片段边界处，尤其是词中间的字母或子词片段；三段均为斯洛文尼亚语议会文本。

patterns.name: 英语 think of 固定表达
patterns.context: 英语句子中短语 think of 后接用途、想法或对象；句子多为第一人称否定式 I can't think of，也有不同说话者与上下文。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在荷兰语动词 brengen 的词中片段，处于议会报告结论与新倡议的上下文。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于德语议会程序词 Abstimmung 的内部，出现在表决结果的正式发言中。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活标在英文专利权利要求的技术描述中，涉及纳米色膜、电极及染料分子；同段另有多个较弱的词内或词片段激活。

en.description: Strong activations all fall on the Latin letter b, in word-initial or in-word positions in Slovenian, English, Turkish, German, and Swedish; syntactic context, topic, and style vary widely.

patterns.name: In-word b in Slovenian
patterns.context: High activation is concentrated in Slovenian, where b and following ending fragments are marked separately; occurs in different syntactic contexts.

patterns.name: Turkish b
patterns.context: b occurs at the beginning of a Turkish word, in a Turkish sentence embedded in code comments.

patterns.name: German b
patterns.context: b occurs at the beginning of a German verb in a formal parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: English b
patterns.context: The mark is on the initial letter of the English word «be»; it is followed by different text such as «ili», «presented», and «at», and appears in different registers.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, USPTO patent backgrounds, StackExchange technical text

patterns.name: Swedish b
patterns.context: b occurs at the beginning of a Swedish verb; the sentence discusses EU policy that should be promoted.

11_1207.description: 强激活均落在拉丁字母 b 上，覆盖斯洛文尼亚语、英语、土耳其语、德语和瑞典语中的词首或词内位置；句法、主题及文体差异很大。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内 b
patterns.context: 高激活集中在斯洛文尼亚语中，b 与后续词尾片段分开标记；出现于不同句法环境。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 土耳其语 b
patterns.context: b 位于土耳其语词首；上下文是代码注释中夹杂的土耳其语句子。

patterns.name: 德语 b
patterns.context: b 位于德语动词词首，出现在正式的议会发言中。

patterns.name: 英语 b
patterns.context: 标记位于英语词 «be» 的首字母；后接 «ili»、«presented»、«at» 等不同后续内容，见于不同语域。
patterns.domain: EuroParl、USPTO 专利背景、StackExchange 技术文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语 b
patterns.context: b 位于瑞典语动词词首；句子讨论应促进的欧盟政策。

en.description: The activation pattern is not consistent: parliamentary text often highlights Slovenian and German intra-word fragments and procedural expressions; patent text contains technical terms, material lists, and citation formats; forum time expressions and business-contract amounts and durations also appear.

patterns.name: Slovenian inflectional morphemes and endings
patterns.context: Consecutive morpheme segmentation in Slovenian sentences, with activations highlighting intra-word fragments such as “sektorju” and “državne pomoči”; also includes « minimal»4«n»4«im»3« pr»4«ag»2«om»5.

patterns.name: Slovenian report and parliamentary expressions
patterns.context: Adjacent to parliamentary-context terms for rapporteurs, report authors, and objectives; activations fall on Slovenian intra-word segments and inflected forms.

patterns.name: German procedural vocabulary
patterns.context: German words in parliamentary speeches concerning withdrawing a name, voting results, or voting procedures; activations concentrate within compound or inflected words.

patterns.name: German committee responses and agenda expressions
patterns.context: Formal expressions for committee responses, welcoming something, and placing an item on the agenda for a vote; highlighted fragments are distributed within German words and common words.

patterns.name: Slovenian committee and bill wording
patterns.context: Formal sentences about committee matters, legislative proposals, and bill text; activations concentrate on intra-word fragments, but no highlighted word is fully shared with other passages.

patterns.name: English causal and Bayesian network terminology
patterns.context: Technical explanation discussing causal relationships and Bayesian networks; activations are sporadic near time words, abbreviation endings, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Time expressions in a technical forum
patterns.context: Describes a temporary situation, followed by a technical discussion about collecting CPU, network, and IO utilization in the future.

patterns.name: Contract amounts, durations, and warranty clauses
patterns.context: Lists months, election periods, warranty periods, and amounts in a contract or business email; strong activations concentrate on numeric amount fragments and time units.

patterns.name: Patent measurement parameters and citation format
patterns.context: Describes impedance measurements, parameter sweeps, and frequency/temperature/bias values, followed by a U.S. patent citation format.

patterns.name: Materials and enumeration in patent claims
patterns.context: Patent claims or background passages describe electrochromic nanofilms, electrodes, semiconductor metal oxides, and dye molecules, with legal-style enumerations and citation wording.

11_1207.description: 激活模式并不统一：议会文本中常落在斯洛文尼亚语、德语词内片段及议事表达；专利文本有技术术语、材料列举和引证格式；另见论坛时间措辞与商务合同金额、期限。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语屈折词素与词尾
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语句子中的连续词素切分，激活突出词内片段，如“sektorju”“državne pomoči”；还包括« minimal»4«n»4«im»3« pr»4«ag»2«om»5。
patterns.domain: EuroParl斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语报告与议会表达
patterns.context: 与报告人员、报告起草者、目标等议会语境词语相邻；激活落在斯洛文尼亚语词内分段及屈折形式上。
patterns.domain: EuroParl斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 德语议事程序词汇
patterns.context: 议会发言中有关撤回姓名、表决结果或表决程序的德语词语；激活集中于复合或屈折词的内部片段。

patterns.name: 德语委员会答复及议程表达
patterns.trigger: « An»6tw«ort»1；Kommiss«arin»4；« be»1grüße« es»5；« auf»5« der»4« T»1«ages»2«ord»1«n»2«ung»4；« Ab»9stimmun«g»4
patterns.context: 委员会答复、欢迎某事以及议题列入议程并提交表决的正式表达；高亮片段分布在德语词内部及常见词上。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语委员会与法案措辞
patterns.trigger: Komis«ije»1；« raz»7«vo»3«jem»3« iz»4«v»1«ajan»3«ja»5；« p»8«ak»5«eta»3« bes»3«ed»1«il»3；« b»9«ili»3
patterns.context: 说明委员会相关事项、立法方案及法案文本的正式句子；激活集中在词内片段，但未见与其他段完全一致的高亮词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 英语因果与贝叶斯网络术语
patterns.context: 讨论因果关系及贝叶斯网络的技术性说明；激活零散出现在时间词、缩写末尾及标点附近。

patterns.name: 技术论坛中的时间表达
patterns.context: 描述暂时情况，并接续未来会收集CPU、网络和IO利用率等技术讨论。

patterns.name: 合同金额、期限与保修条款
patterns.context: 合同或商业邮件中列出月份、选举期限、保修期及金额；强激活集中在数字金额片段和时间单位。

patterns.name: 专利测量参数与引证格式
patterns.context: 描述阻抗测量、参数扫描及频率/温度/偏置值，随后出现美国专利引证格式。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的材料与列举
patterns.trigger: « form»4« of»3；« plurality»5；« see»6«,»9« for»2« example»6
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或背景段落描述纳米变色膜、电极、半导体金属氧化物和染料分子，包含法律式列举及引证措辞。

en.description: Primarily responds to numbers immediately next to units or specification terms: GHz, GB/RAM, vehicle displacement/horsepower/mileage, and phone battery capacity. It also responds to fragments within German and Danish political or address terms, and to “think” in a game-development context.

patterns.name: Hardware clock speed
patterns.context: A number immediately precedes GHz, describing the operating frequency of a processor or device

patterns.name: Memory capacity
patterns.context: A number occurs with GB or RAM to describe device memory

patterns.name: Engine displacement and power specifications

en.description: Activations are distributed across code resource-cleanup statements, patent and legal formats, academic affiliations and prose, mathematical notation, and garbled text; no clear commonality is apparent, though some activations may relate to tokenization boundaries and formatting markers.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols between markers

patterns.name: Specific tokenization boundaries in text

patterns.name: Tokenization of institution names and proper nouns

patterns.name: Legal citation format

patterns.name: Corrupted or garbled text

11_1207.description: 激活分布于代码资源清理语句、专利与法律格式、学术署名和正文、数学符号及乱码文本；共同点不明显，部分激活可能与分词边界和格式标记有关。

en.description: Activation is scattered across word fragments, common words, and morphological fragments in multiple languages, as well as proper names, statistics, patent numbers, medical terms, and citations; there is no single semantic trigger condition stable across corpora.

patterns.domain: European Parliament debates or formal political texts

patterns.name: English Q&A phrasing and word-boundary continuations
patterns.context: Appears in StackExchange answers that begin with an explanatory conditional clause followed by a suggestion; activation spans common words within the sentence, and the final word fragment may continue from the context.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in personal and foreign proper names
patterns.context: Appears in proper names such as Croatian or Bosnian names and band names; some markers are fragments spanning words or within words.

patterns.name: Thousands-separated numbers and statistical descriptions
patterns.context: Comma-separated large numbers and their digit fragments are marked in statistics about population, households, density, and housing units.

patterns.name: Patent numbers and citation formats

patterns.name: Medical institutions and terminology in paper methods sections

patterns.name: Biomedical protein- and nucleolus-related terminology

11_1207.description: 激活分散于多种语言的词片、常见词与形态片段，也出现在专名、统计数字、专利编号、医学术语和引文中；没有跨语料稳定的单一语义触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered: often in proper nouns beginning with or containing B (such as Bayer, Bebek, Bremen), as well as German er- verbs, the word high in an HPLC phrase, commas in legal citations, and line-break markers; these patterns do not form a unified semantic category.

patterns.name: B in institution, company, or brand names
