patterns.context: 按条目列出人物姓名及简短生平信息。

patterns.name: 蛋白质与核仁
patterns.context: 讨论蛋白质的细胞定位及其形成复合物。

patterns.name: 显微成像与细胞染色
patterns.context: 描述细胞实验中的染料转移观察、显微镜成像或抗体显色试剂。

patterns.name: 肽与商业试剂供应商
patterns.context: 说明肽的纯化方式、来源供应商及产品身份。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文材料方法

patterns.name: 实验动物饮食与药物来源
patterns.context: 交代小鼠饮食实验以及所用药物或供应商信息。

en.description: Activation is scattered across texts in multiple languages and fields. German word endings and subword fragments are especially prominent; other examples include B-initial proper names, citation markers, punctuation, numbers, and a few common word fragments. There is no single semantic or syntactic pattern covering all examples.

patterns.name: Endings or morpheme fragments within German words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments inside German words, often nominal endings, inflectional endings, or segmentation boundaries between stems and endings; it also occurs in German compounds.
patterns.domain: German parliamentary speeches and German academic institution names

patterns.name: The letter B and following proper-name fragments
patterns.context: In English or German proper names, B and the following letter string are split into multiple tokens; activation sometimes falls on B and sometimes on a later name fragment.
patterns.domain: Biomedical institutions/reagents, parliamentary texts, academic institution names

patterns.name: Local fragments near citation markers and citation numbers
patterns.context: Short-token activation occurs near reference markers, legal citations, or bibliographic formats such as page and volume numbers; activation does not consistently fall on a single punctuation mark or formatting element.

patterns.name: General in-sentence function words and word-boundary fragments
patterns.context: Several common German prepositions, articles, conjunctions, auxiliary verbs, and in-word fragments also activate, but without a stable specific syntactic environment.

patterns.name: Fragment of the ordinary English word length
patterns.context: The standalone English word “length” is marked in a sentence describing a scraping experiment; the surrounding text concerns dye transfer along a cell scratch.

patterns.name: Commas before periods and citation punctuation
patterns.context: Comma tokens occasionally activate when followed by page numbers, list items, or in-sentence clauses; they occur in different corpora and contexts, with no more specific shared condition.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary texts, paper methods, legal citations

patterns.name: Number or identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activation appears near numbers, identifiers, page numbers, or tokenized fragments of words containing numbers; the values and formats vary, with no unified semantic condition evident.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary texts, academic citations, legal documents

patterns.name: Word fragments not assignable to a stable pattern
patterns.context: Sporadic activation falls within ordinary words or proper names; the available examples are insufficient to determine the trigger condition.

11_1207.concept: 跨语种子词与格式片段
11_1207.description: 激活分散在多语种、不同领域文本中，较显眼的是德语词内的词尾/子词片段；另见 B 开头专名、引文标记、标点、数字及少量普通词片段。没有覆盖所有例子的单一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 德语词中带有的词尾或词素片段
patterns.context: 激活落在德语单词内部的子词片段上，常见于名词化词尾、屈折词尾或词干与词尾的分词边界；也出现在德语复合词中。
patterns.domain: 德语议会发言及德语学术机构名称

patterns.name: B 字母及其后续的专名片段
patterns.context: 英语或德语专名中，B 与紧随其后的字母串被分成多个 token；有时激活落在 B，有时落在名称后续片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学机构/试剂、议会文本、学术机构名称

patterns.name: 引文标记与引文编号中的局部片段
patterns.context: 参考文献标识、法律引文或页码/卷号等书目格式附近出现短 token 激活；激活位置并不固定在单一标点或格式成分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、美国判例引文

patterns.name: 一般句内功能词及词界片段
patterns.trigger: « in»、« den»、« wenn»、« werden»、« an»、« der»、« die»
patterns.context: 德语句子中若干常见介词、冠词、连词、助动词及词内片段也有激活，但没有稳定的特定句法环境。

patterns.name: 普通英文词尾 length 的片段
patterns.context: 在描述刮擦实验的句子中，单独的英语词“length”被标记；周围是关于染料沿细胞刮痕转移的实验方法。

patterns.name: 句号前的逗号及引文标点
patterns.context: 逗号后接页码、列表项或句中从句时，逗号 token 偶有激活；不同语料和语境中均出现，缺少更具体的共同条件。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、论文方法、法律引文

patterns.name: 数字或编号片段
patterns.context: 数字、编号、页码或数字所在词的分词片段附近出现激活；但数值及格式各异，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、学术引文、法律文书

patterns.name: 未能归入稳定模式的词片段
patterns.context: 零星激活落在普通词或专名内部，现有片段不足以判断其触发条件。

en.description: Most samples activate within names, places, or proper names beginning with B; other examples include “sweeps across” in a barcode description, “moved on” in a comment, fragments within German words, and several sporadic proper-name and model-number activations. These cannot be unified under one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Segmentation of B within words
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the initial-letter fragment when proper names or place names begin with B; the same fragment can appear in continuously spelled words.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal documents, academic addresses, encyclopedias, papers, and other texts

patterns.name: In-word fragment of the English verb moves
patterns.context: In a HackerNews comment describing a talk moving on to the next topic, activation falls on “moved” and the following “on.”

patterns.name: Fragments within long German words
patterns.context: When German compounds or inflected words are split into fragments, multiple in-word fragments activate; this is not the sentence-initial B pattern.

patterns.name: Sweeps in a barcode scanning description
patterns.context: When describing a laser beam sweeping across a barcode label, the verb “sweeps” and preposition “across” activate strongly.

patterns.name: Uncategorized local activations
patterns.context: These fragments involve names, institutional/disciplinary names, years, reagent names, and microscope models; the examples are insufficient to establish a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Legal, academic, encyclopedia, and medical experimental methods

11_1207.description: 多数样本在 B 开头的人名、地名或专名内部出现激活；另有条码说明中的 sweeps across、评论中的 moved on、德语词内片段，以及若干零散专名和型号激活，无法统一为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 词中子串 B 的切分
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名或地名以 B 开头时的首字母片段；同一片段可出现在连续拼写的词中。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文书、学术地址、百科、论文及其他文本

patterns.name: 英语动词 moves 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在 HackerNews 评论中，描述演讲转向下一内容时，激活落在 moved 及其后的 on。

patterns.name: 德语长词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 德语复合词或屈折词被分片呈现时，多个词内片段均激活；不是句首 B 模式。

patterns.name: 条码扫描描述中的 sweeps
patterns.context: 说明激光束横扫条码标签时，动词 sweeps 及介词 across 强激活。

patterns.name: 无法归入的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些片段分别涉及姓名、机构/学科名称、年份、试剂名与显微镜型号；现有例子不足以确认共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律、学术、百科、医学实验方法

en.description: Activations span multiple languages and styles, often falling on intra-word subwords, endings, or proper-noun fragments; punctuation and function words also appear. The corpora separately show German morphology, paper entities, patent chemical definitions, Slovenian word forms, and one English colloquial word fragment, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: German endings and agglutinative morphology segmentation
patterns.context: In continuous German prose, activations fall on internal fragments of compounds, inflected words, or participles and adjacent punctuation or function words; they are not tied to a fixed German word
patterns.domain: EuroParl German parliamentary speeches and PhilPapers German academic writing

patterns.name: Terms and entity fragments in scientific literature
patterns.context: Activations appear near terms, drug/company names, units, and their segmented word fragments in descriptions of methods or materials

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and definition text in patents
patterns.context: Patent backgrounds or claim-style definitions list chemical substituent symbols, atom names, and explanations of generic groups

patterns.name: Slovenian word-form fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Slovenian sentences, activations are distributed across words with diacritics, affixes, or subword fragments; punctuation also appears

patterns.name: Ramble word fragment in English colloquial text
patterns.context: An informal forum reply in which the first-person author admits to going somewhat off topic; activations concentrate on an internal word fragment

11_1207.concept: 跨语种词片段/子词形态
11_1207.description: 激活跨多语种与文体，常落在词内部的子词、词尾或专名片段，也见标点和功能词；各语料分别呈现德语形态、论文实体、专利化学定义、斯洛文尼亚词形及一次英语口语词片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 德语词尾与黏着形态切分
patterns.trigger: 如 «-»、« und»、«heit»、«ung»、«en»、«er» 等词素或词尾
patterns.context: 德语连续正文中，激活落在复合词、屈折词或分词的内部片段及其相邻标点、功能词；并非固定某个德语词
patterns.domain: EuroParl 德语议会发言与 PhilPapers 德语学术文字

patterns.name: 科学文献中的术语和实体片段
patterns.context: 论文方法或材料叙述中，术语、药品/公司名称、单位及其拆分词片段附近出现激活

patterns.name: 专利化学式与定义文本
patterns.context: 专利背景或权利要求式定义中，化学取代基符号、原子名称及通用基团解释并列出现

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语连续句子中，激活分布于带变音符号的词、词缀或子词片段，亦见标点
patterns.domain: EuroParl 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 英语口语中的 ramble 词片段
patterns.context: 非正式论坛回复中，第一人称承认自己说得有些跑题；激活集中于单词内部片段

en.concept: In-word fragments and formatted proper names
en.description: Activation mainly falls on German compounds and in-word subword fragments; other examples include patent disclosures and numbered citations, fragments in institutional and address proper names, and “never” in an English biography. Activation is not limited to a single meaning or domain.

patterns.name: Fragments and suffixes within German compounds
patterns.context: German words are split into multiple subwords or word fragments; highly activating fragments often occur within words, especially at word endings or compound components, surrounded by German syntax and punctuation
patterns.domain: EuroParl, PhilPapers, and other German political and academic texts

patterns.name: English patent citations and disclosure language
patterns.context: In patent background or prior-art passages, disclosure content is described and patent publication numbers/identifiers are listed; activation is distributed across multiple parts of the citation format

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names, institution names, and addresses
patterns.context: Personal names, place names, universities or department names and their addresses, often accompanied by abbreviations, postal codes, commas, and hyphens; activation does not always fall on complete words
patterns.domain: Academic addresses, legal affiliations, and proper-name texts

patterns.name: Strong negation word in an English musician biography
patterns.context: A musician's biography describes the release of works and says a planned album was never released; other activation in the passage is sporadic

11_1207.concept: 词内片段与格式化专名
11_1207.description: 激活主要落在德语复合词和词内子词片段；另见专利披露及编号引文、机构与地址专名中的片段，以及一处英文传记的 never。激活并不局限于单一语义或领域。

patterns.name: 德语复合词内部片段与后缀
patterns.context: 德语词被切分为多个子词或词片段；高激活片段常处于词内，尤其是词尾或复合词成分，周围有德语句法与标点
patterns.domain: EuroParl、PhilPapers 等德语政治、学术文本

patterns.name: 英语专利引文与披露用语
patterns.trigger: « disclosed»、« disclosures»，以及 « German»« Offen»«legung»«sschrift»、« Pat»、« Nos»、专利号中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 专利背景或现有技术段落中，描述披露内容并列举专利公开号/编号；激活分布在引文格式的多个片段

patterns.name: 专名、机构名及地址片段
patterns.trigger: « F»、« B»、« Albuquerque»，以及 « Mathemat»«ik»、« Informat»«ik»、«Univers»«ität» 等名称片段
patterns.context: 人名、地名、大学或院系名称及其地址，常伴随缩写、邮编、逗号和连字符；激活点并不总落在完整词上
patterns.domain: 学术地址、法律署名及专名文本

patterns.name: 英文音乐人传记中的强否定词
patterns.context: 音乐人传记叙述作品发布情况时，否定某个计划专辑从未发行；该段其余激活零散
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物传记

en.concept: Subwords and citation formats in domain texts
en.description: Activation is scattered across fragments within German words, patent boilerplate and numbers, case citation formats, and subword fragments in biomedical reagents or author names; it primarily appears in tokenized proper names, terminology, and formatting sequences in domain texts, with no single stable word meaning evident.

patterns.name: German word-final/inflectional fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on stems, affixes, or cross-fragment spellings within German words, often in compounds, derived words, and inflected forms; it is not limited to one fixed ending.

patterns.name: Patent specification boilerplate
patterns.context: Appears in fixed legal-technical formulations in patent backgrounds or descriptions of inventions; activation involves words such as disclosure, specification, invention, and claims.

patterns.name: Patent citations and numbers
patterns.context: Abbreviations, digits, and punctuation sequences in U.S. patent numbers, patent citations, or prior-art citations; activation is distributed across the different parts of the numbers.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds and prior-art citations

patterns.name: Legal case citation format
patterns.context: A California case citation format comprising the court name, volume and page numbers, commas, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Immunostaining reagent names
patterns.context: A methods description lists reagents or dyes used for antibody detection; activation occurs on subword fragments of brand and proper names.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central biomedical paper methods sections

patterns.name: Fragments within protein names
patterns.context: In biomedical papers, split-letter fragments of author surnames and reference markers in square brackets; this example has no clear general semantic trigger word.

11_1207.concept: 领域文本中的子词与引用格式
11_1207.description: 激活分散于德语词内部片段、专利套语与编号、判例引文格式，以及生物医学试剂或作者名的子词片段；主要呈现领域文本中被切分的专名、术语和格式序列，未见单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: 德语词尾/屈折片段
patterns.context: 激活落在德语词内部的词干、词缀或跨片段拼写上，常见于复合词、派生词及屈折形式；并非固定单一词尾。

patterns.name: 专利说明书套语
patterns.trigger: « disclosed»4；« the»8« entire»9« specification»4… incorporated… by reference；« the»9 sub…« claims»2
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景或发明说明的固定法律技术表述中，激活涉及披露、说明书、发明及权利要求等词。

patterns.name: 专利引文与编号
patterns.context: 美国专利号、专利引用或先前技术引文中的缩写、数字和标点序列；激活分布在编号各部分。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景及先前技术引文

patterns.name: 法律判例引文格式
patterns.context: 加州判例引文中，法院名称、卷页数字、逗号及换行构成的法律引用格式。

patterns.name: 免疫染色试剂名称
patterns.trigger: « unique»1 BioCare Medical chromgen (V«ul»3can Fast Red«,»1« B»9ajoran Purple»
patterns.context: 方法描述中列举抗体检测所用的试剂或染色剂名称，激活出现在品牌名及专名的子词片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文方法段

patterns.name: 蛋白名称内部片段
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中，作者姓氏被拆分的字母片段及方括号内的文献标识；此例没有明确的通用语义触发词。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

en.concept: German segmentation fragments and document formatting
en.description: Activation often falls on s/st fragments in German words and the word form “Aufgabe”; it also appears in names, citations, numbers, and patent formats. Other word fragments and cross-domain examples lack a unified pattern.

patterns.name: s within or at the beginning of words
patterns.context: Activation falls on s/S-related fragments segmented within German words, especially “s,” “st,” or near an s sound at the beginning or within a word; “g” after “Auf” also occurs.
patterns.domain: Primarily German European Parliament speeches; also philosophical texts

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names and bibliographic citations
patterns.context: Letter fragments split by the tokenizer in personal names, institutional names, citations, or identifiers; no consistent semantic context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, parliamentary documents, philosophical citations, biomedical papers, patent texts

patterns.name: Word forms related to Aufgabe
patterns.context: Stem fragments of the German noun “Aufgabe/Aufgaben,” appearing in contexts of responsibilities and current tasks, respectively.

patterns.name: Near years or numeric punctuation
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across digits and separators near numbers, page numbers, patent numbers, or document identifiers and their punctuation.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, parliamentary documents, philosophical bibliographies

patterns.name: Legal case caption format
patterns.context: A case caption line composed of attorney names, litigants, and roles; activation mainly falls on name initials and formatting punctuation.

patterns.name: Common words and citations in English patent texts
patterns.context: Patent background passages describe prior art and patent numbers; besides numeric formats, activation also covers ordinary English words.

patterns.name: Several isolated in-sentence word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across German compounds, endings, and other word fragments; no stable semantic or syntactic condition can be inferred.

11_1207.concept: 德语切分片段与文档格式
11_1207.description: 激活多落在德语词的 s/st 片段及 «Aufgabe» 词形，也出现在姓名、引文、编号和专利格式中；其余词片段与跨领域例子缺少统一规律。

patterns.name: 词内部或词首的 s
patterns.context: 激活落在德语词内部被切分的 s/S 相关片段上，特别是 «s»、«st» 或词首/词中 s 音附近；也有 «Auf» 之后的 «g»。
patterns.domain: 以德语为主的欧洲议会发言；另见哲学文本

patterns.name: 专名与文献引文中的片段
patterns.context: 人名、机构名、引文或编号中被分词器切开的字母片段；没有明显一致的语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、议会文件、哲学引文、生物医学论文、专利文本

patterns.name: Aufgabe 相关词形
patterns.context: 德语名词 «Aufgabe/Aufgaben» 的词干片段，分别出现在职责范围与当前任务的语境中。

patterns.name: 年份或数字标点附近
patterns.context: 数字、页码、专利号或文件编号及其标点附近，激活分散在数字与分隔符上。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、议会文件、哲学书目

patterns.name: 法律案件署名格式
patterns.context: 律师姓名、诉讼当事方与职务组成的案件署名行，激活主要落在姓名缩写和格式标点。

patterns.name: 英语专利文本中的常见词与引文
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中描述现有技术与专利号；除数字格式外，激活也覆盖普通英语词。

patterns.name: 句中若干孤立词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在德语复合词、词尾及其他词片段上；未显示可稳定归纳的语义或句法条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across German compounds, health and medical vocabulary, patent numbers and dates, legal affiliations, biomedical citations, and common words in an English comment; triggers vary across domains and positions.

patterns.name: German nouns and intra-word compounds
patterns.context: In German corpora, longer compounds, nouns, or nominalized expressions are split into multiple intra-word fragments; activations often fall near stems, affixes, and intra-word boundaries. Not all German words trigger them.

patterns.name: Health and medical topic words
patterns.context: Activations appear near vocabulary about health, body parts, diseases, and surgery in medical or public-health contexts; both German public-health expressions and English medical text occur.
patterns.domain: Public policy, PubMed medical text, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Patent numbers, dates, and citation formats
patterns.context: In patent documents, activations occur around numbers, U.S. patent identifiers, issue dates, and consecutive patent-number lists; they may fall on number fragments, punctuation, and formatting words.

patterns.name: Names, law firms, and place names
patterns.context: In legal document signatures or citations, activations occur when names, law-firm names, and city/state abbreviations are listed together.

patterns.name: Academic citations and biological terminology
patterns.context: In biomedical papers discussing proteins, experimental subjects, and literature citations, markers appear on citation numbers and related academic text; triggers are not limited to the terminology itself.

patterns.name: Word fragments in ordinary English prose
patterns.context: In HackerNews comments, several common words and sentence-initial words in ordinary English sentences also activate, with no clear medical, patent, or German topic condition.

11_1207.description: 激活分布于德语复合词、健康医疗词汇、专利编号日期、法律署名、生物医学引文及一段英语评论的常见词，跨领域且触发位置不一致。

patterns.name: 德语名词及词内复合结构
patterns.context: 德语语料中，较长的复合词、名词或名词化表达被拆分成多个词内片段；激活常落在词干、词缀和词内边界附近。不是所有德语词都触发。

patterns.name: 健康与医疗主题词
patterns.context: 医学或公共健康语境中，健康、身体部位、疾病及手术相关词汇附近激活；其中德语公共健康表述与英语医学文本均出现。
patterns.domain: 公共政策、PubMed 医学文本、专利背景

patterns.name: 专利编号、日期与引用格式
patterns.context: 专利文献中，编号、美国专利标识、签发日期及连续列举专利号时出现；激活可落在数字片段、标点和格式词上。

patterns.name: 人名、律师事务所与地名
patterns.context: 法律文书的署名或引注中，姓名、事务所名称及城市／州缩写成串列出时出现。

patterns.name: 学术论文引文与生物学术语
patterns.context: 生物医学论文叙述蛋白质、实验对象和文献引用时，标记出现在引文编号及相关学术文本中；触发位置并不只限于术语本身。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 英语普通叙述中的词片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 评论中，普通英语句子里的若干常见词及句首词也有激活，未呈现明确的医学、专利或德语主题条件。

en.concept: Fragments and proper names in multilingual texts
en.description: Activation is heterogeneous: across several German parliamentary and philosophical texts, fragments within German words and verb onsets are prominent; other examples are scattered across English commentary transitions, citation numbers, drug manufacturers, negation words, legal place names, and parliamentary institution identifiers.

patterns.name: Suffix/morpheme boundaries within German words
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across fragments within German compounds, inflected words, or derived words, especially at the junction between a stem and a following morpheme; multiple German word fragments are often marked in the same passage.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or restart-like verbs in parliamentary discourse
patterns.context: Initial fragments of verbs or verbal expressions stand out in long sentences, subordinate clauses, or discourse transitions in parliamentary speeches; the first passage has a similar English usage but a different context.
patterns.domain: European Parliament speeches; also HackerNews comments

patterns.name: English collocations and discourse-transition words
patterns.context: In an English comment, several common function words, connectors, and content words about the progression of a talk and criticism of its failure to provide examples are marked; no single lexical trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Bibliographic citation markers
patterns.context: Fragments within reference markers in a biomedical paper stand out; the context describes a protein, its localization, and its complex.

patterns.name: Fragments in drug names
patterns.context: A veterinary or medical methods section lists injected drugs, doses, and manufacturers; activation falls on the tokenized fragment of the manufacturer name Bayer.

patterns.name: Negation word in a musician's biography
patterns.context: A sentence says that a musician completed a recording but never released the work; strong activation falls on the negative adverb, alongside album and song information.

patterns.name: Legal citation formats and proper names
patterns.context: In attorney appearance lists and institutional addresses in legal proceedings, the initial fragment of the place name Bismarck stands out; other markers involve names, titles, and punctuation.

patterns.name: German fragments in proper names, bibliographies, and terminology
patterns.context: Philosophical bibliographies and academic discussion contain German terms, proper names, and titles; activation is distributed across internal word fragments and bibliographic information, and is difficult to distinguish completely from the German morpheme patterns in items 2, 3, and 7.

patterns.name: Fragments in political institution and agreement names
patterns.context: Political groups, representatives' names, and agreement document identifiers appear in parliamentary records; only a few internal fragments in institution names/identifiers stand out.

11_1207.description: 激活分布很杂：多段德语议会及哲学文本中，德语词内部片段和动词起始处突出；另散见于英语评论推进语、引文编号、药品厂商、否定词、法律地名和议会机构编号。

patterns.name: 德语词内后缀/词素边界
patterns.context: 激活散布于德语复合词、屈折词或派生词的内部片段，尤其是词干与后续词素的拼接处；同一段中常有多个德语词片段被标记。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、哲学文本

patterns.name: 议会语篇中的句首或重启式动词
patterns.context: 动词或动词性表达的起始片段在议会发言中的长句、从句或话语推进处突出；第1段是英语相似用法，但语境不同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会发言；另有 HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: 英语搭配与话语推进词
patterns.trigger: « After»...« hard»...« in»...« example»...« talk»...« moved»« on»...« without»...« to»（1）
patterns.context: 一段英语评论中，多处常见功能词、连接词和讨论内容的实词被标记，集中在对演讲推进及其未应用例子的批评；没有明显单一词法触发条件。

patterns.name: 文献引文标记
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中的参考文献标记内部片段突出；上下文为蛋白质及其定位、复合物的描述。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 药品名称中的片段
patterns.context: 兽医或医学方法段落列出注射药物、剂量及厂商；激活落在厂商名 Bayer 的分词片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 方法/药物描述

patterns.name: 音乐人传记中的否定词
patterns.context: 句子说音乐人虽完成录制但从未发行作品，强激活落在否定副词；周围还有专辑与歌曲信息。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科人物传记

patterns.name: 法律引文格式与专名
patterns.context: 法律诉讼的律师出庭名单和机构地址中，地名 Bismarck 的词首片段突出；其余标记涉及姓名、职衔及标点。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见书/诉讼记录

patterns.name: 专名、书目及术语中的德语片段
patterns.context: 哲学书目与学术论述中出现德语术语、专名及标题；激活分布在这些词的内部片段和书目信息，难与第2、3、7段的德语词素模式完全区分。

patterns.name: 政治机构与协议名称片段
patterns.context: 议会记录中的政治团体、代表姓名及协议文件编号；仅有少量机构名/编号内部片段突出。

en.description: Activations span corpora without a consistent pattern: German intra-word fragments, legal and patent citation formats, English comment word fragments, and biomedical citations and experimental drug/supplier contexts all trigger. The passages share no stable lexical or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments in German compounds
patterns.context: Activations fall on segmented German morphemes or intra-word fragments, often in compounds, derived words, and adjacent function words; no specific syntactic position is required

patterns.name: Legal citations and proper-noun formats
patterns.context: Appears in formal legal text formats such as litigants, lawyer titles, patent numbers, or case citations
patterns.domain: FreeLaw opinions/litigation records and USPTO patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Local word fragments in English content words and collocations
patterns.context: In English comments, activations are distributed across ordinary words, phrases, and sentence transitions, with no single clear semantic or positional condition

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and literature markers
patterns.context: Appears in abstract-style paper narratives and author-year/literature-location markers

patterns.name: Experimental-animal anesthetics and dose units
patterns.context: Around injection doses, brand names, and supplier locations for Zoletil and Rompun

11_1207.description: 激活跨语料且不统一：德语词内片段、法律及专利引文格式、英文评论词片段，以及生物医学引文和实验药剂/供应商语境均有触发。各段没有稳定共享的词义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 德语复合词中的词素片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的德语词素或词内片段上，常见于复合词、派生词及其周边功能词；无需特定句法位置
patterns.domain: EuroParl 德语政治/政策发言

patterns.name: 法律引文与专名格式
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼当事人、律师职衔、专利号或判例引文等正式法律文本格式中
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决/诉讼记录与 USPTO 专利背景

patterns.name: 英文内容词及搭配中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 在英文评论中，激活分布于普通词、短语和句子连接处，没有单一明显的词义或位置条件

patterns.name: 生物医学术语与文献标记
patterns.trigger: «CR»、«10»、«227»、«1»（引用标记拆分）；上下文含 «acidic protein»、«nucleoli»、«Xenopus»、«NPM1»
patterns.context: 出现在论文摘要式叙述和作者-年份/文献定位标记中
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 实验动物麻醉剂与剂量单位
patterns.context: 围绕 Zoletil、Rompun 的注射剂量、商品名及供应商地点

en.description: Activations occur across multiple genres, mainly involving intra-word markers, commonly in words ending in “-ization”; they also occur on content words in emails, title-boundary elements, and biomedical term fragments, with no single semantic pattern explaining them.

patterns.name: English words containing “ization”
patterns.context: The marked portions are nominal forms ending in “-ization” or “ization”; some cover the suffix, others cover different parts of the word, and tokenization varies.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research project texts; also plan notification emails

patterns.name: Important content words in emails
patterns.context: Marked tokens are content words in email bodies, referring respectively to notification content and responses to feedback; no clear shared lexical trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or phrase elements in titles
patterns.context: Elements near boundaries are marked in titles or author-affiliation text, with no consistent semantic or syntactic trigger.
patterns.domain: Philosophy paper titles and author affiliations

patterns.name: Fragments of immune-related molecule names
patterns.context: The marked portion occurs within the biomedical term “intercellular adhesion molecule”; however, the specific triggering fragment does not match the other segments.

11_1444.description: 激活分布在多种文体中，主要涉及词内标记，常见于以“-ization”结尾的词；另有邮件实词、标题边界成分及生物医学术语片段，难以用统一语义规律解释。

patterns.name: 英语词内含 “ization”
patterns.context: 被标记部分是以“-ization”或“ization”结尾的名词化词形；有的标记覆盖后缀，有的覆盖该词的其他部分，且 token 切分不一致。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研项目文本；另见计划通知邮件

patterns.name: 邮件中的重要信息词
patterns.context: 标记的是邮件正文中的实词，分别指通知内容和对意见作出反映；共同的词法触发条件不明显。

patterns.name: 标题中的专名或短语成分
patterns.context: 标题或作者单位文字中标记边界附近的成分，未呈现一致的语义或句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文标题及作者单位

patterns.name: 免疫相关分子名称片段
patterns.context: 标记落在“intercellular adhesion molecule”这一生物医学术语内部；但具体触发片段与其他段并不吻合。

en.description: Primarily responds to the intra-word suffix -ization, and also to cellular-related fragments; email notification terms, reflect in email, slash abbreviations in paper affiliations, and a toxin abbreviation each trigger once.

patterns.name: Intra-word suffix -ization
patterns.context: Activation falls on the latter part of a split word, especially nouns containing -ization; related words occur in medical abstracts or technical text.

patterns.name: cellular in cell-related words
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated within cellular or adjacent word fragments; contexts involve adhesion molecules or cell/tissue transplantation.

patterns.name: reflect in a title or body text
patterns.context: The word appears in an email, meaning that revisions reflect someone's opinion; nearby are names and comments.

patterns.name: Important message in an email
patterns.context: Activation falls on message in a formal notification context, preceded by the phrase very important.

patterns.name: Regional abbreviation in an academic title
patterns.context: A slash and an abbreviation for Riverside appear in the title's author affiliation; activation falls mainly on “/”.

patterns.name: Difficult-to-group biomedical term activation
patterns.context: Appears in the toxin abbreviation “ATX II”; there is insufficient evidence to group it with other trigger forms.

11_1444.description: 主要响应词内后缀 -ization，另对 cellular 相关片段有反应；邮件通知词、邮件中的 reflect、论文单位斜线缩写及毒液缩写也各触发一次。

patterns.name: 词内后缀 -ization
patterns.context: 激活落在拆分词的后半部分，尤其是包含 -ization 的名词；相关词出现在医学摘要或技术文本中。

patterns.name: 细胞相关词中的 cellular
patterns.context: 激活集中于 cellular 一词内部或其相邻词片段；涉及黏附分子或细胞/组织移植。

patterns.name: 标题或正文中的 reflect
patterns.context: 词语出现在邮件中，表示修改内容反映某人的意见；周围是姓名及 comments。

patterns.name: 邮件中的重要消息
patterns.context: 激活落在正式通知语境中的 message，前文称该消息 very important。

patterns.name: 学术标题中的地域缩写
patterns.context: 标题作者单位中的斜线及 Riverside 缩写；激活主要落在“/”上。

patterns.name: 难以归并的生物医学术语激活
patterns.context: 出现在毒液名称缩写“ATX II”中；没有足够证据与其他触发形式归为一类。

en.concept: Biomedical vocabulary and locally salient words
en.description: Strong activation often occurs in biomedical contexts, especially intercellular and cell, graft, and research terminology; also seen are message and reflect in corporate email, a slash in an academic institution name, and terms related to skin friction. The patterns do not form a single theme.

patterns.name: intercellular word form
patterns.context: Appears as part of a word describing molecules, messengers, or adhesion between cells; reaches strong activation in all three passages.

patterns.name: Cell- and graft-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Specific biological terms such as immunosuppression, cell migration, or grafts appear in medical text; activation spans multiple words rather than being limited to intercellular.

patterns.name: Research subjects and technical terminology
patterns.context: Specialized terms for experimental subjects and processes, such as microscopic imaging, the cell cycle, or protein processing, appear in research abstracts.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Important message in a formal notification
patterns.context: A formal email about an Enron savings plan notifies participants to read important information; message has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: reflect related to revision comments
patterns.context: An email discusses further revisions based on comments from the recipient and Tracey; reflect has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Author-affiliation separator in an academic title
patterns.context: The University of California, Riverside appears in a quantum mechanics paper title or author information; the slash has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Friction and stratum corneum adhesion
patterns.context: A study of the skin's stratum corneum discusses changes in friction and intercellular adhesion with application or over time.

patterns.name: Statements of plans and goals
patterns.context: Research plans are organized around future goals or specific research aims.

11_1444.concept: 生物医学词汇及局部显著词
11_1444.description: 强激活常见于生物医学语境，尤其是 intercellular 及细胞、移植物和研究术语；另见企业邮件中的 message、reflect，学术机构名中的斜杠，以及皮肤摩擦相关词。模式并非单一主题。

patterns.name: intercellular 词形
patterns.context: 作为词的一部分，描述细胞间的分子、信使或黏附；在三个段落中均达到强激活。

patterns.name: 细胞与移植物相关词汇
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现免疫抑制、细胞迁移或移植物等具体生物学术语；激活分布在多个词上，而非仅限于 intercellular。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 研究摘要

patterns.name: 研究对象与技术术语
patterns.context: 研究摘要中围绕显微成像、细胞周期或蛋白加工等实验对象和过程的专业词汇。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 正式通知中的重要消息
patterns.context: Enron 储蓄计划的正式邮件，通知参与者阅读重要信息；message 激活最强。

patterns.name: 修改意见相关的 reflect
patterns.context: 邮件谈到根据收件人及 Tracey 的评论作进一步修改；reflect 激活最强。

patterns.name: 学术标题中的作者单位分隔符
patterns.context: 量子力学论文标题或作者信息中的加州大学河滨分校名称；斜杠激活最强。

patterns.name: 摩擦与角质层黏附
patterns.context: 皮肤角质层研究中，讨论摩擦及细胞间黏附随应用或时间的变化。

patterns.name: 计划与目标表述
patterns.context: 研究计划以未来目标或具体研究目的组织内容。

en.description: Activations occur in the segmented spellings of proper nouns, abbreviations, and medical terms, as well as in titles, repeated organization names, emphatic wording in emails, and document metadata; no single clear shared trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Capital-letter sequences in names, titles, or terms
patterns.context: Activations occur across multiple subword fragments of proper nouns, abbreviations, or technical terms; some fragments contain digits, hyphens, or slashes. The samples alone do not establish whether the trigger is tokenization boundaries, letter combinations, or the terms themselves.

patterns.name: Boundary between lowercase words and capitalized proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations occur at boundaries between common words and proper nouns, or between words in different capitalization forms; adjacent contexts include different capitalization forms of the same word stem.

patterns.name: Repeated title-style entity names
patterns.context: An organization name is repeated as an entry name after a line break, followed by the full company name or an abbreviation explanation.

patterns.name: Emphatic wording in formal emails
patterns.context: Business emails contain revision notes or important notifications to recipients; activations cover a range of common function and content words, with no clear fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Document metadata such as title, byline, and date
patterns.context: A short title is followed by a line break, then a weekday, date, and year; another example contains an academic paper title, authors, institution, date, and abstract label.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles/document metadata, academic paper front pages

11_1444.description: 激活见于专名、缩写及医学术语的分段拼写，也见于标题、重复机构名、邮件强调措辞和文档元数据；没有单一明确的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 名称、标题或术语中的大小写字母序列
patterns.context: 激活分布在专名、缩写或技术术语的多个子词片段中；有些片段包含数字、连字符或斜杠。单凭样本无法确定是分词边界、字母组合还是术语本身起作用。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、学术标题

patterns.name: 小写词与大写专名交界
patterns.context: 在普通词、专名或大小写形式的词交界处出现激活；包含同一词根不同大小写形式的相邻语境。

patterns.name: 重复的标题式实体名称
patterns.trigger: «All»iance for Open Society International»，其后再次出现 «All»iance for Open Society International»
patterns.context: 机构名称在换行后作为条目名称重复，并接续公司全称或缩写说明。

patterns.name: 正式邮件中的强调措辞
patterns.trigger: «Further» «changes» to «reflect» yours and Tracey's comments；«very important message»
patterns.context: 商务邮件中出现修改说明或面向收件人的重要通知；激活覆盖多种常见功能词和内容词，未见明确固定短语。

patterns.name: 标题、署名与日期等文档元数据
patterns.context: 短标题后换行，接着出现星期、日期和年份；另一例为学术论文标题、作者、机构、日期及摘要标签。
patterns.domain: 网页标题/文档元数据、学术论文首页

en.description: Activation often occurs at line breaks and the beginnings of structured text, and also covers legal citations, code paths and comments, title dates, biographies and email headings, and medical abstracts; no single word meaning explains all passages.

patterns.name: Statute and case citation format
patterns.context: Volume numbers, Federal Reporter abbreviations, and page numbers, or U.S. Code-style citations appear consecutively, often followed by a line break and case title

patterns.name: Line breaks or section headings
patterns.context: High activation falls on line breaks, commonly at the boundaries of headings, dates, or content paragraphs

patterns.name: Title and date layout
patterns.context: A layout structure consisting of a title, blank line, and date

patterns.name: C/C++ header-generation comment
patterns.context: File path, header filename, and the start of a comment explaining the source of generation

patterns.name: Code path and filename expression
patterns.context: Joining the current file path with a relative path and loading a file

patterns.name: Person's name and biographical opening format
patterns.context: An entry begins with a name, followed by birth information or a biography

patterns.name: Email attachment and notification heading
patterns.context: A blank line after a short email body, followed by a notification-style heading

patterns.name: Medical paper title and case abstract
patterns.context: A line break after a research title, followed by a description of the number of cases

11_1444.concept: 结构化文本边界与格式标记
11_1444.description: 激活常出现在换行边界及结构化文本开头，也覆盖法律引文、代码路径与注释、标题日期、传记和邮件标题、医学摘要；没有单一词义能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 法条与判例引文格式
patterns.context: 卷号、联邦判例汇编缩写和页码，或美国法典式引文连续出现，常接换行及案件标题

patterns.name: 换行边界或段落标题
patterns.trigger: 换行 token «↵»，包括连续换行；其后可接标题或新段内容
patterns.context: 高激活落在换行处，常见于标题、日期或内容段落的边界

patterns.name: 标题与日期版式
patterns.trigger: “At Home in the Self”后连续换行，再接“Sunday, September 30, 2018”
patterns.context: 标题、空行及日期构成的版面结构

patterns.name: C/C++ 头文件生成注释
patterns.context: 文件路径、头文件名及说明生成来源的注释开头

patterns.name: 代码路径与文件名表达式
patterns.context: 使用当前文件路径拼接相对路径并载入文件

patterns.name: 人物姓名及传记起始格式
patterns.trigger: “Felix Götze”后换行、重复姓名并接“(; born”
patterns.context: 条目以姓名起头，随后进入出生信息或传记

patterns.name: 邮件附件与通知标题
patterns.context: 短邮件正文后空行，再出现通知类标题

patterns.name: 医学论文标题与病例摘要
patterns.trigger: “Indications for antibiotics in orthognathic surgery.”后接“One hundred forty-eight cases”
patterns.context: 研究标题后换行并开始病例数量描述

en.description: Activations favor document-layout markers formed by line breaks, blank lines, and visual separators, especially forwarded email headers, webpage link titles, and URLs; they also cover newsletter headings and PHP comment headers.

patterns.name: Title/email layout formed by line breaks and separators
patterns.context: Activations concentrate around blank lines, line breaks, and visual separators between titles and body text; they typically occur around short titles, email paragraphs, or forwarded email headers.

patterns.name: Email forwarding headers and signature format
patterns.context: An email body is followed by a signature or a standard header indicating that someone forwarded it, containing slash-separated organizational paths, date, and time; the first segment has the style of a brief email notification.

patterns.name: Web links and preceding titles
patterns.context: News or discussion links following a line break; the title is usually a short English phrase, and the link often begins with a URL containing a domain and path.

patterns.name: Dated newsletter headings and news leads
patterns.context: A newsletter heading is followed by that day's news lead, date, and topic words.

patterns.name: PHP file headers and comment blocks
patterns.context: At the start of PHP source code, a comment banner made of asterisks follows the file header and precedes engine-related code.

11_1444.description: 激活偏向换行、空行和视觉分隔构成的文档布局标记，尤见邮件转发头、网页链接标题与URL；也覆盖简报标题和PHP注释头。

patterns.name: 换行与分隔符形成的标题/邮件布局
patterns.context: 激活集中在空行、换行及标题或正文之间的视觉分隔处；通常出现在短标题、邮件段落或转发邮件头周围。
patterns.domain: 邮件、链接聚合标题、代码文件

patterns.name: 邮件转发头与署名格式
patterns.context: 邮件正文后接署名或由某人转发的标准邮件头，含斜杠分隔的组织路径、日期和时间；第1段则是简短邮件通知样式。

patterns.name: 网页链接及其前置标题
patterns.context: 换行后的新闻或讨论链接，标题通常为英文短语，链接常以URL开头并带有域名和路径。

patterns.name: 带日期的简报标题与新闻导语
patterns.trigger: «Friday»«'s»« Daily»« P»«ulse»、«What»« you»« need»« to»« know»
patterns.context: 简报标题后接当日新闻导语、日期和主题词。

patterns.name: PHP文件头与注释块
patterns.context: PHP源码开头，文件头后以星号构成注释横幅并进入引擎相关代码。

en.description: Primarily responds to structural markers in source code or documents: HTML tags and section comments, as well as repeated equals-sign or hyphen separators after headings; also occurs on addiction-related terms, JavaScript grouping-wrapper code, and acknowledgment role labels, whose triggers do not fully match.

patterns.name: HTML document structure and section-separating comments
patterns.context: Near section boundaries, navigation bars, or data-like blocks formed by tags, anchors, and comments in code documentation or webpage HTML; [1] is Java class documentation, while the other segments are mostly webpage templates.
patterns.domain: HTML, JavaDoc, and webpage source on GitHub

patterns.name: Section headings with equals-sign or underscore separators
patterns.context: A heading or section name is followed by repeated equals signs or hyphens as a separator, often with a line break; examples include section headings in body text, paper abstract headings, and document titles.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, experimental materials lists, and structured documents

patterns.name: Addiction-related terms
patterns.context: An NIH project description discusses heroin addiction, curriculum design, and medical treatment; activations concentrate on disease/topic nouns.
patterns.domain: NIH grants and medical/public health texts

patterns.name: JavaScript grouping-wrapper code
patterns.context: A JavaScript code segment concatenates HTML strings and constructs grouping wrapper elements, with nearby variable assignments, tag strings, and closing control flow.

patterns.name: Role labels in acknowledgments
patterns.context: An acknowledgment or retrospective paragraph for a personal project first expresses thanks, then lists teachers' or mentors' names with role labels.

11_1444.concept: 结构化文档与代码标记
11_1444.description: 主要响应源码或文档中的结构标记：HTML 标签与章节注释，以及标题后重复等号/横线分隔；另见成瘾主题词、JavaScript 分组包装代码和致谢职务标签，触发条件并不完全相同。

patterns.name: HTML 文档结构与章节分隔注释
patterns.trigger: [1] «<!--» «========» «CON»«STRU»«CTOR»« SUMMARY»；[2–5] «<!--» «========» «START»« OF»« CLASS»« DATA»，以及 «END»« OF»« TOP»« NAV»«BAR»、«skip»«-»«navbar»；[3] 还包括 HTML 标签和注释中的 «//»«-->»
patterns.context: 代码文档或网页 HTML 中，尤其是标签、锚点和注释构成的章节边界、导航栏或类数据区块附近；[1] 为 Java 类文档，其他段多为网页模板。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 HTML、JavaDoc 与网页源码

patterns.name: 等号下划线式章节标题
patterns.context: 标题或章节名后以重复等号或横线作分隔，常伴随换行；包括正文中的章节标题、论文摘要标题及文档标题。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、实验材料表及结构化文档

patterns.name: 成瘾主题词
patterns.context: NIH 项目描述中讨论海洛因成瘾、课程设计和医疗治疗；激活集中在疾病/主题名词上。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目与医学/公共卫生文本

patterns.name: JavaScript 分组包装代码
patterns.context: JavaScript 拼接 HTML 字符串并构造分组包装元素的代码段，附近有变量赋值、标签字符串和控制流闭合。

patterns.name: 致谢中的人名职务标签
patterns.context: 个人项目致谢或回顾段落，先表达感谢，再以职务标签列出教师或导师姓名。

en.description: Activations span email formatting, code comments and import paths, materials science, and medical/public health texts; no clear semantic theme runs across all corpora. Punctuation/formatting tokens are especially prominent in code paths and email separators.

patterns.name: Spaces and separators in email headers
patterns.context: An email body is followed by a signature, names/email addresses in the email header, and date/time fields; activations concentrate on spaces, line breaks, and punctuation and are not necessarily triggered by semantic words.
patterns.domain: Enron emails and email header formatting

patterns.name: C/C++ comments and path filenames
patterns.context: Directory/file paths or filenames separated by slashes occur in C/C++ source code comments.
patterns.domain: GitHub; C/C++ comments, header files, or source file paths

patterns.name: Go import statements and package paths
patterns.context: The package/import section of a Go file, especially quoted import paths separated by slashes and periods.

patterns.name: Time fields in email headers
patterns.context: A time-like fragment before an email quotation signature, followed by a contact and email header; the marked span is very short and may relate to email formatting rather than time semantics.

patterns.name: Nanoporous coordination polymer terminology
patterns.context: An academic abstract describing material preparation, adsorption properties, and controllable nano-/microporous structures.

patterns.name: Cross-species influenza virus reassortment terminology
patterns.context: A research description discussing avian and human influenza genes, viral reassortment, and internal genes.

patterns.name: Health behaviors and obesity risk factors
patterns.context: In a risk-factor statement, listing insufficient physical activity, unhealthy diet, and overweight/obesity.

patterns.name: Mathematical software project paths
patterns.context: A MathJax project directory-style path appears in a GitHub comment; it resembles general C/C++ file paths in form but contains a specific project name.

11_1444.description: 激活跨邮件格式、代码注释与导入路径、材料科学及医学公共卫生文本；没有贯穿所有语料的明确语义主题，代码路径和邮件分隔符中标点/格式 token 尤其突出。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的空格与分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件正文后接署名、邮件头中的姓名/邮箱及日期时间字段；激活集中于空格、换行和标点，未必由语义词触发。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及邮件头格式

patterns.name: C/C++ 注释与路径文件名
patterns.context: C/C++ 源码注释中出现以斜杠分隔的目录/文件路径或文件名。
patterns.domain: GitHub；C/C++ 注释、头文件或源文件路径

patterns.name: Go 导入语句及包路径
patterns.context: Go 文件的 package/import 区域，尤其引号包围、以斜杠和点号分隔的导入路径。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的时间字段
patterns.context: 邮件引文署名之前的时间样式片段，后续跟着联系人和邮件头；标记范围很短，可能与邮件格式而非时间语义有关。

patterns.name: 纳米孔配位聚合物术语
patterns.context: 描述材料制备、吸附性质及可控纳米/微孔结构的学术摘要。

patterns.name: 跨物种流感病毒重配术语
patterns.context: 讨论禽流感与人流感基因、病毒重配及内部基因的研究描述。

patterns.name: 健康行为与肥胖风险因素
patterns.context: 以风险因素陈述为语境，列举体力活动不足、不健康饮食和超重/肥胖。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter；公共卫生/流行病学

patterns.name: 数学软件项目路径
patterns.context: GitHub 注释中出现 MathJax 项目目录式路径；与一般 C/C++ 文件路径有形式相似性，但这里是特定项目名称。

en.description: Covers loop indices, Go imports, configuration key-value pairs, email headers, HTML metadata, hardware inventories, and LaTeX commands in code; the shared feature is structural markers, fields, and separators in structured text.

patterns.name: C/C++ loops and index access
patterns.context: Code contains loop counters, array or pointer indexing, conditional checks, and item-by-item processing; indentation and bracket structures are common.

patterns.name: Go test files and import declarations
patterns.context: The package declaration and grouped import section of Go source code.

patterns.name: Key-value pairs and Boolean fields in structured configuration
patterns.context: Comma-separated fields, numbers, or Boolean values in a mapping/configuration-like structure.
patterns.domain: Code or configuration snippets on StackExchange

patterns.name: Email headers and MIME metadata
patterns.context: In email or HTTP-style headers, field names and colons are adjacent to media-type/charset values.
patterns.domain: Text or request data on Github; Enron email headers

patterns.name: HTML document headers
patterns.context: Comments, meta tags, and attributes in the HTML head section.

patterns.name: Hardware specification inventory
patterns.context: Device categories and model/specification values listed in space-aligned columns after colons.
patterns.domain: Computer configuration inventory in Enron emails

patterns.name: LaTeX Beamer titles and overlay commands
patterns.context: In a LaTeX presentation, a frame title contains an overlay command and angle-bracket parameters.

11_1444.description: 涵盖代码中的循环索引、Go 导入、配置键值、邮件头、HTML 元数据、硬件清单及 LaTeX 命令；共同点偏向结构化文本中的标记、字段和分隔符。

patterns.name: C/C++循环与索引访问
patterns.context: 代码中出现循环计数器、数组或指针索引、条件判断及逐项处理；常见缩进和括号结构。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C/C++ 源码

patterns.name: Go 测试文件与导入声明
patterns.context: Go 源码的包声明和分组导入区。

patterns.name: 结构化配置中的键值与布尔字段
patterns.context: 以逗号分隔的字段、数值或布尔值，含类似映射/配置项的结构。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的代码或配置片段

patterns.name: 邮件头与 MIME 元数据
patterns.context: 邮件头或 HTTP 风格头部中，字段名、冒号和媒体类型/字符集值相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 中的文本或请求数据；Enron 邮件头

patterns.name: HTML 文档头部
patterns.context: HTML head 区域中的注释、meta 标签及属性。

patterns.name: 硬件规格清单
patterns.context: 冒号后以空格对齐列出的设备类别与型号/规格。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的电脑配置清单

patterns.name: LaTeX Beamer 标题与覆盖命令
patterns.context: LaTeX 演示文稿中，帧标题包含覆盖层命令和尖括号参数。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 LaTeX 示例

en.description: Activations concentrate on contrast/alternative arguments introduced by sentence-initial “Instead” (2, 4, 7, 8, 9); they also cover code operations, build paths and configuration, conversational correction suggestions, and identity-based access control discussions.

patterns.name: Prefix decrement, shifts, and pointer-update code
patterns.context: In C/C++-style code, variable names, operators, numbers, and pointer increments are interleaved, involving shifts and memory operations.

patterns.name: Build and dependency configuration paths
patterns.context: Build arguments, library directories, Maven plugin coordinates, and XML file paths in command lines or configuration files; fragments in paths and punctuation are especially prominent.
patterns.domain: Github build logs/configuration; StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Instead contrast
patterns.context: After rejecting a previous proposal or view, English discourse uses sentence-initial “Instead” to introduce an alternative explanation or approach; commas are also often activated.

patterns.name: Direct corrections or suggestions in dialogue
patterns.context: Informal suggestions, corrections, or product-positioning discussions addressed to a reader or conversation partner; some examples also contain sentence-initial Instead.

patterns.name: Identity recognition and network access control
patterns.context: Discusses the identifiability of internet users and websites' use of blacklists, whitelists, and other access controls based on that identity.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions of online identity and privacy

11_1444.description: 激活集中在句首“Instead”引出的转折/替代论述（2、4、7、8、9）；另覆盖代码运算、构建路径与配置、对话式纠错建议及身份访问控制讨论。

patterns.name: 前缀递减、位移与指针更新代码
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中，变量名、运算符、数字与指针递增交织，涉及位移和内存操作。

patterns.name: 构建与依赖配置路径
patterns.context: 命令行或配置文件中的构建参数、库目录、Maven 插件坐标及 XML 文件路径；路径和标点中的片段尤其突出。
patterns.domain: Github 构建日志/配置；StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 句首 Instead 转折
patterns.context: 英语论述在反驳前述方案或观点后，以句首“Instead”引出替代解释或做法；逗号也常有激活。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及 HackerNews 讨论

patterns.name: 对话体中的直接纠正或建议
patterns.trigger: «no»4...everyone else was wrong、«you can»4« directly»1« buy»4...、«you»2«'ll»5« probably»2« want»3
patterns.context: 面向读者或对话对象的非正式建议、纠错或产品定位讨论；部分例子同样含句首 Instead。

patterns.name: 身份识别与网络访问控制
patterns.context: 讨论互联网用户身份可识别性，以及网站据此执行黑名单、白名单等访问控制。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 关于网络身份与隐私的论述

en.concept: Features of multi-domain text and code fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across various code boundaries, identifier fragments, and English function words, and also occur in technology URLs, research aims, clinical recommendations, statistical groupings, customer-service conditions, and training promotions; no single stable semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Punctuation and code boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur at boundary positions such as commas, parentheses, line breaks, and indentation in Java, C/C++ code, or command-line snippets; some activations fall directly on these symbols.

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments and code identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur when code identifiers are split into multiple subword fragments, especially underscore-separated names and Kustomize-related word forms.

patterns.name: Scientific and technical vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in a URL pointing to Quantum Computing Stack Exchange, with activations concentrated on topic words and their subwords.
patterns.domain: Technology discussions and URLs in HackerNews

patterns.name: English conjunctions and function words
patterns.context: In conversational posts, multiple adjacent function words are activated near conditional or contrastive expressions; “than” also activates in comparative constructions.

patterns.name: Research purpose and objective statements
patterns.context: Occurs when research papers introduce their purpose, specific objectives, or questions to be answered, especially in sentences introducing a list of objectives.

patterns.name: Clinical decision-making and prevention support
patterns.context: Describes how tools support clinical decision-making, preventive care, and referral or community support for high-risk children.

patterns.name: Training service promotion and inquiries
patterns.context: Introduces optional corporate training services and ends with a request for more information or a call to action to get in touch.

patterns.name: Research or clinical recommendation phrasing
patterns.context: When discussing heart-failure risk groups, introduces dietary management guidelines from the government or professional societies as a starting point for recommendations.

patterns.name: Statistical groups and academic categories
patterns.context: Reports smoking rates and compares groups by age, school type, and other categories.

patterns.name: Certification and customer-service conditions
patterns.context: Discusses certification paths and future customer-service rules, centered on a condition like “if not certified by us.”

patterns.name: Exception handling and numeric parameters in code
patterns.context: Java code contains autogenerated exception handling, numeric writes, and function parameters; activations are distributed across code words and nearby parameters.

patterns.name: Embedded debugging and delays
patterns.context: A delay call follows a hardware debugging log, with a nearby Chinese comment explaining that it waits for data transmission to complete.

11_1444.concept: 多领域文本与代码片段特征
11_1444.description: 激活分布于多种代码边界、标识符碎片及英文功能词，也涉及科技网址、科研目的、临床建议、统计分组、客服条件和培训宣传；未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 标点及代码边界
patterns.context: 在 Java、C/C++ 代码或命令行片段中，逗号、括号、换行和缩进等边界位置出现激活；部分激活落在这些符号本身。

patterns.name: 分词碎片与代码标识符
patterns.context: 代码标识符被切分为多个子词时有激活，尤其是下划线分隔的名称及 Kustomize 相关词形。

patterns.name: 科学技术词汇
patterns.context: 出现在指向量子计算 Stack Exchange 的网址中，激活集中于主题词及其子词。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 中的科技讨论与网址

patterns.name: 英文连接与功能词
patterns.context: 在口语化帖子中，条件或转折表达附近出现多个相邻功能词激活；另有“than”等词在比较结构中激活。

patterns.name: 研究目的与目标陈述
patterns.trigger: « purpose»、« study»、« specifically»、« objectives»、« answer»、« following»
patterns.context: 研究论文介绍研究目的、具体目标或待回答问题时出现，尤其在引出目标列表的句子中。

patterns.name: 临床决策与预防支持
patterns.trigger: « inform»、« support»、« clinician»、« preventive»、« involving»、« community»
patterns.context: 描述工具如何支持临床人员决策、预防护理及对高风险儿童的转介或社区支持。

patterns.name: 培训服务宣传与询问
patterns.trigger: « more»、« Ask»、« for»、« details»、« about»、« sending»
patterns.context: 介绍企业可选培训服务，并以询问详情或联系行动号召收尾。

patterns.name: 研究或临床建议措辞
patterns.context: 讨论心衰风险人群时，引出政府或专业学会的膳食管理指南作为建议起点。

patterns.name: 统计分组与学术类别
patterns.context: 报告吸烟率，并按年龄、学校类型等群体分类比较。

patterns.name: 认证与客服条件表达
patterns.trigger: « At»、« least»、« stick»、« to»、« by»、« us»
patterns.context: 讨论认证路线及未来客服处理规则，以“如果未由我们认证”一类条件为核心。

patterns.name: 代码中的异常处理与数值参数
patterns.context: Java 代码包含自动生成的异常处理、数值写入及函数参数；激活分布在代码词和参数附近。

patterns.name: 嵌入式调试与延时
patterns.context: 硬件调试日志后接延时调用，且附近有中文注释说明等待数据发送完成。
patterns.domain: Github 嵌入式 C 代码

en.description: Patterns are sporadic: source-code identifiers and output/performance code; organizational change, question framing, collaboration needs, and sample observations in research plans; plus local triggers such as email addresses, educational advice, and job responsibilities. There is no unified, stable semantic or lexical feature.

patterns.name: Underscore-separated identifiers in code
patterns.context: Triggers occur inside identifiers separated by underscores in code, filenames, variable names, or paths; common in GitHub source code, with activation also on sporadic subword fragments.

patterns.name: Organizational change in research plans
patterns.context: Research plans or grant applications describe organizational participation, theoretical frameworks, inclusion of subjects, or research questions; the strongest activation falls on organizational.

patterns.name: Collaboration and needs list
patterns.context: An abstract describes collaboration between institutions and introduces a subsequent list of needs or conditions; activation is concentrated on expressions like following that introduce list items.

patterns.name: Introducing research questions
patterns.context: A research proposal explains that data will be used to answer subsequent questions, especially around following questions.

patterns.name: Recipient address separator in email headers
patterns.context: In email header fields and email addresses, local activation appears near colons and segmented address text; no clear connection to other patterns is apparent.

patterns.name: Samples and measurements in medical research
patterns.context: An abstract states the research sample, medical setting, and observation plan; activation is concentrated on words such as each after the sample count.

patterns.name: Output and performance parameters in code
