patterns.context: A caption describes astronomical projections and density contours, and gives scientific notation and physical units.

patterns.name: Game console comparisons and player voice
patterns.context: Compares handheld gaming technology or discusses leaked information in a colloquial, gamer-oriented style.

11_1444.description: 激活分散在代码与技术标识符、API字段、日志、软件说明、科技报道、天文图注及游戏评论中；没有贯穿所有段落的明确共同触发词或单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 软件接口与驱动代码符号
patterns.context: C/C++或内核代码中出现文件操作、proc 接口、驱动/触发器函数等标识符；激活常落在标识符内部的分词上。

patterns.name: API 地址与结构化头字段
patterns.context: JSON 或类似结构化文本中的 HTTP 响应头/地址字段，尤其是 API URL 中的服务名称片段。

patterns.name: 仓库路径与拉取请求文本
patterns.context: GitHub 项目路径及 pull request 描述、链接或标题，文本涉及菜单行为切换。

patterns.name: 安全上下文与凭据日志
patterns.context: .NET 安全初始化信息日志中出现凭据类型、目标名称及相关参数。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答或日志示例

patterns.name: 应用软件与设备驱动术语
patterns.context: 说明驱动层如何连接测量硬件与应用软件的技术性叙述。

patterns.name: 应用程序及其用途介绍
patterns.context: 面向读者介绍可下载应用、支持的平台及阅读电子书用途。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 产品说明或电子书推广文案

patterns.name: 产品问题报道与公司回应
patterns.context: 报道产品问题后引用公司声明，说明检查或处理措施。

patterns.name: 天体物理图注与量纲
patterns.context: 图注描述天文投影、密度等值线，并给出科学记数法和物理单位。

patterns.name: 游戏主机比较与玩家口吻
patterns.context: 以口语化、熟悉玩家语境的方式比较掌机技术或讨论已泄露信息。

en.concept: Proper nouns and markers in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of technical text, most prominently code identifiers, URLs, academic citations, and medical/scientific terminology; numbers, formula symbols, code keywords, and Portuguese strings also occur. The shared trigger mechanism across passages is not entirely clear.

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and camel-case code
patterns.context: Mixed-case identifiers, type names, function names, or keys occur in code, logs, or JSON configuration; activations often fall on internal identifier fragments.
patterns.domain: Software development, debugging logs, and configuration text

patterns.name: URLs and domain paths
patterns.context: URL, domain, or URL path components, including code strings and Markdown links.
patterns.domain: Code, web links, and online discussions

patterns.name: Literature citations and reference numbers
patterns.context: Academic text with bracketed citations at sentence ends or within sentences; activation may also occur on numbers near citations.

patterns.name: Medical and biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Disease, exposure, clinical trial, imaging, or research terminology in medical or biomedical discussion; some activations fall on terms or abbreviations.

patterns.name: Numbers and scientific measurement symbols in text
patterns.context: Numbers, letters, and Greek letters embedded in trial identifiers, citation numbers, formulas, or figure captions; no independent semantic trigger condition can be determined.

patterns.name: General code syntax and English keywords
patterns.context: Code keywords or ordinary English words in technical contexts; partly overlaps with identifier patterns, but the triggering role of these words themselves is uncertain.

patterns.name: Portuguese strings in code
patterns.context: String literals such as database or collection names in JavaScript examples.

11_1444.concept: 技术文本中的专名与标记
11_1444.description: 激活分布于多类技术文本：代码标识符、URL、学术引用及医学/科学术语最突出；另有数字、公式符号、代码关键字和葡萄牙语字符串。不同段的共同触发机制不完全明确。

patterns.name: 技术标识符与驼峰式代码
patterns.context: 代码、日志或 JSON 配置中出现大小写混合的标识符、类型名、函数名或键名；激活常落在标识符内部片段上。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、调试日志与配置文本

patterns.name: URL及域名路径
patterns.context: 网址、域名或 URL 路径成分；包括代码字符串和 Markdown 链接。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页链接与网络讨论

patterns.name: 文献引用与参考文献编号
patterns.context: 学术文本中句末或句中带方括号的文献标注；也可能在引用附近的数字上激活。
patterns.domain: 学术论文与医学/科学文献

patterns.name: 医学与生物医学术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学论述中出现疾病、暴露物、临床试验、成像或研究术语；部分激活落在术语或缩写上。
patterns.domain: 医学、临床研究与生物医学

patterns.name: 文中数字与科学计量符号
patterns.context: 数字、字母和希腊字母嵌在试验编号、引用编号、公式或图表说明中；无法确定其独立语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 一般代码语法与英文关键词
patterns.context: 代码关键字或普通英文词在技术语境中出现；与标识符模式部分重叠，但这些词自身的触发作用不确定。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语代码字符串
patterns.context: JavaScript 示例中的数据库名或集合名等字符串常量。

en.description: Primarily activates on government domains, path separators, and link formats in URLs; also seen are energy-agency links, C/C++ arrows and declarations, configuration fields, legal citations, and sporadic phrases and code numbers in technical Q&A, with some local triggers difficult to group.

patterns.name: government/civic URL components
patterns.context: Activation falls on government domains or components of government-site paths in URLs; URLs are often link targets and their repeated display text.
patterns.domain: Web links, government and public information

patterns.name: URL punctuation and path structure
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on separators, paths, or query-parameter positions in URLs, especially long URLs and cases where link targets and display text appear together.

patterns.name: energy and national-lab URL
patterns.context: URL fragments in links to energy flow diagrams or national laboratory news; the second passage also contains a line break and link marker.

patterns.name: C/C++ arrow and type declarations
patterns.context: Pointer member access, static functions, and type declarations in code; the arrow symbol occurs repeatedly.

patterns.name: Configuration field Location and API URL
patterns.context: The Location field and its service endpoint in JSON-style configuration.

patterns.name: Legal text citations and bill links
patterns.context: Describes a voting result and includes a state legislative bill citation link.

patterns.name: Technical advice and very large numbers
patterns.context: Advice in a Q&A about using I²C expanders to drive LEDs; activation is scattered around function words, quantities, and technical terms, with no clear single local trigger.

patterns.name: Windows security context and hostname
patterns.context: A target hostname appears among the parameters of an InitializeSecurityContext call; activation falls mainly on the hostname fragment.

patterns.name: Specific numeric spans in code
patterns.context: Numbers in square brackets are marked in a code example that initializes a security context, while most surrounding code is inactive.

patterns.name: Ordinary non-government URL
patterns.context: An energy laboratory domain in a press release link; similar to other URL patterns, but includes an institutional abbreviation.

patterns.name: Markdown links and line breaks
patterns.context: Activation is visible near link text, target URLs, and line-break markers, but intensity and exact location vary across passages.

11_1444.concept: 网址及结构化文本片段
11_1444.description: 主要对网址中的政府域名、路径分隔符及链接格式激活；另见能源机构链接、C/C++箭头与声明、配置字段、法律引用，以及技术问答中的零散词句和代码数值，部分局部触发难以归并。

patterns.name: government/civic URL components
patterns.context: 激活落在网址中政府域名或政府站点路径的组成部分；网址常为链接目标及其重复展示的链接文字。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、政府与公共信息

patterns.name: URL punctuation and path structure
patterns.context: 激活集中于网址中的分隔符、路径或查询参数位置，尤其是长网址及链接目标/显示文本并列时。

patterns.name: energy and national-lab URL
patterns.context: 能源流图或国家实验室新闻链接中的网址片段；第2段还出现换行与链接标记。

patterns.name: C/C++ 箭头与类型声明
patterns.context: 代码中的指针成员访问、静态函数和类型声明；箭头符号重复出现。

patterns.name: 配置项 Location 与 API URL
patterns.context: JSON 风格配置中的 Location 字段及其服务端点。

patterns.name: 法律文本引用及法案链接
patterns.context: 叙述投票结果，并附带州议会法案引用链接。

patterns.name: 技术建议与超大数字
patterns.context: I²C 扩展器驱动 LED 的问答建议；激活散布在功能词、数量和技术词附近，缺乏清晰的单一局部触发。

patterns.name: Windows 安全上下文与主机名
patterns.context: InitializeSecurityContext 调用参数中出现目标主机名；激活主要落在主机名片段。

patterns.name: 代码中特定数值跨度
patterns.context: 初始化安全上下文的代码示例中，方括号内数字被标记，周围代码大多未激活。

patterns.name: 非政府的普通网址
patterns.context: 新闻稿链接中的能源实验室域名；与其他网址模式相似，但包含机构缩写。

patterns.name: Markdown 链接与换行
patterns.context: 链接文本、目标网址及换行标记附近可见激活，但各段强度和具体位置不一致。

en.description: Most samples concern technology and computing, including code/API, devices, and software descriptions, alongside medical risk-factor lists and Q&A advice. Activation locations are nonspecific and include body words, identifiers, proper nouns, numbers, and punctuation; the annotation syntax itself may create an apparent commonality.

patterns.name: Explicit highlighting or markup syntax
patterns.context: The context consists of token-by-token annotations. Trigger locations are not limited to words: ordinary prose, code, punctuation, and numbers may all be marked. This may be an artifact of the data display format.
patterns.domain: Annotation format across all corpus excerpts

patterns.name: Electronics, software, and programming topics
patterns.context: Involves applications, computer hardware, embedded devices, interfaces, or code implementation; some examples are tutorial or Q&A prose, others are program code.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, programming Q&A, encyclopedias, and tutorials

patterns.name: APIs, code identifiers, and program syntax
patterns.context: Function names, types, parameters, member access, or identifiers occur in code or API contexts; code identifiers may also be split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Operating advice for specific devices or peripherals
patterns.context: Q&A about using an expander to drive LEDs, finding example code, or connecting Raspberry Pi peripherals.

patterns.name: Instructional language and step-by-step tutorials
patterns.context: Presented as steps, recommendations, or reader-oriented instructions, including software setup and suggestions to consult documentation or obtain a name.

patterns.name: Risk-factor lists for specific diseases
patterns.context: Medical discussion of CTS enumerates possible associated risk factors in a noun-list construction; this is unrelated to the other technical topics.

patterns.name: Proper nouns, paths, and web references
patterns.context: URLs, software/platform names, place names, or hardware proper nouns occur in prose or around code; sometimes adjacent to links and version information.
patterns.domain: Web pages, GitHub, encyclopedias, and documentation

patterns.name: Numbers in identifiers, addresses, or version numbers
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in code parameters, web links, historical years, or hardware quantities; their semantics vary.
patterns.domain: Code, web references, historical narrative, and hardware documentation

11_1444.description: 样本多为技术与计算机相关内容，涵盖代码/API、设备和软件说明，也有医学风险因素列表及问答建议。激活落点不专一，包含正文词、标识符、专名、数字与标点；标注语法本身可能造成表面共性。

patterns.name: 显式高亮或标记语法
patterns.trigger: «token»k 这种带尖括号的激活标记；片段内部也出现「« [»」「«29»」「«:»」等被标记的标点或数字
patterns.context: 上下文由逐 token 标注构成，触发位置并不局限于词语，普通正文、代码、标点和数字都可能被标记；这可能是数据展示格式造成的伪模式。
patterns.domain: 全部语料片段的标注格式

patterns.name: 电子设备、软件与编程主题
patterns.context: 涉及应用程序、计算机硬件、嵌入式设备、接口或代码实现；有些例子是教程或问答正文，有些是程序代码。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、编程问答、百科与教程

patterns.name: API、代码标识符和程序语法
patterns.context: 代码或 API 语境中出现函数名、类型、参数、成员访问或标识符；代码标识符内部也可能被切分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 特定器件或外设的操作建议
patterns.trigger: 「I²C port expander」「sample code」「raspberry pi」「16 LEDS per chip」「8 chips」「multiplexing」
patterns.context: 问答中讨论用扩展器驱动 LED、查找示例代码或连接树莓派外设。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 硬件/电子制作问答

patterns.name: 操作说明和分步教程措辞
patterns.trigger: 「Step 1: Setting Up the Software」「latest version」「easier to program」「First get the name」
patterns.context: 以步骤、建议或面向读者的操作指引呈现；包括软件设置以及先查阅文档、获取名称等建议。

patterns.name: 特定疾病的风险因素罗列
patterns.trigger: 「advanced age」「repetitive use of hand and wrist」「obesity」「pregnancy」「diabetes mellitus」等
patterns.context: CTS 的医学论述中枚举可能相关的风险因素，句式为名词性列表；不属于其他技术主题。

patterns.name: 专名、路径及网页引用
patterns.context: 正文或代码周围出现 URL、软件/平台名、地名或硬件专名；有时与链接和版本信息相邻。

patterns.name: 标识符中的数字、地址或版本数字
patterns.context: 数字嵌在代码参数、网页链接、历史年份或硬件数量中；所处语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页引用、历史叙述与硬件说明

en.concept: Local patterns in literature search and technical explanations
en.description: Strong activation often occurs in literature searches, methods headings, and research descriptions, and also in expressions with no; other examples include device tutorials, GIS promotion, .NET credential code, register mappings, and clinical outcome comparisons, which do not fit a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Literature search in systematic reviews
patterns.context: Describes searching for relevant studies, screening literature, or querying databases in research methods or abstracts; usually appears near “Methods”.

patterns.name: no in statements of negation and low requirements
patterns.context: Phrases such as “requires no other software” or “little or no equipment”, where no precedes required resources; the contexts are in different fields.
patterns.domain: GIS product descriptions, fitness promotional copy

patterns.name: Section headings and methods structure
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a section heading, numbered step, or structured explanation, alongside separators, line breaks, or colons.
patterns.domain: Medical paper methods sections, technical tutorials

patterns.name: Human participants and study procedures
patterns.context: Descriptions of study conduct, including ethics approval, participant consent, and interviews with participants.

patterns.name: Technical connections and programming instructions
patterns.context: Explains connecting IoT devices to a computer for programming and describes interfaces and required modules.

patterns.name: Promotion of standalone software that requires no installation
patterns.context: Emphasizes that a product works independently, requires no other software, and is intended for landowners or resource professionals.

patterns.name: C# security credential initialization code
patterns.context: Calls to initialize a security context in code or debug output, including credential types and a target hostname.

patterns.name: Code variables and register mapping
patterns.context: Register names and underscore-containing fields are mapped with arrows in compact C-style expressions or code-generation output.

patterns.name: Diagnostic and statistical comparisons in clinical papers
patterns.context: Medical abstracts or papers discuss disease presentation, symptom measurement, and differences in clinical assessment; may not involve literature searches.

11_1444.concept: 文献检索与技术说明中的局部模式
11_1444.description: 强激活多出现在文献检索、方法标题及研究描述，也见于 no 表述；另有设备教程、GIS宣传、.NET凭据代码、寄存器映射和临床结果比较，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 系统综述中的文献检索
patterns.context: 在研究方法或摘要中描述检索相关研究、筛选文献或数据库查询；通常出现在“Methods”附近。

patterns.name: 否定及低需求表述中的 no
patterns.context: “requires no other software”或“little or no equipment”一类表达，no 后接所需资源；上下文领域不同。
patterns.domain: GIS产品介绍、健身宣传文案

patterns.name: 分段标题与方法结构
patterns.context: 出现在章节标题、步骤编号或结构化说明的段落开头，伴随分隔线、换行或冒号。
patterns.domain: 医学论文方法部分、技术教程

patterns.name: 人类参与者及研究程序
patterns.context: 伦理审批、受试者同意、参与者接受访谈等研究执行描述。
patterns.domain: 医学及人类受试者研究

patterns.name: 技术连接与编程说明
patterns.context: 介绍把IoT设备连接到电脑以进行编程，并说明接口及所需模块。

patterns.name: 软件产品免安装或独立运行宣传
patterns.context: 强调产品可独立使用、无需其他软件，并面向土地所有者或资源专业人士。

patterns.name: C#安全凭据初始化代码
patterns.context: 代码或调试输出中调用安全上下文初始化，并包含凭据类型与目标主机名。

patterns.name: 代码变量与寄存器映射
patterns.context: 紧凑的C风格表达式或代码生成输出中，以箭头映射寄存器名和带下划线的字段。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库、低层硬件代码

patterns.name: 临床论文中的诊断与统计比较
patterns.context: 医学摘要或论文讨论疾病表现、症状测量及临床评估差异；未必涉及文献检索。

en.concept: Descriptions of processes and resource requirements
en.description: Common in research methods describing literature searches, data collection, and examination procedures; also occurs in technical text, especially descriptions of resource needs, hardware/software configurations, and solution capabilities. Cross-domain commonality is unclear.

patterns.name: Literature searches in systematic reviews
patterns.context: Describes searching literature, databases, or related publications in the methods section of a medical abstract or systematic review; the key trigger is “literature search,” strongly activated in both passages.

patterns.name: Standardized procedural descriptions in medical methods
patterns.context: Details procedures such as patient history, physical examination, interviews, or data collection in a methods section; a literature search need not be mentioned.

patterns.name: Negation and degree expressions
patterns.context: Describes required or unnecessary resources such as software, hardware, or infrastructure; activations fall on negation words or terms indicating degree of need.

patterns.name: Technical solutions and device capabilities
patterns.context: Introduces the purpose, configuration, and capabilities of software, imaging devices, computers, or modules; different texts involve GIS, HIFU, Qubes, and IoT.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, project abstracts, online discussions

11_1444.description: 常见于研究方法中描述文献检索、数据收集及检查流程；也见于技术文本，尤其资源需求、软硬件配置与方案能力说明。跨领域共同规律不够明确。

patterns.name: 系统综述中的文献检索
patterns.context: 在医学摘要或系统综述方法部分，描述检索文献、数据库或相关出版物；关键触发是“literature search”，且该短语在两段中强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、循证医学综述

patterns.name: 医学方法部分的规范化流程叙述
patterns.context: 研究方法部分中，交代患者病史、体格检查、访谈或数据收集等具体流程；不要求出现文献检索。

patterns.name: 否定词及程度表达
patterns.context: 描述所需或不需要的软件、硬件、基础设施等资源；激活落在否定词之后或需求程度词上。
patterns.domain: 产品说明、技术讨论、教程

patterns.name: 技术方案与设备能力描述
patterns.context: 介绍软件、成像设备、计算机或模块的用途、配置与能力；不同文本中涉及 GIS、HIFU、Qubes、IoT。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、项目摘要、网络讨论

en.concept: English lexical and local syntactic fragments
en.description: Strong activation is scattered across genres and topics, often falling on the English function word to and following verb structures; there are also a few lexical triggers such as carefully, extensive, literature, no, and hyphens in compound words.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: to is followed by a base-form verb or verbal phrase, often in structures such as “need/require ... to ...”; the second passage has “to follow”, and the fourth has “correlated to”, which is a prepositional use.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English narrative and expository writing

patterns.name: Medical history and examination process
patterns.context: Describes patient history-taking and physical examination; carefully precedes a passive predicate.

patterns.name: Comparison of clinical assessment methods
patterns.context: The hyphen and internal word fragment in “clinician-ascertained” are marked in a context comparing it with self-report questionnaires.

patterns.name: Technical performance and low cost
patterns.context: The hyphen and cost fragment in the compound adjective “low-cost” are marked; it modifies PCs.

patterns.name: Professional expertise requirements
patterns.context: Emphasizes the expertise and experience required to design and install systems.

patterns.name: Literature search
patterns.context: The research-methods phrase “undertook a literature search”.

patterns.name: Negative determiner
patterns.context: no negates the required software in “requires no other software”.

patterns.name: Low-spec compound
patterns.context: The hyphen and spec fragment in “low-spec'd phone” are marked, referring to a low-spec phone.

patterns.name: Word fragment in a verbal to-construction
patterns.context: In instructions on using an app-store application, to introduces a use phrase.

11_1444.concept: 英语词法与局部句法片段
11_1444.description: 强激活分散在多种文体与主题中，常落在英语功能词 to 及其后续动词结构；另有少数词汇性触发，如 carefully、extensive、literature、no，以及复合词中的连字符。

patterns.name: 不定式标记to
patterns.context: to 后接动词原形或动词性短语，常处于“need/require ... to ...”等结构中；第2段为“to follow”，第4段为“correlated to”，后者是介词用法。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语叙述与说明文

patterns.name: 医学史与检查流程
patterns.context: 描述患者病史收集及体格检查；carefully 位于被动谓语之前。

patterns.name: 临床评估方式对比
patterns.context: “clinician-ascertained”中的连字符及词内部片段被标记，处于与自报问卷对比的语境。

patterns.name: 技术性能与低成本
patterns.context: 复合形容词“low-cost”中连字符与 cost 片段被标记，修饰 PCs。

patterns.name: 专业知识要求
patterns.context: 强调设计和安装系统所需的专业知识与经验。

patterns.name: 文献检索
patterns.context: “undertook a literature search”这一研究方法表述。

patterns.name: 否定限定词
patterns.context: “requires no other software”中 no 否定所需软件。

patterns.name: 低规格复合词
patterns.context: “low-spec'd phone”中连字符及 spec 片段被标记，指低规格手机。

patterns.name: 动词性 to 结构中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 应用商店应用使用方式的说明中，to 引出 use 短语。

en.description: Activations are scattered across cautious review in professional texts, comprehensive materials, degree and quantity expressions, age groups, electronics Q&A, and local segmentation of technical terms; there is no single clear semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Thorough review and careful handling
patterns.context: Describes collecting medical history, conducting an examination, or reviewing evidence, records, and case facts; often occurs in procedural narratives.

patterns.name: Detailed, comprehensive descriptions or materials
patterns.context: When introducing guidelines, materials, products, or writing, emphasizes broad coverage, full functionality, or abundant information.
patterns.domain: Product marketing, online discussions, nutrition papers

patterns.name: Increase in degree or quantity; higher levels
patterns.context: Compares levels, describes quantities, or emphasizes exceeding a threshold; the specific meaning varies by context.
patterns.domain: Medical research, history of technology, legal argument

patterns.name: Age groups and developmental stages
patterns.context: Organizes information by age group, followed by discussion of growth charts and child health checks.

patterns.name: Device parameters, noise, and power supply discussion
patterns.context: Q&A about a microphone amplifier circuit, noting omitted power-supply information and discussing noise effects.

patterns.name: Local word forms or tokenization in technical terms
patterns.context: Technical terms are split at token boundaries; fragments concern GIS software, forensic medicine, clinical assessment, and fax technology, with no shared semantic condition evident.

11_1444.description: 激活分散于专业文本中的审慎审查、全面资料、程度数量表达，以及年龄分组、电子电路问答和专业词的局部切分；没有单一清晰的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 彻底审查与审慎处理
patterns.trigger: « carefully»10« taken»；« thoroughly»9« reviewed»；« after»6« reviewing»7« the»8« medical»10« evidence»
patterns.context: 描述收集病史、体检或审阅证据、记录和案情；常出现在程序性叙述中。

patterns.name: 详尽、全面的说明或资料
patterns.trigger: « comprehensive»；« extensive»9« scientific»8« data»；« fully»5« functional»
patterns.context: 介绍指南、资料、产品或写作内容时，强调覆盖充分、功能完整或资料丰富。
patterns.domain: 产品宣传、网络讨论、营养学论文

patterns.name: 程度或数量的增加、较高水平
patterns.trigger: « higher»1« frequency and severity»；« millions»；« more» than« sufficiently»
patterns.context: 比较水平、描述数量或强调超过某阈值；具体含义随语境变化。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、技术史、法律论证

patterns.name: 年龄分组与成长阶段
patterns.trigger: « Birth»«-»«35 years»；« 6-12 years, 13-18 years»；« Growing up»
patterns.context: 按年龄段组织信息，随后谈生长曲线及儿童健康检查。

patterns.name: 器件参数、噪声及电源讨论
patterns.trigger: « The bias resistor»；« noise»；« power supply»；« You»4« haven»5«'t»10« mentioned»
patterns.context: 针对麦克风放大电路的问答，指出遗漏的电源信息并讨论噪声影响。

patterns.name: 专业术语中的局部词形或断词
patterns.context: 专业词汇在 token 边界被切分；片段主题分别是 GIS 软件、司法医学、临床评估和传真技术，未见共同语义条件。

en.description: Activations involve healthcare professionals and advice, low-cost or low-specification computing devices, and also occur sporadically in negation, first-person experience, research interviews, age-based growth charts, and retrocomputing materials; these triggers do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Medical professionals and healthcare
patterns.context: Contexts where medical professionals provide information, advice, or care; [1] mentions a doctor reviewing growth charts, and [9] mentions dentists’ knowledge and preventive care.

patterns.name: Low-cost or low-specification computing devices
patterns.context: low modifies specifications, cost, or price to describe computing devices that run software or perform tasks.

patterns.name: Negation with no
patterns.context: A negation appears when describing conditions, available resources, or software requirements; the specific meanings in the two cases are not identical.
patterns.domain: Software product descriptions, medical research texts

patterns.name: First-person experience
patterns.context: The author reports a personal observation in the first person, followed by a generalization about a device.

patterns.name: Research participants and interviews
patterns.context: The methods section describes participants taking part in face-to-face interviews.

patterns.name: Age ranges and growth charts
patterns.context: Describes the use of growth charts for children or adolescents by age group.

patterns.name: Retrocomputing technical materials
patterns.context: Introduces early computer ROM programs and their disassembly and reuse.

11_1444.description: 激活涉及医疗照护人员与建议、低成本或低规格计算设备，也零散出现在否定表达、第一人称经验、研究访谈、年龄生长图及复古计算机资料中；这些触发并未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 医疗人员与医疗照护
patterns.context: 医疗人员提供信息、建议或照护的语境；[1]提到医生查看生长图，[9]提到牙医的知识与预防性护理。

patterns.name: 低成本或低规格计算设备
patterns.context: low 修饰规格、成本或价格，描述运行软件或处理任务的计算设备。
patterns.domain: 计算机、硬件与科技评论

patterns.name: 否定表达 no
patterns.context: 在说明条件、可用资源或软件需求时出现否定词；两处具体语义并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 软件产品介绍、医学研究文本

patterns.name: 第一人称经历表达
patterns.context: 作者以第一人称报告个人观察，后接对设备的概括。

patterns.name: 研究参与者与访谈
patterns.context: 研究方法部分描述参与者接受面对面访谈。

patterns.name: 年龄范围及生长图
patterns.context: 按年龄段说明儿童或青少年的生长图表用途。

patterns.name: 复古计算机技术资料
patterns.context: 介绍早期计算机 ROM 程序及其反汇编和再利用。

en.description: Strong activations fall on diverse local words or subwords: no, doctor, health, carefully, the drug-name fragment trim, physician, documentary/was, and the low and hospital prefixes in compound words. Contexts span software, medicine, law, and technology, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Negation word no
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “requires no other software” describing software requirements; the word itself has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Doctor-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in a description of children’s growth charts for doctors to review during visits; the specific trigger is doctor.

patterns.name: Healthcare word form
patterns.context: Occurs in the hyphenated “health-care”; activation falls on health, not care.

patterns.name: Medical records and examination wording
patterns.context: Modifies medical history taking; the same sentence also concerns history, medication, and physical examination, but the prominent activation falls on carefully.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment trim
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of the combination antibiotic name “trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole”; the drug name is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Physician-patient phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the compound expression “physician-patient visits,” with strong activation on physician.

patterns.name: Evidence terminology
patterns.context: A court ruling argues that the damages amount lacks documentary evidence; strong activation falls on documentary and the following was.

patterns.name: Description of low-cost computing devices
patterns.context: Modifies an inexpensive single-board computer; strong activation falls on the hyphen token between low and priced in low-priced.

patterns.name: Survey research design terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in the research-design phrase “hospital-based and population-based cross-sectional.”

11_1444.description: 强激活落在多种局部词项或子词上：no、doctor、health、carefully、药名片段trim、physician、documentary/was，以及low和hospital复合词前缀。语境横跨软件、医学、法律与科技，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 否定词 no
patterns.context: 出现在描述软件使用要求的短语“requires no other software”中；该词本身激活最强。

patterns.name: 医生相关词语
patterns.context: 出现在儿童生长图表供医生就诊时查看的说明中；具体触发点是 doctor。

patterns.name: healthcare 词形
patterns.context: 出现在连字符连接的“health-care”中；激活落在 health 部分，而不是 care。

patterns.name: 医疗记录与检查措辞
patterns.context: 修饰病史采集；同句还涉及病史、用药及体格检查，但突出激活落在 carefully。

patterns.name: 药名片段 trim
patterns.context: 出现在抗生素复方药名“trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole”的开头；药名被切分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 医患关系词组
patterns.context: 出现在“physician-patient visits”这一复合表达中，强激活位于 physician 部分。

patterns.name: 证据词汇
patterns.context: 法院判决论证赔偿金额缺乏文件证据；强激活落在 documentary 和其后 was。

patterns.name: 低价计算设备描述
patterns.context: 修饰低价单板计算机；强激活位于 low-priced 中 low 与 priced 之间的连字符 token。

patterns.name: 调查研究设计词汇
patterns.context: 出现在“hospital-based and population-based cross-sectional”研究设计表述中。

en.description: Activations are distributed across webpages and papers in many domains, often landing at phrase boundaries, in the second half of compound words, or on high-information completion words; medical and health vocabulary is common, alongside education/GIS, e-commerce, and project-description topics, as well as tokenization and formatting noise.

patterns.name: High-information or completion words at phrase ends
patterns.context: Activated words often occur at phrase boundaries or sentence ends; in several passages, preceding text provides a modifier, compound fragment, or question frame that the word completes.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain webpages, medical texts, and forum posts

patterns.name: Medical, health, and research vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical, screening, health services, or research methods contexts; activations include health terms as well as fragments that link or form compound words.
patterns.domain: Public health, clinical and medical research

patterns.name: Tokenized or split compound-word fragments
patterns.context: A word is split at a marker boundary, and activation often lands on the following morpheme, a component after a hyphen, or an incorrectly segmented internal fragment.
patterns.domain: Webpages and academic texts; includes tokenization or formatting noise

patterns.name: Education, GIS, and interactive participation
patterns.context: Describes students participating in class or taking notes, or introduces GIS products and software usage requirements.
patterns.domain: Educational materials and geospatial software webpage copy

patterns.name: Apparel e-commerce and delivery
patterns.context: E-commerce page fragments involving products, online purchases, and international shipping; the text contains clear spelling or segmentation anomalies.

patterns.name: Project showcases and README advice
patterns.context: Discusses what a project document should say about why it was created, the problem it solves, or lessons learned, followed by a mention of presentation slides.

patterns.name: Growth age ranges and charts
patterns.context: Descriptions of children’s or adolescents’ age groups and growth charts, linked to doctors reviewing charts during routine visits.

patterns.name: Research ethics and data-collection format markers
patterns.context: Research methods or paper fragments containing ethics approval, a data-collection section, and residual formatting markers.

11_1444.description: 激活分布在多领域网页和论文中，常落在短语边界、复合词后半或高信息补全词；医学健康词汇较多，另有教育/GIS、电商和项目说明等主题及分词、格式噪声。

patterns.name: 短语末尾的高信息词或补全词
patterns.trigger: 高激活落在语义完整短语或句子末端，如 “saying”(1)、“clinician”(2)、“software”(3)、“doctor”(4)、“centres”(5)、“Brazil”(6)、“based”(7)、“systems”(8)、“do”(9)、“person”(10)
patterns.context: 激活词常位于短语边界或句末；多段中前文先给出修饰语、复合词片段或问题框架，再由该词补全。
patterns.domain: 跨领域网页、医学与论坛文本

patterns.name: 医学健康与研究语汇
patterns.trigger: “patient/clinician/health system”(2)、“Health Statistics”“doctor”(4)、“breast screening”“breast screening centres”(5)、“hospital-based”“population-based”“cross-sectional”(7)、“pap smear”“STD tests”“breast exam”“birth control pills”(9)、“in-person interviews”(10)
patterns.context: 医学、筛查、健康服务或研究方法语境；激活点包括健康术语，也包括连接或构成复合词的片段。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、临床与医学研究

patterns.name: 分词或断开的复合词片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分在标记边界处，激活常落在后续词素、连字符后的成分，或被错误切分的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 网页与学术文本；含分词或格式噪声

patterns.name: 教育、GIS与交互参与
patterns.trigger: “students”“to be more engaged”“teacher is saying”(1)、“ArcGIS”“GIS solution”“landowners”“use”“no other software”(3)
patterns.context: 描述学生参与课堂、记笔记，或介绍GIS产品与软件使用条件。
patterns.domain: 教育说明与地理信息软件网页文案

patterns.name: 服装电商与配送
patterns.context: 电商页面片段，涉及商品、线上购买、国际配送；文本存在明显拼写或切分异常。

patterns.name: 项目展示与README建议
patterns.trigger: “Readme”“state why you made it”“what problem it solved”“what you learned”“four slides”(8)
patterns.context: 讨论项目说明文档应写明创建原因、解决的问题或所得经验，随后提到展示幻灯片。

patterns.name: 生长年龄范围与图表
patterns.context: 儿童或青少年年龄阶段及生长图表说明，连接到医生在常规就诊时查看图表的场景。

patterns.name: 研究伦理与数据收集格式标记
patterns.context: 研究方法或论文片段，含伦理审批、数据收集小节及格式化残留标记。

en.description: Activations are scattered across conjunctions, hyphenated compounds, numeric ranges, paragraph boundaries, and technical terms or code fragments; a few occur in negation and clinical care terminology. No single domain or stable meaning explains all examples.

patterns.name: and conjunction or additive structure
patterns.context: Appears at the junction of coordinated items, clauses, or research aims; the surrounding text is usually a complete phrase or clause.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, academic papers, webpage descriptions, and code contexts

patterns.name: based compound modifiers
patterns.context: In hyphenated compounds, based modifies the type of study, practice, or center.

patterns.name: Numbers, ranges, and unit formatting
patterns.context: Numbers combine with hyphens, units, or time expressions; the two ends of a range may be adjacent.
patterns.domain: Web health information, commercial descriptions, and research texts

patterns.name: Internal fragments of technical terms or identifiers
patterns.context: Activation lands on an internal fragment of a technical, drug, or code identifier, often with capitalization, hyphens, or camel case; there is no unified meaning.
patterns.domain: Computing technology, medical terminology, and source code

patterns.name: Paragraph and list boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near line breaks, paragraph divisions, or numbered-item boundaries.

patterns.name: Negation or absence expressed by none
patterns.context: Describes the absence of prior history or the lack of a previous project.

patterns.name: Methods and data-collection language
patterns.context: Describes data collection and interview format in a research methods section.

patterns.name: Healthcare topic words
patterns.context: Clinical narrative about nursing education, sodium and fluid restriction, and missed opportunities for intervention.

11_1444.description: 激活分散在并列连接、连字符复合词、数字范围、段落边界及专业词/代码片段；少数落在否定表达和临床护理术语上。没有单一领域或稳定词义能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: and 连接或补充结构
patterns.context: 出现在并列项、从句或研究目标的衔接处；前后通常都是完整短语或分句。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、学术论文、网页说明及代码上下文

patterns.name: based 复合修饰语
patterns.context: 连字符复合词中，based 修饰研究、实践或中心的类型。

patterns.name: 数字、范围与单位格式
patterns.context: 数字与连字符、单位或时间表达组合出现；范围两端可能紧邻。
patterns.domain: 网页科普、商业说明及研究文本

patterns.name: 专业术语或标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在技术、药物或代码标识符的词内片段，常伴随大小写、连字符或驼峰格式；并无统一词义。
patterns.domain: 计算机技术、医学术语与源代码

patterns.name: 段落与列表边界
patterns.context: 换行、分段或编号目标的边界附近出现激活。
patterns.domain: 网页、论文及研究计划文本

patterns.name: none 的否定／缺失表达
patterns.context: 描述没有既往情况或不存在先前项目时。

patterns.name: 方法与数据收集表达
patterns.context: 研究方法段落中，说明数据收集及访谈形式。

patterns.name: 卫生保健主题词
patterns.context: 关于护理教育、限钠限液和错失干预机会的临床叙述。

en.description: The most stable formal cue is hyphens and the compounds they connect, especially research design, treatment, and management terminology in medical abstracts; a CSS background property and a few other contexts, including technical, scientific, and health-disclaimer text, also occur.

patterns.name: CSS background properties and values
patterns.context: Occurs in CSS declarations, especially coordinate lists for background positioning and repeated settings.

patterns.name: Hyphens in compound words
patterns.context: Hyphens connect compound modifiers or phrases, common in academic text; also occurs in code/technical text.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, technical text, and general professional writing

patterns.name: Medical study design and cohort descriptions
patterns.context: Describes study location, sample source, or study design, often alongside methods, participants, or statistical analysis.

patterns.name: Medical scales and treatment adherence
patterns.context: Discusses development or evaluation of patient-reported outcome measures and barriers to treatment adherence.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, especially patient outcomes and treatment adherence research

patterns.name: Compound drug names in medical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in pharmacological contexts contrasting antiepileptic and non-antiepileptic drugs.

patterns.name: Medical quality measures and hospital management
patterns.context: Discusses the development of or consensus on hospital pain management and quality measures.

patterns.name: Computing resources and AI applications
patterns.context: Describes large-scale computing resource needs and tasks such as speech and image processing, virtual assistants, and autonomous driving.
patterns.domain: Technical introductions or popular computer science text

patterns.name: Diabetes prevention and evidence-based management
patterns.context: Lists diabetes prevention and control strategies, screening, monitoring, and diagnostic tools.

patterns.name: Research cores and data processing workflows
patterns.context: Explains the responsibilities of a research platform or core facility in measuring metabolites, processing data, and reanalyzing archived data.

patterns.name: Medical disclaimer and physician-patient relationship
patterns.context: Occurs in a disclaimer stating that the content does not constitute diagnosis, treatment advice, or a physician-patient relationship, and advising readers to consult a doctor.

11_1444.description: 最稳定的形式线索是连字符及其连接的复合词，尤其是医学摘要中的研究设计、治疗与管理术语；另有CSS背景属性和技术、科研、健康免责声明等少数不同语境。

patterns.name: CSS 背景属性和值
patterns.context: 出现在 CSS 声明中，尤其是背景定位的坐标列表及重复设置。

patterns.name: 复合词中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合修饰语或词组，常见于学术文本；也出现在代码/技术文本中。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、技术文本及一般专业写作

patterns.name: 医学研究设计与队列描述
patterns.context: 描述研究地点、样本来源或研究设计，周围常有研究方法、受试者或统计分析内容。

patterns.name: 医学量表与治疗依从性
patterns.context: 讨论患者报告结局量表的开发或评估，以及治疗依从性障碍。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要，尤其是患者结局与治疗依从性研究

patterns.name: 医学术语中的药物复合名称
patterns.context: 出现在抗癫痫药与非抗癫痫药对照的药理学语境中。

patterns.name: 医学质量指标与医院管理
patterns.context: 谈及医院疼痛管理和质量指标的制定或共识。

patterns.name: 计算资源与人工智能应用
patterns.context: 描述大规模计算资源需求及语音、图像处理、虚拟助手和自动驾驶等任务。
patterns.domain: 技术介绍或计算机科学普及文本

patterns.name: 糖尿病防治与循证管理
patterns.context: 列举糖尿病防控策略、筛查、监测和诊断工具。

patterns.name: 研究核心与数据处理流程
patterns.context: 说明研究平台或核心设施对代谢物进行测量、数据处理及存档数据再分析的职责。
patterns.domain: 科研项目说明/生物医学研究基础设施

patterns.name: 医疗免责声明与医患关系
patterns.context: 出现在声明内容不构成诊断、治疗建议或医患关系，并劝告咨询医生的免责声明中。
patterns.domain: 健康信息网页免责声明

en.description: Activations are distributed across technical, medical, health, and product texts, involving numbers and units, technical terms, hyphenated compounds, and feature descriptions; there is no apparent unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Exact numbers and time units
patterns.context: Discusses Unix time or assumptions about time in code, with numbers, units, and quoted terms.

patterns.name: Drug names and classification terms
patterns.context: A neuroscience abstract contrasts drug classes and specific drug names.

patterns.name: Repetition and numeric sequences in CSS property values
patterns.context: CSS declarations contain multiple comma-separated positions, pixel values, and repeated patterns.

patterns.name: Age ranges and growth charts
patterns.context: Introduces different age groups, children’s growth charts, and health statistics agencies.

patterns.name: GIS software product descriptions and feature highlights
patterns.context: Introduces software licensing, uses, and ease of use for landowners or natural resource professionals.

patterns.name: Convenience in fitness training
patterns.context: A fitness camp promotes convenient workouts, minimal equipment needs, and social connections.

patterns.name: Java HTTP connections and bug reports
patterns.context: A programming Q&A discusses Java classes, internal checks, and known defects.

patterns.name: Personnel categories in training programs
patterns.context: Describes a long-term research training program and participating medical and research personnel.

patterns.name: Clinical quality management and pathology operations
patterns.context: An organization describes patient safety, quality improvement, accreditation, and clinical research operations.

patterns.name: Online medical screening and insurance purchases
patterns.context: Promotes the online medical screening process for travel insurance, including privacy and convenience.

11_1444.description: 激活分布在技术、医学、健康与产品文本中，涉及数字和单位、专业术语、连字符复合词及功能描述；没有明显统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 精确数字与时间单位
patterns.context: 讨论 Unix 时间或代码依赖的时间假设，出现数字、单位和引号内术语。

patterns.name: 药物名称及分类术语
patterns.context: 神经科学摘要中并列对照药物类别与具体药名。

patterns.name: CSS 属性值中的重复与数值串
patterns.context: CSS 声明包含逗号分隔的多个位置、像素值及重复模式。

patterns.name: 年龄区间与生长图表
patterns.context: 介绍不同年龄阶段及儿童生长图表、健康统计机构。

patterns.name: GIS 软件产品介绍与功能卖点
patterns.trigger: “ArcGIS”“GIS Kit”“fully functional”“easy to use”“requires no other software”
patterns.context: 面向土地所有者或自然资源专业人士介绍软件许可、用途和易用性。

patterns.name: 健身训练的便利性描述
patterns.trigger: “Boot camp exercises require little or no equipment”“anywhere”
patterns.context: 健身营宣传锻炼方式方便、器材需求少，并提及社交联系。

patterns.name: Java HTTP 连接与缺陷报告
patterns.context: 编程问答中讨论 Java 类、内部检查及已知缺陷。

patterns.name: 培训项目的人员类别
patterns.context: 描述长期研究培训项目及参与的医学、科研人员。

patterns.name: 临床质量管理与病理工作
patterns.context: 机构介绍患者安全、质量改进、认证及临床研究运营。

patterns.name: 在线医疗筛查与购买保险
patterns.trigger: “online medical screening tool”“purchase the appropriate travel cover”
patterns.context: 宣传旅行保险的线上医疗筛查流程及隐私、便利性。

en.description: Activations cluster in medical, clinical research, and healthcare project contexts, often adjacent to hyphenated compounds and professional health vocabulary; other patterns include expressions of minimal equipment in fitness copy, online screening for insurance purchases, and health data exchange.

patterns.name: Hyphenated compound boundaries
patterns.context: Activation lands on or near hyphens or adjacent split compound fragments; occurs across medical abstracts, institutional project texts, and health information texts.

patterns.name: Professional vocabulary in clinical and research institutions
patterns.context: Professional personnel, clinical services, and research activities occur densely in institutional descriptions, grant applications, or medical project narratives.

patterns.name: Medical and health topic vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears when describing diseases, drugs, symptoms, or health screening; it need not refer to the same disease or specific research topic.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and health service texts

patterns.name: Training, exercise, and minimal equipment
patterns.context: Fitness advice for general readers emphasizes training methods and little or no equipment.

patterns.name: Online medical screening and insurance purchase
patterns.context: Describes consumers completing medical screening online and then purchasing travel insurance.

patterns.name: Health data networks and information sharing
patterns.context: Discusses cross-institution health data networks, data resources, or regional information exchange and their use.
patterns.domain: Health informatics and public health project texts

11_1444.description: 激活集中于医学、临床科研和医疗项目语境，常邻接连字符复合词及专业健康词汇；另有健身文案中的器材稀少表达，及在线筛查购险、健康数据交换等较具体模式。

patterns.name: 连字符分隔的复合词边界
patterns.trigger: «-»，以及连字符前后的分词，如“non-antiepileptic”“physician-scientists”“hospital-based”“population-based”“health-information exchange”
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符处或其邻近、被拆分的复合词片段；跨医学摘要、机构项目文本及健康信息文本出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与医疗科研文本

patterns.name: 临床与研究机构专业词汇
patterns.context: 机构介绍、科研资助申请或医疗项目叙述中，专业人员、临床服务和研究活动词汇密集出现。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助与医疗科研文本

patterns.name: 医学健康主题词汇
patterns.context: 描述疾病、药物、症状或健康筛查时出现；不要求同一种疾病或具体研究主题。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要及健康服务文本

patterns.name: 训练、锻炼及装备稀少
patterns.context: 面向普通读者的健身建议，强调训练方式及少量或无需器材。

patterns.name: 在线医疗筛查与保险购买
patterns.trigger: “online medical screening tool”“travel insurance”“purchase the appropriate travel cover”
patterns.context: 介绍消费者通过网络进行医疗筛查并据此购买旅行保险的流程。

patterns.name: 健康数据网络与信息共享
patterns.trigger: “national network”“electronic health record data”“claims”“real world evidence”“health-information exchange”
patterns.context: 讨论跨机构健康数据网络、数据资源或区域信息交换及其使用。
patterns.domain: 医疗信息学与公共卫生项目文本

en.concept: Professional process terms in medical and service texts
en.description: Activations occur mainly in medical, clinical research, and health service texts, involving pathologists, research protocols, medical data exchange, care coordination, and ethics compliance; other examples include medical insurance screening, Angular server resource descriptions, and fitness boot camp copy, so the pattern does not reduce to a single theme.

patterns.name: Pathologist-related words in medical and research texts
patterns.context: Appears in NIH medical research institutions, clinical services, or training contexts; activations cluster on split forms of pathologist and adjacent parts.

patterns.name: Clinical research design and implementation
patterns.context: Involves clinical, patient, or research processes when describing study design, measurement methods, or clinical intervention protocols.
patterns.domain: Medical papers and NIH project abstracts

patterns.name: Medical data exchange and care coordination
patterns.context: Describes health information networks, data sharing, or patient transitions between care settings.
patterns.domain: Health informatics and healthcare project descriptions

patterns.name: Medical review, ethics approval, and compliance
patterns.context: Mentions clinical quality assurance, institutional accreditation, research ethics approval, or authorization to conduct research.
patterns.domain: Healthcare institution documents and medical research papers

patterns.name: Medical screening and insurance products
patterns.context: Online medical screening is used to determine eligible travel insurance coverage or purchase options.

patterns.name: Angular Universal server resources
patterns.context: Explains that browser globals are unavailable during server-side rendering and describes server resource requirements.

patterns.name: Boot camp exercise and equipment
patterns.context: Introduces workout partnerships formed at boot camp and training that requires little or no equipment.

11_1444.concept: 医学与服务文本中的专业流程词
11_1444.description: 激活主要出现在医疗、临床研究及健康服务文本，涉及病理学家、研究方案、医疗数据交换、照护协调和伦理合规；另见医疗保险筛查、Angular服务器资源说明及健身训练营文案，无法归结为单一主题。

patterns.name: 医疗与科研文本中的 pathologist 相关词
patterns.context: 出现在 NIH 医疗科研机构、临床服务或培训的语境中；激活集中在被拆分的 pathologist 词形及其相邻部分。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助与临床科研描述

patterns.name: 临床研究设计与实施
patterns.context: 描述研究设计、测量方式或临床干预方案时，涉及临床、患者或研究流程。
patterns.domain: 医学论文与 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 医疗数据交换与照护协调
patterns.context: 描述健康信息网络、数据共享，或患者在不同照护场景间的转接。
patterns.domain: 医疗信息学与医疗服务项目说明

patterns.name: 医疗审查、伦理审批与合规
patterns.trigger: “Office of Patient Safety”“Joint Commission accreditation”“Ethical Review Board”“Medical Research Council”
patterns.context: 提及临床质量保障、机构认证、研究伦理审批或开展研究的许可。
patterns.domain: 医疗机构文件与医学研究论文

patterns.name: 医疗筛查与保险产品
patterns.context: 在线医疗筛查用于判断旅行保险适用保障或购买方案。

patterns.name: Angular Universal 的服务器资源
patterns.context: 说明服务端渲染时浏览器全局变量不可用，以及服务器的资源需求。

patterns.name: 训练营锻炼与器材
patterns.trigger: “workout buddies”“Boot camp exercises”“little or no equipment”
patterns.context: 介绍训练营形成的锻炼伙伴关系，以及无需或少量器材的训练。
patterns.domain: 健身宣传或生活方式文案

en.description: The most prominent common cue is hyphens, slashes, and intra-word segmentation boundaries; samples are mostly medical and clinical text, with a few exceptions such as legal testimony and Tangut entries.

patterns.name: Hyphens and compound-word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall near hyphens or slashes, especially boundaries between English compound modifiers, compound nouns, and coordinated entities; also occurs in hyphenated Tangut entries.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal text, research funding descriptions, dictionary-like code/lists

patterns.name: Medical and clinical research contexts
patterns.context: Involves patients, clinical services, study design, medical data, or clinical personnel; some activations coincide with the compound-word boundaries above.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, clinical research, healthcare projects, and funding text

patterns.name: Intra-word English tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Activations are distributed around segmented English word fragments or affixes; no specific medical meaning is required.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal narrative, and general English text

patterns.name: Tangut entry numbering format
patterns.context: Dictionary-style entries use hyphens to mark components and list numbers and component names consecutively.

patterns.name: Legal testimony and cross-examination wording
patterns.context: Describes a witness being cross-examined at trial about matters such as conspiracy and smuggling.

patterns.name: Clinical assessment and follow-up measures
patterns.context: Lists measures and describes periodic reassessment after treatment.

patterns.name: Antiepileptic drug names
patterns.context: Drug names occur in a study title or abstract about the effects of antiepileptic versus non-antiepileptic drugs.

patterns.name: Clinical quality and institutional management
patterns.context: Discusses patient safety, clinical quality assurance, accreditation, and organizational management; also includes hyphenated job/department descriptions.
patterns.domain: Healthcare institution management and research project text

patterns.name: Health data networks and collaborative participation
patterns.context: Describes a national network integrating electronic medical records and claims data, with participation by patients, clinical personnel, and healthcare systems.
patterns.domain: Health informatics, research funding project descriptions

patterns.name: Study design terminology
patterns.context: Specifies whether a study is prospective or cross-sectional and how a questionnaire is sent or administered.
patterns.domain: Systematic review or medical methodology text

11_1444.description: 最突出的共同线索是连字符、斜线及词内切分边界；样本多为医学与临床文本，另有法律证词和 Tangut 词条等少数特例。

patterns.name: 连字符与复合词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符或斜线附近，尤其是英文复合修饰语、复合名词及并列实体的分界处；也见于 Tangut 词条中的连字符。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文本、科研资助说明、词典式代码/列表

patterns.name: 医疗与临床研究语境
patterns.context: 涉及患者、临床服务、研究设计、医疗数据或临床人员；部分激活与上述复合词边界同时出现。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、临床研究、医疗项目与资助文本

patterns.name: 英文词内部分词边界
patterns.context: 激活分布在被切分的英文词片段或词缀附近；不要求特定医学含义。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律叙述及一般英文文本

patterns.name: Tangut 词条编号格式
patterns.context: 词典式条目中以连字符标示构件，并连续列出编号和构件名称。

patterns.name: 法律证词与审讯措辞
patterns.context: 描述证人就共谋、走私等事项在审判中接受交叉询问。

patterns.name: 临床评估与随访指标
patterns.context: 列出指标并说明治疗后定期复评。

patterns.name: 抗癫痫药物名称
patterns.context: 药物名称出现在抗癫痫药与非抗癫痫药作用的研究标题/摘要中。

patterns.name: 临床质量与机构管理
patterns.context: 讨论患者安全、临床质量保证、认证和组织管理；也包含连字符复合职位/部门描述。
patterns.domain: 医疗机构管理与科研项目文本

patterns.name: 健康数据网络与参与协作
patterns.context: 描述全国性网络整合电子病历、理赔数据及患者、临床人员和医疗系统参与。
patterns.domain: 健康信息学、科研资助项目说明

patterns.name: 研究设计术语
patterns.context: 说明研究是否前瞻性、横断面以及问卷的发送或管理方式。
patterns.domain: 系统综述或医学方法学文本

en.description: Primarily responds to fragments of hyphenated compounds and clinical or health terms in medical and health texts, with common structures such as patient-level, home-health, and lab-to-clinic; it also marks specialist terms, drug names, function words, and women’s health guidance statements.

patterns.name: patient-level hyphenated fragments
patterns.context: Activations cluster in hyphenated compounds, especially on the hyphen and the following word segment; the same fragment often marks both sides of the hyphen.
patterns.domain: Medical research, clinical services, and healthcare project descriptions

patterns.name: Health and medical topic words
patterns.context: Occurs in medical, health promotion, clinical care, or service contexts; sometimes without an obvious hyphenated compound.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, clinical texts, and public health project texts

patterns.name: Specific medical terminology fragments
patterns.context: Activation lands on internal fragments or stems of specialist medical terms involving different organs, drugs, and professionals; many also occur in clinical health contexts.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, clinical projects, and health guidance texts

patterns.name: Relational and function words
patterns.context: These common function words are also marked in several passages, with no distinctive syntactic condition established on their own; they may co-occur with medical contexts or positions near compounds.

patterns.name: Lists and bullet points
patterns.context: Occurs near reference lists, heading separators, or itemized lists, but markings are sparse and it is unclear whether this is a stable trigger.
patterns.domain: Paper citation formats, health guidance lists

patterns.name: Adult women’s health statements
patterns.context: Guidance statements about women’s health, gynecological visits, and diabetes effects on reproductive health.

patterns.name: Antiepileptic drug fragments
patterns.context: Drug names occur in a study title or abstract comparing antiepileptic and non-antiepileptic drugs; activation lands only on internal fragments of the drug name and conjunctions.

11_1444.concept: 医学复合词与临床术语
11_1444.description: 主要对医学与健康文本中的连字符复合词片段及临床、健康术语起反应，常见 patient-level、home-health、lab-to-clinic 等结构；也标记专科词、药名、功能词及女性健康指导语句。

patterns.name: patient-level 连字符片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在连字符构成的复合词中，尤其是复合词的连字符及其后的词段；同一片段常同时标记连字符前后部分。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、临床服务、医疗项目描述

patterns.name: 健康与医疗主题词
patterns.context: 出现在医疗、健康促进、临床照护或服务语境中；有时不伴随明显连字符复合词。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、临床与公共卫生项目文本

patterns.name: 特定医学术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专业医学术语的词内片段或词干上，涉及不同器官、药物及专业人员；不少词也处于临床健康语境。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、临床项目及健康指导文本

patterns.name: 关系词与功能词
patterns.context: 这些常见功能词在若干段中也被标记，缺少足以单独确定的特殊句法条件；可能与医学语境或复合词周边位置共同出现。

patterns.name: 列表与项目符号
patterns.context: 出现在引用列表、标题分隔或条目列表附近，但标记稀少，是否构成稳定触发条件不明。
patterns.domain: 论文引用格式、健康指导列表

patterns.name: 成人女性健康表述
patterns.context: 围绕女性健康、妇科就诊及糖尿病影响生殖健康的指导性陈述。
patterns.domain: 面向公众的健康指导文本

patterns.name: 抗癫痫药物词段
patterns.context: 药物名称出现在抗癫痫药与非抗癫痫药比较的研究标题或摘要中；激活只落在药名内部片段及连接词上。

en.concept: Medical research and healthcare process texts
en.description: Activations cluster in medical research and service texts: patient assessment, medical records and databases, study design, and care processes; other examples include online medical screening, software installation commands, and a research URL proper name.

patterns.name: Measurement and follow-up in medical research
patterns.context: Involves patient symptom scores, examinations, observation, or screening; surrounding tokens often describe timing, frequency, or medical procedures.
patterns.domain: Medical research and healthcare services, including clinical follow-up, disease monitoring, and screening descriptions

patterns.name: Patient records and medical records
patterns.context: Discusses consulting medical records or evidence, or linking patient records through a database; record-related wording itself may trigger.
patterns.domain: Medical cohort studies, legal decisions involving disability or medical evidence

patterns.name: Study design, participants, and intervention groups
patterns.context: Describes study subjects, study phases, study design, or educational intervention groups; it does not correspond to only one design.
patterns.domain: PubMed clinical research abstracts and systematic reviews

patterns.name: Pain or symptom scales and clinical measurement
patterns.context: Describes symptom scores, baseline data, or physical measurements; requires a patient-assessment context.
patterns.domain: Urology research, reviews, and oncology research

patterns.name: Care transitions and service personnel in healthcare systems
patterns.context: Lists clinical personnel, service recipients, or management roles involved in healthcare transitions.

patterns.name: Software build commands and troubleshooting
patterns.context: First-person descriptions of downloading source code, installing dependencies, running build commands, or attempting to run a program.

patterns.name: million women study in a URL
patterns.context: The URL appears as part of a study name, near descriptions of participant consent, ethics approval, and NHS data linkage; the response may be localized to a proper name or URL fragment.

patterns.name: Online medical questionnaire for travel insurance
patterns.context: Introduces how an online tool helps customers choose travel insurance and mentions privacy or medical conditions.

11_1444.concept: 医学研究与医疗流程文本
11_1444.description: 激活集中于医学研究及服务文本：患者评估、病历与数据库、研究设计和照护流程；另见在线医疗筛查、软件安装命令，以及研究网址专名。

patterns.name: 医疗研究中的测量与随访
patterns.trigger: “IPSS”“uroflowmetry”“routinely … evaluated a year after TRT”；“regularly observed”；“online medical screening tool”
patterns.context: 涉及患者症状评分、检查、观察或筛查；触发 token 周围常有时间、频率或医疗流程描述。
patterns.domain: 医学研究与医疗服务，含临床随访、疾病观察及筛查介绍

patterns.name: 患者资料与医疗记录
patterns.trigger: “patients' medical records”“reviewing … medical evidence”“medical … records”；“NHS databases”
patterns.context: 谈论查阅病历、医疗证据或通过数据库链接患者资料；病历措辞本身可能触发。
patterns.domain: 医学队列研究、法律判决中的残障/医疗证据

patterns.name: 研究设计、参与者与干预分组

en.description: Activations cluster in medical research and service contexts: patient follow-up, medical records or health databases, clinical monitoring, study design, and evaluation; they also cover healthcare quality, personalized medicine, insurance screening, and health information disclaimers.

patterns.name: Clinical examinations and repeat measurements
patterns.context: Describes serum PSA, urinary flow rate, and symptom scores being rechecked at fixed intervals after treatment.

patterns.name: Routine data, databases, or medical record linkage
patterns.context: Patients or clinical records are linked to routinely collected medical databases, or medical records are assessed retrospectively.

patterns.name: Patient consent and ethics approval
patterns.context: Study participants consent to follow-up, and ethics approval is reported.

patterns.name: Online medical screening and insurance process
patterns.context: An online tool is used for medical screening before travel insurance purchase, reducing the need to handle complex conditions individually.
patterns.domain: Travel insurance promotion or service description

patterns.name: Long-term physiological monitoring and event descriptions
patterns.context: A retrospective study combines 24-hour blood pressure and electrocardiographic monitoring and describes events.

patterns.name: Clinical quality, accreditation, and pathology operations
patterns.context: An institution describes clinical service quality assurance, accreditation requirements, and pathology operations.
patterns.domain: Healthcare institution or NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Large-scale electronic health data and real-world evidence
patterns.context: Describes a cross-institution network covering a large population that integrates electronic medical records and claims data for research or evidence generation.

patterns.name: Personalized medicine and patient-level data analysis
patterns.context: Discusses extending personalized medicine analysis frameworks using more granular patient data.

patterns.name: Medical information disclaimers and compliance instructions
patterns.context: A website states that information cannot replace professional medical advice and asks users to read packaging information and follow instructions.
patterns.domain: Medical or health product website disclaimers

patterns.name: Study phases, follow-up, and parameter assessment in disease research
patterns.context: Describes different study phases, patient observation and follow-up, and disease parameter assessment.

patterns.name: Comparison of study designs and measurement methods
patterns.context: A review compares prospective and cross-sectional designs among included studies, as well as mailed or clinic-administered questionnaires.

patterns.trigger: « randomized»,« controlled» studies»；« prospectively»；« cross»-«sectional»；« instrument»
patterns.context: 综述比较纳入研究的前瞻性、横断面设计，以及邮寄或门诊施测问卷。

en.description: Trigger contexts are scattered: medical health and research (databases, ethics approval, trials, diabetes, gynecology), as well as software installation, legal evidence, forum searches, and map links; no stable shared trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Women’s health and gynecological advice
patterns.context: Discusses women’s health, gynecological visits, or medical advice; highlighting occurs in contexts related to gynecological specialists, especially «must».

patterns.name: Medical research data and ethics
patterns.context: Describes study participants, routinely collected medical databases, ethics approval, or authorization from a research institution.

patterns.name: Medical screening and insurance process
patterns.context: An online medical screening tool lets users assess their health and purchase suitable travel insurance; highlighting is concentrated on «to run through».

patterns.name: Clinical trial registration
patterns.context: Mentions COVID-19 treatment research and its registration on ClinicalTrials.gov.

patterns.name: Software build commands
patterns.context: A user describes command-line steps for configuring Ubuntu, installing dependencies, and trying to run software.

patterns.name: Evidence and damages rulings
patterns.context: A legal opinion discusses a lack of documentary support for the damages amount; activation occurs in a passive-voice description of the evidence.

patterns.name: Finding an earlier discussion
patterns.context: The poster says they repeatedly searched for another discussion thread started by Kina.

patterns.name: Research approval and fieldwork
patterns.context: After ethics approval, describes the research team being authorized to work in a specified region.

patterns.name: Diabetes intervention research
patterns.context: Introduces a behavioral intervention project for type 1 diabetes targeting adolescents and families, along with its research objectives.

patterns.name: Map links
patterns.context: A road map link is listed in a Wikipedia entry’s references or external links.

11_1444.description: 触发语境分散：医学健康与研究（数据库、伦理许可、试验、糖尿病、妇科），另有软件安装、法律证据、论坛查找及地图链接；未见稳定的共同触发词。

patterns.name: 女性健康与妇科建议
patterns.context: 谈女性健康、妇科就诊或医疗建议；高亮落在妇科专家相关语境中，尤其是 «must»。

patterns.name: 医学研究数据与伦理
patterns.context: 描述研究参与者、常规收集的医疗数据库、伦理批准或研究机构许可。
patterns.domain: 医学论文／公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 医疗筛查与保险流程
patterns.context: 在线医疗筛查工具让用户评估医疗状况并购买合适的旅行保险；高亮集中在 «to run through»。

patterns.name: 临床试验登记
patterns.context: 提及 COVID-19 治疗研究及其在 ClinicalTrials.gov 上的登记。

patterns.name: 软件构建命令
patterns.context: 用户描述在 Ubuntu 上配置、安装依赖并尝试运行软件的命令行步骤。

patterns.name: 证据与赔偿裁判
patterns.context: 法律意见讨论赔偿金额缺乏文件证据支持；激活在被动语态的证据表述中。

patterns.name: 寻找先前讨论
patterns.context: 发帖者说自己反复查找另一条由 Kina 发起的讨论串。

patterns.name: 研究许可与实地工作
patterns.context: 伦理审批之后，说明研究团队获准在指定地区开展工作。

patterns.name: 糖尿病干预研究
patterns.context: 介绍面向青少年及家庭的 1 型糖尿病行为干预项目和研究目标。

patterns.name: 地图链接
patterns.context: 维基百科条目参考或外部链接中列出公路地图链接。

en.concept: Factual statements and structural markers in professional explanatory texts
en.description: Activations are distributed across medical and clinical research descriptions, evidence statements, webpage links, and structured sections, and also occur in product descriptions and encyclopedia lists; there is no single stable trigger, and many activations lie near function words or formatting markers.

patterns.name: Copular constructions emphasizing facts, evidence, or results
patterns.context: When stating facts or research results, activation occurs near copulas, auxiliaries, or adjacent predicates; the trigger is not consistently limited to a particular word form.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, and general explanatory texts

patterns.name: Medical and health topic vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical vocabulary is activated near text about medical services, diseases, or clinical evaluation, but these terms do not trigger consistently in all medical passages.
patterns.domain: Health information, clinical papers, healthcare service descriptions

patterns.name: Research ethics, consent, and registration procedures
patterns.context: Descriptions of informed consent, ethics approval, and study registration in clinical research methods or participant data use statements.

patterns.name: URL and link formatting
patterns.context: When webpages link to external resources, parts of the URL and adjacent proper names activate.

patterns.name: Lists, sections, and line-break structure
patterns.context: Activations occur when content on a page or in an itemized list is organized with line breaks, bullet points, or section headings.

patterns.name: Product, tool, and service descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a tool or product’s uses, features, target users, or purchase method; passages may also involve medical or GIS topics.

patterns.name: Insufficient legal evidence and adjudication language
patterns.context: Legal reasoning discusses a lack of evidence for compensation amounts, undetermined amounts, or questionable testimony.

patterns.name: Urine-related webpage link
patterns.context: A news URL slug contains headline text about the sterility of urine; there is insufficient evidence that the activation is driven by the topic itself.

patterns.name: Indian national highway entry
patterns.context: Related lists, references, or external map links at the end of an encyclopedia entry.

patterns.name: Geographic information system software descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces GIS software licensing, features, and uses for landowners and resource professionals.

11_1444.concept: 专业说明文中的事实陈述与结构标记
11_1444.description: 激活分布于医学与临床研究说明、证据陈述、网页链接和结构化栏目，也见产品介绍及百科列表；没有单一稳定触发词，且多处激活落在功能词或格式标记附近。

patterns.name: 强调事实、证据或结果的系词结构
patterns.context: 在陈述事实或研究结果时，激活落在系词、助动词或相邻谓词附近；触发并不稳定地限定某个词形。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学及一般说明文

patterns.name: 医疗与健康主题词汇
patterns.context: 涉及医疗服务、疾病或临床评估时，相关医学词汇附近出现激活；但这些词并非所有医疗段落中都稳定触发。
patterns.domain: 健康科普、临床论文、医疗服务介绍

patterns.name: 研究伦理、同意与登记流程
patterns.context: 临床研究方法或参与者数据使用说明中，围绕知情同意、伦理审批、研究登记等表述。

patterns.name: 网址及链接格式
patterns.context: 网页链接或外部资源名称出现时，URL 的部分标记及相邻专名会激活。
patterns.domain: 网页、论文引用、百科条目

patterns.name: 列表、栏目与换行结构
patterns.context: 条目或网页通过换行、项目符号、栏目标题组织内容时出现激活。
patterns.domain: 百科条目及说明性网页

patterns.name: 产品、工具与服务介绍
patterns.trigger: “online medical screening tool”, “travel insurance”, “GIS Kit”, “easy to use”
patterns.context: 介绍工具或产品的用途、功能、适用人群或购买方式；段内另有医学或 GIS 主题。

patterns.name: 法律证据不足与裁定措辞
patterns.trigger: “No documentary evidence was introduced to support the amount awarded”
patterns.context: 讨论赔偿金额缺乏证据、金额待定或证词可疑的司法论证。

patterns.name: 尿液相关网页链接
patterns.context: 新闻 URL 的 slug 中出现关于尿液无菌性的标题文字；没有充分证据显示激活来自该主题本身。

patterns.name: 印度国家公路条目
patterns.context: 百科条目末尾的相关列表、参考文献或外部地图链接。

patterns.name: 地理信息系统软件介绍
patterns.context: 介绍 GIS 软件许可、功能及面向土地所有者和资源专业人士的用途。
patterns.domain: 地理信息系统产品说明

en.description: Activations are distributed across medical research and clinical workflows, research URLs, legal evidence, and link text containing negation. Some strong activations fall on common words or hyphens, with no stable single-word meaning or grammatical trigger condition.

patterns.name: Routine data and follow-up in medical research
patterns.context: Describes NHS databases, routine collection or retesting of clinical measures, and follow-up contact with study participants
patterns.domain: Medical research papers, clinical trial protocols

patterns.name: Healthcare services and clinical workflows
patterns.context: Involves screening or health consultations, clinical service quality, pathology tissue management, or translation of basic research into clinical practice

patterns.name: Medical research registration URLs
patterns.context: A URL appears in registration information for clinical or disease-related research

patterns.name: Judicial evidence and damages assessment
patterns.context: Discusses whether documentary evidence supports a damages amount, and testimony is considered vague or suspicious

patterns.name: Web link text containing negation
patterns.context: A link or surrounding text contains an informal English title with negation

11_1444.description: 激活分布于医学研究与临床流程、研究网址、法律证据和含否定的链接文本。部分高激活落在常见词或连字符上，未显示稳定的单一词义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 医疗研究中的常规数据与随访
patterns.context: 描述 NHS 数据库、临床指标的例行收集或复测，以及研究对象的后续联系

patterns.name: 医疗服务与临床流程

patterns.domain: 医疗健康说明、NIH 项目材料

patterns.name: 医疗研究注册网址
patterns.context: 临床研究或疾病相关研究的注册信息中出现网址
patterns.domain: 医学论文、研究注册信息

patterns.name: 司法证据与金额认定
patterns.context: 讨论赔偿金额是否有文件证据支持，且证词被认为含糊或可疑

patterns.name: 含否定的网页链接文本
patterns.context: 链接或链接周围文字中出现带否定的口语化英文标题

en.description: Activations are scattered across code copyright notices, name fragments, long scientific words, math problem prompts, and email time formats; no single semantic or formatting feature explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Name and surname fragments
patterns.context: Part of a personal name, author name, or name list, especially surnames ending in -son; activation falls within names or their subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, code attributions, email addresses

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in scientific terms
patterns.context: Long scientific terms in specialist text are split into multiple subwords; these fragments do not appear to share a stable meaning.

patterns.name: Copyright and rights-reservation statements in code comments
patterns.context: Copyright years, author or company names, and rights statements appear at the beginning of code files or in comments.

patterns.name: Calculate prompts in math problems
patterns.context: Calculate introduces a solving task after an algebraic expression or equation; numbers, operators, and variables also show sporadic activation.

patterns.name: Time formats in forwarded email headers
patterns.context: Forwarded email headers contain dates, times, and sender information; time digits and punctuation show strong activation.

11_1821.description: 激活分散在代码版权注释、姓名片段、科研长词、数学题提示及邮件时间格式中；未见能解释全部片段的单一语义或格式特征。

patterns.name: 人名及姓氏片段
patterns.context: 人名、作者名或姓名列表中的一部分，尤见 -son 结尾姓氏；激活落在姓名内部或其子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、代码署名、邮件地址

patterns.name: 科学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 专业文本中较长的科学词汇被切分成多个子词；没有显示出这些片段共享某个稳定词义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与科研文本

patterns.name: 代码注释中的版权与保留权利声明
patterns.context: 代码文件开头或注释中出现版权年份、作者或公司名以及权利声明。

patterns.name: 数学题中的 Calculate 提示
patterns.context: 代数式或方程之后，以 Calculate 引出求解任务；此外数值、运算符和变量也有零散激活。

patterns.name: 邮件转发头中的时间格式
patterns.context: 转发邮件头中出现日期、时分和发件人信息；时间数字与标点获得强激活。

en.description: Activations occur sporadically in code comments and line breaks, name fragments, subword fragments within scientific terms, Calculate prompts and local equation spans in math problems, and email time fields; these patterns lack an obvious shared trigger.

patterns.name: Code markers and line breaks
patterns.context: In code comments or document headers, especially at the start of comment lines and at line breaks.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in names
patterns.context: Surname or name fragments in personal names or email usernames; activations fall on parts of names, but the fragments are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within scientific terms
patterns.context: Tokenized subword fragments within chemical and biological terms; no consistent meaning or affix is apparent.

patterns.name: Instruction word in math problems
patterns.context: Appears after polynomial equations or numerical problems when an unknown quantity is to be calculated.

patterns.name: Local number or equation tokens
patterns.context: Coefficients, constants, variables, or local equation spans in math problems; positions and values vary, with no stable numeric pattern.

patterns.name: Time fields in email headers
patterns.context: Timestamps and their AM markers in forwarded email headers.

11_1821.description: 激活散见于代码注释/换行、姓名片段、科研术语词内片段、数学题的 Calculate 与方程局部，以及邮件时间字段；这些模式缺少明显共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 编码标记与换行
patterns.context: 代码注释或文档头部中，尤其是注释行开头及换行位置。

patterns.name: 人名中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 人名或邮箱用户名中的姓氏/姓名片段；激活落在姓名组成部分上，但所含片段并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 科学术语的词内片段
patterns.context: 化学、生物学术语中被分词的词内片段；未见统一的词义或词缀。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与科研文本

patterns.name: 数学题的指令词
patterns.context: 多项式方程或数值题后，要求计算未知量时出现。

patterns.name: 数字或方程局部 token
patterns.context: 数学题中的系数、常数、变量或方程局部；各处位置和数值不一致，未见稳定的具体数值模式。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的时间字段
patterns.context: 转发邮件头里的时间戳及其上午标记。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in Calculate prompts in math exercises; they also appear in GitHub comments and copyright statements, and on the specific word fragments Menisci and tetrameric in two biomedical texts. There is no consistent cross-domain trigger.

patterns.name: Calculate prompt in math problems
patterns.context: In algebra or function problem statements, an equation, expression, or mapping is given, followed by a request to calculate a quantity; the marker clusters near Calculate rather than consistently on a particular mathematical symbol.

patterns.name: English code comments and copyright statements
patterns.context: English comments, copyright, or rights statements at the start of code files or after divider lines; activations fall on comment symbols, separators, and several words in the statement.

patterns.name: Internal word fragment in Menisci
patterns.context: In NIH biomedical code or text, the word Menisci is followed by descriptions such as function to load; this does not recur in other passages.

patterns.name: tetrameric in a PP3 structural description
patterns.context: A PubMed abstract describes PP3 forming a stable tetrameric structure and mentions hydrophobic interactions; this is a local activation over consecutive tokenized fragments.

11_1821.description: 激活主要见于数学练习题的 Calculate 题干；另见 GitHub 注释/版权声明，以及两处生物医学文本中特定词片段 Menisci、tetrameric。跨领域触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: 数学题中的“Calculate”提示
patterns.context: 代数题或函数题的题干中，先给出方程、表达式或映射，随后要求计算某个量；标记集中在 Calculate 附近，而不是稳定地落在某一数学符号上。

patterns.name: 英文代码注释与版权声明
patterns.trigger: 注释标记 «//»，以及 «Copyright»、«All rights»、«reserved» 等
patterns.context: 代码文件开头或分隔线之后的英文注释、版权或权利声明；激活落在注释符号、分隔符和声明中的若干词上。

patterns.name: Menisci 的内部词片段
patterns.context: NIH 生物医学代码或文本中，单词 Menisci 后接 function to load 等描述；没有在其他段复现。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter，生物医学软件相关文本

patterns.name: PP3 结构描述中的 tetrameric
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要描述 PP3 形成稳定的四聚体结构，并提到疏水相互作用；属于连续分词片段的局部激活。

en.description: The main pattern is the co-occurrence of English instructions with variables, coefficients, polynomials, and evaluation tasks in DM Mathematics; there is also an i in one expression. Other activations come from the biological term tetramer and the word Menisci, with no shared semantic cue.

patterns.name: English function words followed by mathematical variables
patterns.context: In formal math problems, especially when variables or function symbols appear near English instructions; activation also covers adjacent symbols and numbers.

patterns.name: Polynomial equations and substitution-based evaluation
patterns.context: A problem gives a polynomial equation or function definition and asks to find roots or calculate a function value; variable names and exponents vary.
patterns.domain: Symbolic algebra exercises in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: i in a mathematical sequence or expression
patterns.context: i appears in an isolated expression next to a calculation instruction; no clear semantic link to the other algebra problems is apparent.

patterns.name: Tetramer structures in biological text
patterns.context: Describes a protein forming a stable tetramer structure and mentions hydrophobic interactions and an entity beginning with C-.

patterns.name: Descriptions related to Menisci
patterns.context: The sentence discusses a function for distribution load and increase stability; activation is concentrated on intra-word subword segmentation and adjacent function words.
patterns.domain: NIH project text or technical descriptions

11_1821.description: 主要模式是 DM Mathematics 中英文指令与变量、系数、多项式及求值任务共现；另有一段算式中的 i。其余激活分别来自生物学 tetramer 术语和 Menisci 一词，缺乏共同语义线索。

patterns.name: 英文功能词后跟数学变量
patterns.context: 在形式化数学题目中，尤其变量或函数符号出现在英文指令附近；激活也覆盖相邻符号与数字。

patterns.name: 多项式方程与代入求值
patterns.context: 题目给出多项式方程或函数定义，要求求根或计算函数值；变量名和幂次各不相同。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的符号化代数练习

patterns.name: 数学序列或算式中的 i
patterns.context: 孤立的算式片段中出现 i，紧邻计算指令；看不出与其他代数题的明确语义联系。

patterns.name: 生物学文本中的四聚体结构
patterns.context: 描述蛋白质形成稳定的四聚体结构，并提及疏水相互作用及 C- 开头的实体。

patterns.name: Menisci 相关描述
patterns.context: 句子谈及某种 function 用于 distribution load 和 increase stability；激活集中在词内分词及邻近功能词。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目文本或技术描述

en.concept: Specific word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Activations span word-initial fragments or short phrases with no clear semantic connection: a mathematical plus sign, Life, Menisci, pretty good, Homeric, and Simultaneous, which recurs in medical abstracts. A possible common pattern is local response to specific word forms or subwords.

patterns.name: Plus sign in arithmetic expressions
patterns.context: A plus sign in a mathematical expression, followed by a number, operator, or variable; also “Calculate r(22).”

patterns.name: Phrase Life and politics
patterns.context: The title-like phrase “Life and politics”, followed by “from the Sunshine State's”

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment in life history traits
patterns.context: An abstract statement relating life-history traits to body size

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment Menisci
patterns.context: The segmented proper/technical term “Menisci”, followed by discussion of function, load distribution, and stability

patterns.name: Informal evaluation pretty good
patterns.context: Informal first-person narrative, followed by “i went to a broker”

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment Homeric
patterns.context: The title “Hom­ eric prayer”, followed by an introduction to the Homeric Hymns

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment Simultaneous
patterns.context: The word “Simultaneous” as a title or abstract opening; followed by different medical research topics

11_1821.description: 激活覆盖多种无明显语义关联的词首或短语：数学加号、Life、Menisci、pretty good、Homeric，以及医学摘要反复出现的 Simultaneous。共同规律可能是对特定词形/子词的局部响应。

patterns.name: 算术表达式中的加号
patterns.context: 数学式中出现加号，后接数字、运算符或变量；另有“Calculate r(22).”

patterns.name: 短语 Life and politics
patterns.context: 标题式短语“Life and politics”，后文为“from the Sunshine State's”

patterns.name: 生物学词首 life history traits
patterns.context: 生命史性状与体型相关的摘要表述

patterns.name: 词首 Menisci
patterns.context: 被拆分的专有/技术词“Menisci”，后文谈功能、负荷分布与稳定性

patterns.name: 口语评价 pretty good
patterns.context: 非正式第一人称叙述，后接“i went to a broker”

patterns.name: 词首 Homeric
patterns.context: 标题“Hom­ eric prayer”，随后介绍《荷马赞歌》作品

patterns.name: 词首 Simultaneous
patterns.context: 单词“Simultaneous”作为标题或摘要开头；后接不同医学研究主题

en.concept: Word forms and local textual cues
en.description: Activations are scattered across the beginning of Life, several segmented word forms and proper names, publication and paper markers, and local words such as held and gas; styles and semantics vary widely, so no single stable meaning explains them.

patterns.name: Life at the beginning of a word or phrase
patterns.context: At the start of a sentence or phrase, followed by content such as history or and politics.

patterns.name: Specific English word forms or subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on words or name fragments split into multiple tokens; surrounding contexts vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Medical, biological, geographic, publication, and academic texts

patterns.name: Publication formats and special markers
patterns.context: Appears in journal copyright/publication metadata or at positions of technical abbreviations.

patterns.name: held in a conference announcement
patterns.context: Used with conference arrangements, date and time, and location information.

patterns.name: gas followed by anomalous text
