patterns.context: gas is followed by unchanged and an ellipsis, then tried to pop up.
patterns.domain: Corporate email; context fragment is incomplete

patterns.name: Long-term learning and networks in a title
patterns.context: A research title about testing promoting long-term learning, stable activation patterns, and brain-region networks.

patterns.name: Entry title and repeated place name
patterns.context: The entry title Bailly Lake is followed by a repetition of the place name; River South appears in parentheses.

patterns.name: Paper structure markers and technical terms
patterns.context: An introduction subsection heading followed by a technical explanation of automated data collection.

patterns.name: held in a sentence about financial thresholds
patterns.context: Describes reserves exceeding a certain threshold, held at a central bank, and negative interest rates.

11_1821.description: 激活分散于 Life 词首、若干被拆分的词形/专名、出版与论文标记，以及 held、gas 等局部词项；文体和语义跨度很大，无法由单一稳定语义解释。

patterns.name: 词首 Life
patterns.context: 句首或短语开头，后接 history、and politics 等内容。

patterns.name: 特定英文词形或子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分成多个 token 的词或名称片段上；各处邻接上下文差异较大。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物、地名、出版信息及学术文本

patterns.name: 出版物格式与特殊标记
patterns.context: 出现在期刊版权/出版元数据或专业缩写位置。
patterns.domain: 哲学期刊元数据、晶体学论文

patterns.name: 会议通知中的 held
patterns.context: 与会议安排、日期时间及地点信息连用。

patterns.name: gas 及后续异常文本
patterns.context: gas 后接 unchanged 和省略号，随后出现 tried to pop up。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件，语境片段不完整

patterns.name: 标题中的长时程学习与网络
patterns.context: 关于测试促进长期学习、稳定激活模式及脑区网络的研究标题。

patterns.name: 条目标题与重复地名
patterns.context: 专名 Bailly Lake 的条目标题后重复该地名；River South 出现在括号内。

patterns.name: 论文结构标记及技术术语
patterns.context: 引言小节标题及其后关于自动化数据采集的技术说明。

patterns.name: 句中 held 与金融阈值语境
patterns.context: 描述超过一定阈值、存放于中央银行的储备及负利率。

en.description: The main response is to recurring Let definitions, numbers, and operators in math exercises, followed by instructions to evaluate, round, solve equations, or factorize; answer line-break formatting is also covered. The first passage describes summations and numerical methods in a statistical analysis.

patterns.name: Let definition phrasing in math problems
patterns.context: First assigns values to variables or defines a function/object, often followed immediately by a question, an operation request, or another Let sentence.
patterns.domain: Automatically generated math problems in DM Mathematics; also seen in descriptions of data-processing steps in papers.

patterns.name: Solving or calculation instructions in math problems
patterns.context: Asks to evaluate, solve, factorize, or round a just-defined value, equation, or polynomial; often appears as a question or imperative.
patterns.domain: Arithmetic and algebra exercises in DM Mathematics.

patterns.name: Line-break marker after a calculation result
patterns.context: A line break follows the answer to a math problem, often immediately followed by the next problem; the marker itself or the answer position may contribute to activation.

patterns.name: Numbers and arithmetic expressions
patterns.context: Digits and operators appear in variable assignments, arithmetic operations, equations, or lists of candidate values; specific forms vary widely.
patterns.domain: Math problems focused mainly on arithmetic and algebra; the first passage also includes numerical operations in a statistical analysis.

patterns.name: Summation in a description of statistical methods
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence discussing approximating a curve with a step function and replacing an integral with a sum; this is not an exercise template.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central academic paper, description of data analysis methods.

11_1821.description: 主要响应数学练习中反复出现的 Let 定义、数值与运算符，以及随后的求值、舍入、解方程或因式分解指令；还覆盖答案换行格式。第1段是统计分析中的 summations 和数值方法说明。

patterns.name: 数学题中的 Let 定义句式
patterns.context: 先给变量赋值或定义函数/对象，常紧接着出现问题、运算要求或另一个 Let 句。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 自动生成的数学题；也见于论文对数据处理步骤的说明。

patterns.name: 数学题中的求解或计算指令
patterns.context: 要求对刚定义的数值、方程或多项式进行求值、求解、因式分解或舍入；常以问句或祈使句出现。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 算术与代数练习。

patterns.name: 计算结果后的换行标记
patterns.trigger: “↵”及其后的数字答案或简短输出
patterns.context: 数学题答案之后换行，随后常立即开始下一题；标记本身或答案位置可能参与激活。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 问答数据格式。

patterns.name: 数值与算术表达式
patterns.context: 变量赋值、算术运算、方程或候选数值列表中出现数字和运算符；具体形式差异很大。
patterns.domain: 以算术和代数为主的数学题；第1段另有统计分析中的数值运算叙述。

patterns.name: 统计方法说明中的求和
patterns.context: 在讨论将曲线近似为阶梯函数、积分由求和替代的句子中出现；不属于练习题模板。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 学术论文，数据分析方法说明。

en.concept: Instructions and expressions in math problems
en.description: Activations concentrate on DM Mathematics problem text: primarily instructions to simplify powers and fractions and expressions with rational exponents, also covering adjacent math question-answer formats such as true/false judgments, numerical comparisons, and simple arithmetic evaluation.

patterns.name: Simplifying powers and fractions
patterns.context: Asks to simplify an algebraic expression containing variable powers; often includes a condition that variables are positive, followed by the simplified result and then the next problem.

patterns.name: True/false judgments and numerical comparisons
patterns.context: Natural-language questions ask for judgments or comparisons about expressions, values, or complex numbers, followed by True/False or the objects being compared.
patterns.domain: Question-answer math problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Arithmetic evaluation
patterns.context: Asks to calculate a given simple numerical expression, followed by a numerical answer.

11_1821.concept: 数学题目指令与表达式
11_1821.description: 激活集中于 DM Mathematics 题目文本：主要响应幂与分式化简指令及有理指数表达式，也覆盖真假判断、数值比较和简单算术求值等相邻的数学问答格式。

patterns.name: 化简幂与分式
patterns.trigger: “Simplify”以及变量幂、分式和有理指数，如 “a**(-2...)”、“assuming ... is positive”
patterns.context: 要求化简含变量幂的代数式；常附变量为正的条件，随后给出化简结果，并接续下一道题。

patterns.name: 真假判断与数值比较
patterns.context: 以自然语言提出关于表达式、数值或复数的判断/比较问题，随后输出 True/False 或比较对象。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的问答式数学题

patterns.name: 算术求值
patterns.trigger: “value of”及“Calculate”，并出现整数加减表达式
patterns.context: 要求计算给定的简单数值表达式，随后给出数值答案。

en.description: The main response is to high-degree polynomials and factorization expressions in math problems, also covering transitions between problem statements; there is also activation for a third-derivative problem and a metric unit-conversion problem.

patterns.name: Algebraic factorization
patterns.context: Presents a high-degree polynomial and asks for factorization; some examples include the factorized form as the answer.

patterns.name: Follow-up problem statement in algebra questions
patterns.context: Another algebra problem or the beginning of a problem statement follows the answer to a factorization problem.
patterns.domain: Sequences of problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Derivative problem and answer
patterns.context: Asks for the third derivative of a function with respect to a variable, followed by a polynomial-form answer.

patterns.name: Metric unit conversion
patterns.context: Asks for a quantity to be converted between metric units, often ending with a numerical answer followed by the next problem.

patterns.name: Question about an x-term in a polynomial
patterns.context: After a numerical or algebraic expression, asks for a specified-degree term in a polynomial; the problem is truncated in the excerpt.

11_1821.concept: 数学题中的代数表达式
11_1821.description: 主要响应数学题中的高次多项式及因式分解表达式，也覆盖题干衔接；另对三阶导数题和公制单位换算题有激活。

patterns.name: 代数因式分解
patterns.trigger: 多项式中的 «*»、«**»、变量字母，以及 «Factor»
patterns.context: 呈现高次多项式并要求因式分解；部分样例含有已分解形式作为答案。

patterns.name: 代数题中的后续题干
patterns.context: 因式分解题的答案后紧接着出现下一道代数题或题干开头。

patterns.name: 导数题及其答案
patterns.context: 询问函数对变量的三阶导数，随后给出多项式形式的答案。

patterns.name: 公制单位换算
patterns.context: 询问数量在公制单位间的换算，常以数值答案结束并接续下一题。

patterns.name: 多项式的 x 项提问
patterns.context: 在一个数值或代数表达式之后，询问多项式中指定次项；题目在截取处未完整显示。

en.description: Activations are cross-domain and scattered: they often occur on English function words, boundaries, and intra-word subword fragments; they also involve time/length quantification, legal procedures, and biological/environmental terms. Swedish parliamentary fragments and proper names are difficult to explain under a unified account.

patterns.name: English function words and fragment boundaries
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across syntactic function words, prepositions, articles, conjunctions, and near line breaks or bullet points, especially near sentence or paragraph boundaries.
patterns.domain: English prose across multiple domains, including academic, legal, encyclopedic, and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Specific substrings segmented within words
patterns.context: Activation sometimes falls on word fragments spanning subword segmentation; some examples correspond to complete words or stems, with no clear evidence of a unified semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, legal, and Swedish parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Descriptions of quantities, time, and length
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions quantifying length, seasonality, duration, age, or time windows; triggers are scattered and may simply reflect local collocations.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic, ecological, legal, and statistical papers

patterns.name: Legal litigation phrasing
patterns.context: Appears in legal discussion of litigation facts, procedures, deadlines, and the responsibilities of parties.

patterns.name: Biological and environmental research terms
patterns.context: Involves organisms, spores, ecological environments, or related measurements; the “spore” fragment shows strong activation in two passages.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, patent background, and ecology-related legal materials

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names and entities
patterns.context: Activation falls on proper names or their segmented fragments, but the entity classes and contexts are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary question fragments
patterns.context: Titles or phrases in Swedish parliamentary corpora containing words about minutes and political questions; their relation to the other English passages is unclear.

11_1821.description: 激活跨领域且分散：多见于英文功能词、边界与词内子词片段；另涉及时间/长度量化、法律程序和生物环境术语。瑞典语议会片段及专名触发难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 英文功能词与片段边界
patterns.context: 激活散落在句法功能词、介词、冠词、连词及换行/项目符号附近；尤其句子或段落边界附近。
patterns.domain: 多领域英文散文，包括学术、法律、百科与议会文本

patterns.name: 词内切分的特定子串
patterns.context: 激活有时落在跨子词切分的词片段上；部分例子对应完整词或词干，不能确定是统一语义触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、法律、瑞典语议会文本

patterns.name: 数量、时间与长度表述
patterns.context: 出现在长度、季节性、期限、年龄或时间窗口等量化叙述中；触发分散，可能只是局部搭配。
patterns.domain: 百科、生态学、法律、统计论文

patterns.name: 法律诉讼措辞
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼事实、程序、期限与当事人责任的法律论述中。

patterns.name: 生物与环境研究术语
patterns.context: 涉及生物体、孢子、生态环境或相关测量；其中“spore”片段在两段中有较强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景、生态相关法律材料

patterns.name: 专名与实体词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或专名的分词片段上，但实体类别与语境并不一致。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会问句片段
patterns.trigger: “Anföranden på en minut om frågor av politisk”
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会语料中的标题或短语，包含分钟、政治问题等词；与其余英语段落关联不明。

en.description: Activations are distributed across explanatory noun phrases and relational statements, covering people/geography, nutrition, experimental values and reactions, genes and proteins, soil, and equipment properties; there is no single stable domain or word-meaning pattern.

patterns.name: Complements/modifiers within noun phrases
patterns.context: A noun serves as the head of a sentence or noun phrase, followed by a complement, property description, or result; activation often falls on the noun and adjacent words
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedia, medical/nutrition, and patent texts

patterns.name: Terminological expressions for research subjects or scientific entities
patterns.context: Scientific texts introduce research subjects, molecular entities, or their properties, often in terminological noun phrases

patterns.name: Food, nutrition, and diet-related descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses food access, vegetable intake, diet, or health-related nutritional factors

patterns.name: Numerical values, experimental conditions, and results
patterns.context: Reports conditions, measurements, or results of experimental reactions, with numbers adjacent to units

patterns.name: Proper names and historical/geographic entries
patterns.context: Encyclopedia entries describe historical figures and places, along with their historical or geographic attributes

patterns.name: Statements about research subjects and associations/effects
patterns.context: In a research or explanatory style, states relationships between factors, causes, roles, or effects
patterns.domain: Paper abstracts, gene pathology descriptions, and encyclopedia explanations

patterns.name: Chemical reaction and spectroscopy descriptions
patterns.context: Describes reaction product colors, absorption peaks, or reaction processes

patterns.name: Geographic locations and descriptions of local attributes
patterns.context: Introduces a place’s location, historical prosperity, or local function

patterns.name: Environmental and land-use effects
patterns.context: Describes relationships between vegetation/cultivation and soil properties or changes

patterns.name: Equipment performance and lists of properties
patterns.context: Lists the performance, form, or power-consumption advantages of equipment

11_1821.concept: 说明性文本中的名词短语
11_1821.description: 激活分布于说明性名词短语和关系陈述中：涵盖人物/地理、营养、实验数值与反应、基因蛋白、土壤及设备属性；没有单一稳定的领域或词义模式。

patterns.name: 名词性短语内部的补语/修饰成分
patterns.context: 名词作为句中或名词短语的中心语，后接补语、性质说明或结果；激活常落在名词及其相邻词上
patterns.domain: 百科、医学/营养、专利等多种文体

patterns.name: 研究对象或科学实体的术语表达
patterns.context: 科学文本中介绍研究对象、分子实体或其性质，常见于术语名词短语

patterns.name: 食物、营养与饮食相关表述
patterns.context: 讨论食物获取、蔬菜摄入、饮食或与健康相关的营养因素
patterns.domain: 公共卫生与营养学摘要

patterns.name: 数值与实验条件、结果
patterns.context: 报告实验反应的条件、测量值或结果，数字与单位相邻
patterns.domain: 实验化学/生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 专名与历史地理条目
patterns.context: 百科条目叙述历史人物、地点及其历史或地理属性

patterns.name: 研究对象与关联/作用的陈述
patterns.context: 以研究或说明性语气陈述因素间关系、病因、作用或影响
patterns.domain: 论文摘要、基因病理描述及百科说明

patterns.name: 化学反应与光谱描述
patterns.context: 描述反应产物颜色、吸收峰或反应过程

patterns.name: 地理位置与地方属性描述
patterns.context: 介绍地点位置、历史繁荣或地方功能

patterns.name: 环境与土地利用影响
patterns.context: 描述植被/种植与土壤性质或变化的关系

patterns.name: 设备性能及属性列举
patterns.context: 列举设备的性能、形态或功耗优势

en.description: Activations are distributed across technical, medical, historical, and legal texts, often falling on nominal content words and their local collocations, such as use, conditions, labor, power consumption, storage, trade, court proceedings, and risk factors; function words such as “a” and “its” also recur, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: Specific time or condition constraints
patterns.context: When describing the conditions under which solar energy, weather, or equipment applies, activations appear near “during” and the following condition phrase.

patterns.name: Increased use and antimicrobial resistance risk
patterns.context: Discusses increased use of drugs in agriculture and its relationship to the emergence of drug-resistant bacteria.

patterns.name: Menstrual-cycle factor
patterns.context: When listing predictors of birth weight, strong activation falls on “menstrual”.

patterns.name: Inheritance among relatives and financial settlement
patterns.context: Historical narrative involving heirs, agreements, creditors, and payments or settlements; strong activations cluster on kinship terms and the article “a”.

patterns.name: Labor-intensive
patterns.context: When comparing the advantages and disadvantages of cell-culture methods, strong activation falls on “labor”.

patterns.name: Device properties and power consumption
patterns.context: When stating the advantages of LCD display devices, the possessive “its” and property words are emphasized consecutively, with the strongest activation on “consumption”.

patterns.name: Storage capacity
patterns.context: Explains the technical relationship between spot-size changes and increased storage capacity; strong activations fall on “potential” and “storage”.

patterns.name: International travel and trade
patterns.context: Public-health rules require controlling disease transmission while avoiding unnecessary interference with international travel and trade; the strongest activation is on “trade”.

patterns.name: Court proceedings
patterns.context: A legal judgment recounts a court taking up a case and reviewing evidence after a hearing; activations cluster on court-related terms, hearing, and the article “a”.

patterns.name: Dietary and physical-activity risk factors
patterns.context: Describes causes of rising obesity or related disease prevalence, involving energy intake, fats and sugars, and reduced activity.

11_1821.description: 激活分布在多种技术、医学、历史与法律文本中，常落于名词性内容词及其局部搭配，如使用、条件、劳动、功耗、存储、贸易、法院程序和风险因素；也多次涉及“a”“its”等功能词，未见统一主题。

patterns.name: 特定时间或条件限制
patterns.context: 描述太阳能、天气或设备适用条件时，激活出现在“during”及其后的条件短语附近。

patterns.name: 使用增加与耐药风险
patterns.context: 讨论农业中药物使用增加及其与耐药菌出现的关系。

patterns.name: 月经周期因素
patterns.context: 列举影响出生体重的预测因素时，强激活落在“menstrual”上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文／出生体重预测

patterns.name: 亲属继承与财务结算
patterns.trigger: great-nephew and heir；a paying out a settlement
patterns.context: 历史叙述涉及继承人、协议、债权人与支付结算；强激活集中在亲属称谓及冠词“a”。

patterns.name: 劳动密集
patterns.context: 比较细胞培养方法的优缺点时，强激活落在“labor”。

patterns.name: 设备属性与功耗
patterns.context: 陈述LCD显示设备的优点时，连续强调所有格“its”及属性词，最高处为“consumption”。

patterns.name: 存储容量
patterns.context: 解释光斑尺寸变化与存储容量提升的技术关系，强激活落在“potential”“storage”。

patterns.name: 国际交通与贸易
patterns.context: 公共卫生规则要求控制疾病传播，同时避免对国际往来和贸易造成不必要干扰；最高处为“trade”。

patterns.name: 法院审理程序
patterns.context: 法律判决叙述法院受理案件并在听证后审查证据；激活集中于法院、听证及冠词“a”。

patterns.name: 饮食与体力活动风险因素
patterns.trigger: consumption of energy-dense food；reduced physical activity
patterns.context: 描述肥胖或相关疾病流行上升的原因，涉及能量摄入、脂肪糖分及活动减少。

en.description: Activations are scattered across different word classes and topics: possessive pronouns, relative pronouns, articles in time phrases, technical storage and performance terms, trade and questionnaire words, and is in a patent sentence. No single semantic or syntactic pattern covers all examples.

patterns.name: Emphasis on possessive her
patterns.context: A legal argument explains someone’s ownership of land or property and their claim; preceded by vested in her by virtue of.

patterns.name: their in an anniversary account
patterns.context: Describes a marriage lasting many years and mentions a shared anniversary celebration; their refers to the couple.

patterns.name: Storage capacity or density
patterns.context: Discusses storage capacity, density, or performance improvements in nonvolatile memory.

patterns.name: Trade relationships
patterns.context: Describes Brazilian beef exports and trade relationships with multiple countries.
patterns.domain: Background in a biomedical paper/agricultural economics

patterns.name: the in a time span
patterns.context: Recounts a player’s league career after a transfer and summarizes their appearances over a period of time.

patterns.name: whose in a relative clause
patterns.context: In an account of family relations, whose introduces someone’s daughter and her marriage.

patterns.name: leisure as a questionnaire dimension
patterns.context: Lists quality-of-life dimensions in a patient questionnaire, alongside daily activities, work, and school.

patterns.name: their in a royal succession account
patterns.context: Recounts royal rule and regency, and identifies their son in common.

patterns.name: is in technical requirements
patterns.context: A patent abstract states that a material’s dielectric constant needs to be reduced further; the highest marker actually falls on is.

11_1821.description: 激活分散于不同词类和主题：所有格代词、关系代词、时间短语中的冠词、技术存储与性能词、贸易和问卷词，以及专利句中的 is。未见能覆盖全部例子的单一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 所有格 her 的强调
patterns.context: 法律论证中，说明某人对土地或财产的所有权及其主张；前有 vested in her by virtue of。

patterns.name: 周年纪念中的 their
patterns.context: 描述婚姻关系持续多年，并提到共同庆祝周年；their 指夫妻双方。

patterns.name: 存储容量或密度
patterns.trigger: potential storage capacity（[3] 中 «storage»10）；storage density（[6] 中 «storage»10）
patterns.context: 讨论存储容量、密度或非易失性存储器性能提升。

patterns.name: 贸易关系
patterns.context: 描述巴西牛肉出口及其与多个国家的贸易关系。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的背景介绍／农业经济

patterns.name: 时间跨度中的 the
patterns.context: 叙述球员转会后的联赛生涯，并以一段时间概括其出场情况。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 whose
patterns.context: 人物关系叙述中，whose 引出某人的女儿及其婚姻关系。

patterns.name: 问卷维度中的 leisure
patterns.context: 列举患者问卷的生活质量维度，与日常活动、工作和学校并列。

patterns.name: 王室继承关系中的 their
patterns.context: 叙述王室成员的统治与摄政，并指出其共同的儿子。

patterns.name: 技术需求中的 is
patterns.trigger: a further reduction is required（[10] 中 «is»9）
patterns.context: 专利摘要说明材料介电常数仍需进一步降低；最高标记实际落在 is。

en.concept: Common syntactic fragments in formal English statements
en.description: Activations occur on common function words and perfect-tense syntactic fragments in formal English texts; specific meanings vary by field, covering patents, law, biography, technology, trade, ecology, and biology, with no single specialized theme.

patterns.name: English function words and common phrases
patterns.context: These high-frequency words occur in grammatically complete English sentences, clauses, or fixed phrases; the specific trigger words differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose and formal texts

patterns.name: Perfect tense and existential statements
patterns.context: has occurs with been to express an ongoing state or something that has occurred; common in background introductions and technical literature.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, patent backgrounds, academic papers

patterns.name: Wording of expectations and needs
patterns.context: Describes a method or improvement as strongly anticipated, in a problem statement in a patent background.

patterns.name: Statements about quantity, capacity, and growth
patterns.context: Technical discussion of optical parameters, storage capacity, and changes in proportions, including formulas and symbols.

patterns.name: Biographical time span and employment history
patterns.context: Introduces a person's birth, start date in a position, and prior experience, emphasizing duration or position.

patterns.name: Court procedures and judgment language
patterns.context: Describes a court hearing, type of procedure, parties, or judgment in a legal case; includes legal citations and formal legal phrasing.

patterns.name: National economy and trade overview
patterns.context: States the size of Brazil's industries, global rankings, exports, and number of trading partners.
patterns.domain: Background economic overview in a biomedical article

patterns.name: Ecological harm and biological effects
patterns.context: Describes the effects of species or ecological factors on bodies of water, wetlands, and local biodiversity, and mentions reproduction and spread.

patterns.name: Prior art and disclosure in patents
patterns.context: Describes existing technical solutions and their disclosures, then notes shortcomings or limitations of the relevant technology.

patterns.name: Species characteristics and research value
patterns.context: Introduces marine fish species, distribution, appearance, and ecological or commercial importance.

11_1821.concept: 正式英文陈述中的常见句法片段
11_1821.description: 激活分布于正式英文文本中的常见功能词与完成时等句法片段；具体语义随领域变化，涵盖专利、法律、传记、技术、贸易及生态和生物学叙述，未见单一专属主题。

patterns.name: 英文功能词与常见短语
patterns.context: 这些高频词出现在语法完整的英文句子、从句或固定短语中；不同段中具体触发词不同。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文与正式文本

patterns.name: 完成时及存在性表述
patterns.context: has 与 been 连用，表示持续状态或已发生的陈述；常见于背景介绍和技术文献。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、专利背景、学术论文

patterns.name: 期望与需求措辞
patterns.context: 描述某项方法或改进受到强烈期待，位于专利背景中的问题陈述。

patterns.name: 数量、容量及增长表述
patterns.context: 围绕光学参数、存储容量及比例变化的技术论述，包含公式和符号。

patterns.name: 传记时间跨度与任职经历
patterns.context: 介绍人物出生、任职起始时间及此前经历，强调持续年限或职位。

patterns.name: 法院程序与判决措辞
patterns.context: 司法案件中描述法院审理、程序类型、当事人或判决；有法律引文和正式程式语。

patterns.name: 国家经济与贸易概况
patterns.context: 陈述巴西产业规模、全球排名、出口及贸易伙伴数量。
patterns.domain: 生物医学文章中的背景性经济介绍

patterns.name: 生态危害与生物学影响
patterns.context: 描述物种或生态因素对水体、湿地及本地生物多样性的影响，并提及繁殖和扩散。

patterns.name: 专利现有技术与披露
patterns.context: 说明已有技术方案及其披露内容，随后转折指出相关技术的不足或局限。

patterns.name: 物种特征与研究价值
patterns.context: 介绍海洋鱼类的种类、分布、外观及生态或商业重要性。

en.concept: Statements after contrast and emphasis of facts
en.description: Activations occur across different domains; they are more common in technical discussion where a contrast introduces limitations, problems, or needs, and also appear in assertions about change and importance. Other sporadic examples involve wedding anniversaries, cat gestation periods, and various technical terms.

patterns.name: Contrast following a problem or limitation
patterns.context: After an earlier statement about technology, a method, or the current state, the text shifts to identify shortcomings, problems, or subsequent needs; there is marked activation near the contrastive word and following discussion.

patterns.name: Assertions about results, trends, or importance
patterns.context: Makes a strong assertion about a property, need, problem, or development trend, often using perfect tense or expressions of ongoing change; specific trigger points are scattered.

patterns.name: Adverb emphasizing practical desirability
patterns.context: Appears in “it is practically desirable to use …”, emphasizing the practical desirability of an option.

patterns.name: Anniversary and marriage accounts
patterns.context: A biographical account describes a marriage and its anniversary; no clear thematic correspondence to other passages.

patterns.name: Animal gestation period
patterns.context: Activation occurs in an encyclopedia description of cats when stating the gestation period.

patterns.name: Specific technical terms or topic words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across nouns and predicates in different technical topics, with no common condition sufficient to show that these topic words themselves form a unified trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Technical or academic texts on materials, devices, medicine, memory, etc.

11_1821.concept: 转折后陈述与事实强调
11_1821.description: 激活分布在不同领域；较常见于技术论述中转折后指出局限、问题或需求，也见于变化与重要性断言。另有周年婚姻、猫的妊娠期及各类专业术语等零散实例。

patterns.name: 问题或局限后的转折
patterns.context: 在先前陈述技术、方法或现状后，转入指出不足、问题或后续需求；转折词附近及其后的论述有明显激活。

patterns.name: 结果、趋势或重要性谓述
patterns.trigger: “has … risen”, “has … been problematic”, “has … not been recognized”, “still … the case”, “continuing process”
patterns.context: 对某性质、需求、问题或发展趋势作较强断言，常用完成时或进行中的变化表达；具体触发点分散。

patterns.name: 程度副词强调实际性
patterns.context: 出现在“it is practically desirable to use …”中，强调某方案在实际上的可取性。

patterns.name: 周年纪念与婚姻叙述
patterns.context: 人物传记中叙述结婚及其婚姻周年；没有明显对应其他段的主题。

patterns.name: 动物妊娠期
patterns.context: 猫的百科描述中陈述妊娠期时激活。

patterns.name: 特定专业名词或主题词
patterns.context: 激活分散在不同专业主题的名词和谓述中，未见足以证明这些主题词本身构成统一触发模式的共同条件。
patterns.domain: 材料、器件、医学、记忆体等技术或学术文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal documents, patent backgrounds, biographies, religious prose, and scientific abstracts; local clues include shelf, marriage/property, judgment enforcement, difficulty, and shortcomings, but no consistent semantic trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: shelf / terms related to temporal stability
patterns.context: [1] directly discusses a product's shelf life stability; in [8], shelf refers to the continental shelf in “on the shelf of the south-east Brazil Bight”.

patterns.name: Acquisition of legal property and marital status
patterns.context: A statute lists cases involving property acquired before or after marriage, by gift, or after a judgment of separation.

patterns.name: Wedding anniversary and long duration
patterns.context: A biographical account describes a marriage and the seventieth wedding anniversary.

patterns.name: Judges and applications in legal documents
patterns.context: A court case caption or a judge speaks in the first person, stating their role and addressing an application.

patterns.name: A long, difficult period after welcoming someone home
patterns.context: A metaphor of a wife welcoming someone back from an expedition introduces the church's feelings after a long period of hardship.

patterns.name: Research or development not yet fully completed
patterns.context: Explains that steam conditions are difficult to adjust during partial-load operation and that related research and development are insufficient.

patterns.name: Judgment and execution sale
patterns.context: Recounts a creditor obtaining rights based on a judgment and an execution sale.

patterns.name: Continental shelf in a scientific abstract
patterns.context: Describes the spawning habitat, egg density, and ocean conditions of Brazilian sardines.

patterns.name: Statements of problems, defects, or difficulties
patterns.context: Points out safety issues from glass breakage, difficulty adjusting technology, or golf-club parameters insufficient to demonstrate trajectory height.

patterns.name: Legal claims and acquisition of property through enforcement
patterns.context: Recounts a North Dakota entity obtaining a claim against a company and recovering through an execution sale.

11_1821.description: 激活分布在法律文书、专利背景、传记、宗教散文和科学摘要中；局部线索包括 shelf、婚姻/财产、判决执行、困难或不足等，未见统一稳定的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: shelf / 时间稳定性相关词
patterns.context: [1]中直接讨论产品的 shelf life stability；[8]中 shelf 指海洋大陆架，处于“on the shelf of the south-east Brazil Bight”中。
patterns.domain: 专利材料/食品技术；海洋科学

patterns.name: 法律财产取得与婚姻状态
patterns.context: 条文列举婚姻前后、赠与或分居判决后取得财产的情形。

patterns.name: 婚姻纪念与长期年数
patterns.context: 人物传记叙述婚姻及结婚七十周年。

patterns.name: 司法文书中的法官与申请
patterns.context: 法院案件标题或法官以第一人称陈述身份并处理申请。

patterns.name: 迎接归来后的漫长艰难时期
patterns.context: 以妻子迎接远征归来的比喻，引出教会经历漫长困苦后的感受。

patterns.name: 尚未充分完成的研究或开发
patterns.context: 说明部分负载运行时蒸汽条件难以调整，相关研究开发尚不充分。

patterns.name: 判决与执行拍卖
patterns.context: 叙述债权人依据判决及执行拍卖取得权利。

patterns.name: 科学摘要中的大陆架
patterns.context: 描述巴西沙丁鱼产卵栖息地、卵密度及海洋条件。

patterns.name: 问题、缺陷或困难的陈述
patterns.context: 指出玻璃破碎的安全问题、技术调整困难或高尔夫球杆参数不足以展示弹道高度。

patterns.name: 法律债权与执行取得财产
patterns.context: 叙述北达科他州机构对公司取得债权并通过执行拍卖追偿。

en.description: The response pattern is not unitary: multiple passages are directly triggered by “shelf life,” while others cover local topics such as marriage, long periods, legal property, glass safety, code functions, famine history, and contraception. Temporal persistence is shared across some passages, but the remaining topics lack a common trigger.

patterns.name: shelf life／storage life
patterns.context: The phrase appears directly in discussions of the usable life, stability, or expiration period of items, food ingredients, or freeze-dried bacteria in storage.
patterns.domain: Accounting, patent technical descriptions, food and biological products

patterns.name: Marriage and wedding anniversaries
patterns.context: Accounts of marriage, spouses, or wedding anniversaries; [4] uses a wife welcoming her husband as a metaphor.

patterns.name: Duration, long-term use, or long-term experience
patterns.context: Describes lifespan, experience, or use in terms of duration or long-term persistence.

patterns.name: Legal property acquisition and separation orders
patterns.context: Lists categories of property acquired during marriage or after a decree of legal separation.

patterns.name: Safety issues after glass breakage
patterns.context: Explains that inorganic glass is fragile and that shard shapes pose safety hazards.

patterns.name: PHP／MySQL code identifier
patterns.context: A database connection error-checking function embedded in HTML/PHP code.

patterns.name: Famine and historical events
patterns.context: Uses a historical famine as a prominent research example and gives its date.

patterns.name: Long-term use of contraception
patterns.context: Describes the efficacy, reversibility, and continued use of contraceptive methods such as IUDs.

11_1821.description: 反应模式并不单一：多段直接触发于“shelf life”，另有婚姻、长期时段、法律财产、玻璃安全、代码函数、饥荒史和避孕等局部主题。时间持续性在部分段落间相通，但其余主题缺乏共同触发条件。

patterns.name: shelf life／保存期
patterns.context: 直接出现短语，讨论物品、食品配料或冻干细菌在储存中的可用期限、稳定性或保质期。
patterns.domain: 会计、专利技术说明、食品与生物制品

patterns.name: 婚姻及结婚周年
patterns.context: 婚姻关系、配偶或婚姻周年的叙述；[4]以妻子迎接丈夫作比喻。

patterns.name: 持续时间、长期使用或长期经历
patterns.context: 以时间长度或长期持续性描述寿命、经历或使用。

patterns.name: 法律财产取得与分居判令
patterns.context: 列举婚姻期间或法定分居判令后的财产取得类别。

patterns.name: 玻璃破碎后的安全问题
patterns.context: 说明无机玻璃易碎，碎片形状带来安全隐患。

patterns.name: PHP／MySQL代码标识符
patterns.context: 嵌在 HTML/PHP 代码中的数据库连接错误检查函数。

patterns.name: 饥荒及历史事件
patterns.context: 以历史饥荒作为研究中的突出实例，并给出年代。

patterns.name: 避孕方法的长期使用
patterns.context: 描述 IUD 等避孕方式的效果、可逆性及持续使用。

en.description: Activations are distributed across biographical kinship, legal documents, novel dialogue and winter-night descriptions, historical figures, religious organizations, Portuguese parliamentary speeches, and materials patent discussions; there is no obvious shared trigger word or single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Kinship and wedding anniversaries
patterns.context: In biographical narrative, describes family relationships, children, or marriage, and mentions a family event or wedding anniversary.

patterns.name: Legal cases and terminology
patterns.context: Court case materials contain terms for parties, criminal convictions, probation, or legal practice.

patterns.name: Invitation to dinner
patterns.context: Dialogue politely invites someone to dinner that evening and specifies the time.

patterns.name: Winter-night descriptions and emotional experience
patterns.context: First-person narrative connects winter and long, dark nights with life experience or emotion.

patterns.name: Historical figures and their experiences
patterns.context: Introduces a historical religious figure in evaluative terms and recounts their experiences in a particular place.
patterns.domain: Historical biography or religious history narrative

patterns.name: Reconciliation and meetings among religious organizations
patterns.context: Recounts changes in relations between Baptist organizations and a meeting held to reach reconciliation.
patterns.domain: Religious organizational history or encyclopedia entry

patterns.name: Portuguese speech in the European Parliament
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech opens with formal address to the chair, commissioners, and members, then presents arguments in Portuguese.

patterns.name: Fluorescent properties of materials
patterns.context: Patent background discusses optical or fluorescent properties of organic materials and points out limitations in prior research.

11_1821.description: 激活分散于传记亲属关系、法律文书、小说对话与冬夜描写、历史人物、宗教组织、葡语议会发言及材料专利论述；没有明显共同触发词或单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 亲属关系与婚姻周年
patterns.trigger: “had an older son who died in infancy”；“he married … daughter of a naval officer”；“their 70th anniversary of marriage”
patterns.context: 人物传记叙述中，说明亲属关系、子女或婚姻，并提及家庭事件或结婚周年。

patterns.name: 法律案件与法律术语
patterns.trigger: “For the appellant”；“probationary period has expired”；“moral turpitude”；“this court”；“State Bar”
patterns.context: 法院案件材料中出现当事人称谓、刑事定罪、缓刑或律师执业相关术语。

patterns.name: 邀请共进晚餐
patterns.trigger: “do me the favor to dine with me this evening”；“now only about an hour to six”
patterns.context: 对话中礼貌邀请某人当晚共进晚餐，并交代时间。

patterns.name: 冬夜描写及情感感受
patterns.trigger: “one winter is more than enough”；“During the long, dark evenings, as I sat”
patterns.context: 第一人称叙事将冬季、漫长昏暗的夜晚与生活体验或感情联系起来。

patterns.name: 历史人物及其经历
patterns.trigger: “the pious bishop of Chiapa”；“This amiable man, during his residence in Spanish America”
patterns.context: 以评价性措辞介绍历史宗教人物，并转述其在某地的经历。
patterns.domain: 历史传记或宗教史叙述

patterns.name: 宗教组织的和解与会议
patterns.trigger: “Association of Fundamental Baptist Churches”；“Bible Believing Churches of the Philippines reconciled at a convention held in 1997”
patterns.context: 叙述浸信会组织之间的关系变化，以及召开会议达成和解。
patterns.domain: 宗教组织史或百科条目

patterns.name: 欧洲议会葡语发言
patterns.trigger: “Senhor Presidente, Senhor Comissário, Senhoras e Senhores Deputados”；“há presentemente muitas razões”
patterns.context: 议会发言以正式称呼主持人、委员及议员开场，随后用葡萄牙语陈述理由。

patterns.name: 材料荧光性质研究
patterns.trigger: “non-linear optical material”；“organic EL material”；“fluorescent property”；“solution state”；“it is still the case”
patterns.context: 专利背景技术讨论有机材料的光学或荧光性质，并指出既有研究局限。

en.description: Activation is distributed: marriage, spouses, and anniversaries are most prominent; other passages concern long-term continuation or return, milestones in people’s careers, sleep EEG, obesity and dietary interventions, legal procedures, and attachment to one’s hometown. The domains and vocabulary are not uniform.

patterns.name: Marriage and anniversaries
patterns.context: Marriage, spousal status, or a wedding anniversary is central to the sentence; also appears in religious allegory.

patterns.name: Long periods and continuity
patterns.context: Mentions long-term persistence, the passage of time, continuity between past and present, or a return.

patterns.name: Identity or career milestones
patterns.context: Introduces a person’s identity, promotion, or a turning point or return in their career; triggers are distributed and do not require a specific sentence structure.

patterns.name: Sleep-related EEG activity
patterns.context: Describes changes in EEG frequency at sleep onset.

patterns.name: Diet and obesity interventions
patterns.context: Describes dietary and exercise interventions for preventing or treating obesity.

patterns.name: Legal procedures and rulings
patterns.context: Legal provisions or litigation decisions explain eligibility, marital status, or appellate review.

patterns.name: Hometown and attachment
patterns.context: A person recalls their birthplace and expresses lasting emotional attachment.

11_1821.description: 激活分布较散：婚姻、配偶与周年最显著；另涉及长期延续或回归、人物生涯节点、睡眠脑电、肥胖饮食干预、法律程序及故乡依恋，领域和词汇均不统一。

patterns.name: 婚姻及周年
patterns.context: 婚姻关系、配偶身份或结婚周年是句子中心；也出现在宗教寓喻中。

patterns.name: 长时段与延续
patterns.trigger: “70th anniversary”“long night”“grew older”“still seemed to cling”“has served”“never appeared ... again”
patterns.context: 提及长期持续、岁月流逝、过去与现在的延续或回归。
patterns.domain: 百科、文学、人物传记、体育报道

patterns.name: 身份或职业生涯节点
patterns.trigger: “episcopal elevation”“is a Norwegian fencer”“his return to Tamworth”
patterns.context: 介绍人物身份、晋升或生涯中的转折、回归；触发分散，不要求特定句式。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、体育报道

patterns.name: 睡眠相关脑电活动
patterns.context: 描述睡眠起始时的脑电频率变化。

patterns.name: 饮食与肥胖干预
patterns.context: 陈述预防或治疗肥胖的饮食、运动干预。

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁决
patterns.trigger: “preference status”“by reason of a marriage determined by the Attorney General”；“dissolution of marriage proceeding”“appellate review”
patterns.context: 法律条文或诉讼判决中说明资格、婚姻关系或上诉审查。

patterns.name: 故乡与依恋
patterns.context: 人物回忆出生故乡，表达持续的情感依恋。

en.description: Activations cluster in narratives about marriage, spouses, and women, while also covering more sporadic patterns involving nights or long periods of hardship, employment or residence, sleep research, parliamentary responses, and facial expressions; no single surface pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: Narratives of marriage and spousal relationships
patterns.context: Biographical or narrative texts mention marriage, marital status, a spouse, or a wedding anniversary; especially evident in passages 1, 2, 3, and 7

patterns.name: Long or dark nights
patterns.context: Uses night or darkness to describe duration, hardship, or a metaphorical phase

patterns.name: Terms for women and marriage
patterns.context: Mentions women or groups of women; some contexts also involve marriage, but not all such terms are directly related to marriage events

patterns.name: During a term of office or residence
patterns.context: Recounts events during a person's appointment to a position or residence in a place; not necessarily related to marriage

patterns.name: Sleep and sleep onset
patterns.context: Research literature describes sleep onset and sleep EEG measures

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary response
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech asks or promises to respond before the meeting begins
patterns.domain: European Parliament record, formal speech in Portuguese

patterns.name: Generalization in a speech
patterns.context: A quotation makes a general judgment about the role of women on important occasions

patterns.name: Description of a surprised expression
patterns.context: Depicts a character's facial reaction to a situation

11_1821.description: 激活集中于婚姻、配偶及女性人物的叙述，也覆盖夜晚/漫长艰难时期、任职或居留、睡眠科研、议会应答和人物表情等较零散模式；没有一个词面模式能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 婚姻及配偶关系叙述
patterns.trigger: “marriage”“married”“husband”“wife”“anniversary of marriage”；葡语“terá uma resposta”不属于此模式
patterns.context: 人物传记或叙事中谈及结婚、婚姻状况、配偶或婚姻纪念；第1、2、3、7段尤明显

patterns.name: 漫长或黑暗的夜晚
patterns.trigger: “long, dark evenings”“long night”“after her long night of toil”
patterns.context: 用夜晚或黑夜描述持续的时间、艰难经历或隐喻性阶段

patterns.name: 女性及婚姻相关称谓
patterns.context: 提及女性人物或女性群体；部分语境同时涉及婚姻，但此类词并不都与结婚事件直接相连

patterns.name: 任职或驻留期间
patterns.trigger: “appointment to the charge of Salem Chapel”“during his residence in Spanish America”
patterns.context: 叙述人物受任某职或在某地居留期间发生的经历；与婚姻主题不必然相关

patterns.name: 睡眠及睡眠起始
patterns.context: 科研文献中描述睡眠起始及睡眠脑电指标

patterns.name: 葡语议会应答
patterns.trigger: “resposta antes do início da sessão”“terá uma resposta”
patterns.context: 议会发言中询问或承诺在会议开始前作答
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录、葡语正式发言

patterns.name: 演说中的普遍判断
patterns.trigger: “On great occasions, it is almost always women”
patterns.context: 引用文字中对女性在重大场合所起作用作概括性判断

patterns.name: 惊讶表情描写
patterns.context: 描绘人物面对情形时的面部反应

en.description: Activation is distributed across the English definite article, possessives referring to people, and feminine pronouns in literature; it also includes ter and agradeço in Portuguese parliamentary contexts, as well as a chemical structural term. No single semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: Strong triggers for English the
patterns.context: The definite article in English narrative or expository text, often at the beginning of a noun phrase; not every occurrence of the is active, and strength depends on the specific context.

patterns.name: English possessive his
patterns.context: The English possessive determiner followed by a noun describing a person’s experience, possessions, or relationships; activation also occurs for the closely related “their”.
patterns.domain: English historical and biographical narratives, sports biographies, literature

patterns.name: Inflected forms of Portuguese ter
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary speeches, ter serves as an auxiliary or means to have or obtain; adjacent polite expressions and forms of address provide context.

patterns.name: Portuguese expression of thanks agradeço
patterns.context: A polite expression of thanks in a formal parliamentary speech, followed by the beneficiary or relevant matter; shares the Portuguese parliamentary context with the previous pattern, but has a different trigger word.

patterns.name: Her in literary contexts
patterns.context: Refers to a female character in English literary narrative, as a possessive or object pronoun; appears when describing women’s experiences, concerns, or interactions.

patterns.name: Chemical term expected square planar
patterns.context: A paper describes the structural configuration of an iridium complex, with the terms appearing together; no clear connection to the functional-word activations in other passages.

11_1821.description: 激活分散于英语定冠词、人物所有格及文学中的女性代词，也包括葡语议会语境的 ter、agradeço，以及化学结构术语；未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语中的 the 强触发
patterns.trigger: “the”，尤以 “the domestic cup final” 中的 “the” 激活最强；另见 “the last 32”、“the Church of God”、“the evening”、“the expected square planar conformation”
patterns.context: 英语叙述或说明文本中的定冠词，常出现在名词短语开头；并非所有 the 都激活，强度取决于具体上下文。
patterns.domain: 英语 Wikipedia、文学、科学论文

patterns.name: 英语所有格 his
patterns.trigger: “his”，包括 “during his residence”、“his job”、“On his return”、“their marriage”
patterns.context: 英语中所有格限定词后接人物经历、归属或关系名词；激活也见于 closely related 的 “their”。
patterns.domain: 英语历史与人物叙述、体育传记、文学

patterns.name: 葡语 ter 的屈折形式
patterns.trigger: “ter” / “terá”，尤其 “me ter informado” 和 “terá uma resposta”
patterns.context: 葡语议会发言中，ter 作助动词或表示将有、将得到；相邻的礼貌表达与发言称呼构成上下文。

patterns.name: 葡语致谢词 agradeço
patterns.context: 正式议会发言中的礼貌致谢，后接受益人或相关事项；与上一模式同属葡语议会语境，但触发词不同。

patterns.name: 文学语境中的 her
patterns.context: 英语文学叙述中指女性人物，作所有格或宾格；在描写女性经历、疑虑或交往时出现。

patterns.name: 化学术语 expected square planar
patterns.context: 论文描述铱配合物的结构构型，术语共同出现；与其他段落的功能词激活缺乏明确联系。
patterns.domain: PubMed 中的化学研究论文

en.concept: Primarily football biographies and match narratives
en.description: Most passages concern football profiles, coaching, transfers, matches, and results; other passages include a Portuguese parliamentary address and historical prose about Las Casas, which do not fit the football theme.

patterns.name: Football coaching career
patterns.context: A professional biography recounts teams coached, seasons, and appointments or dismissals

patterns.name: Football matches and results
patterns.context: Describes team events, match results, league standings, or cup progress

patterns.name: Player appearances and transfers
patterns.context: Football player biography involving teams, loans, appearances, retirement, or dates

patterns.name: Appearance-based contract terms
patterns.context: A player's contract pay or bonuses are tied to the number of appearances

patterns.name: Portuguese-language speech in the European Parliament
patterns.context: Formal parliamentary address and polite thanks, followed by continuous speech in Portuguese

patterns.name: Religious figure and colonial history narrative
patterns.context: Historical prose introduces a figure and their experiences in Spanish America

11_1821.concept: 足球传记与赛事叙述为主
11_1821.description: 多数段落围绕足球人物履历、执教、转会、比赛及成绩；另有葡萄牙语议会致辞和关于拉斯卡萨斯的历史散文，无法归入足球主题。

patterns.name: 足球执教经历
patterns.context: 人物职业履历中叙述执教球队、赛季及任免

patterns.name: 足球比赛与成绩
patterns.trigger: “European Cup Winners' Cup Final”“League title”“Copa del Rey”“relegation”
patterns.context: 描述球队赛事、比赛结果、联赛名次或杯赛进程

patterns.name: 球员效力与转会
patterns.trigger: “made his Football League debut”“available for loan”“joined Fortuna Köln”“representing”“retired”
patterns.context: 足球运动员履历，涉及球队、租借、出场、退役或日期

patterns.name: 附带合同与出场条件
patterns.trigger: “payable when he played ten first-team matches”
patterns.context: 球员合同报酬或奖金与出场次数挂钩

patterns.name: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言
patterns.context: 议会正式称呼与礼貌致谢，葡萄牙语连续发言文本

patterns.name: 宗教人物与殖民史叙述
patterns.context: 历史散文介绍人物及其在西属美洲的经历

en.description: Primarily responds to match results, scores, promotion and relegation in football biographies and team entries, as well as players’ or coaches’ club careers, contracts, appearances, and statistical records; one example also responds to a 70th wedding anniversary.

patterns.name: Football match results and play-by-play
patterns.context: Describes team matches, scores, promotion, or relegation; score and competition terms often appear near the trigger.
patterns.domain: Football history, match reports, and club entries

patterns.name: Football careers and club experience
patterns.context: Describes a player’s or coach’s club tenure, appearances, contracts, transfers, or career timeline, often with team names, seasons, and years.

patterns.name: Football competition statistics and records
patterns.context: Introduces national-team or player goal records and lists matches, opponents, and competition years.

patterns.name: Years of marriage
patterns.context: Accounts of the length of a marriage and wedding anniversary in a biography; not football-related.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: This passage discusses the European Championship final, Leeds United winning the title, and the number of goals, but does not fully match the clear trigger patterns in the other passages.

11_1821.description: 主要响应足球人物与球队条目中的比赛赛果、比分、晋降级，以及球员或教练的俱乐部生涯、合同、出场和统计纪录；另有一例响应婚姻70周年纪念。

patterns.name: 足球比赛结果与赛况
patterns.trigger: 如 “lost 4–2 on aggregate”“drawn the second leg 2–2”“0–5 aggregate loss”“5–2 … Cup win”“relegated”
patterns.context: 叙述球队比赛、比分、晋级或降级等赛事结果；比分和赛制词常出现在触发词附近。
patterns.domain: 足球史、比赛报道及俱乐部条目

patterns.name: 足球生涯与俱乐部经历
patterns.trigger: 如 “remaining there for two years”“being sacked”“made his debut”“218 appearances”“signed a new two-year contract”
patterns.context: 叙述球员或教练的俱乐部任职、出场、合同、转会或生涯时间线，常有球队名、赛季和年份。

patterns.name: 足球竞赛统计与纪录
patterns.trigger: “most goals scored in an international”“four”“on five occasions”
patterns.context: 介绍国家队或球员进球纪录，并列举比赛、对手和赛事年份。

patterns.name: 婚姻纪念年数
patterns.context: 人物传记中的婚姻年限及周年纪念叙述；并非足球内容。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 未见清晰对应的触发子串
patterns.context: 该段谈及欧洲杯决赛、利兹联夺冠及进球数，但与其他段的明显触发模式不完全吻合。

en.concept: Football match narratives and tournament names
en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of leagues, cups, tournament stages, and results in football encyclopedias, especially the definite article before tournament names and at the before venues; nearby contexts such as years and seasons also often activate. A legal appellate ruling passage does not fit the football pattern.

patterns.name: Definite article followed by a tournament or match stage
patterns.context: In football biographies or club narratives, mentions leagues, cups, tournament results, or match stages; often the + tournament/stage name.
patterns.domain: Football encyclopedia biographies and match results

patterns.name: at the before a match venue
patterns.context: at the is followed by a match venue; once it occurs in the common time phrase at the end.
patterns.domain: Football results and league season descriptions

patterns.name: Common function words in season, year, and tournament narratives
patterns.context: When football articles describe seasons, years, appointments, or match experiences, surrounding function words and tournament terms also activate, but no single fixed collocation appears.

patterns.name: Legal appellate language
patterns.context: A judicial opinion citation discusses court discretion and appellate review.

11_1821.concept: 足球赛事叙述及赛事名称
11_1821.description: 主要响应足球百科中联赛、杯赛、赛事阶段及其赛果叙述，尤其是赛事名称前的定冠词和场馆前的 at the；年份、赛季等邻近语境也常激活。另有一段法律上诉裁判用语，难与足球模式统一。

patterns.name: 定冠词后接赛事或比赛阶段
patterns.trigger: «the»10 domestic cup final、«the»10 League title、«the»9 third round、«the»9 quarterfinals、«Scottish Cup»8、«World»5 «Cup»6
patterns.context: 足球人物或俱乐部叙述中，提及联赛、杯赛、赛事成绩或比赛阶段时；常见 the + 赛事/阶段名称。

patterns.name: 比赛地点前的 at the
patterns.context: at the 后接比赛场馆；另有一次用于常见时间短语 at the end。
patterns.domain: 足球赛果与联赛赛季说明

patterns.name: 赛季、年份与赛事叙述中的常见功能词
patterns.context: 足球文章叙述赛季、年份、任职或比赛经历时，周边功能词和赛事词也会激活，但未呈现单一固定搭配。

patterns.name: 法律上诉用语
patterns.context: 司法裁判引文中，讨论法院裁量及上诉审查。

en.description: Activations occur in football biographies and match narratives, as well as legal review, JSON field formatting, Portuguese travel narratives, classical marriage narratives, and plant pathology abstracts; there is no single stable lexical or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Position/season/match narratives in English football reporting
patterns.context: Accounts of a person’s career or a team’s matches; commonly near match dates, scores, clubs, and competition names.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia sports biographies and football reporting

patterns.name: Review language in legal decisions
patterns.context: A court explains jurisdiction and scope of review, appearing after the legal basis is stated.

patterns.name: JSON configuration fields and newline formatting
patterns.context: A configuration snippet consisting of field names, quotation marks, colons, commas, and newlines; activation may relate to local formatting near fields and separators.

patterns.name: First-person plural narrative in Portuguese
patterns.context: The narrator recalls travel, including a meeting, return trip, and conversation; includes Portuguese verbs and place names.
patterns.domain: European Parliament Portuguese speeches or records

patterns.name: Marriage and religious figures
patterns.context: After describing a pastor’s appointment, the narrative turns to his marriage.

patterns.name: Plant virology paper title and background
patterns.context: The paper title reports the first discovery of a disease in a particular place, followed by background on rice cultivation.

11_1821.description: 激活散见于足球传记与比赛叙述，也包括法律审查、JSON 字段格式、葡语行程叙述、古典婚姻叙事和植物病理学摘要；看不出单一稳定的词义或句法触发因素。

patterns.name: 英语足球报道中的位置/赛季/比赛叙述
patterns.trigger: “two-game tie”, “on aggregate”, “second leg”, “debut”, “late substitute”, “defeat”, “Football League”, “FA Cup final”
patterns.context: 人物职业经历或球队比赛叙述；常见比赛日期、比分、俱乐部和赛事名称附近。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科体育传记与足球报道

patterns.name: 法律判决中的审查措辞
patterns.trigger: “Our review, however, is limited to evaluating whether”
patterns.context: 法院说明管辖权及审查范围，出现在法律依据之后。

patterns.name: JSON 配置字段与换行格式
patterns.context: 字段名、引号、冒号、逗号和换行构成的配置片段；强度可能与字段/分隔符附近的局部格式有关。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码仓库中的 JSON

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语第一人称复数叙述
patterns.trigger: “reunimos em Berlim”, “Na Quarta-feira”, “de volta a Bruxelas”, “jantei”
patterns.context: 叙述者回忆会面、返程及交谈等行程；包含葡语动词和地名。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言或记录

patterns.name: 婚姻与宗教人物叙述
patterns.context: 叙述牧师任职后，转入其婚姻情况。

patterns.name: 植物病毒学论文标题与背景
patterns.trigger: “First Report of Rice yellow mottle virus on Rice in Burundi”, “Since the mid-1980s”
patterns.context: 论文标题报告某地首次发现病害，随后介绍水稻种植背景。

en.description: All fragments discuss football: match results, scores, competition stages and elimination, as well as players’ clubs, debuts, and careers; entities such as clubs and leagues recur throughout.

patterns.name: Football match results and progression narratives
patterns.context: Describes match scores, aggregate scores across two legs, competition stages, elimination, or advancement; activations often fall on competition-stage words and time or venue terms.
patterns.domain: Football match reports and competition histories

patterns.name: Football player career biographies
patterns.context: An introduction or career passage describing a player’s clubs, position, debut date, professional career, or coaching role.
patterns.domain: Football player biographies, mainly in an encyclopedic style

patterns.name: European football clubs and league entities
patterns.context: Club, league, country, or stadium names in a football context; most occur within match reports or player career narratives rather than forming a stable pattern independent of the first two categories.

11_1821.description: 全部片段都谈足球：既包括赛果、比分、赛事阶段与淘汰，也包括球员效力、出道和生涯；俱乐部、联赛等实体贯穿其间。

patterns.name: 足球赛事结果与晋级叙述
patterns.trigger: “win over”“draw”“lost 4–2 on aggregate”“went out of the competition”“knocked out by”“quarter finals”
patterns.context: 叙述比赛比分、两回合总比分、赛事阶段、淘汰或晋级结果；激活常落在比赛阶段和时间、场地等词上。
patterns.domain: 足球赛事报道、赛事历史

patterns.name: 足球运动员生涯传记
patterns.context: 人物简介或生涯段落，交代球员效力球队、位置、出道时间、职业经历或执教身份。
patterns.domain: 足球人物传记，主要为百科全书文体

patterns.name: 欧洲足球俱乐部与联赛实体
patterns.context: 足球语境中的俱乐部、联赛、国家或场馆名称；多数嵌在赛事报道或球员生涯叙述中，并非独立于前两类的稳定模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to frequent English function words and common syntactic positions; scores and match phases in sports narratives also stand out. Other activations include legal appellate language, Portuguese subword fragments, and subwords from several proper names, with the latter categories not forming a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: English function words and syntactic scaffolding
patterns.context: Ordinary continuous English prose, especially within sentences or phrases; activation is concentrated on frequent function words rather than content words with fixed meanings
patterns.domain: English narrative, encyclopedic, and legal texts

patterns.name: Sports scores and match phases
patterns.context: Football match narratives, around results, knockout rounds, or group-stage phases; in [1], several words in “at the group stage” activate especially strongly

patterns.name: Portuguese subword fragments
patterns.context: Continuous Portuguese text; markers fall on words or subword fragments, some of which are also common short fragments in English

patterns.name: Legal appeals and court language
patterns.context: Court opinions or procedural rules discuss appeals, motions to dismiss, and jurisdiction; activation includes English function words as well as “is”

patterns.name: Within-word/segmentation-boundary fragments
patterns.context: Within-word fragments after subword segmentation; their contexts concern football team names, personal names, or place names, with no evident shared semantic trigger
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies and football history narratives

patterns.name: Other weak or sporadic content-word activations
patterns.context: Each appears in a different narrative sentence, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition

11_1821.description: 主要对英语高频功能词及常见句法位置反应，体育叙述中的比分和比赛阶段也突出；另见法律上诉措辞、葡萄牙语词片段及若干专名子词激活，后几类难归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语法定词与句法骨架
patterns.context: 普通英语连续散文中，尤其在句子或短语内部；激活集中在高频功能词，而非固定词义内容词
patterns.domain: 英语叙述、百科及法律文本

patterns.name: 体育比分及比赛阶段
patterns.trigger: “the group stage”及“4–2”“5–2”“4–1”等比分中的数字/比分片段
patterns.context: 足球赛事叙述，围绕比赛结果、淘汰赛或小组赛阶段；[1]中“at the group stage”多个词激活尤强

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语连续文本；标记落在词或子词片段上，部分与英语常见短片段相同
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言记录

patterns.name: 法律上诉与法院措辞
patterns.context: 法院意见或程序规则中讨论上诉、驳回动议及管辖权；激活包含英语功能词，也有“is”

patterns.name: 词内/分词边界片段
patterns.context: 子词切分后的词内片段；这些片段所在上下文分别是足球队名、人名或地名，未见它们构成统一语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 百科人物与足球史叙述

patterns.name: 其余弱或偶发内容词激活
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同叙述句中，未显示稳定的共同语义或句法条件

en.description: Primarily responds to competition details, scores, player careers, appearance times, and advancement stages in football encyclopedias; also covers Spanish competition names and coaching records. Parliamentary formal addresses and French diplomatic-representative texts may be separate patterns of cross-lingual formal narration.

patterns.name: Football match results and scores
patterns.context: Scores, wins and losses, goals, or match results in football narratives; often adjacent to teams, opponents, or competition rounds.
patterns.domain: Football biographies, match reports, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Football careers and club transfers
patterns.context: Describes a player or coach joining a club, playing for a club, going on loan, making appearances, or professional experience; often accompanied by club names and years.

patterns.name: Competition stages, advancement, and elimination
patterns.context: Describes a team’s stage or round in a cup or tournament, or whether it advanced or was eliminated.

patterns.name: Match times and appearance events
patterns.context: Provides dates, minutes, or substitute appearance times in match narratives, often close to player names and match results.

patterns.name: European Parliament forms of address and formal remarks
patterns.context: Forms of address, greetings, and descriptions of diplomatic representatives in parliamentary speeches or formal meeting texts.
patterns.domain: Portuguese- and French-language European Parliament records

patterns.name: Spanish football competition names
patterns.context: Spanish football club or league context, mentioning domestic league or cup competition names.

patterns.name: Coaches and team records
patterns.context: Introduces a coach’s background and summarizes a team’s performance in a cup competition during a particular season.

11_1821.concept: 足球百科与正式记录叙述
11_1821.description: 主要响应足球百科中的赛事、比分、球员生涯、出场时间及晋级阶段；也覆盖西班牙赛事名称和教练成绩。另有议会正式致辞与法语外交代表文本，可能只是跨语种正式叙述中的独立模式。

patterns.name: 足球赛事结果与比分
patterns.trigger: “1–1 draw”“4–1 defeat”“4–1 loss”“0–0 FA Cup draw”“8–0 home routing”“scoring 14 goals”
patterns.context: 足球赛事叙述中出现比分、胜负、进球或比赛结果；常与球队、对手、赛事轮次相邻。
patterns.domain: 足球传记、比赛报道及百科条目

patterns.name: 足球生涯与俱乐部转会
patterns.trigger: “joined Bolton”“with Celta de Vigo”“joined Luton Town on loan”“appeared with the club”“playing part-time”
patterns.context: 描述球员或教练加盟、效力、租借、出场或职业经历，常伴随俱乐部名称与年份。

patterns.name: 赛事阶段、晋级与淘汰
patterns.trigger: “group stage”“third round”“last 32”“reached the domestic cup final”
patterns.context: 叙述球队在杯赛或锦标赛中的阶段、轮次、晋级或出局情况。

patterns.name: 比赛时间与出场事件
patterns.context: 比赛叙述中给出日期、分钟数或替补出场时间，往往紧邻球员姓名和比赛结果。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会称谓与正式发言
patterns.trigger: “Senhor Presidente, Senhor Comissário”“Senhoras e Senhores Deputados”“présente dans la tribune”
patterns.context: 议会发言或正式会议文本中的称谓、致辞及外交代表描述。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语、法语欧洲议会记录

patterns.name: 西班牙足球赛事名称
patterns.context: 西班牙足球俱乐部或联赛背景，提及国内联赛或杯赛名称。

patterns.name: 教练与球队成绩
patterns.trigger: “coach of recognized prestige”“The team had its best result”
patterns.context: 介绍教练背景并概述球队在特定赛季杯赛中的表现。

en.concept: Structural words in football and European Parliament texts
en.description: Primarily activates on match stages, rounds, and results in football narratives, as well as diplomatic topics and formal forms of address in Portuguese parliamentary texts; coaching careers and Finnish parliamentary speeches also occur.

patterns.name: English football match stages and results
patterns.context: When discussing teams, players, match results, advancement, or elimination, competition stages, rounds, and scores often occur nearby; also found in player career narratives

patterns.name: Portuguese European Parliament diplomatic and political speeches
patterns.context: Portuguese parliamentary speeches or foreign-policy texts discussing summits, forms of parliamentary address, peace, and topics such as the Middle East

patterns.name: Coaching appointments and club careers
patterns.context: Chronological account of a coach or football figure’s appointments, departures, and results at different clubs

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Questions in Finnish parliamentary texts about the use of tools/weapons, with a speaker’s name and parliamentary form of address

11_1821.concept: 足球与欧洲议会文本中的结构性词语
11_1821.description: 主要激活于足球叙述中的比赛阶段、轮次与赛果，也激活葡语议会文本里的外交议题和正式称谓；另见教练履历及芬兰语议会发言。

patterns.name: 英语足球比赛阶段与赛果
patterns.trigger: «the»10 «group»6 «stage»3；«third»7 round；«round»4 «of»2 «16»5；比分、比赛分钟、进球等片段
patterns.context: 讨论球队、球员、比赛结果、晋级或淘汰时，常见比赛阶段、轮次和比分邻近出现；也见于球员经历叙述

patterns.name: 葡语欧洲议会外交与政治发言
patterns.context: 葡语议会发言或外交政策文本，谈论峰会、议会称谓、和平及中东等议题

patterns.name: 教练任职与俱乐部经历
patterns.trigger: «with» Celta de Vigo；«sacked»；«reached the domestic cup final»
patterns.context: 按时间顺序介绍教练或足球人士在不同俱乐部的任职、离职与成绩

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 未发现能与其他片段稳定归并的特定触发模式
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会文本中关于工具/武器使用的提问，并出现发言人姓名及议会称谓

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions for rounds, group stages, and result statistics in football reporting; especially concentrated around competition terms such as group stage, round, and Cup. One passage in French parliamentary text and one passage on appellate jurisdiction in a court provision show no direct connection to the football pattern.

patterns.name: Sports competition phases and results
patterns.context: Football reporting mentioning match rounds, group stages, or advancement stages, often alongside scores, wins and losses, and team names.

patterns.name: Match results and statistics
patterns.context: Describes football results, aggregate scores, penalty shootout outcomes, or player goal totals; passages typically also contain round or competition information.

patterns.name: Cup in competition names
patterns.context: Cup or Euro appears in a competition name, involving national teams or clubs.

patterns.name: French parliamentary and political institutions
patterns.context: A French sentence discusses a parliamentary delegation and political events, with no football context.

patterns.name: Appellate jurisdiction
patterns.context: Legal provisions concerning a court’s consideration of an appeal and jurisdiction, unlike the sports context.

11_1821.description: 主要响应足球报道中赛事轮次、分组阶段和赛果统计等表达；尤其集中于 group stage、round、Cup 等赛事语汇。另有一段法语议会文本及一段法院上诉管辖权条文，未显出与足球模式的直接联系。

patterns.name: 体育赛事阶段与赛果
patterns.trigger: “group game”“group stage”“third round”“second group game”“round of 16”“second round”“cup final”
patterns.context: 足球赛事报道中，提及比赛轮次、分组阶段或晋级阶段，常与比分、胜负及球队名同现。

patterns.name: 比赛结果与统计表达
patterns.trigger: “1–1 draw”“4–1 loss”“lost 4–2 on aggregate”“won 4–2 on penalties”“14 goals”
patterns.context: 描述足球赛果、总比分、点球胜负或球员进球数；段落通常也包含轮次或赛事信息。

patterns.name: 赛事专名中的 Cup
patterns.context: 赛事名称中出现 Cup 或 Euro，涉及国家队或俱乐部比赛。

patterns.name: 法语议会与政治机构
patterns.context: 法语句子谈及议会代表团及政治事件，未见足球赛事语境。

patterns.name: 法律上诉管辖权
patterns.trigger: “motion to dismiss any appeal”“not within the jurisdiction”
patterns.context: 法院审理上诉及管辖权问题的法律条文，与体育语境不同。

en.concept: Football encyclopedia and related entity narratives
en.description: Primarily appears in football encyclopedia narratives involving match results, competition stages, dates, scores, and career records; also occurs in Portuguese parliamentary diplomatic texts, village administrative definitions, and reports on fan memorial events.

patterns.name: Football match results and stages
patterns.context: Describes match results, advancement, or elimination stages in football narratives; often includes the prepositions “in”, “at”, “on”, especially “at the group stage” and “in the round of 16”.

patterns.name: Competition dates and numeric phrases
patterns.context: In athlete or team career accounts, dates, scores, and competition rounds appear alongside match narratives.

patterns.name: Political institutions and peacekeeping operations
patterns.context: Portuguese political speeches or parliamentary texts mentioning Sudan, the African Union, and peacekeeping missions.

patterns.name: Parliamentary forms of address and speech formulas
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary speeches, greeting the President and responding to political group representatives.

patterns.name: Village definition sentences
patterns.context: A place-name entry gives administrative affiliation using the phrase “is a village in the administrative district of”.

patterns.name: Leicester fan memorial events
patterns.context: Reports on fans holding a memorial walk for victims of a helicopter crash, and mentions a Leicester home match.

patterns.name: Coaching career and domestic cup
patterns.context: A football figure’s career account describes coaching or team experience, being dismissed, and the team ultimately reaching a domestic cup final.

11_1821.concept: 足球百科及相关实体叙述
11_1821.description: 主要出现在足球百科叙述中，涉及比赛结果、赛事阶段、日期比分与履历；另见葡语议会外交文本、村庄区划定义，以及球迷纪念活动报道。

patterns.name: 足球比赛结果与阶段
patterns.trigger: “win over Zaire in the first group game”“1–1 draw”“group stage”“round of 16”“third round”
patterns.context: 足球赛事叙述中，描述比赛结果、晋级或淘汰阶段；常出现介词“in”“at”“on”，尤其“at the group stage”“in the round of 16”。
patterns.domain: 体育百科/足球赛事报道

patterns.name: 赛事日期与数字短语
patterns.context: 体育人物或球队履历中，日期、比分及赛事轮次等数字信息与比赛叙述相邻。

patterns.name: 政治机构与和平行动
patterns.trigger: “No Sudão”“União Africana”“missão de manutenção da paz”
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语政治演讲或议会文本，谈及苏丹、非洲联盟及维和任务。

patterns.name: 议会称谓与发言套语
patterns.trigger: “Senhor Presidente”“ouvi com grande atenção os representantes dos grupos políticos”
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言中，对主席致意并回应政治团体代表。

patterns.name: 村庄定义句
patterns.trigger: “Lipnica is a village in the administrative district of Gmina R”
patterns.context: 地名条目以“is a village in the administrative district of”给出行政区划归属。

patterns.name: 莱斯特球迷纪念活动
patterns.context: 报道球迷为直升机坠毁遇难者举行纪念步行，并提及莱斯特主场比赛。

patterns.name: 教练履历与国内杯赛
patterns.context: 足球人物履历叙述执教或球队经历、被解雇及球队最终进入国内杯赛决赛。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in football encyclopedia narratives, especially competition stages, results, and player and club careers; Portuguese and Finnish parliamentary texts and place-name entries also occur.

patterns.name: Football match stages and results
patterns.context: Mentions competition stages, rounds, or group stages in football narratives, often accompanied by scores, opponents, or dates.

patterns.name: Football careers and clubs
patterns.context: In player or coach career accounts, describes national/youth team experience, club affiliations, transfers, or career development.

patterns.name: EU–Africa summit and parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Portuguese parliamentary speeches discussing the EU–Africa summit and related meetings.

patterns.name: Finnish parliamentary procedural texts
patterns.context: Finnish parliamentary speeches or agenda text, including references to committees, members of parliament, and the President.

patterns.name: Place-name entries and administrative divisions
patterns.context: An entry headed by a place name uses an encyclopedic sentence to describe a village and its administrative divisions.

patterns.name: Unclassified transfer-record phrasing
patterns.context: Mentions a transfer-fee record and a transfer between English clubs, but the fragment is insufficient to determine whether it belongs to the same pattern as football competition narratives.

11_1821.concept: 体育百科与结构化叙述
11_1821.description: 激活集中在足球百科叙述，尤其比赛阶段、赛果、球员与俱乐部履历；另覆盖葡萄牙语和芬兰语议会文本，以及地名条目。

patterns.name: 足球比赛阶段与赛果
patterns.trigger: “the third round of the group stage”；“the play-offs”；“the round of 16”；“second group game”
patterns.context: 足球赛事叙述中提及比赛阶段、轮次或小组赛，并常伴随比分、对手或日期。

patterns.name: 足球职业经历与俱乐部
patterns.trigger: “youth international debut”；“was promoted”；“started 1997–98 in Portugal”；“Manchester United number 9”；“youth team”
patterns.context: 球员或教练履历中，描述国家队/青年队经历、俱乐部效力、转会或职业发展。

patterns.name: 欧盟—非洲峰会与议会发言
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言，谈论欧盟—非洲峰会及相关会议。

patterns.name: 芬兰语议会程序文本
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会发言或议程文字，含委员会、议员及主席称谓。

patterns.name: 地名条目与行政区划
patterns.trigger: “Lipnica, Lublin Voivodeship”；“is a village in the administrative district”
patterns.context: 以地名为标题、用百科式句子说明村庄及行政区划。

patterns.name: 未能明确归类的转会记录表达
patterns.trigger: “transfer fee record”；“transfer between two English clubs”
patterns.context: 提及转会费纪录及英格兰俱乐部之间的转会，但片段不足以确认是否与足球赛事模式相同。

en.description: Primarily responds to competition stages, advancement, finals, trophies, scores, and on-site match information in football narratives; also occurs in fan memorial events, Portuguese summit discussions, and formal parliamentary speeches in multiple languages.

patterns.name: Football competition stages and match results
patterns.context: Football player or team competition narratives mention stages, advancement, finals, trophies, or match results; years, team names, and match dates are common.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia football biographies and competition entries

patterns.name: Fan memorial events
patterns.context: Before a football club match, describes fans taking part in a memorial walk and mentions a home match.
patterns.domain: English football news or match reports

patterns.name: Summit discussions in Portuguese parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Portuguese parliamentary speeches discussing the EU–Africa summit and its venue and date.

patterns.name: Parliamentary speeches and delegation wording
patterns.context: Official speeches or records include forms of address for officials, members’ remarks, or descriptions of a delegation and its presence; found in Portuguese and French.

11_1821.description: 主要在足球叙述中，对赛事阶段、晋级、决赛、奖杯、比分及比赛现场信息反应；另见于球迷纪念活动，以及葡语峰会讨论和多语种议会正式发言。

Other local patterns occur in EU–Africa summit material, U.S. legal decisions, and French/Portuguese parliamentary speeches, and do not form a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Numbers or ordinals in match/advancement narratives
patterns.context: Sports narratives include years, dates, scores, match counts, or phase information; activation falls on numbers and nearby dates, often alongside words such as World Cup, qualification, group, finals, promoted.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia sports biographies and competition entries; date examples in Portuguese parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: UEFA string
patterns.context: Appears as the abbreviation UEFA in football contexts; the examples occur near match histories and competition group descriptions.

patterns.name: EU–Africa relations statements
patterns.context: Portuguese parliamentary text mentions the next EU–Africa summit and discusses when it will take place.

patterns.name: U.S. legal procedure terminology
patterns.context: The discussion section of a legal decision explains the conditions for a court to issue a COA (certificate of appealability).

patterns.name: Common words and paragraph structure in French parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: French parliamentary speeches; include forms of address to the president, words for meetings or discussions, and economic topics, but the examples have no clear shared specific-word trigger.

patterns.name: Dates and travel expressions in Portuguese parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Describes meetings or travel by day of the week and place; activation is more prominent near date and weekday words.

patterns.name: Local activations not covered by other patterns
patterns.context: In football career narratives, activation is distributed over ordinary narrative words and competition years; apart from the competition number/phase pattern, there is no clear independent trigger feature.

11_1821.concept: 文本中的专名、日期与结构化事实
11_1821.description: 主要响应体育赛事叙述中的年份、日期、比分、场次与阶段信息；也见于UEFA缩写。另有欧盟—非洲峰会、美国法律判决及法语/葡语议会发言中的局部模式，未能统一为单一语义。

patterns.name: 比赛/晋级叙述中的数字或序数
patterns.context: 体育赛事叙述里出现年份、日期、比分、场次或阶段信息；激活落在数字、日期附近，常伴随 World Cup、qualification、group、finals、promoted 等词。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科体育人物及赛事条目；葡萄牙语议会发言中的日期示例

patterns.name: UEFA 字符串
patterns.context: 足球语境中作为 UEFA 的缩写出现；所给例子分别位于比赛经历、赛事分组描述附近。

patterns.name: 欧盟—非洲关系表述
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中提及欧盟与非洲的下一次峰会，并谈及其召开时间。

patterns.name: 美国法律程序用语
patterns.trigger: “A COA can issue only”, “substantial showing”, “denial of a constitutional right”, “28 U.S.C. § 2253”
patterns.context: 法律判决的讨论部分，说明法院签发 COA（上诉证明）的条件。

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的常见词及段落结构
patterns.trigger: “Monsieur le Président”, “lors des Assemblées”, “déficit-record de la balance des paiements”, “lors des entretiens”
patterns.context: 法语议会讲话；出现主席称呼、会议或会谈用语及经济议题，但这些例子之间没有明显共同的具体词触发点。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语议会中的日期与行程表达
patterns.trigger: “na passada Terça-feira”, “Na Quarta-feira”, “de volta a Bruxelas”
patterns.context: 以星期和地点描述会议或行程；日期/星期词附近激活较明显。

patterns.name: 无法归入其他模式的局部激活
patterns.trigger: “they finished top of their group”, “in the finals in Japan and South Korea”, “the 2006 World Cup”
patterns.context: 足球履历叙述中，激活分散在普通叙事词和赛事年份上；除赛事数字/阶段模式外，没有清楚的独立触发特征。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科体育条目

en.concept: Proper nouns and salient term fragments
en.description: Activation has diverse sources: it repeatedly highlights the place-name suffix “Heights” and also responds to the geographic name “Queensland,” medical testing terms, bone mineral terminology, Ritz numerical computation documents, review expressions, lawyer advertisements, and “Nine” in titles.

patterns.name: Heights in place names
patterns.context: Heights appears at the end of a place name or other name; contexts include legal cases, encyclopedia categories, location indexes, or webpage titles.

patterns.name: Queensland in place names
patterns.context: Occurs near a place name, regional description, or administrative division; the word itself also activates.

patterns.name: antibodies / sought in medicine
patterns.context: Medical abstracts describe antibodies and their detection; activation falls on immunological terms and the verb for testing.

patterns.name: Bone mineral formation
patterns.context: Describes the structure, composition, and maturation of newly deposited calcium phosphate crystals in chick osteoblasts.

patterns.name: Ritz technical documentation terms
patterns.context: Algorithm names, precision, and error parameters appear in program comments or input-parameter descriptions.

patterns.name: Exclamations and evaluative expressions
patterns.context: In colloquial quotations and commentary, activation falls on concrete metaphors or evaluative words.

patterns.name: Legal services copy
patterns.context: Introduces services for readers seeking a lawyer to handle personal injury cases; a place name also triggers in the same passage.

patterns.name: Nine in titles
patterns.context: Nine receives strong activation in phrases in titles or subtitles; the surrounding text is entertainment-oriented narration.

11_1835.concept: 专名及显著术语片段
11_1835.description: 激活来源多样：反复突出地名后缀“Heights”，也响应地理名“Queensland”、医学检测词、骨矿物术语、Ritz数值计算文档、评论表达、律师宣传和标题中的“Nine”。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Heights
patterns.context: 地名或名称末尾出现 Heights；上下文可为法律判例、百科分类、地点索引或网页标题。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Queensland
patterns.context: 与地名、地区介绍或行政区划相邻；该词本身也有激活。

patterns.name: 医学中的 antibodies / sought
patterns.context: 医学摘要描述抗体及其检测，激活落在免疫学术语和检测动词上。

patterns.name: 骨矿物形成
patterns.context: 描述鸡成骨细胞中新沉积的钙磷晶体结构、组成与成熟。

patterns.name: Ritz 技术文档术语
patterns.context: 程序注释或输入参数说明中出现算法名称、精度与误差参数。

patterns.name: 感叹与评价性表达
patterns.context: 口语引语及评论性论述中，激活落在具象比喻或评价词。

patterns.name: 法律服务文案
patterns.context: 面向读者介绍律师处理人身伤害案件的服务；同段另有地名触发。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Nine
patterns.context: 标题或小标题中的短语，Nine 获较强激活；周围是娱乐性叙事。

en.concept: Phrases containing proper nouns or technical terms
en.description: Activation is dispersed: the clearest repeated cue is “Heights” in place names (3, 4, 6, 9); the rest concern crystal deposition, antibody testing, Ritz numerical-computation documentation, “vain” in a review, a title containing “Nine,” and a Queensland geographic entry.

patterns.name: Heights in place names
patterns.context: “Heights” occurs in a place name or location proper noun; examples appear in legal texts, classification entries, ad headlines, or itemized lists, with no fixed position.
patterns.domain: Place names, legal texts, Wikipedia, web text

patterns.name: deposit(ed) and crystal-related terms
patterns.context: Describes newly deposited calcium phosphate crystals and their structure, composition, or maturation.

patterns.name: test target sought for
patterns.context: Describes antibody testing of patient samples or populations in medical research; this phrase and nearby testing terms are prominent in the fragment.

patterns.name: Formatted technical terms in code documentation
patterns.context: Technical identifiers and fields related to precision and error cluster in Fortran-style comments and parameter descriptions.

patterns.name: Emphatic adjective vain
patterns.context: Describes the most extreme or self-important aspect of a statement about a typology-free approach.

patterns.name: Numbers and title-like phrases
patterns.context: Nine recurs in standalone titles or short phrases, followed by brief narration.

patterns.name: Local adjective and place description
patterns.context: An encyclopedia-style entry begins with a place name, then identifies it as a rural locality in a region.

11_1835.concept: 包含专名或术语的短语
11_1835.description: 激活模式分散：最明确的重复线索是地名中的“Heights”（3、4、6、9）；其余分别涉及晶体沉积、抗体检测、Ritz数值计算文档、评论中的“vain”、含“Nine”的标题，以及昆士兰地理条目。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Heights
patterns.trigger: “Heights”，以及与地名相连的“Arlington Heights”“Hacienda Heights”“Wilson Heights”
patterns.context: 地名或地点专名中出现 Heights；可在法律文本、分类条目、广告标题或条目式列表中，位置不固定。
patterns.domain: 地名、法律文本、Wikipedia、网页文本

patterns.name: deposit(ed) 与晶体相关术语
patterns.context: 描述新沉积的钙磷晶体及其结构、组成或成熟过程。

patterns.name: 检验对象 sought for
patterns.context: 医学研究中描述对患者样本或人群进行抗体检测；此片段内该短语及附近检验术语突出。

patterns.name: 代码文档中的格式化技术词
patterns.context: Fortran 风格注释与参数说明中，技术标识符和精度、误差相关字段集中出现。
patterns.domain: 代码注释或数值计算文档

patterns.name: 强调性形容词 vain
patterns.context: 论述某种 typology-free approach 的语句中，形容其最极端或自负的一面。

patterns.name: 数字与标题式短语
patterns.context: 独立标题或短句中反复出现 Nine，后接简短叙述。

patterns.name: 局部形容词与地点描述
patterns.context: 以地点名称开头的百科式条目，随后说明其为某地区的乡村 locality。

en.description: Activation spans medical abstracts, legal texts, emails, technical documents, and encyclopedia entries, concentrating mainly on proper nouns and technical terms. Several place names contain “Heights,” but the other trigger words and writing styles vary considerably; no consistent syntactic or semantic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Heights in place names
patterns.context: Appears in place names or institution locations, sometimes in titles or historical accounts.
