patterns.domain: Wikipedia place-name and school entries; also case names in legal judgments

patterns.name: Medical and biological terminology
patterns.context: Technical terms appear in medical or biomedical abstracts and research plans; activation is distributed across multiple terms rather than a single lexical item.

patterns.name: Legal judgment phrasing
patterns.context: Describes a court vacating a judgment and remanding the case, and mentions the case name.

patterns.name: General geographic proper nouns and place descriptions
patterns.context: A place-name entry begins with a proper noun and then describes its administrative region or type; “Heights” is absent.

patterns.name: Conversational expression in business emails
patterns.context: Short work-email sentences use everyday conversational and business-related vocabulary.

patterns.name: Numerical parameters in technical documents
patterns.context: Parameter direction is shown in parentheses, followed by brief descriptions of numerical or precision parameters.
patterns.domain: GitHub technical documentation or code comments

patterns.name: Olive oil quality assessment title
patterns.context: A title-like research phrase focuses on quality assessment and describes olive oil and measurement conditions.

patterns.name: School rankings and history
patterns.context: A school entry first mentions rankings, then shifts to its founding history and location.

11_1835.concept: 专名与专业术语
11_1835.description: 激活跨医学摘要、法律、邮件、技术文档和百科条目，主要集中于专名及专业术语；多个地名含“Heights”，但其余触发词与文体差异较大，未见统一句法或语义模式。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Heights
patterns.trigger: «Heights»，以及重复出现的地名片段 «Wilson Heights»、«Rowland Heights»
patterns.context: 出现在地名或机构所在地名称中；有时位于标题或历史叙述中。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 地名与学校条目；另有法律判决中的案例名称

patterns.name: 医学与生物学术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学摘要、研究计划中出现专业术语；激活分布在多种术语上，并非单一词项。

patterns.name: 法律判决措辞
patterns.trigger: «The Supreme Court of the United States»、«vacated the judgment»、«remanded the case»、«further consideration»
patterns.context: 描述法院撤销判决并发回重审，且提及案例名称。

patterns.name: 一般地理专名与地点描述
patterns.context: 地名条目中以专名开头，随后说明行政区域或地点性质；未出现 Heights。

patterns.name: 商业邮件中的口语表达
patterns.trigger: «I called Tino today»、«let him know»、«affiliates are sniffing»
patterns.context: 简短的工作邮件句子，使用日常口语及商业相关词汇。

patterns.name: 技术文档中的数值参数
patterns.context: 以括号标注参数方向，并用简短说明描述数值或精度参数。
patterns.domain: GitHub 技术文档或代码注释

patterns.name: 橄榄油质量评估标题
patterns.trigger: «Quality assessment of olive oils based on temperature-ramped»
patterns.context: 研究标题式短语，以质量评估为主题，描述橄榄油及测量条件。

patterns.name: 学校排名与沿革
patterns.trigger: «ranked 121 out of 500»、«Best High Schools»、«History»、«school was started»
patterns.context: 学校条目先提排名，后转入建校历史和校址叙述。

en.description: Activation is scattered across research-objective headings, proper nouns and name fragments, legal citations, scientific terms, email names, and time expressions; there is no clear shared semantic or formatting pattern.

patterns.name: Objective heading term
patterns.context: “Objectives” in a research abstract or project description, followed by research goals, a disease, or a study purpose; activation is concentrated on the word-initial tokenization

patterns.name: Presence in a radio name
patterns.context: A proper name appears repeatedly; activation primarily falls on the tokenized part of Presence

patterns.name: Name fragment Rajab
patterns.context: A contiguous letter sequence in a person’s name; the name is repeated later

patterns.name: Page numbers or legal citation format
patterns.context: Volume, reporter abbreviation, and page numbers in legal case citations

patterns.name: deposited for deposited material
patterns.context: A scientific abstract describes newly deposited calcium phosphate crystals; the word occurs in a description of material structure and formation

patterns.name: Name spelling in an email greeting
patterns.context: The recipient’s name after the email salutation, written in uppercase letter groups

patterns.name: Colloquial time expression
patterns.context: An email recounts something that happened the previous day and mentions that it took about 45 minutes

patterns.name: Quality assessment terminology
patterns.context: The title-like phrase “Quality assessment of olive oils,” discussing olive oil quality assessment

11_1835.concept: none
11_1835.description: 激活分散于研究目标标题、专名与人名片段、法律引文、科学术语、邮件姓名和时间表达等不同位置；没有明显统一的语义或格式规律。

patterns.name: Objective 标题词
patterns.context: 研究摘要或项目说明中的“Objectives”，后接研究目标、疾病或研究目的；激活集中在词首分词形式

patterns.name: Radio 名称中的 Presence
patterns.context: 专有名称重复出现，激活主要落在 Presence 的分词部分

patterns.name: 人名片段 Rajab
patterns.context: 人名中的连续字母片段，后文重复该姓名

patterns.name: 页码或法律引文格式
patterns.context: 法律判例引文的卷册、报告集缩写与页码数字

patterns.name: 沉积物质的 deposited
patterns.context: 科学摘要中描述新沉积的磷酸钙晶体；该词处于材料结构与形成过程的描述中

patterns.name: 邮件开头的姓名拼写
patterns.context: 邮件称呼后的收件人姓名，以大写字母分块书写

patterns.name: 口语化时间表达
patterns.context: 邮件中叙述前一天发生的事情，并提到花费约45分钟

patterns.name: 质量评估术语
patterns.context: 摘要标题式短语“Quality assessment of olive oils”，讨论橄榄油质量评估

en.concept: Salient subword fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activation appears in subword tokenization of proper nouns, research objectives or topic terms in scientific abstracts, words in academic and email prose, and legal citation numbers. The corpora and parts of speech vary substantially, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or word forms split within words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside proper nouns, place names, or title words composed of multiple subword tokens; repeated titles or forms of address may appear nearby.
patterns.domain: Email salutations, Wikipedia place names and radio station entries

patterns.name: Opening of a research-objective abstract
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a scientific abstract or research description, marking an objective, topic, or quality attribute; the activated subwords are mainly “Objective(s)” or the opening topic word.

patterns.name: Words emphasizing experience or continuity in academic sentences
patterns.context: In complete narrative sentences, activation falls on words describing a research area or ongoing state, as well as words describing recent activity in emails; meanings and sentence structures do not fully align.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric combinations in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation appears in alphanumeric identifiers in case or statutory citations.

11_1835.concept: 异质文本中的显著词片段
11_1835.description: 激活分布在专名的子词切分、科研摘要目标或主题用语、学术与邮件叙述词，以及法律引文编号中；跨语料与词类差异明显，尚无统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内切分的专名或词形
patterns.context: 激活落在由多个子词 token 组成的专名、地名或标题词形内部；周围可有重复标题或称呼。
patterns.domain: 邮件称呼、Wikipedia 地名与广播电台条目

patterns.name: 研究目标摘要的开头
patterns.trigger: «Object»«ives»:；«Object»«ive» To；«Quality» attributes of ...；«The aim of the present study»
patterns.context: 出现在科学摘要或研究描述开头，标示研究目标、主题或质量属性；具体被激活的子词主要是“Objective(s)”或句首主题词。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 学术句中强调经历或延续状态的词
patterns.context: 在完整叙述句中，激活落在表述研究领域或持续状态的词，以及邮件中描述近期活动的词；词义与句式不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 生物学论文引言、商务邮件

patterns.name: 法律编号中的数字与字母组合
patterns.context: 激活出现在判例或法规式引文的字母数字编号中。

en.concept: Terms and boundaries in specialized text
en.description: Responses show several local patterns: abbreviations or supplementary terms in parentheses, academic comparisons, dense medical terminology, patent technical background, and Hungarian word fragments and proper nouns; boundary punctuation such as parentheses, hyphens, and slashes also often activates.

patterns.name: First definition of an abbreviation or term
patterns.context: A technical or specialized term is followed closely by an abbreviation, alternative name, or supplementary explanation in parentheses; activation is concentrated on the opening parenthesis and following word.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research funding text, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Comparative phrasing in academic titles
patterns.context: An abstract title or study objective compares different populations, subjects, or antigens; comparison and the following parallel items are highlighted.

patterns.name: Medical technical terms and disease terminology
patterns.context: Dense occurrences of medical anatomy, disease, treatment, or drug terms; no single specific disease or word form consistently triggers activation.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and medical research funding text

patterns.name: Technical background statements in patent text
patterns.context: Patent background paragraphs introduce energy technology or software testing with general technical statements.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-internal fragments and proper nouns
patterns.context: In continuous Hungarian text, words are split into multiple subwords; the peak falls on the “annapolis” fragment in a sentence about Palestine and a conference.

patterns.name: Grammatical punctuation and connectors
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs at the boundaries of abbreviations, compound words, or coordinated expressions; it may also signal local tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patents, and research text

11_1835.concept: 专业文本中的术语与边界
11_1835.description: 响应呈现多种局部模式：括号中的缩写或补充术语、学术比较表述、密集医学术语、专利技术背景，以及匈牙利语词片段和专名；括号、连字符、斜线等边界标点也常激活。

patterns.name: 缩写或术语首次定义
patterns.trigger: 术语后括号内给出缩写或解释性名称，如“Emergency Medical System (EMS)”“photovoltaic (PV)”“lipopolysaccharide (LPS)”“ionizing radiation (IR)”“structured query language (SQL)”“Left ventricular (LV) enlargement (remodeling)”
patterns.context: 技术或专业术语紧邻括号中的缩写、别称或补充说明；激活集中在左括号及其后的词。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研资助文本、专利背景

patterns.name: 学术标题中的比较表述
patterns.trigger: “A comparison of rural and urban Emergency Medical System (EMS) personnel”及“a comparison of IgG serum antibodies against retinal, optic nerve, and optic nerve head antigens”
patterns.context: 摘要标题或研究目的中，比较不同人群、对象或抗原；突出 comparison 及其后的并列比较项。

patterns.name: 医学专业名词及疾病术语
patterns.trigger: “retinal”“optic nerve”“gram negative bacteremia”“septic shock”“Acne fulminans”“pyoderma gangrenosum”“posterior scleritis”“busulfan and cyclophosphamide”“ventricular enlargement”
patterns.context: 密集出现医学解剖、疾病、治疗或药物名词；并无统一的特定疾病或词形触发条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与医学研究资助文本

patterns.name: 专利文本中的技术背景陈述
patterns.trigger: “Alternative energy sources such as photovoltaic (PV) and wind power generation are becoming”及“Arrangements described herein relate to regression testing of software”
patterns.context: 专利背景段落以一般性技术陈述引出能源技术或软件测试主题。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段与专名
patterns.trigger: “Mi…ét…á…ll…amos… meg…old…á…st… szeretnénk… elérni… Palesztinában… annapolis…i… konferenciát”
patterns.context: 匈牙利语连续文本中，词被切分为多个子词；峰值落在“annapolis”片段，处于关于巴勒斯坦和会议的句子中。

patterns.name: 语法性标点及连接符
patterns.trigger: 括号“(”在多段中强激活；连字符“-”在“high-dose”“-like”中强激活，斜线“/”在“and/or”中强激活
patterns.context: 标点位于缩写、复合词或并列表达的边界；这些标点也可能是局部分词边界信号。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利和科研文本

en.concept: Word-internal character fragments and accented characters
en.description: Activation is scattered across word-internal fragments in several text types: two English words contain “ru,” several proper nouns or loanwords contain accented letters, alongside fragments within chemical terms and a one-off code identifier; there is no shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Russian word fragment “ru”
patterns.context: The trigger occurs inside English words, followed by “ining” and “pees,” respectively; there are too few examples to infer a more specific lexical condition.

patterns.name: Highlighted syllables in proper nouns
patterns.context: Occurs in names of people, works, French words, or foreign proper nouns; activation is concentrated on accented “è” and some adjacent characters. However, [3]’s “Vik” is unaccented, so this may be a broad proper-noun or tokenization-fragment pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, music descriptions, food text, parliamentary records

patterns.name: Specific letter strings in chemical terms
patterns.context: Occurs in “supercritical” and “vinylidenecyclopropanes”; activation falls on substrings within the words. There is insufficient evidence that they share a narrower semantic condition.

patterns.name: Configuration key names and identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs at an all-uppercase variable name and assignment symbol immediately adjacent to a JSON-style configuration object.

patterns.name: “brûlée” spelling in a French dessert term
patterns.context: Appears twice in “crème brûlée(s),” within the accented-letter sequence of a French loanword. It may be related to the accented-character pattern in proper nouns, but the passage also repeats the whole word.

11_1835.concept: 词内字形片段与重音字符
11_1835.description: 激活分散在多类文本的词内片段：两处英文单词含“ru”，多处专名或外来词含重音字母，化学术语内部片段，以及单例代码标识符；未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 俄语词形片段“ru”
patterns.context: 触发点都位于英文单词内部，后续分别接“ining”和“pees”；样本不足以判断是否有更具体词汇条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的高亮音节
patterns.context: 出现在人名、作品名、法语词或外来专名中，激活集中于带重音符号的“è”及部分相邻字符；但[3]的“Vik”并无重音，故可能是宽泛的专名或分词片段模式。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、音乐介绍、食品文字、议会记录

patterns.name: 化学术语中的特定字母串
patterns.context: 分别出现在“supercritical”和“vinylidenecyclopropanes”等专业术语中，激活落在词内部的子串；没有充分证据显示二者共享更窄的语义条件。

patterns.name: 配置键名与标识符
patterns.context: 出现在紧邻JSON样式配置对象的全大写变量名及赋值符号处。

patterns.name: 法语甜点词中的“brûlée”字形
patterns.context: 两次出现在“crème brûlée(s)”中，位于法语借词的重音字母序列。可能与专名中的重音符号模式相关，但该段也重复了整词。

en.description: All highlighted spans fall within vascular terms beginning with arter-: atherosclerosis, ductus arteriosus, arteriovenous malformations or fistulas, arterioles, and the names of measuring instruments; word forms and genres vary, but the trigger location is consistent.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in arteriosclerosis
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the initial arter fragment in arteriosclerosis, arteriosus, and related words; subsequent tokenization varies by word form. Occurs in contexts involving immunology, atherosclerosis, and congenital heart disease.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, patent backgrounds, NIH project text

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in arteriovenous
patterns.context: Occurs in phrases about vascular abnormalities, treatment, and surgery, such as arteriovenous malformation, fistula, or graft; the core highlight remains on the arter stem fragment.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts, NIH project text, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in arteriolar
patterns.context: Occurs as part of the arteriolar wall, describing the small-artery wall and structural changes.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in arteriometer
patterns.context: Occurs in a proper name listing physiological measuring instruments, alongside haemoglobinometer and haemodynamometer.

11_1835.concept: arter- 血管词干
11_1835.description: 各段高亮均落在以 arter- 开头的血管相关词内部：动脉粥样硬化、动脉导管、动静脉畸形或瘘、小动脉及测量仪器名称；词形和文体不同，触发位置一致。

patterns.name: arteriosclerosis 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 arteriosclerosis、arteriosus 等词的 arter 起始片段，词内后续切分随词形变化；出现在免疫学与动脉粥样硬化、先天性心脏病等语境。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、专利背景、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: arteriovenous 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 arteriovenous malformation、fistula 或 graft 等血管异常、治疗及手术相关词组中；核心高亮仍在 arter 词干片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要、NIH 项目文本、专利背景

patterns.name: arteriolar 词内片段
patterns.context: 作为 arteriolar wall 的组成部分出现，描述小动脉壁及其结构变化。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目文本／血管生理学

patterns.name: arteriometer 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在列举生理测量仪器的专名中，与 haemoglobinometer、haemodynamometer 并列。

en.description: Activation is scattered across common function words and word-internal subword fragments, and also covers scientific abbreviations, proper nouns, punctuation and line breaks, and structured lists; there are also local clues from Spanish titles, biographies, and emails, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Tokenization boundaries and syntactic continuation
patterns.context: Activation often falls on short function words, word-form fragments, or punctuation; its position may be within a sentence, word, or proper noun, with no consistent semantic collocation across passages
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose and specialized text

patterns.name: Fragments of scientific and mathematical terms
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical proofs, biomedical experiments, or theoretical physics discussions; the activated word fragments and surrounding contexts vary
patterns.domain: Mathematics, biomedical, and physics academic text

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper nouns and abbreviations
patterns.context: Occurs in personal names, party names, institution names, strain names, or email addresses; activation often aligns with subwords, symbols, or separators

patterns.name: List fields and formatting markers
patterns.context: In structured formatting such as author lists, address lists, or forwarded email headers, punctuation and line breaks interleave with field content

patterns.name: Accented characters and title entries
patterns.context: Occurs in Spanish film or song entry titles, where titles, aliases, and work types are listed consecutively

patterns.name: Address and place-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears as part of an author affiliation or mailing address, often alongside departments, universities, postal codes, and punctuation

patterns.name: Narratives about politicians and public issues
patterns.context: Describes a local councillor’s work on social issues and party leadership position

patterns.name: Local activations without a stable pattern
patterns.context: Occurs in fragments of email bodies and forwarded headers; the trigger clues do not clearly align with those in other passages

11_1835.concept: 英文子词与格式片段
11_1835.description: 激活分散于常见功能词和词内子词片段，也覆盖科学缩写、专名、标点换行与结构化列表；另有西语标题、传记和邮件局部线索，未见稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 分词边界与句法延续
patterns.trigger: « the»、« that»、« to»、« of»、« for»、« in» 等常见功能词，以及词内续接片段，如«fin»«itary»、«ent»«zen»、«immun»«ob»«lot»«ting»
patterns.context: 激活常落在短功能词、词形片段或标点上；其位置可能处于句中、词内或专名中，缺少跨段一致的语义搭配
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文及专业文本

patterns.name: 科学与数学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学证明、生物医学实验或理论物理讨论中；激活词片段及缩写周围的上下文各异
patterns.domain: 数理与生物医学、物理学术文本

patterns.name: 专名及缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名、党名、机构名、品系名或邮箱地址中，激活往往对齐到子词、符号或分隔符
patterns.domain: 百科、论文作者/机构信息、邮件

patterns.name: 列表字段与排版标记
patterns.trigger: «author»后接«:»和«↵-»；另有«↵»、«-»、«/»、«@»及转发邮件分隔线
patterns.context: 作者名单、地址列表或邮件转发头等结构化排版中，标点和换行与字段内容交错

patterns.name: 重音字符与标题条目
patterns.context: 出现在西班牙语电影或歌曲条目标题中，标题、别名及作品类型连续列举

patterns.name: 地址与地名片段
patterns.context: 作为作者单位或邮寄地址的一部分，常与院系、大学、邮编和标点并列

patterns.name: 政治人物与公共议题叙述
patterns.context: 描述地方议员的社会议题工作及政党领导职位

patterns.name: 无法归入稳定模式的局部激活
patterns.trigger: «legal»、邮件转发中的«Forward»及日期时间片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件正文残片及转发头中；与其他段落的触发线索不明显一致

en.concept: Cross-domain word fragments and text boundaries
en.description: Activation is distributed across function words, terms, fragments within proper nouns, citations, and formatting symbols in different domains; there is no stable theme. The clearest commonality is sensitivity to local word fragments and varied text boundaries.

patterns.name: Internal token fragments and word-form boundaries
patterns.context: Marks often fall on internal fragments of proper nouns, academic terms, or other long polymorphemic words; the fragments are not fixed and cannot be attributed to a single root or affix
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including encyclopedias, medicine, biology, mathematics papers, and email

patterns.name: Function words and common collocations
patterns.context: Appears at common prepositions, articles, and collocation positions within sentences; the same function word activates repeatedly in different contexts
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, abstracts, papers, and Q&A

patterns.name: Domain terms and noun phrases
patterns.context: Within domain-specific noun phrases, multiple words or local word fragments can activate; no stable semantic category is evident
patterns.domain: Medicine, biological breeding, mathematics, computing, social narratives, Korean grammar Q&A

patterns.name: Citations and bibliographic markers
patterns.context: Appears in author–year citations, abbreviations in parentheses, or corpus citation formats in papers; activation falls on punctuation, letter fragments, and numbers

patterns.name: Proper nouns, numbers, and special symbols
patterns.context: Occurs sporadically in numbering, strain names, mathematical formulas, compound names, or possessives; there is no shared semantic condition

11_1835.concept: 跨领域词片段与文本边界
11_1835.description: 激活分布在不同领域的功能词、术语、专名内部片段、引文和格式符号上；没有稳定主题，较明显的共性是对局部词片段及多样文本边界敏感。

patterns.name: 分词内部碎片与词形边界
patterns.trigger: 词内被拆分标记的子串，如 «de» «Al» («Albuquerque»)、«Sal» «dan» («Saldanha»)、«pregnant»、«Ph» «ylogenetic»、«or» («alcoholivorans»)、«Com» «bes» («Combes»)、«Res» «het» «ikh» «in»、«J» «ad» «av»
patterns.context: 标记常落在专名、学术术语或其他多词素长词的内部片段；片段并不固定，无法归为单一词根或词缀
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括百科、医学、生物学、数学论文、邮件

patterns.name: 功能词及常见搭配
patterns.context: 在句中常见介词、冠词和搭配位置出现；同一功能词在不同语境中重复激活
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、摘要、论文及问答

patterns.name: 领域术语与名词短语
patterns.context: 在领域相关名词短语中，短语内多个词或局部词片段均可激活，未显示某个稳定语义类别
patterns.domain: 医学、生物育种、数学、计算、社会叙述、韩语语法问答

patterns.name: 引文与文献标记
patterns.context: 出现于论文中的作者—年份引文、括号内缩写或语料引用格式；激活落在标点、字母片段及数字上

patterns.name: 专名、数字及特殊符号
patterns.context: 在编号、菌株名、数学公式、复合名称或所有格等格式中偶发；缺少共同的语义条件

en.description: Activation is distributed across varied English contexts: it highlights the short word to, initial letters or internal fragments in proper nouns, and fragments of medical terms such as obesity, adrenoceptor, and deoxyguanosine; the domains are broad, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Short words at syntactic or phrase boundaries
patterns.context: Appears in continuous English as a preposition or infinitive marker, followed by a verb, object, or phrase; the following content differs in all three examples

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on initial letters or subword fragments of tokenized proper place names; it cannot be explained by the shared semantics of the complete names

patterns.name: Word-initial segment in Obesity
patterns.context: Occurs in a list of diabetes risk factors as part of obesity

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a complex term
patterns.context: Embedded in the mathematical proper name 「Reshetikhin-Semenov-Tian-Shansky」

patterns.name: Subword in an oxidized nucleoside chemical name
patterns.context: Occurs within a long chemical name related to DNA damage and repair

patterns.name: Adenosine receptor root fragment
patterns.context: The segments together form adrenoceptor; segment 1 discusses β-adrenergic receptor responses, and segment 8 discusses α-adrenergic receptor antagonists

11_1835.concept: 英文子词与短词片段
11_1835.description: 激活分布于多种英文语境：突出短词 to、专名首字母或内部片段，也包括 obesity、adrenoceptor、deoxyguanosine 等医学术语片段；领域跨度大，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 句法或短语边界处的短词
patterns.context: 在连续英文中作为介词或不定式标记，后接动词、对象或短语；三个例子里后续内容不同
patterns.domain: 英文科研摘要、叙事文本

patterns.name: 专名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专有地名被拆分后的首字母或子词片段上；不能由完整专名的共同语义解释

patterns.name: Obesity 词首
patterns.context: 出现在糖尿病风险因素列表中，组成 obesity

patterns.name: 复杂术语内部片段
patterns.context: 嵌于数学专名「Reshetikhin-Semenov-Tian-Shansky」内

patterns.name: 氧化核苷化学名称的子词
patterns.context: 处于DNA损伤及修复相关的长化学名称内部

patterns.name: 腺苷受体词根片段
patterns.context: 这些分段共同组成 adrenoceptor；段1谈β肾上腺素能受体响应，段8谈α肾上腺素能受体拮抗剂

en.concept: Biomedical technical terms and proper nouns
en.description: Activation is distributed across technical terms and proper nouns: long chemical and carbohydrate names, immune cells and signaling, genes and cancer research, transplant protocols, pharmacological terms, as well as a French school name and experimental values. There is no single narrow topic.

patterns.name: Acids, polymers, and carbohydrates in chemical names
patterns.context: Activation falls on longer chemical names and their component fragments, often containing hyphens, parentheses, and acid- or carbohydrate-related morphemes.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds; chemical and biochemical terminology in medical abstracts

patterns.name: French proper noun in a school name
patterns.context: A French school proper noun and hyphenated, place-name-like structure; activation is distributed across proper-noun fragments and is not limited to chemical terminology.

patterns.name: Immune cells and cell activation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses cells, surface markers, and immune responses under stimulation.

patterns.name: Experimental values and cell-line names
patterns.context: Values and ± error terms appear in experimental results alongside treatment conditions and cell lines.

patterns.name: Glycosylation-related genes and glycan terminology
patterns.context: Gene names, abbreviations, and complex glycan names appear in research objectives or hypotheses.

patterns.name: Gene expression and tumor-cell proliferation
patterns.context: Describes RNA interference experiments and their effects on cancer-cell phenotypes.

patterns.name: Immune memory and TLR signaling
patterns.context: Discusses mechanisms of immune memory B-cell survival and research hypotheses.

patterns.name: Hematopoietic transplant protocols and clinical research
patterns.context: Statements about cord-blood units, engraftment, and clinical-trial protocols.

patterns.name: Receptor pharmacology and brain-region injections
patterns.context: Describes reversal of an effect by a pharmacological antagonist and microinjection into a brain region.

11_1835.concept: 生物医学专业术语与专名
11_1835.description: 激活分散于专业术语和专名：化学/糖类长名称、免疫细胞与信号、基因及肿瘤研究、移植方案、药理学名词，也包括法语学校名和实验数值；没有统一的窄主题。

patterns.name: 化学名称中的酸、聚合物与糖类
patterns.context: 激活落在较长化学名称及其组成片段上，常含连字符、括号和酸/糖类词素。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学摘要中的化学与生物化学术语

patterns.name: 学校名称中的法语专名
patterns.context: 法语学校专名与地名式连字符结构；激活分布在专名片段，不只限于化学术语。

patterns.name: 免疫细胞与细胞激活术语
patterns.context: 讨论细胞、表面标记及刺激条件下的免疫反应。

patterns.name: 实验数值与细胞系名称
patterns.context: 数值及 ± 误差值出现在实验结果中，并与处理条件和细胞系并列。

patterns.name: 糖基化相关基因与糖链术语
patterns.context: 基因名、缩写及复合糖链名称出现在研究目标或假设中。

patterns.name: 基因表达与肿瘤细胞增殖
patterns.trigger: “MUC16 expression”, “MUC16 mRNA levels”, “ovarian carcinoma cells”, “cell proliferation”
patterns.context: 描述 RNA 干扰实验及其对癌细胞表型的影响。

patterns.name: 免疫记忆与 TLR 信号
patterns.trigger: “TLR signaling”, “bystander T cell help”, “Bmem survival”, “sustains Bmem longevity”
patterns.context: 讨论免疫记忆 B 细胞存活机制及研究假设。

patterns.name: 造血移植方案与临床研究
patterns.context: 脐带血单位、植入及临床试验方案相关表述。

patterns.name: 受体药理学与脑区注射
patterns.context: 描述药理拮抗剂逆转效应及向脑区微量注射。

en.concept: Subword fragments in rare technical names
en.description: Primarily responds to technical names tokenized into rare subwords, especially chemical nomenclature with numbers, hyphens, or parentheses; also occurs in biomedical terms and a few foreign proper nouns and multilingual labels.

patterns.name: Systematic chemical names and structural formulas
patterns.context: Chemical substances, substituents, sugar acids, or steroid names, as well as structural names with numbers, parentheses, and hyphens; activation often falls on tokenized chemical fragments.
patterns.domain: Chemistry, materials, and medicinal chemistry papers and patents

patterns.name: Medical proper nouns and biotechnology terms
patterns.context: Drug names, molecule/system abbreviations, and technical terms in medical or biological contexts; some names consist of rare word fragments.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH project text

patterns.name: Foreign and non-English proper noun fragments
patterns.context: Non-English personal names, place names, or multilingual labels containing accented characters or unusual tokenization; the markers in these examples are sporadic.
patterns.domain: Biographical narratives, multilingual strings in code

11_1835.concept: 罕见专业名称的子词片段
11_1835.description: 主要响应由罕见子词拆分而成的专业名称，尤其是带数字、连字符或括号的化学命名；也见于生物医学术语，以及少数外语专名和多语言标签。

patterns.name: 系统化学名称与结构式
patterns.context: 化学物质、取代基、糖酸或甾体名称，以及带数字、括号和连字符的结构命名；激活常落在被拆分的化学词片段上。
patterns.domain: 化学、材料与药物化学论文及专利

patterns.name: 医学专名与生物技术术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物学语境中的药物名、分子/系统缩写和专业术语；部分名称由罕见词片段构成。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 外语及非英语专名片段
patterns.context: 非英语人名、地名或多语言标签，含重音字符或不常见的词形切分；这些例子中的标记较零散。
patterns.domain: 传记叙述、代码中的多语言字符串

en.description: Activation appears across diverse biomedical texts, often on split substrings of chemical names, gene/protein abbreviations, or statements about research procedures and disease. Chemical-name fragments are prominent, but trigger forms and topics are not unified.

patterns.name: Glucoside fragment in chemical names
patterns.context: Occurs in names of glycosides, glucosides, or related compounds, often near beta-D, enzymes, or metabolism descriptions

patterns.name: Numerals and structural fragments in specific chemical names
patterns.context: Part of a steroid compound name in a discussion of CYP11B1-catalyzed reactions and their substrates

patterns.name: Long substring in a specific chemical name
patterns.context: The substring occurs in the long chemical name of a fluorescent lipid analog

patterns.name: Patent chemical names and punctuation-number strings
patterns.context: Appears in a patent background describing synthetic routes and racemic products

patterns.name: Gene/protein abbreviations and experimental procedures
patterns.context: Gene or protein abbreviations appear in descriptions of knockdown, depletion, overexpression, and similar procedures; these fragments span different genes and show no clear unified biological theme

patterns.name: Exposure and disease-progression statements in research plans
patterns.context: Research objectives concern in utero or lactational exposure, epigenetic features, and prostate cancer progression

patterns.name: Specific protein-phosphatase inhibition context
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of pharmacological PP-2A inhibition on endothelial cell motility

patterns.name: Tuberculosis infection and cytokine response
patterns.context: Studies how Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection changes macrophage responses to cytokines

11_1835.concept: 生物医学术语片段
11_1835.description: 激活分布在多种生物医学文本中，常落在化学名称的拆分子串、基因/蛋白缩写及研究操作或疾病语句上；化学命名相关片段较突出，但触发形式和主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 化学名称中的 glucoside 片段
patterns.context: 出现在糖苷、葡萄糖苷或相关化合物的名称中，常与 beta-D、酶或代谢描述相邻
patterns.domain: 生物化学与营养学论文摘要

patterns.name: 特定化学名称中的数字及结构片段
patterns.context: 在讨论 CYP11B1 催化反应及其底物时，作为类固醇化合物名称的一部分
patterns.domain: 酶学／内分泌生物化学摘要

patterns.name: 特定化学名称中的长子串
patterns.context: 子串位于荧光脂质类似物的长化学名称中

patterns.name: 专利化学名称及标点数字串
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景对合成路线及外消旋产物的描述中

patterns.name: 基因／蛋白缩写与实验操作
patterns.context: 基因或蛋白缩写出现在敲低、耗竭、过表达等实验描述中；这些片段跨越不同基因，未显示明确统一生物学主题
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划／摘要

patterns.name: 研究计划中的暴露与疾病进展表述
patterns.context: 围绕宫内或哺乳期暴露、表观遗传特征及前列腺癌进展的研究目标

patterns.name: 特异性蛋白磷酸酶抑制语境
patterns.context: 讨论药理学抑制 PP-2A 对内皮细胞运动性的影响

patterns.name: 结核感染与细胞因子反应
patterns.context: 研究结核分枝杆菌感染如何改变巨噬细胞对细胞因子的反应

en.description: Sensitive to tokenized proper nouns and compound-word boundaries in technical text: these include gene/protein names, compound names, biomedical terms, and one author–year citation format; common cues are subwords, numbers, or hyphen boundaries.

patterns.name: Compound-word boundaries in gene/protein names
patterns.context: Activation falls near segmented spellings, numbers, or hyphens in proper nouns; many examples are names of genes, proteins, treatments, or experimental models.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH research plans

patterns.name: Morpheme boundaries in biochemical compound names
patterns.context: At the boundaries of fragments in rare, long, highly morphemic chemical, drug, or natural product names, including numbers and hyphens.
patterns.domain: Biochemistry, chemical patents, and natural product literature

patterns.name: Tokenization within biomedical terms
patterns.context: When technical terms are split into multiple subwords, activation occurs on constituent fragments or morpheme boundaries; it is not limited to a specific biological process.
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, figure captions, and research plans

patterns.name: Author name and year format in citations
patterns.context: In citation strings that mention an author account/name and a two-digit year, activation is concentrated near the @ marker, name fragment, and year.
patterns.domain: References or author citations in ArXiv text

11_1835.concept: 专业复合词的子词边界
11_1835.description: 对专业文本中被切分的专名和复合词边界敏感：包括基因/蛋白名、化合物名、生物医学术语，也包括一处作者—年份引文格式；常见线索是子词、数字或连字符接缝。

patterns.name: 基因/蛋白名称中的复合词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在专名的分段拼写、数字或连字符附近；不少例子是基因、蛋白、处理因素或实验模型名称。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及 NIH 研究计划

patterns.name: 生化化合物名称中的词素边界
patterns.context: 罕见、长而高度词素化的化学名或药物/天然产物名称中，数字、连字符和名称片段交界处。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、化学专利及天然产物文献

patterns.name: 生物医学术语内部的切分
patterns.context: 技术词被拆分成多个子词时，激活出现在构词片段或词素接缝；不限于特定生物过程。
patterns.domain: 生物医学正文、图注和研究计划

patterns.name: 引文中的作者名与年份格式
patterns.context: 提及作者账号/姓名及两位数年份的引用串中，激活集中在 @ 标记、姓名片段和年份附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文本中的参考文献或作者引用

en.description: Appears mainly in scientific texts, particularly project abstracts and biomedical papers: statements of research objectives, experimental procedures, and disease or physiological effects. It also covers specific biochemical assays, immune-cell fusion, and a passage from algebraic geometry.

patterns.name: Project objectives and experimental plans
patterns.context: Research plans or abstracts describe hypotheses, objectives, and experiments to be conducted; activation falls on objective/plan-related words and nearby scientific terms.

patterns.name: Biomedical exposures and disease effects
patterns.context: Describes the effects of exposure, infection, or genetic manipulation on disease progression or metabolic phenotypes, often framed as causal hypotheses or experimental tests.

patterns.name: Biochemical and physiological experimental details
patterns.context: Specific substrates, isotopes, concentrations, and experimental results appear in enzyme reactions, ion transport, vitamin absorption, or metabolic assays.

patterns.name: Microbial interactions and biofilms
patterns.context: Bacterial surface factors act together, forming biofilms and affecting disease or drug resistance.

patterns.name: Antigen-directed cell fusion
patterns.context: Describes preparing hybridomas by cell fusion and screening specific hybrids with antigens.

patterns.name: Citation and computational statement in a mathematics paper
patterns.context: A citation supports a statement that a mathematical object has been computed; this differs from the biomedical content.

11_1835.concept: 科研实验与研究陈述
11_1835.description: 主要出现在科研文本中，尤其是项目摘要和生物医学论文：陈述研究目标、实验操作及疾病或生理效应；也覆盖具体生化测定、免疫细胞融合和一段代数几何引文。

patterns.name: 项目目标与实验计划
patterns.trigger: “We intend to test our hypotheses”, “specific aims”, “Aim 4”, “We will determine”, “will generate … and test whether”
patterns.context: 研究计划或摘要中描述假设、研究目标及将实施的实验；激活落在目标/计划相关词及其邻近科学术语上。

patterns.name: 生物医学暴露与疾病效应
patterns.trigger: “TCDD exposure”, “infection”, “accelerates prostate adenocarcinoma progression”, “protects against diet-induced insulin resistance”
patterns.context: 描述暴露、感染或遗传操作对疾病进展、代谢表型的影响，常以因果假设或实验检验呈现。

patterns.name: 生化与生理实验细节
patterns.context: 酶反应、离子转运、维生素吸收或代谢测定中出现具体底物、同位素、浓度及实验结果。
patterns.domain: 生物化学与生理学论文摘要

patterns.name: 微生物相互作用与生物膜
patterns.trigger: “GC-GC interactions”, “produce biofilms”, “Opa and LOS function cooperatively”
patterns.context: 细菌表面因子协同作用、形成生物膜及其疾病或耐药特性。

patterns.name: 抗原导向细胞融合
patterns.trigger: “conjugates will be inserted”, “fused with human T cells”, “antigen-directed fusion”
patterns.context: 描述细胞融合制备杂交瘤并通过抗原筛选特异性杂交体。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的引用与计算陈述
patterns.context: 以论文引文支持某数学对象已被计算的陈述；与生物医学内容不同。

en.concept: Local subword fragments in scientific text
en.description: Activations are widely distributed across common connectives in biomedical papers, chemical/biomolecular names split by tokenization, and descriptions of experimental subjects, conditions, and results; a few fragments occur in specific enzymology, clinical, or natural-product terms.

patterns.name: Intermittent common words and grammatical connectives
patterns.context: These words occur in different positions in academic sentences; activations span multiple semantic domains and commonly appear in expressions of relations, methods, results, or discourse structure, without a stable single collocation

patterns.name: Fragments in chemical and biomolecular names
patterns.context: Activations occur in specialized chemical or biochemical names split by tokenization, or in their local morphemes; different passages refer to different molecules, with no shared entity
patterns.domain: Biochemistry, chemical nomenclature, and enzymology abstracts

patterns.name: Internal fragments of numbers, symbols, and proper names
patterns.context: Activations occur within technical names interspersed with numbers, hyphens, Greek letters, or abbreviations; they are mainly tokenized fragments of technical terms

patterns.name: Fragments describing study subjects or experimental conditions
patterns.context: Activations occur in modifiers specifying study subjects, treatment exposures, genetic defects, or population characteristics; the research topics differ across passages
patterns.domain: Animal experiments, immunology, and clinical research

patterns.name: Descriptions of results, effects, and experimental procedures
patterns.context: Expressions of results or experimental aims in scientific discourse; some describe negative effects, others promotion or research aims, with no consistent direction

patterns.name: Naming fragments for lactones and homoserine lactones
patterns.context: In passage 7, activations concentrate on recurring morphemes in bacterial signaling molecule names and their chemical modifications; these do not fully match the naming of other compounds in other passages

patterns.name: β-glycoside hydrolase mechanisms and substrates
patterns.context: Occurs in one passage around glycoside hydrolysis, enzyme intermediates, and residue numbering; describes a specific enzymatic mechanism

patterns.name: Flavonoid glycoside names
patterns.context: Activations occur in systematic naming fragments for polyphenol/flavonoid glycosides, including sugar groups, linkage positions, and acyl modifications

patterns.name: Pregnancy and weight in reproductive health research
patterns.context: Passage 10 reports an intervention study of overweight or obese pregnant women; activations are distributed across phrases related to the population, gestational weight, and obstetric outcomes

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments that do not fit a stable semantic pattern
patterns.context: Although these occur in specialized scientific contexts, they appear individually, and the samples do not reveal a shared triggering condition

11_1835.concept: 科研文本中的局部词片段
11_1835.description: 激活广泛分布于生物医学论文中的常见连接词、分词拆开的化学/生物分子名称，以及实验对象、条件和结果表述；少数片段落在特定酶学、临床或天然产物术语中。

patterns.name: 断续的常见词和语法连接词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在学术句子的不同位置；激活跨越多种语义领域，常见于关系、方法、结果或论述结构中，没有稳定的单一搭配
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要、科研文本

patterns.name: 化学与生物分子名称中的碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词拆开的专业化学、生化名称或其局部词素中；不同段涉及不同分子，并无共同实体
patterns.domain: 生物化学、化学命名及酶学摘要

patterns.name: 数字、符号与专名的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活位于数字、连字符、希腊字母或缩写交织的技术名称内部；主要是专业名词的分词片段

patterns.name: 研究对象或实验条件的描述片段
patterns.trigger: “exposed fetal UGE”, “in utero and lactational … exposure”, “infected … deficient mice”, “overweight or obese pregnant women”
patterns.context: 激活落在研究对象、处理暴露、基因缺陷或人群特征等限定语中；各段研究主题不同
patterns.domain: 动物实验、免疫学及临床研究

patterns.name: 结果、效应及实验过程表述
patterns.trigger: “accelerates … progression”, “failed to affect”, “was studied to determine”, “did not impair”, “failed to reduce”
patterns.context: 科研叙述中的结果或实验目的表达；有的是否定效应，有的是促进或研究目的，方向不统一

patterns.name: 乳糖内酯与同丝氨酸内酯命名片段
patterns.context: 在第7段，激活集中于细菌信号分子名称中的重复词素及其化学修饰；与其他段的其他化合物命名不完全相同
patterns.domain: 微生物学、生物化学摘要

patterns.name: β-糖苷水解酶机制与底物
patterns.context: 同一段落中围绕糖苷水解、酶中间体和残基编号出现；属于具体酶学机制描述

patterns.name: 类黄酮糖苷名称
patterns.context: 激活落在多酚/黄酮糖苷的系统命名片段中，包含糖基、连接位点及酰基修饰

patterns.name: 生殖健康研究中的妊娠与体重
patterns.context: 第10段报告超重或肥胖孕妇的干预研究，激活散布于人群、妊娠体重和产科结局相关词组

patterns.name: 无法归入稳定语义模式的零散片段
patterns.context: 虽处于专业科研语境，但各自单独出现，无法从样本确认共同触发条件

en.concept: Local word fragments in formatted text
en.description: Activation spans multiple fields and falls on compound-word hyphens, citation markers, medical terms, and formatted fragments such as email addresses and legal titles; sporadic function words also show high activation. The examples lack a unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Non-pharmacological prefix
patterns.context: A hyphenated “non-pharmacological” appears in a research objective; activation concentrates on the non- prefix and hyphen

patterns.name: Hyphens within words
patterns.context: A hyphen or similar connector occurs inside a compound, chemical name, or formatted phrase; meanings and fields vary
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, NIH abstracts, astrophysics papers

patterns.name: Literature citations and author markers
patterns.context: Author-year citations, bracketed citations, or reference markers in ArXiv text
patterns.domain: Academic papers, mainly astrophysics and methods reviews

patterns.name: Genes and biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Abbreviations, terms, and their component parts are split into marked fragments in medical or biological research texts; the terms differ across passages

patterns.name: Proper nouns and string segmentation
patterns.context: Proper nouns and formatted text such as email addresses, underscore-separated strings, or legal case titles; activation falls on local characters or word fragments

patterns.name: Frequent function words and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: A few function words or common phrases in ordinary sentences show strong activation, but there is no clear, consistent semantic condition across passages

11_1835.concept: 格式化文本中的局部词片段
11_1835.description: 激活分布跨领域，落在复合词连字符、引用标记、医学术语，以及邮箱和法律标题等格式化片段；另有零散功能词高激活。各例缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 非药物治疗前缀
patterns.context: 研究目标中出现连字符构成的“non-pharmacological”，激活集中在 non- 前缀及连字符

patterns.name: 词语内部连字符
patterns.context: 连字符或类似连接符位于复合词、化学名称或格式化词组内部；具体词义和领域各异
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 摘要、天体物理论文

patterns.name: 文献引用与作者标记
patterns.context: ArXiv 文本中的作者—年份引用、方括号引用或文献标记
patterns.domain: 学术论文，主要为天体物理及方法综述

patterns.name: 基因与生物医学术语
patterns.trigger: «dis»2ulf«onic»1« acid»1；« epithelial»3« budding»2；« T»3«CD»5«D»7« exposure»9；« E»2«IB»2；« Wnt»2«/?»3«-»5«catenin»3
patterns.context: 医学或生物研究文本中，缩写、术语及其组成部分被拆分标记；各段术语并不相同
patterns.domain: PubMed 与 NIH 生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 专名与字符串分段
patterns.context: 邮箱地址、下划线分隔字符串或法律案件标题等专名和格式化文本；激活落在局部字符或词片段

patterns.name: 高频功能词及句法片段
patterns.trigger: « to»10；« did»6« not»7« affect»4；« studies»3« have»5« attempted»3
patterns.context: 普通语句中少数功能词或常见短语有较强激活，但没有跨段一致的明确语义条件

en.concept: Biomedical research text and results reporting
en.description: Primarily responds to negative results, research aims, and treatment strategies in biomedical text, and also to mechanistic pathways; other examples include chemical experimental details and email address lists, with partially inconsistent trigger cues.

patterns.name: Negative results reporting no expected effect
patterns.context: An intervention, treatment, or research measure is described, followed by a report that it did not change an outcome; common structure: “did not/failed to + verb”.

patterns.name: Research aims and hypothesis testing
patterns.context: States a research aim and describes a causal relationship, treatment effect, or mechanism to be tested.

patterns.name: Combination interventions and treatment strategies
patterns.context: Discusses the use of drugs, treatments, or research methods alone or in combination to alter treatment effects or disease progression.
patterns.domain: Research plans and translational medicine abstracts

patterns.name: Disease mechanisms and signaling pathways
patterns.context: Links signaling pathways, receptors, or immune mechanisms to disease, cell survival, or treatment effects.

patterns.name: Personal or organizational email addresses
patterns.context: A consecutive list of email addresses separated by line breaks; activations concentrate on email symbols, local characters, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Irregular chemical names and experimental conditions
patterns.context: Chemical reagents, ion substitutions, and measurement metrics occur in an experimental results passage.

patterns.name: Specific study subjects or project identifiers
patterns.context: Proper names, disease models, or project abbreviations are embedded in research aims or experimental results; no shared triggering pattern for proper names is apparent.

patterns.name: Unexplained mechanism and results descriptions
patterns.context: These local segments come from biomedical text but do not clearly match the specific triggering features of other patterns.

11_1835.concept: 生物医学研究文本及结果表达
11_1835.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的否定结果、研究目标和治疗策略，也涉及机制通路；另有化学实验细节及邮箱地址列表，触发线索并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 未产生预期效果的否定结果
patterns.trigger: “did not affect”“failed to affect”“did not change”“did not impair”“did not protect”“failed to reduce”
patterns.context: 先描述干预、治疗或研究措施，随后报告其未改变某种结局；常见结构为“did not/failed to + 动词”。

patterns.name: 研究目标与假设检验
patterns.context: 提出研究目标，描述将检验的因果关系、治疗效应或机制。

patterns.name: 组合干预与治疗策略
patterns.trigger: “alone and in combination”“alone or in combination”“co-therapeutic”“therapeutic targeting”
patterns.context: 讨论单独或联合使用药物、治疗或研究方法，以改变治疗效果或疾病进程。
patterns.domain: 研究计划与转化医学摘要

patterns.name: 疾病机制及信号通路
patterns.context: 把信号通路、受体或免疫机制与疾病、细胞生存或治疗效应相联系。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划与摘要

patterns.name: 人名或组织邮箱地址
patterns.context: 连续的电子邮件地址列表，并以换行分隔；激活集中在邮箱符号、局部字符和换行。

patterns.name: 不规则化学名称与实验条件
patterns.context: 实验结果段落中出现化学试剂、离子替换和测量指标。

patterns.name: 具体研究对象或项目标识
patterns.context: 专名、疾病模型或项目缩写嵌入研究目标或实验结果中；未见共同的专名触发规律。

patterns.name: 未解释的机制与结果叙述
patterns.context: 这些局部内容虽来自生物医学文本，但不明显符合其他模式的具体触发特征。
patterns.domain: 研究计划与 PubMed 摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to statements of plans/hypotheses in scientific texts and negation or partial negation in biomedical results; it also responds to ArXiv citation keys, reference lists, and mathematical citations. Astrophysics prose and incomplete citation lists lack a clear shared local pattern.

patterns.name: Research objective and hypothesis constructions
patterns.context: Scientific plans or abstracts propose specific objectives, interventions, and expected results; triggers often occur near modal verbs such as will and can.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, biomedical research plans

patterns.name: Negative results and incomplete elimination
patterns.context: Reports that a result did not change or was only partly reduced after a treatment, replacement, or removal; appears in experimental-result descriptions.

patterns.name: Citation markers and author names
patterns.context: Literature keys or author names marked with @ in reference lists, often accompanied by semicolons, commas, and numeric suffixes.

patterns.name: Specific mathematical citation key
patterns.context: A bracketed citation is inserted while introducing compact Lie groups, nontrivial centers, and a canonical element.

patterns.name: Particle-physics reference lists
patterns.context: Summarizes or directs readers to literature on Monte-Carlo methods and lists references.

patterns.name: Scientific narrative with no clear shared trigger
patterns.context: An astrophysics passage discusses studies of starburst-galaxy scales; its content does not match the other clear patterns.

patterns.name: Fragments that do not fit identified patterns
patterns.context: Truncated or incomplete fragments of citation-key lists; a more specific trigger condition cannot be determined from the fragment alone.

11_1835.concept: 科研论述与引用结构
11_1835.description: 主要响应科研文本中的计划/假设表达及生物医学结果中的否定或部分否定；另对ArXiv引用键、参考文献列举和数学文献引用有反应。天体物理叙述及残缺引用列表缺乏明确共同局部模式。

patterns.name: 研究目标与假设句式
patterns.trigger: “In Aim 2/3 we will…”、“determine if”、“test whether”、“will alter”、“can enhance/can reverse”
patterns.context: 科研计划或摘要中提出具体研究目标、干预及其预期结果；触发点常在 will、can 等情态动词附近。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 否定结果与未完全消除
patterns.trigger: “did not affect”、“failed to affect”、“did not completely abolish”
patterns.context: 报告处理、替换或移除某因素后，某结果没有改变或只部分减弱；可见于实验结果叙述。

patterns.name: 文献引用标记与作者名
patterns.context: 引用列表中以 @ 标记的文献键或作者名，常伴随分号、逗号及数字后缀。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文献引用/参考文献键

patterns.name: 特定数学文献键
patterns.context: 介绍紧李群、非平凡中心及 canonical element 时插入方括号文献引用。

patterns.name: 粒子物理参考文献列举
patterns.context: 总结或指引读者查阅 Monte-Carlo 方法相关文献，列举参考资料。

patterns.name: 未见明确共同触发的科学叙述
patterns.trigger: 未发现稳定共享的局部触发子串
patterns.context: 天体物理段落谈星暴星系尺度研究；其内容不符合其他明确模式。

patterns.name: 无法归入已识别模式的残片
patterns.context: 引用键列表的截断或残缺片段，无法从片段本身确定更具体触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to contrasts between treatments and outcomes in biomedical text, especially negative no-effect statements such as “did not”; also appears in future-tense statements of research aims. A few heterogeneous patterns include corrupted Github text and email header addresses.

patterns.name: Negative results or no effect
patterns.context: A result describes an intervention or treatment that did not change, block, or fully eliminate a measure or response; contrastive constructions are common

patterns.name: Research plans and statements of aims
patterns.context: Uses the future tense to state research aims or test the effects of a therapy or mechanism

patterns.name: Biomedical experimental results reporting
patterns.context: Reports experimental treatments and observed results for cell, tissue, animal, or patient measures; a negative effect is not required

patterns.name: Corrupted text or irregular tokenization
patterns.context: Characters or subword fragments are concatenated irregularly, without an identifiable normal semantic context

patterns.name: Email addresses and recipient fields
patterns.context: Lists recipients, CC recipients, and email addresses in email headers

11_1835.concept: 生物医学研究结果与计划
11_1835.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中处理与结果的对照，尤其“did not”等否定无效应表述；也见研究目标的未来时陈述。另有乱码Github文本和邮件头地址等少数异质模式。

patterns.name: 否定性结果或无效应
patterns.trigger: “did not affect”“failed to affect”“did not completely abolish”“did not alter”“did not influence”“neither has any effect”“did not inhibit”
patterns.context: 结果描述中，某干预或处理未改变、未阻断或未完全消除某项指标/反应；常出现转折对比

patterns.name: 研究计划与目标陈述
patterns.trigger: “Aim 3”“Specific Aim 3”“Specific Aim 4”及“we will”“will establish”“will assess”“will determine”
patterns.context: 以未来时说明研究目标、检验某疗法或机制的作用

patterns.name: 生物医学实验结果叙述
patterns.context: 围绕细胞、组织、动物或患者指标报告实验处理和观察结果；不要求出现否定效应

patterns.name: 乱码或分词异常文本
patterns.context: 字符或子词拼接异常，缺乏可辨识的正常语义上下文

patterns.name: 邮件地址与收件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件头中列出收件人、抄送人及邮箱地址

en.description: Primarily responds to negative-result structures, especially did not/failed to with experimental effect verbs; also occurs with non- prefixes, quantitative results, medical terminology, and experimental methods. Email addresses and several abbreviation fragments are difficult to assign to a stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Results with not as complete negation
patterns.context: Reports negative results after an experiment, intervention, or treatment; often uses did/failed + not followed by verbs such as affect, change, or inhibit

patterns.name: Non-invasive terms and negative prefixes
patterns.context: The word-internal non- indicates the absence of a property, or appears in non-T cell classifications; trigger positions include inside words and in hyphenated structures
patterns.domain: Medical and analytical chemistry abstracts, research plans

patterns.name: Numbers, significance, and comparative results
patterns.context: In quantitative experimental results, numbers occur near percentages, statistical significance, or concentration units

patterns.name: Specific medical abbreviations and fragmented proper nouns
patterns.context: Terms or proper nouns are split into tokens, with activation distributed around abbreviations, alphanumeric strings, or name fragments; no stable shared semantics are evident

patterns.name: Research methods and technical descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces detection or imaging methods and describes their uses or properties
patterns.domain: Analytical chemistry abstracts, neuroscience research plans

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and their effects
patterns.context: Describes experimental procedures, drug treatments, or biological responses to interventions

patterns.name: Email addresses and name fragments
patterns.context: A comma-separated list of recipient names, angle brackets, and email addresses

11_1835.concept: 否定与实验结果表述
11_1835.description: 主要响应否定结果结构，尤其 did not/failed to 与实验效应动词；也见 non-前缀、定量结果、医学术语和实验方法。邮件地址及若干缩写片段难以归入稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: not 完全否定结果
patterns.trigger: “did not”及其后续结果词，如 “did not completely abolish”“did not alter”“did not affect”“failed to affect”“did not change”“did not protect”
patterns.context: 实验、干预或处理后报告阴性结果；常有 did/failed + not，随后接影响、改变、抑制等动词

patterns.name: 非侵入性及否定前缀
patterns.context: 词内 non- 表示非某性质，或细胞分类中的 non-T；触发位置包括词语内部及连字符结构
patterns.domain: 医学、分析化学摘要及研究计划

patterns.name: 数字、显著性与比较结果
patterns.context: 定量实验结果中，数字与百分比、统计显著性或浓度单位相邻

patterns.name: 特定医学缩写及碎片化专名
patterns.context: 术语或专名被分词切分，激活分布在缩写、字母数字串或姓名片段附近；未见稳定共同语义
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、邮件地址名单

patterns.name: 研究方法与技术描述
patterns.context: 介绍检测或成像方法及其用途、特性
patterns.domain: 分析化学摘要、神经科学研究计划

patterns.name: 实验处理及其效应表述
patterns.context: 描述实验操作、药物处理或干预后的生物学响应

patterns.name: 邮件地址与姓名片段
patterns.context: 逗号分隔的收件人姓名、尖括号和电子邮件地址组成的名单

en.description: Primarily responds to negation, lack of effect, or lack of significance in research results; also occurs in contrastive sentences pointing out research gaps and in definitions and word-formation markers in etymology entries.

patterns.name: Negative results or no effect
patterns.context: Negates or limits research effects, impacts, correlations, or existing evidence, often in results statements; activations are prominent near negation words.

patterns.name: Research gaps after a contrast
patterns.context: Describes prior research, then uses a contrast to note that few studies exist or that research is incomplete.

patterns.name: Quoted words in etymological definitions
patterns.context: Explains surname etymology and word-forming elements; activations occur near definitions, quotation marks, and related word forms.

11_1835.concept: 否定或受限的陈述
11_1835.description: 主要对研究结果中的否定、无效或未显著措辞起反应；也见于指出研究缺口的转折句，以及词源条目中的释义和构词标记。

patterns.name: 否定结果或无影响
patterns.trigger: “did not”, “failed to”, “without effect”, “no study”, “did not seem to”, “not significantly”
patterns.context: 否定或限制研究效果、影响、相关性或既有证据，常出现于结果陈述中；否定词附近的激活较突出。

patterns.name: 转折后的研究缺口
patterns.context: 先描述既有研究，再以转折指出研究数量少或尚未完成。

patterns.name: 词源释义中的引号词
patterns.context: 解释姓氏词源及构词成分，激活落在释义、引号标记和相关词形附近。

en.concept: Negation and absence in academic contexts
en.description: Activation commonly occurs with no/little statements of research gaps and with negative or ineffective expressions such as did not and without effect in experimental results; it also appears in two examples of category terms formed with non-.

patterns.name: Statements of research gaps
patterns.context: An introduction or research plan first mentions existing studies or phenomena, then notes that no studies exist, research is limited, or a mechanism is unknown; activation mainly falls on “no” or “little”.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and NIH research plans spanning medicine, public health, reproductive research, and social science

patterns.name: No effect or failure to change
patterns.context: Experimental results state that an intervention did not change a measure, or an operation did not completely eliminate a response; the negation often occurs around the result predicate.

patterns.name: non- before an informal funding category
patterns.context: Modifies a funding-source category and is paired with federally; local activation centers on the negative prefix and hyphen.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions or researcher biographies

patterns.name: non- before a non-biological parent category
patterns.context: A negative prefix in parentheses limits the category of social parents.

11_1835.concept: 学术语境中的否定与缺失
11_1835.description: 激活常见于研究空白表述中的 no/little，及实验结果中 did not、without effect 等否定或无效表达；另有两例落在 non- 构成的类别词上。

patterns.name: 研究空白表述
patterns.trigger: “to date” / “Although … studies …” / “little … has been made” / “little is known”以及附近的 “no” 或 “little”
patterns.context: 在论文引言或研究计划中，先提及已有研究或现象，再指出尚无研究、研究不足或机制未知；激活主要落在“no”或“little”上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文与 NIH 研究计划，涵盖医学、公共卫生、生殖研究及社会科学

patterns.name: 不产生影响或未能改变
patterns.trigger: “did not affect”中的 “to” 附近；“without effect”；“did not completely abolish”中的 “did not”
patterns.context: 实验结果描述中，某干预未改变指标，或某操作未完全消除反应；否定词常在结果谓语前后。
patterns.domain: 生理学、药理学与免疫学论文

patterns.name: 非正式资金类别前的 non-
patterns.context: 修饰资金来源类别，与 federally 并列；局部激活集中在否定前缀和连字符。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目说明或研究人员简介

patterns.name: 非生物学父母类别前的 non-
patterns.context: 括号内用否定前缀限定社会父母的类别。
patterns.domain: NIH 社会科学研究计划

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of impacts, effects, and negative results in biomedical papers, especially inhibition, no significant effect, and molecular binding; also occurs in descriptions of research gaps, experimental mechanisms, and structural effects.

patterns.name: Noncompetitive inhibition
patterns.context: Pharmacological or biochemical experiments describe an inhibitor's effects on receptors, enzymes, or cellular processes and compare them with competitive effects or control results.

patterns.name: No effect or no significant effect
patterns.context: Reports negative experimental results, stating that a treatment has no effect on a response, proliferation, penetration, or structural measure; often listed alongside other results that do show effects.

patterns.name: Statements of impact/effect results
patterns.context: Describes how a drug, mutation, molecular structure, or experimental condition affects a biological outcome; the result need not be negative.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts and article text

patterns.name: Biomolecular binding
patterns.context: Discusses binding of ligands, compounds, or metabolites and binding modes, including binding assays or covalent binding.
patterns.domain: Pharmacology, biochemistry, and toxicology research abstracts

patterns.name: Research gaps / unknowns
patterns.context: Notes that a mechanism or research question has not been sufficiently studied, often using qualifiers such as “to date” or “so far”.
patterns.domain: Medical paper abstracts and main text

patterns.name: Effects or mechanisms in specialized biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Describes stimulation, response, inhibition, proliferation, or mechanisms of action in specialized experimental narratives; no single fixed term triggers the pattern.

11_1835.concept: 生物医学效应与影响
11_1835.description: 主要响应生物医学论文中关于影响、效应及阴性结果的表述，尤其是抑制作用、无显著影响和分子结合；也见于研究空缺、实验机制及结构效应的叙述。

patterns.name: 非竞争性抑制
patterns.context: 药理或生化实验描述抑制剂对受体、酶或细胞过程的作用，并与竞争性作用或对照结果对比。

patterns.name: 无效或无显著影响
patterns.context: 报告实验阴性结果，指出处理对某项反应、增殖、穿透或结构指标无影响；常与其他有影响的结果并列。

patterns.name: 影响/作用结果的表述
patterns.context: 围绕药物、突变、分子结构或实验条件如何影响某种生物学结果展开；不一定为阴性结果。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要及论文正文

patterns.name: 生物分子结合
patterns.context: 讨论配体、化合物或代谢产物的结合及结合模式，包含结合实验或共价结合。
patterns.domain: 药理、生化及毒理研究摘要

patterns.name: 研究空缺/未知
patterns.context: 指出某机制或研究问题尚未被充分研究，常用“to date”“so far”等限定。

patterns.name: 生物医学专业术语中的效应或机制
patterns.context: 在专业实验叙述中描述刺激、反应、抑制、增殖或作用机制；并无单一固定术语触发。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in research background and results discussions in biomedical papers, especially when pointing out missing studies, data, or consensus, and reporting no significant change. They also involve specific expressions of effect size, structural mutations, detection bias, questionnaire revision, and scoring performance.

patterns.name: Denying research gaps and unsettled conclusions
patterns.context: Academic discourse stating that a problem has not yet been studied or lacks data, consensus, or a definitive answer; activations are concentrated on the negation and following words.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research abstracts, and background sections

patterns.name: Non-significant results
patterns.context: Reporting that statistical results, interventions, mutations, or scores produced no significant change or improvement.

patterns.name: Describing effects and differences in research results
patterns.context: Describing effect size, increased risk, between-group differences, or measurement bias in biomedical research; not necessarily a negative result.
patterns.domain: Medical research results and discussion of detection methods

patterns.name: Presenting academic background and research progress
patterns.context: Introducing current understanding or unresolved questions against the background of prior research, related factors, or progress in the field.
patterns.domain: Introductions, discussions, and abstracts of biomedical papers

patterns.name: Questionnaire piloting and revision
patterns.context: Describing tests of questionnaire comprehensibility and feasibility, and revising or deleting items based on participant feedback.

patterns.name: Molecular structure and mutation effects
patterns.context: Comparing the different effects of mutations on protein or hemoglobin structure.

patterns.name: Cellular processes and molecular mechanisms
patterns.context: Discussing the effects of specific molecules or mutations on cellular processes such as receptor internalization, and noting insufficient understanding of the mechanism.

patterns.name: Detection performance and measurement bias
patterns.context: Discussing the performance of laboratory detection methods and their effects on the accuracy of estimated measures.

patterns.name: Numerical comparisons and scoring performance
patterns.context: Reporting values or scores and assessing whether an added measure improves diagnostic performance.
patterns.domain: Medical imaging or clinical evaluation research

patterns.name: Unsettled conclusions in genetics and disease research
patterns.context: Reviewing genetic research on anxiety and mood disorders while noting the lack of definitive conclusions.

11_1835.concept: 生物医学研究论述
11_1835.description: 激活主要出现在生物医学论文的研究背景与结果论述，尤其是指出研究、数据或共识缺失，以及报告未显著变化；也涉及效应大小、结构突变、检测偏差、问卷修订和评分性能等具体表达。

patterns.name: 否定研究空白与未定论
patterns.trigger: “no”后接“study/data/consensus/definitive answers”等否定存在或确定性的表达；另有“nothing is known”
patterns.context: 学术论述中指出某问题尚无研究、数据、共识或确切答案；主要激活集中在否定词及其后续词语
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、科研摘要与研究背景

patterns.name: 非显著结果
patterns.trigger: “non-significant”，以及“did not change”“does not alter”“did not seem to improve”
patterns.context: 报告统计结果或干预、突变、评分等未产生显著变化或改善

patterns.name: 研究结果的效应与差异描述
patterns.context: 描述生物医学研究中的效应大小、风险升高、组间差异或测量偏差；不一定是否定结果
patterns.domain: 医学研究结果与检测方法讨论

patterns.name: 学术论文中的背景与研究进展铺陈
patterns.trigger: “Although several studies…”, “A recent meta-analysis…”, “The archetypal family member…”, “Considerable work has focused…”
patterns.context: 以既有研究、相关因素或领域进展为背景，引出当前认识或尚待解决的问题
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文引言、讨论与摘要

patterns.name: 问卷工具的预试与修订
patterns.context: 描述对问卷进行可理解性、可行性测试，并依据样本反馈删改题目

patterns.name: 分子结构与突变影响
patterns.context: 比较突变对蛋白质或血红蛋白结构的不同影响
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与生物化学

patterns.name: 细胞过程及分子机制
patterns.context: 谈及特定分子或突变对受体内化等细胞过程的作用，并指出机制认识不足

patterns.name: 检测性能与测量偏差
patterns.context: 讨论实验室检测方法的性能及其对估算指标准确性的影响

patterns.name: 数值比较与评分性能
patterns.context: 报告数值或评分，并判断新增指标是否改善诊断表现
patterns.domain: 医学影像或临床评估研究

patterns.name: 遗传与疾病研究尚无定论
patterns.context: 综述焦虑及情感障碍的遗传研究进展，同时指出仍缺乏确定结论

en.concept: Negative hyphenated compounds in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to non- compounds joined by hyphens in academic text, including non-specific, non-significant, non-lethal, noncompetitive, and non-local; also responds to un-bound, β-terms, and one negative sentence with “but does not”.

patterns.name: Evaluative terms with the non- prefix
patterns.context: Forms negative or antonymic compounds in academic statements; commonly describes bias, statistical results, symptoms, inhibition types, or properties. This pattern also covers within-word suffixes marked as split tokens.

patterns.name: Words with the un- prefix
patterns.context: Describes the unbound state of an analyte, in contrast to bound.
patterns.domain: Analytical chemistry, background to detection-method patents

patterns.name: β- in biological terms
patterns.context: Occurs in biomedical descriptions relating to proteins, peptides, and receptor internalization.

patterns.name: Negative statement following a contrast
patterns.context: Describes a mutation that did not change hemoglobin structure; may be related to negative or negated expressions, but does not fit the main hyphenated-prefix pattern.

11_1835.concept: 科学文本中的否定性连字符复合词
11_1835.description: 主要对学术文本中连字符连接的 non- 复合词强烈响应，涉及非特异、非显著、非致命、非竞争及非局部等；另响应 un-bound、β-术语，以及一处 but does not 否定句。

patterns.name: non-前缀的评价性术语
patterns.context: 在学术陈述中构成否定或反义复合词；常用于描述偏差、统计结果、症状、抑制类型或性质。此模式也覆盖被拆分标记的词内后缀。

patterns.name: un-前缀词
patterns.context: 与 bound 对举，描述分析物未结合的状态。
patterns.domain: 分析化学、检测方法专利背景

patterns.name: 生物学术语中的β-
patterns.context: 出现在蛋白、肽及受体内化相关的生物医学叙述中。
patterns.domain: 分子与细胞生物学论文

patterns.name: 转折后的否定陈述
patterns.context: 描述某突变未改变血红蛋白结构；可能与负向或否定表达有关，但不符合主要的连字符前缀模式。

en.concept: Negation and absence in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of negation, absence, or limitation, especially not/no/nothing/unknown/unable and non-specific and other non- words. It also extends occasionally to un- within a word (unbroken), across scientific papers and technical texts.

patterns.name: not followed by a negative or limiting result
patterns.context: Negation or expressions of the unknown or inability are used to limit conclusions or indicate missing evidence or capability; this is the most prominent cross-passage pattern, especially not, no, nothing, and unknown.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, patent technical backgrounds, and mathematics papers

patterns.name: non-specific and hyphenated forms
patterns.context: non- combines with an adjective or noun to express non-specificity, non-significance, or insufficient selectivity; often appears in experimental methods, descriptions of detection bias, or results.

patterns.name: no / nothing indicating the unknown or lack of precedent
patterns.context: no or nothing introduces a lack of knowledge, structure, or prior results; similar to general negation, but focused on gaps in the literature.

patterns.name: Internal word fragment outside common negation patterns
patterns.context: un- occurs within a word describing an unbroken state, rather than in a typical negative-result sentence; activation falls on the word’s subword fragment.

11_1835.concept: 科学文本中的否定与缺失
11_1835.description: 主要响应否定、缺失或受限表达，尤其是 not/no/nothing/unknown/unable，以及 non-specific 等 non- 词。少量延伸到词内 un-（unbroken）；分布于科学论文及技术文本。

patterns.name: not 后接否定或限制结果
patterns.trigger: “does not alter”“did not provide”“no … is/are known”“nothing is known”“unknown”“unable to”
patterns.context: 否定词或表示未知、不能的表达用于限制结论、指出缺失证据或能力；是最显著的跨段模式，尤其突出 not、no、nothing、unknown 等
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、专利技术背景、数学论文

patterns.name: non-specific 及其连字符形式
patterns.context: non-与形容词或名词结合，表达非特异性、非显著性或选择性不足；常出现在实验方法、检测偏差或结果描述中
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与技术说明

patterns.name: no / nothing 表示未知或无先例
patterns.trigger: “nothing is known”“no … structures are available”“no previous results are known”
patterns.context: 以 no 或 nothing 引出知识、结构或既有结果的缺失；与一般否定相近，但侧重文献空白

patterns.name: 不符合常见否定模式的词内片段
patterns.context: un-嵌在表示未中断状态的词中，并非典型否定结论句；激活落在该词的子词片段上

en.concept: Expressions of research results and knowledge gaps
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of knowledge gaps in biomedical text, such as “no studies, consensus, or structural information yet,” and to “non-significant” in statistical descriptions. It also responds locally to contrasts in structural effects and non-specific binding in detection.

patterns.name: Expressions of knowledge gaps
patterns.context: Describes a field in which knowledge, research, consensus, or structural information is currently lacking; often includes “no” followed by a negative proposition.
patterns.domain: Introductions and research backgrounds of biomedical papers

patterns.name: Non-significant statistical results
patterns.context: Modifies effects, bias, or results (e.g., “non-significant 30% increase” and “non-significant bias”); the word form is split into “non”-“-”“significant”.
patterns.domain: Medical research results and technical descriptions of patent detection methods

patterns.name: Contrasting structural effects and no effect
patterns.context: Comparing mutation effects on protein or molecular structure and explicitly stating that a structural feature was unchanged.

patterns.name: HEP inhibition mechanism and missing structural information
patterns.context: First mentioning a known inhibitory effect, then noting that its molecular basis is unknown and that complex or protein structures are lacking.

patterns.name: Non-specific binding caused by detection steps
patterns.context: Describes binding, washing, and separation steps in a detection method, and the resulting non-specific binding or reduced sensitivity.

patterns.name: Biomarker or disease-risk associations
patterns.context: Discusses associations between exposure, drug use, or biological factors and disease or risk; the passage may also mention research gaps or statistical results.

patterns.name: Therapeutic research questions not yet addressed
patterns.context: Identifies a lack of research on a therapy or intervention in a particular population, stage, or related mechanism.
patterns.domain: Addiction treatment and rehabilitation research abstracts

patterns.name: Insufficient consensus on gene family function
patterns.context: After introducing known or hypothesized functions of family members, notes that their scope of action remains unsettled.

patterns.name: Negative control in an individual experimental result
patterns.context: A specific mutation has no effect on one structure, contrasting with its effect on another.

patterns.name: Other unclassified local triggers
patterns.context: Biomedical terms occur locally, but the highlighted fragment alone does not establish a stable shared mechanism with the patterns above.

11_1835.concept: 研究结果与知识缺口表述
11_1835.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中“尚无研究、共识或结构资料”的知识空缺表达，以及统计描述中的“non-significant”；另对结构影响对照、检测非特异结合等局部语境有反应。

patterns.name: 知识空缺表述
patterns.trigger: “to date”后接“nothing is known”“no study has fully described”“no consensus has been reached”或“no … is available”
patterns.context: 描述某研究领域目前尚无知识、研究、共识或结构资料；常出现“no”及其后续否定命题。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文引言、研究背景

patterns.name: 非显著性统计结果
patterns.context: 修饰效应、偏差或结果（如“non-significant 30% increase”“non-significant bias”）；词形分段出现“non”-“-”“significant”。
patterns.domain: 医学研究结果、专利检测技术说明

patterns.name: 结构影响及未影响的对照
patterns.context: 比较突变对蛋白或分子结构的影响，并明确指出某项结构特征未改变。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、血红蛋白结构研究

patterns.name: HEP抑制机制与结构缺失
patterns.trigger: “inhibit HDACs”“molecular basis … unknown”“no … complex structures are available”
patterns.context: 先提及已知抑制作用，继而指出其分子基础未知、缺少复合物或蛋白结构。
patterns.domain: 表观遗传、生物医学研究背景

patterns.name: 检测步骤导致非特异结合
patterns.trigger: “non-specific binding”及“separate the bound analyte from the unbound”
patterns.context: 描述检测方法的结合、洗涤和分离步骤，以及由此造成的非特异结合或灵敏度下降。

patterns.name: 生物标志物或疾病风险关联
patterns.trigger: “association between vitamin D and asthma”“risk of skin cancer”
patterns.context: 讨论暴露、药物使用或生物因子与疾病或风险之间的关联；段内也可能出现研究不足或统计结果。

patterns.name: 疗法研究问题尚未覆盖
patterns.context: 提出某疗法或干预在特定人群、阶段或相关机制方面尚缺研究。
patterns.domain: 成瘾治疗、康复研究摘要

patterns.name: 基因家族功能与共识不足
patterns.context: 介绍家族成员已知或推测的功能后，指出其作用范围仍未形成共识。

patterns.name: 个别实验结果的否定对照
patterns.context: 特定突变对某种结构不产生影响，与其对另一结构的影响形成对照。

patterns.name: 其余未能归入的局部触发
patterns.context: 局部出现生物医学术语，但无法仅凭高亮片段确认与上述模式有稳定共同机制。

en.concept: Negative word forms and specific subword fragments
en.description: The main pattern is sensitivity to negative prefixes and their hyphenated forms (especially non-) in academic or patent text, e.g., non-hermitian, non-significant, non-selective, non-invasive; also includes unbroken and unbound. There is also strong activation on not in “did not”, and sporadic word-form fragment activations in duplication, multiverses, and hemoglobin.

patterns.name: Hyphenated terms with the non- prefix
patterns.context: Activations concentrate when a negative or antonymic prefix combines with a following stem to form a term; token boundaries for the prefix, hyphen, and stem vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain academic papers and patent text

patterns.name: did not in a specific negative construction
patterns.context: In a sentence comparing biological structures, not follows did and negates an experimental result; activation at this location is much stronger than on surrounding words.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments in duplicated / duplication
patterns.context: An internal fragment of duplication activates when discussing replication of an engineered viral sequence and its packaging effect; this does not fully match the prominent non- prefix pattern.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in multiverse
patterns.context: Subword fragments of multiverse activate in a discussion of the multiverse concept; it is unclear whether these belong to the same pattern as other irregular word-form fragments.

patterns.name: Irregular spelling fragments in hemoglobin
patterns.context: An internal fragment of hemoglobin is marked in a discussion of hemoglobin molecular structure; nearby instances of other hemoglobin spellings do not show the same activation.

11_1835.concept: 否定词形与特定词片段
11_1835.description: 主要模式是在学术或专利文本中对否定性前缀及其连字符词形（尤其 non-）敏感，例见 non-hermitian、non-significant、non-selective、non-invasive，也包括 unbroken、unbound。另有 did not 中 not 的强激活，以及 duplication、multiverses、hemoglobin 的零散词形片段激活。

patterns.name: non- 前缀的连字符化术语
patterns.context: 激活集中在否定或反义前缀与后续词根组成术语时；不同例子中前缀、连字符和词根的 token 边界不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术论文与专利文本

patterns.name: 特定否定结构中的 did not
patterns.context: 生物结构比较句中，not 位于 did 后，否定某个实验结果；该处激活显著强于周围词。

patterns.name: duplicated / duplication 拼写片段
patterns.context: 谈及病毒工程序列的复制及其包装效果时，duplication 内部片段激活；与显眼的 non- 前缀模式不完全一致。

patterns.name: multiverse 词形片段
patterns.context: 讨论多重宇宙概念时，multiverse 的分词片段激活；尚不清楚是否与其他不规则词形片段属于同一模式。

patterns.name: hemoglobin 的不规则拼写片段
patterns.context: 讨论血红蛋白分子结构时，hemoglobin 的内部片段被标记；相邻的其他 hemoglobin 拼写并未显示同样激活。

en.description: Activations primarily correspond to academic English negation: one type is not after an auxiliary or modal verb; the other is negative derivatives formed with non-. Both occur in scientific research contexts.

patterns.name: not in negative constructions
patterns.context: In English sentences, not follows an auxiliary or modal verb and precedes the main predicate; not itself is marked as strongly activated in each example.
patterns.domain: Academic English, including biomedical abstracts and research texts

patterns.name: non- derivatives
patterns.context: non- combines with a following stem to form an adjective or adverb expressing negation or lack of a property; non and the hyphen are strongly activated in multiple examples.

11_1835.concept: 科学文本中的否定标记
11_1835.description: 激活主要对应学术英语否定表达：一类是助动词或情态动词后的 not，另一类是 non- 构成的否定派生词；两类均见于科学研究语境。

patterns.name: 否定结构中的 not
patterns.trigger: “does not alter”“did not reduce”“did not provide”“may not be”
patterns.context: 英语句子中 not 位于助动词或情态动词之后、主要谓语之前；各例中 not 本身标为强激活。
patterns.domain: 学术英语，包括生物医学摘要与研究文本

patterns.name: non- 派生词
patterns.context: non- 与后续词根构成表示否定或缺乏某属性的形容词、副词；多个实例中 non 和连字符激活很强。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、药理学及科学论文

en.description: Activations center on negative forms: syntactic not, no/none, and terms formed with non-, often used to indicate nonexistence, unmet conditions, non-specificity, or non-competitiveness; specific domains and meanings vary.

patterns.name: Negation/qualification in non-specific
patterns.context: “non-specific” consists of non- and specific and discusses non-specific binding and related issues; “non-specific bias” also occurs.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, detection methods, and drug/receptor research

patterns.name: Compounds meaning non-…
patterns.context: The non- prefix is joined to or tokenized separately from the following term, modifying Hamiltonian. It has the same non- structure as non-specific but a different meaning.

patterns.name: Emphasis on the negator not
patterns.context: not follows an auxiliary and negates the subsequent predicate; not is strongly activated in every passage.

patterns.name: none indicating absence/lack
patterns.context: none indicates that a category of studies or trials does not exist, qualifying the existing evidence or number of studies.

patterns.name: Negative judgment in no consensus
patterns.context: no negates consensus, expressing a lack of consensus in the field.

patterns.name: Threshold negation in not small enough
patterns.context: not and enough express insufficient degree, indicating that the concentration may not be low enough to meet the condition.

patterns.name: Negative result or inhibition
patterns.context: not-competitively (non-competitive) modifies inhibit; the term contains a negative prefix rather than syntactic not.

patterns.name: Shared cues among general negative elements
patterns.context: Various negative forms, including syntactic negation, quantifier negation, and non- compounds, occur in descriptions of absence, non-specificity, or unmet conditions.

11_1835.concept: 否定表达
11_1835.description: 激活集中于否定形式：句法 not、no/none，以及 non- 构成的术语，常用于说明不存在、未达到条件、非特异性或非竞争性；具体领域与语义各异。

patterns.name: non-specific 的否定/限定
patterns.context: “non-specific”由 non- 与 specific 组成，讨论非特异性结合及其问题；另有“non-specific bias”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、检测方法与药物/受体研究

patterns.name: 非……的复合术语
patterns.context: non- 前缀与后续术语连写或被分词拆开，修饰 Hamiltonian；与 non-specific 同样有 non- 结构，但语义不同。

patterns.name: 否定词 not 的强调
patterns.context: not 位于助动词之后，否定后续谓语；各段均有 not 强激活。

patterns.name: none 表示没有/缺乏
patterns.trigger: «none»9« in»3« a»6« randomized»3« trial；«none»9« of»3« these»5« studies»9
patterns.context: none 表示某类研究或试验不存在，处于对既有证据或研究数量的限定中。

patterns.name: no consensus 的否定判断
patterns.context: no 否定 consensus，表达领域内尚无共识。

patterns.name: not small enough 的阈值否定
patterns.context: not 与 enough 构成程度不足判断，说明浓度可能未低到足以满足条件。

patterns.name: 否定性结果或抑制
patterns.context: not-competitively（非竞争性）修饰 inhibit，术语内部含否定前缀；不是句法上的 not。

patterns.name: 一般否定成分的共同线索
patterns.context: 多种否定形式，包括句法否定、量词否定及 non- 复合词；共同出现于对缺失、非特异性或未达到条件的表述中。

en.concept: Expressions of negation and lack of properties
en.description: Activations are concentrated in expressions of negation or lack of properties in biomedical text, especially non-specific, non-significant, non-selective, unbound, and did/does not. Other local triggers include no consensus, easy, endonucl(e)ase, and drug/receptor abbreviations, which cannot be fully explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: non- in non-specific/negative terms
patterns.context: Describes a lack of specificity, statistical significance, or selectivity, or an unbound state; mostly in medical, life-science, and detection-technology texts.

patterns.name: Negative result expressions
patterns.context: Explicitly states in research results or comparisons that no effect, change, or function occurred or was provided; medical and life-science papers.

patterns.name: Uncertainty and lack of consensus
patterns.context: Reviews a research field after many years of study and notes that there is still no consensus.

patterns.name: The word easy and its quotation
