patterns.trigger: “win in SL”“played in that series”“get the puck out”“hard forechecking”“off-the-ball”“three point plays”“goalies”“last round”“podium”
patterns.context: 讨论球队或运动员的发挥、比赛策略、赛季表现或比赛结果；涉及橄榄球、冰球、篮球及其他竞赛。

patterns.name: 球队人员、教练与阵容变动
patterns.trigger: “Ballard”“AV”“Royal Rumble winner”“Taker”“losing Young and Downing”“quality prospects”“new man”
patterns.context: 讨论球员安排、教练或经理决策、转会及未来阵容；部分内容来自摔角讨论。

patterns.name: 社会政治与激进主义议题
patterns.trigger: “'radicals Islamists'”“extremist views”“extreme acts”“no taxation without representation”
patterns.context: 围绕社区中的极端主义、政治立场或代表权展开讨论。

patterns.name: 电视设备与同时录看节目
patterns.trigger: “record one channel while watching another”“Panasonic DVR”
patterns.context: 询问录像设备能否一边录制一个频道、一边观看另一个频道，并举电视节目为例。

en.description: The most stable cue is the paragraph line-break boundary, especially «↵»10; some examples have a number or new paragraph immediately after the line break. There is also symbol activation in mathematical operations with negative numbers, plus sporadic activation on hyphens, apostrophes, within-word splits, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Line-break markers after paragraph/section boundaries
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on line-break tokens after paragraphs or article excerpts, especially when a number or new paragraph follows immediately; numbers themselves also show weaker activation.
patterns.domain: Formatting boundaries in mixed corpora including news, commentary, web text, and math exercises

patterns.name: Line-break boundaries around quotation marks
patterns.context: A new paragraph or quotation introduced by quotation marks appears after a line break; activation is weaker than in examples with «↵»10.
patterns.domain: News reports, quotations, and narrative text

patterns.name: Negative signs and parentheses in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In consecutive integer-operation expressions, negative signs often occur next to numbers, addition or subtraction, and parentheses.

patterns.name: Hyphens within English words
patterns.context: Hyphens, slashes, and other delimiters inside numbers or words; these occur sporadically outside paragraph-boundary activation, and it is unclear whether they form an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Apostrophes and delimiters in word forms
patterns.context: Near English contractions, possessives, or apostrophes; activation is sporadic and shows no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Splits within capitalized words
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple tokens, an internal fragment briefly activates; there are few other similar examples.

patterns.name: Punctuation and local symbols in formulas
patterns.context: Local punctuation such as question marks and periods, or operators, activates at specific token positions; there is not enough evidence that these form a consistent pattern.

11_2346.description: 最稳定的线索是段落换行边界，尤其«↵»10；部分样例在换行后接数字或新段落。另有数学负数运算中的符号激活，以及零散的连字符、撇号、词内切分和标点激活。

patterns.name: 段落/章节边界后的换行标记
patterns.context: 激活集中在段落或文章片段结束后的换行 token，尤其是换行之后紧接数字或新段落内容时；数字本身也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论、网页文本及数学练习等混合语料中的格式边界

patterns.name: 引号前后的换行边界
patterns.context: 换行后出现引号引出的新段落或引语；强度低于出现«↵»10的例子。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、引语及叙事文本

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的负号与括号组合
patterns.context: 连续的整数运算表达式中，负号常与数字、加减运算和括号相邻。

patterns.name: 英语词内连字符
patterns.context: 数字或单词内部的连字符、斜线等分隔符；目前只在段落边界激活之外零散出现，是否为独立模式不确定。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育报道及评论文本

patterns.name: 撇号及词形中的分隔符
patterns.context: 英语缩写、所有格或撇号附近；仅有零星激活，未显示稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 大写字母内部的切分
patterns.context: 单词被切分成多个 token 时，词内片段短暂激活；缺乏其他类似实例。

patterns.name: 标点及公式局部符号
patterns.context: 问号、句点或运算符等局部标点在特定 token 位置激活，尚无足够证据表明它们构成一致模式。

en.description: The most consistent cue is a newline and short numbers after it as segmentation markers; other activations include mathematical operators, parentheses, sentence-ending or quotation punctuation, and a few in-word hyphens and uppercase subwords. Paragraph 8 has no clear corresponding cue.

patterns.name: Newlines and following numbers
patterns.context: Across multiple text segments, activations occur at newlines or on short number tokens after them; numbers often resemble line numbers or separators and may not belong to the body text.

patterns.name: Mathematical operators and parentheses
patterns.context: Operators and some numbers activate in expressions involving negative numbers, repeated subtraction, and nested parentheses.

patterns.name: Sentence-ending and quotation punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation may activate at the end of questions or sentences, or in direct quotations and possessives; not every occurrence of the same punctuation is activated.
patterns.domain: Prose such as Q&A, news, and commentary

patterns.name: In-word hyphens
patterns.context: Hyphens occasionally activate in compound words; the sample is small, and their similarity to the mathematical minus pattern may be superficial.

patterns.name: Isolated uppercase letter subwords
patterns.context: The initial subword occasionally activates when an uppercase word is split into subwords; two examples are insufficient to establish stable conditions.

11_2346.description: 最稳定的线索是换行及其后短数字等分段标记；另有数学运算符、括号、句末或引语标点，以及少数词内连字符和大写子词激活。第8段缺少明显对应线索。

patterns.name: 换行及其后的数字
patterns.context: 多段文本在换行处或换行后的短数字 token 上激活；数字常像行号或分隔标记，未必属于正文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域语料的文本分段格式

patterns.name: 数学运算符与括号
patterns.context: 负数、连续减法和嵌套括号计算式中，运算符及部分数字激活。

patterns.name: 句末及引号类标点
patterns.context: 标点出现在疑问句、句末或直接引语/所有格中时可激活；并非每处同类标点都激活。
patterns.domain: 问答、新闻及评论等散文

patterns.name: 词内连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合词时偶有激活，样本少，可能与数学减号模式仅表面相似。

patterns.name: 孤立的大写字母子词
patterns.context: 大写词被拆分成子词时，首部子词偶有激活；两例不足以确定稳定条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to negative signs, negative numbers, and parenthesized expressions in DM math problems, often alongside variable assignments, fractions, and calculation or number-theory instructions; there are also isolated math patterns involving factors, ordering, and calculus. It also responds to a web-comment excerpt describing search results and asking about the value of author identity.

patterns.name: Negative signs and numbers in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: A negative sign precedes an integer or parenthesized expression, often mixed with addition, subtraction, nested parentheses, or consecutive operations; activation is often adjacent to the negative sign or negative number.
patterns.domain: Arithmetic problems and solution text in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Math questions and judgment answers
patterns.context: Questions ask whether a given expression is prime or composite, followed by a True/False judgment; local context also includes number-theory terms such as prime and composite.
patterns.domain: Number-theory questions and answers in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Factor and common-factor problems
patterns.context: Asks for the common factors or greatest common factor of two numbers or values related to variables; the excerpt also contains arithmetic expressions.
patterns.domain: Factor and divisibility problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Fractions and denominator-related calculations
patterns.context: Fractions occur in expressions containing negative numbers, or the problem asks for a common denominator for two quantities.

patterns.name: Ordering problems
patterns.context: Fractions, variables, or decimals are given and must be arranged in descending order, followed by the ordered result.
patterns.domain: Numerical comparison and ordering in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Symbolic variables and algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Variables are assigned values or embedded in expressions involving multiplication, exponents, or fractions, followed by a calculation or judgment question.

patterns.name: Derivatives and calculus notation
patterns.context: Includes power functions, function notation, and instructions to take the third derivative with respect to a variable.

patterns.name: Discussion of web search results and sponsored links
patterns.context: Discusses how images in search results attract attention and affect the prominence of sponsored links.

patterns.name: Question and answer about the value of author identity
patterns.context: A general question asks whether author identity still has value, followed by a brief affirmative answer; it appears in the same passage as the preceding search-results discussion, but the topics do not fully align.

11_2346.description: 主要响应 DM 数学题中的负号、负数与括号算式，常伴变量赋值、分数及计算或数论判断指令；另有因数、排序、微积分等单例数学模式。还响应一段网页评论中的搜索结果描述与作者身份问答。

patterns.name: 算术题中的负号与负数
patterns.context: 负号出现在整数或括号表达式前，常与加减、括号嵌套、连续运算混合；激活位置常紧邻负号或负数。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的算术题与解题文本

patterns.name: 数学问句及其判断答案
patterns.trigger: “Is ... prime number”“Is ... a composite number”“?”以及“False”“True”
patterns.context: 围绕给定表达式询问素数或合数性质，随后出现 True/False 判断；局部也包含 prime、composite 等数论词。

patterns.name: 因数与公因数题
patterns.trigger: “common factor of 120 and s”“greatest common factor of g and 27”
patterns.context: 要求计算两个数或变量相关数值的公因数或最大公因数；片段同时含有算术表达式。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的因数与整除问题

patterns.name: 分数及分母相关计算
patterns.trigger: 分数线“/”，以及“Calculate the common denominator”
patterns.context: 分数出现在含负数的表达式中，或要求求两个量的公分母。

patterns.name: 排序题
patterns.context: 给出分数、变量或小数，要求按降序排列，并出现排列结果。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的数值比较与排序

patterns.name: 符号化变量与代数表达式
patterns.trigger: “Let t be”“Let z be”“Let r be”“Let p =”“q«*»2c”
patterns.context: 变量被赋值或嵌入乘法、幂、分数等表达式，之后继续提出计算或判断问题。

patterns.name: 导数与微积分符号
patterns.context: 出现幂函数、函数记号及对变量求三阶导数的指令。

patterns.name: 网页搜索结果与赞助链接讨论
patterns.trigger: “organic results”“sponsored links”“images ... stand out too much”
patterns.context: 讨论搜索结果中的图片如何吸引注意、影响赞助链接的显眼程度。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页或搜索体验评论

patterns.name: 关于作者身份价值的问答
patterns.trigger: “Is authorship still worth having?”“I would say yes.”
patterns.context: 以一般性问句询问作者身份是否仍有价值，随后给出简短肯定回答；与前面的搜索结果讨论同段出现，但主题不完全相同。

en.concept: Detection of local formatting and symbol fragments
en.description: Activation primarily falls on headings and dividers after line breaks, and on minus signs in math expressions; there are also sporadic apostrophe and within-word fragments such as groin, taped, and charms, as well as some web text that cannot be categorized.

patterns.name: Markdown headings and structural dividers
patterns.context: Near headings or section headings, especially when Markdown-like heading structures follow a line break; activation falls on delimiters, numbering, or the start of a heading.

patterns.name: Minus signs and negative expressions in math problems
patterns.context: In math exercises or calculation problems, minus signs indicate negative numbers, subtraction, or operations inside parentheses; the prompt may also ask whether a number is composite.

patterns.name: Possessives with apostrophes in text
patterns.context: Apostrophe possessives or contractions occur in English prose; the apostrophe itself, rather than the whole word, is marked.

patterns.name: Letter sequence within an English word
patterns.context: A letter fragment in the word “charms” is marked; the context discusses folk beliefs about shark teeth.

patterns.name: gro fragment within a word
patterns.context: The initial fragment of the word “groin pain” is marked in an account of an athlete’s injury.

patterns.name: t fragment within a word
patterns.context: A fragment within “taped,” describing a leg being wrapped in an injury account, is marked.

patterns.name: Local prose without clear lexical cues
patterns.context: The activation positions do not share a stable word or structure; they occur only in local web text and at paragraph boundaries.

11_2346.concept: 局部格式与符号片段检测
11_2346.description: 激活主要落在换行后的标题与分隔线、数学算式中的减号；另有撇号及 groin、taped、charms 等零散词内片段，部分网页正文无法归纳。

patterns.name: Markdown标题与结构分隔符
patterns.trigger: «↵» 后的标题、编号标题、连续 «=»/«-» 分隔线，如 “Results {#Sec2}”“Topological Features”“2.1. Basic Preprocessing: Noise Removal”
patterns.context: 标题或小节标题附近，尤其是换行后出现 Markdown/类 Markdown 标题结构；激活落在分隔符、编号或标题起始处。

patterns.name: 数学题目中的减号与负数表达
patterns.context: 数学练习或计算题中，减号用于负数、减法及括号内运算；题干也可能询问数是否为合数。

patterns.name: 文本中带撇号的所有格
patterns.context: 英语叙述中出现撇号所有格或缩写；被标记的是撇号本身，而非整个词。

patterns.name: 英语词内的字母组合
patterns.context: 单词 “charms” 中的字母片段被标记；上下文讲述鲨鱼牙齿的民间信仰。

patterns.name: 词内的 gro 片段
patterns.context: 运动员伤病叙述中，“groin pain”一词的词首片段被标记。

patterns.name: 词内的 t 片段
patterns.context: 运动伤病叙述中，腿部被包扎的 “taped” 一词内出现标记。

patterns.name: 无明显词法线索的局部正文
patterns.trigger: 未标记正文中的「Premier League」「Sandy Row」「sitting down」等邻近词；可见标记分别为« $»、«↵»、«↵»
patterns.context: 激活位置未呈现可稳定归纳的共同词或结构，只有局部网页正文及段落边界。

en.description: Activations mainly respond to punctuation and formatting in math exercises: minus signs before negative numbers, question marks at the ends of prompts, and periods at the ends of probability problems; they also occur in numerical columns of test tables and in number answers to fraction/least-common-multiple problems. Trigger locations and semantics are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation in probability problems
patterns.context: In problems involving drawing letters and giving probabilities, the period falls between the prompt and a subsequent answer or next question.

patterns.name: Minus signs in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Occurs in arithmetic expressions or sequence terms to indicate negative numbers; sometimes the minus sign and following number are marked separately.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic and sequence problems

patterns.name: Question marks at the end of prompts
patterns.context: Occurs at the ends of math problem prompts, such as after “What is next”, “What is the t'th term”, or “common denominator” questions.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, sequence, algebra, and number theory exercises

patterns.name: Numerical fields in medical tables
patterns.context: Reference ranges, NI markers, and values follow test names; activations fall near table content and values.

patterns.name: Numerical answers in fraction or common-multiple problems
patterns.context: Prompts and numerical answers alternate in problems about denominators, fractions, or least common multiples; the exact trigger form is not fully consistent with other paragraphs.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, fraction and number theory exercises

11_2346.description: 主要响应数学练习中的标点与格式：负数前的负号、题干末尾问号，以及概率题句末句号；也见于检验表格数值栏和分数/公倍数题的数字答案。触发位置和语义并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 概率题的句末标点
patterns.trigger: “Give prob of picking 3 g and 1 s”后的«.»；“Give prob of picking 1 m and 1 c”后的«.»
patterns.context: 在抽取字母、给出概率的题目中，句号位于题面与后续答案或下一题之间。

patterns.name: 计算题中的负号
patterns.context: 出现在算术表达式或数列项中，表示负数；有时负号与后续数字被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 问句末尾的问号
patterns.context: 出现在数学题题干末尾，如“What is next”“What is the t'th term”或“common denominator”问题之后。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，数列、代数与数论练习

patterns.name: 医学表格中的数值栏位
patterns.context: 检验项目名后跟参考范围、NI 标记及数值；激活落在表格内容与数值附近。

patterns.name: 分数或公倍数题中的数值答案
patterns.context: 在分母、分数或最小公倍数题目中，题面与数字答案交替出现；具体触发形式与其他段不完全一致。

en.concept: Boundaries and formatting in math problems
en.description: Activation primarily occurs in DM math problems, especially near answers to probability questions and at the prompt or answer boundaries of problems involving fractions, negative numbers, and algebraic operations; there is also one instance near an IgG value and formatting symbols in a medical table.

patterns.name: Answer markers after probability problems
patterns.context: After a probability prompt comes a period and line break, followed by a number or fraction and then «3»; these are mostly probabilities of drawing letters without replacement and obtaining a specified combination.
patterns.domain: Probability exercises and step-by-step solutions in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Fraction and calculation formatting in math problems
patterns.context: Between problems and answers involving fractions, negative numbers, or algebraic expressions, activation often appears at «↵»3; problem types include finding common denominators, calculation, comparison, and evaluating algebraic expressions.
patterns.domain: Arithmetic and algebra problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: IgG values in a table
patterns.context: Activation appears near reference ranges, measurements, and IgG labels in tabular or formatted data; this differs from the surrounding math problem types.

11_2346.description: 激活主要出现在 DM 数学题中，尤其是概率题答案附近，以及分数、负数和代数运算的题干或答案边界；另有一次医学表格中 IgG 数值与排版符号附近的激活。

patterns.name: 概率题后的答案标记
patterns.context: 概率题题干后出现句点、换行，接着是数字或分数，再接 «3»；多为无放回抽字母及指定组合的概率。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的概率练习及其分步解答

patterns.name: 数学题中的分数与计算格式
patterns.context: 分数、负数或代数表达式构成的题目与答案之间，常在 «↵»3 处出现激活；覆盖求公分母、计算、比较及代数求值等不同题型。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的算术与代数题

patterns.name: 表格中的 IgG 数值
patterns.context: 激活出现在表格或排版数据中的参考范围、测量值与 IgG 标签附近；与周围数学题型不同。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学文本/表格

en.description: Primarily responds to arithmetic involving negative signs and parentheses in math exercises, as well as letter-probability problems involving sampling without replacement; derivatives and divisibility/least-common-multiple problems also occur. A Gleason score in a medical table is an isolated example.

patterns.name: Negative signs and parentheses in arithmetic expressions
patterns.context: In arithmetic problems, negative numbers, subtraction, and nested parentheses occur in expressions to be evaluated; they often appear near Calculate or an answer.

patterns.name: Letter-probability problems involving sampling without replacement
patterns.context: A string containing repeated letters is given, and the probability of drawing a specified letter combination is asked; the activated span covers the prompt, answer, or a follow-up question.
patterns.domain: Combinatorial probability problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Polynomial differentiation and subsequent numerical judgment
patterns.context: First defines a polynomial’s derivative and its value at a point, then asks whether an expression meets a divisibility condition.

patterns.name: Fraction expressions in least-common-multiple problems
patterns.context: Asks for the least common multiple; the problem contains a complex expression involving negative numbers, division, and fractions.
patterns.domain: Number theory/arithmetic problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Pathology scores in a clinical study table
patterns.context: The table lists pathology Gleason score categories along with counts, percentages, and significance values.

11_2346.concept: 数学题中的符号化计算
11_2346.description: 主要响应数学练习中带负号和括号的算术，以及不放回抽样字母概率题；另见求导与整除、最小公倍数题。医学表格中的 Gleason 评分是孤立例子。

patterns.name: 算术表达式中的负号与括号
patterns.context: 算术题中，负数、减法和嵌套括号出现在待计算的表达式里；常邻近 Calculate 或答案。

patterns.name: 不放回抽样的字母概率题
patterns.trigger: 「Four letters picked without replacement from」以及「Give prob of picking」
patterns.context: 给出由重复字母组成的字符串，询问抽取指定字母组合的概率；激活片段覆盖题干、答案或后续问题。

patterns.name: 多项式求导及后续数值判断
patterns.trigger: 「first derivative of」及「Is b ... a multiple of 8?」
patterns.context: 先定义多项式的导数及其在某点的值，再询问一个算式是否满足整除条件。

patterns.name: 最小公倍数题中的分数表达式
patterns.trigger: 「Calculate the least common multiple of」及其后的嵌套分数
patterns.context: 要求计算最小公倍数，题目中含有由负数、除法和分数构成的复杂表达式。

patterns.name: 临床研究表格中的病理评分
patterns.context: 表格列出病理 Gleason 评分类别以及计数、百分比和显著性数值。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文表格

en.description: High-activation markers are distributed across operators, periods, line breaks, and numbers in math problems, and also occur in parenthesized percentages in tables and quotation marks or within-word fragments in ordinary text; no stable semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Single-character or word-initial fragments
patterns.context: Trigger markers are scattered across mathematical expressions and ordinary text; they often occur on punctuation, operators, within words, or in truncated fragments, with no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus including math problems, news text, and tables

patterns.name: Periods in math problems
patterns.context: Occurs in DM Mathematics problems, often after a definition or expression and before the question continues.

patterns.name: Line breaks and numbers in math problems
patterns.context: Line breaks and numbers occur in problem templates, answer markers, or between consecutively generated math problems; activation positions are not fixed.

patterns.name: Math operators and expression fragments
patterns.context: In algebraic expressions, fractions, derivatives, and factor/prime problems, symbols are usually adjacent to variables or numbers; there are also outlier triggers such as quotation marks and word fragments in ordinary text.

patterns.name: Parentheses and percentages in tables
patterns.context: Within table rows, percentages are enclosed in parentheses after values, and adjacent columns contain counts or ratios.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and within-word fragments in ordinary text
patterns.context: In news or restaurant-review prose, activation falls on quotation marks, parts of words, or within proper names; these fragments have no obvious shared semantics.

11_2346.description: 高激活标记分布在数学题的运算符、句点、换行和数字，也出现在表格括号百分数及普通文本的引号、词内片段；未显示稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 单字符或词首片段
patterns.context: 触发标记分散在数学表达式和普通文本中；常见于标点、运算符、词语内部或被截断的片段，未见一致的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 混合语料，含数学题、新闻文字和表格

patterns.name: 数学题中的句点
patterns.context: 出现在 DM Mathematics 题目中，常位于定义或表达式之后、问题继续之前。

patterns.name: 数学题中的换行与数字
patterns.context: 题目模板、答案标记或连续生成的数学题之间出现换行和数字；激活位置不固定。

patterns.name: 数学运算符及表达式片段
patterns.context: 代数式、分数、导数及因数/素数问题中，符号前后通常为变量或数字；也有普通文本中的引号、词片段等异类触发。

patterns.name: 表格中的括号与百分数
patterns.context: 表格行内，数值后括号包围百分数，且相邻列含计数或比例。

patterns.name: 普通文本中的引号及词内片段
patterns.context: 新闻或餐饮评论正文中，激活落在引号、词语局部或专名内部；这些片段之间无明显共同语义。

en.description: Activations mainly respond to operators, minus signs, and numeric formulas in math text; they also occur in number theory problems, true/false answers, sequences, and ones-digit questions. Additional activations appear on numeric percentages in paper tables and on shell, Python, and TensorFlow in technical tutorials.

patterns.name: Symbols and number strings in mathematical text
patterns.context: Numbers, operators, and variables form formulas or arithmetic expressions; activation markers often fall on operators or minus signs, followed by math problems or answers

patterns.name: Prime-number tests in math problems
patterns.context: Asks whether an expression or integer is prime or composite, often followed by True/False

patterns.name: True/false answers in math problems
patterns.context: A brief truth judgment follows a math question; the answer token itself is also activated in the snippets

patterns.name: Continuing sequences in math problems
patterns.context: Provides a number sequence and asks for the next number

patterns.name: Ones-digit questions in math problems
patterns.context: Asks for the ones digit of a power or expression

patterns.name: Statistical numbers in tables
patterns.context: Counts and percentages appear side by side in table rows, with newlines and column alignment

patterns.name: Command-line and tool names in software installation instructions
patterns.context: Describes downloading and extracting files, then running Python in a shell and trying TensorFlow

11_2346.concept: 结构化符号与数值文本
11_2346.description: 主要响应数学文本中的运算符、负号与数字公式；在数论题、真假答案、数列和个位数题中也出现。另对论文表格的数值百分比及技术教程中的 shell、Python、TensorFlow 有激活。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的符号与数字串
patterns.context: 数字、运算符和变量组成公式或算术表达式；激活标记常落在运算符或负号上，随后出现数学题目或答案

patterns.name: 数学题中的素数判断
patterns.trigger: “Is w prime?”, “Is o a prime”, “Is r prime”, “Is a(57) composite?”
patterns.context: 询问表达式或整数是否为素数/合数，常跟随 True/False

patterns.name: 数学题中的真假答案
patterns.context: 数学问题之后给出简短真假判断；在片段中答案 token 本身也有激活

patterns.name: 数学题中的数列续写
patterns.context: 给出数字序列并询问下一个数

patterns.name: 数学题中的个位数问题
patterns.context: 询问某个幂或表达式的个位数

patterns.name: 表格中的统计数字
patterns.context: 表格行中并列出现计数和百分比，伴随换行与列对齐

patterns.name: 软件安装说明中的命令行/工具名称
patterns.context: 描述下载、解压文件后在 shell 中运行 Python 并尝试 TensorFlow

en.description: Primarily activates in math problems that introduce variables and use equations to determine integer properties, especially judgments involving primes, composites, prime factors, and divisibility; also covers finding the tens digit. Two other examples involve percentage data in a table and a discussion of English tense, and cannot be clearly unified with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Letter variables in math problems
patterns.context: DM Mathematics problems give equations involving variables, integers, and operations, then ask about properties or digits of the number determined by the variable.

patterns.name: Prime and composite judgments
patterns.context: Asks whether the integer obtained from a variable expression is prime or composite, or asks for its prime factors.

patterns.name: Divisibility or multiple judgments
patterns.context: Determines divisibility or multiple conditions from a given expression or relationship between variables.

patterns.name: Finding the tens digit
patterns.context: An equation is used to find an integer related to a variable, and the problem asks for its tens digit.

patterns.name: Percentages and counts in tables
patterns.context: A table row presents a category, count, and percentage side by side; there is no obvious variable-solving structure like that in math problems.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central paper or data table

patterns.name: Discussion of English tense usage
patterns.context: Discusses the tense meaning of an English phrase and gives examples to explain the order of expression.

11_2346.concept: 数学变量求值与数性质题
11_2346.description: 主要激活于数学题中引入变量并依据方程求整数性质的语境，尤其是质数、合数、质因数及整除判断，也涵盖求十位数字。另有表格百分比数据和英语时态讨论两例，无法与主模式明确统一。

patterns.name: 数学题中的字母变量
patterns.trigger: “Let l =”, “Let z =”, “Let m =”, “Let i =”, “Let y =”等引入变量的表达；变量常出现在方程或算式中
patterns.context: DM Mathematics题目中，给出由变量、整数和运算构成的方程，再询问由变量确定的数的性质或数字

patterns.name: 质数与合数判断
patterns.trigger: “Is ... prime”, “Is ... a prime number”, “Is ... composite number”, “List the prime factors”
patterns.context: 要求判断变量表达式所得整数是否为质数或合数，或列出其质因数

patterns.name: 整除或倍数判断
patterns.context: 根据给定的算式或变量关系判断整除、倍数条件

patterns.name: 求十位数字
patterns.context: 通过方程求出变量相关整数，并询问其十位数字

patterns.name: 表格中的百分比与计数
patterns.context: 表格行中并列呈现类别、计数与百分比；没有明显数学题式的变量求解

patterns.name: 英语时态用法讨论
patterns.context: 讨论短语的英语时态含义，并举例解释表达顺序

en.concept: Segmentation and formatting cues in news text
en.description: Overall, activation favors segmentation formatting in web news text: line breaks after headlines or body text, and reporting that continues after a line break, are common. There are also sporadic activations on punctuation, numbers, and within-word fragments that do not form a stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Line-break separators after news headlines or body text
patterns.context: A line break follows a headline, lead, or body-text excerpt; activation often falls on the line break or on immediately following punctuation or words. The formatting resembles a web-news excerpt.

patterns.name: Near numbers or punctuation in news text
patterns.context: Sporadic activation occurs around headline numbering, dates/ratios, or body-text punctuation; sometimes the marked position is punctuation or a number.
patterns.domain: News headlines and report body text

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on specific words
patterns.context: Activation covers word-initial or within-word fragments; word meaning and syntactic function are inconsistent, with no stable shared lexical category.

patterns.name: Start of body text after a line break in news corpora
patterns.context: Multiple excerpts activate near a line break, as the body text continues or a new paragraph begins; the exact position varies by excerpt.
patterns.domain: News reports, financial reporting, and interviews

11_2346.concept: 新闻文本分段与格式线索
11_2346.description: 总体偏向网页新闻文本的分段格式：标题或正文后换行、换行后续接报道时常见激活。另有标点、数字及词内片段的零散激活，无法归为稳定语义类别。

patterns.name: 新闻标题或正文后的换行分隔
patterns.trigger: «↵»，常与其后的«↵»及正文开头相邻
patterns.context: 标题、导语或正文片段后出现换行，激活常落在换行或紧随的标点、词语上；格式像网页新闻摘录

patterns.name: 新闻正文中数字或标点附近
patterns.context: 标题编号、日期/比率或正文标点周围出现零散激活；有时标记落在标点或数字上

patterns.name: 特定词语的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活覆盖词首或词内片段，词义与句法功能不统一，未见稳定的共同词汇类别

patterns.name: 新闻语料中换行后正文起始处
patterns.context: 多段在换行后、正文续写或下一段起始附近激活；具体落点因片段而异
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、财经报道及访谈

en.description: Activation primarily falls on line-break separators in web articles, and also covers sentence-final punctuation, quotation marks, hyphens, currency symbols, and a few word-initial subword fragments or capitalized word beginnings; overall, it favors formatting and tokenization boundaries in news text.

patterns.name: Line breaks and paragraph separators
patterns.context: Line-break separators appear between news headlines, body text, or paragraphs; multiple excerpts mark the line-break token.

patterns.name: Symbols in number and currency formatting
patterns.context: Dollar signs before monetary amounts; the symbols are adjacent to numbers.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragments and hyphens
patterns.context: A word-initial subword fragment or a hyphen within a compound is split off; the hyphen in go-ahead also occurs.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Periods at the end of complete sentences.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and quotation markers
patterns.context: Quotation marks or apostrophes around direct quotations or quoted material.

patterns.name: Capitalized word beginnings in headlines
patterns.context: Words beginning with a capital letter in headlines or body text are split into word-initial tokens.

11_2346.description: 激活主要落在网页文章的换行分隔处，也覆盖句末标点、引号、连字符、金额符号及少数词首子词或大写词首；整体偏向新闻文本中的格式与分词边界。

patterns.name: 换行与段落分隔
patterns.context: 新闻标题、正文或段落之间出现换行分隔；多段都标出换行 token

patterns.name: 数字与货币格式中的符号
patterns.context: 金额数字前的美元符号；符号与数字相邻

patterns.name: 词首片段与连字符
patterns.context: 词首子词片段或复合词内部连字符被单独切分；另有 go-ahead 中的连字符

patterns.name: 句末标点
patterns.context: 完整句子结束处的句点

patterns.name: 引号与引述标记
patterns.context: 直接引语或引述内容周围的引号、撇号

patterns.name: 标题中的大写词首
patterns.context: 标题或正文中以大写字母开头的词被切成词首 token

en.description: All samples strongly mark newlines; other activations are scattered across punctuation, hyphens, word-initial fragments, and amounts, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Newline characters
patterns.context: Occurs at sentence endings in news snippets or between headline and body fragments; present in all samples and is the strongest marker

patterns.name: Sentence-ending punctuation
patterns.context: Periods or commas occur next to newlines, quotations, or clause boundaries; there is no fixed collocation

patterns.name: Hyphenated structures
patterns.context: Hyphens connect words or numbers, with inconsistent local forms and meanings

patterns.name: Specific word-initial fragments
patterns.context: Appear at the beginnings of “U.N.”, “Anmer”, “Dentsu”, and “Uncertainty”; no shared semantic condition is apparent

patterns.name: Currency symbol and amount
patterns.context: A dollar sign before an amount, followed by “15m”

patterns.name: Number fragments
patterns.context: The number in “$15m”

patterns.name: Atypical in-word markers
patterns.context: Occur within proper nouns or at quotation boundaries, with no confirmed shared condition

11_2346.concept: 新闻文本中的换行边界
11_2346.description: 所有样本都强烈标记换行；其他激活分散于标点、连字符、词首片段及金额等，未显示稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 出现在新闻片段句末或标题/正文片段之间；在所有样本中均出现，且是最强标记

patterns.name: 句末标点
patterns.context: 句点或逗号紧邻换行、引语或从句边界；并非固定搭配

patterns.name: 连字符结构
patterns.context: 连字符连接词语或数字，局部词形和语义不统一

patterns.name: 特定词首片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在“U.N.”、“Anmer”、“Dentsu”、“Uncertainty”词首，未见共同语义条件

patterns.name: 货币符号与金额
patterns.context: 金额前的美元符号，后接“15m”

patterns.name: 数字片段
patterns.context: 金额“$15m”中的数字

patterns.name: 非典型词内标记
patterns.context: 出现在专名或引号边界，缺少可确认的共同条件

en.concept: News web boundaries and formatting cues
en.description: Activation is distributed across news excerpts from multiple domains and commonly occurs at sentence endings, line breaks, and web-module boundaries; there is also activation on proper-name fragments, numbers, and punctuation. Topics vary, and semantic triggers are unclear.

patterns.name: Separators after the end of news body text
patterns.context: After a news-narrative sentence ends, a line break and high-activation marker lead into subsequent content; the trigger words themselves show no stable semantics.

patterns.name: News webpage modules and headlines
patterns.context: Web navigation, video descriptions, or short headlines appear near body text, often at paragraph or article boundaries.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in proper names or abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation falls on partial tokens in proper names, organization abbreviations, or words, possibly related to word-initial or medial tokenization.
patterns.domain: People, place, and organization names in news

patterns.name: Delimiters in numbers and compound words
patterns.context: Local positions such as monetary amounts, hyphenated compounds, and sentence-final punctuation; contexts vary across examples, with no unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Punctuation and number formatting in news text

patterns.name: News events with varied topics
patterns.context: Topics include politics, culture, diplomacy, local planning, cosmetic medicine, sports, and archaeology; there is no clear shared topical trigger condition.

11_2346.concept: 新闻网页边界与格式线索
11_2346.description: 激活分布于多领域新闻摘录，常见于句末、换行及网页模块边界；另有专名片段、数字和标点激活。主题内容多样，语义触发规律不明确。

patterns.name: 新闻正文结束后的分隔符
patterns.trigger: 句号后紧接换行，再出现 «↵»10；常伴随新闻标题、图片说明或下一段正文
patterns.context: 新闻叙述句结束后，文本以换行和高激活标记转入后续内容；未见触发词本身具有稳定语义
patterns.domain: 新闻报道及网页新闻摘录

patterns.name: 新闻网页模块与标题
patterns.trigger: «Read More»、«Video: Hubble's eXtreme Deep Field»、«Most magnetic star»、«Accolades for the 19»
patterns.context: 正文附近出现网页导航、视频说明或短标题，常处于段落或文章边界

patterns.name: 专名或缩写的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、机构缩写或单词的部分 token 上，可能与词首、词中分词有关
patterns.domain: 新闻中的人名、地名、机构名

patterns.name: 数字与复合词中的分隔符
patterns.context: 金额、连字符复合词、句末标点等局部位置；不同实例上下文不一致，未见统一语义条件
patterns.domain: 新闻文本的标点与数字格式

patterns.name: 主题各异的新闻事件内容
patterns.context: 分别涉及政治、文化、外交、地方规划、医疗美容、体育和考古；没有共享的明确主题触发条件

en.concept: News text boundaries and word beginnings
en.description: Activations often fall on word beginnings or affixes, proper-noun fragments, and layout symbols such as periods, hyphens, and newlines in news headlines or reports; trigger locations vary across segments, making a single semantic theme difficult to establish.

patterns.name: Incomplete word forms at headline beginnings
patterns.context: Activations cluster on word beginnings or affixes at the start of news headlines or body text; some markers cover only the beginning of a word, with the unmarked remainder completing it. Also includes markers beginning with headline-like phrases.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial proper nouns or place-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs on capitalized place names or fragments of personal names in news body text, or on hyphens in compound adjectives; trigger location is influenced by proper nouns or word formation.

patterns.name: News layout markers
patterns.context: Activations also occur on punctuation or layout symbols such as newlines, periods, and hyphens; these symbols appear near headlines, body text, or paragraph boundaries.

patterns.name: Isolated initial-letter fragments
patterns.context: Partial characters activate within or adjacent to proper nouns rather than consistently meaningful whole words; this may relate to uppercase abbreviations or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Word beginnings and compounds in headlines
patterns.context: In common compound forms in news headlines, such as “go-ahead”, the hyphen is marked separately and the remaining parts of the word also activate.

11_2346.description: 激活多落在新闻标题或报道中的词首/词缀、专名片段，以及句点、连字符和换行等版式符号；各段触发位置不一致，难以确认单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 标题开头的不完整词形
patterns.context: 激活集中在新闻标题或正文开头的词首/词缀，部分标记只覆盖单词开头，后续未标记部分补全该词；也包括以标题式短语起始的标记。

patterns.name: 句首专名或地名片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻正文中的大写地名、人名片段，或复合形容词中的连字符；触发位置受专名或词形构造影响。

patterns.name: 新闻版式标记
patterns.context: 激活还出现在换行、句点、连字符等标点或版式符号上；这些符号位于标题、正文或段落边界附近。
patterns.domain: 网页新闻及其抓取文本

patterns.name: 孤立首字母片段
patterns.context: 在专名内部或紧邻专名处激活部分字符，而非稳定完整词义；可与大写缩写或分词边界有关。

patterns.name: 标题中的词首与复合词
patterns.context: “go-ahead”等新闻标题常见复合形式中，连字符被单独标记，词的其余部分也有激活。

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and format strings
en.description: Activations are distributed across different domains and contexts: personal names, medical and chemical terms, German word forms, database and code text. Recurring salient cues include split subword fragments and specific strings such as formats and Co-occurrence, which cannot be explained by a single semantic rule.

patterns.name: Josephine Witt in a personal name
patterns.context: A personal name is split into multiple subword fragments, followed by a newline and a repeated name

patterns.name: Drug-form term in a clinical study title
patterns.context: In a clinical study title on misoprostol for labor induction, strong activation is concentrated on insert

patterns.name: Word-ending fragment in a German compound
patterns.context: In a German sentence, activation falls on an internal fragment of a word meaning “standard”
patterns.domain: German text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: Format in structural database text
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of a macromolecular structure database and reading information from text files

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a chondrosarcoma name
patterns.context: A disease name in a medical title is split into multiple subwords; activation is concentrated on an internal fragment

patterns.name: occurrence in a comorbidity title
patterns.context: The word for co-occurrence is marked as split; appears in titles about mutations and disease comorbidity

patterns.name: acids in a microRNA term
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on acids in a micro-ribonucleic acid phrase

patterns.name: Format in code documentation
patterns.context: Appears when describing the format of a Lambda API response

patterns.name: metal-free and token fragments in a chemistry title
patterns.context: In a paper title on radical cyclization, chemical terms are split into subwords; activation is distributed across metal-free and fragments of the reaction name

11_2670.concept: 特定词片段与格式字符串
11_2670.description: 激活分散于不同领域和语境：人名、医学及化学术语、德语词形、数据库与代码文本；反复出现的显著线索是被拆分的词片段及 formats、Co-occurrence 等特定字符串，无法由单一语义规则解释。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Josephine Witt
patterns.context: 人名被拆分为多个子词片段，后接换行和重复姓名

patterns.name: 临床研究标题中的药物剂型词
patterns.context: 米索前列醇用于引产的临床研究标题中，强激活集中于 insert

patterns.name: 德语复合词中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 德语句子中，激活落在规范一词的内部片段上

patterns.name: 结构数据库文本中的格式一词
patterns.context: 介绍宏分子结构数据库及从文本文件读取信息时出现
patterns.domain: 生物信息学数据库说明

patterns.name: 软骨肉瘤名称中的内部片段
patterns.context: 医学标题中的疾病名称被拆成多个子词，激活集中于内部片段

patterns.name: 共病标题中的 occurrence
patterns.context: 共现一词被拆分标记；分别出现在突变和疾病共病标题中

patterns.name: 微RNA术语中的 acids
patterns.context: 微核糖核酸术语的词组中，激活集中于 acids

patterns.name: 代码说明中的格式一词
patterns.context: 描述 Lambda API 响应的格式时出现

patterns.name: 化学标题中的 metal-free 及分词片段
patterns.context: 自由基环化的论文标题中，化学术语被拆分为子词，激活分布于 metal-free 和反应名称片段

en.description: Activations often occur on subword fragments within words, especially compound words, proper names, and medical or chemical terms; sporadic triggers also include Witt, formats, and complex logic. The material spans languages and domains, with no consistent semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments and concatenation boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur within segmented words, especially subword fragments of technical terms, compound words, or proper names; examples include both English and German. Some fragments happen to be parts of complete words rather than stable semantic features.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; scientific and medical literature, German parliamentary texts, encyclopedic and technical material

patterns.name: Witt in a proper name
patterns.context: Occurs in the name Josephine Witt and activates again in repeated instances of the name; this appears more consistent with local recognition of a fragment in the proper name.

patterns.name: Medical terminology and research contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in medical abstract titles or topic descriptions, covering labor induction, chondrosarcoma, mutation co-occurrence, and psoriatic arthritis; triggers fall within different related terms, with no single shared medical concept evident.

patterns.name: Data formats and text processing
patterns.context: Discusses formatting data from text formats or Lambda response formats; the format-related word in segment 4 co-occurs with within-word fragments in other segments, but it is unclear whether they share a mechanism.

patterns.name: Fragments within German compound words
patterns.context: Activations are concentrated within the German word Vorschriften (regulations, provisions); the surrounding text is German parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Fragments within chemical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in chemical titles describing radical cyclization and benzofuran synthesis, with multiple activated fragments inside technical terms.

patterns.name: formats in code and function documentation
patterns.context: Mentions formatting Lambda responses; activations also occur in ordinary explanatory text, so this fragment alone does not establish a connection to code.

patterns.name: complex logic in a database description
patterns.context: Describes software that does not need to contain the complex logic required to retrieve information; these words occur in a technical description, and their relationship to other activated fragments is unclear.

11_2670.description: 激活常落在单词内部的子词片段，尤其是复合词、专名和医学或化学术语；另见 Witt、formats、complex logic 等零散触发。材料跨语种与领域，未显示统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 单词内部碎片与拼接边界
patterns.trigger: 分词边界处的子词片段，如 «Witt»、«mis»«op»«rost»、«vorsch»«rif»«ten»、«ch»«ond»«ros»«arcoma»、«rib»«onucle»«ic»，以及 «Co»-«occur»«rence»、«Met»«al»-«free»
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词内部，尤其是专业术语、复合词或专名的子词片段；既包括英语也包括德语，部分片段恰好是完整词的一部分而非稳定的词义特征
patterns.domain: 跨领域；科学医学文献、德语议会文本、百科及技术材料

patterns.name: 专名中的 Witt
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Josephine Witt 中，并在重复出现的人名中再次激活；更像是对该专名片段的局部识别

patterns.name: 医疗术语及研究语境
patterns.context: 出现在医学摘要标题或主题表述中，涵盖引产、软骨肉瘤、突变共现和银屑病关节炎；触发分布在相关术语的不同词内，未见单一共同医学概念

patterns.name: 数据格式及文本处理
patterns.context: 讨论从文本格式或 Lambda 响应格式化数据；段 4 的格式相关词与其余段中词内片段并存，不能确定是否由同一机制触发
patterns.domain: 生物信息学说明及软件文档

patterns.name: 德语复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在德语词 Vorschriften（规章、规定）内部；周围为德语议会文本

patterns.name: 化学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述自由基环化及苯并呋喃合成的化学标题中，多个激活片段位于专业词内部

patterns.name: 代码及函数文档中的 formats
patterns.context: 提及将 Lambda 的响应格式化；激活还出现在普通说明文字中，无法仅凭此片段断定代码相关性

patterns.name: 数据库说明中的 complex logic
patterns.context: 描述软件无需包含检索信息所需的复杂逻辑；这些词位于一段技术说明中，和其他激活片段的关系不明确
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物信息学说明

en.description: The most consistent trigger is formats/format, spanning different senses involving data, files, display, parsing, and organizational forms; there are also isolated instances involving a name, a microRNA term, and insert in a clinical title, with no clear shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: formats and related word forms
patterns.context: The target word is formats/format, appearing in statements about data, documents, display, parsing, images, or categories of form; the specific meaning varies with context.
patterns.domain: Software/API, structural biology, cell sorting, display technology, image processing, and histology

patterns.name: Witt as a name
patterns.context: A name at the beginning of a Wikipedia biography, followed by the full name again after a line break.

patterns.name: microRNA terminology
patterns.context: Introduces micro-ribonucleic acids in a patent background and gives microRNA as the abbreviation.

patterns.name: formats for tissue morphology
patterns.context: Describes several forms of muscle fibers, followed by polygonal and rounded; here, formats refers to types of morphology, not data or file formats.

patterns.name: Vaginal drug insert
patterns.context: misoprostol vaginal insert occurs in the title of a comparative study of standards for labor induction and modified standards.

11_2670.description: 最稳定的触发是 formats/format，涵盖数据、文件、显示、解析及组织形态等不同含义；另有单例姓名、microRNA 术语和临床标题中的 insert，未见明显共同触发条件。

patterns.name: formats 及相关词形
patterns.context: 目标词本身是 formats/format，出现在描述数据、文档、显示、解析、图像或形态类别的语句中；词前后文的具体含义不同。
patterns.domain: 软件/API、结构生物学、细胞分选、显示技术、图像处理及组织学

patterns.name: Witt 姓名
patterns.context: 维基百科人物条目开头的人名，紧接换行后再次出现全名。

patterns.name: microRNA 术语
patterns.context: 专利背景中引入 micro-ribonucleic acids，并给出 microRNA 的简称。

patterns.name: 组织形态的 formats
patterns.context: 描述肌纤维的多种形态，后接 polygonal 和 rounded；这里是形态种类，不是数据或文件格式。

patterns.name: 药物阴道插入剂
patterns.context: misoprostol vaginal insert 出现在引产标准与调整标准的比较研究标题中。

en.description: Activations span several heterogeneous local patterns: the word formats, subwords of medical terms, repeated personal names, short code or citation fragments near newlines, and Res in code documentation. No stable semantic or syntactic condition explains all examples.

patterns.name: String formats/format-related words
patterns.context: formats appears in descriptions of display data, image conversion, or mixed-language parsing; the main pattern is formats and its local syntactic context in technical text.

patterns.name: Split fragments of medical words
patterns.context: Medical terms are split across subwords; activation falls on word-initial fragments or fragments that form terms.

patterns.name: Subwords and repeated text in entity names
patterns.context: A personal name is repeated at the start of a sentence, followed by birth information in parentheses.

patterns.name: Short code or numbered fragments separated by newlines
patterns.context: Short strings or citation numbers occur near newlines; activation is distributed across letter, number, and punctuation fragments, with no single consistent format.

patterns.name: Response identifier in code
patterns.context: The code-like identifier Res in API documentation appears in a sentence describing Lambda return values.

11_2670.description: 激活分布在若干异质局部模式：formats 一词、医学术语子词、人名重复、换行附近的短代码或引文片段，以及代码说明中的 Res。未见能统一解释所有段的稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 字符串 formats/格式相关词
patterns.context: formats 出现在对 display data、图像转换或混合语言解析的描述中；主要是技术文本中的 formats 及其局部句法上下文。
patterns.domain: 专利、软件文档、网页文案

patterns.name: 医学词语的分词片段
patterns.context: 医学术语跨子词切分；激活落在词首片段或构成术语的片段上。

patterns.name: 实体名称中的子词与重复文本
patterns.context: 人名在句首被重复列出，后接括号中的出生信息。

patterns.name: 换行分隔的短代码或编号片段
patterns.context: 短字符串或引文编号周围有换行，激活分布于字母、数字及标点片段；具体格式并不相同。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目、法律判例引文

patterns.name: 代码中的 Response 标识符
patterns.context: API 说明中的代码式标识符 Res 出现在描述 Lambda 返回结果的句子里。

en.description: The most consistent shared trigger is the line break, especially consecutive line breaks and nearby page, entry, or abstract boundaries; there are also localized responses to webpage sections, repeated word strings, email quotations, and research abstract formatting.

patterns.name: Line breaks
patterns.context: Occurs around short titles, page elements, email quotations, or abstract markers; the line-break token is a prominent shared trigger across segments and often appears consecutively.
patterns.domain: Web text, email, encyclopedias, and research corpora

patterns.name: Repeated titles or section names
patterns.context: On navigation menus or blog pages, a section name is followed by a line break and then another title or body text; activations also occur on nearby repeated line breaks.

patterns.name: Repeated entries or word strings
patterns.context: In encyclopedic text, a word string or phrase is repeated around a line break; the repeated item may be followed by a parenthetical date or explanatory text.

patterns.name: Email quotations and informal body text
patterns.context: An informal email sentence follows a quotation marker and a line break.

patterns.name: Abstract template opening
patterns.context: A fixed marker at the beginning of a research abstract is followed by different abstract text; the body content varies considerably across segments.

patterns.name: Commentary following a title
patterns.context: A short title or topic word is repeated, followed by explanatory text about the topic.

11_2670.description: 最稳定的共同触发是换行，尤其是连续换行及其周围的页面、条目或摘要边界；另对网页栏目、重复词串、邮件引用和论文摘要格式有局部响应。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 在短标题、页面元素、邮件引用或摘要标记周围出现；换行 token 是各段共同的显著触发项，常连续出现。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、百科及论文语料

patterns.name: 重复标题或栏目名
patterns.context: 页面导航或博客页面中，栏目名后接换行，随后出现其他标题或正文；激活也落在邻近的重复换行上。

patterns.name: 重复条目或词串
patterns.context: 百科文本中词串或短语在换行前后重复；重复项后可跟括号时间或解释性正文。

patterns.name: 邮件引用与口语正文
patterns.context: 引用标记和换行之后接非正式邮件语句。

patterns.name: 摘要模板开头
patterns.context: 论文摘要开头的固定标记后接不同摘要正文；各段正文内容差异较大。

patterns.name: 标题后接评论文字
patterns.context: 短标题或主题词重复后，跟着对该主题的说明性文字。

en.description: The most stable cue is literal double asterisks and asterisk delimiters, spanning legal footnotes, medical tables, mathematical expressions, and code. A Ninth Circuit nonprecedential-opinion disclaimer template also occurs near asterisks in this corpus, but does not explain the nonlegal examples.

patterns.name: Double-asterisk footnote marker at the end of a legal opinion
patterns.context: Double asterisks appear in many kinds of structured text: in legal opinion headings or footnotes, beside tables or separator lines, at the end of mathematical expressions, and in C/C++ comments or pointer declarations. Surrounding layout, semantics, and domains vary widely; the trigger appears to be the literal double asterisk rather than specific semantics.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, medical tables, mathematical text, forum tables, and code

patterns.name: Ninth Circuit nonprecedential disclaimer in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in a footnote-style disclaimer in a U.S. Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals opinion, near “**” markers and a statement about the panel’s unanimous conclusion.

patterns.name: Double-asterisk footnote/panel formatting in legal decisions
patterns.context: In the layout of a decision’s first or final page, double asterisks serve as footnote markers; their meaning depends on position and legal document formatting.

patterns.name: Medical table headings and separator lines
patterns.context: In tables or formatted paper content, double asterisks surround column headings, while horizontal lines separate table areas.

patterns.name: Decorative separators or borders
patterns.context: Asterisks are repeated as table borders, visual separator lines, or decoration for note blocks; vertical bars, slashes, newlines, and whitespace often appear nearby.

patterns.name: Double asterisks in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Double asterisks occur immediately after variables and numbers in mathematical expressions, possibly as operators or formatting markers; there is only one example, so the exact function is unclear.

patterns.name: C/C++ double-asterisk pointers
patterns.context: Double asterisks occur between a type name and a variable name as part of a pointer declaration; ordinary code structures also occur, but without the same clearly identifiable double-asterisk trigger.

11_2670.description: 最稳定线索是字面双星号及星号分隔符，横跨法律脚注、医学表格、数学式和代码；另有第九巡回判决的非先例声明模板，与星号在该语料中常相邻，但不足以解释非法律例子。

patterns.name: 法律意见末尾的双星脚注标记
patterns.trigger: “**”被标为强激活（[1]中 ** 为10，[3]–[5]、[7]中 ** 为10；[6]中表格标题附近 ** 为9；[8]中横线后的 ** 为10；[9]中注释分隔线附近 ** 为9；[2]中数学式末尾 ** 为10；[10]中 char 指针声明里的 ** 为9）
patterns.context: 双星号出现在各类结构化文本中：法律意见标题/脚注处、表格或分隔线旁、数学表达式末尾、C/C++ 注释或指针声明中。周围排版、语义和领域差异很大；似乎主要由字面双星号触发，而非特定语义。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、医学表格、数学文本、论坛表格及代码

patterns.name: 法律文书的 Ninth Circuit 非先例声明
patterns.trigger: “This disposition is not appropriate for publication and is not precedent”及“9th Cir. R. 36-3.”
patterns.context: 出现在美国第九巡回上诉法院意见的脚注式声明中，邻近“**”标记及对合议庭一致结论的说明。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的双星脚注/合议庭格式
patterns.trigger: “**”后接“ The panel unanimously concludes this case”，或“Submitted June 25, 2014 **”
patterns.context: 判决首页或结尾的排版结构中，双星号用作脚注标记；其意义受位置与法律文书格式约束。

patterns.name: 医学表格标题与分隔线
patterns.trigger: “**Number of cases**”“**Nail plate dermoscopy**”“**Pathology**”及长串横线
patterns.context: 表格或版式化论文内容中，双星号包围栏目标题，横线用于分隔表格区域。

patterns.name: 装饰性分隔符或边框
patterns.context: 星号被重复用作表格边框、视觉分隔线或注释块装饰；旁边常见竖线、斜杠、换行和空白。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 表格、Github 代码注释

patterns.name: 数学式中的双星号
patterns.context: 双星号紧接数学表达式中的变量和数字，可能充当运算符或格式标记；仅有一个样例，不能确定具体功能。

patterns.name: C/C++ 双星号指针
patterns.context: 双星号出现在类型名与变量名之间，作为指针声明的一部分；另有普通代码结构但未见同样明确的双星触发。
