patterns.name: 单位换算题干与答案
patterns.context: 以问答形式要求在长度、质量、时间、容量等单位间换算，常伴随数字答案

en.concept: Numbers and formatting markers in structured passages
en.description: Activation occurs in formatting-dense passages with many symbols and numbers: most prominently court case names and case numbers, but also paper experimental data, country-value tables, unit conversions, chemical crystal parameters, and patent citations. Specific semantics vary substantially across passages.

patterns.name: Federal litigation case-name and case-number formats
patterns.context: At the beginning of a court document or in the caption, includes plaintiffs and defendants, v., Civil case numbers, and court names; words in the caption are marked in fragments, but activation spans multiple formatting components.

patterns.name: PubMed values and experimental results
patterns.context: Experimental paper abstracts compare treatment groups and report quantitative results, statistical significance, or sample sizes, including decimals and inequalities.

patterns.name: Country codes and values in tables
patterns.context: Country or region abbreviations, values, and names appear in aligned columns; the text resembles a table dump and includes decimals.

patterns.name: Mathematical unit-conversion questions and answers
patterns.context: Asks questions using “How many … are there” or “Convert … to …”, involving metric units, quantities, or decimals, and provides an answer.

patterns.name: Civil-rights litigation narrative and case citation
patterns.context: Body text or case citation in legal documents mentions conspiracy, deprivation of civil rights, parties, and civil case numbers; it is not the standard case-caption layout on an opinion's first page.

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and crystallographic parameters
patterns.context: Structured chemistry/crystallography records contain formulas, molecular weights, crystal systems, and lattice constants, among other symbols and values.

patterns.name: Medical research and regeneration in patent citations
patterns.context: Patent background sections cite research papers or patents discussing bone marrow-derived cell-mediated myocardial regeneration and list patent numbers.

11_2670.concept: 结构化文段中的数字与格式标记
11_2670.description: 激活见于格式密集、符号与数字较多的文段：尤以法院案名和案号最突出，也涵盖论文实验数据、国家数值表、单位换算、化学晶体参数及专利引文。各段具体语义差异较大。

patterns.name: 联邦诉讼案名与案号格式
patterns.context: 法院文书开头或案名区，出现原被告、v.、Civil 案号及法院名称；案名中的词被切分标记，但激活跨越多个格式成分。

patterns.name: PubMed 数值与实验结果
patterns.context: 实验论文摘要中，比较处理组、报告定量结果、统计显著性或样本量，含小数和不等式。

patterns.name: 表格中的国家代码与数值
patterns.context: 以对齐列呈现国家或地区缩写、数值和名称；文本像表格转储，包含小数。

patterns.name: 数学单位换算问答
patterns.trigger: «↵»4How« many»3« nan»2ometers are there« in»2 1/«4»1 of a microm«eter»1«?»4；«Convert»4
patterns.context: 以“How many … are there”或“Convert … to …”提问，涉及公制单位、数量或小数，并给出答案。

patterns.name: 民权诉讼叙述与引案
patterns.trigger: « alleging»2« a»2« conspiracy« to»3 deprive … «civil»1« rights»1；«Civil»2« Action»3« No»4
patterns.context: 法律文本正文或引案信息中，提及阴谋、剥夺民权、当事人及民事案号；不是标准判决首页案名布局。

patterns.name: 化学式与晶体学参数
patterns.context: 结构化化学/晶体学记录，包含分子式、分子量、晶系及晶格常数等符号和数值。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文/补充数据

patterns.name: 专利引用中的医学研究与再生
patterns.trigger: « the»4« regeneration»3« of»3« cardiac»2« muscles»3« mediated»2« by»3« bone»4« marrow»4«-»5«derived»4« cells»2；«JP« Patent»1« Publication»3
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中引用研究文献或专利，讨论骨髓来源细胞介导的心肌再生，并列出专利号。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across medical abstracts, chemical names, personal names, historical texts, and interface code. Local triggers are often subword fragments of proper names or terms, such as drug, assay, place names, and deflated. No unified semantic or stable syntactic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Split Z string
patterns.context: “Zidovudine” appears at the beginning of a sentence or text fragment, split into multiple subwords, followed by a comparison or clinical description.

patterns.name: chromogenic assay
patterns.context: Describes a potency assay method for recombinant factor VIII, especially when the phrase appears after several assays are listed.
patterns.domain: NIH research funding abstracts; coagulation testing

patterns.name: rapamycin and arousal
patterns.context: A study title or abstract begins by discussing the effects of rapamycin on stress-induced hyperarousal and its consolidation.

patterns.name: Skańska in a personal name
patterns.context: The name Felicja Schabińska appears on its own line, immediately followed by a repeated opening.

patterns.name: Probe deflation and deflated
patterns.context: A balloon probe is deflated, followed by a description of inserting it into the body; earlier text concerns cables and electrical safety.

patterns.name: Repeated chemical name
patterns.context: The compound name Zinc ammonium chloride appears at the beginning of a paragraph, then repeats after a line break.

patterns.name: Name of the St. Bartholomew's Massacre
patterns.context: St. Bartholomew's Massacre appears in a historical narrative discussing Henry III and punishment.

patterns.name: lipemic specimens testing
patterns.context: Describes reagent formulations, sample blanks, and automated testing of serum or plasma.

patterns.name: Interface label Top Bar
patterns.context: Appears as a text attribute value in XML/interface configuration, describing a control for toggling the top bar.

patterns.name: Paper references and nonttranslated
patterns.context: After author names and journal citations, an abstract fragment mentions insertion into a non-translated region and gene expression.

11_2793.description: 强激活分散于医学摘要、化学名称、人名、历史文本和界面代码；局部触发多为专名或术语的特定子词片段，如 drug、assay、地名及 deflated，未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 被切分的 Z 字符串
patterns.context: 句首或文本片段开头出现拆分成多个子词的 “Zidovudine”，随后接比较或临床描述。

patterns.name: chromogenic assay
patterns.context: 描述重组因子 VIII 的效价测定方法，尤其是列举多种 assay 后出现该词组。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究资助摘要；凝血检测

patterns.name: rapamycin 与 arousal
patterns.context: 句首研究标题或摘要中讨论 rapamycin 对压力诱发过度唤醒及其巩固过程的影响。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要；神经科学、药理学

patterns.name: 人名中的 Skańska
patterns.context: 人名 Felicja Schabińska 单独成行并紧接着重复开头。

patterns.name: 探头放气与 deflated
patterns.context: 气球探头被放气后，随后描述将探头导入体内；前文涉及电缆和电气安全。

patterns.name: 化学品名称重复
patterns.context: 化合物名称 Zinc ammonium chloride 出现在段落开头，换行后再次重复。

patterns.name: 圣巴托罗缪大屠杀名称
patterns.context: 历史叙述中出现 St. Bartholomew's Massacre，周围讨论亨利三世及惩罚。

patterns.name: lipemic specimens 检测
patterns.context: 描述血清或血浆检测的试剂配方、样本空白及自动化检测。
patterns.domain: 临床检验、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 界面标签 Top Bar
patterns.context: XML/界面配置中作为 text 属性值，描述切换顶部栏的控件。

patterns.name: 论文参考文献与 nonttranslated
patterns.context: 作者姓名和期刊引文之后，摘要片段提及插入非翻译区及基因表达。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文引文或摘要

en.concept: Low-frequency subword fragments and tokenization boundaries
en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from multiple domains, mainly on low-frequency words split by tokenization, proper nouns, technical terms, or abbreviation fragments. Repeated titles, interface labels, and punctuation also appear; there is no stable single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of biomedical or biochemical terms and abbreviations
patterns.context: Positive activations fall on tokenized fragments of medical, biological, or chemical terms; the terms themselves and their surrounding medical contexts vary.

patterns.name: Repeated encyclopedia entry titles
patterns.context: A short title or entry heading is followed by a newline, and the title is repeated at the beginning of the body; activations cover tokenized title fragments.

patterns.name: Rare spelling fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Polish female names appear as standalone name lines in entries, followed by repeated names.

patterns.name: Rare fragments in proper nouns and historical words
patterns.context: In historical narratives, proper nouns are split into multiple fragments; italics or emphasis markers also appear nearby.

patterns.name: Rare technical terms and sentence-final punctuation in operating instructions
patterns.context: In instructions for operating probes and balloons, less common action words are split into fragments; strong activations fall on sentence-final punctuation.

patterns.name: Interface label text
patterns.context: Short titles or control labels appear as attribute values in XML/interface code.

patterns.name: Fragments in abbreviations or bibliography formatting
patterns.context: Token boundaries and abbreviation punctuation appear in bibliography-style text containing author names and journal volume/page details.

11_2793.concept: 低频词片段与分词边界
11_2793.description: 激活散布于多领域文本中，主要落在分词切开的低频词、专名、术语或缩写片段，也见重复标题、界面标签及标点；没有稳定的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 生化医学术语或缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 正激活落在被分词切开的医学、生物或化学术语片段上；词本身及其周边医学语境各异
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 重复的百科词条标题
patterns.context: 短标题或词条首行后换行，并在正文开头重复标题；激活覆盖标题词的分词片段

patterns.name: 人名中的罕见拼写片段
patterns.context: 波兰女性姓名在词条中以独立姓名行出现，随后重复姓名

patterns.name: 专名与历史词语的稀有片段
patterns.context: 历史叙述中，专名被拆成多个片段；附近还有斜体或强调标记

patterns.name: 操作说明中的罕见技术词及句末
patterns.context: 探头和气囊操作说明中，较少见的动作词被拆分；高激活落在句末标点

patterns.name: 界面标签文字
patterns.context: XML/界面代码的属性值中出现简短标题或控件标签

patterns.name: 缩写或引用书目格式片段
patterns.context: 作者姓名及期刊卷页等书目格式文本中出现分词边界和缩写标点

en.concept: Local responses to subword fragments and proper nouns
en.description: Response patterns are scattered: they cover tokenized fragments of drugs, chemicals, and names; common English words; medical and testing terms; code interface labels and numbers; Swedish word fragments; and title/newline boundaries. No single trigger condition appears across the corpus.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in drug or substance names
patterns.context: Responds to tokenized fragments within proper nouns or chemical and drug names; sometimes components of the same name activate consecutively, and similar responses also occur in personal names.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in personal names or proper nouns
patterns.context: When a name is split into multiple subwords or character fragments, activations occur within the name; not all name fragments activate equally.

patterns.name: Lowercase function words and short phrase fragments
patterns.context: In continuous English text, a few common words or short phrases show local activations; the words differ across instances, making a common syntactic condition difficult to identify.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, historical narratives, technical reports

patterns.name: Labels and numbers in structured interface text
patterns.context: Numbers, coordinates, control names, and label text all activate in XML/interface configuration snippets.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Swedish parliamentary text
patterns.context: Words are split into subwords in continuous Swedish text; high responses concentrate on fragments of “står.” No confirmed cross-lingual common trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Title, newline, and repeated-entry boundaries
patterns.context: When an encyclopedia entry title or name is followed by a blank line and a repeated entry opening, both the name and newline boundary activate.

patterns.name: Scientific terms and assay descriptions
patterns.context: Descriptions of clotting factor preparations and potency assays show strong activations near testing, protein names, and assay terms.

patterns.name: Research terms in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Terms such as models, clinicians, and disease states in abstract titles or bodies show local activations; the terms vary with the research topic.

11_2793.concept: 词片段及专名局部响应
11_2793.description: 响应形态较分散：涵盖药物、化学物质及人名的分词片段，英文常见词，医学和检测术语、代码界面标签与数字、瑞典语词片段，以及标题换行边界；未见覆盖所有语料的单一触发条件。

patterns.name: 药物或物质名称中的词尾片段
patterns.trigger: “Z»6«id»3«ov»5«ud»5«ine»6”“« did»10«an»2«osine”“« Zinc»8« ammonium»9« chloride»7”“« rap»3«amycin»8”“« Lé»6«on»6« Mug»3«esera»3”
patterns.context: 对专名或化学、药物名称内部的分词片段有反应；有时同一名称的组成部分连续激活，亦见于人名。

patterns.name: 人名或专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 姓名被拆成多个子词或字符片段时，激活分布于名称内部；并非所有姓名片段都同等激活。

patterns.name: 小写功能词及短语片段
patterns.trigger: “« compared»6« with»2« did»10«an»2”“« and»4”“« in»3« the»2”“« after»2« three»5« years»6”
patterns.context: 在英文连续文本中，少数常见词或短短语出现局部激活；各处词语并不一致，难以确定统一句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、历史叙述、科技报告

patterns.name: 结构化界面文本中的标签与数字
patterns.context: 在 XML/界面配置片段中，数字坐标、控件名称和标签文本均有激活。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会文本中的词片段
patterns.trigger: “« min»1«ut»3« om»1« frå»3«gor»1« av»3« polit»2«isk»2”“« st»år»9”
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中，词被拆分成子词；高响应集中在“står”一词的片段，未见可确认的跨语种共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 标题、换行及重复条目边界
patterns.context: 百科条目标题或名称后紧接空行并重复条目开头时，名称及换行边界均有激活。

patterns.name: 科学术语和测定描述
patterns.trigger: “« potency»2« tests»8”“« recombinant»5« F»7«V»3«III»6”“« chrom»2«ogenic»3« assay»10”
patterns.context: 凝血因子制剂及其效价测定的描述中，检测、蛋白名称和测定术语附近激活较强。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的研究术语
patterns.trigger: “« Care»6« model»3”“« Collaborative»3« Care»7« model»4”“« general»4« practitioners»9”“« hyper»2«ar»7«ousal»9”
patterns.context: 摘要标题或正文中的模型、临床人员、疾病状态等术语出现局部激活，词项随研究主题变化。

en.concept: Formatting markers and salient word fragments
en.description: The strongest common trigger is “FYI” in emails; other activations are scattered across line breaks and heading formats, as well as chemistry, research, finance, and web phrases, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Email opening FYI
patterns.context: At the beginning of an email body or forwarded content, often followed by a line break, hyphen, or explanatory text.

patterns.name: Sectioned or line-broken headings
patterns.context: One or more line breaks follow a heading or phrase, often with a repeated heading or a subsequent paragraph.
patterns.domain: Web pages, encyclopedias, and email-formatted text

patterns.name: Chemical name
patterns.context: Tokens are split within the chemical name “Zinc ammonium chloride.”

patterns.name: Experimental comparison heading
patterns.context: Forms part of a research comparison heading with terms such as potency and recombinant FVIII.

patterns.name: Financial institution name
patterns.context: The beginning of the institution name “Platinum Mortgage Funding.”

patterns.name: Website follow options
patterns.context: Prompts to follow via email or RSS; two similar phrases appear repeatedly.

patterns.name: Scientific term or research topic
patterns.context: Abstract text describing the disintegration of graphene nanoribbons in a strong electrostatic field.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia entry heading
patterns.context: The heading “Industrial espionage” appears repeatedly, with the words split across tokens.

11_2793.concept: 格式标记与高显著词片段
11_2793.description: 最强共同触发是邮件中的“FYI”；其余激活分散于换行/标题格式，以及化学、科研、金融和网页短语，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: FYI 邮件开头
patterns.context: 邮件正文或转发内容开头，常接换行、连字符或说明文字。

patterns.name: 分段或断行标题
patterns.context: 标题或短语后出现一个或多个换行，常伴随标题重复或后续段落。
patterns.domain: 网页、百科及邮件格式文本

patterns.name: 化学品名称
patterns.context: “Zinc ammonium chloride”这一化学名称中，相关词被拆分为 token。

patterns.name: 实验比较标题
patterns.context: 与 potency、recombinant FVIII 等词构成研究比较标题。

patterns.name: 金融机构名称
patterns.context: “Platinum Mortgage Funding”机构名称的开头。

patterns.name: 网页关注方式提示
patterns.context: 提示通过 email 或 RSS 关注，两个相似短语重复出现。

patterns.name: 科学术语或研究主题
patterns.context: 石墨烯纳米带在强静电场中解体的摘要表述。

patterns.name: 百科条目标题
patterns.context: “Industrial espionage”标题重复出现，词语跨 token 拆分。

en.description: Activations primarily occur on “FYI” and its punctuation, newlines, and forwarding format at the beginnings of emails; they also occur on tokenized fragments in chemical names, phrasing about graphene nanofiber disintegration, and title wording.

patterns.name: FYI email notice
patterns.context: At the beginning of an email body or forwarded message; often followed by a newline, blank line, forwarded/original-message divider, or brief comment.

patterns.name: The phrase Zinc ammonium chloride
patterns.context: The chemical name appears repeatedly, followed by a newline and another occurrence of the name.

patterns.name: Description of graphene nanofiber disintegration
patterns.context: Discusses the disintegration of graphene nanofibers in a strong electrostatic field.

patterns.name: Advanced-project wording in a title
patterns.context: A title-like phrase describing an advanced project as easier than expected.

11_2793.description: 主要对邮件开头的“FYI”及其标点、换行和转发格式激活；另对含有特定分词片段的化学名称、石墨烯纳米纤维摘要表述和标题措辞激活。

patterns.name: FYI 邮件提示
patterns.trigger: “FY”后接“I”，即“FYI”；有时后接句点或连字符
patterns.context: 邮件正文或转发邮件开头；其后常有换行、空行、转发/原始邮件分隔符或简短评论

patterns.name: Zinc ammonium chloride 字样
patterns.context: 化学物质名称重复出现，后接换行及再次出现的名称

patterns.name: 石墨烯纳米纤维解体表述
patterns.context: 讨论石墨烯纳米纤维在强静电场中的解体

patterns.name: 标题中的高级项目措辞
patterns.context: 标题式短语，描述高级项目比想象中容易

en.description: Activations occur in medical word fragments, code and configuration identifiers, CSS colors, English contractions, project titles, and all-caps court headings. Trigger forms differ markedly across examples and cannot be grouped into a single semantic or stable syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments in PubMed medical terms
patterns.context: Activations fall within medical vocabulary split across tokens, especially immunology/cytokine terms and terms related to myelodysplasia; there is insufficient evidence of a response to any single medical concept.

patterns.name: Specific strings in structured data
patterns.context: Game/interrogation data in a JSON-style object; activations cluster on difficulty field values and uppercase fear labels in arrays, alongside delimiters, numbers, and enum values.

patterns.name: CSS styles and color values
patterns.context: Character fragments in hexadecimal color codes activate in CSS declarations; the same block also contains properties such as height, background, color, and border.

patterns.name: English negative contraction
patterns.context: In colloquial English sentences, don't is followed by reassurance; the trigger is primarily the contraction itself.

patterns.name: Control syntax in template code
patterns.context: An ERB-style if/end block and conditional class name appear in templated HTML; activations are associated with template markers and the active class.

patterns.name: Slash in project summary heading
patterns.context: Activations occur near the Summary/Abstract slash notation in an NIH project record's title field; the following text summarizes an electronic adherence monitoring project.

patterns.name: Criminal appellate court heading
patterns.context: A formal court heading in all caps, with activations distributed across multiple words and subword fragments in the institution name.

patterns.name: Cloud resource configuration identifier
patterns.context: Activations occur near an AWS instance resource name and the web tag in a Terraform-style resource declaration.

11_2793.description: 激活分散在医学词片段、代码与配置标识符、CSS 颜色、英语缩写、项目标题及法院全大写标题中。各处触发形式差异明显，无法归为单一语义或稳定句法模式。

patterns.name: PubMed 医学术语中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的医学词汇内部，尤其是免疫/细胞因子术语与骨髓增生异常相关术语；没有足够证据表明语义上只响应某一种医学概念。

patterns.name: 结构化数据中的特定字符串
patterns.context: JSON 风格对象中的游戏/审讯数据；激活集中在难度字段值和数组中的大写恐惧标签，周围还有分隔符、数字及枚举值。
patterns.domain: GitHub 结构化文本/游戏数据

patterns.name: CSS 样式与颜色值
patterns.context: CSS 声明中，十六进制颜色代码的字符片段激活；同段还有 height、background、color、border 等属性。

patterns.name: 英语否定缩写
patterns.context: 口语式英语句子中，don't 后接安慰/保证语气；触发主要落在缩写本身。

patterns.name: 模板代码中的控制语法
patterns.context: 模板化 HTML 中出现 ERB 风格的 if/end 块及条件类名；激活与模板标记、active 类附近相关。

patterns.name: 项目摘要标题中的斜线
patterns.context: NIH 项目记录的标题字段中，Summary/Abstract 斜线写法附近激活；后文是电子依从性监测项目摘要。

patterns.name: 刑事上诉法院标题
patterns.context: 全大写的正式法院标题，激活分布在机构名称多个词及其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 云资源配置标识符
patterns.context: Terraform 风格的 resource 声明中，AWS 实例资源名及 web 标签附近激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 基础设施配置代码

en.description: Activations often occur on identifiers, variables, function names, and path-related words in code and formulas. Other sporadic triggers include Chinese algorithm comments, morphemes in cited names, and CSS style values. They span languages, syntax, and domains, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Variable identifiers in code
patterns.context: Identifiers consist of common word roots and naming structures such as camel case and underscores, often in code contexts involving assignment, declaration, loops, or function calls; some longer identifiers activate more strongly.

patterns.name: File- and directory-related identifiers
patterns.context: Code or technical explanations discuss files, folders, and paths; activations occur on path text and related identifiers.

patterns.name: Variables or function symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variables, function names, or index symbols are embedded in formulas or numerical algorithm expressions rather than natural-language prose.
patterns.domain: Mathematical formulas and numerical computing code

patterns.name: Direction and extremum terms in Chinese comments

patterns.name: Hexadecimal color values

11_2793.concept: 代码与公式中的标识符

patterns.name: 代码中的变量标识符
patterns.context: 标识符由普通词根和驼峰、下划线等命名结构组成，常出现在赋值、声明、循环或函数调用等代码语境中；有些较长标识符处激活更强。

patterns.name: 文件与目录相关标识符

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量或函数符号
patterns.context: 变量、函数名或索引符号嵌在公式或数值算法表达式中，而非自然语言叙述。

patterns.name: 中文注释中的方向与极值词

patterns.name: 类名或专名中的词素

patterns.name: 路径及盘符字符串

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal fragments in code identifiers and short variables, SQL fragments, chemical formulas and names, drug abbreviations, and mathematicians' names; no prominent unified semantic or domain pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Fragments within identifiers, class names, and code tokens
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal fragments of program identifiers or type names, often camel-case or compound names; surrounding contexts include code declarations, calls, or assignments.

patterns.name: Short letter fragments in code
patterns.context: Short variable names, parameter names, or identifier components in code statements, appearing in conditions, indexing, function calls, assignments, and other contexts.

patterns.name: Token fragments in SQL queries
patterns.context: In SQL query strings, especially near query keywords, table names, or random-ordering expressions; activations also occur in subsequent PHP data-reading code.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in chemical names and formulas
patterns.context: Spans element symbols, parentheses, numbers, and organic chemistry name fragments in complex formulas or systematic chemical names.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment
patterns.context: The drug abbreviation BCNU appears in descriptions of patient dosage, infusion method, and pharmacokinetics.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a mathematician's name
patterns.context: An author's name in a mathematics paper is tokenized or split around an unusual character, near discussion of exterior algebra and formulas.

11_2793.concept: 词内片段与复合标识符

patterns.name: 标识符、类名与代码 token 内部片段

patterns.name: 代码中的短小字母片段
patterns.context: 代码语句中的短变量名、参数名或标识符组成部分，出现在条件、索引、函数调用、赋值等上下文中。

patterns.name: SQL 查询中的分词片段
patterns.context: SQL 查询字符串中，特别是查询关键字、表名或随机排序表达式附近；激活也出现在后续 PHP 数据读取代码中。

patterns.name: 化学名称与化学式中的内部片段

patterns.name: Delimiter-related code Q&A

en.description: Activations are distributed across word-internal fragments and code identifier fragments in multiple languages, including Java, Swift, Python, JavaScript, and Italian, English, and Spanish text; no stable semantic or grammatical function is evident.

patterns.name: Splitting Java identifiers and method names
patterns.context: Camel-case method names, class names, or identifiers in Java print statements; activations fall on subwords within the names

patterns.name: Word-internal Italian subwords

patterns.name: Word-internal English subwords

patterns.name: Word-internal Spanish fragments

11_2793.description: 激活分布于多种语言的词内片段及代码标识符片段，涵盖 Java、Swift、Python、JavaScript 和意大利语、英语、西班牙语文本；未见稳定的语义或语法功能。

patterns.name: Java 标识符与方法名拆分

patterns.name: 意大利语词内子词

patterns.name: 英语词内子词

en.concept: Multilingual short words and word fragments
en.description: Activations occur mainly on short function words in multilingual text, especially English the/a and Romance-language articles. Other isolated triggers include currency, give, medical word-internal fragments, an Italian reform term, a party name, makefile, and a Spanish evaluative word.

patterns.name: Articles or their morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on articles or short words functioning as articles in different languages, often near noun phrases; the language and syntactic environment vary.
patterns.domain: Natural-language text in English, Italian, Dutch, Spanish, and other languages

patterns.name: Currency-unit noun
patterns.context: In “sovereign currency,” activation falls on the noun naming the type of currency, preceded by sovereign and followed by punctuation.

patterns.name: Expressions of giving or donating
patterns.context: A conditional sentence supposes that someone copies a spreadsheet and gives it away for free; activation falls on give.

patterns.name: Medical word-internal fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a medical term describing acetylcholine hydrolysis levels; activation falls on an internal word fragment.

patterns.name: Italian word-internal fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls within the Italian word for “reform”; the same word appears in different passages discussing PAC reform and judicial reform.
patterns.domain: Italian speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Greek party name
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment of the Communist stem in a Dutch rendering of the name of the Greek Communist Party.

patterns.name: Filename-related fragment
patterns.context: Refers to the software build tool make and its file, alongside C.h, tester, and directories.

patterns.name: Spanish evaluative expression
patterns.context: An answer says it is fine to get a value from the display page, but not from the label; activation falls on the evaluative word meaning “good/okay.”

11_2793.description: 激活主要分布在多语种文本中的短功能词，尤其是英语 the/a 与罗曼语冠词；另有若干孤立触发：货币、give、医学词内片段、意大利语改革词、党名、makefile 及西班牙语评价词。

patterns.name: 冠词或其形态片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言中的冠词或带冠词功能的短词上，常出现在名词短语附近；具体语言和句法环境不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 英语、意大利语、荷兰语、西班牙语等自然语言文本

patterns.name: 货币单位名词
patterns.context: “sovereign currency”中激活在货币类别名词上，前有 sovereign，后接标点。

patterns.name: 让与、赠与表达
patterns.context: 条件句设想某人复制电子表格并免费给出去，激活落在 give。

patterns.name: 医学词内片段

patterns.name: 文件名相关片段

en.description: Activations are distributed across varied corpora: English grammatical words, internal fragments of technical terms, code indexing symbols, Spanish tokenization, and animal adoption narratives. No consistent semantic or syntactic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Marker after a possessive or common grammatical word
patterns.context: An article, pronoun, or conjunction occurs in a sentence, followed by a noun, verb, or phrase; there is no consistent specific syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Religious narratives, HackerNews comments, patent backgrounds, etc.

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments in English words

patterns.name: Code punctuation and array indexing

patterns.name: Tokenization within Spanish words
patterns.context: Common words are split into internal fragments in Spanish sentences; activations occur across multiple words and phrases.

patterns.name: Animal names and adoption narratives

11_2793.description: 激活分散于多种语料：英语语法词、技术词内部片段、代码索引符号、西班牙语分词，以及动物收养叙述；看不出一致的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 所有格或常见语法词后的标记

patterns.name: 英文单词内部子词片段

patterns.name: Bring/cause

patterns.name: Command and performance tool

en.concept: Mixed responses to boundary-adjacent word fragments
en.description: Activations span topics with no single semantic theme: they often occur on words following the, at syntactic or typographic boundaries, and on internal word fragments. Other local patterns appear in religious texts, literary kitchen scenes, medical texts, Italian commentary, and wage disputes.

patterns.name: Words following the
patterns.context: Activations fall on the definite article the and the following proper noun, title, or noun, but the subsequent word classes and meanings vary.

patterns.name: Words at sentence or syntactic boundaries
patterns.context: Strong activations often fall on words or word fragments near syntactic constituent boundaries, with punctuation, newlines, or internal word splits nearby; no consistent boundary type is apparent.
patterns.domain: Novels, legal texts, medical texts, philosophy, encyclopedias, and Italian texts

patterns.name: Religious and Christian vocabulary
patterns.context: Contexts involving religious institutions, Christian figures, or orders; however, activations do not always fall on religious words themselves.
patterns.domain: Church history, Christian exhortation, religious encyclopedias

patterns.name: Verse-drama layout with line breaks
patterns.context: Newlines and indentation structure dialogue or lineated text; activations involve words near line breaks and line-internal content.

patterns.name: Cooking and shipboard kitchen vocabulary
patterns.context: A ship's cook prepares dinner for the captain, with terms related to cooking utensils and kitchen scenes.

patterns.name: Italian word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal word fragments in continuous Italian text, covering meanings such as minorities, ornate, and suddenly obsolete.

patterns.name: Scriptural phrasing about sin and redemption
patterns.context: Expresses human sinfulness, salvation by grace, and Christian doctrines of redemption.

patterns.name: Medical disease and thrombosis vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical abstract contexts about pancreatic cancer and venous thromboembolism, with clear internal tokenization.

patterns.name: Wage payment disputes
patterns.context: In an employment relationship, wages or a check are withheld because the work was not completed.

patterns.context: 激活落在定冠词 the 及紧随其后的专名、头衔或名词上，但后续词类和语义不统一。

patterns.name: 句末或句法边界的词
patterns.context: 强激活常落在句法成分边界附近的词或词片段，附近可见标点、换行或词内切分；未见一致的边界类型。

patterns.name: 宗教与基督教词汇
patterns.context: 宗教机构、基督教人物或修会相关语境；但激活位置并不总是宗教词本身。
patterns.domain: 教会史、基督教劝诫、宗教百科

patterns.name: 换行后的诗剧式排版
patterns.context: 换行与缩进构成对话或分行文本，激活涉及换行邻近词及行内内容。

patterns.name: 烹饪及船上厨房词汇
patterns.context: 船上厨师为船长准备晚餐，出现炊具与厨房场景词汇。

patterns.name: 意大利语词汇片段
patterns.context: 意大利语连续行文中，激活落在词内片段，涉及少数群体、华丽及突然过时等语义。
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学或艺术评论

patterns.name: 经文式罪与救赎表述
patterns.context: 表达人的罪性、无功得救及基督教救赎教义。
patterns.domain: 基督教讲道或灵修文本

patterns.name: 医学疾病与血栓词汇
patterns.context: 胰腺癌及静脉血栓栓塞的医学摘要语境，词内切分明显。

patterns.name: 薪资支付争议
patterns.context: 雇佣关系中因工作未完成而拒付工资或支票。

en.concept: Token fragments and local form features
en.description: Activations occur on word fragments, common short words, code identifiers, and occasional whole words across multiple languages and genres. There is no stable topic or syntactic context. They may primarily reflect token fragments and local form features, but the evidence is insufficient for a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of split words
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of words split into multiple tokens, especially medial or final fragments, rather than on whole-word meaning; positions and parts of speech vary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including encyclopedias, medical papers, and code

patterns.name: Function words or punctuation at word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur on common function words, short words, or structural markers, without a stable syntactic role or fixed neighboring context.
patterns.domain: Legal narrative, encyclopedias, forums, code, and other genres

patterns.name: Multi-token activations in local phrases
patterns.context: Several word fragments in the same local phrase activate, but referents and collocations differ substantially across passages, with no unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Religious history, medicine, forum dialogue, and more

patterns.name: Code identifiers and HTTP field fragments
patterns.context: Identifiers, constants, and keys in code or serialized text activate after tokenization; observed only in code-related fragments.
patterns.domain: PHP source code, HTTP response headers

patterns.name: Italian word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Italian text, both word-internal fragments and whole short words activate; this sample cannot determine whether the effect is language-specific or a general token-fragment effect.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on English words and phrases
patterns.context: Whole words or word fragments activate individually in their respective contexts, without forming a reproducible semantic category or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Law, music encyclopedias, forums, Q&A, medicine

patterns.name: Sentence-final or structural positions
patterns.context: Activations sometimes fall at the end of a phrase or at a code-block boundary, but other examples are inconsistent, so evidence is weak.

11_2793.concept: 分词片段与局部形式特征
11_2793.description: 激活分布在词内分片、常见短词、代码标识符和零散完整词上，跨多种语种与文体；没有稳定的主题或句法上下文。可能主要反映分词片段及局部形式特征，但证据不足以统一解释。

patterns.name: 切分后的词语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分为多个 token 的词内部片段，尤其是词中或词尾，而非完整词义；位置和词类不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括百科、医学论文、代码

patterns.name: 词边界处的功能词或标点
patterns.trigger: « because»、« some»、« pay»、« the»、« an»、« him»、« No»、«}»
patterns.context: 激活出现在常见功能词、短词或结构标记上，未呈现稳定的句法角色或固定邻接条件。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、百科、论坛、代码及其他文体

patterns.name: 局部短语中的多 token 激活
patterns.context: 同一局部短语中的若干词片段激活，但所指概念和搭配跨段差异明显，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 宗教史、医学、论坛对话等

patterns.name: 代码标识符与 HTTP 字段片段
patterns.context: 代码或序列化文本中，标识符、常量、键名被分词后出现激活；仅在代码相关片段中观察到。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 意大利语连续文本中，词内分片及完整短词均有激活；本样本无法判定是语言特异反应还是一般分词片段效应。
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学或评论性散文

patterns.name: 英语词汇和短语的零散激活
patterns.context: 完整词或词片段在各自语境中单独激活，未形成可复现的语义类别或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 法律、音乐百科、论坛、问答、医学

patterns.name: 句末或结构性位置
patterns.context: 激活有时落在短语结尾或代码块结构边界，但其余实例不一致，证据较弱。

en.description: Activations occur across religious texts, code, Italian, politics, the music industry, and literary passages, often on proper nouns, technical terms, or internal word fragments. The passages differ greatly in semantic topic, with no common trigger pattern apparent.

patterns.name: Religious and ecclesiastical terminology
patterns.context: Religious proper nouns and terms occur in accounts of church institutions, orders, Christian doctrine, or liturgy; activations fall within terms or on neighboring words.
patterns.domain: Religious history, Christian texts and commentary

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and code
patterns.context: Identifiers, variable names, and descriptive text are interspersed in code or technical Q&A; activations occur on code fragments or their referents.

patterns.name: Italian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur within tokenized words in Italian prose discussing art, exceptions, minorities, and related topics.

patterns.name: Politics and British government
patterns.context: Words near political institutions and offices activate in discussions of British parties, elections, power, or Scottish devolution.

patterns.name: Music releases and awards
patterns.context: Activations occur near music-industry proper nouns and release terminology in accounts of chart listings, sales, deluxe editions, and music awards.

patterns.name: Death and the meaning of life
patterns.context: Literary commentary addresses death, life's loss of appeal, and facing death or truthful narration.

patterns.name: Poetic vocabulary of giving and generosity
patterns.context: Verse uses irony or admonition to discuss generosity, giving, and miserliness; activations concentrate on words related to giving.

11_2793.description: 激活分布于宗教、代码、意大利语、政治、音乐产业和文学段落，常落在专名、术语或词内片段；各段语义主题差异大，未见统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 宗教与教会用语
patterns.trigger: « Holy» « See»；« Franc»«isc»«an»；« God»；« Jesus» « Christ»；« Mass»
patterns.context: 教会制度、修会、基督教教义或礼仪相关叙述中出现宗教专名与术语；激活落在术语内部或邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 宗教史、基督教文本与评论

patterns.name: 技术标识符与代码
patterns.context: 程序代码或技术问答中，标识符、变量名及描述性文字混排；对代码片段或其所指对象有激活。

patterns.name: 意大利语词形片段
patterns.context: 意大利语散文中，激活分布在被切分的词内部；文本讨论艺术、例外与少数群体等。
patterns.domain: 意大利语评论或学术散文

patterns.name: 政治与英国政体
patterns.trigger: status quo；Labour；« Scottish»« Prime»« Minister»；« ministers»
patterns.context: 讨论英国政党、选举、权力或苏格兰权力下放时，政治制度及官职词附近激活。

patterns.name: 音乐发行与奖项
patterns.context: 介绍唱片榜单、销量、豪华版及音乐奖项时，音乐产业专名与发行术语附近激活。

patterns.name: 死亡与人生意义
patterns.trigger: « death»；“life holds … no longer any charm”；« truth»«ful»«account»
patterns.context: 文学论述中谈及死亡、人生失去吸引力，以及面对死亡或真实叙述。

patterns.name: 赠予与慷慨的诗歌语汇
patterns.context: 韵文中以反讽或劝诫谈慷慨、赠予及吝啬；激活集中于赠予相关词语。

en.description: Activations are distributed across many unrelated contexts: recipient possessives, torrent titles, literary exclamations, code identifiers and URL/message variables, post titles, tumor terminology, and bowel-movement assessments; there is no clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Recipient possessives and keys
patterns.context: Descriptions of email encryption discuss encrypting only with the recipient’s key, preventing the sender from reading sent messages

patterns.name: Torrent titles and ad-link placement
patterns.context: Imagining an ideal world where ad links immediately follow a torrent title or name

patterns.name: Characters and exclamations in literary contexts
patterns.context: Literary or philosophical discussion of original sin, cruelty, and a character first calling out to another person

patterns.name: V-set identifier in CMS calibration code
patterns.context: Appears in a CMS code calibration call, as part of a function or object identifier

patterns.name: Absolute URL in URL concatenation
patterns.context: Constructing an article URL by calling the instance’s get_absolute_url() and concatenating it with the site URL

patterns.name: Post page and automatically populated title
patterns.context: Explaining how a bookmarklet reads a document title and automatically fills it into the post page

patterns.name: Papillary structure in tumor-type names
patterns.context: Describes the site or tissue type of metastatic or metachronous tumors in cancer case reports

patterns.name: Current message vector
patterns.context: Code prints letters from the current message vector to prevent already-entered letters from disappearing

patterns.name: Git remote source URL replacement
patterns.context: Bulk-editing the IP address of remote origin in .git/config to a domain name or another IP

patterns.name: Bloating, bowel movements, and evacuation assessment
patterns.context: Assessment measures describing a sense of incomplete evacuation after a bowel movement and time spent on the toilet

11_2793.description: 激活分布在多种互不相同的语境：recipient 所有格、torrent 标题、文学呼喊、代码标识与 URL/消息变量、发帖标题、肿瘤术语及排便评估；没有明显共同触发模式。

patterns.name: recipient 所有格及密钥
patterns.context: 邮件加密的描述中，讨论只能用收件人密钥加密、导致发件人无法阅读已发送邮件

patterns.name: torrent 标题与广告链接位置
patterns.context: 设想理想世界中的广告链接紧跟 torrent 标题或名称

patterns.name: 文学语境中的人物与呼喊
patterns.context: 关于原罪、残酷和人物首次向另一个人呼喊的文学或哲学论述

patterns.name: CMS 校准代码中的 V 集合标识
patterns.context: 出现在 CMS 代码的校准流程调用中，作为函数或对象标识的一部分

patterns.name: URL 拼接中的绝对地址
patterns.context: 构造文章 URL 时，调用实例的 get_absolute_url() 并与站点 URL 拼接

patterns.name: 发帖页及自动填入标题
patterns.context: 说明书签工具读取文档标题，并在发帖页面自动填入标题

patterns.name: 肿瘤类型名称中的乳头状结构
patterns.context: 癌症病例报告中描述转移性或异时性肿瘤的部位/组织类型

patterns.name: 当前消息向量
patterns.context: 代码打印当前消息向量中的字母，以避免已输入的信件消失

patterns.name: Git 远程源地址替换
patterns.context: 批量修改 .git/config 中 remote origin 的 IP 地址为域名或其他 IP

patterns.name: 腹胀、排便及排空评估
patterns.context: 描述排便后不完全排空感及如厕耗时等症状评估指标

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across tokenized fragments of proper nouns or technical terms (San, Theological, REMAND, Eukaryotes, Mount of Olives, Prime Minister) and contexts such as answer and the instant case; no single domain is apparent.

patterns.name: Names of people or institutions beginning with San-
patterns.context: San is followed by the remainder of a proper noun, sometimes across a token boundary. Occurs in varied contexts such as art institutions, conference locations, and funding organizations.
patterns.domain: Personal/institutional proper nouns, including art history, conference documents, and research acknowledgments

patterns.name: Theological in an institution name
patterns.context: Theological combines with preceding Baptist and following Seminary to form an institution name.

patterns.name: REMAND in legal documents
patterns.context: The uppercase legal term REMAND appears in a judgment and refers to the subsequent part of the ruling.

patterns.name: The phrase Mount of Olives
patterns.context: In a biblical narrative, the proper noun Mount of Olives is preceded by a definite article and followed by Jesus and his disciples' itinerary.

patterns.name: Response context related to answer
patterns.context: A speaker is not listening carefully but is thinking ahead about the answer they will give.

patterns.name: Political office title
patterns.context: Scottish and Prime Minister form a political office title in a discussion of voter attitudes and political figures.

patterns.name: Eukaryotes in a biological term
patterns.context: Appears alongside Archae(a) in a description of the evolutionary conservation of tRNA splicing enzymes.

patterns.name: the instant case in a legal context
patterns.context: Appears after restitution hearing/order as a fixed expression referring to the case at hand in a legal opinion.

11_2793.description: 强激活分散于专名或术语的分词片段（San、Theological、REMAND、Eukaryotes、Mount of Olives、Prime Minister）及 answer、the instant case 等语境；未见统一领域。

patterns.name: San- 开头的人名或机构名
patterns.context: San 后接专名的后续部分；可能跨越分词边界。出现于艺术机构、会议地点、资助机构等不同语境。
patterns.domain: 人物/机构专名，涉及艺术史、会议文献和科研致谢

patterns.name: 机构名称中的 Theological
patterns.context: Theological 与前面的 Baptist、后面的 Seminary 一起构成机构名称。

patterns.name: 司法文书中的 REMAND
patterns.context: 大写法律术语 REMAND 出现在判决文本中，指向判决的后续部分。

patterns.name: Mount of Olives 短语
patterns.context: 圣经叙事中专名 Mount of Olives 前有定冠词，后接耶稣及门徒行程。

patterns.name: 与 answer 相关的应答语境
patterns.context: 谈话者未认真倾听，而是在预先思考将要给出的回答。

patterns.name: 政治职务名称
patterns.context: Scottish 与 Prime Minister 构成政治职务称谓，处于关于选民态度和政治人物的论述中。

patterns.name: 生物学术语中的 Eukaryotes
patterns.context: 与 Archae(a) 并列，描述 tRNA 剪接酶的进化保守性。

patterns.name: 法律语境中的 the instant case
patterns.context: 出现在 restitution hearing/order 之后，是法律意见书指称当前案件的固定表达。

en.description: Activations span technical, legal, political, and conversational corpora, often landing on function words but also on domain terms, code fragments, and specific content words. Sentencing-law and technical passages each show some local commonality, but there is no unified semantic trigger pattern overall.

patterns.name: Function words and local phrases in sentences
patterns.context: Activations occur on common words and phrases in syntactic structures; specific words and contexts vary considerably across corpora, with no clear, consistent triggering substring.
patterns.domain: Multidomain natural language, technical documentation, legal texts

patterns.name: Legal sentencing and execution of punishment
patterns.context: Describes criminal-case judgments, sentence lengths, and consecutive service.

patterns.name: Be at sentence end or in an infinitive
patterns.context: [3] is “going «to»…«give»”, while [5], [8], and [9] contain “«to» «be» served”; these contexts are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and technical term fragments in technical text
patterns.context: Activations fall on code identifiers, technical terms, or fragments of proper nouns, with no shared semantics or fixed context.
patterns.domain: Git, Python/template, HTTP code, and molecular biology

patterns.name: Scottish political title
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the title “Scottish Prime Minister”; «every» also activates weakly, but its relevance is unclear.

patterns.name: Conversational expressions about listening and responding
patterns.context: Discusses listening to others rather than thinking ahead about how to respond; strong activation centers on the verb «give», with sporadic function-word activations nearby.

11_2793.description: 激活跨技术、法律、政治及对话语料，常落在功能词，也落在领域术语、代码片段与特定实词；法律量刑段和技术段各有局部共性，但整体缺少统一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 句中功能词与局部短语
patterns.context: 激活分布在句法结构中的常见词和短语，不同语料里的具体词汇与语境差异较大；没有明显一致的单一触发子串。
patterns.domain: 多领域自然语言、技术文档、法律文本

patterns.name: 法律量刑与刑罚执行
patterns.context: 描述刑事案件的判决、刑期长度及连续执行方式。

patterns.name: 句末或不定式中的 be
patterns.context: [3] 为 “going «to»…«give»”，而 [5]、[8]、[9] 出现 “«to» «be» served”；这几处上下文并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的专名和术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在代码标识符、专业术语或专名的片段上，未见共同的语义或固定上下文。
patterns.domain: Git、Python/模板、HTTP 代码及分子生物学

patterns.name: 苏格兰政治称谓
patterns.context: 在“Scottish Prime Minister”称谓中激活；«every»也有较弱激活，但难确定是否相关。

patterns.name: 倾听与回应的对话表达
patterns.trigger: «give»9，位于“the answer they’re going to give you”
patterns.context: 谈论倾听他人而非提前思考如何回应；强激活集中在动词 «give»，周围也有零散功能词激活。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: give appears in multiple places; other examples include tokenized fragments in savannah, Saviour, godparents, names, CGIL, and IVP, as well as a legal sentence and common words in poetry. No unified semantic theme emerges.

patterns.name: give and its context
patterns.context: give occurs in sentences, often in structures such as give you, give thee, give what I can give, or give you an answer.

patterns.name: Syntactic function words and phrases
patterns.context: Multiple common words activate consecutively in legal judgment narratives or poetic lines; no consistent semantic collocation is apparent.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of savannah
patterns.context: Appears in the environmental description “humid heat of the savannah”.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of Sav(i)our
patterns.context: Appears in the religious expression “most blessed Saviour”.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of godparents
patterns.context: A biographical account describes baptism and godparents.

patterns.name: Tokenized name fragment McM...
patterns.context: A sender's name and email address appear in an email header.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of CGIL
patterns.context: The abbreviation CGIL appears in an Italian bibliography or conference title, accompanied by tokenized Italian words.

patterns.name: IVP abbreviation fragment
patterns.context: Appears within the abbreviation IVP for left ventricular pressure measurement in a cardiovascular physiology abstract.

11_2793.description: 激活模式较分散：多处包含 give；另有法律句、诗歌中的常见词，以及 savannah、Saviour、godparents、姓名、CGIL、IVP 等不同文本中的拆分词片段，未形成统一语义主题。

patterns.name: give 及其上下文
patterns.context: 句中出现 give；多与 give you、give thee、give what I can give，或 give you an answer 等结构有关。

patterns.name: 句法功能词及短语
patterns.context: 法律判决叙述或诗歌行句中，多个常见词连续激活；未见统一的特定语义搭配。

patterns.name: savannah 拆分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“humid heat of the savannah”这一环境描写中。

patterns.name: Sav(i)our 拆分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“most blessed Saviour”这一宗教表达中。

patterns.name: godparents 拆分词片段
patterns.context: 人物传记中描述受洗及教父母。

patterns.name: McM... 姓名拆分片段
patterns.context: 邮件头中出现发件人姓名及电子邮件地址。

patterns.name: CGIL 拆分词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语参考文献或会议题名中出现 CGIL 缩写，并伴有被拆分的意大利语词。

patterns.name: IVP 缩写片段
patterns.context: 心血管生理学摘要中，出现在左心室压力测量缩写 IVP 内。

en.description: Activations mainly occur on word-internal fragments across several word types or on common English function words such as the, a, and in; oper, vari, proper nouns, and sporadic vocabulary also appear. Examples span domains and show no stable shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Recurring word fragment “the”
patterns.context: The definite article appears in ordinary English sentences, often followed by a noun or adjective; activation is not limited to a specific syntactic structure.
patterns.domain: English prose, legal texts, technical documentation, and forum posts

patterns.name: Recurring word fragment “oper”
patterns.context: Occurs in the compound word operand, in a discussion comparing two source operands.

patterns.name: Recurring word fragment “vari”
patterns.context: Appears in the adjective various and in varietal, relating to patented plant varieties; activation falls inside the words.
patterns.domain: Latin placeholder text and plant-variety patent descriptions

patterns.name: Italian place-name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the proper noun San Luca, the Academy of Fine Arts in Rome.

patterns.name: Job-title fragment
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the Scottish local-office title Provost, in a passage about someone’s social relationships and reputation.

patterns.name: Fragment within a modal phrase
patterns.context: In a legal judgment sentence, forms the infinitive to be, followed by arrangements for serving a sentence.

patterns.name: Prepositions and articles
patterns.context: Common English function words in phrases such as strategic point of view, foot in the door, and bump in the road; no shared specialized semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Multiple word fragments in Latin placeholder text on a webpage
patterns.context: Triggers are scattered through a pseudo-Latin webpage placeholder passage, often inside or at the end of words; they cannot be summarized by a single identifiable word meaning.
patterns.domain: Latin placeholder text/HTML on a StackExchange page

patterns.name: Question word in a Q&A reply
patterns.context: In the phrase “answer your question”, question is marked more strongly than neighboring common words.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic triggers

patterns.context: 合同争议由仲裁解决，随后描述裁决及法院登记执行；激活集中在法律套语中的常见词。

patterns.name: 宗教诗文中面向对象的称呼
patterns.context: 呼唤 Kunti 之子，并谈及信徒、正义与永恒和平。

patterns.name: 医学术语及机构专名
patterns.trigger: « CD»、« Gastro»«enter»«ology»、« The»、« Mount»、« S»«inai»、« of»
patterns.context: 描述患者招募、IBD 登记及医院/医学院研究场景；激活落在疾病缩写、专科名和机构名片段。

patterns.name: 邮件中的家庭称谓及地址信息
patterns.context: 谈到母亲的卡片、疗养院、寄送及邮政编码。

patterns.name: 常见词片段或格式标记，触发原因不明
patterns.trigger: « Me»、« with»、« as»、« for»、« has»、« the»、« right»、« resolution»、« Less»、«Than»、«Or»、«Equal»、« body»、« values»、« http»、« Http»、«↵»
patterns.context: 激活分散在宗教散文、枚举运算符、Python 字典/HTTP 代码及邮件换行中；除各自局部语境外看不出共同条件。

en.concept: Diverse text fragments and function words
en.description: Activations are scattered across function words, logical structures, and domain terminology in formal text, and also occur within proper nouns, brands, code fields, and machine identifiers. These examples show no single stable lexical meaning or semantic theme.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in segmented or multipart identifiers
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments of split names, words, or machine identifiers; the fragments have no unified meaning and often form a complete string together with neighboring tokens.
patterns.domain: Proper nouns, software/network identifiers, German addresses, etc.

patterns.name: Function words and logical connectors in formal prose
patterns.context: Appears in coherent formal text such as definitions, legal decisions, or medical discussions, especially clause, judgment, and explanatory structures; activations are distributed across multiple common words rather than a single fixed term.

patterns.name: Field names in code parameter declarations
patterns.context: In Java method signatures, parameter names consist of semantically meaningful field words followed by type declarations or other parameters.

patterns.name: People or narrative words in Bible verses
patterns.context: In narrative sentences from Bible chapters, people, actions, and common function words all activate; there is insufficient evidence that the feature triggers on only one word class.

patterns.name: Person names followed by legal status terms
patterns.context: At the start of a legal decision, parties are introduced and their litigation status is stated; activations cover both name fragments and status terms.

patterns.name: Company or product name fragments in lists
patterns.context: Some brand-name fragments activate in lists of entrepreneurs or companies, where people and company/product names appear together.

patterns.name: Property conveyance terminology in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of deed validity and legal disputes over homestead transfers between spouses; argument connectors in the same passage also activate.

11_2793.concept: 多样文本片段与功能词
11_2793.description: 激活分散于正式文本中的功能词、逻辑结构和领域术语，也出现于专名、品牌、代码字段及机器标识符的内部片段；这些例子没有呈现单一稳定的词义或语义主题。

patterns.name: 分段或多部分标识符中的中间片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的名称、词或机器标识符片段上；片段本身不呈现统一词义，常与相邻 token 一起组成完整字符串。
patterns.domain: 专名、软件/网络标识符、德语地址等

patterns.name: 正式文体中的功能词与逻辑连接结构
patterns.trigger: «such» that any ...；«the» union ...；以及« as»、« in»、« and»、« was»等
patterns.context: 出现在定义、法律判决或医学论述等连贯正式文本中，尤其是从句、判断和说明结构；激活分布在多个普通词上，而非单个固定术语。
patterns.domain: 数学文本、法律文本、医学文本

patterns.name: 代码参数声明中的字段名
patterns.context: Java 方法签名中，参数名由语义性字段词构成，且后接类型声明或其他参数。

patterns.name: 圣经经文中的人物或叙事词
patterns.context: 圣经章节的叙事句中，人物、动作及常见功能词均有激活；没有足够证据确定仅对某一类词触发。

patterns.name: 人名及其后的法律身份称谓
patterns.context: 法律判决开头介绍当事人并说明其诉讼身份；激活同时覆盖人名片段和身份词。

patterns.name: 列表中的公司或产品名称片段
patterns.context: 人物与公司/产品名称并列的创业者或公司名单中，部分品牌名片段激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的房产转让术语
patterns.context: 讨论契据效力及夫妻之间宅地转让的法律争议时出现；同段的论证连接词也激活。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several text types, prominently including common function words, spaces, and punctuation, as well as enumeration separators, units and numbers, legal boilerplate, fixed phrases, and subword tokenization of proper nouns; no single semantic theme unites the passages.

patterns.name: Space before an enumeration symbol
patterns.context: Formatting whitespace between members of a C# [Flags] enum, especially line breaks separating members

patterns.name: Parentheses and statute format in legal citations
patterns.context: Court abbreviations, years, volume and page numbers, and reporter abbreviations appear together in case citations

patterns.name: Percentage and measurement-unit expressions
patterns.context: A percentage or experimental measurement unit follows a number, recurring among control values, changes, and time points

patterns.name: Monetary quotes and thousands separators
patterns.context: Salary or bid amounts use comma-separated thousands, with the amount tied to a minimum-guarantee condition

patterns.name: Function words in arbitration clauses
patterns.context: Standard clause wording on submitting contract disputes to arbitration, issuing an award, and enforcing it in court

patterns.name: Tokenization within a proper noun
patterns.context: A venue’s proper name is split into multiple subwords or punctuation fragments, embedded in background about the venue

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “flies in the face”
patterns.context: The fixed expression “flies in the face of” means to contradict a view or common sense; passage 7 discusses an author’s view, while passage 8 discusses whether insurance claims defy common sense

patterns.name: Biblical chapter and place names
patterns.context: Gospel chapter markers and a place near Jerusalem, followed by a narrative about Jesus and the Mount of Olives

patterns.name: Theology, monastery, and title terms
patterns.context: A biography mentions theological education, a monastery name, and the title of monastery abbot; proper nouns are split into subwords

11_2793.description: 激活分布于多类文本：突出常见功能词、空格与标点，且在枚举分隔、单位数字、法律套语、固定短语和专名子词切分处也有响应；各段无单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 枚举符号前的空格
patterns.trigger: « »2（空格）；接在逗号、换行或已有枚举项之后
patterns.context: C# [Flags] enum 中枚举成员之间的格式化空白，尤其是跨行的成员分隔处

patterns.name: 法律引文括号及法条格式
patterns.trigger: « (»3、«.»1、«2»9d 等括号、句点和引文中的数字片段
patterns.context: 判例引文中法院缩写、年份、卷页码与报告集缩写相邻

patterns.name: 百分比与测量单位表达
patterns.context: 数值后接百分比或实验测量单位，并在对照值、变化量与时间点之间反复出现

patterns.name: 金钱报价与千位分隔
patterns.context: 薪酬或报价金额以逗号分隔千位，金额与最低保障条件相连

patterns.name: 仲裁法律条款中的功能词
patterns.trigger: « be»、« by»、« in»、« the»、« award»、« rendered»、« arbitrator»、« entered»
patterns.context: 合同争议提交仲裁、裁决及法院执行的标准条款句式

patterns.name: 专名内部切分
patterns.context: 专有场馆名称被分成多个子词或标点片段，嵌在场馆背景叙述中

patterns.name: 固定短语“flies in the face”
patterns.context: 固定表达“flies in the face of”，表示与某观点或常理相悖；第7段谈作者观点，第8段谈保险理赔是否违背常理

patterns.name: 圣经经文的章节与地名
patterns.context: 福音书章节标记及耶路撒冷附近地名，随后叙述耶稣与橄榄山

patterns.name: 神学、修道院及职衔词
patterns.context: 人物生平中出现神学教育、修道院名称及修道院院长职衔，专名有子词切分

en.description: Activations are scattered across domains and styles: fragments within French words, medical units, German institutional addresses, legal citations and institutional phrases, historical proper nouns, and bibliographic titles. No stable single semantic or formatting pattern is evident; some cross-passage letter-sequence matches are weak.

patterns.name: Letter sequence “Cur” in English
patterns.context: Appears inside longer words or proper nouns; the marker in passage 1 actually falls on “oprote,” not directly on “Cur,” so its correspondence with passage 6 is weak.

patterns.name: French word endings and inflected forms
patterns.context: In continuous French text, activations fall on letters or word endings, such as “Pr«ésident»,” “demand«é»,” “conf«ir»mer,” and “car«act»éris«é».”

patterns.name: Numbers or adjacent punctuation in citations
patterns.context: In legal case citations, activations occur around the opening parenthesis before the year or near the citation format; the markers are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Population and institutional noun phrases
patterns.context: In legal discussion of electoral districts and state legislative redistricting, activations fall on phrases referring to institutions or population groups.

patterns.name: Medical measurement units and numerical expressions
patterns.context: In physiological experiment results, numbers, units, and descriptions of controls or changes occur together; activations often fall on units and measurement expressions.

patterns.name: Institution and street information in addresses
patterns.context: A German institutional address follows text about multichannel instruments; activations cluster on the institution name and personal-name components of the address.

patterns.name: Titles and proper nouns in bibliographic entries
patterns.context: In a bibliography of U.S. cultural history arranged by year, activations fall on fragments of titles, publishers, or proper nouns.

11_2793.description: 激活分散在不同领域与文体：法语词内片段、医学单位、德语机构地址、法律引文和制度短语、历史专名及书目书名。未见稳定的单一语义或格式模式；部分跨段字母串对应较弱。

patterns.name: 英文中的字母串“Cur”
patterns.context: 出现在较长词或专名内部；片段1的标记实际落在“oprote”部分，未直接标记“Cur”，因此与片段6的对应较弱。

patterns.name: 法语词尾及屈折形式
patterns.context: 法语连续文本中，激活集中在词内部的字母或词尾，如“Pr«ésident»”“demand«é»”“conf«ir»mer”“car«act»éris«é»”。

patterns.name: 引文中的数字或标点邻接结构
patterns.context: 法律判例引文中，年份前的左括号或引文格式附近出现激活；标记分布并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 人口与制度名词短语
patterns.context: 选举区划与州议会重划的法律论述中，激活落在指称机构或人口类别的短语上。
patterns.domain: 美国宪法与选举法律文本

patterns.name: 医学测量单位和数值表达
patterns.context: 生理实验结果中，数字、单位和对照/变化描述交错出现；激活多落在单位及测量表达。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、定量实验结果

patterns.name: 地址中的机构和街道信息
patterns.context: 多通道仪器相关文本后出现德语机构地址，激活集中在机构名及人名地址成分。
patterns.domain: 学术论文地址/机构署名

patterns.name: 书目条目中的书名与专名
patterns.context: 按年份排列的美国文化史书目中，激活落在书名、出版社或专名的片段上。

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and function words
en.description: Activations occur across multiple languages, proper nouns, and internal word fragments, and also cover legal citations and opinions; common articles and prepositions activate in multiple contexts. No stable unified semantic or stylistic trigger is evident across passages.

patterns.name: rom/rome in segmented words
patterns.context: Triggers subword fragments or word-initial/internal segments; appears in names of spectrometers, historical proper nouns, or institutions

patterns.name: Institut in institutional names
patterns.context: A segmented fragment in German institutions, departments, or university proper nouns

patterns.name: Number 8 in legal citations
patterns.context: In case citations, such as reporter abbreviations following volume and page information, e.g. So. 8d

patterns.name: French participles and high-frequency function words
patterns.context: In continuous French text, multiple words are segmented into activating subwords; activations cover function words and internal word fragments

patterns.name: Words and punctuation in Bible verses
patterns.context: Proper nouns, common words, and internal subwords in verse headings and narrative sentences

patterns.name: Proper nouns and word-initial fragments in bibliographies
patterns.context: Bibliographic entries made up of titles, authors, or publishers; several words activate in segmented form

patterns.name: Public health degrees and course names
patterns.context: Names of public health degrees, departments, and research programs, including terms such as Clinical Research Curriculum

patterns.name: Argument words and deed in legal opinions
patterns.context: Argumentation in legal opinions, case citations, or real-estate deed disputes; activations span common words, legal terminology, and word fragments

patterns.name: Prepositions and articles in ordinary text
patterns.context: These high-frequency function words occur in several texts with no clear shared theme; this alone is insufficient to explain the activations

11_2793.concept: 多语种词片段与功能词
11_2793.description: 激活分布于多语种、专名和词内片段，也覆盖法律引注及意见书；多个语境中常见冠词、介词同样激活。跨段未见稳定统一的语义或文体触发条件。

patterns.name: 分词中的 rom/rome
patterns.context: 触发子词片段或词首/词内分词；出现在光谱仪器名称、历史专名或机构名中

patterns.name: 机构名中的 Institut
patterns.context: 德语机构、院系或大学专名中的分词片段

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字 8
patterns.context: 判例引注中卷页信息后的报告集缩写，如 So. 8d

patterns.name: 法语分词与高频功能词
patterns.context: 法语连续文本中，多个词被切分成带激活的子词；激活覆盖功能词及词内片段

patterns.name: 圣经经文中的词语与标点
patterns.context: 经文标题及叙事语句中出现的专名、常见词和词内子词

patterns.name: 书目中的专名与词首片段
patterns.context: 书名、作者或出版社组成的书目条目；若干词被分词激活

patterns.name: 公共卫生学位与课程名
patterns.context: 公共卫生学位、院系及研究项目名称，包含 Clinical Research Curriculum 等词
patterns.domain: NIH 人员简介/学术履历

patterns.name: 法律意见中的论证词和 deed
patterns.context: 法律意见书的论证、判例引证或不动产契据争议；激活对象跨常见词、法律术语及词片段

patterns.name: 普通文本中的介词及冠词
patterns.context: 这些高频功能词在若干无明显共同主题的文本中出现；单独看不足以解释激活

en.description: Activations occur in legal decisions, scientific formulas and experiments, scripture, and historical or everyday prose; they often cover common words, proper nouns, numbers, units, and internal word fragments, with no single stable semantic or domain-specific pattern.

patterns.name: rom sequence within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on letter fragments inside words, appearing in scientific instrument names; the surrounding text also contains a segmented German institutional address.

patterns.name: Legal case and procedural language
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across legal arguments, case citations, litigation procedures, and tax disputes; they repeatedly cover articles, legal terms, and nearby common words.

patterns.name: Biomedical experimental methods and quantity units
patterns.context: Appears in an abstract on perfused rat heart experiments, involving experimental conditions, values, and units; activations cover terminology as well as numbers and measurement expressions.

patterns.name: Astrophysics formulas and variable definitions
patterns.context: Appears in formulas and the following textual definitions of the gravitational constant, neutron-star mass, and radius, covering mathematical symbols, variables, and explanatory text.

patterns.name: Common words and phrases in English narratives
patterns.context: In colloquial narratives, common articles, directional words, descriptive terms, and cross-word fragments activate; the text centers on metaphor and everyday scenes.

patterns.name: Bible chapters and verse narratives
patterns.context: Adjacent to a Bible chapter marker, followed by a narrative about Jesus traveling to a place near Jerusalem; place names, personal names, and common function words all activate.

patterns.name: Tax assessment and appeal narrative
patterns.context: Describes a taxpayer appealing additional taxes and a court setting aside the assessment; amounts, tax terminology, and legal disposition terms activate together.

patterns.name: Narrative of religious conversion and royal marriage
patterns.context: Historical narrative discusses missionary work in Canterbury, a Christian queen, and marriage leading a king and people to convert; activations cluster on religious and royal vocabulary, as well as articles.

11_2793.concept: 广泛而异质的文本片段
11_2793.description: 激活分布在法律判决、科学公式与实验、经文及历史或日常散文中；常覆盖普通词、专名、数字、单位和词内片段，未见单一稳定语义或领域。

patterns.name: 跨词内部的 rom 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的字母片段，出现在科学仪器名称中；周围还含有被分词标记的德语机构地址。

patterns.name: 法律判例与程序用语
patterns.trigger: « a»3« summary»1« judgment»1；« de»1« novo»1；« the»3« county»2«'s»1 occupational« tax»3；« state»2 constitutional grounds；« the»1 mere fact；« a»2 firearm；« the»6« circuit»3« court»4；« tax»3« assess»6«or»3
patterns.context: 激活分布于法律论证、判例引证、诉讼程序和税务争议语句；多次覆盖冠词、法律术语及其附近的普通词。

patterns.name: 生物医学实验方法与数量单位
patterns.trigger: « nitric»1« oxide»1 («NO»2«)»3；« perf»4«used»2« at»2« 9»2« ml»7«/»1«min»8« per»6« g»9；« 5»2« each»3
patterns.context: 出现在大鼠心脏灌流实验摘要中，涉及实验条件、数值和单位；激活既覆盖术语，也覆盖数字及测量表达。

patterns.name: 天体物理公式与变量说明
patterns.trigger: «GM»2«{»1R^3；« G»2« is»2« the»3« gravitational»4« constant»5；« NS»6« mass»9
patterns.context: 出现在公式及其后对引力常数、中子星质量和半径的文字定义中，覆盖数学符号、变量及说明文字。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论天体物理论文

patterns.name: 英文叙事中的普通词与短语
patterns.trigger: « the»4 long-«lost»1 trunk；« the»4« back»1 of« the»4« attic»1；« taken»1« ab»8«ack»1
patterns.context: 在口语化叙事中激活常见冠词、方位词、描述性词语以及跨词片段；文本以比喻和日常场景为主。

patterns.name: 圣经章节与经文叙述
patterns.context: 紧邻经文章节标记，随后为耶稣前往耶路撒冷附近地点的叙述；地名、人名和普通功能词均有激活。

patterns.name: 税务评估与上诉叙述
patterns.trigger: «100»3.« Tax»3«p»1«ayer»2 appealed；« additional»2« assessment»4；« was»5« ann»4«ulled»3« and»3« set»1« aside»4
patterns.context: 描述纳税人对追加税额提出上诉、法院撤销评估的过程；金额、税务术语及法律处置词同时激活。

patterns.name: 宗教传播与王室婚姻叙述
patterns.trigger: « pagan»1 Can«terbury»1；«to»2 minister；« Christian»2« queen»2；«conversion»1；« marriage»2；« the»8« queen»6«'s»7
patterns.context: 历史叙事谈及坎特伯雷的传教、基督教王后及婚姻促成国王和民众皈依；激活集中于宗教和王室词汇，也包括冠词。

en.concept: Heterogeneous word fragments and domain-term activations
en.description: Activations occur in French text (especially j’ai and various word-form fragments), scientific formulas and experimental quantities, English narrative words, and code identifiers; the fragments have no consistent morphological or semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: French first-person form
patterns.context: French sentences contain the first-person singular compound past j’ai; [4] contains the first-person plural avons, but not j’ai
patterns.domain: French conversation and European Parliament texts

patterns.name: Letter or morpheme fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments inside longer words; languages, word forms, and tokenization positions vary
patterns.domain: Paper addresses, English narrative, and religious prose

patterns.name: Physical quantities and scientific notation
patterns.context: In astrophysics, cosmic-ray formulas, or plant oxygen experiments, activations occur near formulas, units, and descriptions of physical quantities

patterns.name: English function words and words in fixed contexts
patterns.context: Ordinary English words activate in narrative, but semantics and collocations differ across passages, with no identifiable shared condition

patterns.name: Code identifier fragments
patterns.context: Identifiers and filenames in Go test configuration and import paths

patterns.name: Other French word-form activations
patterns.context: Several ordinary words and word-internal fragments activate in French teaching and grammar discussions; beyond the French-text condition, there is no specific shared trigger word

patterns.name: Lists and emotion words in political text
patterns.context: French parliamentary context involving a candidate list and a speaker expressing satisfaction

patterns.name: French account of an unfortunate event
patterns.context: Uses “Malheureusement” and the past conditional to express regret or an unwanted event

11_2793.concept: 异质词片段与领域词激活
11_2793.description: 激活分布于法语文本（尤见j’ai及多种词形片段）、科学公式与实验量、英语叙述词语，以及代码标识符；片段间没有一致的词形或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 法语第一人称形式
patterns.trigger: «j»3'«ai»10（[2]、[3]）；同时有« avons»、« nous»等法语词形
patterns.context: 法语句子中出现第一人称单数复合过去时 j’ai；[4]则出现第一人称复数 avons，但无 j’ai
patterns.domain: 法语对话与欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 词内字母或词素片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长单词内部的片段；不同语种、词形及切分位置不一
patterns.domain: 论文地址、英语叙述与宗教散文

patterns.name: 物理量和科学记号
patterns.context: 天体物理、宇宙射线公式或植物氧气实验中，邻近公式、单位及物理量描述

patterns.name: 英文虚词及固定语境中的词
patterns.context: 英语叙述中普通词语激活，但各段语义与搭配不同，无法确认统一条件

patterns.name: 代码标识符片段
patterns.context: Go 测试配置及导入路径中的标识符与文件名

patterns.name: 其他法语词形激活
patterns.context: 法语教学与语法讨论中，多个普通词和词内片段均有激活；除法语文本条件外看不出特定共同触发词

patterns.name: 政治文本中的名单与情绪词
patterns.context: 候选人名单及说话者表达满意的法语议会语境

patterns.name: 法语不幸事件叙述
patterns.context: 以“Malheureusement”及过去条件式表达遗憾或不希望发生的事件

en.concept: Ununified local word forms and symbol fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across languages, domains, and formats: the English definite article the is most common; French and German word fragments, code identifiers, formula symbols, gait-related words, and medical variable abbreviations also occur.

patterns.name: English definite article the
patterns.context: The definite article appears in English sentences or terms; it is distributed across ordinary narratives, Bible text, scientific papers, and legal texts, and some markers occur inside technical names or phrases.
patterns.domain: General English text and multiple specialized domains

patterns.name: French word-form fragments
patterns.context: Continuous French text in a parliamentary speech, with activations on word fragments split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Word fragments in German institutional names
patterns.context: University departments and street names in German addresses; activations are distributed across German words, proper nouns, and their subword fragments.

patterns.name: block.item in code
patterns.context: JavaScript regular-expression code defines or edits block.item; activations are adjacent to program identifiers and dot-notation member access.

patterns.name: Greek-letter symbol GM
patterns.context: A variable or symbol in a mathematical formula, followed by parentheses, a fraction, or an explanation of a physical quantity such as the gravitational constant.

patterns.name: head in a gait description
patterns.context: An exercise option describes how a person walks; head appears in the phrase “up, looking the world in the face.”
patterns.domain: Questionnaire or options text in Enron email

patterns.name: Combination of numbers and unit symbols
patterns.context: A physiology paper describes ventilatory threshold; carbon dioxide production, minute ventilation, and oxygen uptake appear as abbreviations and subscripts.

11_2793.concept: 无法统一的局部词形与符号片段
11_2793.description: 激活分散于多种语言、领域与格式：英语定冠词 the 最常见；另见法语和德语词片段、代码标识符、公式符号、步态词语及医学变量缩写。

patterns.name: 英文定冠词 the
patterns.context: 英语句子或术语中出现定冠词；分布于普通叙述、圣经文本、科学论文和法律文本等不同上下文，部分标记位于专业名词或短语内部。
patterns.domain: 英语通用文本及多个专业领域

patterns.name: 法语词形片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中的连续法语文本，激活落在被分词切开的词语片段上。

patterns.name: 德语机构名称中的词片段
patterns.context: 德语地址中的大学院系及街道名称，激活分布在德语词、专名及其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 代码中的 block.item
patterns.context: JavaScript 正则表达式代码定义或编辑 block.item；激活与程序标识符及点号成员访问相邻。

patterns.name: 希腊字母符号 GM
patterns.context: 数学公式中的变量或符号，后接括号、分数或引力常数等物理量说明。

patterns.name: 步态描述中的 head
patterns.context: 运动选项描述人的走路方式，head 与“up, looking the world in the face”构成短语。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的问卷或选项文本

patterns.name: 数字与单位符号组合
patterns.context: 生理学论文中描述通气阈值，二氧化碳产生、分钟通气量及氧摄取量以缩写和下标形式出现。

en.description: Activations are scattered across narratives, institutional names, legal text, and French material. More recognizable local cues include taken aback, word fragments beginning with Cur, and several words in legal clauses; the remaining activations lack a unified trigger explanation.

patterns.name: aback segmentation in a fixed expression
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed expression “taken aback,” usually meaning surprised; passages 1, 4, and 5 contain the expression, but passage 1 also has many definite-article activations.

patterns.name: Curia proper-name fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on word fragments beginning with Cur, but the meanings and contexts vary: an institution name, a street name, and the name of a historical religious institution.
patterns.domain: Institutional descriptions, academic addresses, historical texts

patterns.name: Scattered activations in administrative and legal clauses
patterns.context: Several highly activating word fragments occur in dense legal or contract language; their specific trigger positions and parts of speech differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Arbitration clauses, government procurement clauses, case law, and mortgage law

patterns.name: Dense French word-fragment activations
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across multiple word fragments in continuous French text, with no single repeated word or clear shared local trigger.

patterns.name: Sporadic proper-name fragments in unmarked contexts
patterns.context: Appear respectively in “Roman Curia” in a historical narrative and “Jobing.com,” a venue name; compared with other highly activating fragments, they are weaker and lack a shared semantic cue.

patterns.name: Definite articles and surrounding narrative in passage 1
patterns.context: Multiple instances of the are marked in a sentence about boxes in an attic and a wedding dress; “taken aback” also appears in the same passage, but other passages do not show the same definite-article pattern.

11_2793.concept: 分散的词片段与法律措辞激活
11_2793.description: 激活跨叙事、机构名、法律文本及法语材料分散出现。较可辨认的局部线索是 taken aback、Cur 起始词片段和法律条款中的若干词；其余激活缺少统一触发解释。

patterns.name: aback 分词构词
patterns.context: 出现在固定表达 “taken aback” 中，通常表示惊讶；第1、4、5段均有该表达，但第1段另有大量定冠词激活。

patterns.name: Curia 专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Cur 起始的词片段，但词义和语境各异：机构名称、街道名及历史宗教机构名称。
patterns.domain: 机构介绍、学术地址、历史文本

patterns.name: 行政与法律条款中的分散激活
patterns.context: 密集法律或合同措辞中出现若干高激活词片段；各段的具体触发位置和词类并不一致。
patterns.domain: 仲裁条款、政府采购条款、判例与抵押贷款法律

patterns.name: 法语词片段密集激活
patterns.context: 激活分散在法语连续文本的多个词片段中，未见单一重复词或明确共同局部触发。

patterns.name: 未标记上下文中的零散专名片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在历史叙述中的 “Roman Curia” 和场馆名称 “Jobing.com” 中；相对于其他高激活片段，强度较低且缺少共同语义线索。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、体育场馆报道

patterns.name: 第1段定冠词及周边叙事
patterns.context: 叙述阁楼箱子与婚纱的句子中，多个 the 被标记；与同段的 “taken aback” 同时出现，但其他段不显示相同的定冠词模式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across the English definite article, legal debt-default terms, poetic ocean imagery, medical units, religious salvation language, code list markers, award coverage, instrument names, and French word forms. No unified semantic or stylistic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: English function word the
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the definite article the in English sentences from legal discussion, religious prose, news, and other genres; its referents differ in each context.

patterns.name: Legal debt and default terms
patterns.context: Legal discussion of debt, mortgage relationships, and liability for default; activations fall on stems or suffix fragments in legal terminology.

patterns.name: Ocean and annual election metaphor
patterns.context: The poetic metaphor “bubbles on the sea of matter,” near a discussion of annual elections and enslavement.

patterns.name: Experimental measurement units and numbers
patterns.context: Flow, time, and mass units in a physiological experiment description; number and unit fragments activate.

patterns.name: Religious salvation vocabulary
patterns.context: Christian eschatological/salvation context describing believers being called and inheriting the kingdom of heaven.

patterns.name: List-item markers in code
patterns.context: Variable or pattern names for handling bulleted lists in regular-expression and code snippets.

patterns.name: Award announcement
patterns.context: Reports an anecdote about a Swedish journalist shouting “finally” at an award announcement; the Academy is mentioned nearby.

patterns.name: Crystal diffraction instrument name
patterns.context: The methods section on experimental data collection names a Bruker APEX II CCD area-detector diffractometer.

patterns.name: French honorific and verb forms
patterns.context: A French parliamentary speech addresses the chair and says “you spoke to us yesterday”; activations span tokenized fragments.

11_2793.description: 激活分散于英语定冠词、法律债务违约词、诗性海洋隐喻、医学单位、宗教救赎语、代码列表标记、奖项报道、仪器名及法语词形；没有统一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 英语虚词 the
patterns.context: 激活常落在定冠词 the，出现在法律论述、宗教散文、新闻等英语句子中；各处所指不同。

patterns.name: 法律债务与违约词
patterns.context: 关于债务、抵押关系及违约责任的法律论述；激活在法律术语的词干或后缀片段上。

patterns.name: 海洋与年度选举隐喻
patterns.context: “bubbles on the sea of matter”诗性比喻，附近讨论年度选举与奴役。
patterns.domain: 历史／政治散文，带诗性修辞

patterns.name: 实验测量单位与数字
patterns.context: 生理学实验描述中的流量、时间和质量单位；数字与单位片段激活。

patterns.name: 宗教救赎词汇
patterns.trigger: « right»« hand»、« His»、« Come»、« blessed»、« inherit»、« kingdom»
patterns.context: 基督教末世／救赎语境，描述信徒受召并承受天国。

patterns.name: 代码中的列表项标记
patterns.context: 正则表达式与代码片段中处理项目符号列表的变量或模式名称。

patterns.name: 奖项颁奖公告
patterns.context: 报道瑞典记者在奖项公告现场喊“finally”的轶事；该词附近提到学院。

patterns.name: 晶体衍射仪器名
patterns.context: 实验数据采集方法部分，出现 Bruker APEX II CCD 面探测器衍射仪名称。

patterns.name: 法语敬语与动词词形
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中对主席的称呼及“您昨天向我们讲话”的句子；激活跨越分词片段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical terminology and units, French parliamentary expressions and names, code identifiers, legal tender and debt wording, and religious phrases; some English derived words also show word-internal tokenization. No unified semantic trigger appears across passages.

patterns.name: Participial or nominalized forms after prepositions/articles
patterns.context: Stems and suffixes are tokenized separately, as are derived nouns or inflected forms; common in ordinary English prose.
patterns.domain: Legal, literary, and public procurement texts

patterns.name: NO and cardiac perfusion experiment terminology
patterns.context: Medical abstracts describe nitric oxide, cardiac perfusion, or flow rate per unit of tissue weight.

patterns.name: Renal physiology and unit expressions
patterns.context: Kidney experiments include renal tubules, renal blood flow, and flow units normalized by kidney weight.

patterns.name: Subword tokenization of crystallography instrument models
patterns.context: Manufacturer, instrument model, and detector names in crystallographic data-collection sections; activation falls on model subwords.

patterns.name: French first-person conditional
patterns.context: French parliamentary speeches contain polite expressions, judgments, or conditional verbs; activation spans tokenized word-internal fragments.

patterns.name: French political figures’ names and candidate terms
patterns.context: Names and words related to “candidate/formal candidacy” appear in political parliamentary contexts and are split into subwords.

patterns.name: Structural markers and identifier subwords in code
patterns.context: Code or regular expressions contain object fields, function calls, class names, and constant identifiers; activations occur across code fragments.

patterns.name: Directional metaphor in religious text
patterns.context: Religious literature depicts the saved coming to the right side of the divine throne; activation centers on a fixed directional phrase.

patterns.name: Legal debt obligations and litigation wording
