patterns.context: Legal discussion covers debt allocation, breach liability, and attorney fees; this occurs alongside tokenization patterns, but there are also independent legal-semantic activations within the passage.

patterns.name: Bidders in legal procurement
patterns.context: Regulations require public opening of bids and awarding contracts to qualified bidders; besides word-internal tokenization, the context is also about procurement.

11_2793.description: 激活分散于医学术语和单位、法语议会表达与人名、代码标识符、法律招标及债务措辞、宗教短语；部分英语派生词也有词内切分激活。各段没有统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 介词/冠词后的分词或名词化词形
patterns.context: 词干与后缀分词、派生名词或屈折形式被分开编码；常见于句中普通英语文本。
patterns.domain: 法律、文学及公共采购文本

patterns.name: NO与心脏灌流实验术语
patterns.context: 医学实验摘要描述一氧化氮、心脏灌流或按组织重量计的流速。

patterns.name: 肾脏生理与单位表达
patterns.context: 肾脏实验中出现肾小管、肾血流及按肾重量归一化的流量单位。

patterns.name: 晶体学仪器型号的子词切分
patterns.context: 晶体学数据采集章节中的厂商、仪器型号和探测器名称；激活落在型号子词上。

patterns.name: 法语第一人称条件式
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中出现礼貌表达、观点判断或条件式动词；激活覆盖被切分的词内片段。

patterns.name: 法语政治人物姓名与候选词
patterns.context: 政治议会语境中出现人物姓名及“候选人／正式候选”相关词汇，且词被拆为子词。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构标记与标识符子词
patterns.context: 代码或正则表达式中出现对象字段、函数调用、类名和常量标识符；激活分布于代码词片段。

patterns.name: 宗教文本中的方位隐喻短语
patterns.context: 宗教文学中描写得救者来到神圣王座右侧的意象；激活集中于固定方位短语。

patterns.name: 法律债务义务与诉讼措辞
patterns.trigger: « the»« debt»« is»« owed»；« underlying»« obligation»；« attorney»« fees»
patterns.context: 法律论述讨论债务归属、违约责任及律师费；与分词模式同时出现，但段内还有独立法律语义触发。

patterns.name: 法律采购中的投标人
patterns.context: 法规规定公开开标及向合格投标人授标；除词内切分外，也处在招标语义环境。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal liability, experimental units, institutional proper nouns, code list parsing, project management, French parliamentary and policy statements, Git configuration, and religious imagery; no stable shared trigger pattern covers these uses.

patterns.name: Defaulting party and debt relationships
patterns.context: Legal text describes allocation of liability after default and relationships between debtors and creditors; a split within “defaulting” also activates strongly.

patterns.name: Measurement units and experimental conditions
patterns.context: Describes experimental parameters in an isolated rat heart perfusion experiment.

patterns.name: Institutional names and proper-name fragments in addresses
patterns.context: Proper nouns occur in academic institutional addresses or affiliations; activations cluster on fragments within names.

patterns.name: Block-item parsing in code
patterns.context: Code defines a list-item matching rule and calls an editing function to process block items.

patterns.name: Project organization and management roles
patterns.context: Introduces a project's cross-departmental leadership structure, committees, and management roles.

patterns.name: Polite address and conditional expressions in French parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech opens with a formal address and expresses judgment and a cautious, conditional commitment.

patterns.name: Transition arrangements in French policy text
patterns.context: Describes a two-year transition period and adaptation arrangements for mercury-containing products and small businesses.

patterns.name: Git remote configuration path and address
patterns.context: Explains the remote origin address setting in a configuration file and the difference between an IP address and a domain name.

patterns.name: Eschatological reward imagery in religious literature
patterns.context: Depicts believers ultimately reaching the right side of the throne and receiving divine acceptance.

11_2793.description: 激活分散于法律责任、实验单位、机构专名、代码列表解析、项目管理、法语议会与政策语句、Git 配置及宗教意象；没有覆盖这些用法的稳定共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 默认责任方及债务关系
patterns.trigger: “the defaulting party”；“the mortgagee as the debtor”
patterns.context: 法律文本中说明违约后责任归属、债务人或债权人之间的关系；“defaulting”内部拆分也有强激活。

patterns.name: 计量单位与实验条件
patterns.context: 描述离体大鼠心脏灌流实验，数值与单位构成实验参数。

patterns.name: 机构名称、地址中的专名片段
patterns.context: 学术机构地址或署名中出现专名；激活集中在名称的词内片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的块项目解析
patterns.context: 代码定义列表项匹配规则，并调用编辑函数处理块项目。

patterns.name: 项目组织与管理职务
patterns.context: 介绍项目的跨部门领导结构、委员会与管理职务。

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的礼貌称呼与条件表达
patterns.trigger: “Monsieur Evans”“j’estime”“je ne pourrais que vous donner une assurance”
patterns.context: 议会发言以正式称呼开头，表达判断及谨慎、条件式承诺。

patterns.name: 法语政策文本中的转型安排
patterns.trigger: “baromètres contenant du mercure”“période de transition de deux ans”“permettra”
patterns.context: 针对含汞产品及小型企业，说明两年过渡期和适应安排。

patterns.name: Git 远程配置路径与地址
patterns.context: 解释配置文件中远程 origin 的地址设置及 IP 与域名的区别。

patterns.name: 宗教文学中的末世奖赏意象
patterns.context: 描写信徒最终到达宝座右侧、获得神圣接纳的宗教意象。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual and domain-diverse texts, favoring tokenized word-internal fragments, proper nouns, and technical/legal terms; French verb endings, experimental-unit formatting, and isolated typographic symbols also appear. No single semantic theme unites the passages.

patterns.name: Cur morpheme
patterns.context: English morphemes beginning with Cur; appear in Cur-riculum (curriculum split across tokens) and Marie-Curie

patterns.name: defaulting
patterns.context: In a legal context, default in defaulting party is marked by tokenization, with default as the strongest activation

patterns.name: French conditional verb ending
patterns.context: French verb voud-rais (voudrais); activation concentrates at the tokenized stem and conditional ending

patterns.name: French future-tense ending
patterns.context: French verb permett-ra (permettra); activation falls on the end of the verb stem and the future-tense ending

patterns.name: Numerical unit format
patterns.context: Experimental measurements expressed with units, slashes, and time or mass denominators

patterns.name: Instrument morphemes in technical terms
patterns.context: Names of spectrometers or diffractometers; activation falls on an internal morpheme of the instrument word

patterns.name: Uppercase abbreviations within technical names
patterns.context: All-uppercase abbreviations for instruments or experimental techniques are split by character or into short fragments; here, specifically, STOE IPDS-II

patterns.name: French specialist vocabulary fragments
patterns.context: French words for mercury (mercure) and manufacturing (fabriqués) are tokenized, with activation on internal fragments

patterns.name: Menu-like identifier fragments
patterns.context: Class names, component names, and identifiers in programming discussions; internal word fragments are marked

patterns.name: Mortgage-law terminology fragments
patterns.context: Legal terms such as mortgagee, mortgagor, and debtor; activation falls on an internal fragment of mortgage

patterns.name: Renal physiology terminology fragments
patterns.context: Word-internal or adjacent fragments in physiological terms such as proximal tubule, loop of Henle, and kidney

patterns.name: Units and time in cardiac experiment protocols
patterns.context: Number of groups, flow rates, and duration in an isolated-heart perfusion experiment

patterns.name: Research organization titles and committee fragments
patterns.context: Words about curriculum committees, executive roles, and admissions in a project-management introduction

patterns.name: Tokenization of mortgage-law compounds
patterns.context: A specific case passage describing the relationship between a mortgagee and debtor; activation falls on an article and the mortgagee stem

patterns.name: Negative superscript sign
patterns.context: Superscript minus signs and adjacent symbols in a crystallographic parameter table; independent of following text

11_2793.description: 激活散布于多语种和多领域文本，偏向被切分的词内片段、专名与技术/法律术语；也见法语动词词尾、实验单位格式及个别排版符号。各段缺乏单一语义主题。

patterns.name: Cur 词素
patterns.context: Cur 开头的英文词素；分别出现在 Cur-riculum（跨 token 的 curriculum）和 Marie-Curie
patterns.domain: 科研机构介绍、学术地址

patterns.name: defaulting
patterns.context: 法律语境中 defaulting party 的 default 被拆分标记，default 是最强激活部分

patterns.name: 法语条件式动词词尾
patterns.context: 法语动词 voud-rais（voudrais），激活集中在词干与条件式词尾的分词处

patterns.name: 法语将来时词尾
patterns.context: 法语动词 permett-ra（permettra），激活落在动词词干末尾及将来时词尾

patterns.name: 数值单位格式
patterns.context: 实验测量中单位、斜线、时间或质量分母组成的数值表达

patterns.name: 技术术语中的测量设备词素
patterns.context: 描述光谱仪或衍射仪的设备名称，激活在仪器词的中间词素

patterns.name: 技术名称内部的大写缩写
patterns.context: 仪器或实验技术的全大写缩写，按字符或短片段拆分；此处具体为 STOE IPDS-II

patterns.name: 法语专业词汇片段
patterns.context: 法语中 mercury（mercure）及制造（fabriqués）等词被分词，激活在词内片段

patterns.name: 菜单类标识符片段
patterns.context: 编程讨论中的类名、组件名和标识符，内部词片段被标记

patterns.name: 法律债务与抵押术语片段
patterns.context: 抵押权人、抵押人及债务人等法律词汇；激活落在 mortgage 的内部片段

patterns.name: 肾脏生理术语片段
patterns.context: 近端小管、Henle 袢、肾脏等生理学术语的词内或相邻片段

patterns.name: 心脏实验流程中的单位与时间
patterns.context: 离体心脏灌流实验的组数、流速及持续时间表达

patterns.name: 科研组织职务与委员会词片段
patterns.context: 项目管理介绍中的课程委员会、执行职务与招生相关词语

patterns.name: 抵押法律复合词切分
patterns.context: 特定判例句中 mortgagee 与 debtor 的关系陈述，激活落在冠词及 mortgagee 词干

patterns.name: 负数上标符号
patterns.context: 晶体学参数表中的负号上标及紧邻符号；独立于后续文字

en.description: Activations occur across multiple text types, commonly at line breaks and indentation, and also in name entries, dates, nematode biomedical contexts, and code identifiers. Sports article fragments also activate; no single stable theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Line breaks and tab indentation
patterns.context: Activations occur at line breaks, tabs, and indentation spaces in code or structured text, often alongside activations in neighboring text.
patterns.domain: GitHub code, paper structure, and entry text

patterns.name: Names and person entries
patterns.context: Names appear near author credits, person disambiguation lists, or name strings in code.
patterns.domain: Papers, Wikipedia entries, GitHub data, or code

patterns.name: Biomedicine and parasitic nematodes
patterns.context: Discussions of nematodes, parasites, and related genomes or health effects; taxonomic names also occur.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH project text

patterns.name: Identifiers, constants, and tests in code
patterns.context: Activations occur near identifiers and control syntax in code structures, field names, hexadecimal constants, C++ expressions, or shell script statements.

patterns.name: Headlines, bylines, and sports reporting
patterns.context: News text consisting of article headlines, author credits, and professional descriptions.

patterns.name: Dates and year numbers
patterns.context: Numbers appearing as years or birth and death years next to names or person entries.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic records and biographical encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: General punctuation and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in code and ordinary text, with no consistent local semantic condition across samples.

11_2805.concept: 结构化文本中的局部片段
11_2805.description: 激活分布在多类文本，常见于换行和缩进，也涉及姓名条目、日期、线虫生物医学语境及代码标识符；体育文章片段亦有激活，未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 换行与制表缩进
patterns.context: 代码或结构化文本中，换行、制表符及缩进空格处有激活；常与邻近文本中的激活同时出现。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码、论文结构及条目文本

patterns.name: 姓名与人名条目
patterns.context: 人名出现在作者署名、人物消歧列表或代码中的姓名字符串附近。
patterns.domain: 论文、Wikipedia 条目、GitHub 数据或代码

patterns.name: 生物医学与寄生线虫
patterns.context: 线虫、寄生虫及相关基因组或健康影响的讨论；另有分类学名称。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符、常量与测试
patterns.context: 代码结构、字段名、十六进制常量、C++ 表达式或 shell 脚本语句中，标识符及控制语法附近激活。

patterns.name: 标题、署名与体育报道
patterns.context: 文章标题、作者署名及职业描述构成的新闻文本。

patterns.name: 日期与年份数字
patterns.context: 姓名或人物条目旁以年份、出生及逝世年份形式出现的数字。
patterns.domain: 书目记录与人物百科条目

patterns.name: 泛化的标点与短语片段
patterns.context: 在代码及普通文本中零散出现，未见跨样本一致的局部语义条件。

en.concept: Multiple types of proper nouns and structured text
en.description: Activations occur across diverse texts: personal names and indexes, biomedical texts about nematodes, C/C++ code identifiers and tests, Shell startup scripts, and sports article headlines, bylines, and author biographies; no single trigger pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: Specific personal-name forms
patterns.context: Personal names appear in indexes, entries, or citation lists; they may also be accompanied by years, occupations, or source information.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia articles, references, or personal-name indexes

patterns.name: “nematode” in noun compounds
patterns.context: The word nematode appears in biological descriptions, including genome studies, parasites, and their harms; paragraph 3 also contains a split-token “nematode”.
patterns.domain: Microbiology or parasitology papers and abstracts

patterns.name: Identifiers and syntax in C/C++ code
patterns.context: Code blocks contain uppercase macros, namespaces, function calls, template parameters, or assertions; activations occur around identifiers and code structures.
patterns.domain: C/C++ source code and tests on Github

patterns.name: Shell service-control scripts
patterns.context: The script branches on command-line arguments and provides an operation to start a daemon.

patterns.name: Sports author bios and news bylines
patterns.context: First-person professional experience and sports-media employment information appear after an article headline and author byline.

11_2805.concept: 多类专名与结构化文本
11_2805.description: 激活分布于多种文本中：人物姓名及索引、涉及线虫的生物医学文本、C/C++代码标识符和测试、Shell启动脚本，以及体育文章的标题署名与作者简介；没有一个触发模式能解释全部样例。

patterns.name: 特定人名词形
patterns.trigger: “Frank Klemm”“Mary Booth”“Buck Rinehart”“Cowboy Slim Rinehart”“Frank Rinehart”
patterns.context: 人物姓名出现在索引、条目或引用列表中；也可能伴随年份、职业或出处信息。
patterns.domain: 维基百科条目、参考文献或人物索引

patterns.name: 名词性复合词中的 nematode
patterns.context: 线虫一词出现在生物学描述中，包括基因组研究、寄生虫及其危害；第3段同时出现被拆分标记的“nematode”。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、寄生虫学论文或摘要

patterns.name: C/C++代码中的标识符与语法
patterns.context: 代码块中出现大写宏、命名空间、函数调用、模板参数或断言；激活分布在标识符及代码结构周围。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C/C++ 源码和测试代码

patterns.name: Shell服务控制脚本
patterns.context: 脚本按命令行参数分支，提供守护进程的启动操作。

patterns.name: 体育作者简介与新闻署名
patterns.trigger: “Another Crossroads, Same Optimism”“Guest Writer Travis Haney”
patterns.context: 文章标题及作者署名之后出现第一人称职业经历和体育媒体任职信息。

en.description: Activations span punctuation and syntax in C++ source code, register-constant definitions, encyclopedia disambiguation lists, headlines containing Nutrition, and nematodes, genes, and developmental terms in biomedical texts; the patterns cross domains, with no single clear trigger feature.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntactic structures in C++ code
patterns.context: C++ code, especially indented statements, function calls, template parameters, and tests; activations are distributed across code punctuation, identifiers, and line boundaries.

patterns.name: Hardware register or configuration constant definitions
patterns.context: An uppercase macro name is followed by an aligned equals sign and hexadecimal constant, forming a sequence of fields or register definitions.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia disambiguation-entry format
patterns.context: A heading or entry introduces a list of people with the same name; each item begins with a name and dates, and includes nationality, occupation, etc.

patterns.name: Nutrition-themed titles or headline fragments
patterns.context: The word appears in nutrition titles; it may be listed alongside terms such as education, rehabilitation, or morphology.
patterns.domain: Popular science or biomedical text headlines

patterns.name: Descriptions related to parasitic nematodes
patterns.context: Describes human or veterinary health problems caused by parasitic nematodes.

patterns.name: Developmental biology and gene-research terminology
patterns.context: Discusses developmental biology, gene research, cell fate, or pattern formation.

11_2805.description: 激活覆盖C++源码的标点与语法、寄存器常量定义、百科人物消歧列表，以及含Nutrition的标题和生物医学文本中的线虫、基因与发育术语；模式跨领域，未见单一明确触发特征。

patterns.name: C++ 代码中的标点与语法结构
patterns.context: C++ 代码中，尤其是带缩进的语句、函数调用、模板参数和测试代码；激活分散在代码标点、标识符及行边界。

patterns.name: 硬件寄存器或配置常量定义
patterns.context: 大写宏名后跟对齐的等号与十六进制常量，呈连续字段或寄存器定义。

patterns.name: 百科消歧条目格式
patterns.trigger: `may refer to:`、`refer to:`，随后是人名、括号内生卒年份及身份描述
patterns.context: 标题或词条引出同名人物列表，每项以姓名和年代开头，并标注国籍、职业等。

patterns.name: 营养主题标题或标题片段
patterns.context: 营养学标题中出现该词；可与教育、康复或形态学等词并列。
patterns.domain: 科普或生物医学文本标题

patterns.name: 寄生线虫相关表述
patterns.context: 描述寄生线虫造成的人类或兽医健康问题。

patterns.name: 发育生物学与基因研究术语
patterns.context: 讨论发育生物学、基因研究、细胞命运或模式形成。

en.description: Activations are distributed across varied text: they often fall on subword fragments of words or proper names, and also occur at sentence-initial “These,” medical terms, all-caps strings, punctuation, line breaks, and byline formatting. No stable semantic feature spans all examples.

patterns.name: Word-initial or subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on the beginnings or internal subword fragments of words, proper names, or long words; no stable semantic relation is apparent across word forms.

patterns.name: Name fragments in proper nouns and titles
patterns.context: Person names, place names, species names, or title-like names are split into multiple tokens; activations are distributed across different parts of the names without indicating a unified category.

patterns.name: Common sentence-initial words and academic prose
patterns.context: “These” appears at the start of a paragraph or sentence, followed by research, experiments, or general statements. Activations peak on “These,” with weaker activations on following words.

patterns.name: Medical nutrition terms
patterns.context: Long technical words are split in medical titles about malnutrition, prenatal and postnatal nutrition, and rehabilitation; strong activations center on “Nutrition” fragments.

patterns.name: Uppercase strings and abbreviations
patterns.context: Abbreviations or labels consisting of consecutive uppercase letters are split into multiple short tokens.

patterns.name: Punctuation, bylines, and numeric formats
patterns.context: Code or document fragments contain semicolons, line breaks, parentheses, bylines, and comma-separated numbers; activations cover punctuation and name characters.

patterns.name: Title and byline formatting
patterns.context: A title is followed by a line break and an author byline; activations involve title words and byline formatting.

patterns.name: Short sentences and line breaks in email
patterns.context: A brief declarative sentence is followed by a period and multiple blank lines, then new content; activations fall on the sentence opening, predicate, period, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Publication title formatting
patterns.context: A publication title is followed by a blank line, then repeated and followed by a colon and introductory title text.

patterns.name: All-caps phrases in email
patterns.context: An all-caps phrase split into letter fragments appears in email; its actual meaning is unclear, and it cannot be linked to other patterns.

11_2805.description: 激活分散于多种文本：常落在词语或专名的子词片段，也见于“These”句首、医学术语、全大写串，以及标点、换行和署名格式；没有贯穿全部例子的稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: 词首或子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词语、专名或长词的开头及内部子词片段；不同词形之间看不出稳定的语义关联。

patterns.name: 专名与标题中的名称片段
patterns.context: 人名、地名、物种名或标题式名称被拆分成多个 token；激活分散在名称的不同部分，未体现统一类别。

patterns.name: 句首常见词与学术表述
patterns.context: 段落或句子开头出现“These”，后接研究、实验或一般陈述；最高激活集中于“These”，后续词也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 医学营养术语
patterns.context: 营养不良、产前产后营养及康复等医学标题中，较长专业词被拆分；强激活集中于“Nutrition”片段。

patterns.name: 大写字母串与缩写
patterns.context: 连续的大写字母组成的缩写或标签，被拆成多个短 token。

patterns.name: 标点、署名及数字格式
patterns.context: 代码或文档片段含分号、换行、括号、署名及逗号分隔数字；激活覆盖标点和姓名字符。

patterns.name: 标题与署名格式
patterns.context: 标题后换行并出现作者署名；激活涉及标题中的词及署名格式。

patterns.name: 邮件中的短句与换行
patterns.context: 简短陈述句后接句号和多重空行，随后出现新内容；激活落在句首、谓语、句号及换行。

patterns.name: 文献刊名格式
patterns.context: 刊名后有空行，并重复刊名再接冒号和介绍性标题文字。

patterns.name: 邮件中的全大写短语
patterns.context: 邮件中出现被拆成字母片段的全大写短语；其实际词义不明，无法与其他模式建立联系。

en.description: Activations occur at the beginnings or headline positions of diverse texts: sentence-initial “These,” encyclopedia titles, code formatting, legal citations, and HN headlines; the commonality is weak, and no single meaning or domain covers them all.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial These
patterns.context: A paragraph or sentence begins with “These,” followed by a description of research, experiments, or a state

patterns.name: Year and title in an event name
patterns.context: A year is followed by the name of a European athletics event, and the title continues with events or divisions

patterns.name: Spanish place-name opening
patterns.context: A Spanish word in a place or institution name is followed by a location name

patterns.name: Formatted citations in code
patterns.context: Line breaks, indentation, and parentheses form code or citation formatting

patterns.name: Legal case citations
patterns.context: A volume number, case reporter abbreviation, page number, and year appear after a line break

patterns.name: Person's name in an HN post headline
patterns.context: After a line break, a headline or a person/startup-related title begins

patterns.name: Engineer and benefit description in an HN headline
patterns.context: Begins with “How one,” describing how a Silicon Valley engineer benefits from some form of tacit approval

11_2805.description: 激活分布于多种文本的开头或标题位置：句首“These”、百科标题、代码格式、法律引文及HN标题；共同点较弱，未见单一词义或领域能覆盖全部。

patterns.name: 句首 These
patterns.context: 段落或句子以“These”起始，后接研究、实验或状态描述
patterns.domain: 科研摘要及邮件/日常文本

patterns.name: 赛事名称中的年份与标题
patterns.context: 年份后接欧洲田径赛事名，标题继续列出项目或组别

patterns.name: 西班牙语地名开头
patterns.context: 地名或机构名称中的西班牙语词，后接地点名

patterns.name: 代码中的格式化引文
patterns.context: 换行、缩进及括号构成的代码或引用格式

patterns.name: 法律判例引文
patterns.context: 换行后出现卷号、判例报告缩写、页码和年份

patterns.name: HN 帖子标题中的人物名
patterns.trigger: «Ask HN: Women in Silicon Valley - ayli yazem»；«Chris Wanstrath's Startup Riot»
patterns.context: 换行后以标题或人物/创业相关标题开头

patterns.name: HN 标题中的工程师与利益描述
patterns.trigger: «How one SV engineer benefitted from the tacit acceptance»
patterns.context: 以“How one”开头，描述硅谷工程师从某种默许中获益

en.description: Mainly occurs in mathematical problem text, responding to fragments such as minus signs, decimal points, commas, line breaks, and formula variables, often between prompts, algebraic expressions, and numerical answers. Also occurs in ordering problems, prime factorization problems, and a few legal titles and Python configuration code.

patterns.name: Boundary/symbol tokens in math tasks
patterns.context: Minus signs, decimal points, commas, and line breaks occur near numbers or problem fragments; many are also adjacent to variables, expressions, or prompts.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics problem and answer text

patterns.name: Formula and variable fragments in mathematical text
patterns.context: Numbers, variables, and operators are interspersed around algebraic expressions, function definitions, or equations.

patterns.name: Math problem questions
patterns.context: Instructions or introductory conditions in math problem statements, often followed by variables, expressions, or numerical answers.

patterns.name: Ordering and comparison question options
patterns.context: Prompts ask to compare or order several values, followed by candidate options or an answer.

patterns.name: Prime factorization problems
patterns.context: Prompts ask for the prime factors of the number represented by a variable.

patterns.name: Court title text
patterns.context: Uppercase, centered legal document titles or headers.

patterns.name: Python imports and test code
patterns.context: Import statements and process-object initialization in Python configuration code.

11_2805.description: 主要出现在数学题语料中，对负号、小数点、逗号、换行及公式变量等碎片有响应，常处于题干、代数式和数值答案之间；另见排序题、质因数题，以及少量法律标题和 Python 配置代码。

patterns.name: 数学任务中的边界/符号 token
patterns.context: 负号、小数点、逗号及换行符位于数字或题目片段附近；多处还紧接变量、运算式或题干。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 题目与答案文本

patterns.name: 数学文本中的公式与变量片段
patterns.context: 代数式、函数定义或方程周围，常见数字、变量、运算符混排。

patterns.name: 数学题目问句
patterns.context: 数学题干中的指令或引入条件；常接变量、表达式或数值答案。

patterns.name: 排序比较题选项
patterns.trigger: «Which is the second biggest value?»、«the third smallest value»
patterns.context: 要求比较或排序若干数值，题干后列出候选项或答案。

patterns.name: 质因数题
patterns.context: 要求列出某个变量所代表数的质因数。

patterns.name: 法院标题文字
patterns.context: 大写、居中排版的法律文书标题或页眉。

patterns.name: Python 导入与测试代码
patterns.context: Python 配置代码的导入语句及进程对象初始化。

en.description: Mainly responds to HTML angle-bracket tag syntax, especially div tags; also responds to div used as a substring in identifiers or method names in code. Weaker, sporadic patterns include email quote symbols and JSON serialization configuration.

patterns.name: HTML div element tags
patterns.context: HTML code contains div opening or closing tags, often in page structure, layout, or element selectors; this activates in multiple webpage code or HTML discussion fragments.
patterns.domain: Web frontend code and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Other HTML tags
patterns.context: HTML markup contains tag-opening or closing syntax, especially tag names enclosed in angle brackets; no specific page content is required.
patterns.domain: Web code and text containing HTML

patterns.name: div substring in code
patterns.context: Outside HTML tag contexts, the string div appears in method names, identifiers, or Python/Java code expressions.
patterns.domain: Programming code and mathematical software implementations

patterns.name: HTML quote or email quotation prefix
patterns.context: Email bodies use multiple greater-than signs at the start of lines to quote earlier messages; activations also occur in the following quoted text and nearby indentation.

patterns.name: JSON serialization configuration
patterns.context: C#-style code constructs a JSON serializer and configures converters; activations occur near nested object/brace structures.

11_2805.description: 主要响应 HTML 的尖括号标签语法，尤其是 div 标签；也响应代码中作为标识符或方法名子串的 div。另有邮件引用符号及 JSON 序列化配置等较弱、较零散模式。

patterns.name: HTML div 元素标记
patterns.context: HTML 代码中出现 div 开始或结束标签，常处于页面结构、布局或元素选择器中；在多个网页代码或讨论 HTML 的片段里触发。
patterns.domain: 网页前端代码与技术问答

patterns.name: HTML 其他标签
patterns.context: HTML 标记语言中出现标签起始或闭合语法，尤其是尖括号包围的标签名；不要求特定页面内容。
patterns.domain: 网页代码及含 HTML 的文本

patterns.name: 代码中的 div 子串
patterns.context: 非 HTML 标签语境中，字符串 div 出现在方法名、标识符或 Python/Java 等代码表达式里。
patterns.domain: 编程代码与数学软件实现

patterns.name: HTML 引用或邮件引文前缀
patterns.context: 邮件正文按行使用多个大于号引用旧邮件内容；激活也落在后续引文文字及其缩进附近。

patterns.name: JSON 序列化配置
patterns.context: C# 风格代码中构造 JSON 序列化器并配置转换器；激活在嵌套对象/大括号结构附近。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on webpage code tags, closing tags, and structural elements, and also occur in XML/XAML tags, Java declarations and method code, as well as a legal document title and statutory citation. Overall, the pattern favors code or document markup in structured text.

patterns.name: HTML table tags
patterns.context: HTML table structures, especially tag names and their closing forms; often accompanied by indentation and line breaks.

patterns.name: HTML container and navigation tags
patterns.context: Paired tags, attributes, and navigation elements in webpage structures or component templates.

patterns.name: XML/XAML components and attributes
patterns.context: Nested XML-style controls or layout descriptions; tag names and attribute values can both activate.

patterns.name: Java methods and type declarations
patterns.context: Declarations, generic types, method calls, and string arguments in Java code; this fragment also includes a mapping configuration call.

patterns.name: Legal document titles and statutory citations
patterns.context: Titles and abstract headings of legal documents, and statutory numbering; surrounding text includes dates, authors, and formal legal language.

11_2805.concept: 结构化文本标记与代码
11_2805.description: 激活主要落在网页代码的标签、闭合标签及结构元素，也出现在XML/XAML标签、Java声明和方法代码；另有一段法律文书标题与法条引用。整体偏向结构化文本中的代码或文档标记。

patterns.name: HTML 表格标签
patterns.context: HTML 表格结构中，尤其是标签名及其闭合形式；常伴随缩进和换行。

patterns.name: HTML 容器与导航标签
patterns.context: 网页结构或组件模板中的成对标签、属性和导航元素。

patterns.name: XML/XAML 组件与属性
patterns.context: 嵌套的 XML 风格控件或布局描述，标签名和属性值均可能触发。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 XAML/界面代码

patterns.name: Java 方法及类型声明
patterns.context: Java 代码中的声明、泛型类型、方法调用和字符串参数；本段也包含映射配置调用。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Java 源码

patterns.name: 法律文档标题与法条引用
patterns.context: 法律文件的标题、摘要标题和法条编号；周围有日期、作者及正式法律措辞。

en.description: Mainly sensitive to code structures in software engineering text: Java types and generics, identifiers and member access, as well as XML/XAML tags, attributes, and project configuration. It also covers comments, API documentation, UI behavior descriptions, JSON examples, and compilation issues in programming contexts.

patterns.name: Java type declarations and generic parameters
patterns.context: Method parameters, return types, local variables, generic containers, or field declarations in Java source; `String` is especially prominent across several fragments.

patterns.name: XML/XAML tags and attributes
patterns.context: Tag names, attribute names, and delimiters in XML or XAML markup, often related to UI or project configuration.

patterns.name: Named identifiers and member access in code
patterns.context: Camel-case method names, member names, and property access in code or markup languages; co-occurs with syntax elements such as type declarations and parentheses.

patterns.name: Code comments and documentation comments
patterns.context: Source comments or API documentation blocks, especially text describing a method's purpose, return value, or field meaning.

patterns.name: Formatted JSON and braces in code examples
patterns.context: JSON/Java examples in StackExchange Q&A, accompanied by discussion of extra braces after an object body or formatted output.

patterns.name: Natural-language compilation questions in code snippets
patterns.context: First-person English question text following a code example, discussing compilation errors or type parameters.

patterns.name: Copyright and project metadata markup
patterns.context: XML metadata section at the beginning of a project file, containing version, copyright, license file, and project URL.

patterns.name: Concurrent map and calendar type fields
patterns.context: Java field declarations and immediately adjacent comments, representing calendar objects indexed by ID or type.

patterns.name: Collection non-empty check and result-list construction
patterns.context: Java control flow that checks a collection and then creates a string list within a method body.

patterns.name: UI control enabled state and click behavior
patterns.context: Describes how disabling a UI cell affects highlighting and clicking, and provides an XAML property example.

patterns.name: Audio file method documentation and signature
patterns.context: A Java method documentation comment says it returns a list of audio files associated with a broadcast account, immediately followed by the public method signature.

patterns.name: Grid column definitions and visibility markup
patterns.context: Consecutive XAML grid layout fragments, with a visibility property following column width configuration.

patterns.name: Error message and content-loading method
patterns.context: Java UI code displays a prompt and then overrides a content-loading method.

11_2805.description: 主要对软件工程文本中的代码结构敏感：Java 类型与泛型、标识符和成员访问，以及 XML/XAML 标签、属性和项目配置。另覆盖注释、API 文档、UI 行为说明、JSON 示例及编译问题等编程语境。

patterns.name: Java 类型声明与泛型参数
patterns.context: Java 源码中的方法参数、返回值、局部变量、泛型容器或字段声明；多段中 `String` 的激活尤其突出。

patterns.name: XML/XAML 标签与属性
patterns.context: XML 或 XAML 标记中的标签名、属性名及边界符；常与 UI、项目配置相关。

patterns.name: 代码中的命名标识符与成员访问
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言中的驼峰式方法名、成员名及属性访问；与类型声明、括号等语法成分并现。

patterns.name: 代码注释与文档注释
patterns.trigger: `/**`、`* Map of available calendars by calendar type.`、`- returns a list of all the audio file...`
patterns.context: 源码注释或 API 文档块，尤其是描述方法用途、返回值或字段含义的文字。
patterns.domain: 源码文档与 API 注释

patterns.name: 代码示例中的格式化 JSON 与花括号
patterns.context: StackExchange 问答中的 JSON/Java 示例，伴随对对象体后多余花括号或格式化输出的讨论。

patterns.name: 代码片段中的自然语言编译问题
patterns.trigger: `I cannot compile the code`、`modify the method handleList`、`but that is NOT my purpose`
patterns.context: 代码示例之后的第一人称英文问题说明，讨论编译错误或类型参数。

patterns.name: 版权与项目元数据标记
patterns.context: 项目文件开头的 XML 元数据区，包含版本、版权、许可证文件和项目 URL。

patterns.name: 并发映射与日历类型字段
patterns.context: Java 字段声明及其紧邻注释，表示按 ID 或类型索引日历对象。

patterns.name: 集合非空判断与结果列表构造
patterns.context: 方法体中检查集合后创建字符串列表的 Java 控制流。

patterns.name: UI 控件启用状态与点击行为
patterns.trigger: `disable the highlight effect`、`disable the click event`、`IsEnabled="false"`
patterns.context: 说明将界面单元格设为不可用会影响高亮和点击，并给出 XAML 属性示例。

patterns.name: 音频文件方法文档与签名
patterns.context: Java 方法的文档注释说明返回广播账户关联的音频文件列表，紧接公开方法签名。

patterns.name: 网格列定义与可见性标记
patterns.context: 连续的 XAML 网格布局片段，列宽配置后接可见性属性。

patterns.name: 错误提示与内容加载方法
patterns.context: Java UI 代码中显示提示信息，随后重写内容加载方法。

en.description: The strongest and most repeated pattern is XHTML/HTML DOCTYPE and root tags. Activations also occur in C# generic registration, an English account of an aircraft vulnerability, and two Java stack traces; the latter patterns have no obvious shared trigger feature.

patterns.name: XHTML DOCTYPE and html root tag
patterns.context: Document declarations in HTML/XHTML, usually the DOCTYPE identifier and the following html root element; specific versions, Strict/Transitional subtypes, and surrounding characters vary.

patterns.name: C# generic registration and type parameters
patterns.context: Activations occur near generic methods and network interface type names in dependency injection registration code; the fragment shows types such as AppleDevice, IDevice, and INetwork.

patterns.name: Short words in an aircraft vulnerability account
patterns.context: English sentences discussing attackers exploiting a vulnerability to insert code into a virtual aircraft; activations fall on function words and the name ACARS, not HTML markup.

patterns.name: Class names and constructors in Java exception stacks
patterns.context: Package paths, class/method names, constructors, and source file line numbers appear in Java stack traces; the matching trace is a Hibernate call stack.
patterns.domain: Java exception stack traces on StackExchange

patterns.name: Java service discovery stack
patterns.context: Service discovery/registration classes and constructor calls in a Java stack trace, with package paths and file line numbers.
patterns.domain: Java exception stack traces on StackExchange

11_2805.concept: 代码与标记语言语法片段
11_2805.description: 最强且重复的模式是 XHTML/HTML DOCTYPE 与根标签；另在 C# 泛型注册、飞机漏洞英文叙述及两种 Java 堆栈跟踪中激活，后几类彼此缺乏明显共同触发特征。

patterns.name: XHTML DOCTYPE 与 html 根标签
patterns.context: HTML/XHTML 文档声明中，通常是 DOCTYPE 标识符和其后的 html 根元素；具体版本、Strict/Transitional 子型和周边字符并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 HTML/XML 源码

patterns.name: C# 泛型注册与类型参数
patterns.context: 在依赖注入注册代码中，泛型方法和网络接口类型名附近激活；片段展示 AppleDevice、IDevice、INetwork 等类型。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 C#/.NET 代码

patterns.name: 飞机漏洞叙述中的短词
patterns.context: 讨论攻击者利用漏洞向虚拟飞机插入代码的英文句子；激活落在功能词及 ACARS 名称上，而非 HTML 标记。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 中的安全／航空网络文字

patterns.name: Java 异常栈中的类名与构造器
patterns.context: Java 堆栈跟踪里出现包路径、类／方法名、构造器及源文件行号；命中 Hibernate 调用栈。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 Java 异常堆栈

patterns.name: Java 服务发现堆栈
patterns.context: Java 堆栈跟踪中的服务发现／注册类与构造器调用，带有包路径及文件行号。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 Java 异常堆栈

en.concept: Noun objects and their classification or composition
en.description: Activations occur in legal documents referring to charges, causes of action, and claims, and in descriptions that divide technical, network, or planning objects into multiple parts. Other isolated contexts include notebook products, patent heat processes, and biomedical modification.

patterns.name: Charges, claims, and causes in legal text
patterns.context: Noun phrases referring to charges, causes of action, claims, or litigation motions in legal documents, often within accounts of case facts or proceedings. Activations are not limited to any one legal term.

patterns.name: Partitions, components, and division
patterns.context: Describes systems, networks, projects, or equipment divided into multiple parts, compartments, or component units; numbers occur next to nouns such as parts, divisions, and compartments. Also includes multiple conductors in technical structures.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, engineering or network descriptions, transportation planning

patterns.name: MacBook product names and model terms
patterns.context: Apple notebook models, screen sizes, years, and port names in consumer technology articles; the passage reports unexpected device shutdowns.

patterns.name: Heat-protective layers in patents
patterns.context: Describes a technical process involving bubble-forming liquid, a heater, and protective layers reaching the liquid's superheat limit; activations highlight protective layers, while not all technical nouns activate equally.

patterns.name: Modification and viral latency in biomedicine
patterns.context: Discusses post-translational modification and its role in signal regulation and viral latency, in research objectives or mechanistic explanations.

11_2805.concept: 名词性对象及其分类、组成
11_2805.description: 激活出现在法律文书中对指控、诉因和诉讼主张的指称，也出现在把技术、网络、规划对象划分为多部分的描述；另有笔记本产品、专利热过程和生物医学修饰等孤立语境。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 charges、claims 与 causes
patterns.trigger: « these»10 charges；« elements»2« of»2« these»10 causes；« federal»5« claims；« motion»1
patterns.context: 法律文书中指代指控、诉因、索赔或诉讼动议的名词短语，常处在案件事实或诉讼程序叙述中。激活并不局限于某个特定法律术语。

patterns.name: 分区、组成部分及其划分
patterns.trigger: « two»10« component»8 projects；« two»10 divisions；« several»9 separate« compartments»；« three»7 live phase-conductors
patterns.context: 描述系统、网络、项目或设备被划分为多个部分、隔间或组成单元；数字与 parts、divisions、compartments 等名词相邻。也包括技术结构中的多个导体。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、工程或网络描述、交通规划

patterns.name: MacBook 产品名称与型号词
patterns.context: 消费科技文章中的苹果笔记本型号、屏幕尺寸、年份及接口名称；段落报告设备异常关机。

patterns.name: 专利中的受热保护层
patterns.context: 描述气泡形成液、加热器和保护层达到液体过热极限的技术过程；激活突出 protective layers，并非所有技术名词都同样强。

patterns.name: 生物医学中的修饰与病毒潜伏
patterns.trigger: « PT»4«M»2；« PT»7Ms；« viral»4 latency；« phosphorylation»；« O»-GlcNAcylation
patterns.context: 讨论翻译后修饰及其对信号调节、病毒潜伏的作用，处于研究目标或机制说明语境。

en.description: Responds to technical, scientific, and architectural descriptions containing structured noun phrases and spatial relationships: power hardware, layers/channels/network modules, signal pathways, and roof or scene layouts; specific trigger words vary by domain.

patterns.name: Power modes and electrical distribution
patterns.context: Describes power supply, power consumption, power modes, batteries, or conductors, plug-in units, and connection points in electrical systems; activations also occur in hardware terms related to power/Power.

patterns.name: Layered structures and interlayer relationships
patterns.context: Descriptions of materials or crystal structures containing layers, interlayers, stacks, and relationships between layers.

patterns.name: Spectrum channel allocation
patterns.context: Radio astronomy observation parameters in which bandwidth is divided into spectral windows and channels, accompanied by GHz, frequency, and polarization labels.

patterns.name: Roof forms and architectural divisions
patterns.context: Explains roof shapes, building components, or the divisions and layout of building complexes.

patterns.name: Convolutional network layers and modules
patterns.context: Lists convolutional blocks, encoders/decoders, and numbers of layers and filters when describing neural-network architectures.

patterns.name: Cell signaling pathways and regulation
patterns.context: In a biomedical context, discusses regulation of cell signaling, proliferation, or immortalization by EBV/LMP1.

patterns.name: Spatial forms in game environments
patterns.context: Game reviews describe spatial elements in an arena, such as floating spheres and walls, and changes in footing during movement.

11_2805.concept: 结构化系统与空间构造
11_2805.description: 响应多种结构化名词短语与空间关系的技术、科学和建筑描述：电力硬件、层/通道/网络模块、信号通路及屋顶或场景布局；具体触发词随领域而变。

patterns.name: power modes and electrical distribution
patterns.context: 描述供电、功耗、供电模式、电池，或电气系统中的导体、插接单元和连接点；激活也出现在与 power/Power 相关的硬件术语中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、计算机硬件百科

patterns.name: 层状结构与夹层关系
patterns.trigger: « layered»4 structure；« ionic»6 ... layers sandwiched« between»7 two»8 Te»10 layers
patterns.context: 材料或晶体结构描述中，出现层、夹层、堆叠以及层间关系。

patterns.name: 频谱通道划分
patterns.context: 射电天文观测参数中，带宽被划分为频谱窗口、通道，并伴随 GHz、频率和偏振标记。

patterns.name: 屋顶形制与建筑分区
patterns.context: 说明屋顶形状、建筑构件或建筑群的分段与布局。

patterns.name: 卷积网络层与模块
patterns.context: 描述神经网络架构时，列举卷积块、编码器/解码器及层数、滤波器数。

patterns.name: 细胞信号通路与调控
patterns.context: 生物医学语境中讨论 EBV/LMP1 对细胞信号、增殖或永生化的调节。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 游戏场景中的空间造型
patterns.context: 游戏评论描写竞技场中漂浮球体、墙面等空间元素，以及移动时的落脚变化。

en.description: High-activation passages often describe physical components, connections, configurations, or operating conditions, especially in patent backgrounds; other text types include game guides and probation rulings.

patterns.name: Electrical equipment and connection structures
patterns.context: Describes power supply, control, connections, or electrical system components and their operation; common in patent backgrounds.

patterns.name: Furniture, supports, and adjustable support structures
patterns.context: Describes support, mounting, tilting, or adjustment components and their connections to other structures.

patterns.name: Refrigerator types and compartment layouts
patterns.context: Lists types and explains the relative positions of refrigerator freezer and fresh-food compartments.

patterns.name: Instrument openings and hinged components
patterns.context: Describes a component structure with an opening, a door leaf, and a hinged connection.

patterns.name: Game checkpoints and cheat codes
patterns.context: A player continues from an already reached checkpoint or uses a code to obtain in-game equipment.

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and probation conditions
patterns.context: Discusses probation conditions, findings of violations, and remand of a case.

11_2805.description: 高激活段多为对实体部件、连接关系、配置或操作条件的说明，尤其常见于专利背景技术；另有游戏攻略和缓刑判决两类不同文本。

patterns.name: 电气设备及连接结构
patterns.context: 描述供电、控制、连接或电气系统部件及其工作方式；常见于专利背景技术。

patterns.name: 家具、支架与可调支撑结构
patterns.context: 描述支撑、安装、倾斜或调节部件及其与其他结构的连接关系。

patterns.name: 制冷设备类型及舱室布局
patterns.trigger: «top mount type»、«bottom freezer type»、«side by side type»、«freezer compartment»、«refrigerator compartment»
patterns.context: 并列分类并说明冰箱冷冻室与冷藏室的相对位置。

patterns.name: 器械开口与铰接部件
patterns.context: 描述带开口、门片及其铰接连接的组件结构。

patterns.name: 游戏存档点与作弊码
patterns.context: 玩家从已到达的检查点继续游戏，或使用代码获得游戏内装备。

patterns.name: 法律程序与缓刑条件
patterns.context: 讨论缓刑条件、违规认定及案件发回处理。

en.concept: Descriptions of structures and positional relationships
en.description: Activations occur across diverse technical explanations, especially patent descriptions of device components, connections, adjustable positions, and wiring structures; other examples include cables, disk servo systems, brain-region studies, and descriptions of game spaces, making them difficult to reduce to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Descriptions of mechanical components and adjustable structures in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes devices composed of multiple components and their selectively engaged, rotated, supported, or adjusted positional relationships; typically appears in patent backgrounds or technical explanations.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds and mechanical/consumer-electronics devices

patterns.name: Electrical wiring, signals, and semiconductor structures
patterns.context: In the context of chips, semiconductor packaging, or power/signal wiring, explains wiring layers, channels, vias, and resulting crosstalk or potential changes.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds, semiconductor and electronic engineering

patterns.name: Cable specifications and retention systems
patterns.context: Discusses an extension cord detaching from a retention system and problems caused by different cable gauges or thicknesses.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds, cables and electrical accessories

patterns.name: Embedded servo information and sectors
patterns.context: Explains where servo information is recorded on a disk and its sector or wedge layout.

patterns.name: Brain regions and cortical tracing studies
patterns.context: Describes cortical regions and studies that look for neuron populations after injecting retrograde tracers into different brain regions.

patterns.name: Direction and spatial changes in game environments
patterns.context: Introduces the spatial design of an arena and changes in footing caused by jumping.

11_2805.description: 激活分布在多种技术说明中，尤见专利文本对装置部件、连接关系、可调位置及布线结构的描述；另有线缆、磁盘伺服、脑区研究和游戏空间描写，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 专利背景中对机械部件与可调结构的描述
patterns.trigger: “selectably engageable”“selectable rotational positions”“adjustably fixed”“tiltably connected”，以及“base”“platform”“supporting member”“bracket”“tray”等部件名
patterns.context: 描述由多个部件组成的装置，以及它们可选择地接合、旋转、支撑或调整的位置关系；多为专利背景或技术说明。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与机械/消费电子装置

patterns.name: 电气布线、信号与半导体结构
patterns.trigger: “wiring channels”“wiring layers”“interlayer or interlevel vias”“wiring patterns”“plurality of wiring”
patterns.context: 在芯片、半导体封装或电力/信号布线语境中，说明布线层、通道、过孔及其导致的串扰或电势变化。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，半导体与电子工程

patterns.name: 线缆规格与保持系统
patterns.trigger: “extension cords”“retention system”“variety of gauges or thicknesses”
patterns.context: 讨论延长线从保持系统脱离，以及线缆规格或厚度不同所造成的问题。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，线缆与电气附件

patterns.name: 嵌入式伺服信息及扇区
patterns.context: 说明磁盘上记录伺服信息的位置及其扇区或楔形布局。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，磁盘驱动器技术

patterns.name: 脑区与皮层示踪研究
patterns.trigger: “precentral and postcentral gyri”“primary auditory cortex”“cortical areas”“neurons”
patterns.context: 描述皮层区域以及向不同脑区注入逆行示踪剂后寻找神经元群的研究。

patterns.name: 游戏场景中的方向与空间变化
patterns.trigger: “floating spheres”“walls that jut out in various directions”“A quick leap shifts your footing”
patterns.context: 介绍竞技场的空间设计及跳跃造成的立足位置变化。

en.description: Mainly occurs in technical descriptions and patent backgrounds, favoring itemized accounts of components, shapes, quantities, and connections, often with structural words such as two, pair, plurality, end, and portion. Also covers game case divisions and encyclopedia passages about church components, so it cannot be assigned to a single domain.

patterns.name: Patent background narratives
patterns.context: Patent-style background, prior approaches, or structural descriptions, often containing common function words such as “the,” “a,” and “of”; activations are distributed across ordinary English and technical terms

patterns.name: Technical structure and component descriptions
patterns.context: Explains what components an object comprises, and the shape, quantity, or connection of those components; often uses structural expressions such as “two,” “pair,” “plurality,” and “includes”
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions involving electronics, mechanics, materials, chemistry, and other fields

patterns.name: Activations near the quantity word two
patterns.context: Numerals and neighboring words activate prominently in descriptions of component counts, pairs, and divisions; however, the pattern is not limited to two
patterns.domain: Patent structural descriptions and architectural descriptions

patterns.name: Game cases and narrative divisions
patterns.context: Introduces gameplay or narrative organization; cases refers to game levels, not patent components

patterns.name: Architectural spaces and component descriptions
patterns.context: Describes church orientation, spatial composition, tower levels, and decorative components

patterns.name: Low-power mode descriptions
patterns.context: Describes different power states in which a controller or processor can operate

patterns.name: Wavy boundary geometry
patterns.context: Describes a repeated undulating contour along the boundary of a bag opening

patterns.name: Disk servo information layout
patterns.context: Explains how servo information is written to and distributed across a disk

patterns.name: Workstations and ergonomic supports
patterns.context: Describes a workbench structure and its interaction with an adjustable chair and leg rest

patterns.name: Process equipment for liquid mixtures
patterns.context: Mentions a crosslinker and a specialized mixer for processing liquid mixtures

patterns.name: Concentric elastomer extrusion structure
patterns.context: Describes elastomer layers or extrudates formed from concentric tubular material flows

patterns.name: Spring mounting ends and connections
patterns.context: Describes connections between the upper and lower ends of a spring and a platform or frame

11_2805.description: 主要出现在技术说明和专利背景中，偏好部件、形状、数量及连接关系的逐项描述，常见 two、pair、plurality、end、portion 等结构词；也覆盖游戏案件划分、教堂构件等百科段落，不能归为单一领域。

patterns.name: 专利背景技术叙述
patterns.trigger: “present inventions relate to”“Discussion of Related Art”“A further process”“earlier inventions”“prior springs”
patterns.context: 专利说明书式的背景、已有方案或结构介绍，常出现“the”“a”“of”等常见功能词；激活分散在普通英文及技术术语中

patterns.name: 技术结构与部件描述
patterns.trigger: “two end portions”“a plurality of servo sectors”“a pair of leg rests”“two mixing chambers”“concentric tubular streams”“mounting feet”
patterns.context: 说明物体由哪些部件构成、部件的形状数量或连接关系；常用“two”“pair”“plurality”“includes”等结构表达
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明，涉及电子、机械、材料、化工等

patterns.name: 数量词 two 附近的激活
patterns.trigger: “two points”“two end portions”“two mixing chambers”“two stages”“two-light”“a pair”
patterns.context: 在部件或对象的数量、成对关系及分段描述中，数词及邻近词明显激活；但不完全局限于 two
patterns.domain: 专利结构描述及建筑说明

patterns.name: 游戏案件与叙事划分
patterns.trigger: “twelve distinct cases”“one overall theme”“the game's story”
patterns.context: 介绍游戏玩法或叙事组织，cases 指游戏中的案件关卡，而非专利部件

patterns.name: 建筑空间与构件描写
patterns.context: 描述教堂方位、空间组成、塔楼层次和装饰构件

patterns.name: 低功耗模式描述
patterns.trigger: “multiple power modes”“high and low power modes”
patterns.context: 描述控制器或处理器可运行的不同功耗状态

patterns.name: 波状边界几何形态
patterns.trigger: “wavy configuration”“a series of inward facing peaks and valleys”
patterns.context: 描述袋口边界线的重复起伏轮廓

patterns.name: 磁盘伺服信息布局
patterns.context: 解释磁盘伺服信息如何写入磁盘以及分布位置

patterns.name: 工作站与人体工学支撑
patterns.context: 说明工作台结构及其与可调椅、腿托的配合

patterns.name: 混合液体的工艺设备
patterns.trigger: “specially constructed mixer”“two mixing chambers”“a mixture of liquids”
patterns.context: 提及交联剂及用于处理液体混合物的特制混合器

patterns.name: 弹性体同心挤出结构
patterns.trigger: “tubular elastomeric ply or extrudate”“first and second concentric tubular streams”
patterns.context: 描述由同心管状材料流构成的弹性体层或挤出物

patterns.name: 弹簧安装端部与连接
patterns.context: 按弹簧上下端描述其与平台或框架的连接结构

en.concept: Descriptions of structured objects and their attributes
en.description: Activations frequently occur in technical or scientific texts that detail an object's composition, components, quantity, spatial relationships, categories, or operating modes; they also appear in descriptions of segmented structures in games and architecture, and in between-group comparisons of pathogen antibody measures.

patterns.name: Descriptions of the structure, components, or classification of diverse technical objects
patterns.context: Activations occur in sequences describing technical objects and their composition, quantity, spatial relationships, types, or operating modes; common in patent backgrounds, but also seen in research-method descriptions

patterns.name: Quantity and organization of segments or stages
patterns.context: In accounts of games or architecture, explicitly states that the whole consists of several distinct units or stages

patterns.name: Specific pathogen antibody measures and between-group comparisons
patterns.context: Compares total or pathogen-specific antibody measures across different mouse genotypes

11_2805.concept: 结构化对象及其属性说明
11_2805.description: 激活多见于技术或科学文本中，对对象的组成、部件、数量、空间关系、类别或运行模式作具体说明；也出现在游戏与建筑的分段结构描述，以及病原体抗体指标的组间比较中。

patterns.name: 多样化技术对象的结构、部件或分类描述
patterns.trigger: “a plurality of servo sectors”, “pair of ferromagnetic layers”, “pair of leg rests”, “plug-in connection sites”, “first and second concentric tubular streams”, “multiple power modes”；另有“four major components”
patterns.context: 激活出现在技术对象及其组成、数量、空间关系、类型或工作模式的连续说明中；常见于专利背景，但也见于科研方法描述
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、科研论文

patterns.name: 分段或阶段的数量与组织
patterns.context: 叙述游戏或建筑时，明确说明整体由若干个可区分的单元或阶段构成

patterns.name: 特定病原体抗体指标及组间比较
patterns.context: 比较感染小鼠不同基因型中的总量或病原体特异性抗体指标

en.description: Activations occur in game introductions and reviews, as well as technical and medical texts. Common local patterns include system hierarchies/classifications, component configurations and functional descriptions; they also involve experimental comparisons, medical imaging workflows, and references to patent figures.

patterns.name: Games and game mechanics
patterns.context: Discusses plot progression, difficulty, gameplay strategies, or level design.

patterns.name: Hierarchical, ranked, or classification structures
patterns.context: Describes a system consisting of multiple levels, categories, modes, or components.

patterns.name: Technical components and their organization or operation
patterns.context: Technical descriptions list equipment, materials, or structural components and explain their configuration, purpose, or operation.
patterns.domain: Architecture encyclopedias, patent backgrounds, engineering descriptions

patterns.name: Medical experimental results and group comparisons
patterns.context: Reports experimental measurements and compares different metrics or experimental groups.

patterns.name: Medical image analysis workflow
patterns.context: Describes automatic recognition, manual correction, and classification steps for images or medical images.

patterns.name: References to figures or patent drawings
patterns.context: Uses figure numbers to refer to drawings and explain technical structures or embodiments.

11_2805.description: 激活分布于游戏介绍与评论，以及技术、医学文本；常见局部模式包括系统的层级/分类、部件配置与功能说明，也涉及实验比较、医学图像流程和专利附图指代。

patterns.name: 游戏及游戏机制
patterns.context: 谈论游戏的剧情推进、难度、玩法策略或场景设计。

patterns.name: 分层、等级或分类结构
patterns.trigger: “twelve distinct cases”“hierarchical structure”“hierarchical layers”“four major components”“multiple power modes”
patterns.context: 描述由多个层级、类别、模式或组成部分构成的系统。

patterns.name: 技术构件及其组织或运作
patterns.trigger: “alternating tie beams”“false hammer beams”“mixing chambers”“servo sectors”“flash memory”“processor cores”
patterns.context: 在技术性说明中列举设备、材料或结构部件，并说明其配置、用途或运行。
patterns.domain: 建筑百科、专利背景、工程说明

patterns.name: 医学实验结果与分组比较
patterns.context: 报告实验测量值，并比较不同指标或实验组。

patterns.name: 医学图像分析流程
patterns.trigger: “automatic edge detection”“iMAP system automatically classified”“plaque”“four major components”
patterns.context: 说明图像或医学影像中的自动识别、人工校正及分类步骤。

patterns.name: 图表或专利附图的指代
patterns.context: 以图号指向附图，并借图说明技术结构或实施内容。

en.concept: Relationships and noun phrases in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across to, articles and quantifiers, and patent technical noun phrases; other examples include game reviews, armor descriptions, magnetic and mechanical structures, legal charges, and paragraph symbols. Medical classification and mathematical ordering are harder to fit into a shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Preposition to
patterns.context: An infinitive or prepositional complement introduced by to follows a verb, noun, or adjective; paragraph 2 also contains “brings me« to» the game’s difficulty”.

patterns.name: Articles and determiners
patterns.context: Articles or quantifiers within noun phrases, especially consecutive noun modifiers in technical text.

patterns.name: Patent technical noun phrases
patterns.context: Noun phrases describing devices, components, materials, structures, or operating modes in technical explanations, often with many modifiers.

patterns.name: Game reviews and game structures
patterns.context: Discusses video-game mechanics, difficulty, levels, or story structure.

patterns.name: Directional or ordering expressions
patterns.context: Requests that a sequence be sorted by size, including directional ordering words.

patterns.name: Legal charge statements
patterns.context: States the charges against a defendant and the number of charges in a legal case; the word may be split into subword tokens.

patterns.name: Image analysis and medical classification
patterns.context: Describes automated recognition and classification of vascular or plaque images and their category composition.

patterns.name: Magnetic-material state relationships
patterns.context: Describes the orientation of a magnetic layer, the effect of an external magnetic field, and their state relationships.

patterns.name: Structural geometry and installation
patterns.context: Describes the geometry, relative positions, or assembly of mechanical components.

patterns.name: Armor structure and protection
patterns.context: Describes the front armor of a vehicle, its shape, and its bulletproof or mine-protection function.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and discourse markers
patterns.context: Paragraph symbols and line breaks in legal text; activations mainly fall on the paragraph symbol itself.

11_2805.concept: 技术说明中的关系与名词短语
11_2805.description: 激活分散于 to、冠词和数量词，以及专利技术名词短语；另见游戏评论、装甲描述、磁性与机械结构、法律指控和段落符号。医学分类与数学排序较难归入共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 介词 to
patterns.context: 动词、名词或形容词后接 to 引出的不定式或介词补语；第 2 段也有 “brings me« to» the game’s difficulty”。

patterns.name: 冠词与限定词
patterns.context: 名词短语内部的冠词或数量词；尤其是技术文本中连续出现的名词修饰语。

patterns.name: 专利技术名词短语
patterns.trigger: “«portable» media cases”“«protective» covers”“«magnetic» layers”“«power» modes”“«cylindrical» portions”
patterns.context: 技术说明中描述装置、部件、材料、结构或工作模式的名词短语，常伴随较多修饰语。

patterns.name: 游戏评论与游戏结构
patterns.context: 谈论电子游戏的玩法、难度、关卡或故事结构。

patterns.name: 方向或排序表达
patterns.context: 要求把数列按大小顺序排列，包含方向性排序词。

patterns.name: 法律罪名表述
patterns.context: 法律案件中陈述被告被控罪名及指控数量；词语可能被拆分为子词 token。

patterns.name: 图像分析与医学分类
patterns.context: 描述血管或斑块图像的自动识别、分类及类别组成。

patterns.name: 磁性材料状态关系
patterns.context: 描述磁性层的取向、外部磁场作用及其状态关系。

patterns.name: 结构几何与安装
patterns.context: 描述机械部件的几何形状、相对位置或装配方式。

patterns.name: 装甲结构与防护
patterns.context: 描述车辆前部装甲、形状以及防弹或防地雷防护功能。

patterns.name: 引号与篇章标记
patterns.context: 法律文本中的段落符号及换行处；激活主要落在段落符号本身。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in patent specifications describing devices and their components, quantities, configurations, and functions, especially lists of multiple components or modes. They also occur in descriptions of game strategies and difficulty, and lists of parties and identities in legal documents.

patterns.name: Two / two-part structures in patent texts
patterns.context: Describes two components, chambers, layers, or nested springs in technical patent backgrounds; quantity–structure relations in noun phrases are also common. Not every occurrence of two is marked as an activation.

patterns.name: Patent-claim-style descriptions of devices and components
patterns.context: Describes device composition, component positions, support, or connection relations; activations may occur on numerals, nouns, and nearby function words, and are not necessarily triggered by a fixed word.
patterns.domain: USPTO mechanical, medical, and other technical patents

patterns.name: Enumeration of multiple modes or options
patterns.context: Describes device operating modes or game difficulty options; presents multiple selectable modes, levels, or strategies.

patterns.name: Action and function relations in patents
patterns.context: Components are described as supporting, receiving, operating, or performing a function, often alongside structural and component relations.

patterns.name: Lists of names and identities in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal documents list parties and their identities as plan administrators; distinct from patent structural descriptions and multiple-mode themes.

patterns.name: Strategy and difficulty in game reviews
patterns.context: Reviews gameplay, discussing strategy, difficulty levels, and completing the game; distinct from technical patent registers.

11_2805.description: 激活主要集中于专利说明书对装置及其部件、数量、配置和功能的描述，尤其是多个部件或模式的列举；另见游戏的策略与难度描述，以及法律文书中的当事人和身份列举。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的 two / two-part 结构
patterns.trigger: “two”及其后接的复数结构或部件
patterns.context: 技术专利背景中描述两个部件、腔室、层或嵌套弹簧；也常见名词短语中的数量—结构关系。不是所有出现 two 的位置都标记激活。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求式装置与部件描述
patterns.trigger: “device”“member”“arms”“frame”“deck”“springs”“cylinders”等部件名词，以及“include”“comprises”等引出结构的词
patterns.context: 描述装置、部件组成、相对位置、支撑或连接关系；激活可落在数词、名词及邻近功能词上，未必只由某个固定词触发。
patterns.domain: USPTO 机械、医疗及其他技术专利

patterns.name: 多种模式或选项的列举
patterns.context: 说明设备运行模式或游戏难度选项；呈现可选择的多个模式、等级或策略。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书与游戏评论

patterns.name: 专利中的动作与功能关系
patterns.trigger: “to support”“for receiving”“can be utilized”“operates in”等功能或用途表达
patterns.context: 部件被描述为支撑、接收、运行或实现某种功能，常与结构和部件关系并现。

patterns.name: 法律文件中的人名与身份列举
patterns.trigger: “Damon Gasque, Joseph Linehan, Peter Haley, Marcellus Duckett, James Paul, and Jeffrey Bryan”“in their capacity as plan administrators”
patterns.context: 法律文件列举当事人及其计划管理人身份；与专利结构描述及多模式主题不同。

patterns.name: 游戏评论中的策略与难度
patterns.trigger: “new strategies and patterns”“game's difficulty”“five difficulty settings”
patterns.context: 评论游戏玩法，谈策略、难度等级及通关；与技术专利语域不同。

en.concept: Descriptions of diverse structures and states in technical text
en.description: Activations occur mainly in patent technical text, favoring paired or multimode structures and the receiving, mounting, supporting, and spatial arrangement of components; they also cover magnetic-layer states, liquid-gas phase descriptions, and an abstract on stem-cell culture. Triggers are not limited to a single part of speech or topic.

patterns.name: Plural/dual-quantity structures
patterns.context: Expressions of dual quantity such as two or both, or nearby noun phrases denoting paired components; activations sometimes fall on the quantifier, component word, or adjacent morphological fragment.
patterns.domain: Primarily patent background technology, also material descriptions

patterns.name: Multiple modes and mode switching
patterns.context: Describes devices or communication ports with multiple operating modes, power states, or mode switching; activations cluster around words such as modes, operating, and power.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology, microcontrollers and communication devices

patterns.name: Component mounting, support, and connection
patterns.context: Describes structures for mounting, supporting, positioning, or receiving mechanical components; trigger words are often components and their function words in compound nouns.

patterns.name: Magnetic layers and field states
patterns.context: Discusses the orientation of multilayer magnetic recording media or magnetic layers as changed by an external magnetic field/programming current.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology, magnetic recording and magnetic devices

patterns.name: Coexisting liquid and gas phases
patterns.context: A heat-transfer fluid is described as simultaneously having liquid and gas phases; activation is prominent on gaseous.

patterns.name: Cell culture conditions
patterns.context: Compares different culture conditions in stem-cell research and examines cell fate or morphology, among other factors.

patterns.name: Spacing/distribution structures in patents
patterns.context: Holes are spaced circumferentially on an annular flange; beyond generic component-receiving structures, the description includes an explicit spatial distribution.

11_2805.concept: 技术文本中的多元结构与状态描述
11_2805.description: 激活主要见于专利技术文本，偏向成对或多模式结构，以及部件的接纳、安装、支承和空间布置；还覆盖磁性层状态、液气相变描述及一段干细胞培养摘要。触发并非单一词类或主题。

patterns.name: 复数/双数量结构
patterns.trigger: “two cylindrical portions”“two spaced-apart arms”“two magnetic layers”“both liquid and gaseous phases”
patterns.context: 出现 two、both 等双数量表达，或紧邻表示成对构件的名词短语；有时激活落在数量词、部件词或相邻形态片段上。
patterns.domain: 以专利背景技术为主，另有材料描述

patterns.name: 多模式与模式切换
patterns.trigger: “multiple power modes”“low power modes”“operating modes”“mode switching code”
patterns.context: 描述设备或通信端口具有多种运行模式、功耗状态或模式切换时；激活集中在 modes、operating、power 等词附近。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，微控制器与通信设备

patterns.name: 部件安装、支承与连接
patterns.context: 描述机械部件的安装、支承、定位或接纳结构，触发词常是复合名词中的部件及其功能词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，机械结构

patterns.name: 磁性层及磁场状态
patterns.context: 讨论多层磁记录介质或磁性层的取向受外部磁场/编程电流改变。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，磁记录与磁性器件

patterns.name: 液态与气态并存
patterns.context: 热传递流体被描述为同时存在液相和气相，激活突出 gaseous。

patterns.name: 细胞培养条件
patterns.context: 干细胞研究中比较不同培养条件，并考察细胞命运或形态等。

patterns.name: 专利中的间隔/分布结构
patterns.context: 环形法兰上沿周向间隔布置孔位；除通用部件接纳结构外，带有明确的空间分布描述。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，轮毂结构

en.description: Activations span mode switching, mechanical components, and surgical tissue descriptions in patents from multiple domains, and also occur in cell-culture abstracts, C struct code, and legal texts. Apart from “mode” in patents, no shared trigger is evident across the passages.

patterns.name: Multiple operating/power modes
patterns.context: Patent descriptions of devices or ports operating or switching between different power states, operating modes, or data rates.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds, microcontrollers and communication interfaces

patterns.name: Mechanical structures, components, and assembly relations
patterns.context: Describes the shape, position, connections, and assembly of shafts, rollers, bed-frame springs, or spring assemblies.
patterns.domain: USPTO mechanical and furniture patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Cells and culture conditions
patterns.context: Introduces stem cell properties and studies cell fate under different culture conditions.

patterns.name: C struct fields and integer types
patterns.context: Code defines a struct and lists fields such as time and resource usage, along with their types.

patterns.name: Police arrest narrative
patterns.context: Describes a vehicle being stopped, its occupants being removed and arrested, and then placed in a police car.

patterns.name: Surgical tissue suturing and fixation
patterns.context: Describes tissue approximation and fixation during surgery, and the effects of sutures or staples on the tissue.

patterns.name: Legal case captions and appeal format
patterns.context: Caption or formatting text in court documents identifying parties, titles, and the originating appellate court.

11_2805.description: 激活覆盖多领域专利中的模式切换、机械组件及手术组织描述，也出现在细胞培养摘要、C 结构体代码和法律文本中；除专利中的“模式”外，未见贯穿各段的共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 多种运行/功率模式
patterns.trigger: «power»10 modes« including»2« high»1« and»1« low»3« power»6 modes；«operating»5« modes；«operating»9 modes
patterns.context: 设备或端口在不同功率状态、运行模式或数据速率之间工作或切换的专利描述。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，微控制器与通信接口

patterns.name: 机械结构、部件与装配关系
patterns.trigger: «inner»6« axial»7« faces»1；«c»2«ams»3；«two»8« cylindrical»10« portions»4；«spring»5« modules»5；«springs»3；«pocket»ed»3« coil»5 springs；«nested»9« coil»8« springs»1
patterns.context: 描述轴、滚轮、床架弹簧或弹簧组件的形状、位置、连接及装配方式。
patterns.domain: USPTO 机械与家具专利背景

patterns.name: 细胞与培养条件
patterns.trigger: «potent»3 cells；«human»2« mesenchymal»4« stem cells；«different»7« cell»9« culture»5 conditions
patterns.context: 介绍干细胞的特性，并研究其在不同培养条件下的细胞命运。

patterns.name: C 结构体字段与整数类型
patterns.context: 代码中定义结构体并列出时间、资源使用量等字段及其类型。

patterns.name: 警务逮捕叙述
patterns.trigger: «black»1« male»2« occupants»1；«placed»1« in»7« two»9« police»7 cars
patterns.context: 叙述车辆被拦停、乘员被带下车并逮捕后安置在警车中。

patterns.name: 外科组织缝合与固定
patterns.trigger: «suture»1« or»2 staple« to»4 tear« through»1« the» tissue；«tissue»9 layers；«mucosa»3« layer»2
patterns.context: 描述手术中组织的对合与固定，以及缝线或吻合钉对组织的影响。
patterns.domain: USPTO 医疗器械专利背景

patterns.name: 法律案件标题与上诉格式
patterns.trigger: «T»4«RET»3NIK；«Health»1« Care»1 Administrator；«On»1 Appeal« from»9« the»2« United»5« States»3« District»3« Court
patterns.context: 法院文书的当事人、职务和上诉法院来源等标题或版式文本。

en.concept: Proper nouns, terminology, and numbers in structured technical and legal text
en.description: Activations occur across specialized texts: patent mechanical structures and power modes, legal provisions, hardware specifications, encyclopedia section descriptions, and math problems. No unified meaning or stable syntactic trigger is evident; some passages may be influenced by numbers, punctuation, or structured terminology.

patterns.name: Power modes and regulation
patterns.context: A microcontroller is battery-powered; power consumption and multiple operating modes are discussed.

patterns.name: Mac hardware models and specifications
patterns.context: Platform information lists MacBook Pro, the operating system, and processor specifications in sequence.

patterns.name: Descriptions of works with multiple sections
patterns.context: Introduces the release of a sequel and mentions release in sections; section titles appear afterward.

patterns.name: Bed frames, springs, and support structures
patterns.context: Describes the frame and support plates of a mattress support device and the spring modules between them.

patterns.name: U.S. legal jurisdiction citation
patterns.context: A court ruling cites a provision of the U.S. Code and then turns to appellate issues.

patterns.name: Number strings in sequences or math problems
patterns.context: Numbers, commas, and questions are mixed together, asking for the nth term of a sequence; the trigger may be related to number strings and punctuation.

patterns.name: Angle-plate shapes and configurations
patterns.context: Discusses angle plates used in a machine and contrasts dedicated angle plates with multiple shapes and configurations.

patterns.name: Legal discussion heading and constitutional-rights citation
patterns.context: A judgment begins with a discussion-section heading, followed by a statutory standard concerning constitutional rights.

patterns.name: Algebraic function definitions and substitution evaluation
patterns.context: First defines a function and its polynomial expression, then asks to calculate a result after composition and substitution.

patterns.name: Annular ribs and cams in mechanical retainers
patterns.context: Describes mechanical structures including a retainer, end cap, axial surface, and circumferentially extending cams.

11_2805.concept: 结构化技术与法律文本中的专名、术语及数字
11_2805.description: 激活分布于多种专门文本：专利机械结构与功率模式、法律条文、硬件规格、百科章节表述及数学题。未见统一词义或稳定句法触发；若干段可能受数字、标点或结构化术语影响。

patterns.name: 电源模式及调节
patterns.trigger: «power»10 modes« including»3« high»3« and»2« low»4« power»7 modes
patterns.context: 微控制器由电池供电，讨论功耗以及多种运行模式。

patterns.name: Mac 硬件型号与规格
patterns.trigger: « Mac»1«Book»1« Pro»2, MacOS 10«.»113.3,« 2»2.3 GHz« Intel»4« Core»10 i«7»2
patterns.context: 平台信息中连续列出 MacBook Pro、操作系统和处理器规格。

patterns.name: 多章节作品表述
patterns.context: 介绍作品续作的发行情况，并提到分章节发布；后面出现章节标题。

patterns.name: 床架、弹簧与支撑结构
patterns.context: 描述床垫支撑装置的框架、支撑板及其间的弹簧模块。

patterns.name: 美国法律管辖权引文
patterns.context: 法院裁定叙述中引用美国法典条文，随后转入上诉事项。

patterns.name: 数列或数学题中的数字串
patterns.context: 数字、逗号及问句混排，要求识别某个数列的第 n 项；触发可能与数字串和标点有关。

patterns.name: 角板形状与配置
patterns.trigger: « angle»4 plates come« in»6« a»3« wide»1« variety»4« of»9 shapes» and»6 configurations
patterns.context: 讨论机器所用角板，并对比专用角板与多种形状、配置。

patterns.name: 法律讨论标题与宪法权利引文
patterns.trigger: « DIS«CUSSION» … « substantial showing of … the denial of a constitutional right»
patterns.context: 判决以讨论章节标题起始，接着引用关于宪法权利的法定标准。

patterns.name: 代数函数定义与代入求值
patterns.context: 先定义函数及其多项式表达式，再要求计算复合代入结果。

patterns.name: 机械保持器的环形凸肋与凸轮
patterns.context: 描述保持器、端盖、轴向表面及周向延伸的凸轮等机械结构。

en.concept: Expressions of quantities and multiple structures
en.description: Activations are concentrated in expressions of multiple configurations or quantities, as well as “What…term/next” prompts in sequence problems; they also involve product styles, experimental groups, and patent component counts.

patterns.name: Quantity or configuration items following multiple
patterns.context: Describes a product, work, or system as having multiple chapters, modes, or versions; usually a quantity-and-configuration expression in a noun phrase.

patterns.name: Question prompts in number sequences
patterns.context: After many numbers, a comma-separated sequence, or a formula, a question asks for the next item or the nth item.

patterns.name: Number of styles or categories of an item
patterns.context: Describes or reviews an item and states that it comes in two styles; item names such as miniatures and minis also appear in the sentence.

patterns.name: Number of research experimental groups
patterns.context: Methods descriptions in animal experiments state that the subjects were divided into several groups.

patterns.name: Quantity expressions for multiple entities or components
patterns.context: A patent describes an inhaler and its blister-pack structure, mentioning multiple cavities and their arrangement; this differs somewhat from the first three types of quantity expression.

11_2805.description: 激活集中于多项配置或数量表达，以及数列题中的“What…term/next”提示；另涉及商品样式、实验分组和专利部件数量。

patterns.name: multiple 后接数量或配置项
patterns.context: 描述产品、作品或系统具有多个章节、模式或版本；通常是名词短语中的数量与配置表达。

patterns.name: 数字序列中的问答提示
patterns.context: 大量数字、逗号分隔的数列或公式之后，出现询问下一项或第 n 项的题目提示。

patterns.name: 物品的样式或类别数
patterns.context: 评论或描述某类物品时，说明其有两种样式；句中还出现 miniatures、minis 等物品名称。

patterns.name: 研究实验分组数量
patterns.context: 动物实验方法描述中，交代受试动物被分为若干组。

patterns.name: 多个实体或部件的数量表达
patterns.context: 专利对吸入器及其泡罩包装结构进行描述，提及多个凹穴及其排列方式；与前三类的数量表达不完全一致。

en.description: Primarily responds to text containing quantity and structural information: solution prompts after mathematical sequences/formulas, repeated fields in code, and descriptions specifying the number and organization of versions, sections, modes, arrays, or components. The commonality is the proximity of numbers or multiplicity to structured nouns and formatting.

patterns.name: Math sequences and find-the-next-term problems
patterns.context: A numerical sequence or algebraic expression is followed by a request to find a term, the next number, or a variable; also includes formulas and answer formats in math problems

patterns.name: Formatted output of numbers and code fields
patterns.context: Repeated tab-delimited records with hexadecimal values following fields, formatted as code or tabular data output

patterns.name: Release notes for multiple versions or parts
patterns.context: Describes the release versions, categories, or number of sections of media, software, or works, often with numerical quantifiers and version/part nouns

patterns.name: Descriptions of multiple modes, layers, or components in technical patents
patterns.context: Patent text uses technical nouns and structural modifiers to describe device operating modes, arrangements, layers, or composition

11_2805.description: 主要响应带数量与结构信息的文本：数学序列/公式后的求解提示、代码中的重复字段，以及说明版本、章节、模式、阵列或构件数目与组织方式的描述。共同点是数字或多重性与结构化名词、格式相邻。

patterns.name: 数学数列与续项题
patterns.trigger: “What is the u'th term of” “What is next in” “What is i?”，以及相邻数值、逗号、问号
patterns.context: 数值序列或代数表达式后提出求项、求下一个数或求变量的问题；也包括数学题中的公式和答案格式

patterns.name: 数字与代码字段的格式化输出
patterns.context: 制表符分隔的重复记录，字段后跟十六进制数值，呈现为代码或数据表输出

patterns.name: 多版本或多部分发行说明
patterns.context: 描述媒体、软件或作品的发行版本、类别或章节数量，常出现数字数量词与版本/部分名词
patterns.domain: 百科全书式产品与作品介绍

patterns.name: 技术专利中的多模式、层次或构件描述
patterns.trigger: “multiple power modes”“longitudinal arrays or layers”“two opposing faces”
patterns.context: 专利文本以技术性名词和结构性修饰语说明装置的工作模式、排列、层次或组成

en.description: Activations occur in structured text: formatted code or number sequences, technical abbreviations and components, legal ruling boilerplate, medical lesion terminology, and music release information. These contexts have no clear shared theme.

patterns.name: Number sequences and formatted math problems
patterns.context: Numbers or code are listed line by line in a fixed format, with line breaks, commas, or special markers; math problems ask about sequence terms.
patterns.domain: Math Q&A, GitHub data or code

patterns.name: Abbreviations and component names in technical documents
patterns.context: Technical descriptions involve software-generated files, hardware structures, or low-power controllers, often containing uppercase abbreviations, paths, and compound terms.

patterns.name: Legal ruling format
patterns.context: Parties, lawyers, judges, ruling language, and statutory citations in court rulings or case records.

patterns.name: Medical lesions and histological descriptions
patterns.context: Describes imaging findings, lesion location and nature, and diagnosis after excision.

patterns.name: Music release information and version counts
patterns.context: Introduces a single’s release order, regions, versions, and CD/DVD configurations.

11_2805.description: 激活出现在结构化文本中：格式化代码或数字序列、技术缩写与组件、法律判决套语、医学病灶术语及音乐发行信息；各类语境并无明显共同主题。

patterns.name: 数字序列及格式化数学题
patterns.trigger: 「What is the u'th term of」或「What is the z'th term of」，后接逗号分隔的整数序列；另有「2d」「AF_V」「END」「OR」等格式化序列
patterns.context: 数字或代码以固定格式逐行列出，包含换行、逗号或特殊标记；数学题中询问序列项

patterns.name: 技术文档中的缩写与组件名称
patterns.context: 技术描述涉及软件生成文件、硬件结构或低功耗控制器，常出现大写缩写、路径和复合术语

patterns.name: 法律判决格式
patterns.trigger: 「General, for appellee State」「Considered by Vogel, P.J.」以及「For the reasons that follow, we affirm」「In July 1994」
patterns.context: 法院判决或案件记录中的当事人、律师、法官、裁决用语和法条引文

patterns.name: 医学病变与组织学描述
patterns.context: 描述影像检查发现、病灶位置与性质，以及切除后的诊断

patterns.name: 音乐发行信息与版本数量
patterns.trigger: 「eighth Japanese single」「double A-side single」「released in four editions」
patterns.context: 介绍单曲发行次序、地区、版本及CD/DVD配置

en.description: Activations are distributed across number- and symbol-dense formats, mathematical sequences, “two + noun” enumerations in encyclopedic text, and split word fragments; legal citations, recipe instructions, and hyphenated review text also appear, making it difficult to assign a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Numeric separators and formatted values
patterns.context: Activations occur in structured numbers, equations, or sequences; numbers and punctuation are dense, sometimes including hexadecimal-like forms or algebraic expressions.

patterns.name: Quantity expressions and enumerations with “two”
patterns.context: “two” appears in phrases listing versions, types, games, or other categories, often immediately before a specific noun.

patterns.name: Fragments within English words and rare spellings
patterns.context: Words are split across multiple tokens, with activations on internal word fragments; the words may be proper nouns, technical terms, or medical terms.

patterns.name: Digitized legal citations
patterns.context: Letters, periods, symbols, and numbers form statutory identifiers embedded in citations in legal judgments.

patterns.name: Actions and quantities in cooking steps
patterns.context: Cooking actions, utensils, times, and food names occur in succession in recipe instructions.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and affix-like word splitting
patterns.context: Hyphenated compounds or split brand names, product names, and ordinary word fragments appear in review text.

patterns.name: Function words in general English phrases
patterns.context: These common words appear in coherent prose or math problem statements, but no stable cross-passage semantic collocation explains their activations.

11_2805.description: 激活分散于数字与符号密集格式、数学数列、百科中 two+名词枚举，以及拆分词片段；另见法律引文、食谱指令和评论断词，难归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字分隔符与格式化数值
patterns.context: 激活出现在结构化数字、算式或数列中；数字和标点密集，部分含有十六进制样式或代数表达式。

patterns.name: “two”数量表达与枚举
patterns.trigger: « two»、« two»«9»；如 “two styles”“two previous Sakura games”“in two varieties”“in two editions”
patterns.context: two 出现在列举版本、类型、游戏或其他类别的短语中，常紧接具体名词。

patterns.name: 英语词内部分片与罕见拼写
patterns.context: 词被拆分成多个 token，激活落在词内部片段；词本身可能是专名、技术术语或医学词。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科技术文章

patterns.name: 数字化法律引文
patterns.context: 字母、句点、符号与数字组成法规编号，嵌在法律判决的引文中。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的动作与数量
patterns.trigger: « in»、« and»、« to»、« onto»；“10 to 12 minutes”
patterns.context: 食谱操作说明中，烹饪动作、器具、时间和食物名称连续出现。

patterns.name: 专名及词缀式断词
patterns.context: 连字符复合词或被拆分的品牌、产品名和普通词片段出现在评论文本中。

patterns.name: 一般英语短语中的功能词
patterns.context: 这些常见词出现在连贯散文或数学题干中，但没有一个跨段稳定的语义搭配可解释其激活。

en.concept: Local structural markers in mixed text
