en.description: Primarily occurs in number-sequence problems, responding to question prompts, number sequences, and commas between terms; sporadic patterns also include music-article titles, aligned code tables, product-review wording, and the technical term yEnc.

patterns.name: Commas between terms in sequence problems
patterns.context: Commas occur between number-sequence terms, especially before a question mark or prompts such as “what is next / what is the n'th term”; comma activations vary in strength.

patterns.name: Question phrases in sequence problems
patterns.context: The prompt in a sequence or term-order problem asks for the next term or the nth term; activations cluster near the start of the prompt and vary in strength.

patterns.name: High-place-value digits or terms in number sequences
patterns.context: In number-sequence problems, sequence terms, digit fragments, and adjacent punctuation may all activate; marked digit positions vary across problems and cannot be attributed to one specific number.

patterns.name: Music work titles and album descriptions
patterns.context: An album or single introduction states its single number, release format, and version after the title; the same passage also marks words such as “is the eighth”, “single”, and “A-side”.

patterns.name: Formatted table fields in code
patterns.context: Code or terminal output lists B identifiers and values/expressions to the right of equals signs, possibly related to table alignment; local letters, numbers, and equals signs all activate.

patterns.name: Appearance and quantity expressions in product descriptions
patterns.context: A product review describes the appearance and theme of paper miniature models and mentions two styles; activations fall on descriptive words, prepositions, and quantity words.

patterns.name: yEnc name and technical description
patterns.context: Technical descriptions of yEnc encoding, decoding, and the related tool yProxy; markings cover name fragments and neighboring words.

11_2805.concept: 混合文本中的局部结构标记
11_2805.description: 主要出现在数列题中，响应题干提示、数字序列及项间逗号；另有音乐条目标题、代码对齐表格、商品评论措辞和 yEnc 技术名词等零散模式。

patterns.name: 数列题中的标点逗号
patterns.context: 逗号出现在数字序列项之间，尤其后接问号或“what is next / what is the n'th term”一类数列题提示；逗号被标记的强度不一。

patterns.name: 数列题的题干短语
patterns.context: 数列或项序问题中，题干询问下一项或第 n 项；触发集中在题干开头，强度并不一致。

patterns.name: 数字序列中的高位数字或项
patterns.trigger: 如 «2»、«3»、«4»，以及逗号后数字中的被标记数字
patterns.context: 数字序列题中，序列项、数字片段及其相邻标点均可能激活；不同题目中被标记的数字位置不固定，不能归为单一特定数字。

patterns.name: 音乐作品标题及专辑描述
patterns.trigger: «Number Nine / Memories: You Gave Me Guidance»
patterns.context: 专辑或单曲介绍中，标题之后说明其单曲序号、发行形式和版本；同段还标记了“is the eighth”“single”“A-side”等词。

patterns.name: 代码中的格式化表格字段
patterns.context: 代码或终端输出中，逐行列出 B 编号与等号右侧的数值/表达式，可能与表格对齐格式有关；局部字母、数字和等号均有激活。

patterns.name: 产品描述中的外观与数量表达
patterns.context: 商品评论描述纸质微缩模型的外观和主题，并提到两种款式；激活落在描述词、介词及数量词上。

patterns.name: yEnc 名称与技术说明
patterns.context: 围绕 yEnc 编码、解码及相关工具 yProxy 的技术说明；标记覆盖名称片段及邻近词。

en.description: Primarily responds to question wording in math sequence problems, such as asking for the number of terms or the next term; also responds to expressions of version, format, model, or chapter counts in encyclopedic text. Ordinals for century ranges and chemical spectral values and abbreviations also occur, possibly reflecting sensitivity to numbers and structured text.

patterns.name: Question wording for the number of terms in math problems
patterns.context: Trigger phrases occur in math problem statements containing sequences, expressions, and numbers; the adjacent sequence content itself varies widely.

patterns.name: Formatted sequences of numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Activations occur near phrases describing the number of items, versions, or chapters, often combining numeric quantifiers with hyphens, commas, or nouns; a math context is not required.

patterns.name: Chemical spectral notation
patterns.context: Adjacent to spectral peaks, chemical-bond abbreviations, and chemical assignments in parentheses.

patterns.name: Response to words before even numbers or special values
patterns.context: In music recording descriptions, indicates a century range spanning historical periods; this activation does not fully match the formatted quantity expressions in the same passage.

11_2805.description: 主要响应数学数列题中的问项数、求下一项等题干；另在百科文本中响应版本、格式、型号或章节数量表达。还见于世纪范围的序数词及化学光谱数值、缩写记法，可能反映对数字与结构化文本的敏感。

patterns.name: 数学题中表示项数的问题用语
patterns.trigger: “What is the u'th term”“What is the o'th term”“What is the w'th term”“What comes next”“What is next in”
patterns.context: 触发短语出现在包含数列、表达式和数字的数学题干中；相邻数列内容本身变化很大。

patterns.name: 数字与标点的格式化序列
patterns.trigger: “four editions: two Limited CD+DVD”“in a number of formats”“in two- and three-pickup models”“features a female protagonist”“in multiple chapters”
patterns.context: 激活出现在叙述物品、版本或章节数量的短语附近，常见数字数量词与连字符、逗号或名词搭配；不要求是数学语境。

patterns.name: 化学光谱记法
patterns.context: 紧邻光谱峰值、化学键缩写及括号中的化学归属。

patterns.name: 双数或特殊数值前的词语反应
patterns.context: 在音乐录音介绍中，表示跨越历史时期的世纪范围；这处激活与同段的格式数量表达并不完全相同。

en.description: Activations are distributed across quantity-and-category expressions in product descriptions, “which term” questions in sequence problems, binary-form clauses in licenses, and citations to legal provisions; mathematical symbols and digit strings also activate.

patterns.name: “in two” and expressions listing varieties/styles/models
patterns.context: Describes an item's categories, styles, or configurations, often with the quantity “two” introduced by “in” or “come in,” followed by “varieties,” “models,” “styles,” etc.; adjacent passages also include “in four editions.”

patterns.name: Questions about indexed terms in math sequences
patterns.context: A sequence problem first lists a numeric sequence or recurrence, then asks for the term at a particular index; the marked feature is the question format involving an ordinal variable and “term.”

patterns.name: Binary-form clauses in open-source licenses
patterns.context: License or copyright notices specify conditions for redistribution of source and binary forms, often alongside “source code/source forms.”

patterns.name: Legal citations and provision numbers in tax litigation
patterns.context: A judicial case narrative cites a provision of the U.S. Code; activations fall on the section symbol and statutory number.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols in special characters and digit strings

en.description: Activations are concentrated on numbers, minus signs, and nearby prompt fragments in math sequence problems; they also occur in two-quantity phrases and sporadic proper names, products, or model descriptions. There is insufficient evidence for a single semantic interpretation across patterns.

patterns.name: Two-digit fragments in math sequence problems
patterns.context: DM Mathematics sequence-completion or nth-term problems, with activations scattered around the prompt and sequence numbers; triggers may involve multi-digit numbers, digit strings, or minus signs, but annotations are insufficient to determine precise boundaries.

patterns.name: Quantity phrases following two
patterns.context: Two indicates a quantity and is followed by a noun or compound noun; occurs in product introductions or version descriptions.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Chandler

patterns.name: Fragments in yEnc/yProxy strings

patterns.name: Appearance descriptions in product reviews
patterns.context: Describes Halloween-themed paper miniature models; activations are sparse and may simply relate to local word forms or tokenization.

patterns.name: Local word fragments in guitar model descriptions
patterns.context: An encyclopedic account of guitar models and pickup configurations; activations are scattered within words or on neighboring words.

patterns.name: Version counts in music release descriptions

11_2805.description: 激活集中于数列数学题的数字、负号及题干邻近片段；另在two数量短语和若干专名、商品或型号描述中出现。跨模式缺乏足够证据支持单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 商品评论中的外观描述
patterns.context: 描述万圣节主题纸制微缩模型；激活稀疏，可能只是与局部词形或分词有关

patterns.context: 日本单曲发行说明，列举发行版本及介质；与数量表达模式重叠

en.description: Activations span several local patterns: descriptions of two styles/variants, music release versions, math questions about term counts, HTML name tables, fixed license wording, hexadecimal constants, and an Italian instruction about pasting long text. No clear common pattern.

patterns.name: Quantity word “two” followed by a category or option
patterns.context: Descriptions of items, software, or models mention two styles, models, or variants; common structures include “in two” + noun or coordinated model descriptions such as “two-and-three.”

patterns.name: Quantity word “four” followed by versions or release configurations
patterns.context: Music release descriptions state that a single was released in several versions, followed by specific version configurations.

patterns.context: A math problem asks for a particular term in a sequence or object; comma-separated numbers follow.

patterns.name: Names and HTML cells in tables
patterns.context: In HTML table rows, cell tags enclose names, which may be split into multiple subword tokens.

patterns.name: Source and binary forms in software licenses
patterns.context: Copyright notices or open-source license clauses describe redistribution and use of source and binary forms.

patterns.name: Hexadecimal constants and assignment format
patterns.context: Hexadecimal numbers prefixed with 0x appear in code or data tables, often aligned with symbols or field values.

patterns.name: Instructions about pasting long text in Italian

11_2805.description: 激活覆盖多类局部模式：描述两种款式/变体、音乐发行版本，数学项数问句，HTML 人名表格，许可证固定措辞，十六进制常量，以及意大利语粘贴长文本说明。共同规律不明显。

patterns.name: 数量词 two 后接类别或选项

patterns.name: 数量词 four 后接版本或发行配置
patterns.context: 音乐发行介绍中，说明单曲以若干版本发行，后接具体版本配置。

patterns.name: 数学问句中的序数词尾
patterns.context: 数学题目询问某数列或对象的第几项；后续出现逗号分隔的数字。

patterns.name: 表格中的人名与 HTML 单元格
patterns.context: HTML 表格行中，单元格标签包裹人名，名字可能被拆分为多个子词 token。

patterns.name: 软件许可证中的源码与二进制形式

patterns.name: 十六进制常量与赋值格式

patterns.name: 意大利语粘贴长文本的说明

en.concept: Quantity-based enumeration and fixed technical phrases
en.description: The strongest pattern is “in two” and similar structures introducing quantities, versions, or options; code samples also contain the fixed license phrase “in source and binary forms.” Other activations are distributed across math sequences, code markers, text processing, and music descriptions, making them difficult to group into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Enumeration of quantities or options after “in two”
patterns.context: The preposition “in” is followed by the number “two” (occasionally “one”) to introduce a category, version, model, or processing method; it is often adjacent to a noun or colon.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, music release descriptions, software explanations, and technical documentation

patterns.name: License wording “source and binary forms”
patterns.context: A fixed phrase in open-source license copyright notices, usually followed by “with or without modification.”
patterns.domain: Software source code and license text

patterns.name: Consecutive values in numeric sequences
patterns.context: Number words or digit strings occur in sequences, years, or expressions of version counts; this does not fully match the “in two” enumeration pattern.

patterns.name: Local markers in formats and filenames
patterns.context: When code, comments, URLs, proper nouns, or spellings are split into tokens, activations fall on punctuation, short subwords, or affixes; there is no unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Source code, URLs, and text tokenization

patterns.name: Questions asking for the next term
patterns.context: A math sequence problem asks for a subsequent term, adjacent to the sequence.

patterns.name: Direction/record separator words in nouns
patterns.context: Text-processing instructions discuss the behavior of newline and backslash characters.

patterns.name: Record and music format descriptions
patterns.context: Describes classical music recordings, downloads, and media formats; these activations are weakly connected to other patterns.

11_2805.concept: 列举数量与固定技术短语
11_2805.description: 强模式是“in two”及相近结构引出数量、版本或选项；代码样本另有许可证固定短语“in source and binary forms”。其余激活分散于数学数列、代码标记、文本处理与音乐描述，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: “in two”后的数量或选项列举
patterns.trigger: «in»6« two»10« styles»；«in»7« four»9« editions»；«in»6« two»9 varieties；«in»5« two»- and three-«pick»up models；«in»5« one« of»5« two»9 ways
patterns.context: 介词 in 后接数词 two（偶尔 one）并引出类别、版本、型号或处理方式；常紧邻名词或冒号。

patterns.name: “source and binary forms”许可语句

patterns.domain: 软件源代码与许可证文本

patterns.name: 数字序列中的连续数值
patterns.context: 数词或数字串处于数列、年份或版本数量表达中；与“in two”列举模式并非完全相同。

patterns.name: 格式与文件名中的局部标记
patterns.context: 代码、注释、URL、专名或拼写被分词切开时，激活落在标点、短子词或词缀上；缺乏统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 表示下一项的问句

patterns.context: 数学序列题中询问后续项，题干与数列相邻。

patterns.name: 名词中的方向/记录分隔词
patterns.context: 文本处理说明中讨论换行符及反斜杠字符的行为。

patterns.name: 唱片与音乐格式描述
patterns.context: 描述古典音乐录音、下载及媒体格式；这些激活与其他模式联系较弱。

en.description: Strong patterns occur with “in two” and item categorization, as well as format language, legal provisions, medical statistical groups, work releases, table names, and political figures; the commonality is unclear.

patterns.name: “in two” and quantity-based categorization
patterns.context: When describing items, versions, models, or release formats, a quantity word follows “in” and introduces a category, style, version, or specification; coordinated lists may follow as well.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, product descriptions, entertainment work references

patterns.name: Variety in formats and languages
patterns.context: The preposition “in” introduces available formats or languages, with quantity expressed by “a number of” or “several” rather than a specific number.

patterns.name: Legal provision numbers
patterns.context: In U.S. statutory citations, §§ and provision numbers, parenthesized letters, and numbers form hierarchical numbering.

patterns.name: Statistical grouping and testing
patterns.context: Methods or results sections describe statistical tests and two groups of participants divided by status.

patterns.name: Work releases and chapter formats
patterns.context: Descriptions of a game or sequel include release information, comparisons with previous works, and release in multiple chapters.

patterns.name: Name fields in HTML tables

patterns.name: Names and political events

11_2805.description: 强模式见“in two”及物品分类，也包括格式语言、法律条款、医学统计分组、作品发行、表格姓名和政治人名；共同点不够明确。

patterns.name: 统计分组与检验

patterns.name: 人名与政治事件

en.description: Primarily responds to category or form lists introduced by “in two”, and also involves classification expressions such as “in three ways”; number activations in mathematical sequences also occur, and some word positions are difficult to explain through a shared pattern.

patterns.name: Enumeration following “in two …”
patterns.context: States that something is divided into two categories or has two forms, often followed by a colon or specific categories; similar enumeration structures also occur with “two …” followed by other quantity words.

patterns.name: Classification list using “one of three ways”

patterns.name: Numbers in math sequence problems

patterns.name: Unexplained residual patterns
patterns.context: Although the passage as a whole contains classification expressions, activations are scattered across other words, and no consistent additional trigger can be identified.

11_2805.description: 主要响应“in two”引出的类别或形式列举，也涉及“三种方式”的分类表达；另有数学数列中的数字激活，部分词位难以由共同模式解释。

patterns.name: “in two …”后的列举

patterns.name: “one of three ways”的分类列举

patterns.name: 数学数列题中的数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在要求寻找数列第 p 项的数学题里；激活落在数列中间的数值。

patterns.name: 未解释的残余模式

patterns.context: 段落整体虽含分类表达，但激活位置分散在其他词语上，无法确定统一的额外触发条件。

en.concept: Categories or options introduced by quantities
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of the form “in + quantity + category/configuration” introducing a categorical list, covering merchandise, versions, medical groups, and holster configurations; also appears in sequence-problem statements and formula answers, and in music download format catalogs.

patterns.name: Enumeration of categories or styles after “in two”
patterns.context: Introduces products, models, versions, research groups, or shape categories, often with a quantity word followed by a list; passage 7 contains a similar variety enumeration, but not strictly an “in two” construction.

patterns.name: Categorization by “in one/three ways”
patterns.context: Uses a number and “ways” to indicate several methods of positioning or configuring something.

patterns.name: Sequence-term questions and formula answers in math problems
patterns.context: Math exercises ask for the rth or wth term of a sequence, followed by an algebraic formula answer; activations are distributed across the question and answer formats.

patterns.name: Catalog of formats for presenting music recordings
patterns.context: Introduces music releases or website-provided recording and download options; this passage does not contain the preceding “in two” enumeration.

11_2805.concept: 数量引出的类别或选项
11_2805.description: 主要响应“in + 数量 + 类别/配置”一类引出分类枚举的表达，涵盖商品、版本、医学分组及枪套方式；也出现在数列题的题干与公式答案，以及音乐下载格式目录中。

patterns.context: 数学练习题要求识别数列的第 r 项或第 w 项，题目后出现代数式答案；激活词分散在题干和答案格式中。

patterns.name: 呈现音乐录音的多格式目录

en.description: Primarily sensitive to expressions like “in two” followed by category, quantity, or group nouns, involving product versions, styles, models, layers, case issues, and study groups; also includes enumeration of “three ways,” legal citation markers, and a single newline activation. Passage 3 is unexplained.

patterns.name: Dividing into two types
patterns.context: When listing, describing, or dividing objects, “in two” / “into two” / “two” is followed by a noun; strong activations cluster around “in/two,” and following nouns are sometimes also marked.
patterns.domain: Various text genres, including encyclopedias, product descriptions, medical papers, and legal documents

patterns.name: Three options or methods
patterns.context: Explicitly lists three methods available for an object; activation falls on “three.”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic prose describing ways to carry a holster

patterns.name: Numbers and legal citation format
patterns.context: Citations to statutes, rules, and parenthetical numbers in legal cases; the § symbol is especially prominent, along with activations on formatting fragments.

patterns.name: Possible newline activation
patterns.context: A newline marker in a quotation is marked on its own; this is a single instance, so its relation to other patterns is unclear.

11_2805.description: 主要对“in two”及其后接类别、数量或分组名词的表达敏感，涉及产品版本、款式、型号、层数、案件问题和研究分组；另见“三种方式”的列举、法律引文标记，以及单例换行符激活。第3段无法解释。

patterns.name: 分成两种类型

en.concept: Quantity-based categorization and listing of options
en.description: Every passage contains expressions quantifying multiple versions, options, methods, levels, or categories; the neuron often activates on “in/into + quantity + category noun” and nearby enumeration contexts. The medical passages also involve patient groups and time points.

patterns.name: Quantity-based introductory phrase
patterns.context: When describing things, products, works, samples, or steps divided by quantity, offered in multiple versions, or grouped, a quantifier or number is often followed by a category or unit noun; activations are distributed across the quantity expression and nearby words, and do not always fall in the same position.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia descriptions, product descriptions, website copy, medical papers

patterns.name: Listing forms and options
patterns.context: A number or quantity phrase introduces available versions, styles, models, methods, formats, or languages; often appears before a colon, list, or subsequent explanation.

patterns.name: Research grouping and measurement time points
patterns.context: Medical papers describe surgical stratification, patient grouping, or research comparisons; statistical contexts also list follow-up time points.

patterns.name: Local activations near names or work titles
patterns.context: Activations also occur in sentences containing proper nouns, but the more prominent adjacent structure is still the quantity-based categorization that follows; it is uncertain whether the proper nouns themselves are independent triggers.

patterns.name: Unexplained accompanying contexts
patterns.context: There are activations near these words, but the examples alone cannot establish whether they form independent triggers apart from co-occurring with subsequent quantity-based categorization statements.
patterns.domain: Product/weapon descriptions, medical papers, and abstracts

11_2805.description: 所有段都出现数量化的多版本、选项、方式、层次或类别表达；神经元常在“in/into + 数量 + 类别名词”及邻近列举语境激活，医学段还涉及患者分组和时间点。

patterns.name: 分类数量引导语
patterns.trigger: "in two varieties"、"in four editions"、"in two styles"、"in two- and three-pickup models"、"in three ways"、"in a number of formats"、"in several languages"、"in multiple chapters"、"in two layers"、"into two subgroups"、"into two categories"
patterns.context: 描述事物、产品、作品、样本或步骤按数量划分、提供多种版本或分组时，常见量词或数字后接类别/单位名词；激活分布在数量表达及其附近词语，并不总是只落在同一位置。
patterns.domain: 百科介绍、商品描述、网站文案、医学论文

patterns.name: 形式与选项列举
patterns.trigger: "two varieties"、"four editions"、"two styles"、"two- and three-pickup models"、"three ways"、"a number of formats"、"several languages"
patterns.context: 数量词或数量短语引出可供选择的版本、款式、型号、方式、格式或语言；常在冒号、列表或后续说明之前。

patterns.name: 研究对象分组与测量时间点
patterns.trigger: "in two layers"、"divided into two subgroups"、"classified into two categories"；另有 "pre-, 1 month, 6 months, and final follow-up"
patterns.context: 医学论文中描述手术分层、患者分组或研究比较；统计语境还列出随访时间点。

patterns.name: 名称或作品名附近的局部激活
patterns.trigger: "yProxy"、"Number Nine / Memories: You Gave Me Guidance"、"Sakura Fantasy"
patterns.context: 专名所在句中也有激活，但更明显的邻近结构仍是随后出现的数量分类表达；专名自身是否为独立触发因素不确定。

patterns.name: 未完全解释的随附语境
patterns.context: 这些词附近有激活，但仅凭例子无法确认它们除与后续数量分类语句共现外是否构成独立触发条件。
patterns.domain: 商品/武器说明、医学论文与摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to quantity and classification expressions in noun phrases, especially numerals indicating the number of styles, versions, groups, modes, or components; sporadic activations also occur on in, time/model numbers, and some proper names, medical terms, and common function words.

patterns.name: Grouping, classification, or quantity expressions after numerals
patterns.context: A numeral in a noun phrase indicates the number of classifications, styles, versions, groups, modes, or components; nearby words often include in or into, or a noun directly follows the numeral.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, product and entertainment introductions, medical papers

patterns.name: Local activations on the preposition in
patterns.context: The preposition in is followed by a quantity, time, or other noun phrase; not every in is marked. The trigger appears biased toward uses adjacent to classification, release, time, or structural descriptions.

patterns.name: Division into two groups in medical statistics
patterns.context: A clinical study divides patients into two subgroups according to a particular status.

patterns.name: Measurement data analysis and listing of time points
patterns.context: A methods section lists follow-up times or the times, tools, and procedures for data analysis.

patterns.name: Numeric expressions in identifiers or model numbers
patterns.context: A number appears as part of a product model or as a publication year; these numbers may share a numeric/classification tendency with nearby quantity expressions, but evidence is weak.

patterns.name: Local activations in encoding names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Subwords within special encoding names or proper nouns are marked, without the clear syntactic conditions found in numeral-based grouping patterns.

patterns.name: Number of electric guitar pickups
patterns.context: In a product model description, a numeral is linked to the compound word pickup to indicate the pickup configuration.

patterns.name: Local activations in anatomical and histological terms
patterns.context: Specialized terms in medical surgery or anatomical descriptions are marked in fragments; no clear shared syntactic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Medical imaging classification components
patterns.context: An imaging system divides a plaque into multiple components, with a number indicating the number of categories.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on common function words such as prepositions and articles
patterns.context: Distributed across different syntactic positions, with no stable, independent trigger condition.

11_2805.description: 主要响应名词短语中的数量与分类表达，尤其数词表示款式、版本、组别、方式或组成数量；也有 in、时间/型号数字及若干专名、医学术语和常见功能词的零散激活。

patterns.name: 数词后的分组、分类或数量表达
patterns.trigger: « two»、« three»、« four»，以及“in two varieties/styles/editions/models”“two subgroups”“three ways”“four major components”等
patterns.context: 数词出现在名词短语中，表示分类、款式、版本、组别、方式或组成部分的数量；附近常有 in、into，或名词直接跟在数词后
patterns.domain: 百科条目、产品与娱乐介绍、医学论文

patterns.name: 介词 in 的局部激活
patterns.trigger: « in»，如“comes in two varieties”“released in four editions”“in May 2015”“in two layers”“in 2016”
patterns.context: 介词 in 后接数量、时间或其他名词短语；并非所有 in 都有标记，触发似乎偏向与分类、发布、时间或结构描述相邻的用法

patterns.name: 医学统计中的两组划分
patterns.context: 临床研究中按某项状态将患者分为两个亚组

patterns.name: 测量数据分析与时间点列举
patterns.trigger: “Data were analyzed … in « 2016»”及“6 months”等时间点
patterns.context: 研究方法段落列出随访时间或数据分析的时间、工具和流程

patterns.name: 编号或型号中的数值表达
patterns.context: 数值作为产品型号的一部分或出版年份出现；这些数值可能与周边的数量表达共享数字/分类倾向，但证据较弱

patterns.name: 编码名称与专名的局部激活
patterns.context: 特殊编码或专名内部的子词被标记，缺乏与数词分组模式相同的明显句法条件

patterns.name: 电吉他拾音器数量表达
patterns.context: 产品型号描述中，数词与复合词 pickup 相连，表示拾音器配置

patterns.name: 解剖与组织学术语中的局部激活
patterns.context: 医学手术或解剖描述中的专业词被拆分标记，未见明确共同句法触发条件
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 病例/手术描述

patterns.name: 医学影像分类组件
patterns.context: 影像系统将斑块划分为多个成分，数字表示分类数目
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学影像研究

patterns.name: 介词或冠词等常见功能词的零散激活
patterns.context: 分布于不同句法位置，未体现稳定、独立的触发条件

en.description: Often activates around quantity words (especially “two”) and the following categories, options, groups, or issues; also occurs in product configurations, work chapters, and descriptions of study timing, though the triggering contexts are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Two or more types and styles
patterns.context: The quantity word “two” is adjacent to or associated with categories, styles, or types, often followed by a specific list or categorization; this pattern recurs across multiple passages.

patterns.name: Product specifications or configuration options
patterns.context: Introduces product or work versions, models, configurations, or usage methods, with a quantity word introducing subsequent options.

patterns.name: Work installments or chapters
patterns.context: Describes a game’s relationship to its predecessor, or states that a work was released in multiple chapters; the “in two” construction is not necessarily present.

patterns.name: Grouping and time points in research
patterns.context: Clinical research describes participant groups or lists follow-up time points; quantity words are used for study design or measurement schedules.

patterns.name: Numbered issues in legal texts
patterns.context: An account of an appellate proceeding introduces legal questions as “two issues.”

patterns.name: Data analysis and time conditions
patterns.context: Analysis years and time conditions in a study methods section; no corresponding type enumeration or “two” construction appears in other passages.

11_2805.description: 常在数量词（尤其 two）及其后续分类、选项、分组或争点附近激活；也见于产品配置、作品章节和研究时间描述，具体触发语境并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 两种或多种类型、款式
patterns.context: 数量词 two 紧邻或关联于类别、款式、类型，常接具体列表或分类说明；该模式在多段中重复出现。

patterns.name: 产品规格或配置选项
patterns.trigger: «in»…« two»- and« three»-«pick»«up» models；«in»« four» editions；«in»…« three» ways
patterns.context: 介绍产品、作品的版本、型号、配置或使用方式，数量词引出后续选项。

patterns.name: 作品分期或章节
patterns.context: 叙述游戏作品与前作的关系，或说明作品以多个章节发行；不一定出现“in two”结构。

patterns.name: 研究中的分组与时间点
patterns.context: 临床研究描述受试者分组，或列出随访时间点；数量词用于研究设计或测量安排。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的争点编号
patterns.context: 上诉程序叙述中以“两个争点”引出法律问题。

patterns.name: 数据分析与时间条件
patterns.context: 研究方法段落中的分析年份及时间条件；未见与其他段落的类型枚举或“two”结构相呼应。

en.description: Primarily responds to classification, style, version, configuration, or layer expressions introduced by quantity words, especially “in two …” and “two + category noun”; it also covers research groupings, format enumerations, and sporadic within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Quantity or type enumeration following “come in”
patterns.context: When describing products, versions, games, or publications, a quantity or category word follows “in”, often introducing subsequent classifications, configurations, or lists.

patterns.name: “two” and its classification collocations
patterns.context: The quantity word two occurs before nouns for categories, groups, styles, configurations, or layers, and may also occur in hyphenated configuration descriptions.

patterns.name: Classification or enumeration introduced by other quantity words
patterns.context: Introduces multiple options such as versions or formats; triggers are not limited to two and also include quantity expressions such as four and number of.

patterns.name: Statistical analysis and grouping expressions
patterns.context: Study subjects are divided into two groups or categories according to a status or characteristic; the phrase need not contain “in”, but retains a quantity-and-category enumeration structure.

patterns.name: Layered structures in medical procedures
patterns.context: Describes the number of layers in surgical suturing or tissue repair; unlike general product classification, it likewise features a quantity word two plus a structural category noun.
patterns.domain: Medical case reports or surgical papers

patterns.name: Quantity descriptions of sources, time, and format
patterns.context: A quantity or range specifies research institutions, a time interval, or formats provided by a website; the first two are only weakly connected to the dominant “quantity + style/category” pattern.

patterns.name: Segmentation fragments within or at the boundaries of English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on segmented words, proper nouns, or morpheme fragments; they occur in technical names, brands, specialized terms, and other texts, making it difficult to infer an independent, consistent semantic trigger from these fragments.

11_2805.description: 主要响应数量词引出的分类、款式、版本、配置或层数表达，尤以“in two …”及“two + 类别名词”为强；亦覆盖研究分组、格式枚举和若干零散词内片段。

patterns.name: “come in”后列举数量或类型
patterns.trigger: « comes»3« in»6« two»10 varieties»；« come»1« in»6« two»9 styles»；« released»1« in»6« four»9 editions»；« released»« in»6« multiple»8 chapters»
patterns.context: 描述产品、版本、游戏或出版物时，数量词或类别词紧跟“in”，常引出后续分类、配置或清单。
patterns.domain: 百科、商品介绍、用户评论

patterns.name: “two”及其分类搭配
patterns.trigger: « two»10 varieties»；« two»9 styles»；« two»9-«；« two»8 subgroups»；« two»8 categories»；« two»8« layers»
patterns.context: 数量词 two 出现在类别、分组、款式、配置或层数等名词前，也可出现在连字符构成的配置描述中。

patterns.name: 其他数量词引出的分类或枚举
patterns.trigger: « in»6« four»9« editions»；« a»« number»2« of»5« formats»
patterns.context: 介绍不同版本、格式等多个选项；触发不限于 two，也包括 four、number of 等数量表达。

patterns.name: 统计分析与分组表达
patterns.trigger: « divided»« into»5« two»8 subgroups»；« classified»« into»3« two»8« categories»
patterns.context: 研究对象按状态或特征划分为两组或两类；未必含“in”，但保留数量与类别的列举结构。

patterns.name: 医疗操作中的分层结构
patterns.context: 描述手术缝合或组织修复的层数；与一般产品分类不同，但同样出现数量词 two 加结构类别名词。

patterns.name: 资料来源、时间及格式的数量描述
patterns.trigger: « from»1« 34»1 hospitals»；« in»4 the United States« from»2 November to December 2016»；« in»3« a»1« number»2« of»5« formats»
patterns.context: 数量或范围用于交代研究机构、时间区间，或网站提供的格式；前两类与主导的“数量+款式/类别”模式联系较弱。

patterns.name: 英文词内部或边界的切分片段
patterns.trigger: « y»1«Enc»1；«Proxy»；« M»2eter«Plus»；« Ev»2«enson»2；« Ar»1«ion»2« mini»2atures；« T»2-ara；« ph»2aryngeal；« muc»2o-«per»1ioste«al»1
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词、专名或词素片段上；出现于技术名称、品牌、专业术语等文本中，难以从这些片段归纳出独立一致的语义触发条件。

en.concept: Parameters and numbers in scientific texts
en.description: Diverse activation patterns: a clear preference for “pH” and its numerical conditions; also responds to digit strings containing “1920,” list formatting, experimental parameters, and technical terms. A few passages can only be described by their specific domain content and are difficult to assign to a unified mechanism.

patterns.name: Occurrence of pH
patterns.context: In scientific or patent texts, as a measurement metric, experimental condition, or adjustment target; followed by a value, range, or other parameter
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, NIH project descriptions, patents

patterns.name: 1920 and adjacent digits
patterns.context: Appears in years, dates, or similar digit sequences; sometimes the digits are split into multiple tokens
patterns.domain: Historical figure lineages, academic entries, mathematical citations, film classifications; also digit strings in emails

patterns.name: Enumerated items and category formatting
patterns.context: Proper names or category labels arranged compactly in entries, references, or classification lists

patterns.name: Scientific experimental parameters and materials
patterns.context: Materials, values, and measurement parameters occur together in experimental methods or results
patterns.domain: PubMed biochemistry and food science abstracts

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and anatomical terms
patterns.context: Technical entities or terms in biomedical texts; triggering substrings are scattered, with no clear shared word form

patterns.name: Preparation/formulation context in patents
patterns.context: Describes latex product manufacturing, formulation, or pH adjustment

patterns.name: Numbers and transaction judgments in emails
patterns.context: Digit strings occur alongside judgments about whether a transaction is good or bad, with names or codes

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and citations
patterns.context: An author-and-year citation follows a formula

patterns.name: Medical disease names
patterns.context: Title-like phrases describing eye diseases and related blood vessels

11_2834.concept: 科学文本中的参数与数字
11_2834.description: 激活模式多样：明显偏好“pH”及其数值条件；另对含“1920”的数字串、列表排版、实验参数和专业术语有响应。少数段落仅能由其具体领域内容描述，难归入统一机制。

patterns.name: pH 的出现
patterns.trigger: “pH”，紧邻数字或实验条件时尤为明显
patterns.context: 在科学或专利文本中，作为测量指标、实验条件或调节目标；后接数值、范围或其他参数
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目描述、专利

patterns.name: 1920 年及相邻数字
patterns.context: 出现在年份、日期或类似数字序列中；有时数字被切分成多个 token
patterns.domain: 历史人物谱系、学术条目、数学引文、电影分类；另有邮件中的数字串

patterns.name: 列举式条目与分类排版
patterns.context: 条目、参考资料或分类列表中，专名或类别标签以紧凑格式排列

patterns.name: 科学实验参数与材料
patterns.trigger: “Sephadex A-50”“Sephadex G-100”“50 kD”“8.0”“50”；以及“11 W/cm2”“40, 60, and 80 min”“10, 7 and 14 d”
patterns.context: 实验方法或结果中，材料、数值和测量参数相邻出现
patterns.domain: PubMed 生化与食品科学摘要

patterns.name: 生物医学术语及解剖名词
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中的专业实体或术语；触发子串分散，并无明显统一词形
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 专利中的制备/配方语境
patterns.context: 描述乳胶制品生产、配方或 pH 调节

patterns.name: 邮件中的数字与交易判断
patterns.context: 数字串与对某项交易好坏的判断并列，含人名或代号

patterns.name: 数学公式及引文
patterns.context: 公式之后接作者与年份引文

patterns.name: 医学疾病名称
patterns.context: 标题式短语中描述眼科疾病及相关血管

en.concept: Specific strings in numerical and technical entries
en.description: Activations often occur on year numbers, pH, and experimental values, and also appear in names and item lists; other local patterns include transaction evaluations, meat experiments, and ophthalmic terminology, which cannot all be explained by a single trigger.

patterns.name: Year and date numbers
patterns.context: Years appear in birth and death dates, historical references, and chronological classifications; in 1, “1920” also appears near a transaction amount. Not all numbers trigger.
patterns.domain: Biography, history, encyclopedia categories, mathematical references, and business email

patterns.name: pH conditions
patterns.context: Appears in experimental conditions or formulation descriptions, followed by or associated with values, adjusting agents, and influencing factors; activation is marked on pH itself.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, chemical, and patent technical texts

patterns.name: Molecular weight and material properties
patterns.context: Characterization of enzymes or bacterial regulatory factors, involving molecular weight, stability, heat treatment, or experimental measurement.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: References and list-style names/institutions
patterns.context: Years and item boundaries in encyclopedia-style lists, genealogies, or references; this pattern overlaps with year numbers but is not fully explained by them.

patterns.name: Business transaction amounts and evaluations
patterns.context: Email discussing whether a transaction benefits Cal; activation is scattered across the amount, deal, and evaluative words.

patterns.name: Experimental values and color/meat evaluation
patterns.context: Discussion of experimental variables such as ultrasound treatment and storage time, alongside meat pH, color, and their effects.

patterns.name: Medical anatomical terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a medical title about the significance of open-angle glaucoma; this passage has no obvious pH, year, or list trigger.

11_2834.concept: 数值与技术条目中的特定词串
11_2834.description: 激活常落在年份数字、pH及实验数值上，也见于姓名/条目列表；另有交易评价、肉品实验和眼科术语等局部模式，彼此并非都能由单一触发解释。

patterns.name: 年份与日期数字
patterns.context: 年份出现在人名生卒年、历史引用、年代分类中；1 中“1920”还出现在交易金额附近。不是所有数字都触发。
patterns.domain: 传记、历史、百科分类、数学引用及商业邮件

patterns.name: pH 条件
patterns.context: 出现在实验条件或配方说明中，后接或关联数值、调节剂及影响因素；激活标在 pH 本身。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、化学、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 分子量与材料性质
patterns.trigger: “molecular”及其相邻性质描述，如“molecular mass”“molecular weight”
patterns.context: 讨论酶或细菌调节因子的表征，涉及分子量、稳定性、热处理或实验测定。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与 NIH 项目说明

patterns.name: 参考文献与条目式人名/机构列表
patterns.trigger: “1920s”及由姓名、机构、头衔、破折号或换行构成的条目
patterns.context: 百科式列表、人物谱系或参考文献中出现的年份和条目边界；此模式与年份数字有重合，但不完全由年份解释。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目、数学论文引用

patterns.name: 商业交易金额与评价
patterns.context: 邮件中讨论某笔交易对 Cal 是否有利；激活分散在金额、deal 和评价词上。

patterns.name: 实验数值与色泽/肉品评价
patterns.context: 超声处理、储存时间等实验变量与肉品 pH、颜色及其影响的讨论。

patterns.name: 医学解剖术语
patterns.context: 出现在关于开角型青光眼意义的医学标题中；该段没有明显的 pH、年份或列表触发。

en.description: The most prominent recognizable pattern is the year “1920,” spanning email, encyclopedias, and paper references. Other activations come from different medical paper titles or abstracts: an ophthalmology title, a uranium co-migration title, and pH in experimental conditions and results; these medical contexts are not entirely alike.

patterns.name: Year 1920
patterns.context: Appears in year, decade, or historical time information; it may be a year, part of a date range, or occur in a literature citation. The first passage also has an adjacent numerical field, but not every instance of “1920” has the same format.

patterns.name: Ophthalmic terminology in a medical paper title
patterns.context: A PubMed abstract title uses a title-style phrase to discuss the possible significance of the retinal artery; activation is concentrated at the title opening and within the ophthalmic terminology.

patterns.name: Technical terminology and punctuation in a paper title
patterns.context: An abstract title describes the co-migration of uranium and colloids in a granite-grain column; activation appears near the title’s hyphen, colon, and terms such as pH.

patterns.name: pH in biomedical text
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of experimental conditions, measurements, or influencing factors; contexts include meat ultrasound treatment, enzyme properties, and bioassay media.

11_2834.concept: 年份与学术文本标记
11_2834.description: 最突出的可辨模式是年份“1920”，横跨邮件、百科与论文引用。其余激活来自不同医学论文标题或摘要：眼科标题、铀共迁移标题，以及实验条件和结果中的 pH；这些医学语境彼此不完全相同。

patterns.name: 年份 1920
patterns.context: 在年份、年代或历史时间信息中出现；可作为年份、年代范围的一部分，或出现在文献引用中。第 1 段另有相邻的数字字段，但并非所有「1920」都处在同一种格式中。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科条目、学术论文

patterns.name: 医学论文标题中的眼科术语
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要标题中，以标题式短语讨论视网膜动脉的可能意义；激活集中在标题开头和眼科术语内部。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的技术术语与标点
patterns.context: 摘要标题描述铀与胶体在花岗岩颗粒柱中的共迁移；标题中的连字符、冒号以及 pH 等术语附近出现激活。
patterns.domain: 环境化学／地球化学摘要

patterns.name: 生物医学文本中的 pH
patterns.context: 在实验条件、测量结果或影响因素的叙述中出现；包括肉类超声处理、酶性质和生物测定培养基等不同语境。

en.description: Activations are scattered across sentence-initial subword fragments (Wire, Tim), digit strings, fragments within medical and biological terms, and could in email requests; these examples show no unified semantics or stable contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Word-initial Wire
patterns.context: Wire appears at the beginning of a sentence in uppercase; later continued as wire bonding or wireless.

patterns.name: Time or timeline word-initial fragment
patterns.context: Tim appears at the beginning of a sentence, continued as Timeline or Tim:.

patterns.name: Specific fragments in digit strings
patterns.context: Transaction records or numeric strings in emails; another activation falls on «85» in mathematical text.

patterns.name: In-word stem fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-initial or stem fragments within longer words, respectively in texts about pregnancy weight and phylogeny.

patterns.name: could in requests
patterns.context: Informal email requests beginning with “Hey could you...”.

11_2834.concept: none
11_2834.description: 激活分散在句首词片段（Wire、Tim）、数字串，以及医学、生物学词内片段和邮件请求中的 could；这些样例未显示统一语义或稳定上下文模式。

patterns.name: Wire 词首
patterns.context: Wire 位于句首并以大写形式出现；后文将其接成 wire bonding 或 wireless。

patterns.name: 时间或时间线词首
patterns.context: Tim 位于句首，分别续成 Timeline 或 Tim:。

patterns.name: 数字串中的特定片段
patterns.context: 邮件中的交易记录或数值串；另一次激活落在数学文本中的 «85»。

patterns.name: 词内词干片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词内部的词首或词干片段，分别出现在孕期体重和系统发育相关文本中。

patterns.name: 请求语句中的 could
patterns.context: 邮件中以“Hey could you...”开头的非正式请求。

en.description: Activations occur most consistently at newline/paragraph boundaries; others are scattered across split proper names, email greetings and requests, Tim-related text and time expressions, as well as isolated accounting entries, mathematical sequences, and encyclopedia titles, making them difficult to group as a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Newline/paragraph boundary
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on newline characters; in a few passages it also marks the token after a newline. Context often has formatting where a heading or item is followed by body text
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, mathematical text, email, and general web text

patterns.name: Token fragments of proper names or words
patterns.context: Markers fall within proper names or on repeated occurrences of them; words are split into multiple subword tokens. This does not consistently correspond to a particular meaning
patterns.domain: Names, place names, or terms in encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Email request sentences
patterns.context: An email begins by addressing the recipient with Hey, followed by an offer of help or a question; activation falls on greetings, request words, and some pronouns

patterns.name: Timeline headings and time expressions
patterns.context: The word timeline or text beginning with Tim appears, alongside one instance marking a preposition in a time interval; these examples show no clear shared semantic condition

patterns.name: Parallel accounting items
patterns.context: Items are listed in parallel in a balance sheet or accounting classification, followed by a blank line and an introductory phrase to the body text

patterns.name: Mathematical sequences and formulas
patterns.context: A number sequence or problem is followed by a newline and formula; markers cover some numbers, question marks, and symbols in the formula

patterns.name: Title on antisemitism
patterns.context: Words in the title “Timeline of antisemitism” are marked as split tokens; other activations occur in the date fragment following the title

patterns.name: Email salutation and newline after a name
patterns.context: In email, a line beginning with a name or initials as a salutation/recipient line is followed by a newline and the body text

11_2834.concept: 换行与文本边界标记
11_2834.description: 激活最稳定地出现在换行/段落边界；其余散见于被拆分的专名、邮件寒暄请求、Tim相关文本和时间表达，以及单例会计列项、数学序列与百科标题，难以归为同一语义特征。

patterns.name: 换行/段落边界
patterns.context: 激活集中落在换行符上，个别段落还标记换行后的 token；上下文常呈标题或条目后接正文的排版
patterns.domain: 百科条目、数学文本、邮件及一般网页文本

patterns.name: 专名或词语的分词片段
patterns.context: 标记落在专名中间或专名的重复出现处，词被拆成多个子词 token；并非稳定对应某个词义
patterns.domain: 百科文本中的人名、地名或术语

patterns.name: 邮件请求语句
patterns.context: 邮件开头以 Hey 称呼收件人，随后提出帮忙或询问；激活落在寒暄、请求词和部分代词上

patterns.name: 时间线标题及时间表达
patterns.context: 出现 timeline 一词或以 Tim 开头的文本，另有一例标记时间区间介词；这些例子未显示明确共同的语义条件
patterns.domain: 百科标题、邮件、时间记录

patterns.name: 会计科目并列
patterns.context: 资产负债表或会计分类中并列列举科目，后接空行和正文引导语

patterns.name: 数学序列与公式
patterns.context: 数字序列或题目内容后接换行及公式，标记覆盖部分数字、问号和公式中的符号

patterns.name: 反犹主义主题标题
patterns.context: “Timeline of antisemitism”标题中的词被切分标记；其他激活在标题后接的年代片段

patterns.name: 邮件称呼及姓名后的换行
patterns.context: 邮件中以姓名或缩写开头的称呼/收件人行后换行，接续正文

en.description: Activations occur at formatting boundaries across genres: spaces, indentation, line breaks, and the text that follows; they also cover email paragraphs, court headings, attachment lists, code comments, legal notices, and mathematical answer choices, with no unified semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Blank lines and sentence starts after line breaks in email body
patterns.context: In email bodies, two spaces and a line break appear after a sentence or paragraph, followed by a new sentence or paragraph; also seen in the space after a salutation.
patterns.domain: Enron emails, conversational or business email body

patterns.name: Court heading formatting
patterns.context: An uppercase court name is centered and indented across line breaks, forming a fixed legal-document heading.

patterns.name: Line breaks and filenames in attachment lists
patterns.context: After “See attached” in an email, attachment filenames are listed using line breaks and bullets.

patterns.name: Line-comment formatting in code license text
patterns.context: Source-code license notices appear as comment lines beginning with asterisks, line breaks, and indentation.

patterns.name: Contract-like data-use restriction clause
patterns.context: States that data may not be disclosed without written consent and emphasizes data ownership or proprietary rights.
patterns.domain: Legal notices about market data in Enron emails

patterns.name: Mathematics problem answer-choice formatting
patterns.context: Parenthesized letter choices and mathematical expressions are separated by spaces after the problem statement.

11_2834.concept: 排版边界与格式化文本
11_2834.description: 激活出现在多种文体的格式边界：空格、缩进、换行及其后的文本；同时覆盖邮件段落、法院抬头、附件列表、代码注释、法律声明和数学选项，缺少统一语义触发词。

patterns.name: 邮件正文换行后的空行与句首
patterns.context: 邮件正文中句子或段落结束后出现两个空格、换行，随后接续新句或新段；也见于称呼后空格。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件，口语或商务邮件正文

patterns.name: 法院抬头排版
patterns.trigger: «                        »4«UNITED»5« STATES»10 DISTRICT« COURT»3«↵»6«                        »5«FOR»2« THE»3« DISTRICT»1 OF
patterns.context: 大写法院名称以居中缩进和换行排版，出现固定法律文书抬头。

patterns.name: 附件清单中的换行与文件名
patterns.context: 邮件中“See attached”之后，以换行和项目符号列出附件文件名。

patterns.name: 代码许可文本中的行注释格式
patterns.context: 源码许可声明以星号开头的注释行、换行及缩进呈现。
patterns.domain: Github 源码注释/许可证文本

patterns.name: 合同式数据使用限制条款
patterns.trigger: «valuable»9« property»3 rights；« the»6« express»2« written»3« consent
patterns.context: 声明不得未经书面同意披露数据，并强调数据所有权或专有权利。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的市场数据法律声明

patterns.name: 数学题选项排版
patterns.context: 题干后以空格分隔括号字母选项及数学表达式。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on the substring New: it appears in proper names such as New York, New Orleans, and Newar, often at the beginning of a place or name; line-break boundaries also often show weaker activations. Variables and exponents in mathematical formulas form a separate pattern.

patterns.name: Proper names or phrases beginning with New
patterns.context: New is followed by York, Orleans, ar, etc., in proper names, place names, ethnic group names, or titles; the strongest activation usually falls on New itself.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, papers, film reviews, and webpage titles

patterns.name: Newline character
patterns.context: Between titles and body text, at paragraph or entry boundaries; also appears near mathematical problem content.
patterns.domain: Formatting and structural markers across corpora

patterns.name: Mathematical variables and polynomial expressions
patterns.context: Formulas consisting of variables, coefficients, powers, and algebra problem instructions.

patterns.name: Title-style proper-name combinations
patterns.context: Phrases made up of multiple capitalized words in webpage titles or section names; this example does not fully match the New York place-name pattern.

patterns.name: Newar substring within a proper name
patterns.context: Within Newar (the name of a Nepali ethnic group), where New is not an independent New York/Orleans place-name word.

11_2834.concept: New 子串及结构边界
11_2834.description: 激活主要集中于 New 这一子串：它出现在 New York、New Orleans、Newar 等专名中，常处于地名或名称开头；此外换行边界也常有较弱激活。数学公式中的变量与幂次构成单独模式。

patterns.name: New 开头的专名或短语
patterns.context: New 后接 York、Orleans、ar 等，出现在专名、地名、族名或标题中；最强激活多落在 New 本身。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、论文、影评及网页标题

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 标题与正文之间、段落或条目边界处；也出现在数学题目内容附近。
patterns.domain: 多种语料的排版与结构标记

patterns.name: 数学变量与多项式表达式
patterns.context: 变量、系数、幂和代数题目指令构成的公式中。

patterns.name: 标题式专名组合
patterns.context: 网页标题或栏目名中，多个首字母大写词组成短语；此例与 New York 地名模式不完全相同。

patterns.name: 专名中间的 Newar 子串
patterns.context: Newar（尼泊尔族群名称）内部，New 并非独立的 New York/Orleans 地名词。

en.description: Activations occur in three text types: GNU software licenses and their disclaimers, all-uppercase U.S. court names in headings, and algebraic variables, numbers, and expressions in math problems; there is no evidence they share a more specific trigger word.

patterns.name: GNU license identifiers
patterns.context: GNU GPL/LGPL appears in software source-file copyright or license text, often alongside line-break comments, disclaimers, or license versions

patterns.name: U.S. court name headings
patterns.context: All-uppercase headings with official U.S. court names; institution names may include qualifiers such as a state or military branch

patterns.name: Variables and numerical expressions in math problems
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions, integer operations, or digit problems appear alongside natural-language math problem statements

11_2834.concept: 法律/许可与数学文本标记
11_2834.description: 激活出现在三类文本：GNU 软件许可证及其免责声明，标题中的美国法院全大写名称，以及数学题里的代数变量、数字和运算式；没有证据表明它们共享更具体的触发词。

patterns.name: GNU 许可证标识
patterns.context: 软件源文件版权或许可证文本中出现 GNU GPL/LGPL，常伴随换行注释、免责声明或许可版本

patterns.name: 美国法院名称标题
patterns.context: 美国法院正式名称的全大写标题；机构名称可包含州或军种等限定词

patterns.name: 数学题中的变量与数值表达
patterns.context: 代数式、整数运算或数位问题与自然语言数学题干相邻

en.description: Activations often occur on fixed modifiers or fact-finding phrases in legal texts: special verdict/conditions, ultimate facts, prior sexual, final contention, consecutive sentences; also seen with colloquial special and neighbors.

patterns.name: special collocations with legal terms
patterns.context: In legal judgments, special modifies legal concepts such as verdicts, conditions, or rules; often appears in descriptions of disputed issues or remedies.

patterns.name: Legal collocation ultimate facts
patterns.context: Legal discussion of claims, evidence, or fact-finding; ultimate occurs with facts.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw: legal opinions and evidentiary discussion

patterns.name: Collocation prior sexual conduct
patterns.context: Discusses a victim’s prior sexual conduct and the admissibility of evidence.

patterns.name: Collocation final contention
patterns.context: When a court addresses appellate claims one by one, final modifies contention.

patterns.name: Collocation consecutive sentences
patterns.context: Discusses whether the court imposed consecutive sentences after making the required findings.

patterns.name: special in personal evaluations
patterns.context: A colloquial quotation evaluates someone’s character and importance; distinct from the legal usage.

patterns.name: Neighbor relationship context
patterns.context: Describes adjacent parties and the locations of their properties, with no clear semantic collocation shared with the other highlighted words.

11_2834.concept: 法律文本中的突出搭配词
11_2834.description: 激活多出现在法律文本中的固定修饰搭配或事实认定措辞：special verdict/conditions、ultimate facts、prior sexual、final contention、consecutive sentences；另见口语 special 和 neighbors。

patterns.name: special 与法律术语搭配
patterns.context: 法律判决中，special 修饰裁决、条件、规则等法律概念；常出现在对争点或救济措施的描述中。

patterns.name: ultimate facts 法律搭配
patterns.context: 法律论述中谈及主张、举证或事实认定；ultimate 与 facts 连用。

patterns.name: prior sexual conduct 搭配
patterns.context: 讨论被害人既往性行为及证据可采性。

patterns.name: final contention 搭配
patterns.context: 法院逐项处理上诉主张时，final 修饰 contention。

patterns.name: consecutive sentences 搭配
patterns.context: 讨论法院是否作出所需认定后判处连续刑期。

patterns.name: 人物评价中的 special
patterns.context: 口语引述中评价某人的品格及其重要性；与法律用法不同。

patterns.name: 邻居关系语境
patterns.context: 描写相邻当事人及其房产位置，缺少与其他高亮词明显一致的语义搭配。

en.description: Often marks the importance of a factor, stage, condition, or work to subsequent research, judgment, or argument in academic prose; also responds to research-plan stage/goal language, with outlier triggers in introductions to scientific works and URL subword fragments.

patterns.name: Importance or significance of a relationship/following content
patterns.context: When explaining that a concept, finding, condition, or step is important to subsequent understanding, research, judgment, or argument; importance terms often follow an explanatory statement
patterns.domain: Academic papers, research plans, and encyclopedia descriptions

patterns.name: Introduction of research goals, plans, or stages
patterns.context: Describes follow-up research or specific goals of a research project, or transitions from prior work to the current stage; not all these instances explicitly express importance

patterns.name: Scientific works and history of science topics
patterns.context: Introduces someone’s works, especially works about scientific progress; activation falls on a phrase related to the work

patterns.name: In-word fragments in webpage links
patterns.context: A Wikipedia URL embedded in a HackerNews post; the trigger is a subword fragment in the link, not a topic word in the body

patterns.name: Local conditions in formal mathematics
patterns.context: In discussing a proof or technical modification, notes that the main change concerns a particular condition; possibly related to research-importance statements only in the sense of “main/key”

11_2834.concept: 重要性与后续研究
11_2834.description: 多在学术叙述中标记某因素、阶段、条件或工作对后续研究、判断或论证的重要性；也响应研究计划的阶段/目标用语，并有科学著作介绍及URL词片段的离群触发。

patterns.name: 关系/后续内容的关键性或重要性
patterns.context: 在说明某个概念、发现、条件或步骤对后续理解、研究、判断或论证具有重要作用时；重要性词常出现在解释性陈述之后
patterns.domain: 学术论文、科研计划与百科说明

patterns.name: 研究目标、计划或研究阶段的引入
patterns.context: 叙述研究项目的后续研究、具体目标，或从既有工作过渡到当前阶段；并非所有这些位置都明确表达重要性

patterns.name: 科学著作及科学史主题
patterns.context: 介绍某人的著作，尤其是关于科学进步的作品；激活落在作品相关短语中

patterns.name: 网页链接中的词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在HackerNews帖子里的维基百科URL，触发点是链接中的词片段，不是正文主题词

patterns.name: 形式化数学中的局部条件
patterns.context: 讨论证明或技术修改时，说明主要改动涉及某一条件部分；与科研重要性表述可能只在“主要/关键”意义上相近

en.description: Activations mainly fall on words emphasizing commonality (common, share) or importance (key, critical, pivotal); two other examples, atypical and unique, both convey distinction or specialness, though the wording is not consistent.

patterns.name: Commonality/shared features
patterns.context: Different genes, antigenic epitopes, or cells have common features, shared origins, or similarities; often appears in sentences presenting evidence or a hypothesis.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, scientific abstracts, and microbial ecology

patterns.name: Key importance or significance
patterns.context: Modifies a function, role, process, or feature to emphasize that it is important, core, or key; common in academic discussion.

patterns.name: Atypical classification
patterns.context: Describes viral genome combinations that differ from common categories.

patterns.name: Unique cultural impact
patterns.context: Describes the distinctive impact of a group’s experiences on culture.

11_2834.concept: 强调特征的显著性
11_2834.description: 激活主要落在强调共同性（common、share）或重要性（key、critical、pivotal）的词上；另有 atypical、unique 两例，均带有突出区别或特殊性的意味，但词面不统一。

patterns.name: 共同性／共性
patterns.context: 不同基因、抗原表位或细胞之间具有共同特征、共享来源或相似性；常出现于提出证据或假设的句子中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、科研摘要及微生物生态学

patterns.name: 关键性或重要性
patterns.context: 修饰作用、角色、过程或特征，强调其重要、核心或关键；多见于学术论述。

patterns.name: 异常／非典型分类
patterns.context: 描述少数病毒基因组组合区别于常见类别。

patterns.name: 独特文化影响
patterns.context: 描述某群体经历对文化产生的特有影响。
patterns.domain: 维基百科传记／书籍介绍

en.description: Primarily responds to genes/genomes, sequence regions, mutations, and homology descriptions in genetics and molecular biology texts; also covers microbial recombination, plant transposases, experimental screening, and neural circuit gene research.

patterns.name: Genomic regions, sequences, or exons
patterns.context: Describes the structure, location, sequencing, or regional characteristics of genes or genetic elements; some triggers occur in compound gene names or sequence descriptions

patterns.name: Genetic variants and mutations
patterns.context: Discusses genetic diseases, genotypes, or candidate gene variants; often accompanied by gene names, mutation types, or clinical associations

patterns.name: Gene/protein homology and similarity
patterns.context: Compares sequences, proteins, or gene similarity relationships across species or genetic elements

patterns.name: Bacteriophage recombination and gene expression regulation
patterns.context: Explicitly discusses the phage Cin recombinase regulating tail fiber gene expression through DNA segment inversion

patterns.name: Bacterial genomic differences
patterns.context: Compares bacterial genomes, but the passage does not further specify the type of difference

patterns.name: Biological experimental screening or detection workflow
patterns.context: Describes primer amplification performance or preparing a reporter system for high-throughput screening; related to other genetic content but emphasizes experimental methods
patterns.domain: Molecular biology experiments and research plans

patterns.name: Integrase in genetic elements
patterns.context: Analyzes the terminal sequences of a genetic element and notes that they contain an integrase gene

patterns.name: Plant gene candidates and transposase-like proteins
patterns.context: Studies candidate proteins in plant genomes or the similarity between cotton proteins and transposases

patterns.name: Neural circuits and human gene function
patterns.context: Uses C. elegans as a model to study nervous system connectivity and implications for related human genes

11_2834.concept: 基因与遗传机制研究
11_2834.description: 主要对遗传学与分子生物学文本中的基因/基因组、序列区域、突变及同源性描述起反应；也覆盖微生物重组、植物转座酶、实验筛选和神经回路基因研究。

patterns.name: 基因组区域、序列或外显子
patterns.context: 描述基因或遗传元件的结构、定位、测序或区域特征；部分触发项出现在复合基因名或序列描述中
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学与基因组学论文

patterns.name: 基因变异与突变
patterns.trigger: “heterozygous novel variant”“heterozygous de novo germline missense mutation”“mutations in the p63 gene”
patterns.context: 讨论遗传病、基因型或候选基因变异；常伴随基因名、突变类型或临床关联
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学与疾病研究

patterns.name: 基因/蛋白同源性与相似性
patterns.trigger: “share significant similarity”“share extensive homologies”“shares similarity with”
patterns.context: 比较不同物种或遗传元件间的序列、蛋白或基因相似关系
patterns.domain: 比较基因组学与分子生物学

patterns.name: 细菌噬菌体重组与基因表达调控
patterns.context: 明确讨论噬菌体 Cin 重组酶通过 DNA 片段倒位调节尾纤维基因表达

patterns.name: 细菌基因组差异
patterns.trigger: “The genome of *B. toyonensis* … shows relevant differences from the genome”
patterns.context: 比较细菌基因组，但片段没有进一步说明差异类型

patterns.name: 生物学实验筛选或检测流程
patterns.trigger: “PCR primer sets”“amplified successfully”“polymorphic products”；“HTS assays”“minigene reporters”
patterns.context: 描述引物扩增表现或为高通量筛选准备报告系统；与其他遗传内容相关但强调实验方法
patterns.domain: 分子生物学实验及研究计划

patterns.name: 遗传元件中的整合酶
patterns.context: 对遗传元件末端序列进行分析，并指出其中含有整合酶基因

patterns.name: 植物基因候选与转座酶样蛋白
patterns.trigger: “rice genome contains three PPT candidates”“Gh_D02G2027 peptide”“hAT-like transposases”
patterns.context: 研究植物基因组候选蛋白或棉花蛋白与转座酶的相似性

patterns.name: 神经回路及人类基因功能
patterns.context: 以秀丽隐杆线虫为模型，研究神经系统连接并推及人类相关基因

en.concept: Biomedical genetic terminology and a few outliers
en.description: Most passages concern genes, cancer, genomic variation, transcription, or genetic selection, with activations often falling on related biological terms; neural circuit research is also present, as are the words “noble,” “worthy,” and “god” in a prayer narrative, which are difficult to fit into the same semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Gene/oncogene terminology
patterns.context: Cancer research, especially oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and their mutations or treatments; activations fall on cancer-related gene terms

patterns.name: Genome and genetic variation terminology
patterns.context: Describes genomic changes in cancer cells or gene conservation and specificity across genomes of different strains

patterns.name: Gene expression and transcriptional regulation
patterns.context: Discusses eukaryotic transcription, specific gene expression levels, or changes in expression patterns

patterns.name: Evolutionary selection and traits
patterns.context: Selection acts on RNA secondary structure and affects fitness, or selective breeding changes genetic traits

patterns.name: Nervous system development and connectivity
patterns.context: Uses Caenorhabditis elegans as a model to study neural connectivity and genes related to spinal circuit formation

patterns.name: Deities and prayer narrative
patterns.context: Narrative descriptions of a person expressing wishes to deities or praying for attention or blessings

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传术语及少数异类
11_2834.description: 多数段落涉及基因、癌症、基因组变异、转录或遗传选择，激活常落在相关生物学术语；另见神经回路研究，以及祈愿叙事中“noble”“worthy”“god”等词，难以归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 基因／癌基因术语
patterns.context: 癌症研究语境，尤其是癌基因、肿瘤抑制基因及其突变或治疗；激活落在癌症相关基因术语上

patterns.name: 基因组与遗传变异术语
patterns.trigger: « recurrent» « homozygous» « deletions»；« copy» « number» « alterations»；« conserved» « genes»；« strain» «-»«specific» « genes»
patterns.context: 描述癌细胞基因组改变或不同菌株基因组中的基因保守性、特异性

patterns.name: 基因表达与转录调控
patterns.trigger: « transcriptional» « repertoire»、« transcription»、« gene»；« minor» … « alterations»
patterns.context: 讨论真核细胞转录、特定基因表达水平或模式变化

patterns.name: 进化选择与性状
patterns.trigger: « selection»、« secondary» « structures»、« beneficial»；« selective» « breeding»
patterns.context: 选择作用于RNA二级结构并影响适应性，或通过选择育种改变遗传性状

patterns.name: 神经系统发育与连接
patterns.trigger: « crucial» … « roles»；« nervous» « system»、« spinal» « cord»
patterns.context: 以秀丽隐杆线虫为模型研究神经连接及脊髓回路形成相关基因

patterns.name: 神祇与祈愿叙事
patterns.context: 人物向神祇表达愿望、祈求关注或恩赐的叙事描写
patterns.domain: 维基百科／宗教或仪式性叙事

en.concept: Biomedical genetics and gene research texts
en.description: Primarily responds to genes/protein symbols, numeric variant annotations, and vocabulary for mutations, cancer, DNA sequence analysis, and gene regulation in biomedical genetics texts; also covers bacterial genetic elements and descriptions of gastrointestinal motility.

patterns.name: Gene/protein symbols and variant annotations
patterns.context: At gene, receptor, or protein names, often accompanied by descriptions of mutations, expression, function, or exons; numbers, letters, or punctuation within symbols can also trigger.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, genetics, and cancer research abstracts

patterns.name: Gene lists and variant classes
patterns.context: Lists cancer-related genes or describes mutations, deletions, and their frequency, risk, or consequences.

patterns.name: Cancer and tumor biology vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses tumor development, tumor suppression, cancer risk, or gene function in tumor cells.

patterns.name: Nucleic acid/genome analysis terminology
patterns.context: Describes DNA sequences, genome structure, detection methods, or DNA repair mechanisms.

patterns.name: Gene regulation and transcription factors
patterns.context: Involves promoter sequences, transcription factor families, or different forms of transcriptional activation.

patterns.name: Isolated description of a specific genetic element
patterns.context: Describes a bacterial genetic element, sequence homology, and restoration of gene function; differs from the cancer theme of the other passages.

patterns.name: Isolated description of clinical physiology and gastrointestinal motility
patterns.context: Reports gastric emptying and intestinal transit test results, followed by OPA1 sequencing.
patterns.domain: Clinical medical case or research report

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传学与基因研究文本
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传学文本中的基因/蛋白符号、数字化变异标注及突变、癌症、DNA序列分析和基因调控词汇；也覆盖细菌遗传元件与胃肠动力描述。

patterns.name: 基因/蛋白符号与变异标注
patterns.trigger: 基因符号及其被拆分的后缀/数字，如“IL-20 receptor”“MYH”“TP53”“BRCA1”“OPA1”“p63”“S545”“c.”
patterns.context: 基因、受体或蛋白名称处，常伴随突变、表达、功能、外显子等描述；符号内部的数字、字母或标点也可触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、遗传学、癌症研究摘要

patterns.name: 基因列表与变异类别
patterns.trigger: “MLH1, MPL, JAK3, JAK2, IDH2, CRAF, CSF1R, CTNNB1”“mutations”“homozygous deletions”
patterns.context: 罗列癌症相关基因或描述突变、缺失及其频率、风险或后果。
patterns.domain: 癌症基因组学与遗传学

patterns.name: 癌症及肿瘤生物学词汇
patterns.context: 讨论肿瘤发生、抑癌作用、癌症风险或肿瘤细胞中的基因功能。
patterns.domain: 癌症生物学与医学摘要

patterns.name: 核酸/基因组分析术语
patterns.trigger: “Sequence analysis”“SNP arrays”“copy number alterations”“exons”“intronic regions”“homologous recombination”
patterns.context: 描述DNA序列、基因组结构、检测方法或DNA修复机制。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与基因组学

patterns.name: 基因调控与转录因子
patterns.context: 涉及启动子序列、转录因子家族或不同转录激活形式。

patterns.name: 单独的特定遗传元件描述
patterns.context: 描述细菌遗传元件、序列同源性及基因功能恢复；与其余段落的癌症主题不同。
patterns.domain: 微生物遗传学论文摘要

patterns.name: 单独的临床生理与胃肠动力描述
patterns.trigger: “gastric emptying”“small bowel transit rate”“colonic activity”“colonic transit”
patterns.context: 报告胃排空及肠道转运检查结果，随后出现OPA1测序。
patterns.domain: 临床医学病例或研究报告

en.concept: Genes and molecular genetics research texts
en.description: Generally oriented toward genes, genetic variation, and expression regulation in biomedical research texts; also responds to topics in tumors, breeding, sequence evolution, and functional experiments. A passage on ascites syndrome in livestock and poultry shows no clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: Gene and molecular biology terminology
patterns.context: Genes and proteins are discussed as research subjects or mechanisms; no specific organism is required.

patterns.name: Genetic variation and chromosomal changes
patterns.context: Describes genetic variation, changes in genome structure, or their relationship to tumors and traits.

patterns.name: Expression regulation and cell differentiation
patterns.context: Involves cell fate, transcriptional regulation, or RNA regulatory mechanisms.

patterns.name: Genome sequencing and sequence homology
patterns.context: Analyzes gene or RNA sequences, homology, or evolutionary processes.

patterns.name: Tumor and cancer-related research
patterns.context: Cancer as a research context, discussing tumor suppression, cancer cells, or chromosomal changes.

patterns.name: Livestock and poultry traits and selective breeding
patterns.context: Relates disease susceptibility or production traits in poultry to genetics and breeding.

patterns.name: Transposon- or integrase-related sequences
patterns.context: Describes sequence elements that contain integrase genes and their homology.
patterns.domain: Microbial or mobile genetic element research

patterns.name: Gene function experiments and reporter systems
patterns.context: Uses experimental systems to test the functional effects of genetic variation or protein isoforms.
patterns.domain: Research plans and experimental molecular biology

patterns.name: snRNA multicopy and coevolution
patterns.context: Discusses the copy number and evolution of small nuclear RNA paralogs.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within terminology
patterns.context: Activations fall on in-word fragments split by tokenization; these fragments occur in different technical contexts and do not support a unified meaning.

11_2834.concept: 基因与分子遗传学科研文本
11_2834.description: 总体偏向生物医学科研文本中的基因、遗传变异与表达调控；也响应肿瘤、育种、序列进化及功能实验等主题。另有畜禽腹水综合征段落，未见明确共享触发词。

patterns.name: 基因与分子生物学术语
patterns.context: 基因、蛋白质及其表达作为研究对象或机制被讨论；不要求特定生物种类。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与科研计划

patterns.name: 遗传变异及染色体改变
patterns.context: 描述遗传变异、基因组结构变化，或其与肿瘤、性状的关系。
patterns.domain: 癌症遗传学、遗传学研究

patterns.name: 表达调控与细胞分化
patterns.context: 涉及细胞命运、转录调控或RNA调控机制。

patterns.name: 基因组测序与序列同源性
patterns.context: 分析基因或RNA序列、同源关系或进化过程。
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学与进化生物学

patterns.name: 肿瘤与癌症相关研究
patterns.context: 癌症作为研究背景，讨论肿瘤抑制、癌症细胞或染色体改变。

patterns.name: 畜禽性状与选择育种
patterns.context: 家禽疾病倾向或生产性状与遗传、育种相关联。

patterns.name: 转座或整合酶相关序列
patterns.context: 描述序列元件中含有整合酶基因及其同源性。
patterns.domain: 微生物或移动遗传元件研究

patterns.name: 基因功能实验与报告系统
patterns.context: 通过实验系统检验遗传变异或蛋白异构体的功能影响。
patterns.domain: 科研计划与实验分子生物学

patterns.name: snRNA多拷贝与协同进化
patterns.context: 讨论小核RNA旁系同源基因的拷贝数及进化。

patterns.name: 术语内部子词碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词拆开的词内片段；这些片段出现在不同专业语境，无法据此归纳统一词义。
patterns.domain: 科研文本中的分词碎片

en.description: Primarily responds to associations between diseases and genes, mutations, or molecular mechanisms in biomedical texts, especially cancer and genetic disease; also covers research contexts involving infection, plant resistance, and bilirubin metabolism disorders.

patterns.name: Genetic/gene variants and inherited disease
patterns.context: Discusses relationships between inherited diseases, genotypes, or specific mutations and disease phenotypes, often in the disease background or results of an abstract.
patterns.domain: Medical genetics and cancer genetics abstracts

patterns.name: Cancer mechanisms and targeted therapy
patterns.context: Describes tumor development, tumor-suppressive or oncogenic mechanisms, and treatment strategies targeting cancer pathways.

patterns.name: Molecular mechanisms and genome recombination
patterns.context: Explains DNA repair, chromosome or genome rearrangements, splicing changes, and related molecular mechanisms.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology and genetics abstracts and patent background

patterns.name: Pathogen infection and host tissue
patterns.context: Discusses HIV in the brain, infected cell types, and effects on the nervous system.

patterns.name: Plant resistance loci and markers
patterns.context: Discusses resistance loci on chromosomes, genetic markers, and identification of causal genes.

patterns.name: Cancer-related disease names and research subjects
patterns.context: Cancer or tumor-related diseases appear as research subjects; gene, mechanism, or treatment content sometimes appears as well.

patterns.name: Disease names and biochemical phenotype
patterns.context: Focuses on inherited bilirubin metabolism disorders and their mutational causes.

11_2834.concept: 疾病相关基因机制
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中疾病与基因、突变或分子机制的关联，尤其是肿瘤和遗传病；也覆盖感染、植物抗性及胆红素代谢疾病等研究语境。

patterns.name: 遗传/基因变异与遗传病
patterns.context: 讨论遗传性疾病、基因型或特定突变与疾病表型之间的关系，常见于摘要的疾病背景或研究结果。
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学、肿瘤遗传学摘要

patterns.name: 癌症机制与靶向治疗
patterns.context: 描述肿瘤发生、抑癌或促癌机制，以及针对癌症通路的治疗策略。

patterns.name: 分子机制与基因组重组
patterns.context: 说明DNA修复、染色体或基因组重排、剪接变化及相关分子机制。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、遗传学摘要及专利背景

patterns.name: 病原体感染与宿主组织
patterns.context: 讨论HIV在脑部的存在、感染的细胞类型及神经系统影响。
patterns.domain: 感染病学研究计划文本

patterns.name: 植物抗性位点与标记
patterns.context: 讨论染色体上的抗性位点、遗传标记及致因基因鉴定。

patterns.name: 癌症相关的病名与研究对象
patterns.context: 癌症或肿瘤相关疾病作为研究对象出现；有时同时出现基因、机制或治疗内容。

patterns.name: 疾病名称与生化表型
patterns.context: 以遗传性胆红素代谢疾病及其突变病因为主题。

en.description: Primarily responds to discussions of genes, mutations, genetic diseases, and cancer in biomedical texts; also covers specific topics such as gene expression regulation, molecular function, integrase sequences, and ABC transporters.

patterns.name: Genetic variation and disease association
patterns.context: Genetic variation, genotype, or gene defects are linked to disease risk or functional consequences; sometimes involving monoallelic or biallelic inheritance.
patterns.domain: Medical genetics and disease research abstracts

patterns.name: Cancer- and tumor suppressor-related genes
patterns.context: Discusses genes in cancer, tumor-suppressive effects, or chromosomal rearrangements and fusion genes.

patterns.name: Gene expression, regulation, and cell differentiation
patterns.context: Describes changes in gene expression, lineage regulation, or the potential regulation of gene expression by small RNAs.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology and cell differentiation research

patterns.name: Molecular mechanisms and functional characterization
patterns.context: Explains molecular function, gene or protein defects, sequence features, and their biological consequences.

patterns.name: Genetic causes of specific diseases
patterns.context: Focuses on a hereditary syndrome, describing its severity and associated gene mutations.

patterns.name: ABC transporter family
patterns.context: Names the ATP-binding cassette transporter family and discusses its links to aging or age-related diseases.

patterns.name: Bacterial integrases and sequence homology
patterns.context: Analyzes sequence elements, noting that they contain an integrase gene and show within-group homology.

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传与基因研究
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中基因、突变、遗传病与癌症的讨论，也涉及基因表达调控、分子功能、整合酶序列及 ABC 转运蛋白等具体主题。

patterns.name: 遗传变异与疾病关联
patterns.context: 遗传变异、基因型或基因缺陷与疾病风险、功能后果相联系；有时涉及单等位或双等位遗传。
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学与疾病研究摘要

patterns.name: 癌症及肿瘤抑制相关基因
patterns.context: 讨论癌症中的基因、肿瘤抑制作用或染色体重排与融合基因。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学与癌症研究

patterns.name: 基因表达、调控与细胞分化
patterns.context: 描述基因表达变化、谱系调控，或小 RNA 对基因表达的潜在调节。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与细胞分化研究

patterns.name: 分子机制与功能表征
patterns.context: 阐述分子功能、基因或蛋白缺陷、序列特征及其生物学后果。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与科研项目文本

patterns.name: 特定疾病的遗传病因
patterns.context: 以遗传性综合征为主题，说明其严重程度及相关基因突变。

patterns.name: ABC 转运蛋白家族
patterns.context: 点名 ATP 结合盒转运蛋白家族，并讨论其与衰老或年龄相关疾病的联系。
patterns.domain: 生物医学综述标题及摘要

patterns.name: 细菌整合酶与序列同源性
patterns.context: 分析序列元件，指出其中含有整合酶基因及组内同源性。
patterns.domain: 微生物遗传学研究摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to genes, variants, expression, and their disease consequences in genetic molecular biology contexts; also responds to chromosome or genome rearrangements, nucleic acid structure descriptions, and a few microbial genetic element and clinical phenotype descriptions.

patterns.name: Gene/genetic variants and disease mechanisms
patterns.context: Discusses how genes, alleles, or mutations affect protein function, disease, or phenotype; often accompanied by gene names, loci, or molecular consequences.
patterns.domain: Biomedical genetics, cancer and genetic disease abstracts, or patent background

patterns.name: Expression, regulation, and gene products
patterns.context: Describes gene expression, promoters, or gene products and their function, distribution, or restoration in cells.

patterns.name: Chromosomal rearrangements and fusions
patterns.context: Structural rearrangements, translocations, or duplications occur in a genome or viral genome, and their consequences are discussed.

patterns.name: Nucleic acid sequence and genome structure descriptions
patterns.context: Specifically describes sequencing, exons, transcripts, or the composition of genomic fragments; not always centered on mutations or disease mechanisms.
patterns.domain: Molecular genetics, biomedical papers, and patent background

patterns.name: Cancer-related genes and receptors/signaling
patterns.context: Mentions tumors, oncogenes, or the role of receptors in cancer, cell growth, and signaling.

patterns.name: Microbial genetic elements and integrases
patterns.context: Describes genetic elements, their sequence homology, or related genes; distinct from human genetic disease topics.

patterns.name: Disease clinical phenotype and infection
patterns.context: Lists clinical manifestations and course related to cystic fibrosis and mentions the CF gene.

11_2834.concept: 基因组遗传与分子机制
11_2834.description: 主要响应遗传分子生物学语境中的基因、变异、表达及其疾病后果；也响应染色体或基因组重排、核酸结构描述，以及少数微生物遗传元件和临床表型表述。

patterns.name: 基因/遗传变异与疾病机制
patterns.context: 讨论基因、等位基因或突变如何影响蛋白功能、疾病或表型；常伴随基因名称、位点或分子后果。
patterns.domain: 生物医学遗传学、癌症与遗传病摘要或专利背景

patterns.name: 表达、调控与基因产物
patterns.context: 描述基因表达、启动子或基因产物及其在细胞中的功能、分布或恢复。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、肿瘤生物学

patterns.name: 染色体重排与融合
patterns.context: 基因组或病毒基因组发生结构重排、易位或重复，并讨论其后果。
patterns.domain: 癌症遗传学、病毒基因组学

patterns.name: 核酸序列与基因组结构描述
patterns.context: 具体说明测序、外显子、转录本或基因组片段的组成；并不总以突变或疾病机制为中心。
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学、生物医学论文及专利背景

patterns.name: 癌症相关基因与受体/信号
patterns.context: 提及肿瘤、癌基因或受体在癌症、细胞生长和信号传导中的作用。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤学与细胞信号研究

patterns.name: 微生物遗传元件与整合酶
patterns.context: 描述遗传元件、其序列同源性或相关基因；与人类遗传病主题不同。
patterns.domain: 微生物分子遗传学摘要

patterns.name: 疾病临床表型与感染
patterns.context: 列举囊性纤维化相关的临床表现和病程，并提及CF基因。
patterns.domain: 遗传病专利背景/临床描述

en.description: Primarily responds to terms related to genes, their sequences, allelic variants, mutations, and genome structure, commonly in biomedical and genetics texts; cancer is prominent, with additional coverage of plant resistance genes and cardiac developmental genetics.

patterns.name: Genes and genetic variation
patterns.context: Discusses gene identity, function, variation, or disease association; paragraph 1 also mentions promoters and integrase genes, while paragraph 7 concerns viral genome fragments
patterns.domain: Biomedical, molecular genetics, and cancer research

patterns.name: Sequences, elements, and genome structure
patterns.context: Describes genetic sequences, repetitive elements, genome rearrangements, or evolutionary relationships

patterns.name: Cancer and tumor-related contexts
patterns.context: Genes or mutations are discussed in the context of cancer development, treatment, or tumor suppression

patterns.name: Cardiac development and congenital defects
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between Nkx2.5 mutations and congenital heart defects in families

patterns.name: Plant resistance genes and truncated proteins
patterns.context: Describes resistance gene allelic variants and their protein truncation in cotton resistant lines

11_2834.concept: 基因与遗传变异
11_2834.description: 主要对基因及其序列、等位变异、突变和基因组结构相关词汇反应，常见于生物医学与遗传学文本；癌症语境突出，另覆盖植物抗性基因和心脏发育遗传学。

patterns.name: 基因与遗传变异
patterns.context: 讨论基因的身份、功能、变异或疾病关联；第1段另有启动子与整合酶基因，第7段涉及病毒基因组片段
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分子遗传学及癌症研究

patterns.name: 序列、元件与基因组结构
patterns.context: 描述遗传序列、重复元件、基因组重排或演化关系

patterns.name: 癌症与肿瘤相关语境
patterns.context: 基因或突变被置于癌症发生、治疗或肿瘤抑制的语境中

patterns.name: 心脏发育与先天性缺陷
patterns.context: 讨论 Nkx2.5 的突变与家系中先天性心脏缺陷的关系

patterns.name: 植物抗性基因与截短蛋白
patterns.context: 描述棉花抗性品系中抗性基因等位变异及其蛋白截短

en.concept: Genes and genetic mechanisms in biomedicine
en.description: Primarily responds to genes and their function, expression, and variation in biomedical genetics contexts; also responds to cancer-related genes, chromosomal rearrangements, transposons, and integrases. A few examples involve RNA regulation, protein domains, and sequence homology.

patterns.name: Gene naming and description
patterns.context: Discusses genes, alleles, expression, mutations, or function in biomedical text; triggers often fall on gene(s) or nearby words
patterns.domain: Genetics, molecular biology, and cancer research papers

patterns.name: Genetic variation and chromosomal rearrangements
patterns.context: Describes gene variants, mutations, alleles, or chromosomal rearrangements and their consequences

patterns.name: Transposons and integrases
