patterns.context: Mentions mobile genetic elements, integrases, or transposition; mostly appears in sequence and genetic element descriptions

patterns.name: Cancer and tumor suppression
patterns.context: Cancer research mentions oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, or abnormalities in cancer-related genes

patterns.name: Gene regulation and RNA
patterns.context: Discusses changes in gene expression during cell differentiation and RNA regulation of this process

patterns.name: Protein domain annotation
patterns.context: Summarizes the domain composition of a protein encoded by a gene

patterns.name: Pathogen-related sequence homology
patterns.context: Describes sequence elements in a genetic element and homology within a population

11_2834.concept: 生物医学中的基因与遗传机制
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传学语境中的基因及其功能、表达和变异，也响应癌症相关基因、染色体重排、转座子与整合酶；少数涉及RNA调控、蛋白结构域和序列同源性。

patterns.name: 基因命名与描述
patterns.trigger: « gene»、« genes»及其相邻的基因名或功能描述，如« gene»6« is»8« highly»10« polymorphic»4
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中讨论基因、等位基因、表达、突变或功能；触发常落在 gene(s) 或其紧邻词上
patterns.domain: 遗传学、分子生物学及癌症研究论文

patterns.name: 遗传变异与染色体重排
patterns.context: 描述基因变异、突变、等位基因，或染色体重排及其后果

patterns.name: 转座子与整合酶
patterns.context: 提及可移动遗传元件、整合酶或转座过程；多见于序列和遗传元件描述
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 癌症与肿瘤抑制
patterns.trigger: « human»1 cancer、« onc»3«ogene»3、« tumor»4« suppressor»6« gene»6
patterns.context: 癌症研究中提及癌基因、肿瘤抑制基因或癌症相关基因异常

patterns.name: 基因调控与RNA
patterns.trigger: « increased»2 expression、« repression»1 of« genes»2、« Micro«RNAs»4
patterns.context: 讨论细胞分化时基因表达变化及 RNA 对该过程的调节
patterns.domain: 细胞与分子生物学论文

patterns.name: 蛋白结构域注释
patterns.context: 概述某基因编码蛋白的结构域组成
patterns.domain: 基因注释、生物信息学文本

patterns.name: 病原相关序列同源性
patterns.context: 描述遗传元件中的序列元件及群体内同源性

en.description: Primarily responds to biomedical contexts involving genes, genetic elements, and their sequence relationships, especially mutations, variants, truncations, rearrangements, and homology; also covers cancer-related genes and clinical descriptions and gene introductions for cystic fibrosis.

patterns.name: Types of genetic variation and mutation
patterns.context: Discusses the types, consequences, or pathogenicity of gene or chromosomal variants, including splice sites, truncations, allelic variants, and fusion genes.
patterns.domain: Medical genetics, cancer genetics, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Sequence homology and gene families
patterns.context: Compares homology among genes, DNA sequences, and family members from different organisms or genetic elements.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, microbiology, and genomics papers

patterns.name: Cancer-related genes and tumor suppression
patterns.context: Introduces cancer-related genes, gene expression, or receptor-mediated antitumor effects.

patterns.name: Clinical manifestations and gene discovery in disease
patterns.context: Describes the clinical manifestations of cystic fibrosis and mentions related gene cloning or function.

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传学
11_2834.description: 主要响应基因、遗传元件及其序列关系的生物医学语境，尤其是突变、变异、截短、重排和同源性；也覆盖癌症相关基因及囊性纤维化临床与基因介绍。

patterns.name: 遗传变异与突变类型
patterns.context: 讨论基因或染色体变异的类型、后果或致病性；包括剪接位点、截短、等位变体及融合基因。
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学、癌症遗传学及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 序列同源与基因家族
patterns.trigger: “Ty3/Gypsy family”“related element”“sequence homology”“share extensive homologies”“structural genes”
patterns.context: 比较不同生物或遗传元件的基因、DNA序列及家族成员之间的同源性。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、微生物学及基因组学论文

patterns.name: 癌症相关基因及肿瘤抑制
patterns.context: 介绍癌症相关基因、基因表达或受体介导的抗肿瘤作用。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学与医学摘要

patterns.name: 疾病临床表现与基因发现
patterns.trigger: “pulmonary infection”“pulmonary failure”“pancreatic dysfunction”“male infertility”“CF gene had been cloned”
patterns.context: 描述囊性纤维化的临床表现，并提及相关基因克隆或功能。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的遗传病医学介绍

en.description: Primarily responds to biomedical contexts involving genomes, genes, chromosomes, and their variation or function, especially viral elements and cancer genetics; also activates on the “G‑d” abbreviation in religious narratives.

patterns.name: Retroviruses or transposable elements
patterns.context: Discusses families, genes, sequence homology, or complete copies of transposable elements or related viruses.

patterns.name: Genomic variation and chromosomal rearrangements
patterns.context: Describes viral genomes or cancer-related chromosomal structural changes, gene localization, and rearrangements.

patterns.name: Cancer-related genes and their roles
patterns.context: Introduces oncogenes or tumor suppressor genes in cancer and their mutations, expression, or therapeutic significance.

patterns.name: Genes, variants, and functional predictions
patterns.context: Describes gene polymorphisms, variants, whether mutations are present, and their potential functional effects.
patterns.domain: Drug metabolism, genetics, and clinical genomics

patterns.name: Divine name in religious narrative
patterns.context: Narrates Moses, God, and the Ten Commandments; activation falls on an abbreviated spelling of the divine name in religious text.

11_2834.concept: 基因组与基因相关文本
11_2834.description: 主要响应基因组、基因、染色体及其变异或功能的生物医学语境，尤其是病毒元件与癌症遗传学；另在宗教叙事的“G‑d”缩写处激活。

patterns.name: 逆转录病毒或转座元件
patterns.context: 讨论转座元件或相关病毒的家族、基因、序列同源性或完整拷贝。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因组学论文

patterns.name: 基因组变异与染色体重排
patterns.context: 描述病毒基因组，或癌症相关的染色体结构变化、基因定位与重排。

patterns.name: 癌症相关基因及其作用
patterns.context: 介绍癌症中的致癌基因或抑癌基因及其突变、表达或治疗意义。
patterns.domain: 癌症生物学、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 基因、变异与功能预测
patterns.context: 描述基因多态性、变异、突变是否存在及其潜在功能影响。
patterns.domain: 药物代谢、遗传学与临床基因组学

patterns.name: 宗教叙事中的神名
patterns.context: 叙述摩西、上帝与十诫；激活落在宗教文本中对神名的缩写写法。

en.description: Primarily responds to genomes, genes, and nucleic acid sequences and their analysis in biomedical genetics texts; also covers variation, homology, expression regulation, transposition, and chromosomal rearrangements, as well as viral, genetic disease, and cancer contexts.

patterns.name: Genome and nucleic acid sequence descriptions
patterns.context: Describes genome composition, gene sequences, cloning, or sequencing in life science papers, especially when terms for genes, nucleic acids, and experimental procedures appear.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, genetics, biomedical abstracts, and research background

patterns.name: Gene variation and polymorphism
patterns.context: Involves gene variants, alleles, or identification of disease-causing genes, often linked to disease risk or genetic markers.

patterns.name: Genome rearrangements and transposable elements
patterns.context: Discusses transposon copies, chromosomal rearrangements or translocations, and their effects on the genome.

patterns.name: Homology and evolutionary relationships
patterns.context: Compares similarities and relationships among genes or genetic elements across members, species, or evolutionary timescales.

patterns.name: Virus and vaccine research
patterns.context: Describes viral genomes or virulence, or genetic modification for vaccine development.

patterns.name: Promoters and gene expression regulation
patterns.context: Focuses on the effects of promoter or LTR sequences on gene function, expression, or transfection assay readouts.

patterns.name: Disease phenotypes and clinical manifestations
patterns.context: Lists clinical manifestations of genetic diseases or cancer-related genomic abnormalities; not always accompanied by specific sequence experiments.

patterns.name: RNA gene families
patterns.context: Describes similarities among members of small nuclear RNA gene families and their species distribution.

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传学与基因组研究
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传学文本中的基因组、基因与核酸序列及其分析；也覆盖变异、同源性、表达调控、转座和染色体重排，以及病毒、遗传病和癌症语境。

patterns.name: 基因组与核酸序列描述
patterns.trigger: « genome»、« RNA»、« gene»、« sequence»、« sequenced»、« cloned»
patterns.context: 生命科学论文中描述基因组组成、基因序列、克隆或测序；尤其出现基因、核酸与实验过程词汇时。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、遗传学、生物医学摘要及研究背景

patterns.name: 基因变异与多态性
patterns.context: 涉及基因变异、等位基因或致病基因识别，常与疾病风险或遗传标记相连。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、药物基因组学及疾病研究

patterns.name: 基因组重排与转座元件
patterns.context: 讨论转座子拷贝、染色体重排或易位，以及这些事件对基因组的影响。

patterns.name: 同源性与进化关系
patterns.context: 比较基因或遗传元件在不同成员、物种或进化时间中的相似性与关系。
patterns.domain: 比较基因组学、进化生物学

patterns.name: 病毒与疫苗研究
patterns.trigger: « rot»«avir»uses、« virulence»、« vaccine» candidates、« RV» genome
patterns.context: 描述病毒基因组、毒力或遗传改造以开发疫苗。

patterns.name: 启动子与基因表达调控
patterns.trigger: « promoter»、« 5»'» sequences、« LTR» enhancement、« reporter» gene
patterns.context: 关注启动子或LTR序列对基因功能、表达或转染实验读出的影响。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因表达实验

patterns.name: 疾病表型与临床表现
patterns.trigger: « pulmonary» infection、« pancreatic» dysfunction、« male» infertility、« cancer»
patterns.context: 列举遗传病临床表现或癌症相关基因组异常；并不总是伴随具体序列实验。
patterns.domain: 临床遗传学、医学研究背景

patterns.name: RNA基因家族
patterns.context: 描述小核RNA基因家族成员的相似性及其物种分布。

en.concept: Biomedical genomic terminology (with a religious exception)
en.description: Most passages come from genomics and molecular biomedical research and involve genes, sequences, variants, chromosomes, function, and genome comparisons; another passage is a religious narrative, with activation on G‑d, commandments, and proper names such as Mount Sinai.

patterns.name: Research text related to genes, genomes, and variants
patterns.context: Biomedical or genomics papers discuss sequences, genetic variation, gene function, localization, or genomic features; activation often falls on related terms, descriptive predicates, or numerical annotations.
patterns.domain: PubMed / PubMed Central research abstracts or body text

patterns.name: Specific genetic findings and pathogenicity assessments
patterns.context: Describes predicted effects of variants or mutations, or explains the relationship between genetic markers, genomic changes, and disease.

patterns.name: Chromosomal rearrangements, fusions, and localization
patterns.context: Discusses cancer-related chromosomal structural changes, gene fusions, or determining gene chromosomal locations through hybridization analysis.

patterns.name: Microbial or phage genome comparisons
patterns.context: Compares bacterial or phage sequences, genome structure, and homology, including strain or phage names and database-style identifiers.

patterns.name: Gene function, candidate genes, and enzyme-related descriptions
patterns.context: Explains the function of a gene or enzyme, candidate homologous genes, or molecular phenomena such as gene amplification.

patterns.name: Divine name and religious proper nouns in biblical narrative
patterns.context: Religious text recounts Moses, Mount Sinai, and the commandments; a special spelling of the divine name appears.

11_2834.concept: 生物医学基因组术语（另有宗教例外）
11_2834.description: 多数段落来自基因组学与分子生物医学研究，涉及基因、序列、变异、染色体、功能及基因组比较；另有一段宗教叙事，激活于G‑d、诫命和西奈山等专名。

patterns.name: 基因、基因组及变异相关科研文本
patterns.context: 生物医学或基因组学论文中讨论序列、遗传变异、基因功能、定位或基因组特征；激活常落在相关术语、描述性谓词或数值标注上。
patterns.domain: PubMed / PubMed Central 科研摘要或正文

patterns.name: 特定遗传学结果与致病性判断
patterns.context: 描述变异、突变的预测影响，或解释遗传标记、基因组改变与疾病的关系。
patterns.domain: 临床遗传学、医学遗传学论文

patterns.name: 染色体重排、融合与定位
patterns.context: 讨论癌症相关染色体结构变化、基因融合，或通过杂交分析确定基因染色体位置。
patterns.domain: 癌症遗传学与分子细胞遗传学

patterns.name: 微生物或噬菌体基因组比较
patterns.context: 比较细菌或噬菌体序列、基因组结构与同源性，包含菌株或噬菌体名称及数据库式编号。
patterns.domain: 微生物基因组学、病毒学

patterns.name: 基因功能、候选基因及酶相关描述
patterns.trigger: “restoring function”“integrase genes”“rice genome”“PPT candidates”“transketolase gene amplification”
patterns.context: 说明某基因或酶的功能、候选同源基因，或基因扩增等分子现象。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、生物化学论文

patterns.name: 圣经叙事中的神名与宗教专名
patterns.context: 叙述摩西、西奈山及诫命的宗教文本；出现对神名的特殊拼写。

en.description: Primarily responds to genome, sequence, and variation terminology in scientific texts, and also covers genetic element annotation and dense numeric/unit information; one passage of religious text involving numerical names is difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Genomics and viral sequence terminology
patterns.context: Biomedical descriptions centered on genome structure, sequences, fragments, or genetic variation; nearby text often includes numbers, abbreviations, and technical modifiers.

patterns.name: Gene mutations and pathogenicity annotation
patterns.context: Discusses predicted effects of mutations, disease associations, conservation, or whether a disease-causing gene has been identified.

patterns.name: Genetic elements and sequence function
patterns.context: Describes functional regions or genetic elements in the genome, often accompanied by abbreviations, classification labels, and accounts of functional restoration or sequence homology.
patterns.domain: Molecular genetics papers, genome annotation tables

patterns.name: Text involving numbers and precision
patterns.context: Numbers, percentages, base lengths, or decimal precision requirements are embedded in text; this pattern may be unrelated to biology.
patterns.domain: Math problems and biomedical data descriptions

patterns.name: Numerical names in Hebrew scripture
patterns.context: Recounts Moses, Mount Sinai, and divine revelation, with numbers forming part of religious names; stylistically distinct from the scientific passages.

11_2834.concept: 基因组科学术语与数字
11_2834.description: 主要响应科学文本中的基因组、序列与变异术语，也覆盖遗传元件注释及密集数字/单位；另有一段宗教文本中的数字称谓，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 基因组学与病毒序列术语
patterns.context: 围绕基因组结构、序列、片段或遗传变异展开的生物医学描述；术语附近常出现数字、缩写及技术性修饰语。
patterns.domain: 病毒学、分子生物学、基因组学论文

patterns.name: 基因突变及致病性注释
patterns.context: 讨论突变的预测影响、疾病关联、保守性或致病基因是否已确定。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与临床生物医学论文

patterns.name: 遗传元件与序列功能
patterns.context: 描述基因组中的功能区域或遗传元件，常伴随缩写、分类标签及功能恢复或序列同源性叙述。
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学论文、基因组注释表

patterns.name: 数字与精度相关文本
patterns.context: 数字、百分比、碱基长度或小数精度要求嵌在文本中；此模式可能与生物学主题无关。
patterns.domain: 数学题及生物医学数据描述

patterns.name: 希伯来经文中的数字化称谓
patterns.context: 叙述摩西、西奈山及上帝启示，数字用作宗教称谓的一部分；与科学段落风格不同。

en.description: Biomedical text primarily involving genes, mutations, and nucleic acid sequences, especially gene identification, sequence elements, and genome structure; also covers transposable elements, viral genomes, and genes associated with specific diseases.

patterns.name: Genetic variation and identification of disease genes
patterns.context: Discusses genes, mutations, allelic variants, or the identification and sequencing of the molecular causes of disease.

patterns.name: Genome sequence and functional element annotation
patterns.context: Describes the structural composition, functional elements, and annotation of nucleic acid sequences, including lists of terms.

patterns.name: Transposable elements and copy characteristics
patterns.context: Describes families, distribution, or full-length copies of mobile genetic elements.

patterns.name: Viral genome structure and rearrangement
patterns.context: Discusses viral genome segments, repetitive sequences, or genome structural features.

patterns.name: Genomic mosaicism
patterns.context: Uses mosaic to describe the composition of bacteriophage genomes.

patterns.name: Specific diseases or molecular targets
patterns.context: Mentions specific genes and their disease, metabolic, or protein-related context; these contexts alone are insufficient to assign a shared mechanism.

11_2834.concept: 基因组与基因变异
11_2834.description: 主要响应基因、突变和核酸序列的生物医学文本，尤偏基因鉴定、序列元件与基因组结构；也覆盖转座元件、病毒基因组及具体疾病相关基因。

patterns.name: 基因变异与致病基因鉴定
patterns.trigger: “causative genes have not been identified”“mutations have been identified”“gene is highly polymorphic”“variant alleles”
patterns.context: 讨论基因、突变、等位变异，或疾病分子病因的鉴定与测序。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 基因组序列与功能元件注释
patterns.context: 描述核酸序列的结构组成、功能元件及其注释，包含术语列表。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与基因组学论文

patterns.name: 转座元件及其拷贝特征
patterns.context: 描述可移动遗传元件的家族、分布或完整拷贝。
patterns.domain: 微生物或基因组学论文

patterns.name: 病毒基因组结构与重排
patterns.trigger: “genome segments undergo rearrangement”“head-to-tail duplication”“direct terminal repeats”
patterns.context: 讨论病毒基因组片段、重复序列或基因组结构特征。

patterns.name: 基因组嵌合性
patterns.context: 以 mosaic 描述噬菌体基因组组成。

patterns.name: 特定疾病或分子靶点
patterns.context: 提及具体基因及其疾病、代谢或蛋白相关背景；仅凭这些上下文难以归入共同机制。

en.description: Primarily responds to identification and definition of genes, mutations, or miRNAs in biomedical genetics texts; also covers molecular function, disease phenotypes, and sequence analysis and homology discourse. These patterns overlap but do not form a single narrow concept.

patterns.name: Identified or unidentified genes/variants
patterns.context: Genetic or molecular biology discourse introduces the discovery, identification, cloning, or number of disease-associated genes, pathogenic mutations, or allelic variants.

patterns.name: miRNA definitions and properties
patterns.context: Defines microRNA, describing its noncoding nature, molecular size, or regulatory function; the same definition may recur in different research contexts.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, patent background, paper background

patterns.name: Pathological or functional mechanism discourse
patterns.context: Explains the physiological mechanism, functional effects, or potential treatment strategies for a disease or molecule; may not focus on identifying genetic variants.

patterns.name: Recombinant sequences, integrase genes, and homology
patterns.context: Analyzes recombinant sequences or genetic elements, describing sequence composition, genes, and their homology relationships.

patterns.name: Clinical disease phenotypes
patterns.context: Describes clinical pathology, expression features, or organ-system manifestations of disease rather than directly reporting molecular discoveries.
patterns.domain: Medical paper background or main text

11_2834.concept: 生物医学分子遗传学叙述
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传学文本中基因、突变或 miRNA 的鉴定与定义，也覆盖分子功能、疾病表型，以及序列分析和同源性叙述；这些模式有交叠，但并非单一窄概念。

patterns.name: 被识别或尚未识别的基因/变异
patterns.trigger: “have been identified”“have not been identified”“had been cloned”，以及“mutations”“genes”“variant alleles”
patterns.context: 遗传或分子生物学叙述中，介绍疾病相关基因、致病突变或等位变异的发现、鉴定、克隆或数量。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、论文背景

patterns.name: miRNA定义与性质
patterns.trigger: “Micro RNAs (miRNAs) are non-coding”“microRNAs (miRNAs) are small non-coding RNAs”
patterns.context: 以定义句介绍 microRNA，说明其非编码属性、分子大小或调控功能；相同定义可在不同研究背景中重复出现。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、专利背景、论文背景

patterns.name: 病理或功能机制叙述
patterns.trigger: “correct BMP signaling defects”“metabolism of clopidogrel”“pulmonary failure”“regulate”
patterns.context: 说明疾病或分子的生理机制、功能影响或潜在治疗策略；未必围绕基因变异鉴定。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与专利背景

patterns.name: 重组序列、整合酶基因与同源性
patterns.context: 分析重组序列或遗传元件，描述序列组成、基因及其同源关系。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、生物技术研究摘要

patterns.name: 临床疾病表型
patterns.trigger: “clinical pathology and expression profile”“pulmonary infection”“pancreatic dysfunction and male infertility”
patterns.context: 描述疾病的临床病理、表达特征或器官系统表现，而不是直接陈述分子发现。

en.concept: Biomedical genetics and molecular biology narratives
en.description: Primarily involves statements in biomedical genetics about genes/mutations being discovered, identified, or associated with disease, as well as miRNA definitions; also includes local patterns involving viral genome descriptions, chromosomal markers, NF-κB regulation, literature reviews, and cystic fibrosis phenotypes.

patterns.name: Gene or mutation counts and identification
patterns.context: Discusses the discovery or identification of genes, mutations, or disease-causing genes, or notes that they remain unidentified. Often uses passive constructions such as have been identified/cloned; also involves counts or disease associations.
patterns.domain: Biomedical genetics papers or patent background

patterns.name: miRNA definition and nucleotide length
patterns.context: Defines miRNA as a small noncoding RNA when it is first introduced, and describes its length or regulatory function.

patterns.name: Description of non-segmented negative-sense viruses
patterns.context: Describes filovirus genomes as non-segmented negative-sense strands in discussions of viral genome transcription and replication strategies.

patterns.name: Genetic markers and chromosomal loci
patterns.context: Discusses resistance loci, chromosomal positions, and marker effectiveness, noting that the causal gene has not yet been identified.

patterns.name: NF-κB regulation of chemokine expression
patterns.context: Describes the expression of a specific chemokine as controlled by NF-κB activity, followed by a definition of miRNA.

patterns.name: Evidence across studies and literature reviews
patterns.context: Uses prior or published studies to introduce a summary, existing knowledge, or new data.

patterns.name: Disease phenotype and cloning history
patterns.context: Describes clinical manifestations of cystic fibrosis and the history of cloning its gene.

patterns.name: Genotype-associated immune risk
patterns.context: Associates intestinal disease risk with genetic susceptibility loci and immune response genes, and lists gene names.

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传学与分子生物学叙述
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传学中基因/突变被发现、鉴定或与疾病关联的表述，以及miRNA定义；另有病毒基因组描述、染色体标记、NF-κB调控、文献回顾和囊性纤维化表型等局部模式。

patterns.name: 基因或突变数量与鉴定
patterns.context: 讨论基因、突变或致病基因的发现、鉴定或尚未鉴定，常出现被动语态的 have been identified/cloned，也涉及数量或疾病相关性。
patterns.domain: 生物医学遗传学论文或专利背景

patterns.name: miRNA定义与核苷酸长度
patterns.context: miRNA首次出现后给出其小型、非编码RNA的定义，并描述长度或调控功能。

patterns.name: 非分节段负义链病毒描述
patterns.context: 病毒基因组转录和复制策略的讨论中，描述丝状病毒基因组为非分节段负义链。

patterns.name: 数字化遗传标记与染色体位点
patterns.context: 讨论抗性位点、染色体位置及标记效力，并指出致因基因尚未识别。

patterns.name: NF-κB控制趋化因子表达
patterns.trigger: expression of CXCL1, CCL2 and CX~3~CL1… activity of «NF»-κB
patterns.context: 描述特定趋化因子的表达受NF-κB活性控制，之后转入miRNA定义。

patterns.name: 跨研究证据与文献回顾
patterns.context: 以既往研究或已发表研究为依据，引出总结、现有知识或新数据。

patterns.name: 疾病表型与克隆史
patterns.context: 囊性纤维化的临床表现及其基因克隆历史叙述。

patterns.name: 基因型相关免疫风险
patterns.context: 肠道疾病风险与遗传易感位点、免疫反应基因相关联，并列出基因名称。

en.description: Primarily involves statements in genetic and molecular biomedical research about genes or variants being discovered, identified, or sequenced, especially “have been identified”; also covers gene conservation, RNA-disease associations, drug-metabolism polymorphisms, and a few microbial and membrane protein contexts.

patterns.name: Identified gene mutations
patterns.context: Genetic or molecular biomedical text reports that mutations or variants in disease-causing or candidate genes have been discovered; a common construction is a plural subject followed by “have been identified/detected.” Also includes variant alleles of polymorphic genes.
patterns.domain: Medical genetics, biomedical abstracts, and patent background

patterns.name: Discovery and identification of novel genes or sequences
patterns.context: Research reports identify, sequence, or characterize genes, disease-causing genes, or related genetic markers; this may occur alongside mutation discovery or without a focus on mutations.

patterns.name: Conservation or homology of gene/protein families
patterns.context: Describes homology between gene sequences or a gene as belonging to a highly conserved family; disease mutations are not necessarily involved.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, gene function research, and patent background

patterns.name: Noncoding RNA and disease association
patterns.context: Introduces miRNA classes and biological roles, or their dysregulation in human disease and cancer; this pattern does not directly describe mutation discovery.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, biomedical reviews, and patent background

patterns.name: Description of specialized transposon/integrase sequences
patterns.context: Describes the sequence composition of a genetic element, homology of integrase genes, and restoration of the function of a disrupted gene; distinct from human disease-gene mutation contexts.

patterns.name: Surface protein copy number and novel genes
patterns.context: First describes the abundance range of a cell-surface protein, then reports discovery and sequencing of a novel gene; pathogenic mutations are not clearly involved.
patterns.domain: Cell biology, blood group, or membrane protein research abstracts

patterns.name: BMP receptor signaling and therapeutic implications
patterns.context: Biomedical text about a specific disease links BMPR2 mutations to signaling defects and potential treatment strategies.

patterns.name: Drug-metabolism gene polymorphisms
patterns.context: States that drug-metabolizing enzyme genes are polymorphic and lists known variant alleles; does not use the typical “mutations have been identified” construction.

patterns.name: Gene function changes causing inherited traits or disease
patterns.context: Links mutations in specific genes to syndromes, pigmentation, or hearing phenotypes, and reports that independent mutations have been discovered; combines mutation discovery with gene-phenotype association.
patterns.domain: Human genetics and model organism research

11_2834.concept: 基因发现与遗传变异
11_2834.description: 主要响应遗传与分子生物医学中基因/变体被发现、鉴定或测序的表述，尤其“have been identified”；也覆盖基因保守性、RNA疾病关联、药物代谢多态性及少量微生物、膜蛋白语境。

patterns.name: 已被识别的基因突变
patterns.trigger: “mutations”及邻近的“have been identified”“have been detected”“identified”；第5段相关变体表述为“gene”“highly polymorphic”“variant alleles”
patterns.context: 遗传或分子生物医学文本中，报告致病基因或候选基因的突变、变体已被发现；常见句式为复数主语后接“have been identified/detected”，也包括多态性基因的变体等位基因。
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学、生物医学摘要及专利背景

patterns.name: 新基因或序列的发现鉴定
patterns.trigger: “have been identified”“has been identified”“identified and sequenced”“sequenced”
patterns.context: 研究报道识别、测序或鉴定基因、致病基因或相关遗传标记；可与突变发现并存，也可不以突变为中心。
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 基因/蛋白家族的保守性或同源性
patterns.context: 描述基因序列之间的同源性，或某基因属于高度保守的家族；未必涉及疾病突变。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因功能研究及专利背景

patterns.name: 非编码RNA及其疾病关联
patterns.context: 介绍miRNA的类别、生物学作用，或其失调与人类疾病、癌症的关系；本模式没有直接的突变发现表述。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、生物医学综述及专利背景

patterns.name: 特殊转座/整合酶序列描述
patterns.trigger: “IncJ's”“integrase genes”“restoring function of the disrupted prfC”
patterns.context: 描述遗传元件的序列组成、整合酶基因同源性及被破坏基因的功能恢复；与人类疾病基因突变语境不同。
patterns.domain: 微生物遗传学或分子遗传学摘要

patterns.name: 表面蛋白拷贝数与新基因
patterns.trigger: “copies/cell”“a new Glycophorin E gene”“identified and sequenced”
patterns.context: 先描述细胞表面蛋白的丰度范围，再报告新基因的发现和测序；不明显涉及致病突变。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、血型或膜蛋白研究摘要

patterns.name: BMP受体信号与治疗推论
patterns.trigger: “BMP type 2 receptor gene”“BMPR2 mutations”“correct BMP signaling defects”
patterns.context: 特定疾病的生物医学文本中，将BMPR2突变与信号缺陷及潜在治疗策略联系起来。

patterns.name: 药物代谢基因多态性
patterns.context: 说明药物代谢酶基因具有多态性，并列举已知变体等位基因；没有典型的“mutations have been identified”句式。

patterns.name: 基因功能改变导致遗传性状或疾病
patterns.trigger: “Mutations in the human MITF gene are responsible for”及“mutations … have been isolated”
patterns.context: 将特定基因突变与综合征、色素或听力表型相连，并报告独立突变已被发现；兼具突变发现和基因—表型关联。
patterns.domain: 人类遗传学及模式生物研究

en.description: Responds to molecular genetics descriptions of genes, RNA, and genomes in biomedical literature, especially definitions of noncoding RNA, gene mutations and disease associations, and sequence analysis and homology comparisons; also covers expression, transcription, and replication.

patterns.name: Noncoding RNA descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces miRNA in a definitional sentence; activation is concentrated on “non-coding/noncoding” and adjacent RNA descriptors.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, patent background, or paper introduction

patterns.name: Gene mutations and disease associations
patterns.context: Discusses disease-related genes, gene mutations, or identification of disease-causing genes; [1] also concerns the number of mutations and their potential effects.

patterns.name: Genomics and sequence comparisons
patterns.context: Describes genomes, sequence analysis, or similarities, homology, and identity between sequences from different organisms.

patterns.name: Gene expression and transcription/replication
patterns.context: Describes genome transcription and replication, or gene/protein expression in an organism; this pattern occurs only sparsely.

11_2834.concept: 分子遗传学描述
11_2834.description: 响应生物医学文献中基因、RNA及基因组的分子遗传学描述，尤其是非编码RNA定义、基因突变与疾病关联，以及序列分析和同源性比较；也涵盖表达、转录和复制。

patterns.name: 非编码 RNA 描述
patterns.trigger: [3]“Micro RNAs (miRNAs) are noncoding, single-stranded RNA molecules”；[10]“MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are small non-coding RNAs”
patterns.context: 以定义性句式介绍 miRNA 的性质；激活集中在“non-coding/noncoding”及相邻 RNA 描述词。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、专利背景或论文引言

patterns.name: 基因突变与疾病关联
patterns.trigger: [1]“BMP type 2 receptor gene… mutations”；[7]“Mutations in the human MITF gene are responsible for… disorder”；[6]“causative genes have not been identified”
patterns.context: 谈论疾病相关基因、基因突变或致病基因鉴定；[1]还涉及突变数量及潜在效应。

patterns.name: 基因组学与序列比较
patterns.trigger: [2]“Sequence analysis… integrase genes… extensive homologies”；[8]“rice genome contains three PPT candidates… significant similarity”；[9]“genome sequences… 97%-99% nucleotide sequence identity”
patterns.context: 描述基因组、序列分析或不同生物序列之间的相似性、同源性与一致性。
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学、微生物学论文摘要

patterns.name: 基因表达及转录/复制
patterns.trigger: [5]“genome transcription and replication strategies”；[4]“Akt… expressed in mammals”
patterns.context: 说明基因组的转录和复制过程，或基因/蛋白在生物体中的表达；该模式仅少量出现。
patterns.domain: 病毒学、细胞生物学论文

en.description: Activation most often occurs in biomedical contexts involving genes, mutations, sequences, and their identification or disease associations; also covers viral genomes, vaccines, protein abundance, immune susceptibility, and integrases. Patent citation number strings are an exception.

patterns.name: Gene names and molecular biology terminology
patterns.context: Medical or biological narratives discuss genes, mutations, sequences, functions, or identification results; “been” shows particularly strong activation in several examples.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts, background, and research funding text

patterns.name: Specific gene symbols and variants
patterns.context: Proper-name genes, gene families, or susceptibility loci appear in disease or biological contexts, often near mutations, disease associations, or functional descriptions.
patterns.domain: Genetics, disease research, and molecular biology

patterns.name: Viral genomes and sequence identity
patterns.context: Compares genome segments and nucleotide sequence similarity between viral strains or species.

patterns.name: Vaccine construction and noncoding regions
patterns.context: Describes poliovirus candidate vaccines, chimeras, or genetic stability modifications, especially involving the 5′ noncoding region.

patterns.name: Chemical patent citations and numbering
patterns.context: Journal citations, volume and issue numbers, and page numbers appear after compound names; activation is concentrated on number strings rather than an evident gene context.
patterns.domain: Organic chemistry patent background and literature citations

patterns.name: Protein abundance and novel gene identification
patterns.context: First quantifies cell-surface protein abundance, then reports identification and sequencing of a novel gene.

patterns.name: Genetic susceptibility and disease association
patterns.context: Describes associations between genetic susceptibility loci or immune-related genes and disease risk.

patterns.name: Mutations and inherited traits/disease
patterns.context: Describes gene mutations in humans or model animals and their links to phenotypes, syndromes, or functional effects.

patterns.name: Integrase genes and sequence homology
patterns.context: Sequence analysis finds integrase genes in some genetic elements and compares homology within the group.

11_2834.concept: 基因与序列研究语境
11_2834.description: 激活多出现在生物医学文本中的基因、突变、序列及其鉴定或疾病关联语境；也覆盖病毒基因组、疫苗、蛋白丰度、免疫易感性和整合酶。专利引文数字串是例外。

patterns.name: 基因名称及分子生物学术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物学叙述中讨论基因、突变、序列、功能或鉴定结果；多个例子中“been”处激活尤强。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要、背景和研究资助文本

patterns.name: 具体基因符号与变异
patterns.context: 疾病或生物学背景中出现专名基因、基因家族或易感位点，常与突变、疾病关联或功能说明相邻。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、疾病研究与分子生物学

patterns.name: 病毒基因组与序列同一性
patterns.context: 比较病毒株或物种的基因组片段及核苷酸序列相似程度。

patterns.name: 疫苗构建与非编码区
patterns.context: 描述脊灰病毒候选疫苗、嵌合体或遗传稳定性改造，尤其提及5′非编码区。
patterns.domain: 疫苗与病毒学论文摘要

patterns.name: 化学专利引文及编号
patterns.context: 化合物名称之后出现期刊引文、卷期与页码；激活集中于数字串，而非显然的基因语境。
patterns.domain: 有机化学专利背景及文献引用

patterns.name: 蛋白丰度与新基因鉴定
patterns.context: 先量化细胞表面蛋白丰度，再报告新基因的鉴定和测序。

patterns.name: 遗传易感性与疾病关联
patterns.context: 描述遗传易感位点或免疫相关基因与疾病风险的关联。
patterns.domain: 免疫遗传学与资助项目文本

patterns.name: 突变与遗传性状/疾病
patterns.context: 说明人或模型动物中的基因突变及其与表型、综合征或功能影响的联系。

patterns.name: 整合酶基因与序列同源性
patterns.context: 序列分析发现某些遗传元件含整合酶基因，并比较组内同源性。
patterns.domain: 微生物遗传学论文摘要

en.description: Primarily involves the words gene, mutations, and disease and nearby descriptions of identification, variation, and pathogenicity in biomedical genetics text; also occurs in gene expression, protein function, drug metabolism, and document structure markers.

patterns.name: Gene followed by a copula or passive predicate
patterns.context: In genetic or molecular biology narratives, gene is the sentence subject, followed by a description of its mutations, variants, or identification status

patterns.name: Narratives linking genes, disease, and mutations
patterns.context: Introduces genetic variation, disease-causing genes, or disease risk; gene need not be the subject

patterns.name: Gene expression and function descriptions
patterns.context: Describes gene expression, classes, or biological functions rather than directly describing a mutation in a particular gene

patterns.name: Repeated identification/discovery statements
patterns.context: Reports whether mutations, genes, or other entities have been discovered; often occurs in medical research review contexts

patterns.name: General medical mechanisms or metabolic protein narratives
patterns.context: Discusses cellular processes, protein abundance, or drug metabolism; related to genetics through the biomedical domain but lacking a clear shared local trigger

patterns.name: Document markers and page structure
patterns.context: A paragraph contains webpage or document extraction markers and separators; activation occurs near a clinical etiology paragraph

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传基因叙述
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传学文本中 gene、mutations、disease 等词及其附近的鉴定、变异和致病表述；也见于基因表达、蛋白功能、药物代谢及文档结构标记。

patterns.name: gene 后接系词或被动谓语
patterns.trigger: “gene”后接 “have been identified”“is responsible”“has been identified”“is highly polymorphic”等；尤以 “gene”及其后的 “been” 最突出
patterns.context: 遗传学或分子生物学叙述中，gene 是句子主语，后续说明其突变、变异或鉴定情况
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 基因与疾病、突变相关叙述
patterns.context: 介绍遗传变异、致病基因或疾病风险；不一定出现 gene 主语

patterns.name: 基因表达与功能说明
patterns.context: 说明基因表达、类别或生物学功能，而非直接描述某个基因突变

patterns.name: 反复出现的鉴定/发现表述
patterns.trigger: “have been identified”“have not been identified”“have been detected”
patterns.context: 报告突变、基因或其他对象是否已被发现；常处于医学研究综述语境

patterns.name: 一般医学机制或代谢蛋白叙述
patterns.trigger: “Akt regulate numerous cellular processes”“proteins vary in abundance”“CYP2C19 enzyme … metabolism”
patterns.context: 谈细胞过程、蛋白丰度或药物代谢；与遗传基因主题有生物医学领域关联，但不共享明显的局部触发词
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 文档标记与页面结构
patterns.context: 段落含网页或文档抽取标记、分隔线，激活出现在临床病因段落附近

en.description: Primarily involves passive discovery, cloning, and sequencing of genes or related entities, and disease associations in biomedical genetics; also responds to gene variation properties, sequence homology, and descriptions of isoform encoding.

patterns.name: Passive discovery and characterization of genes/proteins
patterns.context: In biomedical papers, a gene, protein, mutation, or related entity is the subject of a report describing its identification, acquisition, cloning, sequencing, expression, or lack of identification; often uses perfect or passive constructions.
patterns.domain: Genetics and molecular biology abstracts, patent background

patterns.name: Gene/locus and disease association
patterns.context: Describes associations or effects linking genetic variants, susceptibility loci, or genes to diseases or phenotypes.

patterns.name: Properties of genes and their variants
patterns.context: A gene is the subject, followed by properties such as polymorphism, variation, or the number of alleles.

patterns.name: Gene sequence homology
patterns.context: Discusses sequence homology between genes in genetic elements.

patterns.name: Gene encoding and isoform counts
patterns.context: States that multiple similar protein isoforms are encoded by different genes.

11_2834.concept: 遗传学研究中的基因表征
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传学中基因或相关对象的被动发现、克隆、测序及疾病关联，也响应基因变异属性、序列同源性和同工型编码描述。

patterns.name: 基因/蛋白的被动发现与表征

en.description: Strongly involves research narratives about genes in biomedical text: gene identification, cloning, sequencing, encoded products, as well as mutations, polymorphisms, and their disease or functional effects; also responds to integrase homology and noise in variation tables.

patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, patent background, and research reports

patterns.name: Genes cloned
patterns.context: Describes the discovery or research history of disease-associated genes, often following descriptions of clinical manifestations.

patterns.name: Gene sequencing
patterns.context: Describes sequencing studies of genes or recombinant materials; “nucleotide sequence” also appears.

patterns.name: Genes encoding or corresponding to proteins
patterns.context: Describes gene products, protein-coding relationships, or functions of nucleic acid sequences.

patterns.name: Variants or mutations and their effects

patterns.domain: Genetic disease, pharmacogenomics, and disease research

patterns.name: Gene polymorphisms and variant alleles

patterns.name: Text or numerical formatting noise
patterns.context: Formatting fragments from tables, variation records, or unreadable text; not fully consistent with the gene research narratives in other paragraphs.

11_2834.concept: 生物医学基因研究叙述

patterns.name: 基因已被克隆

patterns.name: Music works and lyric fragments
patterns.context: Performance or recording descriptions list tracks, with activation concentrated on words in English song titles; unrelated to the biomedical theme.
