patterns.name: 基因变异与突变
patterns.trigger: “gene is highly polymorphic”“variant alleles”“mutations”“mutations have been identified”
patterns.context: 说明疾病相关基因存在多态性、等位变异或突变，常伴随数量和功能影响的描述
patterns.domain: 遗传学、疾病机制及医学研究

patterns.name: 生物医学中的基因术语
patterns.trigger: “gene”“cDNA”“non-homologous end joining”及专业基因或分子名称
patterns.context: 基因、分子机制或遗传疾病相关的专业说明；不一定描述发现或突变
patterns.domain: 免疫学及生物医学研究

patterns.name: 专辑曲目标题中的普通词
patterns.trigger: “More than You Know”“All God's Chillun Got Rhythm”
patterns.context: 音乐现场录音或曲目介绍中，标题里的普通英语词被标记；缺少基因或生物医学语境

en.description: The most salient shared cue is available, especially when describing the availability of resources, products, formats, or information. Other local triggers include hunting, drugs, YAML, chemistry, research, typefaces, holsters, product prices, and regulatory emails; the semantic domains are dispersed.

patterns.name: available followed by resources or information
patterns.context: “available” is followed by a specific obtainable object, or describes content that can be provided; objects include preparation, YAML, solvent, services, typefaces, products, and summary.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, technical documentation, encyclopedias, product copy, business emails

patterns.name: available access
patterns.context: “available” modifies access, expressing the convenience of obtaining a method or capability.

patterns.name: Conditional use of available
patterns.context: “available” appears in a conditional clause, indicating that a format will be used if it is available.

patterns.name: hunting
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of people or groups hunting; one instance is paired with gathering food, and another describes a holster used for hunting.

patterns.name: Drug names and clinical comparisons
patterns.context: Drug names appear in research descriptions comparing newer sleeping pills with existing formulations.

patterns.name: YAML format name
patterns.context: Appears in a description of formats that are alternatives to or supersets of JSON, within the conditional phrase “if available”.

patterns.name: Chemical catalysis terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a chemistry abstract on preparing cyclic products, as a method for generating radical species.

patterns.name: High-loading support materials
patterns.context: Describes support materials used to synthesize compound libraries, alongside solvent-delivery robots.

patterns.name: Cancer centers and pharmacogenomics
patterns.context: Describes laboratory services for cancer research and their areas of analysis.

patterns.name: Typefaces and scripts
patterns.context: Describes Baroque style, Gothic calligraphic roots, and digital versions of related typefaces.

patterns.name: Holster categories and uses
patterns.context: Lists holster types used by military and police, plainclothes personnel, private users, and shooting-sports participants.

patterns.name: Product names and prices
patterns.context: Product sets and individual items are available for purchase, with prices listed.

patterns.name: Regulatory documents and meeting abstracts
patterns.context: Concerns rules and strategic plans issued by regulatory agencies, and says meeting abstracts will be available later.

11_2993.concept: 可获得性及若干词项触发
11_2993.description: 最显著共同线索是 available，尤其用于说明资源、商品、格式或信息可获得；另有 hunting、药物、YAML、化学、科研、字体、枪套、商品价格和监管邮件等局部触发，语义领域分散。

patterns.name: available 后接资源或信息
patterns.context: “available”后面跟具体可获取的对象，或以“available”描述可提供的内容；对象包括 preparation、YAML、solvent、services、typefaces、products 和 summary。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、技术文档、百科、商品文案、商务邮件

patterns.name: available access
patterns.context: “available”修饰 access，表达获得某种方法或能力的便利性。

patterns.name: available 的条件性用法
patterns.context: “available”出现在条件从句中，表示某格式若可用则采用。

patterns.name: hunting
patterns.context: 出现在人物或群体从事狩猎的叙述中；一处与 gathering food 并列，一处说明枪套用于 hunting。

patterns.name: 药物名称及临床比较
patterns.context: 药物名称嵌在比较新型安眠药与现有制剂的研究描述中。

patterns.name: YAML 格式名称
patterns.context: 在 JSON 格式的替代或超集格式说明中出现，且处于“if available”条件短语内。

patterns.name: 化学催化术语
patterns.context: 作为生成自由基物种的方法，出现在环状产物制备的化学摘要中。

patterns.name: 高负载支持材料
patterns.context: 描述用于合成化合物库的支持材料，并与溶剂输送机器人并列。

patterns.name: 癌症中心与药物基因组学
patterns.context: 描述面向癌症研究的实验室服务及其分析领域。

patterns.name: 字体与字样
patterns.context: 描述巴洛克风格、哥特书法根源及相关字体的数字版本。

patterns.name: 枪套类别与用途
patterns.context: 枚举军警、便衣人员、私人用户及射击运动者使用的枪套类型。

patterns.name: 商品名称与价格
patterns.context: 商品套装及单品均可购买，并列出价格。

patterns.name: 监管文件与会议摘要
patterns.context: 涉及监管机构发布的规则与战略计划，并称会议摘要稍后可提供。

en.description: All passages contain highlighted markers, but the most salient shared word is available (8 passages), often indicating that resources, methods, goods, or information can be obtained. hunting (2 passages) and within-word fragments of YAML and plainclothes also occur; no stable pattern accounts for all activations.

patterns.name: available followed by a resource or information
patterns.context: Describes something, a service, method, product, or information as obtainable; the trigger word itself appears in varied syntactic positions and is followed by different content
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: research abstracts, software documentation, project descriptions, encyclopedias, product text, email

patterns.name: Hunting
patterns.context: Appears respectively in accounts of family hunting and gathering in the countryside, and descriptions of holsters intended for hunting and other uses

patterns.name: Within-word fragment of plainclothes
patterns.context: Appears in a description of concealed holsters worn by plainclothes officers; the activation falls on a within-word fragment, and its independent semantic role is uncertain

patterns.name: Within-word fragment of YAML
patterns.context: Appears in a comparison of JSON and YAML formats; the activation falls on a within-word fragment of a format name

11_2993.description: 各段都有高亮标记，但最醒目的共同词是 available（8段），常表示资源、方法、商品或信息可获得。另有 hunting（2段）及 YAML、plainclothes 的词内片段，未见能涵盖全部激活的稳定模式。

patterns.name: available 后接资源或信息
patterns.trigger: “available” 后接对象，如 “available preparation”“available, YAML”“available access”“available solvent delivery robot”“services available”“available at $334.99”“available early tomorrow morning”；均标记为 «available»10
patterns.context: 描述某物、服务、方法、商品或信息可获得；触发词本身在多种句法位置出现，后接内容各异
patterns.domain: 跨领域：科研摘要、软件文档、项目说明、百科、商品文本、邮件

patterns.name: 狩猎
patterns.context: 分别出现在回忆家庭在乡间狩猎采集，以及介绍枪套用于狩猎等用途的语境

patterns.name: plainclothes 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在便衣警员所穿的隐蔽式枪套说明中；激活落在词内片段，是否具有独立语义不确定

patterns.name: YAML 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON 与 YAML 格式的比较中；激活落在格式名称的词内片段

en.concept: hunting forms and sporadic lexical triggers
en.description: Most passages activate on hunting in literal hunting contexts; two passages use hunt figuratively or in the sense of “searching.” Other isolated high-activation words, including misunderstood, available, and Pulmonary, cannot be explained by the hunting pattern.

patterns.name: Hunting activity
patterns.context: Hunting appears as a literal outdoor activity, often alongside gathering, hiking, fishing, or shooting; it can also refer to historical hunting.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, outdoor activity descriptions, historical accounts

patterns.name: Figurative or investment-related use of hunt
patterns.context: Not literal hunting: refers respectively to searching for investment property or the rhetorical phrase “witch hunting.”

patterns.name: Isolated lexical triggers
patterns.context: Appear independently in their respective contexts, without a shared semantic cue connected to hunting or to one another.
patterns.domain: Technology company discussion, clinical trial abstract, medical abstract

11_2993.concept: hunting 词形及零散词汇触发
11_2993.description: 多数段落在实际狩猎语境中触发 hunting；两段是 hunt 的比喻或“寻找”义。另有 misunderstood、available、Pulmonary 等孤立高激活词，无法由狩猎模式解释。

patterns.name: 狩猎活动
patterns.context: 狩猎作为实际户外活动出现，常与 gathering、hiking、fishing、shooting 等并列；也可指历史性的捕猎。
patterns.domain: 百科、户外活动介绍、历史论述

patterns.name: hunt 的比喻或投资用法
patterns.context: 不是实际狩猎：分别指寻找投资房产，或修辞性地说“witch hunting”。

patterns.name: 孤立的词汇性触发
patterns.context: 在各自语境中单独出现，没有与狩猎或其他共同语义线索相连。
patterns.domain: 科技公司讨论、临床试验摘要、医学摘要

en.description: Activation triggers are dispersed: several clusters involve initial P/pl and following fragments, alongside isolated triggers such as hunting, dietary, and Monte Carlo, spanning different topics and styles.

patterns.name: Words beginning with P and their following subword fragments
patterns.context: Triggers occur at initial or internal P/pl fragments, which form different words; in segments 9 and 10, “pls” begins a request.
patterns.domain: Different styles, including medical abstracts, grant texts, encyclopedias, and emails

patterns.name: hunting
patterns.context: Appears in contexts describing a family’s hunting-and-gathering history, or holster uses and hunting activities.

patterns.name: dietary fat-related wording
patterns.context: Appears in a title-like statement about the effects of dietary fat levels and types on performance.

patterns.name: Monte Carlo technique
patterns.context: Appears in research text introducing the development of quantitative analysis methods.

11_2993.description: 激活触发形式分散：多段集中于词首 P/pl 及其后续片段，另有 hunting、dietary 和 Monte Carlo 等孤立触发，分属不同主题与文体。

patterns.name: P 开头词及其后续词片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于词首或词内的 P/pl 片段，后续分别组成不同词；第 9、10 段中“pls”是请求语句的开头。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、资助项目文本、百科与邮件等不同文体

patterns.name: hunting
patterns.context: 出现于描述家庭狩猎采集经历，或枪套用途及狩猎活动的语境。

patterns.name: dietary fat 相关措辞
patterns.context: 出现在研究饮食中脂肪水平与类型对表现影响的标题式表述中。

patterns.name: Monte Carlo 技术
patterns.context: 出现在介绍定量分析方法开发的研究文本中。

en.concept: Initial and within-word splits in academic text
en.description: Activations cluster at the beginnings of paper titles or abstracts, especially in split words: pulmonary and prenatal medical terms, Pulsed, Objective, Collective, Novel, and others. Other scientific vocabulary and abstract-template words also occur, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Pulmonary terms beginning with P
patterns.context: The initial P is split into a token, followed by tokens forming pulmonary; appears at the start of medical titles or abstracts and refers to pulmonary arterial hypertension or lung function.

patterns.name: Other terms beginning with P
patterns.context: The initial P is followed by a split stem token, forming Pulsed or Prenatal; passage 6 contains a technical term, while passages 7–9 are titles related to prenatal diagnosis.

patterns.name: Within-word -ive split
patterns.context: A word is split into a stem and ive, forming Objective or Collective, at the beginning of an abstract or paper title.

patterns.name: Within-word -vel split
patterns.context: Novel is split into No and vel, appearing at the start of a title-like sentence introducing a technical method.

patterns.name: Frequent word splits in title-like academic text
patterns.context: Common academic words at the beginnings of paper titles or abstracts, split at the beginning, within the word, or at an affix; no unified medical semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Research abstract template words
patterns.context: Research questions or topic statements used in medical abstract purpose statements or titles.

patterns.name: Other scientific title terms
patterns.context: Appear as methods, experimental techniques, or research subjects in scientific titles or abstracts; they have no evident shared domain or morphological condition.

11_2993.concept: 学术文本中的词首与词内拆分
11_2993.description: 激活集中于论文标题或摘要开头，尤其是被拆分的词：肺部/产前医学术语、Pulsed、Objective、Collective、Novel 等；另有多种科研词汇与摘要模板词，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: P 开头的 pulmonary 术语
patterns.context: 词首 P 被拆成 token，后续组成 pulmonary；分别出现在医学标题或摘要开头，指肺动脉高压、肺功能。

patterns.name: P 开头的其他术语
patterns.context: 词首 P 后接拆分的词干 token，组成 Pulsed 或 Prenatal；段6为技术术语，段7—9为产前诊断相关标题。

patterns.name: 词内 -ive 分词边界
patterns.context: 词被拆成词干与 ive，形成 Objective 或 Collective，位于摘要标题/论文标题的开头。

patterns.name: 词内 -vel 边界
patterns.context: Novel 被拆成 No 与 vel，出现在技术方法介绍的标题式句首。

patterns.name: 标题式学术文本中的高频词拆分
patterns.context: 论文标题或摘要开头的常见学术词，包含词首、词内或词缀拆分；未见统一医学语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 科研摘要模板词
patterns.context: 医学摘要目的句或标题中使用的研究问题/主题表述。

patterns.name: 其他科学标题词语
patterns.context: 作为方法、实验技术或研究对象出现在科学标题/摘要中；彼此没有明显共同领域或词形条件。

en.description: Activation concentrates on specialized terms in medical and life-science abstract titles: pulmonary/respiratory words, Micro- terms, pregnancy and prenatal words, and various diseases and health topics. No more specific shared semantics are apparent across topics.

patterns.name: Pulmonary and respiratory terminology
patterns.context: Medical titles or abstracts contain terms for lung diseases, respiratory tracts, or pulmonary function tests; one instance is a title about a pediatric airway disease.

patterns.name: Terms beginning with micro-
patterns.context: Biomedical or environmental science nouns beginning with Micro- appear at the start of titles or abstracts; they refer to microRNA, microbial quality, and microplastics.

patterns.name: Prenatal and pregnancy-related terms
patterns.context: Concerns vitamin D metabolism during pregnancy or fetal/prenatal diagnosis.

patterns.name: Other medical diseases or health research
patterns.context: Activation falls on disease names, health problems, or related research topics in medical titles or abstracts; these topics are distinct from one another.

11_2993.description: 激活集中于医学及生命科学摘要标题中的专业术语：肺部/呼吸词、Micro-术语、妊娠与产前词，以及多种疾病和健康主题。不同主题间未见更具体的共同语义。

patterns.name: 肺部与呼吸相关术语
patterns.context: 医学标题或摘要中出现肺部疾病、呼吸道或肺功能检测词汇；另有一例儿科气道疾病标题。

patterns.name: micro- 开头的术语
patterns.context: 标题或摘要开头出现以 Micro- 开始的生物医学或环境科学名词；具体所指分别为微 RNA、微生物质量和微塑料。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、食品质量、环境科学

patterns.name: 产前与妊娠相关
patterns.context: 涉及妊娠中的维生素 D 代谢，或胎儿/产前诊断。

patterns.name: 其他医学疾病或健康研究
patterns.context: 激活落在医学标题或摘要中的疾病名、健康问题或相关研究主题；这些主题彼此不同。

en.description: The most prominent shared feature across segments is tokenization activation around apostrophes and following content, especially possessive ’s. Text topics span neuroscience, medicine, law, obituaries, and webpages, without a unified domain semantics.

patterns.name: Possessive marker
patterns.context: High activation occurs after apostrophes in English possessive contractions, especially word-final “’s”; it also appears on digits or gene names after “’”.

patterns.name: English possessive ’s
patterns.context: An apostrophe is followed by s, commonly in possessives of personal names, disease names, institution names, or technical terms.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal texts, obituaries, and webpage copy

patterns.name: Digits or proper-name fragments after apostrophes
patterns.context: Content after an apostrophe is tokenized as digits or single-letter fragments; beyond possessives, this also occurs in abbreviations, names, or transcription boundaries.
patterns.domain: Papers, webpage copy, obituaries, legal texts

patterns.name: Medical research contexts
patterns.context: Biomedical content includes domain terminology and research descriptions, but activation remains concentrated around apostrophe tokenization.

patterns.name: Non-research webpages and legal texts
patterns.context: Webpage event descriptions, prices and obituary lists, or judicial opinions; no unified domain semantics.

11_2993.description: 各段最突出的共同点是撇号及其后接内容的分词激活，尤其是所有格 ’s；文本主题跨神经科学、医学、法律、讣告和网页，领域语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 所有格标记
patterns.context: 高激活集中出现在英文所有格缩写中的撇号后，尤其是词尾 “’s”，也见于 “’” 后的数字或基因名称

patterns.name: 英语所有格 ’s
patterns.context: 撇号后接 s，常见于人名、疾病名、机构名或术语的所有格形式
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文本、讣告与网页文案

patterns.name: 撇号后数字或专名片段
patterns.context: 撇号后的内容被分词成数字或单字母片段；除所有格外，也出现在缩写、名称或转录边界
patterns.domain: 论文、网页文案、讣告、法律文本

patterns.name: 医学科研语境
patterns.context: 生物医学内容中出现领域术语与研究描述；但激活仍集中在撇号分词附近

patterns.name: 非科研的网页及法律文本
patterns.trigger: “Initiation to Shamanistic Ayahuasca”；“the crux of McDonald’s complaint”
patterns.context: 网页活动介绍、价格与讣告列表，或司法意见；缺少统一领域语义
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页文本、FreeLaw 判决

en.concept: Sentence-initial proper names and terminology fragments
en.description: The most prominent repeated pattern is Joe followed by a surname at the beginning of a sentence (5 segments). Other activations are dispersed across Slovak parliamentary text, medical titles, chemical names and formulas, nucleic acid sequences, and Nascom entry titles; these triggers differ in form.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial name Joe
patterns.context: Joe appears at the start of the context, followed by a surname; only the name or a small amount of following text is captured.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, emails, and webpage text

patterns.name: Slovak Q&A/parliamentary text
patterns.context: Slovak words are segmented into subword fragments, appearing near questions and agenda headings in parliamentary documents.

patterns.name: Nitric oxide topic phrase
patterns.context: The chemical name appears at the start of an abstract title or topic phrase, paired with pain.

patterns.name: Lists of silicon compound names
patterns.context: Multiple silicon compound names and molecular formulas are listed line by line, including chemical symbols and numbers.

patterns.name: Nucleic acid sequence fragments
patterns.context: Sequences of uppercase letters appear next to spaces, line breaks, and text resembling primers or markers.

patterns.name: Nascom entry title
patterns.context: Nascom appears at the beginning of an entry title, followed by the parenthetical description “computer kit”.

11_2993.description: 最突出的可重复模式是句首 Joe 后接姓氏（5段）。其余激活分散于斯洛伐克语议会文本、医学标题、化学名与分子式、核酸序列及 Nascom 条目标题；这些触发形式各异。

patterns.name: 句首姓名 Joe
patterns.context: Joe 位于上下文开头，后续是人名中的姓氏；只截取到姓名或其后少量文本。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、邮件及网页文本

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语问答/议会文本
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语词被拆为子词片段；出现在议会文件的提问、议题标题附近。

patterns.name: 一氧化氮主题短语
patterns.context: 化学物质名称位于摘要标题或主题短语开头，并与 pain 并列。

patterns.name: 硅化合物名称列表
patterns.context: 多个硅化合物名称及分子式按行列出，包含化学符号和数字。

patterns.name: 核酸序列片段
patterns.context: 大写字母组成的序列与空格、换行及类似引物/标记的文本相邻。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学文本

patterns.name: Nascom 条目标题
patterns.context: Nascom 出现在条目标题开头，后接括号说明“computer kit”。

en.concept: Structural and technical fragments across diverse text
en.description: Activations are dispersed across several text forms: terminology, formulas, and units in academic prose; references and citations; and parliamentary text, patent chemical formulas, author affiliations, and alphanumeric lists. No stable word meaning or theme spans all segments.

patterns.name: Scientific terminology and academic prose
patterns.context: Appears in coherent academic sentences spanning medicine, harmonic analysis, astrophysics, geology, and other topics; no stable single term or semantic category is apparent.
patterns.domain: Interdisciplinary paper abstracts and main text

patterns.name: Bibliographic formatting and citations
patterns.context: Reference entries or in-text citations; activation falls on formatting elements such as abbreviations, punctuation, numbering, and author names.

patterns.name: Slovenian parliamentary text
patterns.context: Slovenian words appear as subword fragments, alongside parliamentary meeting headings, line breaks, and document numbers.

patterns.name: Patent chemical formulas and variable definitions
patterns.context: A patent background section explains substituent definitions in a general formula and the chemical groups that can be formed.

patterns.name: Author affiliations and addresses
patterns.context: Title-page-like paper metadata lists institutions, locations, and author names; names and places are segmented into subwords.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric sequences and lists
patterns.context: Repeated combinations of numbers and letters are comma-separated and line-broken, resembling a list or data sequence without a definite semantic context.

11_2993.concept: 多样文本中的结构与专业片段
11_2993.description: 激活分散于多种文本形态：学术正文的术语、公式和单位，参考文献与引文，以及议会文本、专利化学式、作者地址和数字字母列表；没有贯穿所有片段的稳定词义或主题。

patterns.name: 科学术语与学术正文
patterns.trigger: 高亮分布在专业术语、数学表达、数值单位及普通学术词语中，如 «laser»、«bounded»、«subset»、«dispersion»、«sub»-«mm»、«ppm»、«precursor»
patterns.context: 出现在连贯的学术句子中；覆盖医学、调和分析、天体物理、地质学等不同主题，未见稳定的单一术语或语义类别
patterns.domain: 跨学科论文摘要及正文

patterns.name: 书目格式与引文
patterns.context: 参考文献条目或正文中的文献引用；激活落在缩写、标点、编号及作者名等格式成分上

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语词语以子词片段呈现，伴随议会会议题头、换行和文件编号

patterns.name: 专利化学式与变量定义
patterns.context: 专利背景段落说明通式中取代基的定义及可形成的化学基团

patterns.name: 作者单位与地址
patterns.context: 论文首页式元数据，列出机构、地点及作者姓名；姓名和地名被切分为子词

patterns.name: 数字字母序列及列表
patterns.context: 重复的数字与字母组合以逗号分隔并换行，近似列表或数据序列，缺少可确定的语义背景
patterns.domain: StackExchange 内容或格式化序列

en.concept: Proper names and numeric fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activation mainly falls on scientific terms containing Fe and paper metadata, and also appears on 30 in legal text, sports season years, and X11/Fe65 in research abstracts; these patterns have no obvious shared trigger semantics.

patterns.name: Scientific terms with Fe
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of iron spectral lines, ionization, chelation, metallic abundance, or iron-containing superconductors.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, chemistry, biomedicine, condensed matter physics

patterns.name: PACS classification numbers
patterns.context: Lists physics subject classification codes at the end of papers or in metadata.

patterns.name: Numerical legal records
patterns.context: Appears in a legal account of a sentence of “30 months”.

patterns.name: Sports season records
patterns.context: Lists team honors and match results by year.

patterns.name: Protein names in research plans
patterns.context: Discusses how their binding to Beta-APP affects processing and secretion.

11_2993.concept: 异质文本中的专名与数字片段
11_2993.description: 激活主要落在含 Fe 的科学术语及论文元数据，也见于法律中的 30、体育赛季年份，以及科研摘要里的 X11/Fe65；这些模式缺少明显共同触发语义。

patterns.name: Fe 的学科术语
patterns.trigger: “Fe”及其化学、天体物理或材料学上下文，如 “Fe K”, “Fe … chelator”, “[Fe/H]”, “KFe$_2$Se$_2$”
patterns.context: 出现在铁的谱线、电离、螯合、金属丰度或含铁超导体等讨论中
patterns.domain: 天体物理、化学、生物医学、凝聚态物理

patterns.name: PACS 分类编号
patterns.trigger: “PACS numbers:” 后的数字、标点和字母代码
patterns.context: 论文末尾或元数据中列出物理学科分类号
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文格式与元数据

patterns.name: 数字化法律记录
patterns.context: 出现在刑期“30 months”的法律叙述中

patterns.name: 体育赛季记录
patterns.context: 按年份列出球队荣誉与比赛成绩

patterns.name: 科研计划中的蛋白质名称
patterns.context: 讨论它们结合 Beta-APP 对加工和分泌的影响

en.concept: Expressions of results/findings and local stylistic cues
en.description: Activations are dispersed: in academic contexts, difficult outcomes introduced by become, citation years, and reports of findings with found stand out; other instances include religious belief narratives, hyphens in disease names, and historical travel stories.

patterns.name: “become” introducing a contrastive result in academic English
patterns.context: Describes a method or computation becoming extremely difficult due to a particular challenge; become introduces an outcome or state change.

patterns.name: Years in bibliographic citations
patterns.context: A colon and year follow an author name; digit fragments within the year also activate strongly.

patterns.name: Reporting research findings after a citation
patterns.context: States that a person or study found, concluded, or observed a result in a reference or narrative.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and Wikipedia narratives

patterns.name: Volunteering for an assignment in a historical narrative
patterns.context: People want to avoid lengthy official travel, others make excuses, while Zhao volunteers to go.

patterns.name: Belief and practice in religious or spiritual contexts
patterns.context: Mentions Bonpo symbolic beliefs and spiritual practices, or worship, devotion, and righteous resolve in the Bhagavad Gita.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia religious and cultural entries; religious texts and StackExchange citations

patterns.name: Recurring abnormalities in MeCP2 disease research
patterns.context: In a neurogenetic disease context, discusses MeCP2 and cell types or syndromes.

patterns.name: Relaxing the compact Lie algebra condition
patterns.context: Mathematical discussion relaxes a compactness condition to the noncompact case and states the resulting conclusion.

patterns.name: Functional relation result following a mathematical theorem
patterns.context: Cites work by author and theorem number, then states that a functional relation was found.

11_2993.concept: 结果/发现表达及局部文体线索
11_2993.description: 激活分散：学术语境中突出 become 引出的困难结果、引文年份及 found 报告发现；另见宗教信仰叙述、疾病名中的连字符和历史差旅故事。

patterns.name: 学术英语中的“become”转折结果
patterns.context: 描述某项方法或计算因特定困难而变得极难；become 引出结果或状态变化

patterns.name: 文献引文中的年份
patterns.context: 作者姓名后的冒号及年份；年份内部的数字片段也显著激活

patterns.name: 引用后报告研究结果
patterns.context: 文献或叙述中说明某人/某研究发现、得出或观察到某结果
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及 Wikipedia 叙述

patterns.name: 历史叙事中主动承担差事
patterns.context: 众人想躲避漫长公务差旅，其他人找借口，而 Zhao 主动自愿前往

patterns.name: 宗教或灵性语境中的信仰与实践
patterns.context: 提到 Bonpo 象征信仰、灵性实践，或《薄伽梵歌》中崇拜、虔诚信仰与正当决心
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 宗教文化条目；宗教文本及 StackExchange 引文

patterns.name: MeCP2疾病研究中的重复异常
patterns.context: 神经遗传疾病语境，讨论 MeCP2 与细胞类型或综合征

patterns.name: 紧凑李代数条件的放宽
patterns.context: 数学论述从紧致性条件放宽转向非紧情形，并陈述由此得到的结论

patterns.name: 数学定理后的函数关系结果
patterns.context: 按作者和定理编号引用工作，说明其随后发现函数关系

en.description: All passages are from ArXiv scientific papers. Activations cluster on numbers, units, and scientific-notation formats in physical quantities, observational parameters, and instrument specifications, involving energy, mass, distance, brightness, rates, redshift, and detector dimensions.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and symbolic numerical expressions
patterns.context: At values and their units, subscripts or superscripts, and error notation; activation often falls on number, unit, or adjacent symbol tokens
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, high-energy physics, and detector papers

11_2993.description: 所有片段均为 ArXiv 科学论文，激活集中于物理量、观测参数和仪器规格中的数字、单位及其科学记数法格式；涉及能量、质量、距离、亮度、速率、红移和探测器尺寸等。

patterns.name: 数字、单位及符号化数值表达
patterns.trigger: 数字与单位或科学记数法，如“26…15 keV”“10⁹%”“10²⁰ MeV”“1.5×10³² cm⁻² s⁻¹”“100 GeV”“10¹² M☉”“800…to the red”“4 TeV”“10⁻²² eV”“18 m”“690 ton”
patterns.context: 数值及其单位、上下标或误差记号处；激活常落在数字、单位或相邻符号 token 上
patterns.domain: 天体物理、高能物理及探测器论文

en.concept: ArXiv scientific paper formatting and terminology
en.description: Activations often occur in specialized formats and terminology in ArXiv scientific papers: PACS classification codes, section headings, citations, formulas, and numerical values, as well as physics and mathematics topics. Coverage includes nuclear physics, field theory, astronomy, semiconductors, and theorem discussions.

patterns.name: PACS/subject classification numbers
patterns.context: Classification information near the beginning or abstract of a paper; codes consist of digits, decimal points, and letters, often adjacent to commas and line breaks.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata, especially physics classifications

patterns.name: Paper titles and section heading formats
patterns.context: Paper titles or section boundaries, often with line breaks, Markdown/LaTeX markers, or rows of equals signs.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and symbols
patterns.context: Specialized terminology and formulas are interwoven in discussions of particles, nuclear structure, field theory, or gravity-related physics.

patterns.name: Mathematical/statistical methods and theorem terminology
patterns.context: Mathematical objects, error bounds, inequalities, or theorem names appear in method descriptions or theoretical statements.

patterns.name: Scientific citation format
patterns.context: In-text citations use square brackets and @ markers, linking author names to years, journal information, or numbers.

patterns.name: Numerical results, units, and formula fragments
patterns.context: The context reports quantitative results, physical units, or mathematical expressions embedded in prose.

patterns.name: Astronomical observables and data relationships
patterns.context: Discusses astronomical observables, time units, and data scatter or empirical relationships.

patterns.name: Semiconductor and nanostructure classifications
patterns.context: Lists condensed matter physics topics in a classification-style format with corresponding subject codes.

11_2993.concept: ArXiv 科学论文格式与术语
11_2993.description: 激活多见于 ArXiv 科学论文的专门格式与术语：PACS 分类码、章节标题、引文、公式和数值，以及物理、数学主题词；覆盖核物理、场论、天文、半导体及定理论述。

patterns.name: PACS/学科分类编号
patterns.context: 论文开头或摘要附近的分类信息；编号由数字、小数点及字母组成，常与逗号、换行相邻
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据，尤其物理学分类

patterns.name: 论文标题与章节标题格式
patterns.trigger: “[**Introduction**]”“Introduction”“====================”及“BESIII, charmonium decay, proton form factor”等标题文字
patterns.context: 论文标题或章节分隔处，常出现换行、Markdown/LaTeX 标记或等号线

patterns.name: 物理学专业术语与符号
patterns.trigger: “nucleons”“nuclear surface”“shell model”“fermion spinor”“quartic interactions”“renormalize”“spin-0”“higher spin”“Teukolsky system”等
patterns.context: 讨论粒子、核结构、场论或引力相关物理问题时，专业术语与公式交织出现

patterns.name: 数学/统计方法与定理术语
patterns.trigger: “non-asymptotic theorems”“L^p-mean error bounds”“concentration inequalities”“tensor algebra”“MacMahon’s Master theorem”“Molien’s theorem”
patterns.context: 方法或理论陈述中出现数学对象、误差界、不等式或定理名称

patterns.name: 科学文献引用格式
patterns.context: 正文中以方括号和 @ 标记引用，作者名与年份、期刊信息或编号相连
patterns.domain: 学术论文引用与参考文献

patterns.name: 数值结果、单位与公式片段
patterns.context: 上下文报告定量结果、物理单位或嵌入正文的数学表达式

patterns.name: 天文学观测量与数据关系
patterns.context: 讨论天体观测量、时间单位及数据散布或经验关系

patterns.name: 半导体与纳米结构分类
patterns.context: 以分类式条目列出凝聚态物理主题和对应学科代码

en.concept: Structural markers and terminology in academic text
en.description: Activations are scattered across academic formatting markers, PACS classification codes, citations, mathematical symbols, and multidisciplinary terminology, and also respond to hyphenated compounds. Historical descriptions of soldiers and biomedical experiment descriptions also occur, making a single semantic theme difficult to identify.

patterns.name: PACS classification codes in physics papers
patterns.context: Appears in classification metadata near paper title information or body text; activation clusters on code characters and adjacent symbols.

patterns.name: Paper introduction heading format
patterns.context: Section headings or introduction separators at the start of a paper.

patterns.name: Literature citations and bibliography cues
patterns.context: Citations in academic discussion, often accompanied by authors, years, journal abbreviations, or multiple adjacent citations.

patterns.name: Specialized academic terminology and noun strings
patterns.context: Domain-specific terminology appears densely in academic abstracts or body text; trigger points are scattered across different disciplines rather than belonging to one terminology category.
patterns.domain: Physics, mathematics, and biomedical academic prose

patterns.name: Hyphenated compound expressions
patterns.context: A hyphen connects morphemes or repeated words; activation falls on the compound and its local morphological boundary.

patterns.name: Descriptions of people and equipment in historical military narratives
patterns.context: Describes the condition of northern soldiers on the march and in battle, listing their equipment, food, and weapons.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and statistical expressions
patterns.context: Formulas, powers, error bounds, or percentage values are used in body text to express mathematical results.

patterns.name: Biomedical experimental measurement descriptions
patterns.context: Describes phospholipid bilayer vesicles, their NMR spectra, measurement frequencies, and experimental observations.

11_2993.concept: 学术文本中的结构与术语标记
11_2993.description: 激活分散于学术论文格式标记、PACS 分类码、引文、数学符号和多学科术语，也响应连字符复合词；另有历史士兵描写与生物医学实验描述，难归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 物理学论文的 PACS 分类码
patterns.trigger: “PACS numbers”及其后的数字、字母和标点分类码，如“42.65.Tg”“11.610.Gh”
patterns.context: 出现在论文标题信息或正文附近的分类元数据中，激活集中于分类码字符和邻近符号。

patterns.name: 论文引言标题格式
patterns.trigger: “Introduction”及其前后的方括号、星号、换行或等号分隔线
patterns.context: 论文开头的章节标题或引言分隔标记。

patterns.name: 文献引用与参考书目线索
patterns.trigger: “[@...:...:...]”、作者名与年份组成的引用键，以及“Refs.”
patterns.context: 学术论述中引用文献，常伴随作者、年份、期刊缩写或多个引用并列。

patterns.name: 专业学术术语与名词串
patterns.trigger: “spin-0”“higher spin fields”“Teukolsky system”“homotopy Lie algebras”“Coulomb collisions”“bilayer vesicles”等专业名词
patterns.context: 学术摘要或正文中密集出现领域术语；触发点分散于不同学科内容，并非同一术语类别。
patterns.domain: 物理、数学及生物医学学术文体

patterns.name: 带连字符的复合表达
patterns.context: 连字符连接词素或重复词，激活落在复合词及其局部构词边界。

patterns.name: 历史军事叙述中的人物装备描写
patterns.context: 叙述北方士兵在行军与战斗中的状态，连续列举其装备、食物和武装。

patterns.name: 数学符号与统计量表达
patterns.context: 正文用公式标记、幂次、误差界或带百分号的数值表达数学结果。

patterns.name: 生物医学实验测量描述
patterns.context: 描述磷脂双层囊泡及其核磁共振谱、测量频率和实验观察。

en.description: Activations span multiple text domains and involve English function words, proper-name subwords, formulas, and formatting markers; local patterns also include classification numbers, hyphenated descriptions, personal titles, and nuclear physics result words. No stable unified semantic or syntactic condition is apparent across instances.

patterns.name: English word-initial fragments and common function words
patterns.context: Activation falls on initial subword fragments of ordinary English words or phrases across narratives, paper text, and titles; there is no consistent syntactic position or semantic role.

patterns.name: Proper names and internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal subword fragments of people, places, institutions, physics terminology, and other names or words; trigger words vary by text, with no unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, historical narratives, physics papers

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and markers
patterns.context: Local activations occur near paper formulas, citation labels, and mathematical formatting; the papers are all ArXiv papers, but marker forms are not identical.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in classification codes
patterns.context: In a list of PACS numbers following the paper title and author information, digits, periods, and commas occur in sequence and activate.

patterns.name: Hyphenated coordinated adjectives
patterns.context: Repeated well- structures and fragments after hyphens activate in a sentence describing soldiers’ equipment and condition.

patterns.name: Section heading separators
patterns.context: Activations occur near paper-style section titles and their Markdown/text-format boundaries.

patterns.name: Occupational title after a personal name
patterns.context: In a biographical sentence, the occupational title teacher receives the strongest local activation after the name, ethnicity, and description of scholarly identity.

patterns.name: Expressions of action outcomes
patterns.context: In a nuclear physics explanation, result nouns and adjectives activate in a sentence describing nucleons forming isolated clusters or protrusions.

11_2993.description: 激活跨多领域文本，涉及英文功能词、专名子词、公式与排版标记；另有分类号、连字符描写、人物称谓及核物理结果词等局部模式。各处缺少稳定统一的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 英文词首及常见功能词
patterns.trigger: « the»、« in»、« of»、« to»、« and»、« a»
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英文单词或词组的起始子词片段，分布在叙述、论文正文与标题中；并无一致的句法位置或语义角色。

patterns.name: 专名与词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人物、地名、机构、物理术语及其他专名或词语的内部子词片段；触发词随文本而变，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、历史叙述、物理学论文

patterns.name: 数学公式与标记
patterns.context: 论文公式、引用标签及数学排版附近出现局部激活；同为 ArXiv 论文，但标记形式不完全相同。

patterns.name: 分类号中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 紧跟论文标题作者信息后的 PACS numbers 列表中，数字、句点和逗号依次出现并被激活。

patterns.name: 带连字符的并列形容词
patterns.context: 同一段中重复的 well- 结构以及连字符后的词片段被激活，处于描写士兵装备与状态的句子里。

patterns.name: 章节标题分隔符
patterns.context: 论文标题式章节名及其 Markdown/文本格式边界附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 人名后的身份称谓
patterns.context: 人物传记句中，在姓名、族群和学者身份描述之后，职业称谓 teacher 获得该段最强局部激活。

patterns.name: 动作结果表达
patterns.context: 核物理解释中，描述核子形成孤立团簇或凸起的句子里，结果性名词和形容词被激活。

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and structural markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple genres, mainly on in-sentence function words, headings and structural markers, classification numbers, and subwords in proper nouns. Citations, email addresses, religious vocabulary, dramatic plots, and physics terminology also occur, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: In-sentence function words and grammatical connectors
patterns.context: Lowercase prepositions, articles, conjunctions, copulas, or introductory words in ordinary prose, especially at phrase or clause transitions. Activation is usually low.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic prose, paper body text, and other natural-language text

patterns.name: Headings and section labels
patterns.context: Near subsection headings, classification labels, or document-structure markers; often at a line break or the beginning of an entry
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries, papers, and academic documents

patterns.name: Scientific classification numbers and code strings
patterns.context: In disciplinary classification codes such as PACS, activation falls on code fragments made up of numbers, periods, letters, and hyphens

patterns.name: Subwords and syllables within proper nouns
patterns.context: When names of people, places, institutions, or physics terms are split into multiple subwords, activation often falls on internal fragments of the proper noun or term; it does not consistently correspond to a fixed meaning
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies and geography entries, paper author information, and physics body text

patterns.name: Literature citation format
patterns.context: Bracketed author–year citations in body text and adjacent punctuation or citation keys

patterns.name: Symbols and numbers in email addresses
patterns.context: Email addresses in author contact information, especially separators, domain numbers, and local strings

patterns.name: Religious prayer tone and aphoristic statements
patterns.context: Formal prose sentences expressing wishes, exhortations, or aphoristic ideas
patterns.domain: Historical religious or speech texts from Gutenberg

patterns.name: Administrative affiliation of place names in encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: Statements about railway stations and their administrative or railway-system affiliation

patterns.name: Ritual and religious terminology
patterns.context: Encyclopedic paragraphs describing religious worship, scriptures, or ritual categories

patterns.name: Plot and cast in drama entries
patterns.context: A film synopsis followed by a cast list and role assignments

patterns.name: Technical physics discussion in papers
patterns.context: Discussion of decays, form factors, and cross sections in high-energy or particle physics body text

patterns.name: Contrastive discussion after citations in papers
patterns.context: After citing prior work, uses Although to introduce a contrast or research background

11_2993.concept: 异质文本片段与结构标记
11_2993.description: 激活分散于多种文体，主要落在句中功能词、标题与结构标记、分类编号及专名子词；另见引用、邮箱、宗教语汇、戏剧情节和物理术语，未见单一稳定语义触发器。

patterns.name: 句中功能词与连接语法
patterns.trigger: “hits”“and”“the”“of”“how”“on”“is”“Although”“for”等；以及“how all of them escape”“in the vicinity of”等短语
patterns.context: 普通正文句子中的小写介词、冠词、连词、系动词或引导词；尤其出现在短语或从句衔接处。激活强度通常较低
patterns.domain: 百科正文、论文正文及其他自然语言文本

patterns.name: 标题与章节标签
patterns.context: 小节标题、分类标签或文档结构标记附近；常位于换行或条目开头
patterns.domain: 维基条目、论文和学术文档

patterns.name: 科学分类号与编号串
patterns.context: PACS 等学科分类代码中，激活落在数字、点号、字母和连字符组成的代码片段上

patterns.name: 专名内部子词与音节
patterns.context: 人名、地名、机构名或物理术语被切分为多个子词时，常激活专名或术语内部片段；并非稳定对应某个固定词义
patterns.domain: 维基人物与地理条目、论文作者信息及物理学正文

patterns.name: 文献引用格式
patterns.context: 正文中的方括号作者—年份引用及其相邻标点、引用键

patterns.name: 邮箱地址中的符号与数字
patterns.context: 作者联系信息中的电子邮件地址，尤其地址分隔符、域名数字和局部字符串

patterns.name: 宗教祷告语气与格言陈述
patterns.trigger: “bless our efforts”“enlighten us”“It is an axiom that”
patterns.context: 祈愿、劝勉或带格言色彩的正式散文句式
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 历史性宗教或演说文本

patterns.name: 百科条目中的地名行政归属
patterns.trigger: “station is under the administration of the Asansol division”
patterns.context: 介绍铁路车站及其行政或铁路系统归属的陈述

patterns.name: 仪式与宗教术语
patterns.context: 描述宗教崇拜、经典或仪式类别的百科段落

patterns.name: 戏剧情节与演员表
patterns.trigger: “tries to commit suicide”“The rest of the story is how all of them escape”及演员条目中的“as”
patterns.context: 电影剧情梗概后接演员表和角色对应信息

patterns.name: 论文中的技术性物理叙述
patterns.trigger: “charmonium decay”“proton form factor”“Higgs production cross sections”“large top quark mass limit”
patterns.context: 高能物理或粒子物理正文的衰变、形状因子及截面讨论

patterns.name: 论文参考文献之后的转折论述
patterns.trigger: “Although the two decays have been extensively discussed in the literature”
patterns.context: 引用既有研究后，以 Although 引出转折或研究背景

en.description: Activations are scattered across paper structure and citations, astrophysics, biophysics, particle physics, molecular physics, mathematical physics, and historical prose; local token strings are clear in each passage, but no common semantic trigger pattern can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Line breaks and section headings
patterns.context: A paper introduction heading appears after a line break, followed by an underlined-style heading format.

patterns.name: Reference citations and numbering
patterns.context: Author–year citations, bibliography keys, and reference lists appear in the paper body, often alongside numbers, abbreviations, or equations.

patterns.name: Orbital parameters and comparisons
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between increasing distance or changing slope and orbital distributions or inclinations.

patterns.name: X-ray emission and observation
patterns.context: Describes celestial objects emitting intense X-rays due to shock heating, and the detection and measurement of spectral lines.

patterns.name: Phospholipid vesicles and nuclear magnetic resonance
patterns.context: Describes vesicle structure, phase-transition properties, and proton NMR spectra.

patterns.name: Praise of the Red Cross
patterns.context: Describes the reputation and work of the Red Cross and its supporters in a laudatory tone.

patterns.name: Hidden-sector Higgs and theoretical limits
patterns.context: Discusses the origin of dark matter mass and theoretical limits on additional Higgs bosons.

patterns.name: Raman spectra and molecular cluster growth
patterns.context: Identifies pure gas molecules in a low-temperature free jet and tracks their cluster growth.

patterns.name: Spin fields and symmetry operators
patterns.context: Discusses symmetry operators for different spin fields and cites mathematical physics literature.

11_2993.description: 激活分散在论文结构与引文、天体物理、生物物理、粒子物理、分子物理、数学物理及历史散文中；各段局部词串明显，但没有可确认的共同语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 行首换行与章节标题
patterns.context: 行首换行后出现论文引言标题及其下划线式标题格式。

patterns.name: 参考文献引用与编号
patterns.context: 论文正文中出现作者—年份引用、文献键及引文列表；常伴随数字、缩写或公式。

patterns.name: 轨道参数与比较描述
patterns.context: 讨论距离增大或斜率变化与轨道分布、倾角之间的关系。

patterns.name: X射线辐射与观测
patterns.context: 描述天体因激波加热而强烈发射X射线，以及谱线的探测和测量。

patterns.name: 磷脂囊泡与核磁共振
patterns.trigger: 「phospholipid bilayer vesicles」「Proton nuclear magnetic resonance spectra」「360 MHz」
patterns.context: 描述囊泡结构、相变性质及其质子核磁共振谱。

patterns.name: 红十字会的赞誉叙述
patterns.context: 以赞扬口吻叙述红十字会及其支持者的声誉与工作。

patterns.name: 隐藏部门希格斯与理论界限
patterns.context: 讨论暗物质质量来源及额外希格斯玻色子的理论界限。

patterns.name: 拉曼谱与分子团簇生长
patterns.context: 在低温自由射流中识别纯气体分子，并追踪其团簇生长。

patterns.name: 自旋场与对称算符
patterns.context: 讨论不同自旋场的对称算符，并给出数学物理文献引用。

en.concept: Rare proper nouns and specialized text fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across various rare proper nouns, numbers, and specialized symbol sequences, especially South Asian names and places, paper citations, and research terminology. Astrophysical descriptions of degree or change and expressions of ability or willingness in letters also occur.

patterns.name: South Asian proper nouns and place names
patterns.context: Multisyllabic Indian place names, personal names, or political figures, often split into subword fragments; includes station affiliations, biographies, or candidate lists.

patterns.name: Paper citations and year markers
patterns.context: Author–year citations, especially year and author-name subwords within citation markers.

patterns.name: Rapid changes and spectral lines in astrophysics
patterns.context: Describes exposure times in variable-star observations, spectral-line broadening, or high-velocity features and rapid expansion in supernovae.

patterns.name: Theoretical physics formulas and terminology
patterns.context: Formulas, particle-physics expansions, or relativity terminology and their explanations.

patterns.name: Expressions of restrictive intensity or degree
patterns.context: Scientific descriptions of the intensity, speed, or degree of change of observed features; associated with phenomena such as spectral lines and expansion.

patterns.name: Ability and willingness in polite requests
patterns.context: A letter explains why a young doctor was chosen and predicts that the recipient will be more able and willing to devote time.

patterns.name: Plasmid and construct names
patterns.context: Plasmid and construct labels in experimental-method descriptions of cloning between restriction enzyme sites.

11_2993.concept: 稀有专名与专业文本片段
11_2993.description: 激活分布于多类稀有专名、数字及专业符号序列，尤其是南亚人地名、论文引用和科研术语；另见天体物理的程度/变化描述及书信中的能力意愿表达。

patterns.name: 南亚专名与地名
patterns.context: 印度地名、人名或政治人物的多音节专名，常被拆成子词片段；含车站行政归属、人物简介或候选人名单。

patterns.name: 论文引用与年份标记
patterns.context: 作者-年份式文献引用，尤其是引用标记内部的年份及作者名子词。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的快速变化与谱线
patterns.context: 描述变星观测曝光时间、谱线展宽，或超新星的高速特征和快速膨胀。

patterns.name: 理论物理公式与术语
patterns.context: 公式、粒子物理展开式或相对论术语及其解释。
patterns.domain: 理论物理 ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 限制性强度或程度表达
patterns.context: 科研叙述中描述观测特征的强度、速度或变化程度；与谱线、膨胀等现象相连。

patterns.name: 礼貌请求中的能力与意愿
patterns.context: 书信体中解释为何选年轻医生，并预测对方更有能力和意愿投入时间。

patterns.name: 质粒与构建体名称
patterns.context: 在限制性内切酶位点间克隆的实验方法叙述中出现的质粒和构建体标记。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学论文方法部分

en.concept: Technical text markers in academic papers
en.description: Activations are concentrated in ArXiv academic text: citations and author–year markers, split technical terms and proper nouns, numerical formulas, and disciplinary terminology. Topics include physical theory, astronomical observations, and paper title formatting. Some common linking words also activate, but there is no stable semantic collocation.

patterns.name: Bibliographic citations and metadata
patterns.context: A research statement, term, or result is followed by an author–year citation; activations involve author names, years, and tokens near punctuation in the citation.

patterns.name: Technical terms and compounds
patterns.context: Technical terms are split across multiple tokens or formed from hyphens and abbreviations; they occur in dense academic and technical prose.

patterns.name: Quantitative expressions and symbolic notation
patterns.context: Papers contain orders of magnitude, values, units, mathematical expressions, or physical quantities, often alongside technical explanations.

patterns.name: Physical models, theories, and interactions
patterns.context: Discusses theoretical frameworks, particles or fields, symmetries, cosmological conditions, or effective theories, often alongside citations and formulas.
patterns.domain: High-energy physics, field theory, string theory, and cosmology

patterns.name: Astronomical observations and astrophysical phenomena
patterns.context: Describes spectra, velocities, observational exposure conditions, and evolutionary features of stars or supernovae.

patterns.name: Highly activated words at local syntactic connections
patterns.context: These words appear in technical prose across different topics, often linking conditions, causes, modifiers, or purposes; no single fixed collocation is evident.

patterns.name: Section headings and formatting markers
patterns.context: Activations occur near opening paper headings and Markdown or text separators.

patterns.name: Author names and proper nouns split after citations
patterns.context: Names or proper nouns are split by the tokenizer, usually adjacent to citations; they may also be part of the citation marker itself.

11_2993.concept: 学术论文技术文本标记
11_2993.description: 激活集中在 ArXiv 学术文本：引用及作者年份标记、被拆分的专业术语和专名、数值公式与学科术语；具体涵盖物理理论、天体观测及论文标题排版。部分普通连接词也激活，但无稳定语义搭配。

patterns.name: 文献引用与元数据
patterns.context: 出现研究陈述、术语或结果后，接有作者—年份式参考文献；激活涉及引用中的作者名、年份及标点附近 token。

patterns.name: 技术术语及其复合词
patterns.context: 专业术语被拆分成多个 token，或由连字符、缩写组成；出现在密集的学术技术叙述中。
patterns.domain: 物理、天文学及理论研究

patterns.name: 量化表达与符号化记法
patterns.context: 论文中出现阶数、数值、单位、数学表达式或物理量；附近常有技术性解释。

patterns.name: 物理学模型、理论与相互作用
patterns.context: 讨论理论框架、粒子或场、对称性、宇宙学条件或有效理论；常与引文和公式并存。
patterns.domain: 高能物理、场论、弦论、宇宙学

patterns.name: 天体观测与天体物理现象
patterns.context: 描述恒星或超新星的光谱、速度、观测曝光条件及演化特征。

patterns.name: 高激活词位于局部句法连接处
patterns.context: 这些词在不同主题的科技叙述中出现，常连接条件、因果、修饰或目的结构；未见单一固定搭配。

patterns.name: 章节标题与排版标记
patterns.context: 论文开篇标题及 Markdown/文本分隔符附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 引用后作者名及专名切分
patterns.context: 姓名或专名被分词器拆分，通常紧邻文献引用；也可能是引用标记本身的一部分。

en.description: Activations span Indian railway and biography entries as well as physics papers. More salient recurring cues are proper nouns, domain terminology, and number fragments in citation years. Some common syntactic words also activate, but no single semantic theme runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Indian place names and railway-route word fragments
patterns.context: Proper nouns for Indian railways, stations, and administrative divisions appear in sentences; activation falls on split proper-noun fragments and common words in route descriptions.

patterns.name: Year fragments in high-energy physics citations
patterns.context: In citation markers in ArXiv academic text, a year is followed by an author name or citation identifier; year digits activate prominently.

patterns.name: Indian political terms and proper-noun fragments
patterns.context: Biographies contain Indian political and parliamentary terms, names, communities, or place names; activation clusters on political words and split proper-noun fragments.

patterns.name: Black-hole object names and parameter terms
patterns.context: Sentences describe black-hole transients and their properties, such as mass, companion, and distance; activation is distributed across fragments of astronomical names and common words describing parameters.

11_2993.description: 激活跨印度铁路与人物条目及物理学论文；较显著的重复线索是专名、领域术语和引文年份中的数字片段，部分常见句法词也有激活，但没有单一语义主题贯穿全部段落。

patterns.name: 印度地名与铁路路线词片段
patterns.trigger: «Par»«as»«n»«ath» Station, on the Howrah-Delhi grand chord line, is 48 km from Giridih… Asansol division
patterns.context: 印度铁路、车站、行政区等专名在句中出现；激活落在被切分的专名片段及路线描述中的常见词上。
patterns.domain: 维基百科地理与交通条目

patterns.name: 高能物理文献引文中的年份片段
patterns.context: ArXiv 学术文本的引用标记中，年份后接作者名或引用标识；年份数字片段激活突出。

patterns.name: 印度政治人物词语与专名片段
patterns.context: 人物传记中出现印度政治、议会、姓名、社群或地点专名；激活集中在政治词和被拆分的专名片段。
patterns.domain: 维基百科印度人物传记

patterns.name: 黑洞天体名称及参数词
patterns.context: 介绍黑洞暂现源及其质量、伴星、距离等性质的句子；激活分布在天体名称片段和描述参数的常见词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across the digit 9 in citation years, the T in Tamil Nadu, commas after astrophysical parameters, and the words excessive and changing in an observation sentence about pulsating stars; a discussion of complex shell properties has no clear counterpart. Overall, these appear to be multiple local triggers.

patterns.name: Tokenization of digit 9 in citation years
patterns.context: Appears in the year portion of a bracketed citation key; activation falls on a year digit token rather than a term from a single discipline.

patterns.name: Tokenization of Madras/Tamil Nadu place names
patterns.context: In an account of local Indian political history, a place name is expanded with a slash after a mention of the 1967 election in Madras and party alliances.

patterns.name: Comma in variable mass notation
patterns.context: In an introduction to black hole X-ray transients, a comma separates the mass function from parameters such as the companion and distance.

patterns.name: Time variation causing spectral line broadening
patterns.context: An observation description of RR Lyrae pulsating stars explains that short exposures avoid spectral line broadening caused by time variation.

patterns.name: T/U ordinal marker
patterns.context: Here it is associated with local subword segmentation at the same token position and a place-name string; it appears only here, so any relation to general letters or markers is uncertain.

11_2993.description: 激活分散于学术引用年份中的数字 9、Tamil Nadu 的 T、天体物理参数后的逗号，以及脉动星观测句中的 excessive、changing；另有复形壳性论述无明确对应。整体更像多个局部触发。

patterns.name: 数字 9 的引文年份分词
patterns.context: 出现在方括号引用键的年份部分；激活落在年份数字的分词上，而非单一学科术语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及其引用

patterns.name: Madras/Tamil Nadu 地名分词
patterns.context: 印度地方政治史叙述中，提到 1967 年 Madras 的选举与政党结盟后，地名以斜杠连接展开。

patterns.name: 变量质量记号中的逗号
patterns.context: 黑洞 X 射线暂现源介绍中，逗号分隔质量函数与伴星、距离等参数。

patterns.name: 时间变化导致光谱线展宽
patterns.context: RR Lyrae 脉动星的观测说明中，短曝光用于避免随时间变化造成的光谱线展宽。

patterns.name: T/U 序号标记
patterns.trigger: “T”10，出现在 “T” 与后续 “amil Nadu” 的分词边界
patterns.context: 这里与同一 token 位置的局部子词分割及地名字符串有关；仅此处出现，是否与一般字母或标记有关无法确认。

en.description: Activations are distributed across subject–predicate structures in academic text, lists of biographical positions in encyclopedia entries, descriptions of places, and rhetorical questions in literary prose. Some activations also occur near proper nouns. Trigger words and genres vary substantially across corpora.

patterns.name: Subject or noun phrase before the predicate
patterns.context: In scientific or mathematical expository prose, a noun phrase is followed by a copula or similar predicate; activation often occurs between the subject and predicate or immediately beside the predicate. The trigger is not limited to a particular topic.

patterns.name: Lists of people and positions
patterns.context: Near titles, offices, or status descriptions in line-separated entries for political figures, especially the position nouns in the descriptions.

patterns.name: Directions and places in geographical descriptions
patterns.context: Activates when narrative or expository text mentions a place, direction, or region; instances are sporadic and trigger words are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Travel narratives, political history, and historical narratives

patterns.name: Religious personification and emotional narration
patterns.context: Occurs in rhetorical questions that personify a group or institution while describing its feelings, circumstances, or experiences.

patterns.name: Activations near scattered proper nouns or rare words
patterns.context: Activations occur near proper nouns and their segmented fragments, but the sample is insufficient to establish them as an independent trigger pattern; some overlap with geographical or biographical entry patterns.

11_2993.description: 激活分布在学术文本的主语—谓语结构、百科人物职务名录、地点描述及文学修辞问句中；部分专名附近也有激活。跨语料触发词和文体差异明显。

patterns.name: 谓语前的主语/名词短语
patterns.trigger: “The system is lying”“the system is”“NGC 7714 is”“G X 339-4 is”“stars are pulsating”“Delta is (non-pure) shellable”
patterns.context: 科学或数学说明文中，名词短语后接系动词或类似谓语，常在主语和谓语之间或紧邻谓语处激活；触发并不局限于特定主题。

patterns.name: 人名与职务名录
patterns.trigger: “former Chief Minister of Sindh”“Prime Minister of the princely state Junagarh”“former Federal Minister of Pakistan”
patterns.context: 换行排列的政界人物条目中，职务、头衔或身份描述附近出现激活，尤其是描述中的职务名词。

patterns.name: 地理描述中的方位与地点
patterns.trigger: “the most southern point of Spain and of Europe”“in Madras”“in any of his majesty's plantations in America”
patterns.context: 叙述或说明文字提到地点、方位或地区时激活；表现为零散实例，触发词不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 旅行叙述、政治史和历史叙述

patterns.name: 宗教拟人化与情绪叙述
patterns.trigger: “How will … feel”“the Church of God feel”“her long night of toil and difficulty”
patterns.context: 修辞性问句中将群体或机构拟人化，描述其感受、处境或经历时出现。

patterns.name: 离散专名或罕见词附近激活
patterns.context: 专名及其分词片段附近可见激活，但样本不足以判定它们是独立触发模式；部分与地理或人物条目模式重合。

en.description: Activations span Indian place names and personal names, academic technical terms and formulas, historical religious and moral statements, and local police reporting; no single word form or semantic trigger unifies all passages.

patterns.name: Indian people and place names
patterns.context: Indian historical figures, administrative places, transport stops, or political place names appear; proper nouns are often split across multiple tokens, and some passages contain lists of places.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on Indian history, geography, railways, and politics

patterns.name: Technical terms and symbols in academic text
patterns.context: Academic discussion includes specialized mathematical or physical terms, abbreviations, and formula symbols; activations fall on term fragments, symbols, and nearby words.

patterns.name: Quaker religious testimony and moral statements
patterns.context: A historical account introduces a religious group's public position on an issue and quotes a moral statement about ease, affluence, and the labor of others.
patterns.domain: Historical religious documents; old-style Gutenberg prose

patterns.name: Police deployment and local security reporting
patterns.context: Reports that checkpoints are guarded by police and soldiers, gives the number of personnel deployed, and quotes a local police official.

11_2993.description: 激活分布于印度地名与人物专名、学术技术术语和公式、历史宗教道德陈述及地方警务报道；未见单一词形或语义触发点能统一所有段落。

patterns.name: 印度人物与地名
patterns.context: 出现印度历史人物、行政地名、交通站点或政治地名；专名常被拆成多个 token，部分段落中有地名列表。
patterns.domain: 印度历史、地理、铁路与政治的百科条目

patterns.name: 学术文本中的技术术语与符号
patterns.trigger: “simplicial complex”“field”“shellable”“RR Lyrae stars”“spectral lines”“coupled-cluster”“CCSD”“binding energies”“Λ=2.0 fm”
patterns.context: 学术论述中出现数学或物理专门术语、缩写及公式符号，激活落在术语片段、符号和邻近词上。

patterns.name: Quaker 宗教见证与道德陈述
patterns.trigger: “religious society”“Quakers”“publicly testified”“their sentiments”“live in ease and plenty by the toil”
patterns.context: 历史叙述引出宗教团体对某议题的公开表态，并引用有关安逸、富足与他人劳动的道德陈述。
patterns.domain: 历史宗教文献、Gutenberg 旧式散文

patterns.name: 警务部署与地方治安报道
patterns.trigger: “checkpoints manned by police officers and soldiers”“commune police chief”“district police had ordered”

en.description: Activations fall mainly on split fragments of South Asian and Australian proper nouns; there are also local words related to nuclear physics, non-minimal coupling, equation subscripts, and historical quotations, with no consistent semantic trigger across passages.

patterns.name: Indian place names Bang(a)lore / Junagadh

patterns.name: Australian surname fragment Hawthorn

patterns.name: Fragments of Indian names and biographical proper nouns

patterns.name: Spatial localization in nuclear physics

patterns.name: Equation symbol with velocity subscript Fe

en.description: Strong activations fall on on, spatially, himself, the legal phrase for, and fragments of words such as Bangalore, ODI, Sayyid, Hussain, Ooty, and Kendi; topics and semantics are diverse, with no single condition explaining them.

patterns.name: Preposition on

patterns.name: Spatial localization expression

patterns.name: Fragment in the proper name Bangalore

patterns.name: Fragment in the proper name Sayyid

patterns.name: Fragment in the proper name Kendi

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in LaTeX mathematical expressions, especially paired \left/\right delimiters and formula structure; there are also physical symbols, descriptions of paper decay, and local wording in historical, copyright, and judicial texts, with the latter categories differing considerably from one another.

patterns.name: left in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX mathematical expressions, often paired with parentheses, square brackets, or braces, near fractions, variables, or formula structure.

patterns.name: Right delimiter in physical formulas
patterns.context: Closes parentheses or square brackets in mathematical formulas, often adjacent to variables, parameters, or operators.

patterns.name: Long-form LaTeX formula syntax
patterns.context: Dense mathematical formula fragments; activations are scattered near structural commands, variables, and operators.

patterns.name: Functions, parentheses, and quantitative relations
patterns.context: Formulas express quantitative relationships between functions or variables.

patterns.name: Physical symbols and particle notation
patterns.context: Particles, energy, cosmological parameters, or neutrino symbols in physics text; formula notation interleaves with prose.

patterns.name: Religious groups and descriptions of lifestyle
patterns.context: A historical account describes a religious group's position on a social issue.

patterns.name: Copyright legal language
patterns.context: Discusses copyright protection, legal clauses or bills, and an author's views on them.

patterns.name: Conclusion of a judicial decision
