patterns.name: Research plans and decay processes in papers
patterns.context: A paper introduction states which particle decays and related configurations will be studied.

11_2993.description: 激活主要集中于LaTeX数学表达式，尤其成对的\left/\right及公式结构；另见物理符号、论文衰变描述，以及历史、版权和判决文本中的局部措辞，后几类彼此差异较大。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 left
patterns.context: 出现在LaTeX数学表达式中，常与括号、方括号或大括号配对，附近有分数、变量或公式结构。

patterns.name: 物理公式中的右括号
patterns.context: 作为数学公式中括号或方括号的闭合部分，常邻接变量、参数或运算符。

patterns.name: 长篇LaTeX公式语法
patterns.context: 密集排版的数学公式片段，激活散落于结构命令、变量及运算符附近。

patterns.name: 函数、括号与定量关系
patterns.context: 以公式表达函数或变量之间的数量关系。

patterns.name: 物理符号与粒子记号
patterns.context: 物理学文本中的粒子、能量、宇宙学参数或中微子符号；公式符号与叙述文字交错。

patterns.name: 宗教团体及生活方式叙述
patterns.trigger: “Quakers”“testified”“live in ease and plenty by the toil”
patterns.context: 历史叙述中描述宗教团体对社会议题的表态。

patterns.name: 版权法律措辞
patterns.context: 讨论版权保护、法律条款或法案及作者对此的看法。

patterns.name: 司法判决结语
patterns.context: 判决结果以大写格式标示，前文涉及巡回法院、案件及时限或法条主张。

patterns.name: 论文研究计划及衰变过程
patterns.context: 论文引言说明将考察的粒子衰变及相关构型。

en.description: Activations mainly concern left/leave: both “putting someone in a situation, leaving something behind, or depriving them of a remedy” and LaTeX \left; also directional left. Other activations in scientific passages are scattered across technical terms, formulas, and numerical values, and are difficult to explain with a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: left / left without
patterns.context: “left” or “leave” means that a person or party is in a certain situation, that some result is left behind, or that a remedy is lacking; nearby words may include without, with, or phrases describing a state.

patterns.name: left in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A LaTeX math typesetting command occurring with parentheses, functions, or formula structures, rather than the English verb.

patterns.name: left as a direction or spatial marker
patterns.context: A left-right directional marker when describing coordinates, function arguments, or spatial positions.

patterns.name: left concatenated with letters or notation
patterns.context: Used in formulas to delimit a function expression or range of parentheses; overlaps with the mathematical typesetting command pattern, but here activation falls on parentheses and following expressions.

patterns.name: Legal collocation of left followed by without
patterns.context: A party may be left without adequate remedies due to legal proceedings, fines, or injunctions.

patterns.name: left denoting a state of enslavement
patterns.context: “state of” introduces an ongoing condition, and the sentence concerns involuntary servitude; left is not marked, so this may only reflect a nearby-word trigger or weak association.

patterns.name: Other scientific terms and numerical content
patterns.context: Topics include stellar metallicity, atomic spin, critical magnetic fields, and astronomical observational data; activation markers fall on terms or formula elements in their respective fields.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, condensed matter physics, and theoretical physics

11_2993.description: 主要激活 left/leave：既包括“使某人处于某境地、留下或使其缺少补救”，也包括 LaTeX 的 \left；另有方向性 left。其余科学段落中的激活分散于专业词汇、公式和数值，难以用同一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: left / left without
patterns.context: “left”或“leave”表示某人/某方处于某种境地、留下某种结果或缺少补救；邻近可有 without、with 或描述状态的短语。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 left
patterns.context: 作为 LaTeX 数学排版命令，出现在括号、函数或公式结构中，并非英语动词。

patterns.name: left 作方向或空间标记
patterns.context: 描述坐标、函数自变量或空间位置时，作为左右方向标记。

patterns.name: left 与字母或记号拼接
patterns.context: 公式中用于界定函数表达式或括号范围；与数学排版命令模式重叠，但此处激活落在括号和后续表达式上。

patterns.name: left 后接 without 的法律搭配
patterns.context: 当事人因法律程序、罚款或禁令而可能被置于没有充分救济的境地。

patterns.name: left 表示奴役状态
patterns.context: “state of”引出一种持续状态，句中涉及非自愿奴役；未标记 left，可能只是邻近词触发或弱相关。
patterns.domain: 历史/宗教社会议题叙述

patterns.name: 其他科学术语与数值内容
patterns.trigger: 本段没有明确的 left/leave 触发 token
patterns.context: 天体金属丰度、原子自旋、临界磁场及天文观测数据等内容；激活标记落在各自领域术语或公式成分上。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、凝聚态物理及理论物理

en.description: Mainly responds to the left-parenthesis structure in mathematical formulas, \left(; also activates on uses of left/leave meaning being put in a situation or direction, and on a few isolated word fragments (Habib, soundness). These occur across genres, and the latter associations are weaker.

patterns.name: Left parenthesis in LaTeX mathematics
patterns.context: In mathematical formulas, \left is immediately followed by a left parenthesis, especially before a variable, expression, or summation term; activation concentrates on the parenthesis and nearby mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: left in legal texts
patterns.context: Describes someone being put in a situation or facing a consequence, common in legal arguments; the similar form leave also appears once.

patterns.name: Literal directional word left
patterns.context: Appears as an ordinary directional word describing an object or event, rather than a formula or legal situational expression.

patterns.name: Literary expression containing left
patterns.context: left appears in a historical narrative, but its meaning and collocation do not form an evident stable pattern.

patterns.name: Partial sender name in an email header
patterns.context: A name in email metadata is split into multiple tokens; activation falls on a subword of Habib.

patterns.name: soundness in acknowledgments
patterns.context: An acknowledgment praises the soundness of a business arrangement; activation focuses on a fragment within soundness.

11_2993.description: 主要响应数学公式中 \left( 的左括号结构；另对 left/leave 表示置于某种处境或方向的用法，以及若干孤立词片段（Habib、soundness）有激活，跨文体且后几类关系较弱。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学中的左括号
patterns.context: 数学公式里 \left 后紧接左圆括号，尤其后面跟变量、表达式或求和项；激活集中在括号及邻近数学符号。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 left
patterns.trigger: “be left without a remedy”中的 «left»；另有 «leave» me with
patterns.context: 描述某人被置于某种处境或后果中，常见于法律论述；近形词 leave 也出现一次。
patterns.domain: 法律文书与叙述性文本

patterns.name: left 的字面方向词
patterns.context: 作为普通方向词出现在对物体或事件的描述中，而非公式或法律处境表达。

patterns.name: 带 left 的文献表达
patterns.context: 历史叙述中出现 left，但含义和搭配未形成明显稳定模式。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的发件人姓名局部
patterns.context: 邮件元数据中姓名被拆分为多个 token；激活落在 Habib 的子词部分。

patterns.name: 致谢中的 soundness
patterns.context: 感谢文字中评价商业安排的可靠性，激活集中在 soundness 的词内片段。

en.concept: left/leave and sparse triggers across domains
en.description: Activations do not form a single theme: they occur repeatedly on left/leave in expressions about lacking a remedy or describing an outcome, and also appear in mathematical left parentheses, nuclear physics nuclides and decay, historical quotations, dates in entertainment reporting, and legal inference language.

patterns.name: Remedy language that leaves a party unharmed
patterns.context: The trigger words left/leave collocate with without, with, or remedy, describing an outcome; in legal passages this often means no remedy, with another instance in a general first-person expression

patterns.name: Comfortable and prosperous living
patterns.context: A quotation about living comfortably and prosperously through the labor of others
patterns.domain: Historical, religious, or social issue texts

patterns.name: left in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Use of the LaTeX left-parenthesis command in mathematical formulas, with formula symbols nearby

patterns.name: Light nuclides and mass-number ranges
patterns.context: Discusses light nuclides, ions, and their ranges of atomic numbers

patterns.name: Dates in awards reporting
patterns.context: Date lines appear in entertainment news headlines or awards reporting excerpts

patterns.name: Inference or adjudication language
patterns.context: A qualified comment on whether evidence is sufficient to support an inference or adjudication

patterns.name: Radioactive decay rates and nuclide symbols
patterns.context: Compares observed decay rates with the decay of a particular cobalt isotope, including a nuclide symbol

11_2993.description: 激活并非单一主题：多次出现在 left/leave 与无救济或结果表述中，也散见于数学左括号、核物理核素与衰变、历史引文、娱乐报道日期及法律推论措辞。

patterns.name: 使当事方免于受损的救济表述
patterns.trigger: “left without adequate remedy”“be left without a remedy”“leave me with”
patterns.context: 触发词 left/leave 与 without、with 或 remedy 等搭配，描述留下某种结果；法律段落中常指无救济，另有一般第一人称表述
patterns.domain: 法律论述（另见文学版权论述）

patterns.name: 生活安逸与富足
patterns.context: 引述通过他人劳动而过安逸富足生活的表述
patterns.domain: 历史、宗教或社会议题文本

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 left
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式里使用左侧括号命令，附近含公式符号

patterns.name: 轻核素与质量数范围
patterns.context: 讨论轻核素、离子及其原子序数范围

patterns.name: 奖项报道中的日期
patterns.context: 娱乐新闻标题或奖项报道片段中出现日期行

patterns.name: 推论或裁断措辞
patterns.trigger: “pressing the matter too far”“warrant an inference”
patterns.context: 对证据是否足以支持某项推论或裁断作限制性评论

patterns.name: 放射性衰变率与核素符号
patterns.context: 比较观测衰变率与特定钴同位素衰变，含核素符号

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal, scientific, sports, and literary-historical texts. Local cues respectively involve evaluative judgments, records, nuclides or experimental results, legal relief, aesthetic change, and labor and living conditions; there is no clear shared word form or topic.

patterns.name: Incomplete judgment/opinion expression
patterns.context: An evaluation or opinion follows “leave me with,” and the sentence is unfinished; activation is concentrated around me and with exactly the opinion.

patterns.name: Nuclides and neutron abundance
patterns.context: Describes neutron excess, nuclides, and their reactions in astrophysics or nuclear physics.

patterns.name: Sports records and performance
patterns.context: Compares the pace of scoring a cricket century, balls faced, or historical records.

patterns.name: Particle physics states and thresholds
patterns.context: Discusses resonance or non-resonance production cross-sections and the position of charmonium states relative to thresholds.

patterns.name: Legal injunctions and relief
patterns.context: A court considers an injunction to prevent harm to a party and describes the consequences of inadequate relief.

patterns.name: Supernova decay rates and nuclides
patterns.context: Compares an observed decay rate or magnitude with cobalt-56 decay; activations involve formulas, symbols, and nuclide notation.

patterns.name: Evaluative judgment about something
patterns.context: Uses would be to introduce a positive evaluation of a proposed activity, with evaluative words such as interesting and fitting nearby.

patterns.name: Experimental results confirm neutrino oscillations
patterns.context: Reports experimental results and corroborates them with neutrino observations from another experiment.

patterns.name: Aesthetic change and contrast
patterns.context: Contrasts a formerly admired beauty with a later shift toward unadorned natural beauty; includes evaluative and change-related language.

patterns.name: Lifestyle and labor
patterns.context: Discusses a luxurious, affluent life dependent on the labor of others, quoting a religious group's position on the issue.

11_2993.description: 激活分散于法律、科学、体育与文学历史文本，局部线索分别涉及判断评价、纪录、核素/实验结果、法律救济、审美变化及劳作生活；没有明显共享的具体词形或主题。

patterns.name: 未完成判断/观点表达
patterns.trigger: “will leave me with exactly the opinion”
patterns.context: “leave me with”后接评价或观点，句子尚未结束；激活集中在 me 和 with exactly the opinion 一带。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、版权法律议题（Gutenberg）

patterns.name: 核素与中子丰度
patterns.context: 天体物理或核物理中描述中子过剩、核素及其反应。

patterns.name: 体育纪录与成绩
patterns.context: 比较板球百球得分速度、用球数或历史纪录。

patterns.name: 粒子物理态及阈值
patterns.context: 讨论共振或非共振产生截面，以及粲偶素态相对于阈值的位置。

patterns.name: 法律禁令与救济
patterns.context: 法院为避免一方受损而考虑禁令，描述未获充分救济的后果。

patterns.name: 超新星衰变率及核素
patterns.context: 用观测衰变率或星等与钴-56衰变作比较；激活涉及公式、符号与核素标记。

patterns.name: 对某事物的评价判断
patterns.trigger: “It would be an interesting and fitting thing”
patterns.context: 以 would be 引出对拟议活动的正面评价，interesting、fitting 等评价词相邻。

patterns.name: 实验结果确认中微子振荡
patterns.context: 报告实验结果并将其与另一实验的中微子观测相印证。

patterns.name: 美感变化与对照
patterns.context: 对比过去受欣赏的美与后来转移到未经修饰的自然美；含有评价与转变叙述。

patterns.name: 生活方式与劳作
patterns.trigger: “to live in ease and plenty by the toil of those”
patterns.context: 讨论奢逸富足的生活依赖他人劳作，引用宗教团体关于相关议题的表态。

en.description: Activations are distributed across formula-like mathematical/scientific texts, technical terms mixed with symbols, ordinary English prose, email headers, and copyright and historical narratives; there is no single reliable semantic trigger, and local high responses may be related to formulas or text formatting.

patterns.name: Special functions, quantifiers, or intervals in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In mathematical or theoretical physics paper formulas, symbol commands occur next to parentheses, intervals, or variables; not a single mathematical object

patterns.name: Scientific terms and symbolic proper names
patterns.context: In specialized scientific texts, terms, astronomical categories, particles, or model names are mixed with formula symbols
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers in astronomy, particle physics, materials simulation, etc.

patterns.name: English function words or ordinary narrative fragments
patterns.context: Frequent words and phrases in ordinary English prose, without a shared narrow semantic condition
patterns.domain: Historical narratives and scientific paper body text

patterns.name: Fields and names in email headers
patterns.context: Headers in forwarded emails or discussion threads, including sender and date fields

patterns.name: Religious communities and accounts of living conditions
patterns.context: Historical texts describe public statements by Quakers, as well as comfort, prosperity, and labor

patterns.name: Copyright language and author opinion
patterns.context: Discussion related to a copyright bill, with the author expressing a personal view of the bill's impact

11_2993.description: 激活分布在公式化的数学/科学文本、专业术语与符号混排、普通英文正文、邮件头及版权和历史叙述中；没有单一可靠语义触发条件，局部高响应可能与公式或文本格式有关。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的特殊函数、量词或区间
patterns.context: 数学或理论物理论文公式中，符号命令与括号、区间或变量相邻；并非某个单一数学对象

patterns.name: 科学术语与符号化专名
patterns.context: 专业科学文本中，术语、天体类别、粒子或模型名称与公式符号混排
patterns.domain: 天文学、粒子物理、材料模拟等 ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 英文功能词或普通叙述片段
patterns.context: 普通英文正文中的高频词及短语；缺乏共同的窄语义条件
patterns.domain: 历史叙述与科学论文正文

patterns.name: 邮件头中的字段与姓名
patterns.context: 邮件转发或讨论串的头部，包含发件人、日期等字段

patterns.name: 宗教社群与生活状况叙述
patterns.context: 历史文本叙述贵格会公开表态，以及安逸、富足与劳动

patterns.name: 版权措辞与作者意见
patterns.context: 版权法案相关讨论，作者表达对法案影响的个人看法

en.concept: Professional texts and structural markers across domains
en.description: Activations span mathematical formulas and theorems, several theoretical and observational physics topics, as well as email headers, copyright prose, and case citations; each domain has its own local triggers, with no single content theme running through all passages.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula structures
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols, variables, and LaTeX control sequences occur densely; activations fall on various tokens in formulas, rather than being limited to a specific symbol.
patterns.domain: Formulas in mathematics and theoretical physics papers

patterns.name: Theorems and mathematical exposition
patterns.context: Formal statements concerning inequalities, theorems, and variable ranges.

patterns.name: Astrophysical observations and frequencies
patterns.context: Describes stellar types, oscillation modes, and their characteristic frequencies.

patterns.name: Gravity and Lifshitz theory
patterns.context: Discusses Lifshitz-type systems and compares them with results from the gravity side.

patterns.name: Meson decays and the Standard Model
patterns.context: Describes meson processes induced by quark transitions, and mentions the Standard Model and its extensions.

patterns.name: Email headers and names
patterns.context: Proper names and email formatting in email subject, sender, and date fields.

patterns.name: Copyright terms and expression of opinion
patterns.context: Discusses copyright language and expresses a first-person judgment about the bill's impact.

patterns.name: Case citations and judicial outcomes
patterns.context: Court case citations and descriptions of appellate court decisions that affirm in part and reverse in part.

11_2993.concept: 多领域专业文本与结构标记
11_2993.description: 激活覆盖数学公式与定理、多个理论和观测物理主题，以及邮件头、版权散文和判例引注；不同领域中各自有明确局部触发，未见单一内容主题贯穿全部片段。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式结构
patterns.context: 数学符号、变量及 LaTeX 控制序列密集出现；激活落在公式中的多种 token 上，不限于某个具体符号。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论物理论文的公式

patterns.name: 定理与数学论述
patterns.context: 围绕不等式、定理及变量范围的正式陈述。

patterns.name: 天体物理观测与频率
patterns.context: 描述恒星类型、振荡模式及其典型频率。

patterns.name: 引力与 Lifshitz 理论
patterns.context: 讨论 Lifshitz 型系统，并与引力侧结果作比较。

patterns.name: 介子衰变与标准模型
patterns.context: 描述由夸克跃迁诱发的介子过程，并提及标准模型及其扩展。

patterns.name: 邮件头与人名
patterns.context: 邮件主题、发件人和日期字段中出现的专名及邮件格式。

patterns.name: 版权条款与意见表达
patterns.context: 讨论版权法措辞，并以第一人称表达对法案影响的判断。

patterns.name: 判例引证与裁判结果
patterns.context: 法院判例引注及上诉法院部分维持、部分撤销的裁判描述。

en.concept: Symbols and terminology in academic technical texts
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in passages with dense LaTeX symbols, parentheses, and formula structures; there are also scattered responses to copyright rights language, email header fields, Fermi-level/spin terms, and stellar oscillation terminology.

patterns.name: Specific symbols and parentheses in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematical formulas, especially where parentheses, fractions, subscripts/superscripts, and Greek letters are dense; this pattern spans multiple formula excerpts, though not all these commands trigger in every passage.

patterns.name: Labels or environment endings in formula fragments
patterns.context: At the end of formula or array environments, next to markers or typesetting control characters.

patterns.name: rights in copyright text
patterns.context: Prose discussing copyright notices, copyright law, or reservation-of-rights language.

patterns.name: Fields and values in email headers
patterns.context: Headers in forwarded emails or discussion threads, containing sender and date information.

patterns.name: Fermi and spin terminology in condensed matter physics
patterns.context: Discusses the density of states near the Fermi level and the temperature dependence of susceptibility.

patterns.name: Stellar oscillation terminology and frequency ranges
patterns.context: Compares stellar types and the frequencies of their oscillation modes.

11_2993.concept: 学术技术文本中的符号与术语
11_2993.description: 激活主要集中于含密集 LaTeX 符号、括号与公式结构的片段；另对版权权利措辞、邮件头字段、费米能级/自旋术语及恒星振荡术语有零星响应。

patterns.name: 数学排版中的特定符号与括号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式中，尤其是括号、分式、上下标及希腊字母密集出现时；该模式覆盖多个公式片段，但并非这些命令都在每段触发。

patterns.name: 公式片段中的标签或环境结束
patterns.context: 公式或数组环境末尾、紧邻标记或排版控制符时。

patterns.name: 版权文字中的 rights
patterns.context: 讨论版权声明、版权法或权利保留措辞的散文语境。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 文学文本／版权讨论

patterns.name: 邮件头中的字段和值
patterns.context: 邮件转发或讨论串的头部，含发件人和日期信息。

patterns.name: 凝聚态物理中的费米与自旋术语
patterns.context: 讨论费米能级附近的态密度及磁化率随温度变化。

patterns.name: 恒星振荡术语与频率范围
patterns.context: 比较恒星类型及其振荡模式频率。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of local fragments: tokenized names, LaTeX formula symbols and commands, first-person me in copyright discussion, astrophysical terminology, legal citation abbreviations, and wording about enslavement; no unified semantic trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: F and Hab in a person's name
patterns.context: A person's name appears in an email header, with name tokenization especially salient.

patterns.name: Specific symbols and structures in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical expressions, integrals, or formula environments; activations are scattered across formula symbols, commands, and adjacent structure.

patterns.name: me in statements about bills and copyright
patterns.context: First-person narration about the possible personal impact of a copyright bill.

patterns.name: Elemental abundances in astrophysics
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between red giant color and overall metallicity or iron abundance.

patterns.name: Case citation abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Abbreviated format for court citations and appellate dispositions.

patterns.name: Wording about enslavement
patterns.context: Describes the condition of people involuntarily enslaved in a sentence discussing a religious denomination and opposition to slavery.

11_2993.description: 激活分布于多类局部片段：姓名分词、LaTeX公式符号与命令、版权叙述中的第一人称me、天体物理术语、法律引证缩写及奴役状态措辞；未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 人名中的 F 与 Hab
patterns.context: 邮件头中出现个人姓名，尤其姓名分词被标记

patterns.name: 数学公式中的特定符号与结构
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式、积分或公式环境；激活分散在公式符号、命令和相邻结构上

patterns.name: 法案与版权表述中的 me
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述版权法案可能带来的个人影响

patterns.name: 天体物理学中的元素丰度
patterns.context: 讨论红巨星颜色与总体金属丰度或铁丰度的关系

patterns.name: 法律引证中的判例缩写
patterns.context: 法院判决引证及上诉处理情况的缩写格式

patterns.name: 奴役状态的措辞
patterns.context: 描述被非自愿奴役者的状态，且句子谈及宗教派别及反对奴役

en.description: Activations are highly diverse: many cluster on delimiters, punctuation, and LaTeX structures in ArXiv formulas, and also cover equations and physics terms; there are scattered responses to email names, copyright text, Thai place names, and literary aesthetic description.

patterns.name: Right parentheses and punctuation in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Parentheses, commas, or periods occur near LaTeX mathematical expressions and formula boundaries; activations often fall on right delimiters and formula punctuation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers, including integrals, functions, and formula environments

patterns.name: Text separators and where after formulas
patterns.context: Within or after formula environments, especially when formula expressions are followed by explanatory text, labels, or definitions.

patterns.name: Boundary-value problem statements in mathematics papers
patterns.context: A paper introduces a boundary-value problem and lists equations in an aligned environment.
patterns.domain: ArXiv partial differential equations or mathematical analysis

patterns.name: Subscripts and infinite-series notation for mathematical objects
patterns.context: Indices, subscripts/superscripts, and summation or series notation appear in succession in formulas.

patterns.name: Split names in email headers
patterns.context: Personal names in the From field of email headers are split into several subword fragments.

patterns.name: Copyright notices and legal text
patterns.context: Discusses copyright notices, insertion of formulas, or a copyright bill; the text includes quotation marks and line breaks.

patterns.name: Tokenization of Thai place names as personal names
patterns.context: Place names are split into multiple subword fragments and occur in place names and administrative region names.

patterns.name: Scientific terminology for energy-level spacing
patterns.context: Explains the spacing between adjacent energy levels and its distribution and level repulsion.

patterns.name: Literary descriptions of aesthetics and decay
patterns.context: A long sentence contrasts the forgetting of former beauty with people's appreciation of another, unadorned beauty.

patterns.name: Temperature, chemical potential, and phase diagrams
patterns.context: Discusses long-range correlations, restricted to the zero-momentum mode.

11_2993.concept: 混合的结构与片段特征
11_2993.description: 激活分布很杂：多处集中于ArXiv公式的定界符、标点和LaTeX结构，也覆盖方程、物理术语；另对邮件姓名、版权文字、泰国地名和文学审美描写有零散响应。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的右括号与标点
patterns.context: 括号或逗号、句点出现在 LaTeX 数学表达式及公式边界附近；激活常落在右侧定界符和公式标点。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文，含积分、函数及公式环境

patterns.name: 数学公式中的文本分隔与公式后 where
patterns.context: 公式环境中或公式之后，尤其公式表达式接续解释性文字、标签或定义时。

patterns.name: 数学论文的边界值问题陈述
patterns.context: 论文以引导语引出边界值问题，并在对齐环境中列出方程。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 偏微分方程或数学分析

patterns.name: 数学对象的下标与无穷级数记法
patterns.context: 公式中索引、上下标和求和或级数记法成串出现。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的姓名拆分
patterns.context: 邮件头的 From 字段中，个人姓名被拆成若干子词片段。

patterns.name: 版权声明与法律文字
patterns.context: 讨论版权声明、公式插入或版权法案，文字中夹有引号和换行。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书信或非虚构文本

patterns.name: 泰国地名的人名式分词
patterns.context: 地名被拆成多个子词片段，出现在地点名与行政区名称中。

patterns.name: 能级间距的科学术语
patterns.context: 解释相邻能级之间的间距及其分布、能级排斥。

patterns.name: 文学性审美与衰败描写
patterns.context: 以长句和对照描写昔日美貌被遗忘、众人转而欣赏另一种未经修饰的美。

patterns.name: 温度、化学势与相图
patterns.context: 讨论长程关联，并限定到零动量模式。

en.concept: Formulas and structural markers in scientific text
en.description: Most activations occur in LaTeX mathematical formulas in scientific text, favoring right-hand delimiters, Greek letters, integrals and differentials, and formula-environment markers; there are also sporadic activations on condensed matter physics terminology, email header fields, and copyright wording.

patterns.name: Right parentheses in LaTeX math environments
patterns.context: Occurs especially at closing parentheses or delimiters in mathematical formulas; often adjacent to equations, subscripts or superscripts, or punctuation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv/scientific paper mathematical typesetting; also medical paper formulas

patterns.name: Integral expressions and differential variables
patterns.context: Near integrands and differential symbols in integral formulas; often at the end of a formula line or in an alignment environment.

patterns.name: Formula markers and environment endings
patterns.context: Near equation numbers, reference labels, or the end of an alignment environment for displayed equations.

patterns.name: Greek letters and parameter formulas
patterns.context: Symbolic expressions for parameters, functions, or variables in mathematical formulas; usually co-occurs with delimiters and subscripts or superscripts.

patterns.name: Physics term Fermi liquid
patterns.context: A physics prose passage discussing high density of states, Fermi energy, and spin susceptibility.

patterns.name: Email subject and sender fields
patterns.context: Email reply headers followed by a subject, email address, name, and date.

patterns.name: Copyright language and insertions or deletions
patterns.context: Discusses whether copyright text covers insertions, deletions, or language reserving rights.

11_2993.concept: 科学文本中的公式与结构标记
11_2993.description: 多数激活出现在科学文本的 LaTeX 数学公式中，偏向右侧定界符、希腊字母、积分微分及公式环境标记；另对凝聚态物理术语、邮件头字段和版权措辞有零星激活。

patterns.name: LaTeX数学环境中的右括号
patterns.context: 数学公式中，尤其是括号或定界符闭合处；常邻接公式、上下标或标点。
patterns.domain: ArXiv/科学论文数学排版；另见医学论文公式

patterns.name: 积分表达式及微分变量
patterns.context: 积分公式中，被积函数和积分微分符号附近；常处于公式行尾或对齐环境。

patterns.name: 公式标记与环境收尾
patterns.context: 显示公式的编号、引用标签或对齐环境收尾附近。

patterns.name: 希腊字母与参数公式
patterns.context: 数学公式中参数、函数或变量的符号表达；通常与定界符、上下标同现。

patterns.name: 物理术语 Fermi liquid
patterns.context: 讨论高态密度、费米能级和自旋磁化率的物理叙述段落。

patterns.name: 邮件标题与发件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件回复头部，后接主题、邮箱地址、姓名与日期。

patterns.name: 版权措辞及插入删节
patterns.context: 讨论版权文本是否涵盖插入、删节或保留权利措辞。
